translations.translation: parama karuNAmaYa, asIma daYAlu AllAhara nAme (zuru karachi)|
AllAharai janya samasta prazaMsA, yini vizvajagatera rAvva|
yini parama daYAlu, atizaYa karuNAmaYa|
yini vicAra dinera mAlika|
AmarA ApanArai ivAdAta karachi evaM ApanArai nikaTa sAhAyya cAcchi|
AmAderake sarala saThika patha pradarzana karuna|
tAdera patha, yAdera prati Apani anugraha karechena| tAdera pathe naYa, yAdera prati ApanAra gayava varSita haYeche, tAdera pathao naYa yArA pathabhraSTa haYeche| AmIna!!
Alipha-lAma-mIma|
ihA ai grantha yAra madhye kona sandeha-saMzaYera avakAza nei; dharma-bhIrudera janya e grantha pathanirdeza|
yArA adRzya viSaYagulite vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM sAlAta pratiSThA kare evaM Ami tAderake ye upajIvikA pradAna karechi tA hate dAna kare thAke |
evaM tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche o tomAra pUrve yA avatIrNa haYechila, yArA tadviSaYe vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM AkhirAtera prati yArA dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkhe|
erAi tAdera ravera pakSa hate prApta hidAYAtera upara pratiSThita raYeche evaM erAi pUrNa saphalakAma|
nizcaYai yArA avizvAsa karache tAdera janya ubhaYai samAna; tumi tAderake bhaYa pradarzana kara vA nA kara, tArA ImAna AnavenA|
AllAha tAdera antarasamUhera upara o tAdera karNasamUhera upara moharAMkita kare diYechena evaM tAdera cakSusamUhera upara AvaraNa par3e Ache evaM tAdera janya raYeche bhaYAnaka zAsti|
Ara mAnuSera madhye emana loka Ache yArA vale, AmarA AllAhara upara evaM zeSa dinera upara ImAna enechi, athaca tArA moTei ImAnadAra naYa|
tArA AllAha o mu’minadera saGge dho~kAvAjI kare| prakRta pakSe tArA nijedera vyatIta Ara kArao sAthe dho~kAvAjI karenA, athaca tArA e samvandhe anubhava karate pArenA|
tAdera antare pIr3A raYeche, paranta AllAha tAdera pIr3A Arao vAr3iYe diYechena evaM tAdera janya gurutara zAsti raYeche yehetu tArA asatya valata|
evaM yakhana tAderake valA haYaH tomarA pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi karanA takhana tArA valeH AmarAto zudhui zAnti sthApanakArI|
sAvadhAna! nizcaYai tArAi azAnti sRSTikArI, kintu tArA vujhenA|

evaM yakhana tAderake valA haYaH loke yerUpa vizvAsa kareche tomarAo tadrupa vizvAsa sthApana kara, takhana tArA valeH nirvodherA yerUpa vizvAsa kareche AmarAo ki seirUpa vizvAsa karava? sAvadhAna! nizcaYai tArAi nirvodha, kintu tA tArA avagata naYa|

evaM yakhana tArA mu’minadera sAthe milita haYa takhana tArA valeH AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi; evaM yakhana tArA nijedera dalapati o duSTa netAdera sAthe gopane milita haYa takhana valeH AmarA tomAdera saGgei Achi, AmarAto zudhu ThATTA-vidrupa o prahasana kare thAki|
AllAha tAdera saGge ThATTA-vidrupa karachena evaM tAderake avakAza dicchena| phale tArA nijedera avAdhyatAra madhye udbhrAnta haYe phirache|
erA tArAi yArA su-pathera parivarte ku-pathake kraYa kareche, sutarAM tAdera vANijya lAbhajanaka haYani evaM tArA sarala saThika pathe caleni|

edera avasthA ai vyaktira nyAYa ye Aguna prajjvalita karala, ataHpara yakhana tAra pArzvavartI samasta sthAna Alokita hala, takhana AllAha tAdera Alo chiniYe nilena evaM tAderake andhakArera madhye cher3e dilena, sutarAM tArA kichui dekhate pAYanA|
tArA vadhira, mUka, andha| ataeva tArA pratyAvRtta havenA|

athavA AkAza hate vAri varSaNera nyAYa yAte andhakAra, garjana o vidyut raYeche, tArA vajradhvani vazataH mRtyubhaYe tAdera karNasamUhe sva sva aGgulI guje deYa, evaM AllAha avizvAsIdera pariveSTanakArI|

acire vidyut tAdera dRSTi haraNa karave, yakhana tAdera prati Aloka pradIpta haYa takhana tArA calate thAke evaM yakhana tAdera upara andhakAra Acchanna haYa takhana tArA ThAYa dA~r3iYe thAke evaM yadi AllAha icchA karena - nizcaYai tAdera zravaNazakti o tAdera dRSTizakti haraNa karate pArena, nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe zaktimAna|
he mAnavavRnda! tomarA tomAdera ravera ivAdAta kara yini tomAderake evaM tomAdera pUrvavartIderake sRSTi karechena, yena tomarA dharmabhIru hao|

yini tomAdera janya bhUtalake zayyA o AkAzake chAda svarUpa sRSTi karechena evaM AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena, ataHpara tadvArA tomAdera janya upajIvikA svarUpa phalapuJja utpAdana karena, ataeva tomarA AllAhara samakakSa sthira karanA evaM tomarA eTA avagata Acha|

evaM Ami AmAra vAndAra prati yA avatIrNa karechi, yadi tomarA tAte sandihAna hao tAhale tatsadRza ekaTi ‘‘sUrA’’ AnaYana kara evaM tomAdera sei sAhAyyakArIderake Deke nAo yArA AllAha hate pRthaka, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao!

ataHpara yadi tomarA tA karate nA pAra evaM tomarA tA kakhanao karate pAravenA, tAhale tomarA sei jAhAnnAmera bhaYa kara yAra khorAka manuSya o prastara khanDa - yA avizvAsIdera janya prastuta karA haYeche|

evaM yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche o sat kAryAvalI sampAdana kare thAke tAderake susaMvAda pradAna kara ye, tAdera janya emana jAnnAta raYeche yAra taladeza diYe nadIsamUha pravAhita hacche; yakhanai sekhAne tAderake khAvAra hisAve phalapuJja pradAna karA have takhanai tArA valaveH AmAderato eTA pUrvei pradatta haYechila, vastutaH tAderake ekai sadRza phala pradAna karA have, evaM tAdera janya tanmadhye zuddhA sahadharminIgaNa raYeche, evaM tanmadhye tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|

nizcaYai AllAha mazA athavA tadapekSA kSudratara dRSTAnta varNanA karate lajjAvodha karenanA| sutarAM yArA ImAna eneche tArAto vizvAsa karave ye, e upamA tAdera ravera pakSa hate khuvai sthAnopayogI haYeche, Ara yArA kAphira sarvAvasthAYa tArA eTAi valave ye, e sava nagaNya vasttara upamA dvArA AllAhara uddezyai vA ki? tini era dvArA anekake vipathagAmI karena evaM era dvArA anekake saThika patha pradarzana karena, Ara era dvArA tini zudhu phAsikaderakei vipathagAmI kare thAkena|

yArA AllAhara saGge dRr3habhAve pratijJAvaddha haoYAra para tA bhaGga kare evaM ai sava samvandha chinna kare yA avicchinna rAkhate AllAha nirdeza diYechena evaM yArA bhUpRSThe vivAda sRSTi kare tArAi pUrNa kSatigrasta|

kirUpe tomarA AllAhake avizvAsa karacha? athaca tomarA chile prANahIna? ataHpara tinii tomAderake saJjIvita karechena, punarAYa tini tomAderake nirjIva karavena evaM punarAYa tomAderake jIvita karA have| avazeSe tomAderake tA~rai dike pratyAgamana karate have|
pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai tini tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena; ataHpara tini AkAzera prati manaHsaMyoga karena, ataHpara sapta AkAza suvinyasta karena evaM tini sarva viSaYe mahAjJAnI|

evaM yakhana tomAra rAvva mAlAikA/pherezatAdera valalenaH nizcaYai Ami pRthivIte pratinidhi sRSTi karava; tArA valalaH Apani ki yamIne emana kehake sRSTi karavena yArA tanmadhye azAnti sRSTi karave evaM raktapAta karave? evaM AmarAito ApanAra guNagAna karachi evaM ApanArai pavitratA varNanA kare thAki| tini valalenaH tomarA yA avagata nao nizcaYai Ami tA jJAta Achi|

evaM tini Adamake samasta nAma zikSA dilena, anantara tatsamUdaYa mAlAikA/pherezatAdera sAmane upasthApita karalena, ataHpara valalenaH yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale AmAke e sava vastura nAmasamUha varNanA kara|
tArA valechilaH Apani parama pavitra! Apani AmAderake yA zikSA diYechena tadvyatIta AmAdera konai jJAna nei, nizcaYai Apani mahAjJAnI, vijJAnamaYa|

tini valechilenaH he Adama! tumi tAderake ai sakalera nAmasamUha varNanA kara; ataHpara yakhana se tAderake aigulira nAmasamUha valechila takhana tini valechilenaH Ami ki tomAderake valini ye, nizcaYai Ami AsamAna o yamInera adRzya viSaYa avagata Achi evaM tomarA yA prakAza kara o yA gopana kara Ami tAo parijJAta Achi?

evaM yakhana Ami mAlAikA/pherezatAderake valechilAma ye, tomarA Adamake sAjadAha kara, takhana ivalIsa vyatIta sakale sAjadAha karechila; se agrAhya karala o ahaMkAra karala evaM kAphiradera antarbhukta haYe gela|

evaM Ami valalAmaH he Adama! tumi o tomAra strI jAnnAte avasthAna kara evaM tA hate yA icchA svacchande AhAra kara; kintu ai vRkSera nikaTavartI haYonA, tAhale tomarA atyAcArIdera antarbhukta haYe yAve|

anantara zAitAna tAdera ubhaYake sekhAna hate vicyuta karala, ataHpara tArA ubhaYe yekhAne chila sekhAna hate tAderake varhigata karala; evaM Ami valalAmaH tomarA nIce neme yAo, tomarA paraspara parasparera zatru; evaM pRthivItei raYeche tomAdera janya eka nirdiSTa kAlera avasthiti o bhoga sampada|
ataHpara Adama svIYa rAvva hate katipaYa vANI zikSA lAbha karala, AllAha takhana tAra prati kRpA dRSTi dilena; nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa!

Ami valalAmaH tomarA savAi ekhAna theke nIce neme yAo; anantara AmAra pakSa hate tomAdera nikaTa ye upadeza upasthita have-yArA AmAra sei upadeza anusaraNa karave vastutaH tAdera konai bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao havenA|
Ara yArA avizvAsa karave evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUhe asatyAropa karave, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI - tanmadhye tArA sadA avasthAna karave|

he isarAIlI vaMzadhara! Ami tomAderake ye sukha sampada dAna karechi tA smaraNa kara evaM AmAra aGgIkAra pUrNa kara - Amio tomAdera prati kRta aGgIkAra pUrNa karava evaM tomarA zudhu AmAkei bhaYa kara|

evaM Ami yA avatIrNa karechi tatprati vizvAsa sthApana kara, ihA (kuraAna) tomAdera kAche yA Ache uhArai satyatA pranaYanakArI evaM ete tomarAi prathama avizvAsI haYonA evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalIra parivarte sAmAnya mUlya grahaNa karanA evaM tomarA varaM AmAkei bhaYa kara|
evaM tomarA satyake mithyAra sAthe mizrita karanA evaM jene zune satya gopana karanA|
Ara tomarA sAlAta pratiSThita kara o yAkAta pradAna kara evaM rukukArIdera sAthe ruku kara|
tomarA ki lokaderake sat kAje Adeza karacha evaM tomAdera nijedera samvandhe vismRta haccha? athaca tomarA grantha pATha kara; tAhale ki tomarA hRdaYaGgama karachanA?
evaM tomarA dhairya o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya cAo; avazyai oTA kaThina, kintu vinItadera pakSe naYa|
yArA dhAraNA kare ye, nizcaYai tArA tAdera ravera sAthe sammilita have evaM tArA tA~rai dike pratigamana karave|
he vAnI isarAIla! Ami tomAderake ye sukha sampada dAna karechi tA smaraNa kara evaM nizcaYai Ami tomAderake samagra pRthivIra upara zreSThatva dAna karechi|

evaM tomarA sei dinera bhaYa kara, ye dina eka vyakti anya vyakti hate kichumAtra upakRta havenA evaM kona vyakti hate kona supArizao gRhIta havenA, kona vyakti hate kona vinimaYao grahaNa karA havenA evaM tAderake sAhAyya karAo havenA|

evaM yakhana Ami tomAderake phira‘Aunera sampradAYa hate vimukta karechilAma - tArA tomAderake kaThora zAsti pradAna karata, tomAdera putraderake hatyA karata evaM tomAdera kanyAderake jIvita rAkhata evaM ete tomAdera rAvva hate tomAdera janya mahA parIkSA chila|
evaM yakhana Ami tomAdera janya samudrake vibhakta karechilAma, ataHpara tomAderake uddhAra karechilAma o phira‘Aunera svajanaderake nimajjita karechilAma evaM tomarA tA pratyakSa karechile|
evaM yakhana Ami mUsAra saGge calliza rajanIra aGgIkAra karechilAma, anantara tomarA go-vatsake upAsyarUpe grahaNa karechile evaM tomarA chile atyAcArI|
era pareo Ami tomAderake mArjanA karechilAma - yena tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
Ara yakhana Ami mUsAke grantha evaM satya o mithyAra prabhedakArI nirdeza diYechilAma, yena tomarA supatha prApta hao|

Ara yakhana mUsA svIYa sampradAYake valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! nizcaYai tomarA go-vatsake upAsya rUpe grahaNa kare tomAdera nijedera prati atyAcAra karecha| ataeva tomarA tomAdera ravera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tomarA tomAdera nija nija prANa visarjana dAo, tomAdera ravera nikaTa eTAi tomAdera janya kalyANakara; anantara tini tomAdera prati kSamA pradarzana karalena, nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

evaM yakhana tomarA valechileH he mUsA! AmarA AllAhake prakAzyabhAve darzana nA karA paryanta tomAke vizvAsa karavanA - takhana vajrapAta tomAderake AkramaNa karechila evaM tomarA tA pratyakSa karechile|
ataHpara tomAdera mRtyura para Ami tomAderake punarujjIvita karechilAma, yena tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

evaM Ami tomAdera upara meghamAlAra chAYA dAna karechilAma evaM tomAdera prati ‘mAnnA’ o ‘sAlaoYA’ avatIrNa karechilAma; Ami tomAderake ye upajIvikA dAna karechi sei pavitra jinisa hate AhAra kara; evaM tArA AmAra kona aniSTa kareni, varaM tArA nijedera aniSTa karechila|

evaM yakhana Ami valalAmaH tomarA ei nagare praveza kara, ataHpara yA icchA svacchande AhAra kara evaM sAjadAhavanatabhAve dvAre praveza kara evaM tomarA valaH AmarA kSamA prArthanA karachi, tAhale Ami tomAdera aparAdha kSamA karava evaM acirei satkarmazIlagaNake adhikatara dAna karava|

anantara yArA atyAcAra karechila tAderake yA valA haYechila, tatparivarte tArA sei kathAra parivartana karala, pare atyAcArIrA ye duskarma karechila tajjanya Ami tAdera upara AkAza hate zAsti avatIrNa karechilAma|

evaM yakhana mUsA svIYa sampradAYera janya pAni prArthanA karechila takhana Ami valechilAmaH tumi svIYa lAThi dvArA prastare AghAta kara, anantara tA hate dvAdaza prasravana viniHsRta hala, pratyekei sva sva sthAna jene nila, tomarA AllAhara upajIvikA hate AhAra kara o pAna kara evaM pRthivIte zAnti bhaGgakArI rUpe vicaraNa karanA|

evaM yakhana tomarA valechile - he mUsA! AmarA ekairUpa khAdye dhairya dhAraNa karate pArachinA, ataeva tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa prArthanA kara yena tini AmAdera janmabhUmite yA utpanna haYa tA hate ora zAka-zavji, ora kA~kur3a, ora gama, ora masura evaM ora piYAja utpAdana karena| se valechilaH yA utkRSTa tomarA ki tAra saGge yA nikRSTa tAra vinimaYa karate cAo? kona nagare upanIta hao, tomAdera prArthita dravyaguli avazyai prApta have| tAdera upara lAJchanA o dAridratA nipatita hala evaM tArA AllAhara kope patita hala ei hetu ye, nizcaYai tArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhe avizvAsa karata evaM anyAYabhAve nAvIgaNake hatyA karata; evaM ei hetu ye, tArA avAdhyAcaraNa karechila o tArA sImA atikrama karechila|

nizcaYai musalima, iYAhudI, khRSTAna evaM sAveIna sampradAYa, (edera madhye) yArA AllAhara prati o kiYAmAtera prati vizvAsa rAkhe evaM bhAla kAja kare, tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa puraskAra raYeche, tAdera kona prakAra bhaYa nei evaM tArA cintitao havenA|

evaM yakhana Ami tomAdera aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma evaM tomAdera upara tUra parvata samucca karechilAma ye, Ami tomAderake yA diYechi tA dRr3ha rUpe dhAraNa kara evaM ete yA Ache tA smaraNa kara - sambhavataH tomarA niskRti pAve|
erapara punarAYa tomarA phire gele, ataeva yadi tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha evaM tA~ra karuNA nA thAkata tAhale avazyai tomarA vinAza prApta hate|
evaM avazyai tomarA avagata Acha ye, tomAdera madhye yArA zanivArera vyApAre sImA laMghana karechila| Ami tAderake valechilAma ye, tomarA adhama vAnara haYe yAo|
anantara Ami eTA tAdera samasAmaYika o tAdera paravartIdera janya dRSTAnta evaM dharmabhIrugaNera janya upadeza svarUpa karechilAma|

evaM yakhana mUsA nija sampradAYake valechilaH nizcaYai AllAha tomAderake Adeza karechena ye, tomarA ekaTi garu yavAha kara| tArA valechilaH tumi ki AmAderake upahAsa karacha? se valechilaH Ami AllAhara nikaTa AzraYa prArthanA karachi, yena Ami mUrkhadera antarbhukta nA hai|

tArA valechilaH tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa prArthanA kara ye, tini AmAderake yena oTA ki ki guNa viziSTa haoYA darakAra tA vale dena| se valechilaH tini valechena ye, nizcaYai sei garu vaYoHvRddha naYa evaM zAvakao naYa, e du’Yera madhyavartI; ataeva tomarA yerUpa AdiSTa haYecha tA kare phela|

tArA valechilaH tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa prArthanA kara ye, tini yena ora varNa kirUpa tA AmAderake vale dena| se valechilaH tini valechena ye, nizcaYai sei garura varNa gAr3ha pIta, oTA darzakaderake Ananda dAna kare|

tArA valechilaH tumi AmAdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa prArthanA kara ye, tini yena oTA kirUpa tA AmAdera janya varNanA karena, nizcaYai AmAdera nikaTa sakala garui samatulya evaM AllAha icchA karale AmarA supathagAmI hava|

se valechilaH nizcaYai tini valechena ye, avazyai sei garu susthakAYa, nikhu~ta, oTA cASAvAdera kAje lAgAno haYani evaM kSete pAni secaneo niyukta haYani| tArA valechilaH ekSaNe tumi satya enecha, ataHpara tArA oTA yavAha karala yA tAdera karAra icchA chilanA|
evaM yakhana tomarA eka vyaktike hatyA karAra para tadviSaYe virodha karachile evaM tomarA yA gopana karachile AllAha tAra prakAzaka halena|
ataHpara Ami valechilAmaH ora eka khanDa dvArA tAke AghAta kara, ei rUpe AllAha mRtake jIvita karena evaM svIYa nidarzanasamUha pradarzana karena yAte tomarA hRdaYaGgama kara|

ataHpara tomAdera hRdaYa prastarera nyAYa kaThina, varaM ora ceYeo kaThinatara hala evaM nizcaYai prastara hateo prasravana nirgata haYa evaM nizcaYai ogulira madhye kona konaTi vidIrNa haYa, ataHpara tA hate pAni nirgata haYa evaM nizcaYai aigulira madhye konaTi AllAhara bhaYe patita haYa evaM tomarA yA karacha tatprati AllAha amanoyogI nana|

tomarA ki AzA kara ye, tomAdera kathAYa tArA ImAna Anave? athaca tAdera madhye emana kataka loka gata haYeche yArA AllAhara kAlAma zunata, ataHpara uhA vujhAra para uhAke vikRta karata, athaca tArA jAnata|

yakhana tArA mu’minadera sAthe milita haYa takhana valeH AmarA ImAna enechi; Ara yakhana tAdera keha kArao (iYAhudIra) nikaTa gopane yAYa takhana tArA valeH tomarA ki musalimaderake emana kathA vale dAo yA AllAha tomAdera nikaTa prakAza karechena? pariNAme tArA tomAderake tarke parAjita karave (ei vale) ye, e viSaYaTi ravera nikaTa hate tomAdera kitAve raYeche, tomarA ki vujhanA?
tArA ki jAnenA ye, tArA yA gopana rAkhe evaM yA prakAza kare, AllAha savai jAnena?
evaM tAdera madhye aneka azikSita loka Ache yArA pravRtti vyatIta kona grantha avagata naYa evaM tArA zudhu kalpanAsamUha racanA kare thAke|

tAdera janya AkSepa yArA svahaste pustaka racanA kare, yArA vale ye, eTA AllAhara nikaTa hate samAgata! era dvArA tArA sAmAnya mUlya arjana karache, tAdera hasta yA lipivaddha kareche tajjanya tAdera prati AkSepa! evaM tArA yA upArjana karache tajjanyao tAdera prati AkSepa!

evaM tArA valeH nirdhArita dinasamUha vyatIta (jAhannAmera) Aguna AmAderake sparza karavenA| tumi valaH tomarA ki AllAhara nikaTa hate aGgIkAra niYecha ye, pare AllAha kakhanai svIYa aGgIkArera anyathA karavenanA? athavA AllAha samvandhe yA jAnonA tomarA tA’i valacha?
hyA~, yArA aniSTa arjana kareche evaM svIYa pApera dvArA pariveSTita haYeche tArAi agnivAsI, sekhAne tArA sadA avasthAna karave|
evaM yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche o sat kAja karache tArAi jAnnAtavAsI, tanmadhye tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|

Ara yakhana Ami vAnI isarAIla hate aGgIkAra niYechilAma ye, tomarA AllAha vyatIta Ara kArao ivAdAta karavenA evaM mAtApitAra saGge sadvyavahAra karave o AtmIYadera, pitRhInadera o misakInadera saGgeo (sadvyavahAra karave), Ara tomarA lokera sAthe uttamabhAve kathA valave evaM sAlAta pratiSThita karave o yAkAta pradAna karave; ataHpara tomAdera madhya hate alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta tomarA sakalei vimukha haYechile, yehetu tomarA chile agrAhyakArI|

evaM Ami yakhana tomAdera aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma ye, paraspara zoNitapAta karavenA evaM svIYa vAsasthAna hate Apana vyaktiderake vahiskAra karavenA; ataHpara tomarA svIkRta haYechile evaM tomarAi ora sAkSI chile|

ataHpara sei tomarAi paraspara khunAkhuni karacha evaM tomarA tomAdera madhya hate eka dalake tAdera gRha hate vahiskAra kare diccha, tAdera viruddhe (zatrutA vazataH) pApa o anyAYa kAje sAhAyya karacha evaM tArA vandI haYe tomAdera nikaTa AnIta hale tomarA tAderake vinimaYa pradAna kara, athaca tAderake vahiskAra karA tomAdera janya avaidha chila, tAhale ki tomarA granthera kichu aMza vizvAsa kara evaM kichu aMza avizvAsa kara? tomAdera madhye yArA erUpa kare tAdera pArthiva jIvane durgati vyatIta kichui nei evaM utthAna dine tArA kaThora zAstira dike nikSipta have evaM tomarA yA karacha, tadviSaYe AllAha amanoyogI nana|
erAi AkhirAtera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvana kraYa kareche, ataeva tAdera danDa laghu karA havenA evaM tArA sAhAyya prAptao havenA|

evaM avazyai Ami mUsAke kitAva pradAna karechi o tatpare kramAnvaYe rAsUlagaNake preraNa karechi, evaM Ami mAraiYAma nandana IsAke nidarzanasamUha pradAna karechilAma evaM pavitra AtmAyoge tAke zakti sampanna karechilAma; kintu pare yakhana tomAdera nikaTa kona rAsUla - tomAdera pravRtti yA icchA karatanA tA niYe upasthita hala takhana tomarA ahaMkAra karale, avazeSe eka dalake mithyAvAdI valale evaM ekadalake hatyA karale|
evaM tArA vale, AmAdera hRdaYa AvRta; evaM tAdera avizvAsera janya AllAha tAderake abhisampAta karechena - yehetu tArA ati alpai vizvAsa kare|

evaM yakhana AllAhara sannidhAna hate tAdera nikaTa yA Ache tAra satyatA pratipAdaka grantha upasthita hala evaM yA pUrva hatei tArA kAphiradera upara vijaYa prArthanA karata; ataHpara yakhana tAdera nikaTa sei paricita kitAva ela takhana tArA tAke asvIkAra karala| sutarAM erUpa kAphiradera upara AllAhara lA’nata varSita hoka|

yAra vinimaYe tArA nijedera vikri kareche tA khuvai manda, yehetu tArA AllAha yA nAyila karechena tA asvIkAra kareche - ei haThakAritAra janya ye, AllAha svIYa vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA anugraha avatAraNa karena| ataeva tArA krodhera upara krodha arjana kareche| evaM kAphiradera janya lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

evaM yakhana tAderake valA haYa - AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tA vizvAsa kara takhana tArA valeH yA AmAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche AmarA tA’i vizvAsa kari evaM tA chAr3A yA raYeche tA avizvAsa kari; athaca e granthaTi satya, tAdera kAche yA Ache eTA tArai satyatAra pratipAdaka| tumi valaH yadi tomarA vizvAsIi chile tAhale itopUrve kena AllAhara nAvIgaNake hatyA karechile?
evaM nizcaYai mUsA ujjvala nidarzanAvalIsaha tomAdera nikaTa upasthita haYechila; anantara tomarA go-vatsake upAsya rUpe grahaNa karechile, yehetu tomarA atyAcArI chile|

evaM yakhana Ami tomAdera aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma evaM tomAdera upara tUra parvata samucca karechilAma evaM valechilAma ye, Ami yA pradAna karalAma tA dRr3harUpe dhAraNa kara evaM zravaNa kara| tArA valechila, AmarA zunalAma o agrAhya karalAma, evaM tAdera avizvAsera nimitta tAdera antarasamUhe go-vatsa priYatA siJcita haYechila| tumi valaH yadi tomarA vizvAsI hao tAhale tomAdera vizvAsa yA kichu Adeza karache tA atyanta nindanIYa|
tumi valaH yadi apara vyaktigaNa apekSA tomAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa vizeSa pAralaukika AlaYa thAke tAhale tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
evaM tAdera hastasamUha pUrve yA preraNa kareche tajjanya tArA kakhanai tA kAmanA karavenA evaM AllAha atyAcArIdera samvandhe savizeSa avagata Achena|

evaM nizcaYai tumi tAderake anyAnya loka evaM aMzIvAdIdera apekSAo adhikatara AYu-AkAMkSI pAve; tAdera madhye pratyeke kAmanA kare yena tAke hAjAra vachara AYu deYA haYa, evaM airUpa AYu prAptio tAderake zAsti hate mukta karate pAravenA evaM tArA yA karache AllAha tAra paridarzaka|

tumi valaH ye vyakti jivarAIlera sAthe zatrutA rAkhe e janya ye, se AllAhara hukume ei kuraAnake tomAra antaHkaraNa paryanta pau~chiYeche, yA pUrvavatI kitAvasamUhera satyatA pramANa karache evaM mu’minadera susaMvAda dicche |
ye vyakti AllAhara, tA~ra mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNera, tA~ra rAsUlagaNera, jivarAIlera evaM mikAIlera zatru, nizcaYai AllAha erUpa kAphiradera zatru|
evaM nizcaYai Ami tomAra prati spaSTa nidarzanasamUha avataraNa karechi evaM duskarmakArI vyatIta kehai tA avizvAsa karavenA|
ki Azcarya! yakhana tArA kona aGgIkAre Avaddha hala takhanai tAdera ekadala tA bhaGga karala| varaM tAdera adhikAMzai vizvAsa karenA|

evaM yakhana AllAhara nikaTa hate, tAdera nikaTa yA Ache tAra satya pratyaYanakArI rAsUla tAdera nikaTa Agamana karala, takhana yAderake grantha pradAna karA haYeche tAdera ekadala AllAhara granthake nijedera pazcAdabhAge nikSepa karala, yena tArA kichui jAnenA|

evaM sulAimAnera rAjatvakAle zAitAnarA yA AvRtti karata, tArA orai anusaraNa karache, evaM sulAimAna avizvAsI haYani - kintu zAitAnarAi avizvAsa karechila| tArA lokaderake yAdu vidyA evaM yA vAvela zahare hArUta-mArUta mAlAka/pherezatAdvaYera prati avatIrNa haYechila tA zikSA dita, evaM tArA ubhaYe kehakeo oTA e kathA nA vale zikSA ditanA ye, ‘AmarA parIkSAdhIna chAr3A kichui nai, ataeva tomarA kupharI karanA’| anantara tArA yAte svAmI o strIra madhye viccheda saMghaTita haYa tA tAdera nikaTa theke zikSA grahaNa karata| kintu tArA AllAhara Adeza vyatIta tadvArA kArao aniSTa karate pAratanA, kintu tArA oTAi zikSA karache yAte tAdera kSati haYa evaM tAdera kona upakAra sAdhita nA haYa; evaM nizcaYai tArA jJAta Ache - ye keha oTA kraYa kareche tAra janya AkhirAte sukha lAbha nei evaM tAra vinimaYe tArA ye AtmavikraYa kareche tA nikRSTa - yadi tArA tA jAnata!
evaM yadi tArA satya satyai vizvAsa karata o dharmabhIru hata tAhale AllAhara nikaTa hate kalyANa lAbha karata - yadi tArA eTA vujhato|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA ‘rA‘YenA’ valanA, varaM ‘unayuranA’ vala evaM zune nAo - avizvAsIdera janya raYeche yantranAmaYa zAsti|

Ahale kitAvadera madhye yArA kAphira (arthAt iYAhudI o nAsArA) evaM muzarikarA moTei pachanda karenA ye, tomAdera ravera pakSa hate tomAdera upara kona kalyANa varSita hoka, Ara AllAha yAke icchA karena tA~ra karuNAra janya nirdiSTa kare nena evaM AllAha mahA karuNAmaYa|
Ami kona AYAtera hukuma rahita karale kiMvA AYAtaTike vismRta kariYe dile tadapekSA uttama athavA tadanurUpa AYAta AnaYana kari| tumi ki jAnanA ye, AllAha sarva viSaYera uparai kSamatAvAna?
tumi ki jAnanA ye, AkAza o pRthivIra Adhipatya AllAharai evaM AllAha vyatIta tomAdera kona vandhuo nei evaM kona sAhAyyakArIo nei?

tomarA ki cAo ye, tomAdera rAsUlera nikaTa Avedana karave yemana itopUrve mUsAra nikaTa (haThakAritA vazataH eirUpa vahu nirarthaka) Avedana karA haYechila? Ara ye vyakti ImAnera parivarte kupharI avalamvana kare, nizcaYai se saThika patha hate dUre sare par3e|

kitAvIdera aneke tAdera prati satya prakAzita haoYAra para tArA tAdera antarhita vidveSa vazataH tomAderake vizvAsa sthApanera pare avizvAsI karate icchA kare; kintu ye paryanta AllAha svaYaM Adeza AnaYana nA karena se paryanta tomarA kSamA kara o upekSA karate thAka; nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYera upara kSamatAvAna|

Ara tomarA sAlAta pratiSThita kara o yAkAta pradAna kara; evaM tomarA sva sva jIvanera janya ye satkAja agre preraNa karecha tA AllAhara nikaTa prApta have; tomarA yA karacho nizcaYai AllAha tAra paridarzaka|
evaM tArA valeH iYAhudI vA khRSTAna chAr3A Ara kehai jAnnAte praveza karavenA; eTA tAdera mithyA AzA| tumi valaH yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara|
avazya ye vyakti nijeke AllAhara nikaTa sarmapana kareche evaM satkAja kareche, phalataH tAra janya tAra ravera nikaTa pratidAna raYeche evaM tAdera janya kona AzaMkA nei o tArA cintita havenA|

Ara iYAhudIrA valeH khRSTAnarA kona viSaYera upara nei; evaM khRSTAnarA vale, iYAhudIrAo kona viSaYera upara nei - athaca tArA grantha pATha kare| erUpa yArA jAnenA, tArAo odera kathAra anurUpa kathA vale thAke; ataeva ye viSaYe tArA matavirodha karechila, utthAna dine AllAha tAdera madhye tadviSaYe phAYasAlA kare divena|

evaM ye AllAhara mAsajidasamUhera madhye tA~ra nAma uccAraNa karate niSedha karache evaM tA ujAr3a karate ceSTA karache se apekSA ke adhika atyAcArI? tAdera pakSe upayukta naYa ye, tArA zaMkita haoYA vyatIta tanmadhye praveza kare; tAdera janya ihaloke durgati evaM paraloke kaThora zAsti raYeche|
AllAharai janya pUrva o pazcima; ataeva tomarA ye dikei mukha phirAo sei dikei AllAhara dika; kenanA AllAha (sarvadika) pariveSTanakArI, pUrNa jJAnavAna|
evaM tArA vale, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena| tini parama pavitra! varaM yA kichu AsamAne o bhUmanDale raYeche tA tA~rai janya; savai tA~ra AjJAdhIna|
tini AkAza o pRthivIra sRSTikartA evaM yakhana tini kona kAja sampAdana karate icchA karena takhana tAra janya zudhumAtra ‘hao’ valena, Ara tAtei tA haYe yAYa|

evaM mUrkherA valeH AllAha AmAdera sAthe kena kathA valenanA, athavA kena AmAdera janya kona nidarzana upasthita haYanA? edera pUrve yArA chila tArAo edera anurUpa kathA valata; tAdera savArai antara paraspara sAdRzyapUrNa; nizcaYai Ami vizvAsI sampradAYera janya ujjvala nidarzanAvalI varNanA kari|
nizcaYai Ami tomAke satyasaha susaMvAdadAtA o bhaYa pradarzaka rUpe preraNa karechi evaM tumi jAhAnnAmavAsIdera samvandhe jijJAsita havenA|

evaM iYAhudI o khRSTAnarA - tumi tAdera dharma anusaraNa nA karA paryanta tomAra prati santuSTa havenA; tumi valaH AllAhara pradarzita pathai supatha; evaM jJAna prAptira para tumi yadi tAdera kheYAla-khuzira anusaraNa kara tAhale AllAha hate tomAra janya konai abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI nei|
Ami yAderake ye dharmagrantha dAna karechi tA yArA saThikabhAve satya vujhe pATha kare tArAi era prati vizvAsa sthApanakArI, evaM ye keha eTA avizvAsa kare phalataH tArAi kSatigrasta have|
he vAnI isarAIla! Ami tomAderake ye sukha sampada dAna karechi evaM Ami pRthivIra upara tomAderake ye zreSThatva dAna karechi - tomarA tA smaraNa kara|
Ara tomarA ai dinera bhaYa kara yedina ekajana anyajana hate kichumAtra upakRta havenA evaM kArao nikaTa hate vinimaYa gRhIta havenA, kArao supAriza phalaprada havenA evaM tArA sAhAyya prApta havenA|

evaM yakhana tomAra rAvva ivarAhImake katipaYa vAkya dvArA parIkSA karechilena pare se tA pUrNa karechila; tini valechilenaH nizcaYai Ami tomAke mAnavamanDalIra netA karava| se valechilaH AmAra vaMzadharagaNa hateo| tini valechilenaH AmAra aGgIkAra atyAcArIdera prati prayojya havenA|

evaM yakhana Ami kA‘vA gRhake mAnava jAtira janya surakSita sthAna o puNyadhAma karechilAma, evaM mAkAme ivarAhImake sAlAtera jAYagA nirdhAraNa karechilAma; evaM Ami ivarAhIma o isamAIlera nikaTa aGgIkAra niYechilAma ye, tomarA AmAra gRhake tAoYAphakArI o i’tikAphakArI evaM ruku o sAjadAhakArIdera janya pavitra rekha|

yakhana ivarAhIma valalaH he AmAra rAvva! e sthAnake Apani nirApattAmaYa zahare pariNata karuna evaM era adhivAsIdera madhye yArA AllAha o AkhirAte vizvAsa sthApana kareche tAderake upajIvikAra janya phala-zaSya pradAna karuna| (AllAha) valenaH yArA kupharI kare tAderake Ami alpa kichu dina jIvanopabhoga karate diva, ataHpara tAderake agnira zAsti bhoga karate vAdhya karava, ai gantavya sthAna nikRSTatama|
yakhana ivarAhIma o isamAIla kA‘vAra bhitti sthApana karala (takhana valala) he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera pakSa hate eTi grahaNa karuna, nizcaYai Apani zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|

he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera ubhaYake ApanAra anugata karuna, evaM AmAdera vaMzadharadera madhya hateo ApanAra anugata eka dala loka sRSTi karuna, Ara AmAderake hAjjera AhakAma vale dina evaM AmAdera prati daYA karuna, nizcaYai Apani kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

he AmAdera rAvva! tAderai madhya hate emana ekajana rAsUla preraNa karuna yini tAderake ApanAra nidarzanAvalI pATha kare zunAvena evaM tAderake grantha o vijJAna zikSA dAna karavena o tAderake pavitra karavena| nizcaYai Apani parAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|
evaM ye nijake nirvodha kare tuleche se vyatIta ke ivarAhImera dharma hate vimukha have? evaM nizcaYai Ami tAke ei pRthivIte manonIta karechilAma, nizcaYai se sat karmazIlagaNera antarbhukta chila|
yakhana tAra rAvva tAke valechilenaH tumi Anugatya svIkAra kara; se valechila: Ami vizvajagatera ravera nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karalAma|

Ara ivarAhIma o iYAkUva svIYa santAnaderake sadupadeza pradAna karechilaH he AmAra vaMzadharagaNa! nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera janya ei dharma manonIta karechena, ataeva tomarA musalima nA haYe mRtyu varaNa karanA|

yakhana iYAkUvera mRtyu upasthita hala takhana ki tomarA upasthita chile, yakhana se nija putraderake valechilaH AmAra pare tomarA kon jinisera ivAdAta karave? tArA valechilaH AmarA tomAra upAsyera evaM tomAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma, isamAIla o isahAkera upAsya - sei advitIYa upAsyera ivAdAta karava evaM AmarA tA~rai anugata thAkava|
oTi ekaTi dala chila, yA atIta haYe geche; tArA yA arjana karechila tA tAdera janya evaM tomarA yA arjana karecha tA tomAdera janya evaM tArA yA kare geche tajjanya tomarA jijJAsita havenA|
evaM tArA vale ye, tomarA iYAhudI athavA khRSTAna hao, tAhalei supatha prApta have; tumi valaH varaM AmarA ivarAhImera sudRr3ha dharme Achi evaM se aMzIvAdIdera antarbhukta chilanA|

tomarA valaH AmarA AllAhara prati evaM yA AmAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche, Ara yA ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tadIYa vaMzadharagaNera prati avatIrNa haYechila evaM yA mUsA o IsAke pradAna karA haYechila evaM anyAnya nAvIgaNake tAdera rAvva hate yA pradatta haYechila, tadasamudaYera upara vizvAsa sthApana karachi, tAdera madhye kehakeo AmarA prabheda karinA, evaM AmarA tA~rai prati AtmasamarpaNakArI|

anantara tomarA yerUpa vizvAsa sthApana karecha, tArAo yadi tadrupa vizvAsa sthApana kare tAhale nizcaYai tArA supatha prApta have; evaM yadi tArA phire yAYa tAhale tArA zudhu viruddhAcaraNei phire yAve; ataeva acirei AllAha tAdera pratikUle tomAkei yatheSTa karavena evaM tinii zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|
AmarA AllAharai raMYe raJjita, AllAha apekSA ke zreSThatama raJjanakArI? evaM AmarA tA~rai vAndA|

tumi valaH tomarA ki AllAha samvandhe AmAdera saGge virodha karacha? athaca tinii AmAdera rAvva o tomAdera rAvva, evaM AmAdera janya AmAdera kAryasamUha evaM tomAdera janya tomAdera kAryasamUha evaM AmarA tA~rai prati vizvasta|

tomarA ki valacha - ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tadIYa vaMzadharagaNa iYAhudI o khRSTAna chila? tumi valaH tomarAi saThika jJAnI nA AllAha evaM AllAhara nikaTa hate prApta sAkSya ye vyakti gopana karache se apekSA ke vezi atyAcArI? evaM tomarA yA karacha tA hate AllAha amanoyogI nana|
oTA ekaTi jAmA‘Ata chila yA vigata haYeche; tArA yA arjana kareche tA tAdera janya evaM tomarA yA arjana karecha tA tomAdera janya, evaM tArA yA kare geche tadviSaYe tomarA jijJAsita havenA|

mAnavamanDalIra madhyasthita nirvodherA acirei valave, kise tAderake sei kivalA hate pratyAvRtta karala yAra dike tArA chila? tumi vale dAoH pUrva o pazcima AllAharai janya, tini yAke icchA sarala patha pradarzana karena|

ebhAve Ami tomAderake Adarza jAti karechi, yena tomarA mAnavagaNera janya sAkSI hao evaM rAsUlao tomAdera janya sAkSI haYa; evaM tumi ye kivalAra dike chile tA Ami e janya pratiSThita karechilAma ye, ke rAsUlera anusaraNa kare, Ara ke tA hate svIYa padadvaYe pazcAte phire yAYa Ami tA jene niva evaM AllAha yAderake patha pradarzana karechena tArA chAr3A aparera janya eTi avazyai kaThoratara; evaM AllAha erUpa nana ye, tomAdera vizvAsa vinaSTa karena; nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati snehazIla, karuNAmaYa|

nizcaYai Ami AkAzera dike tomAra mukhamanDala uttolana avalokana karechi| tAi Ami tomAke ai kivalAhamukhIi karAcchi yA tumi kAmanA karacho| ataeva tumi mAsajidula hArAmera dike tomAra mukhamanDala phiriYe dAo evaM tomarA yekhAnei thAka tomAdera Anana se dikei pratyAvartita kara; evaM nizcaYai yAderake kitAva deYA haYeche tArA avazyai avagata Ache ye, nizcaYai eTi tAdera ravera nikaTa hate prerita satya; evaM tArA yA karache tadviSaYe AllAha amanoyogI nana|

evaM yAderake grantha pradatta haYeche tAdera nikaTa yadi tumi samudaYa nidarzana AnaYana kara tavuo tArA tomAra kivalAhake grahaNa karavenA; evaM tumio tAdera kivalAha grahaNa karate pAranA, Ara tAdera kona dalao anya dalera kivalAhake svIkAra kareni, evaM tomAra nikaTa ye jJAna eseche era pareo yadi tumi tAdera pravRttira anusaraNa kara tAhale nizcaYai tumi atyAcArIdera antarbhukta haYe yAve|
yAderake Ami kitAva pradAna karechi tArA tAke erUpabhAve cine, yemana cine tArA Apana santAnaderake evaM nizcaYai tAdera eka dala jJAtasAre satyake gopana karache|
ei vAstava satya tomAra ravera pakSa hate; sutarAM tumi saMzaYIdera antarbhukta haYonA|

pratyekera janya eka ekaTi lakSyasthala raYeche, ai dikei se mukhamanDala pratyAvartita kare, ataeva tomarA kalyANera dike dhAvita hao; tomarA yekhAnei thAkanA kena, AllAha tomAdera sakalakei ekatrita karavena; nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe pUrNa kSamatAvAna|

evaM tumi yekhAna hatei vera have- tomAra mukha pavitratama mAsajidera dike pratyAvartita kara evaM nizcaYai eTAi tomAra ravera nikaTa hate prerita satya evaM tomarA yA karacha tadviSaYe AllAha amanoyogI nana|

Ara tumi yekhAna hatei niskrAnta hao - tomAra mukha pavitratama mAsajidera dike phirAo evaM ye yekhAne Acha tomAdera mukhamanDala taddikei pratyAvartita kara yena atyAcArIrA vyatIta apare tomAdera sAthe virtaka karate nA pAre| ataeva tomarA tAderake bhaYa karanA, varaM AmAkei bhaYa kara yena Ami tomAdera upara AmAra anugraha pUrNa kari, evaM yena tomarA supatha prApta hao|

Ami tomAdera madhya hate erUpa rAsUla preraNa karechi ye tomAdera nikaTa AmAra nidarzanAvalI pATha kare evaM tomAderake pavitra kare, tomAderake grantha o vijJAna zikSA deYa evaM tomarA yA avagata chilenA tA zikSA dAna kare|
ataeva tomarA AmAkei smaraNa kara, Amio tomAderakei smaraNa karava evaM tomarA AmArai nikaTa kRtajJa hao evaM avizvAsI haYonA|
he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! tomarA dhairya o sAlAtera mAdhyame sAhAyya prArthanA kara; nizcaYai AllAha dhairyazIlagaNera sAthe Achena|
Ara yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche tAderake mRta valanA, varaM tArA jIvita; kintu tomarA tA avagata nao|
evaM nizcaYai Ami tomAderake bhaYa, kSudhA, dhana, prANa evaM phala-phasalera dvArA parIkSA karava; evaM ai sava dhairyazIladera susaMvAda pradAna kara|
yAdera upara kona vipada nipatita hale tArA vale, nizcaYai AmarA AllAharai janya evaM nizcaYai AmarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartanakArI|
edera upara tAdera ravera pakSa hate zAnti o karunA varSita have evaM erAi supathagAmI|

nizcaYai ‘sAphA’ o ‘mAraoYA’ AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera antargata| ataeva ye vyakti ei gRhe ‘hAjja’ athavA ‘umarAha’ pAlana’ kare tAra janya etadubhaYera pradakSiNa karA doSaNIYa naYa, evaM kona vyakti svecchAYa sat kAja karale AllAha guNagrAhI, sarvajJAta|

Ami ye sava ujjvala nidarzana o patha-nirdeza avatIrNa karechi aigulike sarva sAdhAraNera nikaTa prakAza karAra parao yArA aisava viSaYake gopana kare, AllAha tAderake abhisampAta karena evaM abhisampAtakArIrAo tAderake abhisampAta kare thAke|
kintu yArA tAovAha kare o saMzodhita haYa evaM satya prakAza kare, vasttataH Ami tAdera prati kSamA pradAnakArI, karuNAmaYa|
yArA avizvAsa kareche o avizvAsI avasthAYa mRtyu varaNa kareche, nizcaYai tAdera upara AllAhara mAlAka/pherezatA evaM mAnavakUlera savArai abhisampAta|
tanmadhye tArA sarvadA avasthAna karave, tAdera zAsti prazamita havenA evaM tAderake avakAza deYA havenA|
evaM tomAdera ilAha ekamAtra AllAha; sei sarvadAtA karuNAmaYa vyatIta anya keha upAsya nei|

nizcaYai nabhomanDala o bhUmanDala sRSTite, dina o rAtera parivartane, nau-pathe jAhAjasamUhera calAcale - yAte raYeche mAnuSera janya kalyANa| mRta pRthivIke saJjIvita karaNe, tAte nAnAvidha jIvajantu saJcArita karAra janya AllAha AkAza hate vRSTi varSaNa karena| vAYurAzira gati parivartane evaM AkAza o pRthivIra madhyastha saJcita meghera saJcAraNe satyi satyii jJAnavAna sampradAYera janya nidarzana raYeche|

evaM mAnavamanDalIra madhye erUpa Ache - yArA AllAha vyatIta aparake sadRza sthira kare, AllAhake bhAlavAsAra nyAYa tArA tAderake bhAlavAse| evaM yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche AllAhara prati - tAdera prema dRr3hatara evaM yArA atyAcAra kareche tArA yadi zAsti avalokana karata tAhale dekhata, samudaYa zaktii AllAhara evaM nizcaYai AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora|
yAdera anusaraNa karA haYeche tArA yakhana anusArIderake pratyAkhyAna karave takhana tArA zAsti pratyakSa karave evaM tAdera samparka vicchinna haYe yAve|

anusaraNakArIrA valaveH yadi AmarA phire yete pAratAma tAhale tArA yerUpa AmAderake pratyAkhyAna kareche AmarAo tadrupa tAderake pratyAkhyAna karatAma| ebhAve AllAha tAdera kRtakarmera pariNAma duHkhajanakabhAve pradarzana karavena evaM tArA agni hate uddhAra pAvenA|
he mAnavamanDalI! pRthivIra madhye yA vaidha o pavitra, tA hate AhAra kara evaM zAitAnera padAGka anusaraNa karanA, nizcaYai se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|
se etadvyatIta tomAderake Adeza kare zAitAnI o azlIla kAja karate evaM AllAha samvandhe tomarA yA jAnanA tA valate|

evaM yakhana tAderake valA haYa ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tA anusaraNa kara takhana tArA valeH varaM AmarA orai anusaraNa karava yA AmAdera pitR-puruSagaNa hate prApta haYechi; yadio tAdera pitR-puruSadera konai jJAna chilanA evaM tArA supathagAmIo chilanA|
Ara yArA avizvAsa kareche tAdera dRSTAnta odera nyAYa - yemana keha AhavAna karale zudhu cItkAra o dhvani vyatIta Ara kichui zonenA, tArA vadhira, muka, andha; kAjei tArA vujhate pArenA|
he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! Ami tomAderake yA upajIvikA svarUpa dAna karechi sei pavitra vastusamUha AhAra kara evaM AllAhara nikaTa kRtajJatA prakAza kara, yadi tomarA tA~rai ivAdAta kare thAka|

tini zudhu tomAdera janya mRta jIva, rakta, zukarera mAMsa evaM yA AllAha vyatIta aparera uddeze nivedita - tadvyatIta avaidha karenani; vastutaH ye vyakti nirUpAYa, kintu sImA laMghanakArI naYa, tAra janya pApa nei; evaM nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

AllAha yA granthe avatIrNa karechena tA yArA gopana kare o tatparivarte nagaNya mUlya grahaNa kare, nizcaYai tArA agni chAr3A anya kichu bhakSana karenA; evaM utthAna dine AllAha tAdera sAthe kathA valavenanA, tAderake pavitra karavenanA evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantranAdAYaka zAsti|
orAi supathera vinimaYe kupatha evaM kSamAra parivarte zAsti kraYa kareche, ataHpara jAhAnnAmera Aguna kirUpe sahya karave?
e janyai AllAha satyasaha grantha avatIrNa karechena evaM yArA grantha samvandhe virodha kare vAstavikai tArA viruddhAcaraNe sudUragAmI|

tomarA tomAdera mukhamanDala pUrva vA pazcima dike pratyAvartita karalei tAte puNya nei, varaM puNya tAra ye vyakti AllAha, AkhirAta, mAlAikA/pherezatA, kitAva o nAvIgaNera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM tA~rai preme dhana-sampadera prati AkarSaNa thAkA sattveo se tA AtmIYa-svajana, pitRhIna, daridra, pathika o bhikSukaderake evaM dAsatva mocanera janya vyaYa kare, Ara sAlAta pratiSThita kare o yAkAta pradAna kare evaM aGgIkAra karale tA pUraNa kare evaM yArA abhAve o kleze evaM yuddhakAle dhairyazIla tArAi satya parAYaNa evaM tArAi dharmabhIru|

he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! nihatadera samvandhe tomAdera janya pratizodha grahaNa vidhivaddha karA hala; svAdhInera parivarte svAdhIna, dAsera parivarte dAsa evaM nArIra parivarte nArI| kintu yadi keha tAra bhAi kartRka kona viSaYe kSamA prApta haYa tAhale yena nyAYa saGgatabhAve pAonA sAvyasta karA haYa evaM sadbhAve tA parizodha kare| eTA tomAdera ravera pakSa hate laghu vidhAna o karuNA; ataHpara ye keha sImA laMghana karave tAra janya yantranAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
he jJAnavAna lokerA! kisAsera madhye tomAdera janya jIvana raYeche, yena tomarA tAkaoYA avalamvana karate pAra|

yakhana tomAdera kArao mRtyu nikaTavartI vale mane haYa, takhana se yadi dhana sampatti rekhe yAYa tAhale mAtA-pitA o AtmIYa-svajanera janya vaidhabhAve asIYAta karA tomAdera janya vidhivaddha hala, dharma-bhIrudera eTA avazya karaNIYa|
ataHpara ye vyakti zonAra para tA parivartana kare, tAhale era pApa tAderai have yArA eke parivartana karave; nizcaYai AllAha zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|
anantara yadi keha asIYAtakArIra pakSe pakSapAtitva athavA pApera AzaGkA kare tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare deYa, tAte tAra pApa nei; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! tomAdera pUrvavatI lokadera nyAYa tomAdera uparao siYAmake aparihArya kartavya rUpe nirdhAraNa karA hala yena tomarA saMyamazIla hate pAro|

oTA nirdiSTa kaYeka dina| kintu tomAdera madhye ye keha pIr3ita kiMvA pravAsI haYa tAra janya apara kona dina hate gaNanA karave, Ara yArA ote akSama tArA tatparivarte ekajana daridrake AhArya dAna karave| ataeva ye vyakti svecchAYa sat kAja kare tAra janya kalyANa evaM tomarA yadi vujhe thAka tAhale siYAma pAlanai tomAdera janya kalyANakara|

rAmAyAna mAsa, ye mAse vizvamAnavera janya patha pradarzana evaM su-pathera ujjvala nidarzana evaM haka o vAtilera prabhedakArI kuraAna avatIrNa haYeche| ataeva tomAdera madhye ye vyakti sei mAse (nija AvAse) upasthita thAke se yena siYAma pAlana kare evaM ye vyakti pIr3ita athavA pravAsI, tAra janya apara kona dina hate gaNanA karave; tomAdera pakSe yA sahajasAdhya AllAha tA’i icchA karena o tomAdera pakSe yA duHsAdhya tA icchA karenanA evaM yena tomarA nirdhArita saMkhyA pUraNa kare nite pAra evaM tomAderake ye supatha dekhiYechena tajjanya tomarA AllAhake mahimAnvita kara evaM yena tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

evaM yakhana AmAra sevakavRnda (vAndA) AmAra samvandhe tomAke jijJesa kare takhana tAderake vale dAoH nizcaYai Ami sannikaTavartI| kona AhavAnakArI yakhanai AmAke AhavAna kare takhanai Ami tAra AhavAne sAr3A dii; sutarAM tArAo yena AmAra DAke sAr3A deYa evaM AmAke vizvAsa kare - tAhalei tArA saThika pathaprApta hate pArave|

rAmAyAnera rAte Apana strIdera sAthe melAmezA karA tomAdera janya vaidha karA haYeche, tArA tomAdera janya evaM tomarA tAdera janya AvaraNa, tomarA ye nijedera kSati karachile AllAha tA jJAta Achena, e janya tini tomAdera prati pratyAvRtta halena evaM tomAdera (bhAra) lAghava kare dilena; ataeva ekSaNe tomarA (rAmAyAnera rAteo) tAdera sAthe milita hao evaM AllAha tomAdera janya yA lipivaddha karechena tA anusandhAna kara evaM pratyuSe kAlo sUtA hate sAdA sUtA prakAzita nA haoYA paryanta tomarA AhAra o pAna kara, ataHpara rAta samAgama paryanta tomarA siYAma pUrNa kara; tomarA mAsajide i‘tikApha karAra samaYa (tomAdera strIdera sAthe) milita havenA; eTii AllAhara sImA| ataeva tomarA uhAra nikaTeo yAvenA; ebhAve AllAha mAnavamanDalIra janya tA~ra nidarzanasamUha vivRta karena, yena tArA saMyata haYa|

evaM tomarA nijedera madhye parasparera dhana sampatti anyAYabhAve grAsa karanA evaM tA vicArakera nikaTa Topa hisAve upasthApana karanA yAte tomarA jJAtasAre lokera sampadera aMza anyAYabhAve udarastha karate pAra|

tArA tomAke natuna cA~dasamUha samvandhe jijJesa karache| tumi valaH eguli hacche samagra mAnava jAtira janya samaYasamUha (mAsasamUha) nirdhAraNa (gaNanA vA hisAva) karAra mAdhyama evaM hAjjera janya; Ara (ai hAjjera cA~de) tomarA ye pazcAt dika diYe gRhe praveza kara eTi puNyera kAja naYa, varaM puNyera kAja hala ye vyakti saMyamazIlatA avalamvana karala| evaM tomarA gRhasamUhe ogulira darayA diYe praveza kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yAte tomarA suphala prApta hao|
evaM yArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare, tomarAo tAdera sAthe AllAhara pathe yuddha kara evaM sImA atikrama karanA; nizcaYai AllAha sImA laMghanakArIderake bhAlavAsenanA|

tAderake yekhAnei pAo, hatyA kara evaM tArA tomAderake yekhAna hate vahiskAra kareche tomarAo tAderake sekhAna hate vahiskAra kara evaM hatyA apekSA azAnti (phitanA) gurutara evaM tomarA tAdera sAthe pavitratama mAsajidera nikaTa yuddha karanA, ye paryanta nA tArA tomAdera sAthe tanmadhye yuddha kare; kintu yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha kare tAhale tomarAo tAderake hatyA kara; avizvAsIdera janya eTAi pratiphala|
ataHpara yadi nivRtta haYa tAhale nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
phitanA dUra haYe AllAhara dIna pratiSThita nA haoYA paryanta tomarA tAdera sAthe yuddha kara; ataHpara yadi tArA nivRtta haYa tAhale atyAcArIdera upara vyatIta zatrutA nei|

niSiddha mAsera parivarte niSiddha mAsa o samasta niSiddha viSaYa paraspara samAna; ataHpara ye keha tomAdera prati atyAcAra kare, tAhale se tomAdera prati yerUpa atyAcAra karave tomarAo tAra prati serUpa atyAcAra kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara o jene rekha ye, AllAha saMyamazIladera saGgI|
evaM tomarA AllAhara pathe vyaYa kara evaM svIYa hasta dhvaMsera dike prasArita karanA evaM kalyANa sAdhana karate thAko, nizcaYai AllAha kalyANa sAdhanakArIdera bhAlavAsena|

tomarA AllAhara uddeze hAjja o ‘omarAha sampUrNa kara; kintu tomarA yadi vAdhAprApta hao tAhale yA sahaja prApra tAi utsarga kara evaM kuravAnIra jantuguli svasthAne nA pau~chA paryanta tomAdera mastaka munDana karanA| kintu keha yadi tomAdera madhye pIr3ita haYa, athavA tAra mastiska yantranAgrasta haYa tAhale se siYAma kiMvA sAdAkAha athavA kuravAnI dvArA ora vinimaYa karave, ataHpara yakhana tomarA zAntite thAko takhana ye vyakti omarAh o hAjja ekatre kAmanA kare tAhale yA sahaja prApya tA’i utsarga karave| kintu keha yadi tA prApta nA haYa tAhale hAjjera samaYa tina dina evaM yakhana tomarA pratyAvartita hao takhana sAta dina - ei pUrNa daza dina siYAma pAlana karave; eTA tArai janya - yAra parijana pavitratama mAsajide upasthita nA thAke evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara o jene rekha ye, AllAha kaThina zAsti dAtA|

hAjjera mAsaguli suvidita| keha yadi ai mAsagulira madhye hAjjera saMkalpa kare tAhale se hAjjera samaYe sahavAsa, duskArya o kalaha karate pAravenA evaM tomarA ye kona sat kAja karanA kena AllAha tA jJAta Achena| Ara tomarA tomAdera sAthe pAtheYa niYe nAo| vasttataH utkRSTa pAtheYa hacche tAkaoYA vA AtmasaMyama| sutarAM he jJAnavAnagaNa! AmAke bhaYa kara|

tomarA svIYa ravera anugraha lAbhera ceSTA karale tAte tomAdera pakSe kona aparAdha nei; ataHpara yakhana tomarA ArAphAta hate pratyAvartita hao takhana pavitra smRti-sthAnera nikaTa AllAhake smaraNa kara; evaM tini tomAderake yerUpa nirdeza diYechena tadrupa tA~ke smaraNa kara; evaM nizcaYai tomarA era pUrve vibhrAntadera antarbhukta chile|
ataHpara anyAnyarA yekhAna hate pratyAvartana kare tomarAo pratyAvartana kara evaM AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

anantara yakhana tomarA tomAdera (hAjjera) anuSThAnaguli sampanna kare phela takhana yerUpa tomAdera pitR-puruSaderake smaraNa karate tadrupa AllAhake smaraNa kara, varaM tadapekSA dRr3hatarabhAve smaraNa kara; kintu mAnavamanDalIra madhye keha keha erUpa Ache yArA valeH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake ihakAlei dAna kara evaM tAdera janya AkhirAte konai aMza nei|
Ara tAdera madhye keha keha vale - he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake ihakAle kalyANa dAna karuna o AkhirAte kalyANa dAna karuna evaM jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate AmAderake rakSA karuna|
tArA yA arjana kareche, tAdera janya tArai aMza raYeche evaM nizcaYai AllAha sattvara hisAva grahaNakArI|

evaM nirdhArita dinasamUhe AllAhake smaraNa kara; ataHpara keha yadi du’ dinera madhye (mAkkAYa phire yete) tAr3Ahur3A kare tAhale tAra janya kona pApa nei| pakSAntare keha yadi du‘ dina vilamva kare tAhale tAra janyao pApa nei evaM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara o jene rekha ye, tomAdera sakalake tA~rai sannidhAne samaveta karA have|

evaM mAnuSera madhye emanao Ache yAra pArthiva jIvana saMkrAnta kathA tomAke camatkRta kare, Ara se nijera (antarastha satatA) samvandhe AllAhake sAkSI kare thAke, kintu vastutaH se hacche kaThora kalahaparAYaNa vyakti|
yakhana se pratyAvartana kare takhana tAra uddezya thAke duniYAYa azAnti sRSTi karA evaM zasya-kSetra o jIva-jantu vinAza karA; evaM AllAha azAnti bhAlavAsena nA|
yakhana tAke valA haYa, tumi AllAhake bhaYa kara, takhana pratipattira ahamikA tAke adhikatara anAcAre lipta kare| ataeva jAhAnnAmai tAra janya yatheSTa evaM nizcaYai oTA nikRSTa AzraYa sthala|
pakSAntare kona kona loka erUpa Ache ye AllAhara santuSTi sAdhanera janya Atmavirsajana kare, evaM AllAha hacchena samasta vAndAra prati sneha-parAYaNa|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA pUrNa rUpe isalAme praviSTa hao evaM zAitAnera padAMka anusaraNa karanA, nizcaYai se tomAdera janya prakAzya zatru|
ataHpara spaSTa dalIla pramANAdI tomAdera nikaTa samAgata haoYAra pareo yadi tomarA padaskhalita haYe yAo tAhale jene rekha, AllAha hacchena mahAparAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|

tArA zudhu ei apekSAi karache ye, AllAha zubhra meghamAlAra chAYAtale mAlAikA/pherezatAderake saGge niYe tAdera nikaTa samAgata havena o samasta kAjera nispatti karavena| evaM AllAharai nikaTa samasta kArya pratyAvartita haYe thAke|

isarAIla vaMzIYaderake jijJesa kara, Ami kata spaSTa pramANa tAderake pradAna karechi| evaM ye keha tAra nikaTa AllAhara anugraha sampada AsAra para tA parivartana kare tAhale jene rekha, nizcaYai AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|

yArA avizvAsa kareche tAdera pArthiva jIvana suzobhita karA haYeche evaM tArA vizvAsa sthApanakArIderake upahAsa kare thAke, evaM yArA dharmabhIru tAderake utthAna dine samunnata karA have; evaM AllAha yAke icchA karena aparimita jIvikA dAna kare thAkena|

mAnava jAti ekai sampradAYabhukta chila; ataHpara AllAha susaMvAda vAhaka o bhaYa pradarzaka rUpe nAvIgaNake preraNa karalena evaM tini tAdera sAthe satyasaha grantha avatIrNa karalena yena (ai kitAva) tAdera matabhedera viSaYaguli samvandhe mImAMsA kare deYa, athaca yArA kitAva prApta haYechila, spaSTa nidarzanasamUha tAdera nikaTa samAgata haoYAra para, parasparera prati hiMsA vidveSa vazataH tArA sei kitAvake niYe matabheda ghaTiYe vasalo, vizvAsa sthApanakArIrA ye viSaYe bhinna mata poSaNa karata AllAha nija anugrahe sei viSaYe tAderake satya pathe paricAlita karena| AllAhara yAke icchA saThika pathe paricAlita karena|

tomarA ki mane karecha ye, tomarAi jAnnAte praveza karave? athaca tomarA ekhanao tAdera avasthA prApta haoni yArA tomAdera pUrve vigata haYeche; tAderake vipada o duHkha sparza karechila evaM tAderake prakampita karA haYechila; emana ki rAsUla o tatsaha vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa valechilaH kakhana AllAhara sAhAyya Asave? satarka hao, nizcaYai AllAhara sAhAyya nikaTavartI|

tArA tomAke jijJesa karache, tArA kirUpe vyaYa karave? tumi valaH tomarA dhana sampatti hate yA vyaYa karave tA mAtA-pitAra, AtmIYa-svajanera, pitRhInadera, daridradera o pathikavRndera janya kara; evaM tomarA ye sava satkAja kara nizcaYai AllAha tA samyaka rUpe avagata|

jihAdake tomAdera janya aparihArya kartavya rUpe avadhArita karA haYeche evaM eTi tomAdera nikaTa aprItikara; vasttataH tomarA emana viSaYake apachanda karacha yA tomAdera pakSe vAstavikai maGgalajanaka, pakSAntare tomarA emana viSaYake pachanda karacha yA tomAdera janya vAstavikai aniSTakara evaM AllAhai (tomAdera bhAla-manda) avagata Achena evaM tomarA avagata nao|

tArA tomAke niSiddha mAse yuddha karA samvandhe jijJesa karache| tumi valaH ora madhye yuddha karA atIva anyAYa| Ara AllAhara pathe pratirodha karA evaM tA~ke avizvAsa karA o pavitra mAsajida hate tAra adhivAsIderake vahiskAra karA AllAhara nikaTa tadapekSA gurutara aparAdha; evaM azAnti sRSTi hatyA apekSA gurutara evaM yadi tArA sakSama haYa tAhale tArA tomAderake tomAdera dharma hate phirAte nA pArA paryanta nivRtta havenA; Ara tomAdera madhyakAra keha yadi svadharma hate phire yAYa evaM ai kAphira avasthAYai tAra mRtyu ghaTe tAhale tAra ihakAla o parakAla saMkrAnta samasta sAdhanAi vyartha haYe yAve; tArAi agnira adhivAsI evaM tArai madhye tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|
nizcaYai yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM AllAhara pathe deza tyAga kareche o dharma-yuddha kareche, tArAi AllAhara anugraha pratyAzI evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

mAdaka dravya o juYA khelA samvandhe tArA tomAke jijJesa karache| tumi valaH e du’Tora madhye gurutara pApa raYeche evaM kona kona lokera (kichu) upakAra Ache, kintu o du’Tora lAbha apekSA pApai gurutara; tArA tomAke (Arao) jijJesa karache, tArA ki (parimAna) vyaYa karave? tumi valaH yA tomAdera uddhRtta; ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya nidarzanAvalI vyakta karena yena tomarA cintA-bhAvanA kara|

pArthiva o pAralaukika viSaYe| tArA tomAke iYAtImadera samvandhe jijJesa karache; tumi valaH tAdera hita sAdhana karAi uttama; evaM yadi tomarA tAderake sammilita kare nAo tAhale tArA tomAdera bhAi; Ara ke aniSTakArI, ke hitAkAMkhI AllAha tA avagata Achena evaM yadi AllAha icchA karatena tAhale tini tomAderake vipade phelatena, nizcaYai AllAha parAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|

evaM muzarika nArIke ImAna nA AnA paryanta tomarA viYe karanA evaM nizcaYai mu’mina kRtadAsI muzarika mahilA apekSA uttama yadio se tomAderake mohita kare; evaM aMzIvAdIrA vizvAsa sthApana nA karA paryanta tAdera sAthe (musalima nArIdera) viYe dionA evaM nizcaYai aMzIvAdI tomAdera manaHputa haleo vizvAsI dAsa tadapekSA zreYatara; erAi jAhAnnAmera dike AhavAna kare evaM AllAha svIYa icchAYa jAnnAta o kSamAra dike AhavAna karena o mAnavamanDalIra janya svIYa nidarzanAvalI vivRta karena yena tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|

evaM tArA tomAke (strIlokadera) Rtu samvandhe jijJesa karache; tumi valaH oTA hacche azuci| ataeva RtukAle strIlokaderake antarAla kara evaM uttama rUpe zuddha nA haoYA paryanta tAdera nikaTe yeonA; ataHpara yakhana tArA pavitra have takhana AllAhara nirdeza mata tomarA tAdera nikaTa gamana kara, nizcaYai AllAha tAovAhakArIderake bhAlavAsena evaM yArA pavitra thAke tAderakeo bhAlavAsena|

tomAdera strIgaNa tomAdera janya kSetra svarUpa; ataeva tomarA yakhana yebhAve icchA svIYa jIvanera janya vyavahAra kara evaM nijedera AgAmI dinera janya vyavasthA kara evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara o jene rekha, ekadina AllAhara sAthe sAkSAta have| Ara vizvAsIderake susaMvAda jAniYe dAo|
evaM mAnavamanDalIra madhye hita sAdhana, paraheyagArI o mImAMsA kare deYAra kSetre tomarA svIYa zapathasamUhera janya AllAhara nAmake lakSyavastu vAnio nA| vastutaH AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJAtA|

tomAdera nirarthaka zapathasamUhera janya tomAderake AllAha pAkar3Ao karavenanA, kintu tini tomAderake ai sava zapatha samvandhe dharavena yeguli tomAdera manera saMkalpa anusAre sAdhita haYeche; evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, dhairyazIla|
yArA svIYa strIgaNa hate pRthaka thAkAra zapatha kare tArA cAra mAsa pratIkSA karave, ataHpara yadi tArA pratyAvartita haYa tAhale nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
pakSAntare yadi tArA tAlAka ditei dRr3ha pratijJa haYa tAhale nizcaYai AllAha zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|

evaM tAlAka prAptAgaNa tina Rtu paryanta apekSA karave; evaM yadi tArA AllAha o parakAle vizvAsa kare tAhale AllAha tAdera garbhe yA sRSTi karechena tA gopana karA tAdera pakSe vaidha havenA; evaM era madhye yadi tArA sandhi kAmanA kare tAhale tAdera svAmIi tAderake pratigrahaNa karate samadhika svatvavAna; Ara nArIdera upara tAdera svAmIdera yerUpa svatva Ache, strIderao tAdera puruSadera (svAmIra) upara tadanurUpa nyAYasaGgata adhikAra Ache; evaM tAdera upara puruSadera zreSThatva raYeche; AllAha hacchena mahA parAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|

tAlAka duivAra; ataHpara (strIke) haYa vihitabhAve rAkhate have athavA sadbhAve parityAga karate have; Ara nijedera deYa sampada theke kichu phiriYe neYA tomAdera janya jAYeya naYa strIdera kAcha theke, yadi ubhaYe AzaMkA kare ye, tArA AllAhara sImA sthira rAkhate pAravenA| anantara tomarA yadi AzaMkA kara ye, AllAhara nirdeza Thika rAkhate pAravenA, sei avasthAYa strI nijera mukti lAbhera janya kichu vinimaYa dile tAte ubhaYera kona doSa nei; eguli hacche AllAhara sImAsamUha| ataeva tA atikrama karanA evaM yArA AllAhara sImA atikrama kare vastutaH tArAi atyAcArI|

ataHpara yadi se tAlAka pradAna kare tAhale erapare anya svAmIra sAthe vivAhitA nA haoYA paryanta se tAra janya vaidha havenA, ataHpara se tAke tAlAka pradAna karale yadi ubhaYe paraspara pratyAvartita haYa tAte ubhaYera pakSe konai doSa nei, yadi AllAhara sImArekhA vajAYa rAkhAra icchA thAke| evaM egulii AllAhara sImAsamUha, tini jJAnI sampradAYera janya eguli vyakta kare thAkena|

evaM tomarA yakhana strIderake tAlAka dAo, Ara tArA tAdera nirdhArita samaYe pau~che yAYa, takhana tAderake niYamitabhAve rAkhate pAra athavA niYamitabhAve parityAga karate pAra; evaM tAderake yantraNA deYAra janya Avaddha kare rekhanA, tAhale sImA laMghana karave; Ara ye vyakti erUpa kare se nizcaYai nijera prati avicAra kare thAke| evaM AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke vidrupAcchale grahaNa karanA, tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha evaM tomAderake upadeza dAnera janya grantha o vijJAna hate yA avatIrNa karechena tA smaraNa kara, Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM jene rekha ye, AllAha sarva viSaYe mahAjJAnI|

evaM yakhana tomarA strIlokaderake tAlAka dAo, ataHpara tArA tAdera nirdhArita samaYe pauche yAYa, takhana tArA ubhaYei yadi parasparera prati vihitabhAve sammata haYe thAke, sei avasthAYa strIrA nija svAmIderake viYe karate gele tomarA tAderake vA~dhA pradAna karanA; tomAdera madhye ye AllAha o AkhirAtera prati vizvAsa sthApana kareche era dvArA tAderakei upadeza deYA hacche; tomAdera janya eTi zuddhatama o pavitratama (vyavasthA) evaM AllAha avagata Achena o tomarA avagata nao|

evaM yadi keha stanya pAnera kAla pUrNa karate icchA kare tAra janya jananIgaNa pUrNa dui vachara svIYa santAnaderake stanya dAna karave; Ara santAnera janakagaNa vihitabhAve prasUtidera khorAka o tAdera pozAka dite vAdhya; kehakeo tAra sAdhyera atIta kaSTa deYA yAvenA, nija santAnera kAraNe jananIke kSatigrasta karA calavenA, evaM pitAra janyao ekai vidhAna, kintu yadi tArA paraspara parAmarza o sammati anusAre stanya tyAga karAte icchA kare tAte ubhaYera kona doSa nei; Ara tomarA yadi nija santAnaderake stanya pAnera janya samarpaNa kare vihitabhAve kichu pradAna kara tAhaleo tomAdera kona doSa nei; evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara o jene rekha ye, tomarA yA karacha AllAha tA pratyakSakArI|

evaM tomAdera madhye yArA strIderake rekhe mRtyumukhe patita haYa, tArA (vidhavAgaNa) cAra mAsa o daza dina pratIkSA karave; ataHpara yakhana tArA svIYa nirdhArita samaYe upanIta haYa takhana tArA nijedera samvandhe vihitabhAve yA karave tAte tomAdera kona doSa nei; evaM tomarA yA karacho tadviSaYe AllAha samyaka khavara rAkhena|

evaM tomarA strIlokadera prastAva samvandhe parokSabhAve yA vyakta kara athavA nijedera mane gopane yA poSaNa kara tAte tomAdera kona doSa nei; AllAha avagata Achena ye, tomarA tAdera viSaYa AlocanA karave, kintu gopanabhAve tAderake pratizruti dAna karanA, varaM vihitabhAve tAdera sAthe kathA vala; evaM nirdhArita samaYa pUrNa nA haoYA paryanta vivAha vandhane Avaddha haoYAra saMkalpa karanA; evaM eTio jene rekha ye, tomAdera antare yA Ache AllAha tA avagata| ataeva tomarA tA~ke bhaYa kara evaM jene rekha ye, AllAha kSamAzIla, sahiSNu|

yadi tomarA strIderake sparza nA kare athavA tAdera prApya nirdhAraNa karAra pUrve tAlAka pradAna kara tAhale tAte tomAdera kona doSa nei, evaM tomarA tAderake kichu saMsthAna kare dive, avasthApanna loka nijera avasthAnusAre evaM abhAvagrasta loka tAra sAdhyAnusAre vihita saMsthAna (kare dive); sat karmazIla lokadera upara ihAi kartavya|

Ara tomarA yadi tAderake sparza karAra pUrvei tAlAka pradAna kara evaM tAdera mohara nirdhAraNa kare thAka tAhale yA nirdhAraNa karechile tAra ardheka diYe dAo; kintu yadi tArA kSamA kare kiMvA yAra hAte vivAha vandhana se kSamA kare tAhale tA svatantra kathA; athavA tomarA puruSarA yadi kSamA kara tAhale eTA parahejagArIra ati nikaTavartI; evaM parasparera upakArake yena bhule yeonA; tomarA yA kara nizcaYai AllAha tA pratyakSakArI|
tomarA sAlAtera prati yatnavAna have vizeSataH madhyavartI sAlAtera evaM AllAhara uddeze tomarA vinItabhAve danDAYamAna hao|

tave tomarA yadi AzaMkA kara, sei avasthAYa padavraje vA yAnavAhanera upara sAlAta samApana kare nive, pare yakhana nirApada hao takhana tomAderake yebhAve zikhiYe deYA haYeche seibhAve AllAhara prazaMsA kara yA tomarA itopUrve jAnatenA|

evaM tomAdera madhye yArA mRtyumukhe patita haYa o strIgaNake cher3e yAYa tArA yena svIYa strIgaNake vahiskRta nA kare eka vachara paryanta tAderake bharaNa-poSaNa pradAna karAra janya asIYAta kare yAYa, kintu yadi tArA (svecchAYa) vera haYe yAYa tAhale nijedera samvandhe vihitabhAve tArA ye vyavasthA kare tajjanya tomAdera kona doSa nei, evaM AllAha mahAparAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|
Ara tAlAka prAptadera janya vihitabhAve bharaNa poSaNera vyavasthA karA dharmabhIrugaNera kartavya|
ebhAve AllAha svIYa nidarzanAvalI vivRta karena, yena tomarA hRdaYaGgama kara|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani, mRtyura vibhISikAke er3Anora janya yArA nijedera gRha hate vahirgata haYechila? athaca tArA chila vahu sahasra; takhana AllAha tAderake valalenaH tomarA mara; punarAYa tini tAderake jIvana dAna karalena; nizcaYai mAnavagaNera prati AllAha anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza loka kRtajJatA svIkAra karenA|
tomarA AllAhara pathe saMgrAma kara evaM jene rekha ye, nizcaYai AllAha hacchena sarvazrotA, sarvajJAtA|

ke se, ye AllAhake uttama RNadAna kare? anantara tini tAke dviguNa, vahuguNa vardhita karena evaM AllAhai (mAnuSera Arthika avasthAke) kRccha vA svacchala kare thAkena evaM tA~rai dike pratyAvartana karate have|

tumi ki mUsAra pare isarAIla vaMzIYa pradhAnadera prati lakSya karani? nijedera eka nAvIke yakhana tArA valechilaH AmAdera janya ekajana rAjA niyukta kare dAo (yena) AmarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karate pAri| se valechilaH eTA ki sambhavapara naYa ye, yakhana tomAdera upara yuddha vidhivaddha haYe yAve takhana tomarA yuddha karavenA? tArA valechilaH AmarA yuddha karavanA eTA kirUpe (sambhava), athaca nijedera AvAsa hate o svajanadera nikaTa hate AmarA vahiskRta haYechi? anantara yakhana tAdera upara yuddha vidhivaddha hala takhana tAdera alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta savAi pazcAtpada haYe par3ala evaM atyAcArIderake AllAha samyaka rUpe avagata Achena|

evaM tAdera nAvI tAderake valechilaH nizcaYai AllAha tAlUtake tomAdera janya rAjA rUpe nirvAcita karechena; tArA valalaH AmAdera upara tAlUtera rAjatva ki rUpe (saGgata) hate pAre? rAjatve tAra apekSA AmAderai svatva adhika, pakSAntare yatheSTa Arthika svacchalatAo tAra nei; tini valalenaH nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera janya tAkei manonIta karechena evaM tAke pracura jJAna o daihika zakti dAna karechena, AllAha tA~ra rAjatva yAke icchA pradAna karena evaM AllAha hacchena dAnazIla, sarvajJAtA|

evaM tAdera nAvI tAdera valechilaH tAra rAjatvera nidarzana ei ye, tomAdera nikaTa sinduka samAgata have, yAte thAkave tomAdera ravera nikaTa hate zAnti evaM mUsA o hArunera parivArera (parityakta) kichu sAmagrI, mAlAikA/pherezatA oTA vahana kare Anave, tomarA yadi vizvAsa sthApanakArI hao tAhale ora madhye nizcaYai tomAdera janya nidarzana raYeche|

anantara yakhana tAlUta sainyadalasaha vahirgata haYechila takhana se valechila, nizcaYai AllAha ekaTi nadI dvArA tomAderake parIkSA karavena, oTA hate ye pAna karave se AmAra dalabhukta naYa evaM ye svIYa hasta dvArA aJjali pUrNa kare nive evaM tadvyatIta se Ara AsvAdana karavenA se nizcaYai AmAra loka; kintu tAdera madhye alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta anya savAi sei nadIra pAni pAna karala, ataHpara yakhana se o tAra saGgI vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa nadI atikrama kare gela takhana tArA valalaH jAluta o tAra senAvAhinIra mukAvilA karAra zakti Aja AmAdera nei; pakSAntare yArA vizvAsa karata ye, tAderake AllAhara sAthe sAkSAt karate have tArA valalaH AllAhara hukume kata kSudra dala kata vRhat dalake parAjita kareche; vastutaH dhairyazIladera saGgI hacchena AllAha!

evaM yakhana tArA jAluta o tAra senAvAhinIra sammukhIna hala, valate lAgalaH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake pUrNa sahiSNutA dAna karuna, Ara AmAdera caraNaguli aTala rAkhuna evaM kAphira jAtira upara AmAderake sAhAyya karuna!

takhana tArA AllAhara hukume jAlutera sainyaderake parAjita karala evaM dAUda jAlutake hatyA karala| evaM AllAha dAudake rAjya o prajJA dAna karalena evaM tAke icchAnuyAYI zikSA dAna karalena; Ara yadi AllAha eka dalake apara dalera dvArA pradamita nA karatena tAhale nizcaYai pRthivI azAntipUrNa hata, kintu AllAha vizva jagatera prati anugrahakArI|
egulo AllAhara nidarzana - tomAra nikaTa eguli satyarUpe upasthApana karechi evaM nizcaYai tumi rAsUlagaNera antarbhukta|

ei sakala rAsUla, Ami yAdera kArao upara kehake maryAdA pradAna karechi, tAdera madhye kArao sAthe AllAha kathA valechena evaM kehake padamaryAdAYa samunnata karechena, Ara mAraiYAma nandana IsAke prakAzya nidarzanAvalI dAna karechi evaM tAke pavitra AtmAyoge sAhAyya karechi, Ara AllAha icchA karale nAvIgaNera paravartI lokerA, tAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANapuJja samAgata haoYAra para parasparera sAthe yuddha vigrahe lipta hatanA| kintu tArA paraspara matavirodha karechila; phale tAdera kataka hala mu’mina, Ara kataka hala kAphira| vasttataH AllAha icchA karale tArA paraspara yuddha vigrahe lipta hatanA, kintu AllAha yA icchA karena tA’i sampanna kare thAkena|
he vizvAsIgaNa! Ami tomAderake ye jIvanopakaraNa dAna karechi tA hate sedina samAgata haoYAra pUrve vyaYa kara yedina kraYa-vikraYa, vandhutva o supAriza nei, Ara avizvAsIrAi atyAcArI|

AllAha, tini chAr3A kona (satya) ilAha nei, tini ciraJjIva, supratiSThita dhAraka| tA~ke tandrA o nidrA sparza kare nA| tA~ra janyai AsamAnasamUhe yA raYeche tA evaM yamIne yA Ache tA| ke se, ye tA~ra nikaTa supAriza karave tA~ra anumati chAr3A? tini jAnena yA Ache tAdera sAmane evaM yA Ache tAdera pechane| Ara tArA tA~ra jJAnera sAmAnya parimANao AYatva karate pAre nA, tave tini yA cAna tA chAr3A| tA~ra kurasI AsamAnasamUha o yamIna parivyApta kare Ache evaM e du’Tora saMrakSaNa tA~ra janya vojhA haYa nA| Ara tini suucca, mahAna| (AYAtula kurasI)

dInera vyApAre kona javaradasti kiMvA vAdhyavAdhakatA nei| nizcaYai bhrAnti hate supatha prakAzita haYeche| ataeva ye tAgutake avizvAsa kare evaM AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kare se dRr3hatara rajjuke A~kar3e dharalo yA kakhanao chinna havAra naYa evaM AllAha zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|

AllAhai hacchena mu’minadera abhibhAvaka| tini tAderake andhakAra hate Alora dike niYe yAna; Ara yArA avizvAsa kareche tAguta tAdera pRSThapoSaka, se tAderake Alo hate andhakArera dike niYe yAYa, tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, okhAne tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|

tumi ki tAra prati lakSya karani ye ivarAhImera sAthe tAra rAvva samvandhe vitarka karechila, yehetu AllAha tAke rAjatva pradAna karechilena| ivarAhIma valechilaH AmAra rAvva tinii yini jIvita karena o mRtyu dAna karena| se valechilaH Amii jIvana o mRtyu dAna kari| ivarAhIma valechilaH nizcaYai AllAha sUryake pUrva dika hate AnaYana karena, kintu tumi oke pazcima dika hate AnaYana kara; ete sei avizvAsakArI hatavuddhi haYechila; evaM AllAha atyAcArI sampradAYake patha pradarzana karenanA|

athavA ai vyaktira anurUpa ye kona eka janapada atikrama karachila evaM tA chila zUNya - nija bhittira upara patita| se valalaH ei nagarera mRtyura para AllAha AvAra tAke jIvana dAna karavena kirUpe? anantara AllAha tAke ekaza vacharera janya mRtyu dAna karalena, ataHpara tAke punarjIvita karalena evaM valalenaH e avasthAYa tumi katakSaNa ativAhita karecha? se valalaH ekadina athavA ekadinera kiYadaMza| tini valalenaH tA naYa, varaM tumito ebhAve ekaza vachara chile| tomAra khAdya o pAnIYera prati lakSya kara - oTA vikRta haYani evaM tomAra gardabhera prati dRSTipAta kara; evaM yehetu Ami tomAke mAnavera janya nidarzana vAnAte cAi; Arao lakSya kara asthipuJjera dike, oke kirUpe Ami saMyukta kari; ataHpara oke mAMsAvRta kari| anantara yakhana oTA tAra nikaTa spaSTa haYe gela takhana se valalaH Ami jAni, AllAha sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

evaM yakhana ivarAhIma valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani kirUpe mRtake jIvita karena tA AmAke pradarzana karuna| tini valalenaH tAhale ki tumi vizvAsa karanA? se valalaH hyA~ avazyai, kintu tAte AmAra antara paritRpta have| tini valalenaH tAhale cAraTi pAkhI grahaNa kara, tArapara oderake TukarA TukarA kare mizrita kara, anantara pratyeka pAhAr3era upara odera eka eka khanDa rekhe dAo, ataHpara oderake AhavAna kara, orA tomAra nikaTa daur3e Asave; evaM jene rekha ye, nizcaYai AllAha parAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|

yArA AllAhara pathe svIYa dhana-sampada vyaYa kare tAdera upamA yemana ekaTi zasyavIja, tA hate utpanna hala sAtaTi zISa, pratyeka zISe (utpanna hala) eka zata zasya, evaM AllAha yAra janya icchA karena vardhita kare dena; vastutaH AllAha hacchena ati dAnazIla, sarvajJa|

yArA AllAhara pathe nijedera dhana sampada vyaYa kare, evaM vyaYa karAra para anugrahera kathA prakAza karenA, kaSTao deYanA, tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa raYeche puraskAra; vastutaH tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duzcintAgrastao havenA|
ye dAnera pazcAte thAke kleza, sei dAna apekSA uttama vAkya o kSamAi utkRSTa evaM AllAha mahA sampadazAlI, sahiSNu|

he mu’minagaNa! kRpA prakAza o kleza dAna kare nijedera dAnaguli vyartha kare phelanA sei vyaktira nyAYa ye nijera dhana vyaYa kare loka dekhAnora janya, athaca AllAha o AkhirAte se vizvAsa karenA| phalataH tAra upamA, yemana eka vRhat masRna prastara khanDa yAra upara kichu mATi (jame) Ache, e avasthAYa tAte varSita hala pravala varSA, ataHpara tA pariSkAra haYe gela| tArA yA arjana kareche tanmadhya hate kona viSaYei tArA suphala pAvenA evaM AllAha avizvAsI sampradAYake patha pradarzana karenanA|

evaM yArA AllAhara santuSTi sAdhana o svIYa jIvanera pratiSThAra janya dhana sampada vyaYa kare tAdera upamA - yemana urvara bhUbhAge avasthita ekaTi udyAna, tAte pravala vRSTidhArA patita haYa, phale sei udyAna dviguNa khAdyazasya dAna kare; kintu yadi tAte vRSTipAta nA haYa tAhale zizirai yatheSTa evaM tomarA yA karacha AllAha tA pratyakSakArI|

tomAdera kArao yadi emana ekaTi khejura o AGgura udyAna thAke yAra taladeza diYe nadI-nAlA pravAhita, sekhAne sarva prakAra phalera saMsthAna tAra raYeche, Ara se vArdhakye upanIta hala, athaca tAra katakaguli durvala (aprApta vaYaska) santAna-santati raYeche, e avasthAYa sei vAgAne upasthita hala agnisaha eka vAtyAvarta, Ara tA pur3e (bhasmIbhUta haYe) gela; tomarA keha eTA pachanda karave ki? e rUpe AllAha tomAdera janya nidarzanAvalI vyakta karena, yena tomarA cintA-bhAvanA kara|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yA upArjana karecha evaM Ami yA tomAdera janya bhUmi hate utpanna karechi, tA hate utkRSTa vastta kharaca kara evaM tA hate erUpa nikRSTa vastta vyaYa karate manastha karanA yA tomarA mudita cakSu vyatIta grahaNa karanA; evaM tomarA jene rekha, AllAha mahA sampadazAlI, prazaMsita|
zAitAna tomAderake abhAvera bhIti pradarzana kare evaM tomAderake azlIlatAra Adeza kare evaM AllAha tomAderake tA~ra nikaTa hate kSamA o daYAra aMgIkAra karena| AllAha hacchena vipula dAtA, sarvajJa|
tini yAke icchA prajJA dAna karena evaM yAke prajJA dAna karA haYa se nizcaYai pracura kalyANa lAbha kare; vasttataH jJAnavAna vyaktigaNa vyatIta kehai upaladdhi karate pArenA|
evaM ye kona vastu tomarA vyaYa karanA kena, athavA ye kona pratijJA (nayara) tomarA grahaNa karanA kena, AllAha nizcaYai tA avagata hana; Ara atyAcArIdera konai sAhAyyakArI nei|

yadi tomarA prakAzyabhAve dAna kara tAhale tA utkRSTa evaM yadi tomarA tA gopana kara o daridraderake pradAna kara tAhale oTAo tomAdera janya uttama, evaM era dvArA tomAdera kichu pApa (era kAlimA) vidUrita have; vasttataH tomAdera kAryakalApa samvandhe AllAha vizeSa rUpe khavara rAkhena|

tAderake supathe AnAra dAYitva tomAra naYa, varaM yAke icchA AllAha tAke sat pathe paricAlita karena evaM tomarA dhanasampada hate yA vyaYa kara vastutaH tA tomAdera nijedera janya, Ara ekamAtra AllAhara santoSa lAbhera ceSTA vyatIta (anya kona uddeze) artha vyaYa karanA; evaM tomarA hAlAla sampada hate yA vyaYa karave tA sampUrNabhAve punaHprApta have, Ara tomAdera prati anyAYa karA havenA|

dAna khaYarAta ai sava lokadera janya yArA AllAhara kAche Avaddha haYe geche, jIvikAra sandhAne anyatra ghorAphirA karate sakSama naYa| tAdera sAvalila calAcalera janya ajJa lokerA tAderake abhAvahIna mane kare, tumi tAderake tAdera lakSaNa dvArA cinave| tArA mAnuSera kAche yAJcA karenA| evaM tomarA vaidha sampada theke yA vyaYa kara se viSaYe AllAha samyakarUpe avagata|
yArA rAte o dine, gopane o prakAzye nijedera dhana-sampada vyaYa kare tAdera ravera nikaTa tAdera puraskAra raYeche, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita havenA|

yArA suda bhakSaNa kare tArA zAitAnera sparze mohAbhibhUta vyaktira anurUpa kiYAmAta divase danDAYamAna have; era kAraNa ei ye, tArA vale, vyavasA sudera anurUpa vai to naYa; athaca AllAha tA‘AlA vyavasAke hAlAla karechena evaM sudake hArAma karechena; ataHpara yAra nikaTa tAra ravera pakSa hate upadeza samAgata haYa, phale se nivRtta haYa; sutarAM yA atIta haYeche tAra kRtakarma AllAhara upara nirbhara; evaM yArA punarAYa suda grahaNa karave tArAi hacche jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAnei cirakAla avasthAna karave|
AllAha sudake kSaYa karena evaM dAnake vardhita karena, vastutaH AllAha ati kRtaghna pApAcArIderake bhAlavAsenanA|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna Ane evaM sat kAryAvalI sampAdana kare, sAlAtake pratiSThita rAkhe o yAkAta pradAna kare, tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa puraSkAra raYeche; evaM tAdera kono AzaMkA nei evaM tArA duHkhita havenA|
he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM yadi tomarA mu’mina hao tAhale sudera madhye yA avaziSTa raYeche tA varjana kara|

kintu yadi nA kara tAhale AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe yuddha karate prasttata haYe yAo| Ara yadi tomarA kSamA prArthanA kara tAhale tomAdera mUladhana peYe yAve, tomarA atyAcAra karavenA evaM tomarAo atyAcArita havenA|
Ara yadi se abhAvagrasta haYa tAhale svacchalatAra pratIkSA karave evaM yadi tomarA vujhe thAka tAhale tomAdera janya dAna karAi uttama|
Ara tomarA sei dinera bhaYa kara yedina tomarA AllAhara kAche pratyAvartita have, takhana ye yA arjana kareche tA sampUrNa rUpe pradatta have evaM tArA atyAcArita havenA|

he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! yakhana tomarA kona nirdiSTa samaYera janya RNera AdAna pradAna karave takhana tA likhe nive; Ara kona ekajana lekhaka yena nyAyyabhAve tomAdera madhye (ai AdAna pradAnera dalIla) likhe deYa, Ara kona lekhaka yena (dalIla) likhe dite asvIkAra nA kare, AllAha tAke yerUpa zikSA diYechena, tAra ucita tA likhe deYA, evaM RNa grahitA yena lekhAra viSaYa vale deYa evaM tAra ucita svIYa rAvva AllAhake bhaYa karA evaM ora madhye kichumAtra vyatikrama nA karA; ataHpara RNa grahItA yadi nirvodha vA ayogya athavA likhiYe nite asamartha haYa tAhale tAra abhibhAvakarA nyAYa saGgatabhAve likhiYe nive evaM tomAdera madhye du’jana puruSa sAkSIke sAkSI karave; kintu yadi du’jana puruSa nA pAoYA yAYa tAhale sAkSIgaNera madhye tomarA ekajana puruSa o du’jana nArI manonIta karave, yadi nArIdvaYera ekajana bhule yAYa tAhale ekajana apara janake smaraNa kariYe dive; evaM yakhana AhavAna karA haYa takhana sAkSIgaNera asvIkAra nA karA ucita, evaM kSudra athavA vRhat viSaYera nirdiSTa samaYa likhe dite tomarA avahelA karanA, eTA AllAhara nikaTa ati saGgata evaM sAkSyera janya eTAi dRr3hatara o sandehe patita nA haoYAra nikaTatara; kintu yadi tomarA kAravAre paraspara hAte hAte AdAna pradAna kara tAhale tA lipivaddha nA karale tomAdera pakSe doSa nei; kintu vANijyika lenadenera janya sAkSI rekha, yena lekhaka kiMvA sAkSI kSatigrasta nA haYa| yadi erUpa kara (kSatigrasta) tAhale tA tomAdera pakSe pApera viSaYa| AllAhake bhaYa kara| AllAhai tomAderake zikSA pradAna karena evaM AllAha sarva viSaYe mahAjJAnI|

evaM yadi tomarA pravAse thAka o lekhaka nA pAo tAhale vandhakI vastta nijera dakhale rAkha| ataHpara keha yadi kehake vizvAsa kare tAhale yAke vizvAsa karA haYeche tAra pakSe gacchita dravya pratyarpaNa karA ucita evaM svIYa rAvva AllAhake bhaYa karA ucit| sAkSya gopana karanA; evaM ye keha tA gopana karave, nizcaYai tAra mana pApAcArI; vastutaH AllAha tomAdera kAryakalApa samvandhe samyaka jJAta|

nabhomanDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu raYeche savai AllAhara evaM tomAdera antare yA raYeche tA prakAza kara athavA gopana rAkha, AllAha tAra hisAva tomAdera nikaTa hate grahaNa karavena; ataHpara tini yAke icchA kSamA karavena, yAke icchA zAsti divena; evaM AllAha sarva viSaYopari zaktimAna|

rAsUla tAra rAvva hate tAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA vizvAsa kare evaM mu’minagaNao (vizvAsa kare); tArA savAi AllAhake, tA~ra mAlAikAke, tA~ra granthasamUhake evaM tA~ra rAsUlagaNake vizvAsa kare; (tArA vale) AmarA tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye kehakeo pArthakya karinA| evaM tArA vale, AmarA zunalAma evaM svIkAra karalAma; he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA ApanArai nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karachi evaM ApanArai dike zeSa pratyAvartana|

kona vyaktikei AllAha tAra sAdhyera atirikta kartavya pAlane vAdhya karenanA; se yA upArjana kareche tA tArai janya evaM yA se arjana kareche tA tArai upara vartAve| he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA yadi bhule yAi athavA bhula kari sejanya AmAderake aparAdhI karavenanA| he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera pUrvavartIgaNera upara yerUpa gurubhAra arpaNa karechilena AmAdera upara tadrupa bhAra arpaNa karavenanA| he AmAdera rAvva! yA AmAdera zaktira vAire airUpa bhAra vahane AmAderake vAdhya karavenanA, evaM AmAdera pApa mocana karuna o AmAderake kSamA karuna, AmAderake daYA karuna, Apanii AmAdera AzraYadAtA! ataeva kAphira sampradAYera viruddhe AmAderake jaYayukta karuna|
Alipha, lAma, mIma|
AllAha chAr3A konai ilAha (upAsya) nei, tini ciraJjIva o nitya virAjamAna|
tini satyasaha tomAra prati grantha avatIrNa karechena, yA pUrvavartI viSaYera satyatA pratipAdanakArI| evaM era pUrve tAorAta o iJjIla avatIrNa karechilena|

mAnavamanDalIra janya satpatha pradarzanera janya evaM tinii phurakAna avatIrNa karechena| yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra prati avizvAsa kare nizcaYai tAdera janya kaThora zAsti raYeche evaM AllAha parAkrAnta, pratizodha grahaNakArI|
nizcaYai AllAhara nikaTa bhUmanDala o nabhomanDalera kona viSaYai lukAYita nei|
tinii svIYa icchAnuyAYI jarAYura madhye tomAdera AkRti gaThana karechena| tini vyatIta anya konai upAsya nei, tini parAkrAntazAlI, vijJAnamaYa |

tinii tomAra prati grantha avatIrNa karechena yAte suspaSTa AYAtasamUha raYeche - oguli granthera jananI svarUpa evaM anyAnya AYAtasamUha aspaSTa; ataeva yAdera antare vakratA raYeche, phalataH tArAi azAnti sRSTi o vyAkhyA vizleSaNera uddeze aspaSTera anusaraNa kare; evaM AllAha vyatIta ora artha kehai avagata naYa, Ara yArA jJAne supratiSThita tArA valeH AmarA ote vizvAsa kari, samastai AmAdera ravera nikaTa hate samAgata evaM jJAnavAna vyatIta kehai upadeza grahaNa karenA|
he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake patha pradarzanera para AmAdera antarasamUha vakra karavena nA evaM AmAderake ApanAra nikaTa hate karuNA pradAna karuna, nizcaYai Apani prabhUta pradAnakArI|
he AmAdera rAvva! nizcaYai Apani sakala mAnuSake samavetakArI, ai dine moTei sandeha nei, nizcaYai AllAha pratijJA bhaGgakArI nana|
nizcaYai yArA avizvAsa kareche, tAdera dhana-sampada o tAdera santAna-santati AllAhara nikaTa kona viSaYei phalaprada havenA evaM tArAi jAhAnnAmera indhana|
phira‘Auna sampradAYa evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera prakRtira nyAYa tArA AmAra AYAtasamUhera prati asatyAropa kareche, ei hetu AllAha tAdera dhRta karechena evaM AllAha kaThora zAstidAtA|
