yArA avizvAsa kareche, tumi tAderake valaH acirei tomarA parAbhUta have evaM tomarA jAhAnnAmera dike ekatrita have evaM oTA nikRSTatara sthAna|

nizcaYai tomAdera janya du’Ti dalera paraspara sammukhIna haoYAra madhye mahAna namunA raYeche, tAdera ekadala AllAhara pathe saMgrAma karachila evaM apara dala avizvAsI chila; tArA pratyakSa dRSTite musalimaderake dviguNa dekhechila evaM AllAha yAke icchA tadvIYa sAhAyya dAne zaktizAlI karena, nizcaYai era madhye cakSusmAnadera janya upadeza raYeche|

mAnavamanDalIke ramaNI, santAna-santati, puJjIkRta svarNa o raupyabhAnDAra, suzikSita azva o pAlita pazu evaM zasya kSetrera AkarSaNIYa vastta dvArA suzobhita karA haYeche, eTA pArthiva jIvanera sampada evaM AllAhara nikaTa raYeche zreSThatama avasthAna|

tumi valaH Ami ki tomAderake eTA apekSAo uttama viSaYera saMvAda diva? yArA dharmabhIru tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa jAnnAta raYeche yAra taladeze srotasvinIsamUha pravAhitA, tanmadhye tArA sadA avasthAna karave evaM sekhAne zuddhA sahadharminIgaNa o AllAhara prasannatA raYeche evaM AllAha vAndAdera prati lakSyakArI|
yArA valeH he AmAdera rAvva! nizcaYai AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi, ataeva AmAdera aparAdha kSamA karuna evaM jAhAnnAmera Agunera zAsti hate AmAderake vA~cAna|
yArA sahiSNu, satyaparAYaNa, sevAnugata, dAnazIla evaM USAkAle kSamAprArthI|

AllAha sAkSya pradAna karena ye, nizcaYai tini vyatIta keha ilAha (upAsya) nei evaM mAlAikA/pherezatA, jJAnavAnagaNa o suvicAre AsthA sthApanakArIgaNao sAkSya deYa ye, ei mahA parAkrAnta vijJAnamaYa vyatIta Ara konai upAsya nei|

nizcaYai isalAmai AllAhara nikaTa ekamAtra dharma| evaM yAderake grantha pradatta haYeche tAdera jJAna AsAra parao tArA matavirodhe lipta raYeche zudhumAtra paraspara vidveSa vazataH; evaM ye AllAhara nidarzanasamUha asvIkAra kare nizcaYai AllAha sattvara hisAva grahaNakArI|

ataHpara yadi tArA tomAra sAthe kalaha kare tAhale tumi valaH Ami o AmAra anusArIgaNa AllAhara uddezye AtmasamarpaNa karechi evaM yAderake grantha pradatta haYeche o yArA nirakSara tAderake valaH tomarAo ki AtmasamarpaNa karecha? ataHpara yadi tArA ‌AtmasamarpaNa kare tAhale nizcaYai tArA supatha peYe yAve, Ara yadi phire yAYa tAhale tomAra upara dAYitva hacche pracAra karA mAtra evaM AllAha vAndAdera prati lakSyakArI|

nizcaYai yArA AllAhara nidarzanasamUha avizvAsa kare o anyAYabhAve nAvIderake hatyA kare evaM hatyA kare tAdera yArA mAnavamanDalIra madhye nyAYera AdezakArI, tAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda dAo|
edera kRtakarmasamUha ihakAla o AkhirAte vyartha have evaM tAdera janya keha sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani yAderake granthera ekAMza pradatta haYeche? tAderake granthera dike AhavAna karA haYeche yena eTA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare, ataHpara tAdera ekadala pratigamana karala evaM tArA pratigamanakArI|
eTA e janya ye, tArA valeH nirdiSTa saMkhyaka dina vyatIta jAhAnnAmera Aguna AmAderake sparza karavenA; evaM tArA yA sthira kareche, tAdera dharma viSaYe oTA tAderake pratArita kareche|
ataHpara ye dina Ami tAderake ekatrita karava, yAte kona sandeha nei, takhana tAdera ki dazA have? evaM pratyeka vyakti yA arjana kareche tA samyaka rUpe pradatta have evaM tArA atyAcArita havenA|

tumi valaH he rAjyAdhipati AllAha! Apani yAke icchA rAjatva dAna karena evaM yAra nikaTa hate icchA rAjatva chiniYe nena; yAke icchA sammAna dAna karena evaM yAke icchA lAJchita karena; ApanArai hAte raYeche kalyANa| nizcaYai Apanii sarva viSaYe kSamatAvAna|
Apani rAtake dine parivartita karena evaM dinake rAte pariNata karena, evaM jIvitake mRta hate nirgata karena o mRtake jIvita hate vahirgata karena evaM Apani yAke icchA aparimita jIvikA dAna karena|

mu’minagaNa yena mu’minagaNake cher3e kAphiraderake vandhu rUpe grahaNa nA kare, evaM tAdera AzaMkA hate AtmarakSA vyatIta ye erUpa kare se AllAhara nikaTa samparkahIna; Ara AllAha tomAderake svIYa pavitra astitvera bhaYa pradarzana karachena evaM AllAharai dike phire yete have|

tumi valaH tomAdera antarasamUhe yA raYeche tA tomarA gopana kara athavA prakAza kara AllAha tA avagata Achena evaM nabhomanDale o bhUmanDale yA kichu raYeche AllAha tA jJAta Achena; evaM AllAha sarva viSaYe zaktimAna|

sedina pratyeka vyakti satkAja hate yA kareche o duskarma hate yA kareche tA dekhate pAve; takhana se icchA karave - yadi tAra madhye evaM ai duskarmera madhye sudUra vyavadhAna hata! AllAha tomAderake svIYa pavitra astitvera bhaYa pradarzana karachena evaM AllAha svIYa vAndAdera prati snehazIla|
tumi valaH yadi tomarA AllAhake bhAlavAsa tAhale AmAra anusaraNa kara, yAte AllAha tomAderake bhAlavAsena o tomAdera aparAdhasamUha kSamA karena; evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
tumi valaH tomarA AllAha o rAsUlera anusaraNa kara; kintu yadi tArA phire yAYa tAhale nizcaYai AllAha avizvAsIderake bhAlavAsena nA|
nizcaYai AllAha Adama o nUhake evaM ivarAhIma o imarAnera santAnagaNake vizva jagatera upara manonIta karechena|
tArA eke aparera vaMzadhara evaM AllAha zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|

yakhana imarAna-patnI nivedana karala, he AmAra rAvva! nizcaYai AmAra garbhe yA raYeche tA Ami mukta kare ApanAra uddeze utsarga karalAma, sutarAM Apani AmA hate tA grahaNa karuna, nizcaYai Apani zravaNakArI, mahAjJAnI|

anantara yakhana se tA prasava karala takhana valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Amito kanyA prasava karechi; evaM se yA prasava kareche tA AllAha samyaka avagata Achena, evaM kono putra ei kanyAra samakakSa naYa! Ara Ami kanyAra nAma rAkhalAma ‘mAraiYAma’ evaM Ami tAke o tAra santAnagaNake vitAr3ita zAitAna hate ApanAra AzraYe samarpana karalAma|

anantara tAra rAvva tAke uttama rUpe grahaNa karalena evaM tAke uttama pravRddhi dAna karalena evaM yAkAriYAke tAra bhArArpana karalena; yakhanai yAkAriYA tAra nikaTa ukta prakoSThe praveza karata takhana tAra nikaTa khAdya sambhAra dekhate peta; se valataH he mAraiYAma! eTA kothA hate prApta hale? se valataH eTA AllAhara nikaTa hate, nizcaYai AllAha yAke icchA aparimita jIvikA dAna karena|
takhana yAkAriYA tAra ravera nikaTa prArthanA karechila, se valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke ApanAra nikaTa hate pavitra santAna pradAna karuna, nizcaYai Apani prArthanA zravaNakArI|

ataHpara yakhana se meharAvera madhye dA~r3iYe prArthanA karachila takhana mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNa tAke samvodhana kare valechilaH nizcaYai AllAha tomAke iYAhaiYA samvandhe susaMvAda dicchena - tAra avasthA ei have ye, se AllAhara ekaTi vAkyera satyatA prakAzakArI have, netA have, svIYa pravRttike damanakArI have evaM sat karmazIlagaNera madhye nAvI have|
se valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! kirUpe AmAra putra have? nizcaYai AmAra vArdhakya upasthita haYeche evaM AmAra strI vandhyA; tini valalenaH eirUpe AllAha yA icchA karena tA’i kare thAkena|

se valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAra janya kona nidarzana nirdiSTa karuna; tini valalenaH tomAra nidarzana ei ye, tumi tina dina iGgita vyatIta lokera sAthe kathA valate pAravenA; evaM svIYa rAvvake vezI vezI smaraNa kara evaM sandhyAYa o prabhAte tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
evaM yakhana mAlAka/pherezatA valechilaH ohe mAraiYAma! nizcaYai AllAha tomAke manonIta karechena o tomAke pavitra karechena evaM vizva jagatera nArIgaNera upara tomAke manonIta karechena|
he mAraiYAma! tomAra ravera ivAdAta kara evaM sAjadAha kara o rukukArIgaNera sAthe ruku kara|

eTA sei adRzya viSaYaka saMvAda yA Ami tomAra prati pratyAdeza karachi; evaM yakhana tArA svIYa lekhanIsamUha nikSepa karachila ye, tAdera madhye ke mAraiYAmera pratipAlana karave takhana tumi tAdera nikaTa chilenA; evaM yakhana tArA kalaha karachila takhanao tumi tAdera nikaTa chilenA|

yakhana mAlAikA/pherezatArA valechilaH he mAraiYAma! nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra nikaTa hate ekaTi vAkya dvArA tomAke susaMvAda dicchena nandana IsA masIha - se ihaloka o paraloke sammAnita evaM sAnnidhya prAptagaNera antarbhukta|
Ara se dolanA hate o pariNata vaYase lokera sAthe kathA valave evaM se puNyavAnagaNera antarbhukta have|

se valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! kirUpe AmAra putra have? kona puruSa mAnuSato AmAke sparza kareni; tini valalenaH erUpe AllAha yA icchA karena, sRSTi kare thAkena, yakhana tini kona kAjera manastha karena takhana tini oke ‘hao’ valena, phalataH tAtei haYe yAYa|
tini tAke grantha, vijJAna evaM tAorAta o iJjIla zikSA divena|

Ara tAke isarAIla vaMzIYagaNera janya rAsUla karavena| nizcaYai Ami (IsA) tomAdera ravera nikaTa hate nidarzanasaha tomAdera nikaTa Agamana karechi; nizcaYai Ami tomAdera janya mATi hate pAkhira AkAra gaThana karava, ataHpara ora madhye phutkAra diva, anantara AllAhara Adeze oTA pAkhi haYe yAve, evaM janmAndhake o kuSTha rogIke nirAmaYa kari evaM AllAhara Adeze mRtake jIvita kari evaM tomarA yA AhAra kara o tomarA yA svIYa gRhera madhye saMgraha kare rAkha tadviSaYe saMvAda dicchi - yadi tomarA vizvAsI hao tAhale nizcaYai ete tomAdera janya nidarzana raYeche|

evaM Ami esechi AmAra pUrve tAorAte yA chila tAra satyatA pradAna karate evaM tomAdera janya yA avaidha haYeche tAra katipaYa tomAdera janya vaidha karate, Ara tomAdera ravera nikaTa hate tomAdera janya nidarzana niYe; ataeva AllAhake bhaYa kara o AmAra anugata hao|
nizcaYai AllAha AmAra rAvva evaM tomAdera rAvva; ataeva tA~ra ivAdAta kara - eTAi sarala patha|

anantara yakhana IsA tAdera madhye pratyAkhyAna pratyakSa karala takhana se valalaH AllAhara uddeze ke AmAra sAhAyyakArI have? hAoYArigaNa valalaH AmarAi AllAhara sAhAyyakArI, AmarA AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana karechi, evaM sAkSI theko ye, AmarA AtmasamarpaNakArI|
he AmAdera rAvva! Apani yA avatIrNa karechena, AmarA tA vizvAsa kari evaM AmarA rAsUlera anusaraNa karachi, ataeva sAkSIgaNera sAthe AmAderake lipivaddha karuna|
Ara tArA (kAphirerA) Sar3ayantra karechila o AllAhao kauzala karalena evaM AllAha zreSThatama kauzalI|

yakhana AllAha valalenaH he IsA! nizcaYai Ami tomAke AmAra dike pratigrahaNa karava evaM tomAke uttolana karava evaM avizvAsakArIdera hate tomAke pavitra karava, Ara yArA avizvAsa kareche tAdera upara tomAra anusArIgaNake utthAna dina paryanta samunnata karava; anantara AmArai dike tomAdera pratyAvartana; ataHpara tomAdera madhye ye viSaYe matabheda chila tAra mImAMsA karava|
anantara yArA kupharI kareche (avizvAsI haYeche), vastutaH tAderake ihakAla o AkhirAte kaThora zAsti pradAna karava evaM tAdera janya keha sAhAyyakArI nei|
Ara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche o satkAja kareche phalataH tini tAderake pUrNa pratidAna pradAna karavena evaM AllAha atyAcArIderake bhAlavAsenanA|
Ami tomAra prati vijJAnamaYa varNanA o nidarzanAvalI hate eTA AvRtti karachi|
nizcaYai AllAhara nikaTa IsAra dRSTAnta Adamera anurUpa; tini tAke mATi dvArA sRSTi karalena, ataHpara valalena hao, phalataH tAtei haYe gela|
ei vAstava ghaTanA tomAra ravera pakSa hate; sutarAM tumi saMzaYIdera antarbhukta haYonA|

ataHpara tomAra nikaTa ye jJAna eseche, tArapare tadviSaYe ye tomAra sAthe kalaha kare, tumi valaH eso, AmarA AmAdera santAnagaNa o tomAdera santAnagaNake, AmAdera nArIgaNa o tomAdera nArIgaNake evaM svaYaM AmAdera o tomAderake AhavAna kari| ataHpara prArthanA kari ye, asatyavAdIdera upara AllAhara abhisampAta varSita hoka|
nizcaYai eTAi satya vivaraNa evaM AllAha vyatIta anya kona ilAha (upAsya) nei, nizcaYai sei AllAha vijJAnamaYa, mahAparAkrAnta|
ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale nizcaYai AllAha duskAryakArIdera jJAta Achena|

tumi valaH he Ahale kitAva! AmAdera madhye o tomAdera madhye ye vAkye susAdRzya raYeche tAra dike eso, yena AmarA AllAha vyatIta kArao ivAdAta nA kari evaM tA~ra sAthe kona aMzI sthira nA kari evaM AllAhake parityAga kare AmarA paraspara kehake rAvva rUpe grahaNa nA kari| ataHpara yadi tArA phire yAYa tAhale valaH sAkSI theko ye, AmarA musalima (AllAhara nikaTa AtmasamaparnakArI)|
he Ahale kitAva! tomarA ivarAhIma samvandhe kena virtaka karacha? athaca tAra pare vyatIta tAorAta o iJjIla avatIrNa haYani - tavuo ki tomarA vujhachanA?

hyA~, tomarA emana ye, ye viSaYe tomAdera jJAna chila tA niYeo tomarA kalaha karechile, kintu yadviSaYe tomAdera konai jJAna nei tA niYe tomarA kena kalaha karacha evaM AllAha jJAta Achena o tomarA avagata nao|
ivarAhIma iYAhudI chilanA evaM khRSTAnao chilanA, varaM se sudRr3ha musalima chila evaM se muzarikadera (aMzIvAdI) antarbhukta chilanA|
niHsandehe ai sava loka ivarAhImera nikaTatama yArA tAra anusaraNa kareche evaM ei nAvI evaM (tA~ra sAthera) mu’minagaNa; evaM AllAha vizvAsIgaNera abhibhAvaka|
evaM kitAvIdera madhye eka dalera vAsanA ye, tomAderake pathabhrAnta kare; kintu tArA nijedera vyatIta anya kehake vipathagAmI karenA evaM tArA tA vujhachenA|
he Ahale kitAva! tomarA kena AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera prati avizvAsa karacho? athaca tomarAi ora sAkSI|
he kitAvIrA! tomarA kena satyera saGge mithyAke miliYe niccha evaM satyake gopana karacha? athaca tomarAto avagata Acha|
Ara Ahale kitAvera madhye ekadala eTAi vale ye, vizvAsa sthApanakArIdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tatprati pUrvAhne vizvAsa sthApana kara evaM aparAhne tA asvIkAra kara, tAhale tArA phire yAve|

Ara yArA tomAdera dharmera anusaraNa kare tArA vyatIta anyadera vizvAsa karanA| tumi tAderake valaH AllAhara pathai ekamAtra supatha| ei Ahale kitAvIrA vizvAsa karenA ye, tAdera parivarte anya kArao upara ahI avatIrNa hate pAre| athavA tArA tomAra ravera kAche pau~chA paryanta tarka/vitarka karatei thAkave| tumi valaH anugraha AllAharai hAte, tini yAke icchA ihA dAna karena evaM AllAhai rakSAkArI, mahAjJAnI|
tini yAra prati icchA karena svIYa karunA nirdiSTa karena evaM AllAha mahAna, anugrahazIla|

kitAvIdera madhye erUpa Ache ye, yadi tumi tAra nikaTa puJjIbhUta dhanarAzio gacchita rekhe dAo tavuo se tA tomAra nikaTa pratyarpaNa karave evaM tAdera madhye erUpao Ache ye, yadi tumi tAra nikaTa ekaTi dInArao gacchita rAkha tAhale se tAo tomAke pratyarpaNa karavenA ye paryanta tumi tAra ziropari danDAYamAna thAka| kAraNa tArA vale ye, AmAdera upara ai azikSitadera kona dAYa dAYitva nei evaM tArA AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare, yA tArAo jAne|
hyA~, yArA svIYa aGgIkAra pUrNa kare o saMyata haYa, tAhale nizcaYai AllAha dharmabhIrugaNake bhAlavAsena|

nizcaYai yArA AllAhara prati aGgIkAra o svIYa zapatha sAmAnya mUlye vikri kare, paraloke tAdera konai aMza nei evaM utthAna dine AllAha tAdera sAthe kathA valavenanA evaM tAdera prati dRSTipAtao karavenanA evaM parizuddhao karavenanA| tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

Ara tAdera madhye nizcaYai erUpa ekadala Ache yArA kuJcita bhASAYa grantha AvRtti kare, yena tomarA oTAke granthera aMza mane kara, athaca oTA granthera aMza naYa; evaM tArA vale ye, eTA AllAhara nikaTa hate samAgata, athaca oTA AllAhara nikaTa hate naYa, evaM tArA AllAha samvandhe mithyA vale evaM tArAo tA avagata Ache|

eTA kona mAnuSera pakSe upayogI naYa ye, AllAha yAke grantha, vijJAna o navuoYAta dAna karena, ataHpara se mAnavamanDalIra madhye vale - tomarA AllAhake parityAga kare AmAra upAsaka hao; varaM valaveH ravera ivAdAtakArI hao - kAraNa tomarAi kuraAna zikSA dAna kara evaM oTA pATha kare thAka|
Ara tini Adeza karenanA ye, tomarA mAlAka/pherezatA o nAvIgaNake rAvva rUpe grahaNa kara; tomarA AtmasamarpaNakArI havAra para tini ki tomAderake punarAYa kupharIte phire yAvAra Adeza karavena?

evaM AllAha yakhana nAvIgaNera aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilena, Ami tomAderake grantha o vijJAna hate dAna karAra para tomAdera saGge yA Ache tAra satyatA pratyAYanakArI ekajana rAsUla Agamana karave, takhana tomarA avazyai tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karave evaM tAra sAhAyyakArI have; tini Arao valechilenaH tomarA ki ete svIkRta hale evaM pratizruti grahaNa karale? tArA valechila - AmarA svIkAra karalAma| tini valalenaH tAhale tomarA sAkSI theka evaM Amio tomAdera sAthe sAkSIgaNera antarbhukta railAma|
ataHpara era pare yArA phire yAve tArAi duskAryakArI|

tAhale ki tArA AllAhara dharma vyatIta anya kichu kAmanA kare? athaca nabhomanDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache, icchA o anicchAkrame savAi tA~ra uddeze AtmasamarpaNa kareche evaM tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|

tumi valaH AmarA AllAhara prati evaM yA AmAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche evaM ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tAdera vaMzadharagaNera prati avatIrNa haYeche evaM yA mUsA, IsA o anyAnya nAvIgaNake tAdera rAvva kartRka pradatta haYeche tatprati vizvAsa sthApana karalAma, AmarA tAdera madhye kehakeo pArthakya jJAna karinA evaM AmarA tA~rai prati AtmasamarpaNakArI|
Ara ye keha isalAma vyatIta anya dharma anveSaNa kare tA kakhanai tAra nikaTa hate gRhIta havenA evaM paraloke se kSatigrastadera antarbhukta have|

kirUpe AllAha sei sampradAYake patha pradarzana karavena yArA vizvAsa sthApanera para, rAsUlera satyatA viSaYe sAkSyadAnera para evaM tAdera nikaTa prakAzya nidarzanasamUha AsAra parao avizvAsI haYeche? Ara AllAha atyAcArI sampradAYake patha pradarzana karenanA|
orAi - yAdera pratiphala ei ye, nizcaYai tAdera upara AllAhara, tA~ra mAlAikA/pherezatAra evaM samasta mAnavera abhisampAta|
tArA tanmadhye sadA avasthAna karave - tAdera upara hate zAsti prazamita havenA evaM tAderake virAma deYA havenA|
kintu yArA erapara kSamA prArthanA kare o saMzodhita haYa, tAhale nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
nizcaYai yArA vizvAsa sthApanera para avizvAsI haYeche, ataHpara avizvAsa parivardhita kareche - tAdera kSamA prArthanA kakhanai gRhIta havenA evaM tArAi pathabhrAnta|

nizcaYai yArA avizvAsa kareche o avizvAsI avasthAYa mRtyu varaNa kareche tAdera muktira vinimaYe yadi pRthivIpUrNa svarNa deYA haYa tavuo kakSano tA grahaNa karA havenA| oderai janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche evaM odera janya konai sAhAyyakArI nei|
tomarA yA bhAlavAsa tA hate vyaYa nA karA paryanta tomarA kakhanai kalyANa lAbha karate pAravenA; evaM tomarA yA kichui vyaYa kara, AllAha tA jJAta Achena|

pratyeka khAdyai vAnI isarAIlera janya hAlAla chila| ekamAtra tAorAta avatIrNa haoYAra pUrve vAnI isarAIla nijera upara yA hArAma kare niYechila tAi tAdera upara hArAma karA haYechila| tumi valaH yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale tAorAta AnaYana kara, ataHpara oTA pATha kara|
sutarAM yadi keha erapara AllAhara prati asatyAropa kare tAhale tArAi atyAcArI|
tumi valaH AllAha satya valechena; ataeva tomarA ivarAhImera sudRr3ha dharmera anusaraNa kara evaM se aMzIvAdIdera antargata chilanA|
nizcaYai sarva prathama gRha, yA mAnavamanDalIra janya nirdiSTa karA haYeche tA ai ghara yA vAkkAYa (mAkkAYa) avisthata; oTi saubhAgyayukta evaM samasta vizvavAsIra janya patha pradarzaka|

ora madhye prakAzya nidarzanasamUha vidyamAna raYeche, mAkAme ivarAhIma ukta nidarzanasamUhera anyatama| Ara ye ora madhye praveza kare se nirApattA prApta haYa evaM AllAhara uddeze ei gRhera hAjja karA sei sava mAnuSera kartavya yArA saphara karAra Arthika sAmarthya rAkhe evaM yadi keha asvIkAra kare tAhale nizcaYai AllAha samagra vizvavAsI hate pratyAzAmukta|
tumi valaH he kitAvadhArIrA! tomarA kena AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra prati avizvAsa karacho? tomarA yA karacho AllAha tadviSaYe sAkSI|

he granthaprAptarA! ye vyakti vizvAsa sthApana kareche tAra madhye kuTilatAra kAmanAYa kena tomarA tAke AllAhara pathe rodha karacho, athaca tomarA e pathera satyatA pratyakSa karacha evaM tomarAi sAkSI raYecha? Ara tomarA yA karacho tadviSaYe AllAha amanoyogI nana|
he mu’minagaNa! yAderake grantha pradatta haYeche, yadi tomarA tAdera eka dalera anusaraNa kara tAhale tArA tomAderake tomAdera ImAna AnaYanera para kAphira vAniYe dive|

Ara kirUpe tomarA avizvAsa karate pAra - yakhana AllAhara nidarzanAvalI tomAdera sAmane paThita haYa evaM tomAdera madhye tA~ra rAsUla vidyamAna raYeche? Ara ye AllAhara patha dRr3ha rUpe dhAraNa kare, avazyai se sarala patha pradarzita have|
he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara yemanabhAve karA ucit evaM tomarA musalima nA haYe mRtyu varaNa karanA|

Ara tomarA ekayoge AllAhara rajju sudRr3ha rUpe dhAraNa kara o vibhakta haYe yeonA, evaM tomAdera prati AllAhara ye dAna raYeche tA smaraNa kara| yakhana tomarA paraspara zatru chile takhana tinii tomAdera antaHkaraNe prIti sthApana karechilena, ataHpara tomarA tA~ra anugrahe bhrAtRtve Avaddha hale evaM tomarA anala-kunDera dhAre chile, anantara tinii tomAderake oTA hate uddhAra karechena; erUpe AllAha tomAdera janya svIYa nidarzanAvalI vyakta karena, yena tomarA supatha prApta hao|
evaM tomAdera madhye erUpa eka sampradAYa haoYA ucita yArA kalyANera dike AhavAna kare evaM sat kAje Adeza kare o asat kAje niSedha kare, Ara tArAi suphala prApta have|
evaM tAdera mato haYonA yAdera nikaTa spaSTa pramANa AsAra parao vibhinna dale vibhakta haYeche o paraspara matabhede lipta raYeche; tAdera janya raYeche kaThora zAsti|

sedina kataguli mukhamanDala have zvetavarNa evaM kataka mukhamanDala have kRSNavarNa; ataHpara yAdera mukhamanDala kRSNavarNa have, (tAderake valA have) tAhale ki tomarA vizvAsa sthApanera para avizvAsI haYecha? ataeva tomarA zAstira AsvAda grahaNa kara, yehetu tomarA avizvAsa karechile|
Ara yAdera mukhamanDala zubhra have, tArA AllAhara karuNAra antarbhukta, tArA tanmadhye sadA avasthAna karave|
eguli hacche AllAhara nidarzana - yA Ami tomAra prati satyasaha AvRtti karachi evaM AllAha vizva jagatera prati atyAcArera icchA karenanA|
Ara yA nabhomanDalera madhye Ache o yA bhUmanDalera madhye raYeche tA AllAhara evaM AllAhara kAchei sava kichu pratyAvartanazIla|

tomarAi sarvottama ummAta, mAnava jAtira kalyANera janya tomAdera udbhava ghaTAno haYeche, tomarA sat kAje Adeza karave o asat kAje niSedha karave evaM AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana karave; Ara yadi grantha prAptarA vizvAsa sthApana karata tAhale avazyai tAdera janya maGgala hata; tAdera madhye keha keha mu’mina evaM tAdera adhikAMzai duskAryakArI|

sAmAnya duHkha pradAna vyatIta tArA tomAdera kona aniSTa karate pAravenA; Ara yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe lar3Ai kare tAhale tArA tomAderake pRSTha pradarzana karave; ataHpara tAderake sAhAyya karA havenA|

AllAhara nikaTa AzraYa grahaNa evaM manuSyagaNera nikaTa atmasamarpaNa vyatIta tArA yekhAnei avasthAna karuka nA kena, lAJchanAYa AkrAnta haYeche, AllAhara kope nipatita haYeche evaM galagrahatA odera upara cApiYe deYA haYeche| eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra prati avizvAsa karechila evaM nAvIgaNake anyAYabhAve hatyA karechila; yehetu tArA viruddhAcaraNa karechila o sImA atikrama karechila|
tArA sakale samAna naYa; Ahale kitAvera madhye kichu loka raYeche yArA gabhIra rAta paryanta AllAhara AYAtasamUha pATha kare evaM sAjadAha kare|
tArA AllAha o AkhirAta vizvAsa kare evaM sat kAje Adeza o asat kAje niSedha kare evaM sat kAjasamUhe tatpara thAke, Ara tArAi sat karmazIlagaNera antarbhukta|
Ara tArA ye sat kAja karave tA kakhanao avajJA karA havenA; evaM AllAha dharmabhIrugaNake avagata Achena|
nizcaYai yArA avizvAsa kareche tAdera dhanarAzi o santAna-santati AllAhara nikaTa kichumAtra kAje AsavenA; evaM tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tanmadhye tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|

tArA pArthiva jIvane yA vyaYa kare tAra dRSTAnta zaityapUrNa jhaJjhA-vAYura anurUpa - yArA svIYa jIvanera prati atyAcAra kareche - oTA sei sakala sampradAYera zasyakSete nipatita haYa evaM tA vidhvasta kare| evaM AllAha tAdera prati atyAcAra karenani, varaM tArAi svIYa jIvanera prati atyAcAra kareche|

he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! tomarA nijedera sampradAYa vyatireke anya kehake vandhu rUpe grahaNa karanA, tArA tomAderake kSatigrasta karate saMkucita havenA; evaM tomarA yAte vipanna hao tArA tA’i kAmanA kare; vastutaH tAdera mukha hatei zatrutA prakAzita haYa, evaM tAdera antara yA gopana kare tA Arao gurutara; nizcaYai Ami tomAdera janya nidarzanAvalI vyakta karachi, yena tomarA vujhate pAra|

sAvadhAna hao - tomarAi tAderake bhAlavAsa, athaca tArA tomAderake bhAlavAsenA; evaM tomarA samasta granthai vizvAsa kara; Ara tArA yakhana tomAdera sAthe milita haYa takhana valeH AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi evaM yakhana tomAdera hate pRthaka haYe yAYa takhana tomAdera prati Akroze AGgulera agrabhAgasamUha daMzana kare| tumi valaH tomarA nijedera Akroze mare yAo! nizcaYai AllAha antarera kathA jJAta Achena|

yadi tomAderake kalyANa sparza kare tAhale tArA asantaSTa haYa; Ara yadi amaGgala upasthita haYa takhana tArA Anandita haYe thAke, evaM yadi tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara o saMyamI hao tAhale tAdera cakrAnta tomAdera konai kSati karate pAravenA| tArA yA kare - nizcaYai AllAha tAra pariveSTanakArI|
(smaraNa kara) yakhana tumi vizvAsIderake yuddhArthe yathAsthAne saMsthApita karAra janya prabhAte svIYa parijana hate vera haYechile evaM AllAha sava kichu zravaNa karena o jAnena|
yakhana tomAdera dui dala bhIrutA prakAzera saMkalpa karechila evaM AllAha sei daladvaYera pRSThapoSaka chilena; evaM mu’minagaNai AllAhara upara nirbhara kare thAke|
Ara nizcaYai AllAha tomAderake vadare sAhAyya karechilena evaM tomarA durvala chile; ataeva tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, yena tomarA kRtajJa hao|
yakhana mu’minaderake valechilenaH eTA ki tomAdera pakSe yatheSTa naYa ye, tomAdera rAvva tina sahasra mAlAikA/pherezatA preraNa kare tomAdera sAhAyya karavena?
varaM yadi tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara o saMyamI hao evaM tArA yadi svecchAYa tomAdera upara nipatita haYa tAhale tomAdera rAvva pA~ca sahasra viziSTa mAlAikA dvArA tomAderake sAhAyya karavena|
Ara AllAha ei sAhAyya zudhu e janyai karechena yena tomAdera janya susaMvAda haYa evaM tomAdera antare zAnti Ase| Ara sAhAyya zudhu AllAhara pakSa hatei haYe thAke, yini parAkrAnta, vijJAnamaYa|
yArA avizvAsI haYeche - tini erUpe tAdera ekAMzake kartita karena athavA tAderake durvala karena, yAte tArA akRtakArya sahakAre phire yAYa|
e vyApAre tomAra konai karaNIYa nei, tini tAderake kSamA karena athavA zAsti pradAna karena; nizcaYai tArA atyAcArI|
Ara nabhoHmanDale yA raYeche o bhUmanDale yA Ache tA AllAharai; tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti pradAna karena evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYa|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA dviguNera upara dviguNa suda bhakSaNa karanA evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara yena tomarA suphala prApta hao|
Ara tomarA sei jAhAnnAmera bhaYa kara, yA avizvAsIdera janya prastuta rAkhA haYeche|
Ara AllAha o rAsUlera Anugatya svIkAra kara yena tomarA karuNA prApta hao|
tomarA svIYa ravera kSamA o jAnnAtera dike dhAvita hao, yAra prasAratA nabhomanDala o bhUmanDala sadRza, oTA dharmabhIrudera janya nirmita haYeche|
yArA svacchalatA o abhAvera madhye vyaYa kare evaM krodha saMvaraNa kare o mAnavaderake kSamA kare; evaM AllAha satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

evaM yakhana keha azlIla kAja kare kiMvA svIYa jIvanera prati atyAcAra kare ataHpara AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM aparAdhasamUhera janya kSamA prArthanA kare, evaM AllAha vyatIta ke aparAdhasamUha kSamA karate pAre? evaM tArA yA karache sei vyApAre jene zune haThakAritA karenA|

tAdera puraskAra have tAdera ravera nikaTa hate mArjanA evaM emana udyAnasamUha yegulira taladeza diYe srotasvinIsamUha pravAhita thAkave, tanmadhye tArA sadA avasthAna karave, evaM karmIdera janya ki sundara pratidAna!
nizcaYai tomAdera pUrve vahu jIvanAcaraNa atikrAnta haYeche, pRthivIte vicaraNa kara, evaM lakSya kara ye, avizvAsIdera pariNAma kirUpa haYeche|
eTA mAnavamanDalIra janya vivaraNa evaM AllAhabhIrugaNera janya patha pradarzana o upadeza|
Ara tomarA nirAza haYonA o viSanna haYonA evaM yadi tomarA vizvAsI hao tAhale tomarAi vijaYI have|

yadi tomAdera AghAta lege thAke tAhale nizcaYai sei sampradAYerao tadrupa AghAta legeche, evaM ei dinasamUhake Ami mAnavagaNera madhye parikramaNa karAi; evaM yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche tAderake AllAha ei rUpe prakAza karena; evaM tomAdera madhya hate katakake zahIda rUpe grahaNa karavena, Ara AllAha atyAcArIderake bhAlavAsenanA|
Ara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche tAderake AllAha eirUpe pavitra karena evaM avizvAsIderake dhvaMsa karena|
tomarA ki dhAraNA karacha ye, tomarAi jAnnAte praveza karave? athaca kArA jihAda kare o kArA dhairyazIla AllAha tomAdera madhya hate tAderake ekhanao parIkSA karenani?
evaM nizcaYai tomarA mRtyura pUrvei ora sAkSAt kAmanA karachile, anantara nizcaYai tomarA ekhana tA pratyakSa karacha tomAdera nijedera cokhe|

evaM muhAmmAda rAsUla vyatIta kichui naYa, nizcaYai tAra pUrve rAsUlagaNa vigata haYeche, anantara yadi tAra mRtyu haYa athavA se nihata haYa tAhale ki tomarA pazcAdapade phire yAve? evaM ye keha pazcAdapade phire yAYa tAte se AllAhara konai aniSTa karavenA evaM AllAha kRtajJagaNake puraskAra pradAna karena|

Ara AllAhara Adeze lipivaddha nirdiSTa samaYa vyatIta kehai mRtyumukhe patita haYanA; evaM ye keha ihalokera pratidAna kAmanA kare, Ami tAke tA duniYAYa pradAna kare thAki; pakSAntare ye loka AkhirAte vinimaYa kAmanA kare Ami tAke tA pradAna karava evaM Ami kRtajJagaNake acirei puraskAra pradAna karava|

Ara emana aneka nAvI chila yArA saGgIsahayoge anuvartI haYe yuddha karechila; paranta AllAhara pathe yA saMghaTita haYechila tAte tArA nirutsAha haYani o zaktihIna haYani evaM vicalita haYani| evaM AllAha dhairyazIlagaNake bhAlavAsena|

Ara etadvyatIta tAdera kathA chilanA ye, tArA valataH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera aparAdha o AmAdera kAjera vAr3AvAr3i hetu kRta anyAYasamUha kSamA karuna, AmAderake dRr3ha rAkhuna evaM avizvAsIdera viruddhe AmAderake sAhAyya karuna|
anantara AllAha tAderake pArthiva puraskAra pradAna karalena evaM paralokera puraskAra zreSThatara; evaM AllAha satkarmazIlagaNake bhAlavAsena|
he mu’minagaNa! yArA avizvAsa kareche, yadi tomarA tAdera AjJAvaha hao tAhale tArA tomAderake pazcAdapade phiriYe nive, tAte tomarA kSatigrasta have|
varaM AllAha tomAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tinii zreSThatara sAhAyyakArI|

yArA avizvAsa kareche, Ami sattvara tAdera antare bhIti saJcAra karava, yehetu tArA AllAhara sAthe sei viSaYe aMzI sthApana kareche yadviSaYe tini kona pramANa avatIrNa karenani evaM jAhAnnAma tAdera avasthAna sthala evaM oTA atyAcArIdera janya nikRSTa vAsasthAna!

Ara nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera prati deYA tA~ra aGgIkAra pUrNa karechena yakhana tomarA tA~ra anumatikrame tomAdera zatrudera vinAza karachile tomarA sAhasahArA haYe yAoYA paryanta evaM nirdeza samparke vivAda karachile o avAdhya haYechile| ataHpara tomarA yA pachanda kara (vijaYa) tA tomAdera pratyakSa karAlena| tomAdera madhye emana kichu loka Ache yArA pArthiva vastta kAmanA kare evaM kichu loka parakAla pachanda kare| ataHpara tini tomAdera parIkSA karAra janya zatrudera theke phiriYe dilena evaM nizcaYai tini tomAderake kSamA karalena| AllAha vizvAsIdera prati anugrahazIla|

Ara yakhana tomarA ArohaNa kare yAcchile evaM kArao dike phireo dekhachilenA evaM rAsUla tomAderake pazcAda hate AhavAna karachila; anantara tini tomAderake duHkhera upara duHkha pradAna karalena| kintu yA atikrAnta haYeche evaM tomAdera upara yA upanIta haYani, tomarA tajjanya duHkha karanA; evaM tomarA yA karacha AllAha tadviSaYe abhijJa|

anantara tini duHkhera pare tomAdera upara zAnti avataraNa karalena, tA chila tandrA, yA tomAdera eka dalake tandrAcchanna karechila, Ara ekadala nijedera jIvanera janya cintA karachila; tArA AllAha samvandhe ajJatAra anurUpa dhAraNA poSaNa karachila| tArA valechilaH e viSaYe ki AmAdera kona adhikAra nei? tumi valaH sakala viSaYe AllAhara adhikAra| tArA nijedera antare yA gopana rAkhe tA tomAra nikaTa prakAza karenA; tArA valeH yadi e viSaYe AmAdera kona adhikAra thAkato tAhale ekhAne AmarA nihata hatAmanA| tumi valaH yadi tomarA tomAdera gRhera madhyeo thAkate tavuo yAdera prati mRtyu vidhivaddha haYeche tArA nizcaYai svIYa mRtyu sthAne ese upasthita hata; tomAdera antarera madhye yA Ache, AllAha tA parIkSA kare thAkena; evaM AllAha manera antarnihita bhAva jJAta Achena|

nizcaYai tomAdera madhye yArA du’dalera sammukhIna haoYAra dina pazcAdavartIta haYechila tAra kAraNa zAitAna tAderake pratArita karechila tAderai kono pApera kAraNe| kintu AllAha tAderake kSamA karechena; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, sahiSNu|

he mu’minagaNa! yArA avizvAsa kareche tomarA tAdera mata haYonA; evaM yakhana tAdera bhrAtRgaNa pRthivIte kona abhiyAne vera haYa athavA yuddhe nihata haYa takhana tArA valeH yadi orA AmAdera nikaTa thAkato tAhale mRtyumukhe patita hatanA athavA nihata hatanA; AllAha erUpe tAdera antare duHkha o anutApa saJcAra karena, AllAhai jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu dena evaM tomarA yA karacha tatprati AllAha lakSyakArI|
Ara yadi tomarA AllAhara pathe nihata athavA mRtyumukhe patita hao tAhale AllAhara nikaTa hatei kSamA raYeche evaM tArA yA saJcaYa kareche tadapekSA tA~ra karuNA zreSThatara|
Ara yadi tomarA mRtyuvaraNa kara kiMvA nihata hao tAhale tomAderake avazyai AllAhara dike ekatrita karA have|

ataeva AllAhara anugraha ei ye, tumi tAdera prati komala citta; evaM tumi yadi karkazabhASI, kaThora hRdaYa hate tAhale nizcaYai tArA tomAra saMsarga hate antarhita hata| ataeva tumi tAderake kSamA kara o tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara evaM kArya samvandhe tAdera sAthe parAmarza kara; ataHpara tumi yakhana saMkalpa kara takhana AllAhara prati nirbhara kara; evaM nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra upara bharasAkArIgaNake bhAlavAsena|

yadi AllAha tomAderake sAhAyya karena tAhale kehai tomAdera upara jaYayukta havenA; evaM yadi tini tomAderake parityAga karena tAhale tA~ra pare Ara ke Ache ye tomAderake sAhAyya karate pAre? evaM vizvAsIgaNa AllAhara uparei nirbhara kare thAke|

Ara kona nAvIra pakSe kona viSaYa gopana karA zobhanIYa naYa; evaM ye keha gopana karave tAhale se yA gopana kareche tA utthAna dine AnaYana karA have; anantara pratyeka vyakti yA arjana kareche tA pUrNarUpe pradatta have evaM tArA niryAtita havenA|
ye AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa kareche se ki tAra mata hate pAre, ye AllAhara Akroze patita haYeche? evaM tAra vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma evaM oTA nikRSTa gantavya sthAna|
AllAhara nikaTa mAnuSera vibhinna padamaryAdA raYeche evaM tomarA yA karacha tadviSaYe AllAha lakSyakArI|

nizcaYai AllAha mu’minadera prati anugraha karechena, tini tAdera nijederai madhya hate rAsUla preraNa karechena, ye tAdera nikaTa tA~ra nidarzanAvalI pATha kare o tAderake pavitra kare evaM tAderake grantha o vijJAna zikSA dAna kare evaM nizcaYai tArA era pUrve prakAzya bhrAntira madhye chila|

hyA~, yakhana tomAdera upara vipada upasthita hala, vastutaH tomarAo tAdera prati tadanurUpa du’vAra vipada upasthita karechile, tomarA valechileH eTA kothA hate hala? tumi valaH oTA tomAdera nijederai nikaTa hate; nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYopari zaktimAna|
ei dui dalera sammukhIna haoYAra dine tomAdera upara yA Apatita haYechila tA AllAharai icchAkrame; evaM taddArA AllAha vizvAsIderake parIkSA karena|

Ara taddArA tini munAphikaderake paricita karena; evaM tAderake valA haYechilaH eso, AllAhara pathe saMgrAma kara athavA zatruderake pratihata kara; tArA valechilaH yadi AmarA jAnatAma ye, lar3Ai have tAhale avazyai AmarA tomAdera anugamana karatAma| tArA sedina vizvAsa apekSA avizvAsera nikaTavartI chila; tAdera antare yA nei tA’i tArA mukhe vale thAke; tArA ye viSaYa gopana kare AllAha tA jJAta Achena|
orA tArA, yArA gRhe vase svIYa nihata bhAidera samvandhe valeH yadi tArA AmAdera kathA mAnya karata tAhale nihata hatanA; tumi valaH yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale nijederake mRtyu hate rakSA kara|
yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche tAderake kakhanao mRta mane karanA; varaM tArA jIvita, tArA tAdera rAvva hate jIvikA prApta|

AllAha tAderake svIYa anugraha hate yA dAna karechena tAtei tArA parituSTa; evaM tAdera bhAiYerA yArA ekhano tAdera sAthe sammilita haYani tAdera ei avasthAra pratio tArA santuSTa haYa ye, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhita havenA|
tArA AllAhara nikaTa hate anugraha o ni‘AmAta lAbha karAra kAraNe Anandita haYa; Ara e janya ye, nizcaYai AllAha vizvAsIgaNera pratidAna vinaSTa karenanA|
yArA AghAta pAoYAra pareo AllAha o rAsUlera nirdezake mAnya kareche tAdera madhye yArA sat kAja kareche o saMyata haYeche tAdera janya raYeche mahAna pratidAna|

yAderake lokerA valechilaH nizcaYai tomAdera viruddhe sei sava loka samaveta haYeche; ataeva tomarA tAderake bhaYa kara; kintu ete tAdera vizvAsa parivardhita haYechila evaM tArA valechilaH AllAhai AmAdera janya yatheSTa evaM tini maGgalamaYa, karmavidhAYaka|
anantara tArA AllAhara anugraha sampadasaha pratyAvartIta haYechila, tAderake amaGgala sparza kareni evaM tArA AllAhara santuSTira anusaraNa karechila; Ara AllAhara anugraha ati vyApaka|
nizcaYai zAitAna zudhumAtra tAra alI hate tomAderake bhaYa pradarzana kare; kintu yadi tomarA vizvAsI hao tAhale tAderake bhaYa karanA; evaM AmAkei bhaYa kara|

Ara yArA avizvAse tatpara, tumi tAdera janya viSanna haYonA; vastutaH tArA AllAhara kona aniSTa karate pAravenA; AllAha tAdera janya AkhirAte kona kalyANa icchA karenanA evaM tAderai janya kaThora zAsti raYeche|
nizcaYai yArA vizvAsera parivarte avizvAsa kraYa kareche tArA AllAhara konai aniSTa karate pAravenA evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantranAdAYaka zAsti|

avizvAsIrA yena e dhAraNA nA kare ye, Ami tAderake ye avakAza diYechi tA tAdera jIvanera janya kalyANakara; tArA svIYa pApa vardhita karave e janyai Ami tAderake avakAza pradAna kari; evaM tAdera janya apamAnakara zAsti raYeche|

satke asat (munAphika) hate pRthaka nA karA paryanta AllAha mu’minaderake, tArA ye avasthAYa Ache ai avasthAYa rekhe dite pArenanA, Ara gAivera khavarao tAderake avahita karavenanA, tave tA~ra rAsUladera madhya theke yAke icchA grahaNa karena| sutarAM tomarA AllAhake o tA~ra rAsUlake vizvAsa kara| evaM yadi vizvAsa kara o bhAla ‘Amala kara tAhale tomAdera janya raYeche mahA puraskAra|

Ara AllAha yAderake svIYa anugrahe kichu dAna karechena tadviSaYe yArA kArpaNya kare tArA yena erUpa dhAraNA nA kare ye, oTA tAdera janya kalyANakara; varaM oTA tAdera janya kSatikara; tArA ye viSaYe kRpaNatA kareche utthAna dine oTAi tAdera kanTha-nigar3a have; evaM AllAha nabhomanDala o bhUmanDalera svatvAdhikArI evaM yA tomarA karacha AllAha tadviSaYe pUrNa khavara rAkhena|

avazyai AllAha tAdera kathA zravaNa karechena yArA vale thAke ye, AllAha daridra o tArA dhanavAna; tArA yA valache evaM tAdera anyAYabhAve nAvIgaNake hatyA karA Ami lipivaddha karava; evaM tAderake valavaH tomarA jvalanta Agunera zAstira AsvAda grahaNa kara|
eTA tA’i yA tomAdera hastasamUha pUrve preraNa kareche evaM nizcaYai AllAha atyAcArI nana, yArA tA~ke sevA kare tAdera prati|

yArA vale thAke, avazyai AllAha AmAdera theke aGgIkAra niYechena ye, agni yA grAsa kare, AmAdera janya emana kuravAnI AnaYana nA karA paryanta AmarA yena kona nAvIra prati vizvAsa sthApana nA kari; tumi valaH nizcaYai AmAra pUrve samujjvala nidarzanAvalI evaM tomarA yA vala tatsaha rAsUlagaNa Agamana karechila; yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale kena tomarA tAderake hatyA karechile?
ataHpara yadi tArA tomAra prati asatyAropa kare tAhale tomAra pUrveo rAsUlagaNake avizvAsa karA haYechila, yArA prakAzya nidarzanAvalI o kSudra pustikA evaM ujjvala granthasaha Agamana karechila|

samasta jIvai mRtyura AsvAda grahaNa karave; evaM nizcaYai utthAna dine tomAderake pUrNa pratidAna deYA have; ataeva ye keha jAhAnnAma hate vimukta haYa evaM jAnnAte praviSTa haYa - phalataH nizcaYai se saphalakAma; Ara pArthiva jIvana chalanAmaYa bhoga vyatIta Ara kichui naYa|

avazyai tomarA tomAdera dhana-sampada o jIvana samparke parIkSita have| tomAdera pUrve yAderake grantha pradatta haYeche o yArA aMzI sthApana kareche tAdera nikaTa hate tomAderake vahu duHkhajanaka vAkya zunate have; evaM yadi tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara o saMyamI hao tAhale avazyai eTA sudRr3ha kAryAvalIra antargata|

Ara AllAha yakhana yAderake grantha pradAna karA haYeche tAdera kAcha theke aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilena ye, tArA nizcaYai eTi lokadera madhye vyakta karave evaM tA gopana karavenA; kintu tArA oTA tAdera pazcAte nikSepa karala evaM oTA alpa mUlye vikri karala| ataeva tArA yA kraYa karechila tA nikRSTatara|
yArA svIYa kRtakarme santaSTa evaM tArA yA kareni tajjanya prazaMsA prArthI erUpa lokadera samvandhe dhAraNA karanA ye, tArA zAsti hate vimukta, tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
AllAharai janya nabhomanDala o bhUmanDalera Adhipatya evaM AllAha sarva viSaYopari zaktimAna|
nizcaYai nabhomanDala o bhUmanDala sRSTite evaM dina o rAtera parivartane jJAnavAnadera janya spaSTa nidarzanAvalI raYeche|

yArA danDAYamAna, upavezana o elAYita avasthAYa AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM nabhomanDala o bhUmanDalera sRSTi viSaYe cintA-gaveSanA kare evaM valeH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani esava vRthA sRSTi karenani; Apanii pavitratama! ataeva AmAderake jAhAnnAma hate rakSA karuna!
he AmAdera rAvva! Apani yAke jAhAnnAme praviSTa karAna, phalataH nizcaYai tAke lAJchita karA haYeche; evaM atyAcArIdera janya kehai sAhAyyakArI nei|

he AmAdera rAvva! nizcaYai AmarA eka AhavAnakArIke ImAnera prati AhavAna karate zunechilAma ye, tomarA svIYa ravera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara; AmarA vizvAsa sthApana karechi; he AmAdera rAvva! ataeva AmAdera aparAdhasamUha kSamA karuna o AmAdera sakala doSakraTi dUra karuna evaM punyavAnadera sAthe AmAdera mRtyu dAna karuna|
he AmAdera rAvva! Apani svIYa rAsUlagaNera mAdhyame AmAdera sAthe ye aGgIkAra karechilena tA dAna karuna evaM utthAna divase AmAderake lAJchita karavenanA| nizcaYai Apani aGgIkAra bhaGga karenanA|

anantara tAdera rAvva tAdera janya oTA svIkAra karalena evaM valalenaH Ami tomAdera puruSa athavA nArIra madhya hate kona karmIra kRtakarma vyartha karavanA, tomarA paraspara eka, ataeva yArA deza tyAga kareche athavA svIYa gRhasamUha hate vitAr3ita haYeche o AmAra pathe niryAtita haYeche evaM saMgrAma kareche o nihata haYeche - nizcaYai tAdera janya Ami tAdera amaGgalasamUha apasAraNa karAva evaM nizcaYai Ami tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAva, yAra nimne srotasvinI nadIsamUha pravAhita; eTA AllAhara nikaTa hate pratidAna evaM AllAhara nikaTai uttama pratidAna raYeche|
yArA avizvAsI haYeche tAdera nagarasamUhe pratyAgamana yena tomAderake pratArita nA kare|
eTA mAtra kaYekadinera sambhoga; anantara tAdera avasthAna jAhAnnAma evaM oTA nikRSTa sthAna|

kintu yArA svIYa rAvvake bhaYa kare tAdera janya raYeche jAnnAta-yAra nimne srotasvinIsamUha pravAhita, tammadhye tArA sadA avasthAna karave, eTA AllAhara nikaTa raYeche, tA satkarmazIladera janya vahuguNe uttama|

evaM nizcaYai Ahale kitAvera madhye erUpa lokao raYeche yArA AllAhara prati ImAna Ane evaM tomAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche evaM yA tAdera prati avatIrNa haYechila tadviSaYe vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM AllAhara sammukhe vinaYAvanata thAke| yArA alpa mUlye AllAhara nidarzanAvalI vikri karenA tAderai janya tAdera ravera nikaTa pratidAna raYeche; nizcaYai AllAha sattvara hisAva grahaNakArI|
he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! tomarA dhairya avalamvana kara evaM sahiSNu o supratiSThita hao; evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara yena tomarA suphala prApta hao|

he mAnavamanDalI! tomarA tomAdera rAvvake bhaYa kara, yini tomAderake ekai vyakti hate sRSTi karechena evaM tA hate tadIYa sahadharminI sRSTi karechena evaM tAdera ubhaYa hate vahu nara o nArI char3iYe diYechena evaM sei AllAhake bhaYa kara yA~ra nAmera dohAi diYe tomarA eke aparake yAJcA kara, evaM AtmIYa-jJAtidera vyApAre satarkatA avalamvana kara| nizcaYai AllAhai tattvAvadhAnakArI|

Ara iYAtImaderake tAdera dhana sampatti vujhiYe dAo evaM pavitratAra sAthe apavitratAra vinimaYa karanA o tomAdera dhana sampattira sAthe tAdera dhana sampatti mizrita kare bhoga karanA; nizcaYai eTA gurutara aparAdha|

Ara yadi tomarA AzaMkA kara ye, iYAtImadera prati suvicAra karate pAravenA tAhale nArIdera madhya hate tomAdera pachanda mata du’Ti, tinaTi kiMvA cAraTike viYe kare nAo; kintu yadi tomarA AzaMkA kara ye, tAdera sAthe nyAYa saGgata AcaraNa karate pAravenA tAhale mAtra ekaTi athavA tomAdera DAna hAta yAra adhikArI (krItadAsI); eTA Arao uttama; eTA avicAra nA karAra nikaTavartI|
Ara santuSTa citte nArIderake tAdera deYa mohara pradAna kara, kintu yadi tArA svecchAYa kiYadaMza pradAna kare tAhale saThika vivecanA mata tRptira sAthe bhoga kara|

AllAha tomAdera janya ye dhana-sampatti nirdhAraNa karechena tA avodhaderake pradAna karanA; varaM tA hate tAderake bhakSaNa karAte thAka, paridhAna karAte thAka evaM tAdera sAthe sadbhAve kathA vala|

Ara iYAtImarA viYera yogya nA haoYA paryanta tAderake parIkSA kare nAo; ataHpara yadi tAdera madhye viveka-vuddhi paridRSTa haYa tAhale tAdera dhana-sampatti tAderake samarpaNa kara; iYAtImera dhana-sampada apavyaYa karanA athavA tArA vaYaHprApta have vale oTA sattvaratA sahakAre AtmasAt karanA; evaM dekhAzonAkArI yadi abhAvamukta haYa tAhale iYAtImera mAla kharaca karA hate se nijake sampUrNa virata rAkhave, Ara ye vyakti abhAvagrasta se saGgata parimANa bhoga karave, anantara yakhana tAdera sampatti tAderake samarpaNa karate cAo takhana tAdera janya sAkSI rekha evaM AllAhai hisAva grahaNe yatheSTa|

puruSadera janye pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera parityakta viSaYa-sampattite aMza raYeche evaM nArIdera janyeo pitA-mAtA o AtmIYa-svajanera parityakta viSaYa-sampattite aMza raYeche- alpa vA adhika eka nirdiSTa parimANa|
vanTanera samaYe yakhana svajanagaNa, iYAtImagaNa evaM daridragaNa upasthita haYa takhana tA hate tAderakeo jIvikA dAna kara evaM tAdera sAthe sadbhAve kathA vala|

tAdera mane ei bheve zaMkA thAkA ucit ye, yadi tArA mRtyukAle tAdera pazcAte asahAYa parivAra rekhe yAYa tAhale tAderao ekai avasthA ghaTate pAre| sutarAM tArA yena AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM saGgata kathA vale|
yArA anyAYabhAve pitRhInadera dhana sampatti grAsa kare, nizcaYai tA svIYa udare agni vyatIta kichui bhakSaNa karenA evaM sattvarai tArA agni zikhAYa praveza karave|

AllAha tomAdera santAnadera samvandhe tomAderake nirdeza dicchenaH eka putrera janya dui kanyAra aMzera tulya; Ara yadi zudhu kanyAgaNa dui janera adhika haYa tAhale tArA mRta vyaktira parityakta sampatti hate dui tRtIYAMza prApta have| Ara yadi ekaTi mAtra kanyA haYa tAhale se ardhekAMza prApta have; evaM yadi mRta vyaktira kona santAna thAke tAhale mAtA-pitAra janya arthAt ubhaYera pratyekerai janya tAra parityakta sampatti hate eka SaSThAMza raYeche, Ara yadi tAra kona santAna nA thAke evaM zudhu mAtA-pitAi tAra uttarAdhikArI haYa tAhale tAra mAtAra janya raYeche eka tRtIYAMza evaM yadi tAra bhAi thAke tAhale se yA nirdeza kare geche sei nirdeza o RNa ante tAra jananIra janya eka SaSThAMza; tomAdera pitA o tomAdera putrera madhye ke tomAdera adhikatara upakArI tA tomarA avagata nao, eTAi AllAhara nirdeza| nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI o vijJAnamaYa|

Ara tomAdera patnIgaNera yadi santAna-santati nA thAke tAhale tArA yA parityAga kare yAYa tA theke tomAdera janya uhAra ardhAMza; kintu yadi tAdera santAna-santati thAke tAhale tArA yA asIYAta kareche sei asIYAta o RNa parizodhera para tAdera parityakta sampatti hate tomAdera janya eka caturthAMza; evaM yadi tomAdera strIdera kona santAna-santati nA thAke tAhale tomarA yA parityAga kare yAve, tAdera janya tAra eka caturthAMza; kintu yadi tomAdera santuAna-santati thAke tAhale tomarA yA asIYAta karave sei asIYAta o RNa parizodhera para tomAdera parityakta sampatti hate tAdera janya eka aSTamAMza; yadi kona mUla o zAkhAvihIna puruSa kiMvA strI mArA yAYa evaM tAra eka bhAi athavA eka bhagnI thAke tAhale etadubhaYera madhya hate pratyekei eka SaSThAMza pAve, Ara yadi tArA tadapekSA adhika haYa tAhale kRta asIYAta pUraNa karAra para athavA RNa zodhera para, kArao aniSTa nA kare tArA uhAra eka tRtIYAMza prApta have; eTAi AllAhara nirdeza evaM AllAha mahAjJAnI, sahiSNu|

eTAi AllAhara nirdiSTa sImAsamUha; evaM ye keha AllAha o tadIYa rAsUlera anugata haYa tini tAke erUpa jAnnAte praviSTa karAvena yAra nimne srotasvinIsamUha pravAhitA, tammadhye tArA sadA avasthAna karave; evaM eTAi var3a saphalatA|

Ara ye keha AllAha o tadIYa rAsUlake amAnya kare evaM tA~ra nirdiSTa sImAsamUha atikrama kare tini tAke jAhAnnAme praveza karAvena| tanmadhye se sadA avasthAna karave evaM tAra janya lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

Ara tomAdera nArIdera madhye yArA nirlajja kAja kare, tomarA tAdera viruddhe tomAdera madhya hate cAra jana sAkSI upasthita kara; anantara yadi tArA sAkSya pradAna kare tAhale tAderake tomarA gRhasamUhera madhye Avaddha kare rAkha ye paryanta mRtyu tAderake uThiYe nA neYa kiMvA AllAha tAdera janya kona patha nirdeza nA karena|

Ara tomAdera madhya hate ye kona duijana ei nirlajjatAra kAja karave, tAdera ubhaYakei zAsti pradAna kara; kintu tArA yadi tAovAha kare evaM sadAcArI haYa tAhale etadubhaYa hate pratyAvartita hao| nizcaYai AllAha tAovAha grahaNakArI, karuNAmaYa|

tAovAha kavUla karAra dAYitva ye AllAhara upara raYeche tAto zudhu tAderai janya yArA ajJatA vazataH pApa kare thAke, ataHpara avilamve kSamA prArthanA kare; sutarAM AllAha tAderakei kSamA karavena; AllAha mahAjJAnI, vijJAnamaYa|

Ara tAdera janya kona kSamA nei yArA ai paryanta pApa karate thAke yakhana tAdera kArao nikaTa mRtyu upasthita haYa takhana vale, nizcaYai Ami ekhana kSamA prArthanA karachi evaM tAdera janyao kSamA naYa yArA avizvAsI avasthAYa mRtyumukhe patita haYeche; tAderai janya Ami vedanAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

he mu’minagaNa! eTA tomAdera janya vaidha naYa ye, tomarA valapUrvaka nArIdera uttarAdhikArI hao; evaM prakAzya azlIlatA vyatIta tomarA tAderake yA pradAna karecha uhAra kiYadaMza grahaNera janya tAderake vAdhya karanA evaM tAdera sAthe sadbhAve sama maryAdAYa avasthAna kara; kintu yadi apachanda kara tAhale tomarA ye viSaYa apachanda kara AllAha seTAke pracura kalyANakara karate pArena|

Ara yadi tomarA eka strIra sthale anya strI parivartana karate icchA kara evaM tAdera ekajanake pracura dhana-sampada pradAna kare thAka tAhale tomarA tanmadhya hate kichui pratigrahaNa karanA; tAhale ki tomarA apavAda praYoga evaM prakAzya pApa kare seTA grahaNa karave?
evaM kirUpe tomarA tA grahaNa karave? vastutaH tomarA paraspara eke anyera nikaTa gamana karechile evaM tArA tomAdera nikaTa hate sudRr3ha aGgIkAra grahaNa karechila|
tomAdera pitRgaNa nArIkUlera madhye yAderake viYe kareche tomarA tAderake viYe karanA, kintu yA vigata haYeche| nizcaYai eTi azlIla, arucikara evaM nikRSTa AcaraNa|

tomAdera janya avaidha karA haYeche - tomAdera mAtRgaNa, kanyAgaNa, bhagnigaNa, phuphugaNa, khAlAgaNa, bhrAtRkanyAgaNa, bhagnira kanyAgaNa, tomAdera sei mAtRgaNa yArA tomAderake stanya dAna kareche, tomAdera dugdha bhagnigaNa, tomAdera strIdera mAtRgaNa, tomarA yAdera abhyantare upanIta haYecha sei strIdera ye sakala kanyA tomAdera kror3e avasthita; kintu yadi tomarA tAdera madhye upanIta nA haYe thAka tAhale tomAdera janya kona aparAdha nei; evaM aurasajAta putradera patnIgaNa; evaM yA atIta haYe geche, tadvyatIta dui bhagnike ekatre viYe karA; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

evaM nArIdera madhye vivAhitagaNa tomAdera janya niSiddha karA haYeche; kintu tomAdera DAna hAta yAdera adhikArI - AllAha tomAdera janya tAderake vidhivaddha karechena, etadvyatIta tomAdera janya vaidha karA haYeche anyAnya nArIdera; tomarA svIYa dhanera dvArA vyabhicArera uddezya vyatIta vivAha karAra janya tAdera anusandhAna kara; anantara tAdera dvArA ye phala bhoga karave tajjanya tAderake tAdera nirdhArita deYa pradAna kara evaM kona aparAdha havenA yadi nirdhAraNera para tomarA paraspara sammata hao, nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, vijJAnamaYa|

Ara tomAdera madhye ye vyakti svAdhInA o musalima nArIke viYe karAra sAmarthya rAkhenA tAhale tomAdera DAna hAta adhikArI sei vizvAsinI dAsIke viYe kare| AllAha tomAdera vizvAsa viSaYe jJAta Achena, tomarA eke apara hate samudbhuta| ataeva tAdera manivadera anumatikrame tAderake viYe kara evaM niYama anuyAYI tAderake tAdera prApya (moharAnA) pradAna kara ematAvasthAYa ye, tArA vyabhicAriNI kiMvA upa-pati grahaNakAriNI havenA| ataHpara yakhana tArA vivAhavaddha haYa, tatpara yadi tArA vyabhicAra kare tAhale tAdera prati svAdhInA nArIdera zAstira ardheka, eTA tAderai janya tomAdera madhye yArA duskAryake bhaYa kare| evaM yadi virata thAka tAhale eTA tomAdera janya kalyANakara evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

AllAha tomAdera janya savakichu pariskAra varNanA karate evaM tomAderake tomAdera pUrvavartIgaNera AdarzasamUha pradarzana karate o tomAderake kSamA karate icchA karena evaM AllAha mahAjJAnI, vijJAnamaYa|
Ara AllAha tomAderake kSamA karate icchA karena evaM yArA pravRttira pUjArI tArA icchA kare ye, tomarA ghora adhaHpatane patita hao|
AllAha tomAdera vojhA laghu karate cAna yehetu mAnuSa durvala (rUpe) sRSTa haYeche|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA anyAYabhAve parasparera dhana-sampada grAsa karanA; kevalamAtra paraspara sammatikrame ye vyavasA kara tA vaidha evaM tomarA nijedera hatyA karanA; nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera prati kSamAzIla|
Ara ye keha sImA atikrama kare athavA yalamera vazavartI haYe e kAja kare, phalataH nizcaYai Ami tAke jAhAnnAme nikSepa karava evaM AllAhara pakSe eTA khuvai sahajasAdhya|
tomarA yadi sei var3a var3a pApasamUha hate virata hao yA tomAderake niSedha karA haYeche, tAhalei Ami tomAdera kraTi vicyutiguli kSamA kare diva evaM tomAderake sammAnajanaka sthAne praviSTa karAva|

evaM tomarA ora AkAMkhA karanA yadvArA AllAha ekera upara aparake zreSThatva dAna karechena; puruSerA yA upArjana kareche tAte tAdera aMza raYeche evaM nArIrA yA upArjana kareche tAte tAdera aMza raYeche evaM tomarA AllAharai nikaTa anugraha prArthanA kara, nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe mahAjJAnI|

Ami savAikei uttarAdhikArI karechi yA tAdera mAtA-pitA o AtmIYa-svajana parityAga kare yAYa evaM dakSiNa hasta yAdera sAthe pratijJAvaddha; ataeva tomarA tAderake tAdera aMza pradAna kara; nizcaYai AllAha sava viSaYe sAkSI|

puruSerA nArIdera upara tattvAvadhAnakArI o bharaNapoSaNakArI, yehetu AllAha tAdera madhye ekera upara aparake vaiziSTya dAna karechena evaM ei hetu ye, tArA svIYa dhana sampada hate tAdera janya vyaYa kare thAke; sutarAM ye samasta nArI puNyavatI tArA Anugatya kare, AllAhara saMrakSita pracchanna viSaYa saMrakSaNa kare; yadi nArIdera avAdhyatAra AzaMkA haYa tAhale tAderake sadupadeza pradAna kara, tAderake zayyA hate pRthaka kara evaM tAderake prahAra kara; anantara yadi tArA tomAdera anugata haYa tAhale tAdera janya anya panthA avalamvana karanA; nizcaYai AllAha samunnata, mahA mahIYAna|

Ara yadi tomarA ubhaYera madhye vicchedera AzaMkA kara tAhale tomAdera vaMza hate ekajana vicAraka evaM tomAdera strIdera vaMza hate ekajana vicAraka nirdiSTa kara; yadi tArA mImAMsAra AkAMkhA kare tAhale AllAha tAdera madhye samprIti saJcAra karavena; nizcaYai AllAha mahAjJAnI, abhijJa|

evaM tomarA AllAharai ivAdAta kara evaM tA~ra sAthe kona viSaYe aMzI sthApana karanA; evaM mAtA-pitAra sAthe sadvyavahAra kara evaM AtmIYa-svajana, pitRhIna, daridra, samparkavihIna prativezI, pArzvavatI sahacara o pathika evaM tomAdera dAsa-dAsIdera sAtheo sadvyavahAra kara; nizcaYai AllAha ahaMkArI AtmAbhimAnIke bhAlavAsenanA|
yArA kRpaNatA kare o lokadera kArpaNya zikSA deYa evaM AllAha svIYa anugrahe yA dAna karechena tA gopana kare, vastutaH Ami sei avizvAsIdera janya apamAnajanaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
evaM yArA lokadera dekhAnora janya svIYa dhana sampada vyaYa kare evaM AllAhara prati o AkhirAtera prati vizvAsa sthApana karenA, Ara yAdera sahacara zAitAna - se nikRSTa saGgIi vaTe|
Ara ete tAdera ki kSati hata - yadi tArA AllAha o AkhirAtera prati vizvAsa sthApana karata evaM AllAha tAderake yA dAna karechena tA hate vyaYa karata? evaM AllAha tAdera viSaYe yathArthai avagata|
nizcaYai AllAha aNu parimANao atyAcAra karenanA evaM yadi keha kona sat kAja kare tAhale tini oTA dviguNa kare dena evaM svIYa pakSa hate ora mahAna pratidAna pradAna karena|
anantara takhana ki dazA have yakhana Ami pratyeka dharma/sampradAYa hate sAkSI AnaYana karava evaM tomAkei tAdera prati sAkSI karava?
yArA avizvAsI haYeche o rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kareche tArA sedina kAmanA karave - yena bhUmanDalera sAthe tArA mize yAYa evaM AllAhara nikaTa tArA kona kathAi gopana karate pAravenA|

he mu’minagaNa! nezAgrasta avasthAYa sAlAtera kAcheo yeonA, yakhana nijera uccArita vAkyera artha nijei vujhate sakSama nao - e avasthAYa athavA gosala yarurI hale tA samApta nA kare sAlAtera janya dAnDAYamAna haYonA| kintu musAphira avasthAra kathA svatantra| yadi tomarA pIr3ita hao, kiMvA pravAse avasthAna kara athavA tomAdera madhye keha pAYakhAnA hate pratyAgata haYa kiMvA ramaNI sparza kare evaM pAni nA pAoYA yAYa tAhale vizuddha mATira amveSaNa kara, tadvArA tomAdera mukhamanDala o hastasamUha muche phela; nizcaYai AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|
tomarA ki tAdera prati lakSya karani yAderake granthera eka aMza pradatta haYeche? tArA pathabhraSTatA kraYa kareche evaM icchA kare ye, tomarAo saThika patha hate dUre sare yAo|
evaM AllAha tomAdera zatruderake samyaka avagata Achena; pRSThapoSaka evaM sAhAyyakArI hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa|

iYAhudIdera madhye keha keha yathAsthAna hate vAkyAvalI parivatirta kare evaM valeH AmarA zravaNa karalAma o Agrahya karalAma; evaM vale, zona - nA zonAra mata; evaM tArA svIYa jihavA vikRta kare o dharmera prati doSAropa kare vale ‘rAinA’; evaM yadi tArA valata, ‘AmarA zunalAma o mene nilAma; evaM AmAderake vujhAra zakti dAo’ tAhale eTA tAdera pakSe uttama o saThika hata; kintu AllAha tAdera avizvAsa hetu tAderake abhisampAta karechena; ataeva alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta tArA vizvAsa karenA|

he grantha prAptarA! tomAdera saGge yA Ache tAra satyatA pratipAdanakArI yA avatIrNa karechi tatprati vizvAsa sthApana kara ai samaYa AsAra pUrve, yakhana Ami aneka mukhamanDala vikRta kare diva| ataHpara tAderake pRSThera dike ulTiYe diva athavA AsahAve sAvatera prati yerUpa abhisampAta karechilAma tadrupa tAdera pratio abhisampAta kari; evaM AllAhara Adeza kAryakarI haYei thAke|
nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra sAthe aMzI sthApanakArIke kSamA karavenanA evaM tadvyatIta yAke icchA kSamA karavena evaM ye keha AllAhara aMzI sthira kare se mahApApe Avaddha hala|
tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani yArA svIYa pavitratA prakAza kare? varaM AllAha yAke icchA pavitra karena evaM tArA eka sUtA parimANao atyAcArita havenA|
lakSya karaH tArA kirUpe AllAhara prati mithyA apavAda dicche! spaSTa aparAdhI haoYAra janya eTAi yatheSTa|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani yAderake granthera ekAMza pradatta haYeche? tArA mUrti o zAitAnera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM kAphiraderake vale, musalimadera apekSA tArAi adhikatara supathagAmI|
ederai prati AllAha abhisampAta karechena; evaM AllAha yAke abhisampAta karena, tumi tAra janya konai sAhAyyakArI khu~je pAvenA|
tAhale ki rAjatve tAdera kona aMza raYeche? vastutaH takhana tArA lokaderake kaNA parimANao pradAna karavenA|

tAhale ki tArA lokadera prati e janya hiMsA kare ye, AllAha tAderake svIYa sampada hate kichu dAna karechena? phalataH nizcaYai Ami ivarAhIma vaMzIYagaNake grantha o vijJAna dAna karechi evaM tAderake vizAla sAmrAjya pradAna karechi|
anantara tAdera madhye aneke ora prati vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM anekei oTA hate virata raYeche; evaM (tAdera janya) zikhA viziSTa jAhAnnAmai yatheSTa|

yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhera prati avizvAsI haYeche tAderake avazyai Ami jAhAnnAmera Agune praveza karAva| yakhana tAra carma vidagdha have, Ami tatparivarte tAdera carma parivartana kare diva, yena tArA zAstira AsvAda grahaNa kare, nizcaYai AllAha parAkrAnta, hikamAtera adhikArI|

Ara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare sat kAryAvalI sampAdana kareche, nizcaYai Ami tAderake jAnnAte praveza karAva, yAra nimne srotasvinIsamUha pravAhitA, tanmadhye tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave; sekhAne tAdera janya pavitrA sahadharmiNIgaNa raYeche evaM Ami tAderake suvistRta chAYA zItala sthAne praveza karAva|

nizcaYai AllAha tomAderake Adeza karachena, gacchita viSaYa ora adhikArIke arpaNa kara; evaM yakhana tomarA lokadera madhye vicAra mImAMsA kara takhana nyAYa vicAra kara; avazyai AllAha tomAderake uttama upadeza dAna karachena; nizcaYai AllAha zravaNakArI, paridarzaka|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhara o rAsUlera anugata hao evaM tomAdera janya yArA vicAraka tAdera; ataHpara yadi tomAdera madhye kona viSaYe kona matavirodha haYa tAhale AllAha o rAsUlera dike pratyAvartita hao, yadi tomarA AllAha o parakAlera prati vizvAsa kare thAka; eTAi kalyANakara o zreSThatara parisamApti|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani yArA dAvI kare ye, tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche evaM tomAra pUrve yA avatIrNa haYechila tatprati tArA vizvAsa kare? athaca tArA nijedera mukAddAmA tAgutera nikaTa niYe yete cAYa, yadio tAderake Adeza karA haYechila yena tAke avizvAsa kare; pakSAntare zAitAna tAderake pratArita kare pathabhraSTa karate cAYa|
Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena sei dike evaM rAsUlera dike eso takhana tumi munAphikaderake dekhave, tArA tomA hate mukha phiriYe vicchinna hacche|

anantara takhana kirUpa have, yakhana tAdera hastasamUha yA pUrve preraNa kareche, tajjanya tAdera upara vipada upanIta haYa? takhana tArA AllAhara zapatha karate karate tomAra kAche ese valave - kalyANa o samprIti vyatIta AmarA kichui kAmanA karini|
tAdera antarasamUhe yA Ache AllAha tA jJAta Achena| ataeva tumi tAdera dika hate nirlipta hao evaM tAderake sadupadeza pradAna kara evaM tAderake tAdera samvandhe hRdaYasparzI kathA vala|

Ami etadvyatIta konai rAsUla preraNa karini ye, AllAhara Adeze tA~ra Anugatya svIkAra karave, evaM yadi tArA svIYa jIvanera upara atyAcAra karAra para tomAra nikaTa Agamana karata, ataHpara AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karata Ara rAsUlao tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa kSamA cAita tAhale nizcaYai tArA AllAhake tAovAha kavUlakArI, karuNAmaYa dekhate peta|

ataeva tomAra ravera zapatha! tArA kakhanai vizvAsa sthApanakArI hate pAravenA, ye paryanta tomAke tAdera sRSTa virodhera vicAraka nA kare, ataHpara tumi ye vicAra karave tA dvidhAhIna antare grahaNa nA kare evaM oTA santaSTa citte kavUla nA kare|

Ara Ami yadi tAdera upara vidhivaddha karatAma ye, tomarA nijederake hatyA kara athavA svIYa gRha prAcIra hate niskrAnta hao tAhale tAdera alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta oTA karatanA evaM yadviSaYe tAderake upadeza deYA haYechila tA yadi tArA karata tAhale nizcaYai oTA hata tAdera janya kalyANakara evaM dharmera upara sudRr3ha thAkAra janyao|
evaM takhana Ami tAderake avazyai svIYa sannidhAna hate vRhattara pratidAna pradAna karatAma|
evaM nizcaYai tAderake sarala patha pradarzana karatAma|

Ara ye keha AllAha o rAsUlera anugata haYa, tArA ai vyaktidera saGgI have yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechena; arthAt nAvIgaNa, satya sAdhakagaNa, zahIdagaNa o sat karmazIlagaNa; evaM erAi sarvottama saGgI|
eTAi AllAhara anugraha evaM AllAhara jJAnai yatheSTa|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA svIYa AtmarakSAra saraJjAma tule nAo, ataHpara pRthakabhAve vahirgata hao athavA sammilitabhAve abhiyAna kara|

Ara tomAdera madhye erUpa lokao raYeche ye zaithilya kare; anantara yadi tomAdera upara vipada nipatita haYa tAhale valeH AmAra prati AllAhara anugraha chila ye, Ami takhana tAdera sAthe upasthita chilAmanA|

pakSAntare yadi AllAhara sannidhAna hate tomAdera upara anugraha, sampada avatIrNa haYa tAhale erUpabhAve vale yena tomAdera o tAdera madhye konai samvandha chilanA - hAYa! yadi Amio tAdera saGgI hatAma tAhale mahAna phalaprada suphala lAbha karatAma!

ataeva yArA duniYAra vinimaYe AkhirAta kraYa kare tArA yena AllAhara pathe saMgrAma kare; evaM ye AllAhara pathe yuddha kare, ataHpara nihata athavA vijaYI haYa, tAhale Ami tAke mahAna pratidAna pradAna karava|

tomAdera ki haYeche ye, tomarA AllAhara pathe yuddha karachanA? athaca nArI, puruSa evaM zizudera madhye yArA durvala tArA valeH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake atyAcArI ei nagara hate niskRti dina evaM svIYa sannidhAna hate AmAdera pRSThapoSaka o nijera nikaTa hate AmAdera janya sAhAyyakArI preraNa karuna|

yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche tArA AllAhara pathe saMgrAma kare evaM yArA kAphira tArA zAitAnera pakSe yuddha kare; sutarAM tomarA zAitAnera vandhudera viruddhe yuddha kara; nizcaYai zAitAnera kauzala durvala|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani yAderake valA haYechila ye, tomAdera hastasamUha saMyata rAkha evaM sAlAta pratiSThita kara o yAkAta pradAna kara| anantara yakhana tAdera prati jihAda pharaya kare deYA hala takhana tAdera ekadala AllAhake yerUpa bhaYa karave tadrupa mAnuSake bhaYa karate lAgala, varaM tadapekSAo adhika; evaM tArA valalaH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani kena AmAdera upara yuddha pharaya karalena? kena AmAderake Ara kichukAlera janya avasara dilenanA? tumi valaH pArthiva Ananda khuvai sImita evaM dharmabhIrugaNera janya parakAlai kalyANakara; evaM tomarA khejura vIja parimANao atyAcArita havenA|

tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena, mRtyu tomAderake peYe yAve, yadio tomarA sudRr3ha durge avasthAna kara; evaM yadi tAdera upara kona kalyANa avatIrNa haYa tAhale tArA valeH eTA AllAhara nikaTa hate evaM yadi tAdera prati amaGgala nipatita haYa tAhale vale ye, eTA tomAra nikaTa hate haYeche| tumi valaH samastai AllAhara nikaTa hate haYa; ataeva ai sampradAYera ki haYeche ye, tArA kona kathA vujhate ceSTA karenA!

tomAra nikaTa ye kalyANa upasthita haYa tA AllAhara sannidhAna hate evaM tomAra upara ye akalyANa nipatita haYa tA tomAra nija hate haYe thAke, evaM Ami tomAke mAnavamanDalIra janya rAsUla rUpe preraNa karechi; evaM AllAhara sAkSIi yatheSTa|
ye keha rAsUlera anugata haYa nizcaYai se AllAharai anugata haYe thAke, evaM ye phire yAYa Ami tAra janya tomAke rakSaka rUpe preraNa karini|

Ara tArA valeH AmarA anugata| kintu yakhana tArA tomAra nikaTa hate vera haYe yAYa takhana tAdera ekadala, tumi yA vala tAra viruddhe parAmarza kare; evaM tArA yA parAmarza kare AllAha tA lipivaddha karena; ataeva tAdera prati nispRha hao evaM AllAhara upara nirbhara kara; evaM AllAhai kArya sampAdane yatheSTa|
tArA kena kuraAna samvandhe gaveSanA karenA? Ara yadi oTA AllAha vyatIta anya kArao nikaTa hate hata tAhale tArA ote vahu vaiparitya dekhate peta|

Ara yakhana tAdera nikaTa kona zAsti athavA bhItijanaka viSaYa upasthita haYa takhana tArA oTA raTanA karate thAke evaM yadi tArA oTA rAsUlera kiMvA tAdera Adeza dAtAdera prati samarpana karata tAhale tAdera madhye saThika tathya peYe yeta evaM yadi tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o karuNA nA hata tAhale alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta tomarA zAitAnera anusaraNa karate|

ataeva AllAhara pathe yuddha kara; tomAra nijera chAr3A tomAra upara anya kArao bhAra arpaNa karA haYani evaM vizvAsIderake uddhuddha kara; acirei AllAha avizvAsIdera saMgrAma pratirodha karavena; evaM AllAha saMgrAme sudRr3ha o zAsti dAne kaThora|
ye keha sat supAriza karave se ora aMza pAve evaM ye keha asat supAriza karave seo ora aMza prApta have; evaM AllAha sarvazaktimAna|
Ara yakhana tomarA zubhAzISe sambhASita hao takhana tomarAo tA hate zreSThatara zubha sambhASaNa kara athavA oTAi pratyarpaNa kara; nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe hisAva grahaNakArI|
AllAha, tini vyatIta keha upAsya nei; nizcaYai ete sandeha nei ye, tini tomAderake ekatrita karavena; evaM vAkye AllAha apekSA ke vezi satyaparAYana?

anantara tomAdera ki haYeche ye, tomarA munAphikadera samvandhe dui dala hale? evaM tArA yA arjana kareche tajjanya AllAha tAderake pratyAkhyAna karechena; AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tumi ki tAke patha pradarzana karate cAo? evaM AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karechena vastutaH tumi tAra janya konai patha pAvenA|

tArA icchA kare ye, tArA yerUpa kAphira tomarAo yena tadrupa kAphira haYe yAo, yAte tomarAo tAdera sadRza hao| ataeva tAdera madhya hate vandhu grahaNa karanA, ye paryanta nA tArA AllAhara pathe deza tyAga kare; ataHpara yadi tArA pratigamana kare tAhale tAderake dhara evaM yekhAne pAo tAderake saMhAra kara; evaM tAdera madhya hate vandhu athavA sAhAyyakArI grahaNa karanA|

kintu tomAdera madhye o tAdera madhye sandhivaddha sampradAYera sAthe yArA sammilita haYa, athavA tomAdera sAthe yuddha karate saMkucita citta haYe yArA tomAdera nikaTa upasthita haYa| yadi AllAha icchA karatena tAhale tomAdera upara tAderake zaktizAlI karatena| tAhale nizcaYai tArA tomAdera sAthe yuddha karata| ataHpara yadi tArA tomAdera dika hate sandhi prArthanA kare tAhale AllAha tAdera pratikUle tomAdera janya kona panthA rAkhenani|

acirei tumi erUpao prApta have, yArA tomAdera dika hate o svIYa sampradAYa hate zAntira sAthe thAkate icchA kare, yakhana tAdera virodhera prati praluvdha karAno haYa takhana tAtei nipatita haYa; anantara yadi tomAdera dika hate nivRtta nA haYa o sandhi prArthanA nA kare evaM tAdera hastasamUha saMyata nA kare tAhale tAderake pAkar3Ao kara evaM yekhAne pAo tAderake saMhAra kara; ederai janya AllAha tomAderake prakAzya yukti pramANa dAna karechena|

kona mu’minera ucita naYa ye, bhrama vyatIta kona mu’minake hatyA kare; ye keha bhrama vazataH kona mu’minake hatyA kare tAhale se janaika mu’mina dAsake mukta kare dive evaM tAra AtmIYa svajanake hatyAra vinimaYa samarpaNa karave; kintu yadi tArA kSamA kare deYa evaM yadi se tomAdera zatru sampradAYera antargata o mu’mina haYa tAhale janaika mu’mina dAsake mukti dAna karave; evaM yadi se tomAdera madhye o tAdera madhye sandhivaddha sampradAYera antargata haYa tAhale tAra svajanaderake hatyAra vinimaYa arpaNa karave evaM janaika mu’mina dAsake mukta karave; kintu yadi se oTAYa akSama haYa tAhale AllAhara nikaTa hate kSamA prAptira janya ekAdikrame dui mAsa siYAma pAlana karave| AllAha mahAjJAnI, vijJAnamaYa|

Ara ye keha icchA kare kona mu’minake hatyA kare tAhale tAra zAsti jAhAnnAma, tanmadhye se sadA avasthAna karave evaM AllAha tAra prati kruddha haYechena o tAke abhizapta karechena evaM tAra janya bhISaNa zAsti prastuta rekhechena|

he mu’minagaNa! yakhana tomarA AllAhara pathe vahirgata hao takhana pratyeka kAja yAcAi kare nAo, evaM keha tomAderake ‘sAlAma’ karale tAke valanA ye, ‘tumi mu’mina nao’; tomarA ki pArthiva jIvanera sampada anusandhAna karacho? tAhale AllAhara nikaTa pracura sampada raYeche; prathame tomarA airUpai chile, ataHpara AllAha tomAdera upara anugraha karechena| ataeva tomarA sthira kare nAo ye, tomarA yA karacha nizcaYai AllAha tadviSaYe abhijJa|

mu’minadera madhye yArA kona duHkha pIr3A vyatItai gRhe vase thAke, Ara yArA svIYa dhana o prANa dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda kare tArA samAna naYa; yArA dhana-prANa dvArA jihAda kare AllAha tAderake gRhe avasthAnakArIdera upara ucca maryAdA diYechena; evaM sakalakei AllAha kalyANaprada pratizruti dAna karechena| evaM upaviSTadera upara dharmayoddhAgaNake mahAna pratidAne gauravAnvita karechena|
svIYa sannidhAna hate padamaryAdA, kSamA o karunA (dvArA gauravAnvita karechena) evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

yArA svIYa jIvanera prati atyAcAra karechila, mAlAka/pherezatA tAdera prANa haraNa kare vale, tomarA ki avasthAYa chile? tArA vale, AmarA duniYAYa asahAYa chilAma; tArA vale, AllAhara pRthivI ki prazasta chilanA ye, tanmadhye tomarA hijarAta karate? ataeva oderai vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma evaM kata nikRSTa ai jAYagA!
kintu puruSa, nArI evaM zizudera madhye asahAYatA vazataH yArA kona upAYa karate pArenA athavA kona patha prApta haYanA|
phalataH tAderai AzA Ache ye, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavena evaM AllAha mArjanAkArI, kSamAzIla|

Ara ye keha AllAhara pathe deza tyAga kare se pRthivIte vahu prazasta sthAna o svacchalatA prApta have| evaM ye keha gRha hate vahirgata haYe AllAha o rAsUlera uddeze deza tyAga kare, ataHpara se mRtyumukhe patita haYa, tAhale nizcaYai era pratidAna AllAhara upara nyasta raYeche; evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

Ara yakhana tomarA bhUpRSThe bhramaNa kara takhana sAlAta saMkSepa karale tomAdera kona aparAdha nei, yadi tomarA AzaMkA kara ye, yArA avizvAsI tArA tomAderake vivrata karave; nizcaYai kAphirerA tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

evaM yakhana tumi tAdera (sainyadera) madhye thAka, ataHpara sAlAte danDAYamAna hao takhana yena tAdera ekadala tomAra sAthe danDAYamAna haYa evaM sva sva astra grahaNa kare; ataHpara yakhana sAjadAh sampanna kare takhana yena tArA tomAra pazcAdvartI haYa; evaM anya dala yArA sAlAta AdAYa kareni tArA yena agrasara haYe tomAra sAthe sAlAta AdAYa kare evaM sva sva AtmarakSikA o astra grahaNa kare| avizvAsIrA icchA kare ye, tomarA svIYa astrazastra o dravya sambhAra samvandhe asatarka halei tArA ekayoge tomAdera upara nipatita haYa; evaM ete tomAdera aparAdha nei yadi tomarA vRSTipAte vivrata haYe athavA pIr3ita avasthAYa sva sva astra parityAga kara evaM svIYa AtmarakSikA saGge grahaNa kara; nizcaYai AllAha avizvAsIdera janya avamAnanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena|

ataHpara yakhana tomarA sAlAta sampanna kara takhana danDAYamAna, upaviSTa evaM zAYita avasthAYa AllAhake smaraNa kara; ataHpara yakhana tomarA nirApada hao takhana sAlAta pratiSThita kara; nizcaYai sAlAta vizvAsIgaNera upara nirdiSTa samaYera janya nirdhArita|

evaM sei sampradAYera pazcAddhAvane zaithilya karanA; yadi tomarA kaSTa peYe thAka tAhale tArAo tomAdera anurUpa kaSTa bhoga kareche; evaM tatsaha AllAha hate tomAdera ye bharasA Ache tAdera sei bharasA nei; evaM AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

nizcaYai Ami tomAra prati satyasaha grantha avatIrNa karechi - yena tumi tadanuyAYI mAnavaderake Adeza pradAna kara, yA AllAha tomAke zikSA dAna karechena evaM tumi vizvAsaghAtakadera pakSe vitarkakArI haYonA|
evaM AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara; nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
evaM yArA svIYa jIvanera prati vizvAsaghAtakatA kare, tumi tAdera pakSe virtaka karanA; nizcaYai AllAha vizvAsaghAtaka pApIke bhAlavAsenanA|

tArA mAnava hate gopana karate cAYa, kintu AllAha hate gopana karate pArenA; evaM tini tAdera saGge raYechena yakhana tArA rajanIte emana viSaYe parAmarza kare yAte tini sammata nana; evaM tArA yA karache AllAha tAra pariveSTanakArI|

sAvadhAna! tomarAi ai loka yArA odera pakSa hate pArthiva jIvana samvandhe vitarka karacha; kintu kiYAmAta divase tAdera pakSa hate ke AllAhara sAthe vitarka karave evaM ke tAdera kArya sampAdanakArI have?
evaM ye keha duskArya kare athavA svIYa jIvanera prati atyAcAra kare, ataHpara AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthI haYa, se AllAhake kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa dekhate pAve|
evaM ye keha pApa arjana kare, vastutaH se svIYa AtmAra pratii era pratikriYA pau~chiYe thAke evaM AllAha mahAjJAnI, vijJAnamaYa|
Ara ye keha aparAdha athavA pApa arjana kare, ataHpara oTA niraparAdhIra prati Aropa kare, tAhale se nijei sei aparAdha o prakAzya pApa vahana karave|

Ara yadi tomAra prati AllAhara anugraha o karuNA nA hata tAhale tAdera ekadala tomAke pathabhraSTa karate icchuka haYechila, evaM tArA nijederake chAr3A vipadagAmI kareni o tArA tomAke kona viSaYe kleza dite pAravenA; evaM AllAha tomAra prati grantha o prajJA avatIrNa karechena evaM tumi yA jAnatenA tini tA tomAke zikSA diYechena; evaM tomAra prati AllAhara asIma karuNA raYeche|

sAdhAraNa lokera adhikAMza gupta parAmarze kona maGgala nihita thAkenA, tave hyA~ ye vyakti dAna khaYarAta kare athavA kona sat kAja kare kiMvA lokera madhye paraspara sandhi sthApana kare deYAra uddeze tA kare tAhale tA svatantra evaM ye AllAhara prasannatA sandhAnera janya airUpa kare, Ami tAke mahAna vinimaYa pradAna karava|

Ara supatha prakAzita haoYAra para ye rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare evaM vizvAsIgaNera viparIta pathera anugAmI haYa, tAhale se yAte abhiniviSTa Ami tAke tAtei pratyAvartita karAva evaM tAke jAhAnnAme nikSepa karava; evaM oTA nikRSTatara pratyAvartana sthala|

nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra sAthe aMzI sthApanakArIke kSamA karenanA evaM etadvyatIta tini yAke icchA kSamA kare thAkena; evaM ye AllAhara sAthe aMzI sthApana kare se nizcaYai sudUra vipathe vibhrAnta haYeche|
tArA tA~ke parityAga kare nArI mUrtiderakei AhavAna kare evaM tArA vidrohI zAitAnake vyatIta AhavAna karenA|
AllAha tAke abhisampAta karechena; evaM zAitAna valechila, Ami avazyai tomAra sevakavRnda hate eka nirdiSTa aMza grahaNa karava |

evaM nizcaYai Ami tAderake pathabhrAnta karava, tAderake ku-mantranA diva evaM tAderake Adeza karava yena tArA pazura karNa chedana kare evaM tAderake Adeza karava AllAhara sRSTa AkRti parivartana karate| ye AllAhake parityAga kare zAitAnake vandhu rUpe grahaNa kare, nizcaYai se prakAzya kSatite kSatigrasta have|
zAitAna tAderake pratizruti deYa o AzvAsa dAna kare, kintu zAitAna pratAraNA vyatIta tAderake pratizruti pradAna karenA|
tAderai vAsasthAna jAhAnnAma evaM sekhAna hate tArA pAlAvAra kona jAYagA pAvenA|

evaM yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche o sat kAja kare, Ami tAderake jAnnAte praviSTa karAva yAra nimne srotasvinIsamUha pravAhitA, tanmadhye tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave, AllAhara pratizruti satya; evaM ke AllAha apekSA vAkye adhikatara satyaparAYaNa?
nA tomAdera vRthA AzAYa kAja have, Ara nA Ahale kitAvera vRthA AzAYa; ye asat kAja karave se tAra pratiphala pAve evaM se AllAhara parivarte kehake vandhu athavA sAhAyyakArI prApta havenA|
puruSa athavA nArIra madhye yArA sat kAja kare evaM se vizvAsIo haYa, tAhale tArAi jAnnAte praveza karave evaM tArA kharjura dAnAra kaNA parimANao atyAcArita havenA|

Ara ye AllAhara uddeze svIYa Anana samarpaNa kareche o sat kAja kare evaM ivarAhImera sudRr3ha dharmera anusaraNa kare, tAra apekSA kAra dharma utkRSTa? evaM AllAha ivarAhImake svIYa vandhu rUpe grahaNa karechilena|
evaM nabhomanDala o bhU-manDale yA kichu Ache savai AllAharai janya; AllAha sarva viSaYe pariveSTanakArI|

evaM tArA tomAra nikaTa nArIdera samvandhe vyavasthA jijJesa karache; tumi vala, AllAha tomAderake tAdera samvandhe vyavasthA dAna karechena evaM pitRhInA nArIdera samvandhe tomAdera prati grantha hate pATha karA haYeche ye, tAdera janya yA vidhivaddha haYeche tA tomarA pradAna karachanA, athaca tAderake viYe karate vAsanA kara evaM zizudera madhye durvaladera o pitRhInadera prati suvicAra pratiSThA kara evaM tomarA ye sat kAja kara, nizcaYai AllAha tadviSaYe khuva bhAla jAnena |

kona nArI yadi tAra svAmIra pakSa theke asadAcaraNa athavA upekSAra AzaMkA kare tAhale tArA ubhaYe ApoSa mImAMsA kare nile tAte tAdera ubhaYera kona aparAdha nei| vastutaH ApoSa mImAMsAi uttama| evaM lobhera kAraNe svabhAvataHi mAnuSera hRdaYa kRpaNa; evaM yadi tomarA sat vyavahAra kara o saMyamI hao tAhale tomarA yA karacho tadviSaYe AllAha abhijJa|

tomarA kakhanao strIgaNera madhye suvicAra karate pAravenA yadio tomarA tA kAmanA kara, sutarAM tomarA kona ekajanera prati sampUrNarUpe jhuke par3onA o aparajanake jhulanta avasthAYa rekhonA evaM yadi tomarA paraspara samajhatAYa Aso o saMyamI hao tAhale nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|
evaM yadi tArA ubhaYe vicchinna haYa tAhale AllAha svIYa prAcurya hate tAdera pratyekake sampadazAlI karavena evaM AllAha suprazasta mahAjJAnI|

nabhomanDala o bhU-manDale yA kichu raYeche tA AllAharai janya; evaM nizcaYai tomAdera pUrve yAderake grantha pradatta haYechila - Ami tAderake o tomAderake Adeza karechilAma ye, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, evaM yadi avizvAsa kara tAhale nizcaYai nabhomanDala o bhU-manDale yA kichu Ache tA AllAharai evaM AllAha mahAsampadazAlI, prazaMsita|
evaM AkAzasamUhe yA kichu raYeche o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA AllAharai; evaM karmavidhAne (oYAkila) AllAhai yatheSTa|
he loka sakala! yadi tini icchA karena tAhale tomAderake vilupta kare anyaderake AnaYana karate pArena evaM AllAha e vyApAre zaktimAna|
ye ihalokera pratidAna AkAMkhA kare, AllAhara nikaTa ihaloka o paralokera pratidAna raYeche; evaM AllAha zravaNakArI, paridarzaka|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhara uddeze sAkSya dAnakArI, suvicAra pratiSThAtA hao evaM yadio eTA tomAdera nijera athavA mAtA-pitA o AtmIYa-svajanera pratikUla haYa, yadio se sampadazAlI kiMvA daridra haYa tAhale AllAhai tAdera janya yatheSTa; ataeva suvicAre svIYa pravRttira anusaraNa karanA, Ara tomarA yadi ghuriYe peciYe kathA vala kiMvA pAza kATiYe yAo tAhale nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera samasta karmera pUrNa saMvAda rAkhena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA vizvAsa sthApana kara AllAhara prati o tA~ra rAsUlera prati evaM ei kitAvera prati yA tini tA~ra rAsUlera upara avatIrNa karechena evaM ai kitAvera prati yA pUrve avatIrNa haYechila, evaM ye keha AllAha, tadvIYa phereztA, tA~ra kitAvasamUha, tA~ra rAsUlagaNa evaM parakAla samvandhe avizvAsa kare, nizcaYai se sudUra vipathe vibhrAnta haYeche|

nizcaYai yArA vizvAsa sthApana kare, ataHpara avizvAsI haYa, punarAYa vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM AvAra avizvAsI haYa, anantara avizvAse parivardhita haYa, tAhale AllAha kakhanai tAderake kSamA karavenanA evaM tAderake patha pradarzana karavenanA|
munAphikadera susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|
yArA mu’minaderake parityAga kare kAphiradera vandhu rUpe grahaNa kare, tArA ki tAdera nikaTa sammAna anusandhAna kare? kintu yAvatIYa sammAnai AllAhara|

evaM nizcaYai tini granthera mAdhyame tomAdera Adeza karachena ye, tomarA yakhana AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera prati avizvAsa karA evaM tA~ra prati upahAsa karA hacche zravaNa kara takhana tAdera sAthe (vaiThake) upavezana karanA, ye paryanta nA tArA anya kathAra AlocanA kare; anyathAYa tomarAo tAdera sadRza haYe yAve, nizcaYai AllAha sei samasta munAphika o kAphiraderake jAhAnnAme ekatrita karavena|

orA emana yArA tomAdera samvandhe pratIkSA karache; evaM yadi tomarA AllAhara pakSa hate jaYalAbha kara tAhale tArA valeH AmarA ki tomAdera saGge chilAmanA? evaM yadi oTA avizvAsIdera bhAgye ghaTe tAhale vale- AmarA ki tomAdera netRtva karini evaM vizvAsIgaNa hate tomAderake rakSA karini? ataHpara AllAha utthAna divase tomAdera madhye vicAra karavena; evaM AllAha kakhanao mu’minadera viruddhe kAphiraderake vijaYI karavenanA|

nizcaYai munAphikarA AllAhara sAthe pratAraNA kare evaM tinio tAderake ai pratAraNA pratyArpaNa karachena; evaM yakhana tArA sAlAtera janya dA~r3AYa takhana lokaderake dekhAnora janya Alasyabhare dA~r3AYa evaM AllAhake khuva kamai smaraNa kare|
erA sandehera dolAYa dodulyamAna raYeche| tArA e dikeo naYa odikeo naYa; evaM AllAha yAke pathabhrAnta karechena, vastutaH tumi tAra janya konai patha pAvenA|
