he mu’minagaNa! tomarA mu’minaderake cher3e kAphiraderake vandhu rUpe grahaNa karanA, tomarA ki AllAhara janya tomAdera viruddhe spaSTa pramANa dite cAo?
nizcaYai munAphikarA jAhAnnAmera nimnatama stare avasthAna karave evaM tumi kakhanao tAdera janya sAhAyyakArI pAvenA|

kintu yArA kSamA prArthanA kare o saMzodhita haYa evaM AllAhara pathake sudRr3habhAve A~kar3e dhare o AllAhara dharme vizuddha haYa, phalataH tArAi mu’minadera saGgI evaM acirei AllAha mu’minaderake uttama pratidAna divena|
AllAha kenaivA tomAderake zAsti pradAna karavena yadi tomarA kRtajJa hao o vizvAsa sthApana kara? evaM AllAhato atizaYa guNagrAhI, mahAjJAnI|
AllAha kona manda kathAra pracAraNA bhAlavAsena nA, tave keha atyAcArita haYe thAkale tAra kathA svatantra; evaM AllAha zravaNakArI mahAjJAnI|
yadi tomarA sat kAja prakAzye kara athavA gopane kara athavA yadi tomarA aparAdha kSamA kare dAo tAhale jene rekha ye, AllAha nijeo kSamAkArI, sarvazaktimAna|

nizcaYai yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati avizvAsa kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye pArthakya karate icchA kare evaM vale, AmarA katipaYake vizvAsa kari o katipaYake avizvAsa kari evaM tArA era madhyavartI patha avalamvana karate icchA kare |
orAi prakRta avizvAsI, evaM Ami avizvAsIdera janya avamAnanAkara zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

evaM yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNera prati vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM tA~ra rAsUlagaNera madhye kona pArthakya karenA - AllAha zIghrai tAdera pratidAna pradAna karavena evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, karuNAmaYa|

Ahale kitAva tomAra nikaTa Avedana jAnAYa ye, tumi tAdera prati AkAza hate kona grantha nAyila kara - paranta tArA mUsAra nikaTa eTA apekSAo vRhattara dAvI karechila| tArA valechila, AllAhake prakAzyabhAve pradarzana kara; ataHpara tAdera avAdhyatAra janya vajrapAta tAderake AkramaNa karechila, ataHpara tAdera nikaTa nidarzanAvalI AsAra pareo tArA go-vatsake upAsya hisAve grahaNa karechila| kintu oTAo Ami kSamA karechilAma, evaM mUsAke prakAzya prabhAva pradAna karechilAma|

evaM Ami tAdera pratizrutira janya tAdera upara tUra parvata samucca karechilAma evaM tAderake valechilAma avanata zire dvAre praveza kara| evaM tAderake Arao valechilAma, zanivArera sImA atikrama karanA| ebhAve tAdera nikaTa hate kaThora pratizruti grahaNa karechilAma|

kintu tArA lA‘natagrasta haYechila tAdera pratizruti bhaGga evaM AllAhara nidarzanAvalIra prati tAdera avizvAsa o anyAYabhAve tAdera nAvIdera hatyA evaM ‘‘tAdera sva sva antarasamUha AcchAdita’’ ei ukti karAra janya; hyA~ - tAdera avizvAsa hetu AllAha odera antare mohara e~Te diYechena, e kAraNe tArA alpa saMkhyaka vyatIta vizvAsa karenA |
evaM tAdera kupharI o mAraiYAmera prati tAdera bhaYAnaka apavAdera janya|

evaM ‘‘AllAhara rAsUla o mAraiYAma nandana IsAke AmarA hatyA karechi’’ valAra janya| athaca tArA nA tAke hatyA kareche Ara nA zule car3iYeche; varaM tArA dhA~dhA~Ya patita haYechila| tArA tadviSaYe sandehAcchanna chila, kalpanAra anusaraNa vyatIta e viSaYe tAdera kona jJAna chilanA| prakRta pakSe tArA tAke hatyA kareni|
paranta AllAha tAke nijera dike uThiYe niYechena, evaM AllAha parAkrAnta mahAjJAnI|
evaM Ahale kitAvera madhye emana keha nei ye, tAra mRtyura pUrve vyatIta eTA vizvAsa karave; evaM utthAna dine se (IsA) tAdera upara sAkSya dAna karave|
Ami iYAhudIdera avAdhyatA hetu tAdera janya ye samasta vastta vaidha chila tA tAdera prati avaidha karechi; evaM yehetu tArA anekake AllAhara patha hate pratirodha karata|

evaM tArA niSiddha haoYA sattveo suda grahaNa karata evaM tArA anyAYabhAve lokadera dhana sampada grAsa karata evaM Ami tAdera madhyastha avizvAsIdera janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|

kintu tAdera madhye yArA jJAne sudRr3ha evaM vizvAsI tArA tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche evaM tomAra pUrve yA avatIrNa haYechila tatprati vizvAsa sthApana kare| evaM yArA sAlAta AdAYakArI o yAkAta pradAnakArI evaM AllAha o AkhirAtera prati vizvAsa sthApanakArI tAderakei Ami pracura pratidAna pradAna karava|

nizcaYai Ami tomAra prati pratyAdeza karechi, yerUpa Ami nUha o tatparavartI nAvIgaNera prati pratyAdeza karechilAma evaM ivarAhIma, isamAIla, isahAka, iYAkUva o tadvaMzIYagaNera prati evaM IsA, Aiyuva, iunusa, hArUNa, sulAimAnera prati pratyAdeza karechilAma evaM Ami dAUdake yAvura pradAna karechilAma|
Ara nizcaYai Ami tomAra pUrvera vahu rAsUlera prasaGga tomAke varNanA karechi evaM aneka rAsUla yAdera kathA tomAke valini; AllAha mUsAra sAthe pratyakSa kathA valechena|
Ami susaMvAdadAtA o bhaYa pradarzaka rUpe rAsUlagaNake preraNa karechi yAte rAsUlagaNera pare lokadera madhye AllAha samvandhe kona apavAda deYAra avakAza nA thAke evaM AllAha parAkrAnta, mahAjJAnI|
kintu AllAha tomAra prati yA avatIrNa karechena, tatsamvandhe tini sajJAne avatAraNera sAkSya pradAna karechena; evaM sAkSya dAne AllAhai yatheSTa|
nizcaYai yArA avizvAsa kareche evaM aparake AllAhara patha hate pratirodha kareche, avazyai tArA sudUra vipathe vibhrAnta haYeche|
nizcaYai yArA avizvAsI haYeche o atyAcAra kareche, AllAha tAderake kSamA karavenanA evaM tAderake supatha pradarzana karavena nA |
jAhAnnAmera patha vyatIta, tanmadhye tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave evaM eTA AllAhara pakSe sahajasAdhya|

he loka sakala! nizcaya়i tomAdera pratipAlakera sannidhAna hate satyasaha rAsUla Agamana karechena, ataeva vizvAsa sthApana kara - tomAdera kalyANa have, Ara yadi avizvAsa kara tave nabhomaNDala o bhUmanDale yA kichu Ache tA AllAhara evaM AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaya়|

he Ahale kitAva! tomarA svIYa dharme sImA atikrama karanA evaM AllAhara viruddhe satya vyatIta valanA; nizcaYai mAraiYAma nandana IsA mAsIh AllAhara rAsUla o tA~ra vANI - yA tini mAraiYAmera prati saJcArita karechilena evaM tA~ra AdiSTa AtmA; ataeva AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera upara vizvAsa sthApana kara| Ara ‘‘AllAha tina janera ekajana’’- e kathA valA parihAra kara| tomAdera kalyANa have; nizcaYai AllAhai ekamAtra ilAha; tini kona santAna haoYA hate putaH, mukta| nabhomanDala o bhU-manDale yA Ache tA tA~rai evaM AllAhai kArya sampAdane yatheSTa|
AllAhara vAndA haoYAra vyApAre mAsIh evaM sAnnidhya prApta mAlAikAdera konai saMkoca nei; evaM yArA tA~ra sevAYa saMkucita haYa o ahaMkAra kare tini tAdera sakalake nijera dike ekatrita karavena|

anantara yArA vizvAsa sthApana kareche o sat kAja kare thAke tAderake tini samyaka pratidAna pradAna karavena evaM svIYa sampada hate adhikatara dAna karavena evaM yArA saMkucita haYa ahaMkAra kare, tAderake tini yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pradAna karavena| evaM AllAha vyatIta tArA nijedera janya kona abhibhAvaka vA sAhAyyakArI pAvenA|
he loka sakala! tomAdera ravera sannidhAna hate tomAdera nikaTa pratyakSa pramANa eseche evaM Ami tomAdera prati samujjvala jyoti avatIrNa karechi|

ataHpara yArA AllAhara prati vizvAsa sthApana kareche evaM tA~ke sudRr3ha rUpe dhAraNa kareche, phalataH tini tAderake svIYa karuNA o kalyANera dike praviSTa karAvena evaM svIYa sarala patha pradarzana karavena|

tArA tomAdera nikaTa vyavasthA prArthanA karache, tumi valaH AllAha tomAderake pitA-putrahIna samvandhe vyavasthA dAna karechena| yadi kona vyakti niHsantAna avasthAYa mArA yAYa evaM tAra bhagnI thAke tAhale se tAra parityakta sampatti hate ardhAMza pAve; evaM yadi kona nArIra santAna nA thAke tAhale tAra bhAii tadIYa uttarAdhikArI have; kintu yadi dui bhagnI thAke tAhale tAdera ubhaYera janya parityakta viSaYera dui tRtIYAMza evaM yadi tAra bhAi bhagnI-puruSa o nArIgaNa thAke tAhale puruSa dui nArIra tulya aMza pAve; AllAha tomAdera janya varNanA karachena yena tomarA vibhrAnta nA hao, evaM AllAha sarva viSaYe mahAjJAnI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tomAdera o‘YAdAguli pUrNa kara| tomAdera janya catuspada jantu hAlAla karA haYeche| tave yeguli hArAma haoYA samparke tomAdera upara pavitra kuraAnera AYAtaguli avatIrNa haYeche seguli evaM iharAma vA~dhA avasthAYa tomAdera zikAra karA jantuguli hAlAla naYa| nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra icchA anuyAYI hukuma kare thAkena|

he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA AllAhara nidarzanAvalI, niSiddha mAsaguli, kuravAnIra pazugulira galAYa vyavahRta cihnaguli evaM yArA tAdera ravera santuSTi o anugraha pAvAra janya sammAnita ghare yAvAra icchA kare tAdera avamAnanA karA vaidha mane karanA| Ara tomarA yakhana iharAma theke mukta hao takhana zikAra kara| yArA tomAderake pavitra mAsajide yete vA~dhA diYeche sei sampradAYera duzamani yena tomAderake sImA chAr3iYe yete utsAhita nA kare| sat kAja karate o saMyamI hate tomarA parasparake sAhAyya kara| tave pApa o zakratAra vyApAre tomarA eke aparake sAhAyya karanA| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| nizcaYai AllAha kaThina zAstidAtA|

tomAdera janya mRta jIva, rakta, zukarera mAMsa, AllAha chAr3A aparera nAme utsargIkRta pazu, kanTharodhe mArA pazu, AghAta lege mare yAoYA pazu, patanera phale mRta pazu, zRMgAghAte mRta pazu evaM hiMsra jantute khAoYA pazu hArAma karA haYeche; tave yA tomarA yavAha dvArA pavitra karecha tA hAlAla| Ara ye samasta pazuke pUjAra vedIra upara vali deYA haYeche tA evaM juYAra tIra dvArA bhAgya nirNaYa karAo tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche| esava kAja pApa| Aja kAphirerA tomAdera dInera viruddhAcaraNera vyApAre hatAza haYe par3eche| sutarAM tomarA tAderake bhaYa karanA; zudhu AmAkei bhaYa kara| Aja tomAdera janya tomAdera dIna pUrNAGga karalAma, tomAdera prati AmAra anugraha sampUrNa karalAma evaM isalAmake tomAdera janya dIna hisAve manonIta karalAma| tave keha pApera dike nA jhu~ke kSudhAra tAr3anAYa AhAra karate vAdhya hale seguli khAoYA tAra janya hArAma havenA| kAraNa nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla o daYAlu|

tArA tomAke jijJesa kare - tAdera janya ki ki hAlAla karA haYeche? tumi valaH pavitra jinisaguli tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche| AllAhara nirdezita niYamAnuyAYI tomarA ye samasta pazu-pakSIke zikAra karA zikSA diYecha; tArA yA zikAra kare Ane tA tomarA khAo evaM ogulike zikArera janya pAThAnora samaYa AllAhara nAma smaraNa kara| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, nizcaYai AllAha hisAva grahaNe tatpara|

Aja tomAdera janya pavitra vastuguli hAlAla karA hala| Ahale kitAvera yavAhakRta jIvao tomAdera janya hAlAla evaM tomAdera yavAhakRta jIvao tAdera janya hAlAla| Ara satI sAdhvI musalima nArIrAo evaM tomAdera pUrvavartI Ahale kitAvera madhyakAra satI-sAdhvI nArIrAo (tomAdera janya hAlAla), yakhana tomarA tAderake tAdera vinimaYa (mohara) pradAna kara, e rUpe ye, tomarA (tAderake) patnI rUpe grahaNa kare nAo, nA prakAzye vyabhicAra kara, Ara nA gopana praNaYa kara; Ara ye vyakti ImAnera sAthe kupharI mizrita karave tAra ‘Amala nisphala haYe yAve evaM se AkhirAte sampUrNa rUpe kSatigrasta have|

he mu’minagaNa! yakhana tomarA sAlAtera uddeze danDAYamAna hao takhana (sAlAtera pUrve) tomAdera mukhamanDala dhauta kara evaM hAtagulike kanui paryanta dhuYe nAo, Ara mAthA mAsAha kara evaM pA’gulike TAkhanu paryanta dhuYe phela| yadi tomarA apavitra hao tAhale gosala kare samasta zarIra pavitra kare nAo| kintu yadi rogagrasta hao kiMvA saphare thAka athavA tomAdera keha pAYakhAnA hate phire Asa kiMvA tomarA strIderake sparza kara (strI-sahavAsa kara), ataHpara pAni nA pAo tAhale pavitra mATi dvArA tAYAmmuma kare nAo, takhana tomarA tA dvArA tomAdera mukhamanDala o hAta mAsAha kara, AllAha tomAdera upara kona saMkIrNatA AnaYana karate cAnanA, varaM tini tomAderake pavitra karate o tomAdera upara svIYa ni‘AmAta pUrNa karate cAna, yena tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

Ara tomarA tomAdera prati varSita AllAhara anugrahake smaraNa kara evaM tA~ra ai aGgIkArakeo smaraNa kara, ye aGgIkAra tini tomAdera nikaTa theke grahaNa karechilena| tomarA valechile, AmarA zunalAma o mene nilAma| Ara tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, nizcaYai tini antarera kathAgulirao pUrNa khavara rAkhena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhara uddeze vidhAnasamUha pUrNa rUpe pratiSThAkArI o nyAYera sAthe sAkSyadAnakArI haYe yAo, kona vizeSa sampradAYera zakratA yena tomAderake era prati prarocita nA kare ye, tomarA nyAYavicAra karavenA| tomarA nyAYavicAra kara, eTA AllAha-bhItira adhikatara nikaTavartI| AllAhake bhaYa kara, nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera kRtakarma samvandhe pUrNa oYAkiphahAla|
yArA ImAna eneche o bhAla kAja kareche tAderake AllAha pratizruti diYechena ye, tAdera janya kSamA o mahAna puraskAra raYeche|
pakSAntare yArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra vidhAnasamUhake mithyA jeneche tArAi hacche jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera prati ye AllAhara anugraha raYeche tA smaraNa kara, yakhana eka sampradAYa ei cintAYa chila ye, tomAdera dike tAdera hasta prasArita karave, kintu AllAha tAdera hAtake tomAdera dika theke thAmiYe diYechena, tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, evaM mu’minadera AllAhara uparai bharasA karA ucita|

Ara AllAha vAnI isarAIlera nikaTa theke aGgIkAra niYechilena, Ami tAdera madhya hate vAro jana dalapati niyukta karechilAma; evaM AllAha valechilenaH Ami tomAdera sAthe raYechi, yadi tomarA sAlAta supratiSThita kara o yAkAta dite thAka evaM AmAra rAsUladera upara ImAna Ana o tAderake sAhAyya kara evaM AllAhake uttamarUpe karja dite thAka; tAhale Ami avazyai tomAdera pApaguli tomAdera theke muche diva evaM avazyai tomAderake emana udyAnasamUhe dAkhila karava yAra taladeze naharasamUha vaite thAkave, ataHpara ye vyakti eraparao kupharI karave, nizcaYai se sojA patha theke dUre sare par3ala|

vastutaH zudhu tAdera pratizruti bhaGgera kAraNei Ami tAderake svIYa abhizapta karalAma evaM antarake kaThora kare dilAma| tArA kAlAmake (tAorAta) ora sthAnasamUha hate parivartana kare deYa evaM tAderake yA kichu upadeza deYA haYechila tArA tAra madhya hate eka var3a aMzake vismRta hate vaseche, Ara AgAmIteo (avirata) tAdera kona nA kona khiYAnatera saMvAda tomAra nikaTa Asate thAkave, tAdera alpa kaYekajana vyatIta| ataeva tumi tAderake kSamA karate thAka evaM tAderake mArjanA karate thAka; nizcaYai AllAha sadAcArI lokaderake bhAlavAsena|

Ara yArA valeH ‘AmarA nAsArAha,’ Ami tAdera nikaTa thekeo o‘YAdA niYechilAma, anantara tAderakeo yA kichu upadeza deYA haYechila tAra madhya hate tArA nijedera eka var3a aMza vismRta haYeche| sutarAM Ami tAdera parasparera madhye hiMsA o zakratA saJcAra kare dilAma kiYAmAtera dina paryanta evaM acirei AllAha tAderake tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe saMvAda divena|

he Ahale kitAva! tomAdera kAche AmAra rAsUla eseche, tomarA kitAvera ye sava viSaYa gopana kara tanmadhya hate vahu viSaYa se tomAdera sAmane pariskArabhAve vyakta kare, Ara vahu viSaYa (prakAza karA) varjana kare, tomAdera kAche AllAhara nikaTa theke eka AlokamaYa vastta eseche evaM tA ekaTi spaSTa kitAva (kuraAna)|

tA dvArA AllAha erUpa lokaderake zAntira panthAsamUha vale dena yArA tA~ra santuSTi amveSaNa kare evaM tini tAderake nija tAophIke (o karuNAYa) kupharIra andhakAra theke vera kare (ImAnera) Alora dike AnaYana karena evaM tAderake sarala (saThika) pathe pratiSThita rAkhena|

nizcaYai tArA kAphira yArA valeH nizcaYai AllAha svaYaM hacchena masIh (IsA) ivane mAraiYAma! tumi valaH yadi AllAha masIh (IsA) ivanu mAraiYAmake o tAra mAtAke evaM bhU-pRSThe yArA Ache tAdera savAike dhvaMsa karAra icchA karena tAhale erUpa ke Ache ye tAderake AllAha hate etaTuku rakSA karate pAre? AllAharai kartRtva nirdiSTa raYeche AkAzasamUhe o yamIne evaM etadubhaYera madhyasthita yAvatIYa kichura upara; tini yA icchA karena tAi sRSTi karena, Ara AllAha sakala vastura upara pUrNa kSamatAvAna|

iYAhudI o nAsArAh valeH AmarA AllAhara putra o tA~ra priYapAtra| tumi tAdera vale dAo, AcchA tAhale tini tomAderake tomAdera pApera daruNa kena zAsti pradAna karavena? varaM tomarAo anyAnya sRSTira nyAYa sAdhAraNa mAnuSa mAtra, tini yAke icchA mArjanA karavena evaM yAke icchA zAsti divena, Ara AllAhara kartRtva raYeche AkAzasamUhe o yamIne evaM etadubhaYera madhyasthita savakichuteo; Ara savAike AllAhara dikei pratyAvartana karate have|

he Ahale kitAva! rAsUladera Agamana dIrghakAla vandha thAkAra para tomAdera nikaTa AmAra rAsUla ese pau~cheche, ye tomAderake spaSTabhAve (AllAhara hukuma) vale dicche, yena tomarA (kiYAmAta dine) valate nA pAra ye, tomAdera nikaTa kona susaMvAdadAtA o bhaYa prardazanakArI Agamana kareni| (ekhana to) tomAdera nikaTa susaMvAdadAtA o bhaYa prardazanakArI ese geche, Ara AllAha sakala vastura upara pUrNa kSamatAvAna|

Ara yakhana mUsA svIYa sampradAYake valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera prati AllAhara ni’Amatake smaraNa kara, yakhana tini tomAdera madhye vahu nAvI sRSTi karalena, rAjyAdhipati karalena evaM tomAderake emana vastusamUha dAna karalena yA vizvavAsIdera madhye kehakeo dAna karenani|
he AmAra sampradAYa! ei puNya bhUmite praveza kara yA AllAha tomAdera janya likhe diYechena, Ara pichanera dike phire yeonA, tAhale tomarA sampUrNa rUpe kSatigrasta have|

tArA valalaH he mUsA! sekhAneto parAkramazAlI loka raYeche| ataeva tArA ye paryanta sekhAna hate vera haYe nA yAYa se paryanta AmarA sekhAne kakhanao praveza karavanA| hyA~, yadi tArA sekhAna hate veriYe yAYa tAhale nizcaYai AmarA yete prastuta Achi|

sei dui vyakti (yArA AllAhake bhaYakArIdera antarbhukta chila evaM yAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechilena) valalaH tomarA tAdera upara AkramaNa cAliYe (nagarera) dvAradeza paryanta yAo, anantara yakhanai tomarA dvAradeze pA rAkhave takhanai jaYa lAbha karave; evaM tomarA AllAhara uparai nirbhara kara, yadi tomarA mu’mina hao|

tArA valalaH he mUsA! nizcaYai AmarA kakhanao sekhAne pA rAkhavanA ye paryanta tArA sekhAne vidyamAna thAke| ataeva Apani o ApanAra rAvva (AllAha) cale yAna evaM ubhaYe yuddha karuna, AmarA ekhAnei vase thAkava|
mUsA valala- he AmAra rAvva! Ami zudhu nijera upara o nijera bhAiYera upara adhikAra rAkhi, sutarAM Apani AmAdera ubhaYera evaM ei avAdhya sampradAYera madhye mImAMsA kare dina|

tini (AllAha) valalenaH (tAhale mImAMsA ei ye) ei deza calliza vachara paryanta edera hastagata havenA, e rUpei tArA bhU-pRSThe udabhrAnta haYe phirave, sutarAM tumi avAdhya sampradAYera janya (ekaTuo) viSanna haYonA|

tumi tAderake (Ahale kitAvaderake) Adamera putradvaYera (hAvIla o kAvIlera) ghaTanA saThikabhAve pATha kare zuniYe dAo; yakhana tArA ubhaYei eka ekaTi kuravAnI upasthita karala evaM tanmadhya hate ekajanera (hAvIlera) kuravAnI kavUla hala evaM aparajanera kavUla halanA| aparajana valate lAgalaH Ami tomAke nizcaYai hatyA karava; prathamajana valalaH AllAha AllAhabhIrudera ‘Amalai kavUla kare thAkena|
tumi yadi AmAke hatyA karAra janya hAta prasArita kara, tathApi Ami tomAke hatyA karAra janya tomAra dike kakhanao AmAra hAta vAr3AvanA; Amito vizva jAhAnera rAvva AllAhake bhaYa kari|
Ami cAi ye, (AmAra dvArA kona pApa nA hoka) tumi AmAra pApa evaM tomAra pApa samastai nijera mAthAYa tule nAo; anantara tumi jAhAnnAmIdera antarbhukta haYe yAo, atyAcArIdera zAsti erUpai haYe thAke|
ataHpara tAra pravRtti tAke svIYa bhrAtR hatyAra prati praluvdha kare tulala| sutarAM se tAke hatyA karei phelala, phale se kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe par3ala|

ataHpara AllAha ekaTi kAka preraNa karalena, se mATi khu~r3ate lAgala, yena se tAke (kAvIlake) zikhiYe deYa ye, svIYa bhAiYera mRtadeha kibhAve DhAkave, se valate lAgalaH AmAra avasthAra prati Aphasosa! Ami ai kAkera samatulya hate pAralAmanA evaM nija bhAiYera mRtadeha AvRta karate akSama haYe gelAma| phale se atyanta lajjita hala|

e kAraNei Ami vAnI isarAIlera prati ei nirdeza diYechi ye, ye vyakti kona vyaktike hatyA kare anya prANera vinimaYa vyatIta, kiMvA tAra dvArA bhU-pRSThe kona phitanA-phAsAda vistAra vyatIta, tAhale se yena samasta mAnuSake hatyA kare phelala; Ara ye vyakti kona vyaktike rakSA karala, tAhale se yena samasta mAnuSake rakSA karala; Ara tAdera (vAnI isarAIlera) kAche AmAra vahu rAsUlao spaSTa pramANasamUha niYe Agamana karechila, tavu era pareo tanmadhya hate anekei bhU-pRSThe sImA laMghanakArI haYe geche|

yArA AllAhara viruddhe o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhe saMgrAma kare, Ara bhU-pRSThe azAnti sRSTi kare ver3AYa, tAdera zAsti eTAi ye, tAderake hatyA karA have athavA zule car3Ana have, athavA eka dikera hAta o apara dikera pA keTe phelA have, athavA tAdera deza theke nirvAsita karA have; eTAto duniYAYa tAdera janya bhISaNa apamAna, Ara AkhirAteo tAdera janya bhISaNa zAsti raYeche|
kintu hyA~, tomarA tAderake grephatAra karAra pUrve yArA tAovAha kare, tAhale jene rekha ye, nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tA~ra sAnnidhya amveSaNa kara o AllAhara pathe jihAda karate thAka| AzA karA yAYa ye, tomarA saphalakAma have|

nizcaYai yArA kAphira, yadi tAdera kAche vizvera samasta sampadao thAke evaM ora sAthe tatparimAna Arao thAke, evaM egulora vinimaYe kiYAmAtera zAsti theke mukti pete cAYa, tavuo ei sampada tAdera theke kavUla karA havenA, Ara tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
nizcaYai tArA eTA kAmanA karave ye, jAhAnnAma theke vera haYe yAYa, athaca tArA tA theke kakhanao vera hate pAravenA, vastutaH tAdera janya raYeche cirasthAYI zAsti|
Ara ye puruSa curi kare evaM ye nArI curi kare, tomarA tAdera kRtakarmera sAjA hisAve tAdera (DAna hAta) keTe phela, eTA AllAhara pakSa theke zAsti, Ara AllAha atizaYa kSamatAvAna, mahA prajJAmaYa|

anantara ye vyakti sImA laMghana karAra para (curi karAra para) tAovAha kare evaM ‘Amalake saMzodhana kare, tAhale AllAha tAra prati (rAhamAtera) dRSTi varSaNa karavena, nizcaYai AllAha parama kSamAzIla, ati daYAlu|
tumi ki jAnanA ye, AllAharai janya raYeche Adhipatya AsamAnasamUhe evaM yamIne, tini yAke icchA zAsti dena evaM yAke icchA kSamA karena! Ara AllAha sarva viSaYera upara pUrNa kSamatAvAna|

he rAsUla! yArA daur3e daur3e kupharIte patita haYa tAdera ei kAja yena tomAke cintita nA kare, tArA ai sava lokera madhya thekei hoka yArA nijedera mukheto (michAmichi) valeH AmarA ImAna enechi; athaca tAdera antara vizvAsa kareni, athavA tArA sei sava iYAhudI yArA mithyA kathA zunate abhyasta, tArA tomAra kathAguli anya sampradAYera janya kAna pete zone; sei sampradAYera avasthA erUpa ye, tArA tomAra nikaTa Aseni (varaM anyake pAThiYeche); tArA kAlAmake ora svasthAna theke parivartana kare thAke| tArA valeH yadi tomarA (sekhAne giYe) ei (vikRta) vidhAna pAo tAhale tA kavUla karave, Ara yadi ei (vikRta) vidhAna nA pAo tAhale virata thAkave| AllAha yAke parIkSAYa phelAra icchA karena tumi tAra janya AllAhara sAthe kona kichui karAra adhikArI nao; tArA erUpa ye, tAdera antaraguli pavitra karA AllAhara abhiprAYa naYa; tAdera janya duniYAYa raYeche apamAna evaM AkhirAteo tAdera janya raYeche bhISaNa zAsti|

tArA mithyA kathA zunate abhyasta, hArAma vastu khete abhyasta| ataeva tArA yadi tomAra kAche Ase tAhale tumi tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dAo, kiMvA tAdera vyApAre nilipta thAka, Ara yadi tumi tAdera theke niliptai thAka tAhale tAdera sAdhya nei ye, tomAra vindumAtrao kSati kare| Ara yadi tumi vicAra-mImAMsA kara tAhale tAdera madhye nyAYasaGgata vicAra karave, nizcaYai AllAha nyAYavicArakaderake bhAlavAsena|
Ara tArA kirUpe tomAke mImAMsAkArI vAniYe nicche? athaca tAdera kAche tAorAta raYeche, yAte AllAhara vidhAna vidyamAna! ataHpara tArA (tomAra mImAMsA hate) phire yAYa, Ara tArA kakhanao vizvAsI naYa|

Ami tAorAta nAyila karechilAma, yAte hidAYAta chila evaM (AnuSThAnika vidhAnAvalIra) Alo chila, AllAhara anugata nAvIgaNa tadanuyAYI iYAhudIderake Adeza karata Ara AllAhaoYAlAgaNa evaM AlimagaNao| kAraNa ei ye, tAderake ei kitAvullAhara saMrakSaNera Adeza deYA haYechila evaM tArA era sAkSI| ataeva (he iYAhudI AlimagaNa!) tomarA mAnuSake bhaYa karanA, varaM AmAke bhaYa kara; Ara AmAra vidhAnasamUhera vinimaYe (pArthiva) sAmAnya vastu grahaNa karanA; Ara ye vyakti AllAhara avatArita (vidhAna) anuyAYI vicAra karenA, emana lokato pUrNa kAphira|

Ara Ami tAdera prati tAte (tAorAte) eTA pharaya karechilAma ye, prANera vinimaYe prANa, cakSura vinimaYe cakSu, nAkera vinimaYe nAka, kAnera vinimaYe kAna, dA~tera vinimaYe dA~ta evaM (tadrupa anyAnya) yakhamerao vinimaYe yakhama raYeche; kintu ye vyakti tAke kSamA kare deYa, tAhale eTA tAra janya (pApera) kAphphArA haYe yAve; Ara ye vyakti AllAhara avatArita vidhAna anuyAYI phAisAlA karenA, tAhaleto emana vyakti pUrNa yAlima|

Ara Ami tAdera para IsA ivane mAraiYAmake ei avasthAYa preraNa karechilAma, se tAra pUrvavartI kitAvera arthAt tAorAtera satyAYanakArI chila evaM Ami tAke iJjIla pradAna karechi, yAte hidAYAta evaM Alo chila, Ara oTA tAra pUrvavartI kitAva arthAt tAorAtera satyatA samarthana karata evaM eTA sampUrNa rUpe muttAkIdera janya hidAYAta o nasIhata chila|

Ahale iJjIlera ucita-AllAha tAte yA kichu avatIrNa karechena, tadanuyAYI hukuma pradAna karA, Ara ye vyakti AllAhara avatArita (vidhAna) anuyAYI hukuma pradAna karenA, tAhale to e rUpa lokai pApAcArI phAsika|

Ara Ami ei kitAvake (kuraAna) tomAra prati nAyila karechi yA nijeo satyatA guNe vibhUSita, (evaM) ora pUrvavartI kitAvasamUherao satyAYanakArI evaM ai sava kitAvera viSaYa vastura saMrakSakao| ataeva tumi tAdera pArasparika viSaYe AllAhara avatArita ei kitAva anuyAYI mImAMsA kara, yA tumi prApta haYecha, tA theke virata haYe tAdera pravRtti anuyAYI kAja karanA, tomAdera pratyekera (sampradAYa) janya Ami nirdiSTa zArIYAta evaM nirdiSTa panthA nirdhAraNa karechilAma; Ara yadi AllAha icchA karatena tAhale tomAdera sakalake ekai ummAta kare ditena| kintu tini tA karenani e kAraNe ye, ye dharma tini tomAderake pradAna karechena tAte tomAdera sakalake parIkSA karavena, sutarAM tomarA kalyANakara viSaYasamUhera dike dhAvita hao; tomAdera sakalake AllAharai samIpe pratyAvartana karate have, takhana tini tomAderake jAniYe divena ye viSaYe tomarA matavirodha karachile|

Ara Ami nirdeza dicchi ye, tumi tAdera pArasparika vyApAre ei prerita kitAva anuyAYI mImAMsA karave evaM tAdera pravRtti anuyAYI kAja karavenA, evaM tAdera dika theke satarka thAkave yena tArA tomAke AllAha prerita kona nirdeza hate vibhrAnta karate nA pAre; anantara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale dRr3ha vizvAsa rekha, AllAhara icchA eTAi ye, tAderake kona kona pApera kAraNe zAsti pradAna karavena; Ara vahu lokato nApharamAnai haYe thAke|
tAhale ki tArA ajJatA yugera mImAMsA kAmanA kare? Ara dRr3ha vizvAsIdera kAche mImAMsA kArye AllAhara ceYe ke uttama phAisAlAkArI?

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA iYAhudI o khRSTAnaderake vandhu rUpe grahaNa karanA, tArA paraspara vandhu; Ara tomAdera madhye ye vyakti tAdera sAthe vandhutva karave nizcaYai se tAderai madhye gaNya have; nizcaYai AllAha atyAcArI sampradAYake supatha pradarzana karenanA|

e kAraNei yAdera antare pIr3A raYeche tAderake tomarA dekhecha ye, tArA daur3e daur3e tAdera (kAphiradera) madhye praveza karache, evaM tArA valeH AmAdera bhaYa hacche ye, AmAdera upara kona vipada ese par3e nA ki! ataeva AzA karA yAYa ye, acirei AllAha (musalimadera) pUrNa vijaYa dAna karavena athavA anya kona viSaYa vizeSabhAve nija pakSa hate (prakAza karavena), anantara tArA nijedera antare lukAYita manobhAvera kAraNe lajjita have|

Ara musalimarA valaveH Are! erAi nAki tArA, yArA ati dRr3hatAra sAthe AllAhara nAme zapatha karata, AmarA tomAdera sAthei Achi? edera samasta kAjai vyartha haYe geche, phale tArA akRtakArya haYe raila|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera madhya hate ye vyakti svIYa dharma hate vicyuta have, (ete isalAmera kona kSati nei, kenanA) AllAha sattvarai (tAdera sthale) emana eka sampradAYa sRSTi karavena yAderake AllAha bhAlavAsavena evaM tArAo AllAhake bhAlavAsave, tArA musalimadera prati meheravAna thAkave, kAphiradera prati kaThora have, tArA AllAhara pathe jihAda karave Ara tArA kona nindukera nindAra paraoYA karavenA; eTA AllAhara anugraha, tA tini yAke icchA pradAna karena; vastutaH AllAha prAcurya dAnakArI, mahAjJAnI|
tomAdera vandhuto AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla evaM mu’minagaNa - yArA sAlAta supratiSThita kare, yAkAta pradAna kare evaM vinamra|
Ara yArA vandhutva rAkhave AllAhara sAthe, tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe evaM mu’minadera sAthe, tAhale tArA AllAhara dalabhukta hala evaM nizcaYai AllAhara dalai vijaYI|

he mu’minagaNa! yArA tomAdera pUrve kitAva prApta haYeche, tAdera madhye yArA tomAdera dharmake hAsi-tAmAzAra vastu mane kare tAderake evaM anyAnya kAphiraderake vandhu rUpe grahaNa karanA, evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, yadi tomarA ImAnadAra haYe thAka|
Ara yakhana tomarA sAlAtera (AyAna dvArA) AhavAna kara takhana tArA ora sAthe upahAsa kare; era kAraNa ei ye, tArA erUpa loka yArA moTei jJAna rAkhenA|

tumi vale dAo, he Ahale kitAva! tomarA AmAdera madhye kon kAjaTi duSaNIYa pAccha eTA vyatIta ye, AmarA ImAna enechi AllAhara prati evaM ai kitAvera prati yA AmAdera nikaTa prerita haYeche evaM ai kitAvera pratio yA atIte prerita haYeche, athaca tomAdera adhikAMza loka (ullikhita kitAvasamUhera) prati ImAna (era ganDi) hate vahirbhUta|

tumi vale dAoH Ami ki tomAderake erUpa panthA hisAve oTA hateo (yAke tomarA manda vale jAna) erUpa saMvAda diva yA AllAhara kAche adhika nikRSTa? oTA ai sava lokera panthA, yAderake AllAha abhisampAta karechena evaM yAdera prati gayava nAyila karechena o yAderake vAnara o zukare rUpAntarita karechena evaM yArA tAgutera ivAdAta karache tArA maryAdAra dika diYe nikRSTatara evaM sarala patha hate sarvAdhika vicyuta |
Ara yakhana tArA tomAdera nikaTa Ase takhana vale, AmarA ImAna enechi; athaca tArA kupharI niYei esechila evaM tArA kupharI niYei cale geche; evaM AllAhato khuva bhAla jAnena yA tArA gopana rAkhe|
Ara tumi tAdera madhye anekake dekhave, daur3e daur3e pApa, yulama o hArAma bhakSaNe nipatita hacche; vAstavikai tArA khuva manda kAja karache|
tAderake AllAhaoYAlA evaM AlimagaNa pApera vAkya hate evaM hArAma mAla bhakSaNa karA hate kena niSedha karachenA? tAdera e abhyAsa nindanIYa|

Ara iYAhudIrA valeH AllAhara hAta vandha haYe geche| tAderai hAta vandha, evaM tAdera ei uktira daruNa tArA abhizapta| varaM tA~ra (AllAhara) to ubhaYa hAta ummukta, yerUpa icchA tini vyaYa karena; Ara ye viSaYa tomAra nikaTa tomAra ravera pakSa hate prerita haYa tA tAdera madhye anekera nApharamAnI o kuphara vRddhira kAraNa haYa, evaM tAdera parasparera madhye zakratA o hiMsA nikSepa karechi kiYAmAta paryanta; yakhanai (musalimadera viruddhe) yuddhAgni prajjvalita karate cAYa, AllAha tA nirvApita kare dena; tArA bhU-pRSThe azAnti char3iYe ver3AYa; Ara AllAha azAnti vistArakArIderake bhAlavAsenanA|

Ara ei Ahale kitAva (iYAhudI o nAsArAh) yadi ImAna Anata evaM tAkaoYA avalamvana karata, Ami avazyai tAdera samasta anyAYa kSamA kare ditAma evaM avazyai tAderake ni‘AmAtera udyAnasamUhe dAkhila karatAma|

Ara yadi tArA tAorAta o iJjIlera evaM ye kitAva (arthAt kuraAna) tAdera ravera pakSa hate tAdera prati avatIrNa haYeche, ora theke yathArIti ‘AmalakArI hata tAhale tArA upara (arthAt AkAza) hate evaM nimna (arthAt yamIna) hate prAcuryera sAthe AhAra peta; tAdera ekadalato sarala pathera anugAmI; Ara tAdera adhikAMzai erUpa ye, tAdera kAryakalApa ati jaghanya|

he rAsUla! yA kichu tomAra ravera pakSa theke tomAra upara avatIrNa karA haYeche, tumi (mAnuSake) sava kichui pau~che dAo| Ara yadi erUpa nA kara tAhale tomAke arpita dAYitva pAlana karalenA; AllAha tomAke mAnuSa (arthAt kAphira) hate rakSA karavena| nizcaYai AllAha kAphira sampradAYake supatha pradarzana karenanA|

tumi vale dAoH he Ahale kitAva! tomarA kono pathei pratiSThita nao ye paryanta nA tAorAta, iJjIla evaM ye kitAva (arthAt kuraAna) tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera ravera pakSa theke pAThAno haYeche tAra upara Amala kara; Ara avazyai yA tomAra prati tomAra ravera pakSa theke preraNa karA haYa, tA tAdera madhye anekerai nApharamAnI o kuphara vRddhira kAraNa haYe yAYa| ataeva tumi ei kAphiradera janya manaHkSunna haYonA|

eTA sunizcita ye, musalima, iYAhudI, sAveI evaM khRSTAnadera madhye ye vyakti AllAhara prati o kiYAmAtera prati vizvAsa rAkhe evaM sat kAja kare, eirUpa lokadera janya zeSa dine nA kona prakAra bhaYa thAkave Ara nA tArA cintAnvita have|

Ami vAnI isarAIla hate aGgIkAra niYechi evaM tAdera kAche vahu rAsUla preraNa karechi; yakhanai tAdera kAche kona nAvI Agamana karata emana kona vidhAna niYe yA tAdera manaHputa hatanA, takhanai tArA katipaYake mithyAvAdI sAvyasta karata evaM katipaYake hatyAi kare phelata|

Ara tArA ei dhAraNAi karechila ye, kona zAstii havenA, phale tArA Arao andha o vadhira haYe gela, ataHpara dIrghakAla para AllAha tAdera prati karuNA karalena; tavuo tAdera adhikAMzai andha o vadhirai raila| vastutaH AllAha tAdera kAryakalApasamUha pratyakSa karena|

nizcaYai tArA kAphira haYeche yArA vale - masIha ivane mAraiYAmai AllAha| athaca masIh nijei valechilaH he vAnI isarAIla! tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara! yini AmAra rAvva evaM tomAderao rAvva; nizcaYai ye vyakti AllAhara aMzI sthApana karave, AllAha tAra janya jAnnAta hArAma kare divena evaM tAra vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma; evaM erUpa atyAcArIdera janya kona sAhAyyakArI thAkavenA|

niHsandehe tArAo kAphira yArA valeH ‘AllAha tinera (arthAt tina mA‘vUdera) eka’, athaca ivAdAta pAvAra yogya eka AllAha chAr3A anya kehai nei; Ara yadi tArA svIYa uktisamUha hate nivRtta nA haYa tAhale tAdera madhye yArA kupharIte aTala thAkave tAdera upara yantraNAdAYaka zAsti patita have|
tArA AllAhara samIpe kena tAovAha karenA evaM tA~ra kAche kSamA prArthanA karenA? athaca AllAha atyanta kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYa|

mAraiYAma putra mAsIha kevala ekajana rAsUla| tAra pUrve aneka rAsUla vigata haYeche evaM tAra mA chila ati satyavAdI| tArA ubhaYe khAvAra kheta| dekha, kIbhAve Ami tAdera janya AYAtasamUha varNanA karachi| ataHpara dekha, kIbhAve tAderake satyavimukha karA hacche|
tumi vale dAoH tomarA ki AllAha chAr3A emana vastura ivAdAta kara yA tomAdera nA kona apakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhe, Ara nA kona upakAra karAra? athaca AllAhai sava zunena, jAnena|

tumi valaH he Ahale kitAva! tomarA nijedera dharme anyAYabhAve sImA laMghana karanA, evaM ai sampradAYera (bhittihIna) kalpanAra upara calonA yArA atIte nijerAo bhrAntite patita haYeche evaM anyAnyaderake bhrAntite nikSepa kareche| vastutaH tArA sarala patha theke dUre sare par3echila|

vAnI isarAIlera madhye yArA kAphira chila, tAdera upara abhisampAta karA haYechila dAUda o IsA ivane mAraiYAmera mukhe; ei lA’nata e kAraNe karA haYechila ye, tArA avAdhya chila evaM sImAlaMghana karata|
tArA ye anyAYa kAja karechila tA hate eke aparake niSedha karatanA; vAstavikai tAdera kAja chila atyanta garhita|

tumi tAdera (iYAhudIdera) anekake dekhave, tArA kAphiradera sAthe vandhutva karache; ye kAja tArA bhaviSyatera janya kareche tA niHsandehe manda, AllAha tAdera prati asantuSTa haYechena| phalataH tArA AyAve cirakAla thAkave|

Ara yadi tArA AllAhara prati ImAna Anato evaM nAvIra prati evaM ai kitAvera (tAorAtera) prati yA tA~ra nAvIra nikaTa prerita haYechila, tAhale tAderake (muzarikaderake) kakhanao vandhu rUpe grahaNa karatanA, kintu tAdera adhikAMza lokai phAsika|

tumi mAnavamanDalIra madhye iYAhudI o muzarikaderake musalimadera sAthe adhika zakratA poSaNakArI pAve, Ara tanmadhye musalimadera sAthe vandhutva rAkhAra adhikatara nikaTavartI ai sava lokake pAve yArA nijederake nAsArAh (khRSTAna) vale; eTA e kAraNe ye, tAdera madhye vahu Alima evaM vahu daraveza raYeche; Ara e kAraNe ye, tArA ahaMkArI naYa|

Ara yakhana rAsUlera kAche yA avatIrNa haYeche tA zravaNa kare takhana tumi dekhate pAo ye, tAdera azru vaiche; e kAraNe ye, tArA satyake upaladdhi karate pereche| tArA erUpa valeH he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA mu’mina haYe gelAma, sutarAM AmAderakeo ai sava lokera sAthe lipivaddha kare nina, yArA (muhAmmAda o kuraAnake satya vale) svIkAra kare |

Ara AmAdera ki emana oyara Ache, ye janya AmarA ImAna AnavanA AllAhara prati evaM sei satyera prati yA AmAdera kAche pau~cheche; athaca e AzA rAkhavo ye, AmAdera rAvva nekakAradera sAthe AmAderake zAmila karavena?

phalataH tAdera ei uktira vinimaYe AllAha tAderake emana udyAnasamUha pradAna karavena, yAra taladeze nahara vaite thAkave, tArA tAte anantakAla avasthAna karave| sat karmazIladera janya eTAi pratidAna!
Ara yArA kAphira haYeche evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA valeche tArA have jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAha ye sava vastu tomAdera janya hAlAla karechena tanmadhye susvAdu vastugulike hArAma karanA evaM sImA laMghana karanA; nizcaYai AllAha sImA laMghanakArIderake pachanda karenanA|
Ara AllAha tomAderake yA dAna karechena tanmadhya hate hAlAla o pavitra vastuguli AhAra kara, evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara - yA~ra prati tomarA vizvAsI|

AllAha tomAdera arthahIna kasamera janya tomAdera pAkar3Ao karavenanA, kintu tini tomAderake ai kasamasamUhera janya pAkar3A karavena yegulike tomarA (bhaviSyata viSaYera prati) dRr3ha kara, sutarAM ora kAphaphArA hacche dazajana abhAvagrastake madhyama dharaNera khAdya pradAna karA, yA tomarA nija parivArera lokaderake khAiYe thAka, kiMvA tAderake paridheYa vastra dAna karA (madhyama dharaNera), kiMvA ekajana golAma kiMvA vA~dI mukta karA| Ara ye vyakti sAmarthya rAkhenA se (ekAdhAre) tina dina siYAma pAlana karave; eTA tomAdera kasamasamUhera kAphphArA yakhana tomarA kasama kara evaM ataHpara bhaGga kara evaM nijedera kasamasamUhake rakSA karave| ei rUpei AllAha tomAdera janya svIYa vidhAnasamUha varNanA karena yena tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
he mu’minagaNa! nizcaYai mada, juYA, mUrti ityAdi evaM laTArIra tIra, e sava garhita viSaYa, zAitAnI kAja chAr3A Ara kichui naYa| sutarAM e theke sampUrNa rUpe dUre thAka, yena tomAdera kalyANa haYa|

zAitAnato eTAi cAYa ye, mada o juYA dvArA tomAdera parasparera madhye zakratA o hiMsA sRSTi hoka evaM AllAhara smaraNa hate o sAlAta hate tomAderake virata rAkhe| sutarAM ekhano ki tomarA nivRtta havenA?
Ara tomarA AllAhara Anugatya karate thAka o rAsUlera anugata hao evaM satarka thAko, Ara yadi vimukha thAko tAhale jene rekha ye, AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva chila zudhu spaSTabhAve (Adeza) pau~che deYA|

yArA ImAna eneche o bhAla kAja kare, erUpa lokadera upara kona pApa nei yA tArA pUrve AhAra kareche yakhana tArA bhaviSyatera janya paraheya kare, ImAna rAkhe o bhAla kAja kare, punarAYa saMyata thAke evaM vizvAsa sthApana kare| punarAYa saMyata thAke o bhAla kAja karate thAke; vastuta AllAha erUpa satkarmazIladera bhAlavAsena|

he mu’minagaNa! AllAha tomAderake kataka zikArera dvArA parIkSA karavena, ye zikAra paryanta tomAdera hAta o tomAdera vallama pau~chate pArave, ei uddeze ye, AllAha jene nivena ke tA~ke nA dekhe bhaYa kare| sutarAM ye vyakti eraparao sImA laMghana karave, tAra janya yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA ihrAmera avasthAYa niSiddha elAkAYa vaNya zikArake hatyA karanA; Ara tomAdera madhye ye vyakti icchA pUrvaka zikAra vadha karave tAra upara takhana vinimaYa oYAjiva have, yA (mUlyera dika diYe) sei jAnoYArera samatulya haYa yAke se hatyA kareche, yAra (AnumAnika mUlyera) mImAMsA tomAdera madhya hate du‘jana nirbharayogya vyakti kare dive| (ataHpara nirUpita mUlya dvArA) sei vinimaYa gRhapAlita catuspada jantu neYAy svarUpa kA‘vA ghara paryanta pau~che dive, nA haYa kAphaphArA svarUpa (nirUpita mUlyera khAdyadravya) misakInadera madhye vitaraNa karave, athavA era sama parimANa siYAma pAlana karave, yena nijera kRtakarmera pariNAmera svAda grahaNa kare; atIta (kraTi) AllAha kSamA kare diYechena; Ara punarAYa ye vyakti erUpa kAjai karave, AllAha sei vyakti hate (era) pratizodha grahaNa karavena; AllAha parAkrAnta, pratizodha grahaNe sakSama|

tomAdera janya sAmudrika zikAra dharA o khAoYA hAlAla karA haYeche tomAdera o musAphiradera upakArera janya, Ara sthalacara zikAra dharA tomAdera janya hArAma karA haYeche yatakSaNa tomarA ihrAma avasthAYa thAka; Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara, yA~ra samIpe tomAderake ekatrita karA have|

sammAnita gRha kA‘vAke AllAha mAnuSera sthitizIlatAra kAraNa rUpe tairI karechena evaM sammAnita mAsasamUhake, hArAme kuravAnIra jantuke evaM sei pazukeo yAra galAYa vizeSa dharaNera ver3I par3Ano haYeche| eTA e janya yena tomarA dRr3ha vizvAsa rAkha ye, nizcaYai AllAha AkAzasamUha o yamInasthita sava vasturai khavara rAkhena, Ara nizcaYai AllAha sarva viSaYe mahAjJAnI|
tomarA jene rekha ye, nizcaYai AllAha kaThina zAstidAtA evaM nizcaYai ati kSamAzIla |
rAsUlera dAYitva zudhu pau~che deYA mAtra; Ara tomarA yA kichu prakAza kara evaM yA kichu gopana kara tA savakichui AllAha jAnena|
tumi vale dAoH pavitra o apavitra samAna naYa, yadio apavitrera Adhikya tomAke camatkRta kare| ataeva he jJAnIgaNa! AllAhake bhaYa karate thAka yena tomarA (pUrNa) saphalakAma hate pAra|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA emana sava viSaYa jijJesa karanA, yadi tA tomAdera nikaTa prakAza kare deYA haYa tAhale tomAdera khArApa lAgave, Ara yadi tomarA kuraAna avatIrNa haoYAra samaYa ukta viSaYasamUha samvandhe jijJesa kara tAhale tomAdera janya prakAza kare deYA have, atItera jijJAsAvAda AllAha kSamA kare diYechena| vastutaH AllAha mahAkSamAzIla, atizaYa sahiSNu|
erUpa viSaYa tomAdera pUrve anyAnya lokerAo jijJesa karechila, ataHpara ai sava viSaYera haka tArA AdAYa kareni|
AllAha nA vAhIrAhara pracalana karechena, nA sAYevAhara; nA oYAchIlAra Ara nA hA‘mIra; kintu yArA kAphira tArA AllAhara prati mithyAropa kare, Ara adhikAMzai (dharma) jJAna rAkhe nA|

Ara yakhana tAderake valA haYa, ‘AllAhara avatIrNa vidhAnasamUhera dike eso evaM rAsUlera dike’ takhana tArA valeH AmAdera janya oTAi yatheSTa yAra upara AmarA AmAdera pUrva-puruSaderake peYechi; yadio tAdera pUrva-puruSarA nA kona jJAna rAkhato, Ara nA hidAYAta prApta chila| tavuo ki tArA tAi karave?

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera (saMzodhana karAra) dAYitva tomAdera, yArA pathabhraSTa haYeche tArA tomAdera kona kSati karate pAravenA yadi tomarA dInera pathe cala; tomarA savAi AllAharai samIpe pratyAvartita have, ataHpara tomarA yA kichu karachile se samparke tini tomAderake avahita karavena|

he mu’minagaNa! yakhana tomAdera madhye kArao mRtyu Asanna haYa takhana asIYAta karAra samaYa tomAdera madhya hate du’jana loka sAkSI thAkA saGgata| ei du’vyakti have dInadAra evaM tomAdera madhya hate; athavA bhinna sampradAYa hate du’jana have, yadi tomarA saphare thAka evaM ai avasthAYa mRtyu tomAdera upara upasthita haYa; yadi tomAdera sandeha haYa tAhale osIdvaYake sAlAtera (jAmA‘Atera) para rukhe nAo, ataHpara tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valave, AmarA ei zapathera vinimaYe kona svArtha bhoga karavanA yadi AtmIYao haYa; Ara AllAhara sAkSya pramANake AmarA gopana karavanA, (yadi erUpa kari) ematAvasthAYa AmarA bhISaNa pApI hava|

ataHpara yadi jAnA yAYa ye, osIdvaYa kona pApe jar3ita haYe par3echila tAdera madhya hate (mRtera) sarvApekSA nikaTatama apara du’vyakti tAdera sthalAbhiSikta have, ataHpara ubhaYe (erUpe) AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valaveH nizcaYai AmAdera ei zapatha tAdera zapatha apekSA adhika satya evaM AmarA vindumAtra vyatikrama karini, (yadi kari tAhale) ematAvasthAYa yAlimadera antarbhukta hava|

eTAi e viSaYe atIva sahaja panthA ye, tArA ghaTanA yathAyathabhAve prakAza kare dive, athavA ei bhaYa karave ye, tAdera zapatha grahaNa karAra para (punaH) zapatha karAno have; AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM (vidhAnasamUha) zravaNa kara, Ara AllAha phAsikaderake patha dekhAvenanA|

ye dina AllAha samasta rAsUladerake samaveta karavena, ataHpara valavenaH tomarA (ummAtadera nikaTa theke) ki uttara peYechile? tArA valaveH (tAdera antarera kathA) AmAdera kichui jAnA nei; nizcaYai Apani samasta gopanIYa viSaYe sampUrNa jJAta|

yakhana AllAha valavenaH he IsA ivane mAraiYAma! AmAra anugraha smaraNa kara yA tomAra upara o tomAra mAtAra upara (pradatta) haYeche| yakhana Ami tomAke rUhula kudusa dvArA sAhAyya karechi, (evaM) tumi mAnuSera sAthe (mAtAra) krodhera kathA valecha evaM pau~r3ha vaYaseo; Ara yakhana Ami tomAke kitAvasamUha, pragAr3ha jJAna evaM tAorAta o iJjIla zikSA diYechi evaM yakhana tumi AmAra Adeze mATi dvArA pAkhIra AkRti sadRza eka AkRti prastuta karechile, ataHpara tumi ote phutkAra dile, yAra phale oTA AmAra Adeze pAkhI haYe yeta, Ara tumi AmAra Adeze janmAndha o kuSTha rogI nirAmaYa kare dite Ara yakhana tumi AmAra Adeze mRtaderake vera kare dA~r3a karAte, Ara yakhana Ami vAnI isarAIlake (tomAke hatyA karA hate) nivRtta rekhechi yakhana tumi tAdera kAche (svIYa navuoYAtera) pramANAdI niYe hAjira haYechile, ataHpara tAdera madhye yArA kAphira chila tArA valechilaH eTA (mu’jiyAsamUha) spaSTa yAdu chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|
Ara yakhana Ami hAoYArIderake Adeza karalAmaH AmAra prati evaM AmAra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana takhana tArA valalaH AmarA ImAna AnalAma evaM Apani sAkSI thAkuna ye, AmarA musalima|

yakhana hAoYArIrA valalaH he IsA ivane mAraiYAma! ApanAra rAvva ki erUpa karate pArena ye, AmAdera janya AkAza hate kichu khAdya preraNa karena? IsA valalaH AllAhake bhaYa kara yadi tomarA ImAnadAra haYe thAka|

tArA valalaH AmAdera uddezya ei ye, AmarA tA theke AhAra kari evaM AmAdera antara sampUrNa prazAnta haYe yAYa, Ara AmAdera ei vizvAsa Arao sudRr3ha haYa ye, Apani AmAdera nikaTa satya valechena evaM AmarA era prati sAkSyadAnakArIdera antarbhukta hai|

IsA ivane mAraiYAma du‘A karalaH he AllAha! AmAdera prati AkAza hate khAdya avatIrNa karuna yena oTA AmAdera, agra o pazcAtavartIdera janya ekaTi Anandera viSaYa haYa evaM ApanAra pakSa hate eka nidarzana haYe thAke| Ara AmAderake riyka pradAna karuna, vastutaH Apanito sarvottama jIvikA pradAnakArI|
AllAha valalenaH Ami ei khAdya tomAdera prati avatIrNa karava, anantara tomAdera madhya hate ye erapara akRtajJa have, Ami tAke emana zAsti diva ye, vizvavAsIdera madhye ai zAsti Ara kehakeo divanA|

Ara yakhana AllAha valavenaH he IsA ivane mAraiYAma! tumi ki lokaderake valechileH tomarA AllAhara sAthe AmAra o AmAra mAYerao ivAdAta kara? IsA nivedana karaveH Apani pavitra! AmAra pakSe konakramei zobhanIYa chilanA ye, Ami emana kathA vali yA valAra AmAra kona adhikAra nei; yadi Ami vale thAki tAhale avazyai ApanAra jAnA thAkave; Apanito AmAra antare yA Ache tAo jAnena, pakSAntare ApanAra jJAne yA kichu raYeche Ami tA jAninA; samasta gAivera viSaYa Apanii jJAta|

Ami tAderake uhA vyatIta kichui valini yA Apani AmAke Adeza karechena ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, yini AmAra rAvva evaM tomAderao rAvva| Ami yatadina tAdera madhye chilAma tatadina tAdera samparke avagata chilAma, ataHpara Apani yakhana AmAke tule nilena takhana Apanii chilena tAdera rakSaka, vastutaH Apanii sarva viSaYe pUrNa khavara rAkhena|
Apani yadi tAderake zAsti pradAna karena tAhale orAto ApanAra vAndA; Ara yadi tAderake kSamA karena tAhaleto Apani parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha valavenaH eTi sei dina yedina satyavAdIdera satyavAdItA kAje Asave, tArA udyAna prApta have, yAra taladeze naharasamUha vaite thAkave, AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa haYechena evaM tArAo AllAhara prati santuSTa; eTAi hacche mahAsaphalatA|
AllAharai janya adhipatya raYeche nabhomanDala o bhU-manDala evaM ai samasta kichura yA etadubhaYera mAjhe vidyamAna; Ara tini sakala viSaYe pUrNa kSamatAvAna|

samasta prazaMsA AllAharai janya yini AkAzasamUha o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM sRSTi karechena Alo o andhakAra; e sattveo yArA kAphira haYeche tArA apara kichuke tAdera ravera samakakSa nirUpaNa kareche|

athaca tini tomAdera mATi hate sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tomAdera jIvanera janya ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda nirdhAraNa karechena, echAr3A Arao ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda tA~ra nikaTa nirdhArita raYeche, kintu erapareo tomarA sandeha kare thAka|
AkAzasamUha o pRthivIte ai eka AllAhai raYechena, tomAdera aprakAzya o prakAzya sava avasthAi tini jAnena, Ara tomarA yA kichu kara tAo tini pUrNarUpe avagata Achena|
Ara tAdera avasthA hacche ei ye, tAdera nikaTa tAdera ravera nidarzanasamUha hate ye kona nidarzanai Asuka nA kena, tA hatei tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
sutarAM tAdera nikaTa yakhana satya vANI eseche, oTAo tArA mithyA jeneche| ataeva ati sattvarai tAdera nikaTa sei viSaYera saMvAda ese pau~chave, ye vyApAre tArA ThATTA-vidrupa karata|

tArA ki bheve dekheni ye, Ami tAdera pUrve vahu dala o sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi, yAderake duniYAYa emana zakti sAmarthya o pratipatti diYechilAma yA tomAderake diini, Ara Ami tAdera prati AkAza hate pracura vRSTi varSaNa karechi evaM tAdera nimnabhUmi hate jharNAdhArA pravAhita karechi, kintu AmAra ni‘AmAtera zokara nA karAra pApera kAraNe Ami tAderake dhvaMsa karechi, evaM tAdera para anya natuna natuna jAti o sampradAYasamUha sRSTi karechi|

yadi Ami tomAra prati kAgaje likhita kona kitAva avatIrNa karatAma, ataHpara tArA tA nijedera hAta dvArA sparzao karata; tavuo kAphira o avizvAsI lokerA valataH eTA prakAzya yAdu chAr3A Ara kichui naYa|

Ara tArA vale thAke, tAdera kAche kona mAlAka/pherezatA kena pAThAno haYanA? Ami yadi prakRtai kona mAlAka/pherezatA avatIrNa karatAma tAhale yAvatIYa viSaYerai cUr3Anta samAdhAna haYe yeta, ataHpara tAderake kichumAtrai avakAza deYA hatanA|
Ara yadi kona mAlAkakeo/pherezatAkeo rAsUla kare pAThAtAma tAhale tAke mAnuSa rUpei pAThAtAma; eteo tArA ai sandehai karata, ye sandeha o prazna ekhana tArA karache|
tomAra pUrve ye sava nAvI rAsUla esechila, tAdera sAtheo ThATTA vidrupa karA haYeche, phalataH ei sava vyaGga vidrupera pariNAma phala vidrupakArIderakei pariveSTana kare phelechila|
tumi valaH tomarA bhU-pRSTha paribhramaNa kara, ataHpara satyake mithyA pratipannakArIdera pariNAma ki haYeche tA gabhIra abhiniveza sahakAre lakSya kara|

tumi jijJesa karaH AkAzamanDalI o dharAdhAme avasthita yA kichu raYeche tAra mAlika ke? tumi valaH tA savai AllAhara mAlikAnAYa, anugraha karA tini tA~ra nIti vale grahaNa karechena, tini tomAdera sakalake kiYAmAta divase avazyai samaveta karavena ye dina samparke kona sandehai nei; yArA nijerAi nijedera kSati o dhavaMsera mukhe pheleche tArAi vizvAsa karenA|
rAtera andhakAre evaM dinera AloYa yA kichu vasavAsa kare o vartamAna raYeche tA sava kichui AllAhara| tini sava kichui zonena o jAnena|

valaH Ami ki AllAhake vAda diYe anya kehakeo AmAra abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa karava, yini halena AkAza o pRthivIra sRSTikartA? tini riyka dAna karena, kintu kArao riyka grahaNa karenanA| tumi valaH AmAke ei Adezai karA haYeche ye, Ami sakalera Agei isalAma grahaNa kare tA~ra sAmane mAthA nata kare diva| Ara tumi muzarikadera madhye zAmila haYonA|
tumi valaH Ami AmAra ravera avAdhya hale, Ami mahAvicArera dinera zAstira bhaYa karachi|
sedina yAra upara hate zAsti pratyAhAra karA have tAra prati AllAha var3ai anugraha karavena, Ara eTAi hacche prakAzya mahAsAphalya|

AllAha yadi kArao kSati sAdhana karena tAhale tini chAr3A sei kSati dUra karAra Ara keha nei, Ara yadi tini kArao kalyANa karena, (tAhale AllAha seTAo karate pArena, kenanA) tini samasta kichura upara kSamatAvAna|
tinii tA~ra vAndAdera upara ekacchatra kSamatAra adhikArI, tinii mahAjJAnI o sarva viSaYe oYAkiphahAla|

tumi tAderake jijJesa karaH kAra sAkSya savaceYe vezi gaNya? tumi vale dAoH AmAra o tomAdera madhye AllAhai hacchena sAkSI, Ara ei kuraAna AmAra nikaTa ahIra mAdhyame pAThAno haYeche, yena Ami tomAderake evaM yAdera nikaTa eTi pau~chave tAdera sakalake era dvArA satarka kari| vAstavikai tomarA ki ei sAkSya dite pAra ye, AllAhara sAthe anya kona mA‘vUda raYeche? tumi valaH Ami ei sAkSya dite pArinA| tumi ghoSaNA karaH tinii ekamAtra ilAha, Ara tomarA ye zirake lipta raYecha, AmAra sAthe ora konai samparka nei|
yAderake Ami kitAva dAna karechi, tArA rAsUlake emanabhAve jAne o cine, yerUpa tArA nijedera santAna-santatiderake jAne o cine, kintu yArA nijederake dhvaMsera mukhe phele diYeche tArA ImAna AnavenA|

ye vyakti AllAhara prati mithyA doSAropa kare, kiMvA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare, tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre? erUpa yAlima loka kakSanoi sAphalya lAbha karate pArave nA|
sei dinaTio smaraNayogya yedina Ami sakalake ekatrita karava, ataHpara yArA AmAra sAthe zir‌ka kareche tAderake Ami valavaH yAderake tomarA mA‘vUda vale dhAraNA karate tArA ekhana kothAYa?
takhana tAdera e kathA valA vyatIta Ara kona kathA valAra thAkavenA, tArA valaveH AllAhara zapatha, he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA muzarika chilAmanA|
lakSya kara, tArA nijedera samparke kirUpa mithyA valache! takhana yAderake tArA mithyA mA‘vUda manonIta karechila tArA savAi niruddeza haYe yAve|

tAdera madhye emana lokao raYeche yArA manoyoga sahakAre kAna lAgiYe tomAra kathA zune thAke, (athaca grahaNa karenA) tomAra kathA yAte tArA bhAla rUpe vujhate nA pAre sejanya Ami tAdera antarera upara AvaraNa rekhe diYechi evaM tAdera karNe kaThina bhAra (vadhiratA) arpaNa karechi| tArA yadi samasta nidarzanao avalokana kare tavuo tArA ImAna AnavenA, emanaki yakhana tArA tomAra kAche Ase takhana tomAra sAthe arthahIna virtaka jur3e deYa, Ara tAdera kAphira lokerA (sava kathA zonAra para) valeH eTA prAcIna kAlera lokadera kissA kAhinI vyatIta Ara kichui naYa|
tArA nijerAto tA theke virata thAke, adhikanta lokaderakeo tArA tA theke virata rAkhate cAYa; vastutaH tArA dhvaMsa karache zudhumAtra nijederakei athaca tArA anubhava karachenA|

tumi yadi tAdera sei samaYera avasthATi avalokana karate yakhana tAderake jAhAnnAmera kinArAYa dA~r3a karAno have| takhana tArA valaveH hAYa! katai nA bhAla hata AmarA yadi AvAra duniYAYa phire yete pAratAma, AmarA sekhAne AmAdera ravera nidarzanasamUhake avizvAsa karatAmanA evaM AmarA ImAnadAra haYe yetAma!

ye satya tArA pUrve gopana karechila tA takhana tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa rUpe pratibhAta haYe par3ave, Ara yadi tAderake sAveka pArthiva jIvane phire yeteo deYA haYa, tavuo yA karate tAderake niSedha karA haYechila tArA tA’i karave, niHsandehe tArA mithyAvAdI|
tArA valeH ei pArthiva jIvanai prakRta jIvana, erapara Ara kona jIvana nei, Ara AmAderake punarutthita karA havenA|

hAYa! tumi yadi sei dRzyaTi dekhate, yakhana tAderake tAdera ravera sammukhe danDAYamAna karA have, takhana AllAha tA‘AlA jijJesa karavenaH eTA (kiYAmAta) ki satya naYa? takhana tArA uttare valaveH hyA~, AmarA AmAdera ravera (AllAhara) zapatha kare valachi! eTA vAstava o satya viSaYa| takhana AllAha valavenaH tAhale tomarA eTAke asvIkAra o amAnya karAra phala svarUpa zAstira svAda grahaNa kara|

ai sava lokai kSatigrasta yArA AllAhara sAthe sAkSAta haoYAke mithyA bheveche| yakhana sei nirdiSTa samaYaTi haThAt tAdera kAche ese par3ave takhana tArA valaveH hAYa! pichane AmarA katai nA doSa kraTi karechi! tArA nijerAi nijedera vojhA piThe vahana karave| zune rekha! tArA yA kichu vahana kareche tA katai nA nikRSTatara vojhA!
ei pArthiva jIvana khela-tAmAzA o Amoda pramodera vyApAra chAr3A Ara kichui naYa, yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare, parakAlera jIvanai have tAdera janya utkRSTatara| tomarA ki cintA bhAvanA karavenA?

tAdera kathAvArtAYa tomAra ye duHkha o manaHkaSTa haYa tA Ami khuva bhAlabhAvei jAni, tArA zudhumAtra tomAkei mithyA pratipanna karachenA, varaM ei pApiSTha yAlimarA AllAhara AYAtasamUhakeo asvIkAra o amAnya karache|

tomAra pUrve vahu nAvI o rAsUlakeo mithyA pratipanna kareche, ataHpara tArA ei mithyA pratipannake evaM tAdera prati kRta niryAtana o utpIr3anake amlAna vadane sahya kareche, ye paryanta nA tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya ese pau~cheche| AllAhara Adezake parivartana karAra keha nei| tomAra kAche pUrvavartI kona kona nAvIra kichu kichu saMvAda o kAhinIto pau~che geche|

Ara yadi tAdera anAgraha o upekSA sahya karA tomAra kAche kaThina haYe par3e tAhale kSamatA thAkale mATira kona sur3aGga patha anusandhAna kara athavA AkAze si~r3i lAgiYe dAo; ataHpara tAdera kAche kona nidarzana niYe eso, AllAha icchA karale tAdera sakalake hidAYAtera upara samaveta karatena| sutarAM tumi avujhadera mata haYonA|
yArA zune tArAi satyera DAke sAr3A deYa| AllAha mRtaderake jIvita kare uThAvena, ataHpara tArA tA~rai kAche pratyAvartita have|
tArA valeH ravera pakSa hate tAra prati kona nidarzana kena avatIrNa karA halanA? tumi vale dAoH nidarzana avatIrNa karAYa AllAha niHsandehe pUrNa kSamatAvAna, kintu adhikAMza lokai tA jJAta naYa|

bhU-pRSThe calAcalakArI pratiTi jIva evaM vAYumanDale DAnAra sAhAyye ur3anta pratiTi pAkhIi tomAdera nyAYa eka ekaTi jAti, Ami kitAve kona viSaYai lipivaddha karate vAda rAkhini| ataHpara tAdera sakalake tAdera ravera kAche samaveta karA have|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA mane kare tArA andhakAre nimajjita mUka o vadhira, AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA hidAYAtera sarala sahaja pathera sandhAna dena|

tumi tAderake valaH tomarA yadi nijedera Adarze satyavAdI hao tAhale cintA kare dekha, yadi tomAdera prati AllAhara zAsti ese par3e athavA tomAdera nikaTa kiYAmAta divasa ese upasthita haYa takhanao ki tomarA AllAha vyatIta anya kehake DAkave?
varaM tA~kei tomarA DAkate thAkave| ataeva ye vipadera janya tomarA tA~ke DAkacho, icchA karale tini tA tomAdera theke dUra kare divena, Ara yAderake tomarA aMzI karechile tAdera kathA bhule yAve|
Ara avazyai Ami tomAra pUrve vibhinna kaomera kAche rAsUla preraNa karechi| ataHpara Ami tAderake dAridrya o duHkha dvArA pAkar3Ao karechi, yAte tArA anunaYa vinaYa kare|

sutarAM tAdera prati yakhana AmAra zAsti ese pau~chala takhana tArA kena namratA o vinaYa prakAza karalanA? varaM tAdera antara Arao kaThina haYe par3ala, Ara zAitAna tAdera kAjake tAdera cokhera sAmane suzobhita kare dekhAla|

ataHpara tAderake yA kichu upadeza o nAsIhAta karA haYechila tA yakhana tArA bhule gela takhana Ami sukha zAntira janya pratiTi vastura darajA unmukta kare dilAma| yakhana tArA tAderake dAnakRta vastu lAbha kare khuva Anandita o ullasita hala takhana haThAt ekadina Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma, Ara tArA sei avasthAYa nirAza haYe par3ala|
ataHpara atyAcArI sampradAYera mUla zikar3a keTe phelA hala, Ara samasta prazaMsA vizvera rAvva AllAharai janya|

tumi jijJesa karaH AllAha yadi tomAdera zravaNazakti o dRSTizakti ker3e nena evaM tomAdera manera kapATe tAlA lAgiYe mohara eTe dena tAhale ei zakti tomAderake AvAra dAna karate pAre emana kona sattA AllAha vyatIta Ache ki? lakSya karato! Ami AmAra nidarzanasamUha o dalIla pramANAdI kibhAve ghuriYe phiriYe varNanA karachi| era pareo tArA tA theke mukha phiriYe neYa!
tumi Arao jijJesa karaH AllAhara zAsti yadi haThAt kare athavA prakAzye tomAdera upara ese par3e tAhale ki atyAcArIrA chAr3A Ara keha dhvaMsa have?

Ami rAsUladerake zudhu e uddeze pAThiYe thAki ye, tArA (sat lokaderake) susaMvAda dive evaM (asat lokaderake) bhaYa dekhAve| sutarAM yArA ImAna eneche o caritra saMzodhana kareche tAdera janya kona bhaYa-bhIti thAkavenA evaM tArA cintitao havenA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAta o nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna karave tArA tAdera nijedera phAsekIra kAraNe zAsti bhoga karave|

tumi valaH Ami tomAderake e kathA valinA ye, AmAra kAche AllAhara dhana bhAnDAra raYeche, Ara Ami adRzya jagaterao kona jJAna rAkhinA, evaM Ami tomAderake e kathAo valinA ye, Ami ekajana mAlAka/pherezatA| AmAra kAche yA kichu ahI rUpe pAThAno haYa, Ami zudhumAtra tArai anusaraNa kare thAki| tumi (tAderake) jijJesa karaH andha o cakSusmAna ki samAna hate pAre? sutarAM tomarA kena cintA bhAvanA karanA?

tumi era (kuraAna) sAhAyye ai sava lokake bhIti pradarzana kara yArA bhaYa kare ye, tAderake tAdera ravera kAche emana avasthAYa samaveta karA have yekhAne tini chAr3A tAdera nA kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave, Ara nA thAkave kona supArizakArI, haYata tArA sAvadhAna have|

Ara ye sava loka sakAla sandhyAYa tAdera ravera ivAdAta kare evaM era mAdhyame tA~ra santuSTii kAmanA kare, tAderake tumi dUre sariYe divenA, tAdera hisAva-nikAzera kona kichura dAYitva tomAra upara naYa evaM tomAra hisAva-nikAzera kona kichura dAYitvao tAdera upara naYa| era parao yadi tumi tAderake dUre sariYe dAo tAhale tumi yAlimadera madhye zAmila haYe yAve|

ebhAvei Ami kichu lokake kichu loka dvArA parIkSAYa nipatita kari| tArA valate thAkeH erAi ki ai sava loka, AmAdera madhya theke yAdera prati AllAha anugraha o meheravANI karechena? AllAha ki kRtajJadera samparke avagata nana?

AmAra AYAtasamUhera upara vizvAsa sthApanakArIrA yakhana tomAra nikaTa Ase takhana tAderake valaH tomAdera prati zAnti varSita hoka, tomAdera rAvva nijera upara daYA o anugraha karAra nIti vAdhyatAmUlaka kare niYechena| tomAdera madhye ye vyakti ajJatA o mUrkhatAvazataH kona khArApa kAja kare, ataHpara se yadi tAovAha kare evaM nijeke saMzodhana kare tAhale jAnave ye, tini hacchena kSamAparAYaNa, karuNAmaYa|
emanibhAve Ami AmAra AYAta o nidarzanasamUha savistAra varNanA kare thAki yena, aparAdhI lokadera pathaTi suspaSTa haYe par3e|

tumi kAphiraderake vale dAoH tomarA AllAhake cher3e yAra ivAdAta kara, AmAke tAra ivAdAta karate niSedha karA haYeche| valaH Ami tomAdera kheYAla khuzira anusaraNa karavanA, tAhale Ami pathabhrAnta haYe yAva evaM Ami Ara patha prAptadera madhye zAmila thAkavanA|

tumi valaH Ami AmAra ravera pradatta ekaTi suspaSTa ujjvala yukti pramANera upara pratiSThita, athaca tomarA sei dalIlake mithyAropa karacho| ye viSaYaTi tomarA khuva tAr3AtAr3i pete cAo tAra ekhatiYAra AmAra hAte nei| hukumera mAlika AllAha chAr3A Ara keha naYa, tini satya o vAstavAnuga kathA varNanA karena, tinii hacchena sarvottama phAisAlAkArI|

tumi valaH tomarA ye vastuTi tAr3AtAr3i pete cAo tA yadi AmAra ekhatiYArabhukta thAkato tAhaleto AmAra o tomAdera madhye cUr3Anta phAisAlA aneka Agei haYe yeta, yAlimaderake AllAha khuva bhAla karei jAnena|

adRzya jagatera cAvikAThi tA~rai nikaTa raYeche; tini chAr3A Ara kehai tA jJAta naYa| pRthivIte o samudrera sava kichui tini avagata Achena, tA~ra avagati vyatIta vRkSa hate ekaTi pAtAo jhare par3enA evaM bhU-pRSThera andhakArera madhye ekaTi dAnAo patita haYanA, emanibhAve kona sarasa o nirasa vastuo patita haYanA; samasta kichui suspaSTa kitAve lipivaddha raYeche|

Ara sei mahAna sattA rAte nidrArUpe tomAdera eka prakAra mRtyu ghaTiYe thAkena, Ara dinera velA tomarA ye parizrama kara tini seTAo samyaka parijJAta; ataHpara tini nirdiSTa samaYakAla pUraNera nimitta tomAderake nidrA theke jAgiYe thAkena, parizeSe tA~ra kAchei tomAderake phire yete have, takhana tini tomAderake tomAdera kRtakarma samparke avahita karavena|

Ara AllAhai svIYa vAndAdera upara pratApazAlI, tini tomAdera upara rakSaNAvekSaNakArI niyukta kare pAThiYe thAkena, emanaki yakhana tomAdera kArao mRtyu samaYa samupasthita haYa takhana AmAra prerita dUtagaNa tAra prANa haraNa kare neYa, e vyApAre tArA vindumAtra kraTi karenA|

tArapara sakalake tAdera satyikAra abhibhAvaka AllAhara kAche pratyAvartita karAno haYa| tomarA jene rekha ye, ai dina ekamAtra AllAhai rAYa pradAnakArI havena, Ara tini khuvai tvarit hisAva grahaNakArI|

tumi tAderake jijJesa karaH sthalabhAga o pAnisthita andhakAra (vipada) theke tomAderake ke paritrANa diYe thAkena, yakhana kAtara kanThe vinItabhAve evaM cupe cupe tA~ra kAche prArthanA kare thAka, Ara valate thAkaH tini yadi AmAderake ei vipada theke mukti dena tAhale AmarA avazyai kRtajJadera antarbhukta hava|
tumi vale dAoH AllAhai tomAderake ai vipada evaM anyAnya pratiTi vipada Apada theke rakSA karena, kintu eraparao tomarA ziraka kara|

tumi vale dAoH AllAha tomAdera Urdhvaloka hate evaM tomAdera pAYera taladeza hate zAsti preraNa karate yatheSTa kSamatAvAna, athavA tomAderake dale dale vicchinna kare eka dalera dvArA apara dalera zaktira svAda grahaNa karAvena; lakSya kara! Ami vAra vAra vibhinna upAYe AmAra nidarzana o yukti pramANa varNanA karachi - uddezya hala, yena viSaYaTike tArA pUrNa rUpe jJAnAYatva o hRdaYaGgama kare nite pAre|
tomAra sampradAYera lokerA oke mithyA pratipanna karache, athaca oTA pramAnita satya| tumi vale dAoH Ami tomAdera ukila haYe Asini|
pratyekaTi saMvAda prakAzera ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa raYeche evaM acirei tomarA tA jAnate pArave|

yakhana tumi dekhave ye, lokerA AmAra AYAtasamUhe doSa-kraTi anusandhAna karache takhana tumi tAdera nikaTa hate dUre sare yAve, yatakSaNa nA tArA anya kona prasaGge nimagna haYa| zAitAna yadi tomAke eTA vismRta kare tAhale smaraNa haoYAra para Ara ai yAlima lokadera sAthe tumi vasavenA|

odera yakhana vicAra have takhana muttAkIdera upara era kona prabhAva paravenA, kintu oderake upadeza pradAnera janya tAdera upara dAYitva raYeche, haYato vA upadezera phale orA pApAcAra hate ve~ce thAkate pArave|

yArA nijedera dInake khela-tAmAzAra vastute pariNata kareche tumi tAderake varjana kare calave, pArthiva jIvana yAderake sammohita kare dho~kAYa nipatita kareche, kuraAna dvArA tAderake upadeza dite thAka, yAte kona vyakti svIYa kAja doSe dhvaMsa haYe nA yAYa| AllAha chAr3A tAra kona vandhu, sAhAyyakArI o supArizakArI thAkave nA, Ara yena ei avasthAra sammukhIna nA haYa ye, duniYAra samasta kichura vinimaYa diYeo mukti pete cAile sei vinimaYa grahaNa karA havenA| tArA emanai loka yArA nijedera karmadoSe ATakA par3e geche; tAdera kupharI karAra kAraNe tAdera janya phuTanta garama pAnIYa evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti raYeche|

tumi vale dAoH AmarA ki AllAha chAr3A emana kichura ivAdAta karava, yArA AmAdera kona upakAra karate pAravenA evaM AmAdera kona kSatio karate pAravenA? adhikantu AmAderake supatha pradarzanera para AmarA ki ulTA pathe phire yAva? AmarA ki ai vyaktira nyAYa hava yAke zAitAna marubhUmira madhye vibhrAnta kare pheleche evaM ye dizehArA-lakSyahArA haYe ghure marache? tAra sahacarerA tAke hidAYAtera dike Deke valache - tumi AmAdera saGge eso| tumi valaH AllAhara hidAYAtai hacche satyikArera saThika hidAYAta, Ara AmAke sArA jAhAnera ravera sAmane mAthA nata karAra nirdeza deYA haYeche|
Ara tumi niYamitabhAve sAlAta kAYema kara evaM sei rAvvake bhaYa kare cala yA~ra nikaTa tomAdera sakalake samaveta karA have|

sei sattA AkAzamanDala o bhU-manDalake yathAyathabhAve sRSTi karechena| yedina tini valavenaH ‘hAzara hao‘ sedina hAzara haYe yAve| tA~ra kathA khuvai yathArtha vAstavAnuga| yedina ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have sedina ekamAtra tA~rai have vAdazAhI o rAjatva| gopana o prakAzya sava kichu tA~ra jJAnAYatve| tini hacchena prajJAmaYa, sarvavidita|
smaraNa kara, yakhana ivarAhIma tAra pitA AyArake valalaH Apani mUrtiguloke mA‘vUda manonIta karechena? niHsandehe Ami ApanAke o ApanAra sampradAYake prakAzya bhrAntira madhye nipatita dekhachi|
emanibhAvei Ami ivarAhImake AsamAna o yamInera sRSTi avalokana kariYechi, yAte se vizvAsIdera antarbhukta haYe yAYa|

yakhana rAtera andhakAra tAke AvRta karala takhana se AkAzera ekaTi nakSatra dekhate pela, Ara valalaH eTAi AmAra rAvva! kintu yakhana oTA astamita hala takhana se valalaH Ami astamita vastuke bhAlavAsinA|

Ara yakhana se AkAze cA~dake ujjvala AbhAYa dekhate pela takhana valalaH eTAi AmAra rAvva! kintu oTAo yakhana astamita hala takhana valalaH AmAra rAvva yadi AmAke patha pradarzana nA karena tAhale Ami pathabhraSTa sampradAYera antarbhukta haYe yAva|

ataHpara yakhana se sUryake udbhAsita dekhate pela takhana se valalaH eTii AmAra rAvva! eTi vRhattara| ataHpara yakhana oTA Duve gela takhana valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera zirakera sAthe AmAra Adau kona samparka nei, Ami mukta|
AmAra mukhamanDalake Ami ekaniSThabhAve sei mahAna sattAra dike phirAcchi yini nabhomanDala o bhU-manDala sRSTi karechena, Ara Ami muzarikadera antarbhukta nai|

Ara tAra jAtira lokerA tAra sAthe jhagar3A karate thAkale se tAderake valalaH tomarA ki AllAhara vyApAre AmAra sAthe jhagar3A karacho? athaca tini AmAke saThika pathera sandhAna diYechena! tomarA AllAhara sAthe yA kichu zarIka karacho Ami odera bhaYa karinA, tave yadi AmAra rAvva kichu cAna| pratiTi vastu samparke AmAra ravera jJAna khuvai vyApaka, era pareo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karavenA?

tomAdera managar3A o vAnAno zarIkaderake Ami kirUpe bhaYa karate pAri? athaca tomarA ei bhaYa karachanA ye, AllAhara sAthe yAderake tomarA zarIka karacha tAdera vyApAre AllAha tomAdera kAche kona dalIla pramANa avatIrNa karenani, AmAdera dui dalera madhye kArA adhikatara zAnti o nirApattA lAbhera adhikArI yadi tomAdera jAnA thAke tAhale valata?
prakRta pakSe tArAi zAnti o nirApattAra adhikArI evaM tArAi saThika pathe paricAlita, yArA nijedera ImAnake yulamera sAthe (zir‌kera sAthe) mizrita kareni|

Ara eTAi chila AmAra yukti pramANa, yA Ami ivarAhImake tAra svajAtira mukAvilAYa dAna karechilAma| Ami yAke icchA kari, sammAna-martavA o mahattva vAr3iYe dei, niHsandehe tomAra rAvva prajJAmaYa o vijJa|

Ami tAke isahAka o iYAkUvake dAna karechi evaM ubhaYakei saThika pathera sandhAna diYechi, Ara tAra pUrve nUhakeo saThika pathera hidAYAta diYechi; Ara tAra (ivarAhImera) vaMzera madhye dAUda, sulAimAna, Aiuva, iusupha, mUsA o hArUnake emanibhAvei saThika pathera sandhAna diYechi| emanibhAvei Ami sat o puNyazIla lokaderake pratidAna diYe thAki|
Ara yAkAriYA, iYAhaiYA, IsA o iliYAsa - tArA pratyekei sat lokadera antarbhukta chila|
Ara isamAIla, iYAsA, iunusa o lUta - edera pratyekakei Ami navuoYAta dAna kare samagra vizvera upara mahattva o zreSThatva dAna karechi|
Ara edera vApa-dAdA, santAna, santati o bhAidera madhye anekake Ami manonIta kare saThika o sojA pathe paricAlita karechi|
eTAi AllAhara hidAYAta; tini tA~ra vAndAra madhye yAke cAna ei pathe paricAlita karena| kintu tArA yadi zir‌ka karata tAhale tArA yA kichui karata, savai vyartha haYe yeta|

erA chila sei loka, yAderake Ami kitAva, zAsanabhAra o navuoYAta dAna karechi| sutarAM yadi erA tomAra navuoYAtake asvIkAra kare tAhale tAdera sthale Ami emana eka jAtike niYoga karava, yArA oTA asvIkAra karenA|

erA hacche orAi, yAderake AllAha supatha pradarzana karechilena| sutarAM tumi tAdera patha anusaraNa kare cala| tumi vale dAoH Ami kuraAna o dInera tAvalIgera vinimaYe tomAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAinA| ei kuraAna samagra jagatavAsIra janya upadezera bhAnDAra chAr3A kichui naYa|

ei lokerA AllAhara yathAyatha maryAdA upalavdhi kareni| kenanA tArA valalaH AllAha kona mAnuSera upara kona kichu avatIrNa karenani; tumi tAderake jijJesa karaH mAnuSera hidAYAta o AlokavartikA rUpe ye kitAva mUsA enechila tA ke avatIrNa karechena? tomarA sei kitAva khanDa khanDa kare vibhinna patre rekhecha, ora kiYadaMza tomarA prakAza karacha evaM vahulAMza gopana karacha| (ai kitAva dvArA) tomAderake vahu viSaYe avahita karA haYeche, yA tomarA o tomAdera pUrva-puruSarA jAnatenA; tumi vale dAoH tA AllAhai avatIrNa karechena| sutarAM tumi tAderake tAdera vAtila dhAraNAra upara cher3e dAo, tArA khelA karate thAkuka|

Ara ei kitAvao (kuraAna) Amii avatIrNa karechi; yA khuvai vArAkAtamaYa kitAva evaM pUrvera sakala kitAvake satyAYita kare thAke, yena tumi kendrIYa mAkkA nagarI evaM ora catuspArzvastha janapadera lokaderake ora dvArA bhIti pradarzana kara| yArA parakAle vizvAsa rAkhe tArA ei kitAvakeo vizvAsa karave evaM ora prati ImAna Anave, Ara tArA niYamitabhAve sAlAtao AdAYa kare thAke|

Ara ai vyakti apekSA adhika atyAcArI ke hate pAre ye AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kareche? athavA erUpa valeH AmAra upara ahI nAyila karA haYeche, athaca tAra upara prakRta pakSe kona ahI nAyila karA haYani evaM ye vyakti eo valeH yerUpa kAlAma AllAha nAyila karechena, tadrupa Amio AnaYana karachi| Ara tumi yadi dekhate pete (ai samaYera avasthA) ye samaYa yAlimarA have mRtyu saMkaTe (pariveSTita); Ara mAlAikA/pherezatArA hAta vAr3iYe valaveH nijedera prANaguli vera kara, Aja tomAderake sei sava aparAdhera zAsti hisAve lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti deYA have yA tomarA AllAhara upara mithyA doSAropa kare akAraNa pralApa vakechile evaM tA~ra AYAtasamUha kavUla karA hate ahaMkAra karechile|

Ara tomarA AmAra kAche niHsaGga esecha, yebhAve prathamavAra Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechilAma, Ara yA kichu Ami tomAderake diYechilAma tA tomarA nijedera pazcAtei cher3e esecha, Ara Amito tomAdera sAthe tomAdera sei supArizakArIderake dekhachinA yAdera samvandhe tomarA dAvI karate ye, tArA tomAdera kAjakarme (AmAra) zarIka; vAstavikai tomAdera parasparera samparkato vicchinna haYe geche, Ara tomarA yA kichu dhAraNA karate tA savai Aja tomAdera nikaTa theke udhAo haYe geche|
nizcaYai dAnA o vIja dAnakArI hacchena AllAha| tinii jIvantake prANahIna theke vera karena evaM tinii prANahInake jIvanta hate nigartakArI; tiniito AllAha, tAhale tomarA kothAYa yAccho?

tinii rAtera AvaraNa vidIrNa kare raGgina prabhAtera unmeSakArI, tinii rAtake vizrAmakAla evaM sUrya o cA~dake samaYera nirUpaka kare diYechena; eTA hacche sei parama parAkrAnta o sarva parijJAtAra (AllAhara) nirdhAraNa|

Ara tinii tomAdera janya nakSatrarAjike sRSTi karechena, yena tomarA ogulira sAhAyye andhakAre pathera sandhAna pete pAra sthala bhAge evaM samudre| nizcaYai Ami pramANasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA kare diYechi ai samasta lokera janya yArA jJAna rAkhe|

tinii tomAderake eka vyakti hate sRSTi karechena, ataHpara (pratyekera janya) ekaTi sthAna adhika dina thAkAra janya evaM ekaTi sthAna alpa dina thAkAra janya raYeche, ei nidarzanasamUha Ami tAdera janya suspaSTabhAve varNanA karalAma yAdera vuddhi vivecanA Ache|

Ara tini AkAza hate pAni varSaNa karena, ora sAhAyye sava rakamera udbhida Ami (AllAha) utpanna kari; ataHpara tA theke savuja zAkhA vera kari, phalataH tA theke Ami uparyupari utthita vIja utpanna kari| evaM khejura vRkSa theke arthAt ora puspakaNikA theke char3A haYa yA nimna dike jhu~ke par3e, Ara AGgurasamUhera udyAna evaM yAitUna o AnAra yA paraspara sAdRzyayukta| pratyeka phalera prati lakSya kara yakhana oTA phale evaM ora paripakka haoYAra prati lakSya kara| ei samudaYera madhye nidarzanasamUha raYeche tAderai janya yArA ImAna rAkhe|

Ara ei (ajJa) lokerA jinaderake AllAhara zarIka vAniYe niYeche, athaca AllAhai aigulike sRSTi karechena, Ara nA jene nA vujhe tArA tA~ra janya putra kanyA racanA kare; tini mahimAnvita (pavitra), edera Aropita vizeSaNaguli hate vahu urdhve tini|
tini AsamAna o yamInera sraSTA; tA~ra santAna have ki kare? athaca tA~ra jIvana saGginIi keha nei| tinii pratyekaTi jinisa sRSTi karechena, pratyekaTi jinisa samparke tA~ra bhAla rupe jJAna raYeche|
tini AllAha, tomAdera paraoYAradigAra| tini chAr3A anya kehai mA‘vUda nei, pratyeka vasturai sraSTA tini, ataeva tomarA tA~rai ivAdAta kara, tinii sava jinisera upara dAYitvazIla|
kona mAnava-dRSTi tA~ke dekhate pArenA, athaca tini sakala kichui dekhate pAna evaM tini atIva sUkSmadarzI evaM sarva viSaYe oYAkiphahAla|

ekhana nizcaYai tomAdera kAche tomAdera ravera pakSa hate satya darzanera upAYasamUha pau~cheche, ataeva ye vyakti nijera gabhIra dRSTite avalokana karave se nijerai kalyANa sAdhana karave, Ara ye andha thAkave se nijei kSatigrasta have, Ara Amito tomAdera praharI nai|
e rUpei Ami nidarzanasamUha prakAza kari, yena lokerA nA vale - tumi kArao nikaTa theke pATha kare niYecha, Ara yena Ami eke vuddhimAna lokadera janya prakAza kare dii|
tomAra prati tomAra ravera pakSa theke ye ahI nAyila haYeche, tumi tArai anusaraNa kare cala, tini chAr3A anya kehai mA‘vUda nei, Ara aMzIvAdIdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo|
Ara AllAhara yadi abhiprAYa hata tAhale erA zir‌ka karatanA; Ara Ami tomAke edera rakSaka niyukta karini evaM tumi tAdera upara kSamatAprApta nao|

erA AllAhake vAda diYe yAdera ivAdAta (pUjA-arcanA) kare tomarA tAderake gAlAgAli karanA, tAhale tArA ajJatA vazataH vairIbhAve AllAhakei gAlAgAli dite zuru karave| Amito e rUpei pratiTi janagoSThIra janya tAdera ‘Amalake cAkacikyamaYa kare diYechi| zeSa paryanta tAderake tAdera ravera kAche phire yete have, takhana tArA ki ki kAja karechila tA tini tAderake jAniYe divena|

Ara kaThina aGgIkAra sahakAre AllAhara nAme kasama kare tArA valeH kona nidarzana (mu’jiyA) tAdera kAche ele tArA ImAna Anave; tumi vale dAoH nidarzanaguli samastai AllAhara adhikAre, Ara (he musalimarA!) ki kare tomAderake vujhAno yAve ye, nidarzana eleo tArA ImAna AnavenA!
Ara yehetu tArA prathamavAra ImAna Aneni, era phale tAdera manobhAvera o dRSTibhaGgira parivartana kare diva evaM tAderake tAdera avAdhyatAra madhyei vibhrAntera nyAYa ghure ver3Ate cher3e diva|

Ami yadi tAdera kAche mAlAka avatIrNa karatAma, Ara mRtarAo yadi tAdera sAthe kathA valata evaM duniYAra samastai yadi Ami tAdera cokhera sAmane samaveta karatAma, tavuo tArA ImAna AnatanA AllAhara icchA vyatIta| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mUrkha|

Ara emanibhAvei Ami pratyeka nAvIra janya vahu zAitAnake zatrurUpe sRSTi karechi; tAdera kataka mAnuSa zAitAnera madhya hate evaM kataka jina zAitAnera madhya hate haYe thAke, erA eke anyake katakaguli manomugdhakara dhokApUrNa o pratAraNAmaYa kathA dvArA prarocita kare thAke| tomAra ravera icchA hale, tArA emana kAja karate pAratanA| sutarAM tumi tAderake evaM tAdera mithyA racanAgulike varjana kare calave|
yArA parakAlera prati ImAna rAkhenA tAdera antarake ai dike anurakta hate dAo; evaM tArA yena tAte santuSTa thAke, Ara tArA yesava kAja kare tA yena tArA Arao karate thAke|

(tumi tAderake jijJesa kara) tAhale ki Ami AllAhake varjana kare anya kehake mImAMsAkArI o vicAraka rUpe anusandhAna karava? athaca tinii tomAdera kAche ei kitAvake vistAritabhAve avatIrNa karechena! Ami yAderake kitAva dAna karechi tArA jAne ye, ei kitAva tomAra ravera pakSa hatei yathArtha o saThikabhAve avatIrNa karA haYeche, sutarAM tumi sandeha poSaNakArIdera madhye zAmila haYonA|
tomAra ravera vANI satyatA o inasAphera dika diYe paripUrNa, tA~ra vANI parivartanakArI kehai nei, tini savakichu zonena o savakichu jAnena|
tumi yadi duniYAvAsI adhikAMza lokera kathAmata cala tAhale tArA tomAke AllAhara patha hate vicyUta kare phelave, tArAto zudhu anumAnera anusaraNa kare, Ara tArA zudhu anumAnabhittika kathA vale|
kon vyakti AllAhara patha hate vibhrAnta haYeche tA tomAra rAvva nizcitabhAve avagata Achena, Ara tini tA~ra pathera pathikagaNa samparkeo khuva bhAlabhAve jJAta raYechena|
ataeva ye jIvake AllAhara nAma niYe yavAha karA haYeche tA tomarA AhAra kara, yadi tomarA AllAhara vidhAnera prati ImAna rAkha|

ye jantura upara yavAha karAra samaYa AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karA haYeche, tA AhAra nA karAra tomAdera kAche ki kAraNa thAkate pAre? athaca AllAha tomAdera upara yA kichu hArAma karechena tA tini savistAre varNanA karechena, tave nirUpAYa avasthAYa tomarA ukta hArAma vastuo AhAra karate pAra, niHsandehe kona dInI jJAna nA thAkA sattveo nijedera icchA, vAsanA o bhrAnta dhAraNAra bhittite aneke vahu lokake pathabhraSTa kareche, nizcaYai tomAra rAvva sImA laMghanakArIdera samparke bhAlabhAvei oYAkiphahAla|
tomarA prakAzya pApa kAja parityAga kara evaM parityAga kara gopanIYa pApa kAjao| yArA pApa kAja kare tAderake ati sattvarai tAdera manda kAjera pratiphala deYA have|

Ara ye jantu yavAha karAra samaYa AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karA haYanA tA tomarA AhAra karanA| kenanA eTA garhita vastu, zAitAnarA nijedera saGgI sAthIdera mane nAnA prakAra sandeha o prazna sRSTi kare, yena tArA tomAdera sAthe jhagar3A o vitarka karate pAre| yadi tomarA tAdera ‘AkIdAh vizvAsa o kAja karme Anugatya kara tAhale niHsandehe tomarA muzarika haYe yAve|

emana vyakti-ye chila prANahIna, ataHpara tAke Ami jIvana dAna kari evaM tAra janya Ami emana Alokera vyavasthA kare dii, yAra sAhAyye se janagaNera madhye calAphirA karate thAke, se ki emana kona lokera mata hate pAre ye Duve Ache andhakAre evaM tA hate vera haoYAra patha pAcchenA? e rUpei kAphiradera janya tAdera kAryakalApa manomugdhakara kare deYA haYeche|
Ara emanibhAvei Ami pratyeka janapade aparAdhIdera janya kichu sardAra niYoga karechi yena tArA sekhAne cakrAnta kare| tAdera se cakrAnta nijedera viruddhei| kintu tArA tA upalavdhi karate pArenA|

tAdera sAmane yakhana kona nidarzana Ase takhana tArA valeH AllAhara rAsUladerake yA kichu deYA haYechila, AmAdera anurUpa jinisa nA deYA paryanta AmarA ImAna AnavanA| risAlAtera dAYitva kAra upara arpaNa karate have tA AllAha bhAlabhAvei jAnena| ei aparAdhI lokerA ati sattvarai tAdera Sar3ayantra o pratAraNAra janya AllAhara nikaTa lAJchanA o kaThina zAsti prApta have|

ataeva AllAha yAke hidAYAta karate cAna, isalAmera janya tAra antaHkaraNa unmukta kare dena, Ara yAke pathabhraSTa karAra icchA karena, tini tAra antaHkaraNa saMkucita kare dena - khuvai saMkucita kare dena, emanabhAve saMkucita karena yena mane haYa se AkAze ArohaNa karache| emanibhAvei yArA ImAna AnenA tAderake AllAha kaluSamaYa kare thAkena|
Ara eTAi hacche tomAra ravera sahaja sarala patha, Ami upadeza grahaNakArI lokadera janya AYAtasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA kare diYechi|
tAdera janya tAdera ravera nikaTa raYeche eka zAntira AvAsa tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe, tinii hacchena tAdera abhibhAvaka|

Ara yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake ekatrita karavena, sedina tini valavenaH he jina sampradAYa! tomarA mAnuSera madhye anekake vibhrAnta kare anugAmI karecha, Ara odera madhye yAdera mAnuSera sAthe vandhuRtvera samparka chila tArA svIkAroktite valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA eke aparera dvArA upakRta haYechi| hAYa! Apani AmAdera janya ye nirdiSTa samaYa nirdhAraNa karechena tA ese geche! takhana (kiYAmAta divase) AllAha (samasta kAphira jina o mAnuSake) valavenaH jAhAnnAmai hacche tomAdera vAsasthAna, tAte tomarA cirasthAYIbhAve thAkave, tave AllAha yAderake cAivena (tArAi tA theke mukti pete pAre) tomAdera rAvva atizaYa sammAnita evaM atyanta jJAnavAna|
emanibhAvei Ami yAlimaderake (kAphiraderake) tAdera kRtakarmera phale parasparake parasparera upara prabhAvazAlI o kartRtvazAlI vAniYe diva|

(kiYAmAta divase AllAha jijJesa karavena) he jina o mAnava jAti! tomAdera kAche ki tomAdera madhya hatei nAvI rAsUla Aseni yArA tomAdera kAche AmAra AYAtasamUha varNanA karata evaM Ajakera e dinera vyApAre tomAdera sAkSAta haoYAra bhIti pradarzana kareni? tArA javAva diveH hyA~, AmarAi AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya dicchi (arthAt AmarA aparAdha karechi), pArthiva jIvanai tAderake dho~kAYa nipatita karechila| Ara tArAi nijedera viruddhe sAkSya dive ye, tArA kAphira chila|
ei rAsUla preraNa e janya ye, tomAra rAvva kona janapadake uhAra adhivAsIrA satya samparke ajJAta thAkA avasthAYa anyAYabhAve dhvaMsa karena nA|
Ara pratyeka lokai nija nija ‘Amalera kAraNe maryAdA lAbha karave, tArA ki ‘Amala karata se viSaYe tomAra rAvva udAsIna nana|
