tomAra rAvva amukhApekSI o daYAzIla, tA~ra icchA hale tomAderake apasArita karavena evaM tomAdera pare tomAdera sthAne yAke icchA sthalAbhiSikta karavena, yemana tini tomAderake anya eka jAtira vaMzadhara hate sRSTi karechena|
tomAdera nikaTa ye viSaYa samparke pratizruti deYA haYeche tA avazyambhAvI, tomarA AllAhake akSama o durvala karate pAravenA|

tumi vale dAoH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA nija nija avasthAYa ‘Amala karate thAka, Amio ‘Amala karachi, ataHpara zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave ye, kAra pariNAma kalyANakara| niHsandehe atyAcArIrA kakhanao mukti o sAphalya lAbha karate pAravenA|

Ara AllAha ye sava zasya o pazu sRSTi karechena, tArA (muzarikarA) ora ekaTi aMza AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa kare thAke| ataHpara nijedera dhAraNA mate tArA vale ye, ei aMza AllAhara janya evaM ei aMza AmAdera zarIkadera janya| kintu yA tAdera zarIkadera janya nirdhArita haYe thAke, tAto AllAhara dike pau~chenA, pakSAntare yA AllAhara janya nirdhAraNa karA haYechila tA tAdera zarIkadera kAche pau~che thAke| ei lokadera phAisAlA o vanTana nIti katai nA nikRSTa!

Ara emanibhAve aneka muzarikera dRSTite tAdera upAsyarA tAdera santAna hatyA karAke zobhaNIYa kare diYeche, yena tArA tAdera sarvanAza karate pAre evaM tAdera kAche tAdera dharmake vibhrAnta kare dite pAre| AllAha cAile tArA esava kAja karate pAratanA| sutarAM tumi tAderake evaM tAdera bhrAnta uktigulike cher3e dAo|

Ara tArA vale thAkeH ei sava nirdiSTa pazu o kSetera phasala surakSita, kehai tA AhAra karate pAravenA, tave yAderake AmarA anumati diva (tArAi AhAra karate pArave), Ara (tArA vale) ei vizeSa pazugulira upara ArohaNa karA o bhAra vahana niSedha kare deYA haYeche| Ara katakaguli vizeSa pazu raYeche yegulike yavAha karAra samaYa tArA AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karenA, zudhu AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa karAra uddeze| AllAha esava mithyA Aropera pratiphala ati sattvarai dAna karavena|

Ara tArA e kathAo vale thAke ye, ei sava vizeSa pazugulira garbhe yA kichu raYeche tA vizeSabhAve tAdera puruSadera janya rakSita, Ara tAdera nArIdera janya oTA hArAma; kintu garbha hate prasUta vAccA yadi mRta haYa tAhale nArI-puruSa savAi tA bhakSaNe aMzI hate pArave| tAdera kRta ei sava varNanAra pratidAna ati sattvarai AllAha tAderake divena, niHsandehe tini hacchena prajJAmaYa, sarvavidita|

yArA nijedera santAnaderake mUrkhatA o ajJAnatAra kAraNe hatyA kareche Ara AllAha samparke mithyA racanA kare tA~ra pradatta riykake hArAma kare niYeche, tArA nizcita rUpe pathabhraSTa haYeche; vastutaH tArA hidAYAta grahaNa karAra pAtrao chilanA|

Ara sei AllAhai nAnA prakAra vAgAna o gulmalatA sRSTi karechena yAra kataka svIYa kAnDera upara sanniviSTa haYa, Ara kataka kAnDera upara sanniviSTa haYanA; Ara khejura vRkSa o zasyakSetra yAte vibhinna prakArera khAdya utpanna haYe thAke, Ara tini yAitUna (jalapAi) o AnArera (DAlimera) vRkSao sRSTi karechena yA dRzyataH abhinna haleo svAde vibhinna, ei sava phala tomarA AhAra kara yakhana ote phala dhare, Ara tA hate zArIYAtera nirdhArita ye aMza raYeche tA phasala kATAra dina AdAYa kare nAo, apavyaYa kare sImA laMghana karanA| nizcaYai tini (AllAha) apavyaYakArI o sImAlaMghanakArIke bhAlavAsena nA|

Ara catuspada jantugulira madhye katakaguli (u~cu AkRtira) bhAravAhI raYeche; Ara katakaguli raYeche choTa AkRtira, gozata khAoYAra o cAmar3A dvArA vichAnA vAnAnora yogya| AllAha yA kichu dAna karechena tomarA tA AhAra kara, Ara zAitAnera padAGka anusaraNa karanA, niHsandehe se tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

ei pazuguli ATa prakAra raYeche, bher3Ara eka jor3A strI-puruSa evaM vakarIra eka jor3A strI-puruSa| tumi jijJesa karaH AllAha ki ubhaYa puruSa pazugulike hArAma karechena, nAki ubhaYa strI pazugulike, athavA strI du‘Tira garbhe yA Ache tA hArAma karechena? tomarA jJAnera sAthe AmAke uttara dAo yadi tomarA satyavAdI haYe thAka|

Ara uTera strI-puruSa du‘Ti evaM garura strI-puruSa du‘Ti pazu, tumi tAderake jijJesa karaH AllAha ki e du‘Ti puruSa pazuke vA e du‘Ti strI pazuke hArAma karechena, athavA ubhaYa strI garu o uTera garbhe yA raYeche tA hArAma karechena? AllAha yakhana esava pazu hAlAla-hArAma haoYAra vidhAna jAri karena takhana ki tomarA hAyira chile? ye vyakti vinA pramANe nA jene (ajJatAvazataH) mAnuSake vibhrAnta karAra uddeze AllAhara nAme erUpa mithyA Aropa kare tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre? AllAha yAlimaderake supatha pradarzana karenanA|

tumi valaH ahIra mAdhyame AmAra kAche ye vidhAna pAThAno haYeche tAte kona AhArakArIra janya kona vastu hArAma karA haYeche emana kichu Ami pAini; tave mRta jantu, pravAhita rakta, zukarera mAMsa evaM yA AllAhara nAme yavAha karA haYani tA hArAma karA haYeche| kenanA oTA nApAka o zArIYAta vigarhita vastu| kintu yadi kona loka svAda AsvAdana o sImA laMghanera uddezya vyatIta nirUpAYa haYe par3e (tAra pakSe oTAo khAoYA vaidha)| kenanA AllAha kSamAzIla o anugrahazIla|

iYAhudIdera prati Ami sarva prakAra avibhakta nakha viziSTa jIva hArAma karechilAma| Ara garu o bher3A hate utpanna ubhaYera carvi tAdera janya Ami hArAma karechilAma, kintu pRSThadezera carvi, nAr3i bhur3ira carvi o hAr3era sAthe mizrita carvi ei hArAmera antarbhukta chilanA| tAdera vidrohamUlaka AcaraNera janya Ami tAderake ei zAsti diYechilAma, Ara Ami niHsandehe satyavAdI|
sutarAM e sava viSaYe yadi tArA tomAke mithyAvAdI mane kare tAhale tumi vale dAoH tomAdera rAvva khuvai karuNAmaYa, Ara aparAdhI sampradAYa hate tA~ra zAstira vidhAna kakhanai pratyAhAra karA havenA|

muzarikarA (tomAra kathAra uttare) avazyai valaveH AllAha yadi cAitena tAhale AmarA zir‌ka karatAmanA, Ara nA AmAdera vApa-dAdArA karata, Ara kono jinisao AmarA hArAma karatAmanA| vastutaH ebhAvei tAdera pUrva yugera kAphirerA(rAsUladerake) mithyA pratipanna karechila| zeSa paryanta tArA AmAra zAstira svAda grahaNa karate vAdhya haYechila| tumi jijJesa karaH tomAdera kAche ki kona dalIla pramANa Ache? thAkale AmAra sAmane peza kara| tomarA dhAraNA o anumAna vyatIta Ara kichurai anusaraNa karanA, tomarA sampUrNa AnumAnika kathA chAr3A Ara kichui valachanA|
tumi vale dAoH satya bhittika pUrNAGga dalIla pramANato ekamAtra AllAharai raYeche, tini cAile tomAdera savAike hidAYAta dAna karatena|

tumi Arao valaH AllAha esava pazu hArAma karechena, era sAkSya yArA dive sei sAkSIderake tomarA niYe eso| tArA yadi sAkSya deYa tAhale tumi tAdera sAthe sAkSya divenA, tumi emana lokadera kheYAla khuzira (vAtila dhyAna dhAraNAra) anusaraNa karanA yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare, parakAlera prati ImAna AnenA evaM tArA anyAnyaderake nijedera ravera samamaryAdA dAna kare|

lokaderake valaH tomarA eso! tomAdera rAvva tomAdera prati ki ki vidhi-niSedha Aropa karechena tA Ami tomAderake pATha kare zonAi; tA ei ye, tomarA tA~ra sAthe kehakei zarIka karavenA, mAtA-pitAra sAthe sadvyavahAra karave, dAridratAra bhaYe nijedera santAnaderake hatyA karavenA| kenanA Amii tomAderake o tAderake jIvikA dii; Ara azlIla kAja o kathAra nikaTeo yeonA, tA prakAzyai hoka kiMvA gopanIYai hoka, Ara AllAha yAra hatyA niSiddha karechena - yathArtha kAraNa chAr3A tAke hatyA karanA| esava viSaYa AllAha tomAderake nirdeza diYechena, yena tomarA anudhAvana karate pAra|

Ara iYAtImarA vaYaHprApta nA haoYA paryanta saduddezya vyatIta tAdera viSaYa sampattira kAcheo yeonA, Ara AdAna-pradAna, parimAna-ojana saThikabhAve karave, Ami kArao upara tAra sAdhyAtIta bhAra (dAYitva/kartavya) arpana karinA, Ara tomarA yakhana kathA valave takhana svajanera viruddhe haleo nyAYAnuga kathA valave, Ara AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra pUraNa karave| AllAha tomAderake esava viSaYa nirdeza diYechena, yena tomarA tA~ra e nirdeza o upadeza grahaNa kara|

Ara nizcaYai ei pathai AmAra sarala patha; ei pathai tomarA anusaraNa kare calave, ei patha chAr3A anya kona pathera anusaraNa karavenA, tAhale tomAderake tA~ra patha theke vicchinna kare dUre sariYe nive| AllAha tomAderake ei nirdeza dicchena, yena tomarA satarka hao|

ataHpara mUsAke Ami emana kitAva pradAna karechilAma, yA chila sat karmaparAYaNadera janya pUrNAGga kitAva| Ara tAte chila pratyekaTi vastura vizada vivaraNa, patha nirdeza samvalita AllAhara rAhamAtera pratIka svarUpa, yAte tArA tAdera ravera sAthe sAkSAt haoYA samvandhe pUrNa vizvAsa lAbha karate pAre|
Ara Ami ei kitAva avatIrNa karechi yA vArAkAtamaYa o kalyANamaYa| sutarAM tomarA era anusaraNa kara evaM era virodhitA hate ve~ce thAka, haYata tomAdera prati daYA o anugraha pradarzana karA have|
yena tomarA nA valate pAra: ai kitAvato AmAdera pUrvavartI dui sampradAYera prati avatIrNa karA haYechila evaM AmarA tAdera paThana pAThane sampUrNa ajJa chilAma|

athavA tomarA yena e kathAo valate nA pAra, AmAdera prati kitAva nAyila karA hale AmarA tAdera tulanAYa vezi hidAYAta lAbha karatAma| ekhana tomAdera kAche tomAdera ravera pakSa theke eka suspaSTa dalIla evaM patha nirdeza o rAhamAta samAgata haYeche| erapara AllAhara AYAtake ye mithyA pratipanna karave evaM tA theke er3iYe calave tAra ceYe var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre? yArA AmAra AYAtasamUha er3iYe cale, ati sattvara tAderake Ami kaThina zAsti diva, jaghaNya zAsti-tAdera er3iYe calAra janya!

tArA ki zudhu e pratIkSAYa raYeche ye, tAdera kAche mAlAikA/pherezatA Asave? kiMvA svaYaM tomAra rAvva Asavena? athavA tomAra ravera kona kona nidarzana prakAza haYe par3ave? yedina tomAra ravera kataka nidarzana prakAza haYe par3ave sei dinera pUrve yArA ImAna Aneni athavA yArA nijedera ImAna dvArA kona neka kAja kareni takhana tAdera ImAna AnaYane kona upakAra havenA, tumi esava pApiSThake jAniYe dAoH tomarA (erUpa AzA niYe) pratIkSA karate thAka, Amio pratIkSA karachi|

nizcaYai yArA nijedera dInera madhye nAnA matavAda sRSTi kare oke khanDa vikhanDa kareche evaM vibhinna dale upadale vibhakta haYe par3eche, tAdera sAthe kona vyApAre tomAra kona dAYitva nei, tAdera viSaYaTi nizcaYai AllAhara nikaTa samarpita, parizeSe tinii tAderake tAdera kAryakalApa samparke avahita karavena|
keha kona bhAla kAja karale se tAra daza guNa pratidAna pAve, Ara keha pApa o asat kAja karale tAke zudhu tataTukui pratiphala deYA have yataTuku se kareche, Ara tArA atyAcArita havenA|

tumi valaH niHsandehe AmAra rAvva AmAke saThika o nirbhula pathe paricAlita karechena| oTAi supratiSThita dIna evaM ivarAhImera avalamvita Adarza yA se aikAntika niSThAra sAthe grahaNa karechila| Ara se muzarikadera antarbhukta chilanA|
tumi vale dAoH AmAra sAlAta, AmAra kuravAnI, AmAra jIvana o AmAra maraNa sava kichu sArA jAhAnera rAvva AllAhara janya|
tA~ra kona zarIka nei, Ami era janya AdiSTa haYechi, Ara musalimadera madhye Amii halAma prathama|

tumi jijJesa karaH Ami ki AllAhake vAda diYe anya ravera sandhAna karava? athaca tinii hacchena pratiTi vastura rAvva! pratyeka vyaktii svIYa kRtakarmera janya dAYI have, keha kArao kona vojhA vahana karavenA, parizeSe tomAdera ravera nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana karate have, ataHpara tini tomarA ye viSaYe matavirodha karechile se viSaYera mUla tattva tomAderake avahita karavena|

Ara tini emana, yini tomAderake duniYAra pratinidhi karechena evaM tomAdera katakake katakera upara maryAdAYa unnIta karechena, uddezya hala tomAderake tini yA kichu diYechena tAte tomAderake parIkSA karA| niHsandehe tomAra rAvva tvarita zAstidAtA, Ara niHsandehe tini kSamAzIla o kRpAnidhAna|
Alipha lAma-mima-sAda|
e ekaTi kitAva yA tomAra upara avatIrNa karA haYeche, sutarAM tomAra antare yena moTei saMkIrNatA nA Ase| Ara mu’minadera janya eTA upadeza|

tomAra ravera pakSa theke yA tomAra prati nAyila karA haYeche tumi tA anusaraNa kara evaM AllAhake vAda diYe anyaderake abhibhAvaka athavA sAhAyyakArI hisAve grahaNa karanA| tomarA khuva alpai upadeza grahaNa kare thAko|
kata janapadakei nA Ami dhvaMsa karechi! AmAra zAsti tAdera upara rAte ghumanta avasthAYa athavA dviprahare yakhana tArA vizrAmarata chila takhanai Apatita haYeche|
AmAra zAsti yakhana tAdera kAche ese par3echila takhana tAdera mukhe ‘‘vAstavikai AmarA atyAcArI chilAma’’ e kathA chAr3A Ara kichui chilanA|
ataHpara Ami (kiYAmAta divase) yAdera kAche rAsUla preraNa karA haYechila tAderake evaM rAsUladerakeo avazyai jijJAsAvAda karava|
takhana Ami tAdera samasta vivaraNa akapaTe prakAza kare diva, yehetu Ami pUrNarUpe jJAta Achi, Ara Amito kona kAle vekhavara chilAmanA|
Ara sedina (kiYAmAtera dina) nyAYa o saThikabhAve (pratyekera ‘Amala) oyana karA have, sutarAM yAdera (puNyera) pAllA bhArI have tArAi have kRtakArya o saphalakAma|
Ara yAdera pAllA hAlakA have, tArA have sei sava loka yArA nijedera dhvaMsa o kSati nijerAi kareche| kenanA tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake (AYAta) pratyAkhyAna karata|
Ara nizcaYai Ami tomAderake bhU-pRSThe pratiSThita karechi evaM Ami tomAdera janya ote jIvikA nirvAhera upakaraNasamUha sRSTi karechi, tomarA khuva kamai kRtajJatA prakAza kare thAka|

Amii tomAderake sRSTi karechi, ataHpara tomAderake rUpa dAna karechi, tArapara Ami mAlAikAderake/pherezatAderake nirdeza diYechi - tomarA Adamake sAjadAha kara| takhana ivalIsa chAr3A savAi sAjadAha karala, yArA sAjadAha karala se tAdera antarbhukta halanA|

tini (AllAha) tAke (ivalIsake) jijJesa karalenaH Ami yakhana toke sAjadAha (Adamake) karate Adeza karalAma takhana kona vastu toke nata zira hate nivRtta karala? se uttare valalaH Ami tAra ceYe zreSTha, Apani AmAke Aguna dvArA sRSTi karechena, Ara tAke sRSTi karechena kAdAmATi dvArA|
AllAha valalenaH ei sthAna theke neme yA, ekhAne theke ahaMkAra karA yete pArenA; sutarAM vera haYe yA, nizcaYai tui itaradera antarbhukta|
se valalaH AmAke punarutthAna dina paryanta avakAza dina!
AllAha valalenaH toke avakAza deYA hala|
(ivalIsa) valalaH Apani ye AmAke pathabhraSTa karalena e kAraNe Amio zapatha kare valachi - Ami ApanAra sarala pathe avazyai ot pete vase thAkava|
ataHpara Ami tAdera sammukha diYe, pichana diYe, DAna dika diYe evaM vAma dika diYe tAdera kAche Asava, Apani tAdera adhikAMzakei kRtajJa pAvenanA|

tini (AllAha) valalenaH tui ekhAna theke apamAnita o lAJchita avasthAYa vera haYe yA, tAdera (vAnI Adamera) madhye yArA tora anusaraNa karave, nizcaYai Ami todera sakalera dvArA jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|
Ara he Adama! tumi evaM tomAra strI jAnnAte vasavAsa kara evaM ekhAne tomAdera mane yA cAYa tAi khAo, kintu ei vRkSera nikaTavartI haYonA, tAhale atyAcArIdera madhye gaNya have|

ataHpara tAdera lajjAsthAna yA parasparera kAche gopana rAkhA haYechila tA prakAza karAra janya zAitAna tAderake kumantraNA dila, se valalaH tomAdera rAvva ei vRkSera kAche yete niSedha karechena, era kAraNa e chAr3A kichui naYa ye, tomarA yena mAlAikA/pherezatA haYe nA yAo, athavA ekhAne (ei jAnnAte) cirantana jIvana lAbha karate nA pAra|
se tAdera ubhaYera nikaTa zapatha kare valalaH Ami tomAdera hitAkAMkhIdera anyatama|

ataHpara se (zAitAna) tAdera ubhaYake vibhrAnta karala| yakhana tArA sei niSiddha gAchera phalera svAda grahaNa karala takhana tAdera lajjAsthAna tAdera kAche prakAza haYe par3ala evaM tArA vAgAnera vRkSapatra dvArA nijederake AvRta karate lAgala| tAdera rAvva tAderake samvodhana kare valalenaH Ami ki ei vRkSa samparke tomAderake niSedha karini evaM valini ye, zAitAna tomAdera prakAzya zakra?
tArA valalaH he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA nijedera prati anyAYa karechi, Apani yadi AmAderake kSamA nA karena tAhale AmarA kSatigrastadera antarbhukta haYe par3ava|

tini (AllAha) valalenaH tomarA eke anyera zakra rUpe ekhAna theke neme yAo, tomAdera janya pRthivIte vAsasthAna raYeche, ekaTi nirdiSTa meYAda paryanta sekhAne jIvana dhAraNera upayogI sAmagrIra vyavasthA rAkhA haYeche|
tini valalenaH sei pRthivItei tomarA jIvana yApana karave, sekhAnei tomAdera mRtyu saMghaTita have evaM sekhAna hatei tomAderake punarutthita karA have|

he vAnI Adama! Ami tomAdera lajjAsthAna AvRta karAra o vezabhUSAra janya tomAdera pozAka paricchadera upakaraNa avatIrNa karechi| (veza-bhUSAra tulanAYa) AllAhabhItira paricchadai hacche sarvottama paricchada| eTA AllAhara nidarzanasamUhera anyatama nidarzana, sambhavataH mAnuSa eTA hate upadeza grahaNa karave|

he Adama santAna! zAitAna yena tomAderake serUpa praluvdha karate nA pAre yerUpa tomAdera mAtA-pitAke (praluvdha kare) jAnnAta hate vahiskAra karechila evaM tAderake tAdera lajjAsthAna dekhAnora janya vivastra karechila| se (zAitAna) nije evaM tAra dala tomAderake dekhate pAYa, athaca tomarA tAderake dekhate pAonA| niHsandehe Ami avizvAsIdera janya zAitAnake vandhu o abhibhAvaka vAniYe diYechi|

yakhana tArA kona lajjAskara o azlIla AcaraNa kare takhana tArA valeH AmarA AmAdera pUrva-puruSaderake esava kAja karate dekhechi evaM AllAhao AmAderake eTA karate nirdeza diYechena| tumi valaH nA AllAha kakhanao azlIla o lajjAskara AcaraNera nirdeza denanA, tomarA ki AllAha samparke emana sava kathA valacha ye viSaYe tomAdera kona jJAna nei?

tumi valaH AmAra rAvva nyAYa vicArera Adeza diYechena evaM tomarA pratyeka sAlAte tomAdera manayoga sthira rekha evaM tA~ra Anugatye vizuddha mane ekaniSThabhAve tA~kei DAka; tomAderake prathama yebhAve sRSTi karA haYeche, tomarA temanibhAve phire Asave|

AllAha eka dalake sat pathe paricAlita karechena evaM apara dalera janya saMgata kAraNei bhrAnti nirdhArita haYeche,tArA AllAhake cher3e zAitAnake abhibhAvaka o vandhu vAniYechila evaM nijederake sat pathagAmI mane karata|
he Adama santAna! pratyeka sAlAtera samaYa sundara pozAka paricchada grahaNa kara, Ara khAo evaM pAna kara| tave apavyaYa o amitAcAra karavenA, nizcaYai AllAha apavyaYakArIdera bhAlavAsenanA|

tumi jijJesa karaH AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera janya ye sava zobhanIYa vastu o pavitra jIvikA sRSTi karechena tA ke niSiddha kareche? tumi ghoSaNA kare dAo - ei samastato tAdera janyai yArA pArthiva jIvane evaM vizeSa kare kiYAmAta divase vizvAsa kare| emanibhAve Ami jJAnI sampradAYera janya nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve vivRta kare thAki|

tumi valaH AmAra rAvva prakAzya, aprakAzya azlIlatA, pApa kAja, anyAYa o asaMgata vidroha o virodhitA evaM AllAhara sAthe kona kichuke zarIka karA yAra pakSe AllAha kona dalIla pramANa avatIrNa karenani, Ara AllAha samvandhe emana kichu valA ye samvandhe tomAdera kona jJAna nei, (ityAdi kAja o viSaYasamUha) niSiddha karechena|
pratyeka jAtira janya ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa raYeche, sutarAM yakhana sei nirdiSTa samaYa samupasthita have takhana tA eka muhurtakAlao Age kiMvA pare havenA|

he Adama santAna! tomAdera madhya hate yadi kona rAsUla tomAdera nikaTa Agamana kare evaM AmAra vANI o nidarzana tomAdera kAche vivRta kare; takhana yArA satarka have evaM nijederake saMzodhana kare nive evaM sat kAja karave, tAdera kona bhaYa-bhIti thAkavenA|
Ara yArA AmAra nidarzana o vidhAnake mithyA pratipanna kare evaM ahaMkAra kare oTA hate dUre sare thAke tArAi have jAhAnnAmI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|

ye vyakti AllAhara upara mithyA Aropa kare evaM tA~ra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare se apekSA var3a yAlima Ara ke hate pAre? tAdera ‘AmalanAmAYa likhita nirdhArita aMza tAdera nikaTa pau~chavei, parizeSe yakhana AmAra prerita mAlAka/pherezatA tAdera prANa haraNera janya tAdera nikaTa pau~chave, takhana tArA (pherezatArA) jijJesa karaveH AllAhake vAda diYe yAderake tomarA DAkate tArA kothAYa? takhana tArA uttare valaveH AmAdera hate tArA udhAo haYe geche| Ara nijerAi svIkArokti karave ye, tArA kAphira vA satya pratyAkhyAnakArI chila|

AllAha valenaH tomAdera pUrve mAnava o jina hate ye sava sampradAYa gata haYeche, tAdera sAthe tomarAo jAhAnnAme praveza kara| yakhana kona dala tAte praveza karave takhanai apara dalake tArA abhisaspAta karave, parizeSe yakhana tAte sakale jamAYeta have takhana paravartIrA pUrvavartIdera samparke valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! erAi AmAderake vibhrAnta kareche, sutarAM Apani edera dviguNa zAsti dina! takhana AllAha valavenaH tAdera pratyekera janyai raYeche dviguNa zAsti, kintu tomarA jAnanA|
ataHpara pUrvavartI lokerA paravartI lokaderake valaveH AmAdera upara tomAdera kona zreSThatva nei, tomarA tomAdera kRtakarmera phala svarUpa zAsti bhoga karate thAka|

nizcaYai yArA AmAra AYAtake mithyA pratipanna kare evaM ahaMkAra vazataH tA theke phire thAke, tAdera janya AkAzera dvAra unmukta karA havenA evaM tArA jAnnAteo praveza karavenA, yatakSaNa nA sucera chidra pathe uTa praveza kare, emanibhAvei Ami aparAdhIderake pratiphala diYe thAki|
tAdera janya have jAhAnnAmera (Agunera) zayyA evaM tAdera uparera AcchAdanao have (Agunera tairI) cAdara, emanibhAvei Ami yAlimaderake pratiphala diYe thAki|
yArA ImAna eneche o bhAla kAja kareche emana kona vyaktike Ami tAra sAdhyAtIta dAYitva arpaNa karinA - tArAi have jAnnAtavAsI, sekhAne tArA cirakAla avasthAna karave|

Ara tAdera antare yA kichu IrSA o vidveSa raYeche tA Ami dUra kare diva, tAdera nimnadeza diYe nadI pravAhita have; takhana tArA valaveH samasta prazaMsA sei AllAhara janya yini AmAderake patha pradarzana karechena, AllAha AmAderake patha pradarzana nA karale AmarA patha petAmanA, AmAdera ravera prerita rAsUlagaNa satya vANI niYe esechilena| Ara tAderake samvodhana kare valA haveH tomarA ye (bhAla) ‘Amala karate tArai janya tomAderake ei jAnnAtera uttarAdhikArI vAnAno haYeche|

Ara jAnnAtera adhivAsIgaNa Agunera adhivAsIderake DAkave ye, ‘AmAdera rava AmAderake ye oYAdA diYechena tA AmarA satya peYechi| sutarAM tomAdera rava tomAderake ye oYAdA diYechena, tA ki tomarA satyai peYecha’? tArA valave, ‘hyA~’| ataHpara eka ghoSaka tAdera madhye ghoSaNA deve ye, AllAhara lA’nata yAlimadera upara’|
yArA AllAhara pathe calate (mAnuSake) vAdhA dita evaM tAte vakratA anusandhAna karata tArA parakAlakeo asvIkAra karata|

ei ubhaYa zreNIra lokadera mAjhe pArthakyakArI ekaTi pardA raYeche| evaM A‘rAphe (jAnnAta o jAhAnnAmera UrdhvasthAne) kichu loka thAkave, tArA pratyekake lakSaNa o cihna dvArA cinate pArave| tArA jAnnAtavAsIke Deke valaveH tomAdera prati zAnti varSita hoka; takhano tArA jAnnAte praveza kareni vaTe, kintu tArA praveza karAra AkAMkhA karave|
paranta jAhAnnAmIdera prati tAdera dRSTi phiriYe deYA have, takhana tArA (A‘rAphavAsIrA) valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani AmAderake yAlima sampradAYera saGgI karavenanA|

A‘rAphavAsIdera kaYekajana jAhAnnAmI lokake tAdera lakSaNa dvArA cinate pere DAka diYe valaveH tomAdera dalavala o pArthiva jIvanera dhana-sampada evaM tomAdera garva, ahaMkAra tomAdera konai upakAre elonA|

ei jAnnAtavAsIrA ki tArA naYa yAdera samparke tomarA kasama kare valate ye, edera prati AllAha daYA pradarzana karavenanA? tomarA jAnnAte praveza kara, tomAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tomarA cintita o duHkhita havenA|

jAhAnnAmIrA jAnnAtIderake samvodhana kare valaveH AmAdera upara kichu pAni Dhele dAo athavA AllAha pradatta tomAdera jIvikA hate kichu pradAna kara| tArA valaveH AllAha e du’Ti jinisa kAphiradera janya hArAma kare diYechena|

tArA nijedera dInake krIr3A-kautukera vastute pariNata karechila evaM pArthiva jIvana tAderake dhokAYa phele rekhechila| sutarAM Aja Ami tAderake temanibhAve bhule thAkava yemanibhAve tArA ei dinera sAkSAtera kathA bhule giYechila evaM yemanabhAve tArA AmAra nidarzana o AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karechila|
Ara Ami tAdera nikaTa emana ekaTi kitAva pau~chiYechilAma yAke Ami svIYa jJAna dvArA vistArita varNanA karechilAma evaM yA chila mu’minadera janya patha nirdeza o rAhamAtera pratIka|

tArA ki ei apekSAYai Ache ye, era viSaYa vastu prakAza karA hoka? yedina era viSaYa vastu prakAzita have sedina yArA era Agamanera kathA bhule giYechila tArA valaveH vAstavikai AmAdera ravera rAsUlagaNa satya vANI niYe esechilena, emana kona supArizakArI Ache ki yArA AmAdera janya supAriza karave? athavA AmAderake ki punarAYa duniYAYa pAThAno yete pAre yAte AmarA pUrvera kRtakarmera tulanAYa bhinna kichu karate pAri? niHsandehe tArA nijerAi nijedera kSati kareche, Ara tArA yesava mithyA (mA‘vUda o rasama reoYAja) racanA karechila, tAo tAdera hate antarhita haYe yAve|

nizcaYai tomAdera rAvva hacchena sei AllAha yini AsamAna o yamInake chaYa dine sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tini svIYa Arazera upara samAsIna hana| tini dinake rAta dvArA AcchAdita karena yAte orA eke anyake anusaraNa kare cale tvarita gatite; sUrya, cA~da o nakSatrarAjI savai tA~ra hukumera anugata| jene rekha, sRSTira ekamAtra kartA tinii, Ara hukumera ekamAtra mAlikao tini, sArA jAhAnera rAvva AllAha halena vArAkAtamaYa|
tomarA vinItabhAve o saMgopane tomAdera rAvvake DAkave, tini sImA laMghanakArIderake bhAlavAsenanA|
duniYAYa zAnti zRMkhalA sthApanera para viparyaYa o vizRMkhalA sRSTi karanA, AllAhake bhaYa-bhIti o AzA AkAMkhAra sAthe DAka, niHsandehe AllAhara rAhamAta satkarmazIladera ati sannikaTe|

sei AllAhai svIYa rAhamAtera (vRSTira) Age vAtAsake susaMvAda vahanakArI rUpe preraNa karena| yakhana ai vAtAsa bhArI meghamAlAke vahana kare niYe Ase takhana Ami ai meghamAlAke kona nirjIva bhU-khanDera dike preraNa kari| ataHpara oTA hate vAridhArA varSaNa kari, tArapara sei pAnira sAhAyye sekhAne sarva prakAra phala phalAdi utpAdana kari| emanibhAvei Ami mRtake jIvita kari, yAte tomarA eTA theke zikSA grahaNa karate pAra|

Ara utkRSTa bhUmi ora ravera nirdezakrame khuva utkRSTa phasala phalAYa, Ara yA nikRSTa bhUmi - tAte khuva kamai phasala phale thAke| emanibhAvei Ami kRtajJa parAYaNadera janya AmAra AYAtasamUha vibhinnabhAve varNanA kare thAki|

Ami nUhake tAra sampradAYera nikaTa preraNa karechilAma| se tAderake valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA zudhu AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona ilAha nei, Ami tomAdera prati eka gurutara dinera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|
tAra sampradAYera pradhAna o netArA valalaH AmarA tomAke spaSTa vibhrAntira madhye dekhachi|
se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami kona bhula bhrAnti o gumarAhIra madhye lipta nai, varaM Ami sArA jAhAnera ravera (prerita) ekajana rAsUla|
Ami AmAra ravera vArtA tomAdera kAche pau~che dicchi, Ara Ami tomAderake hitopadeza dicchi| tomarA yA jAnanA Ami tA AllAhara nikaTa theke jene thAki|

tomAdera madhya theke ekajana lokera mAdhyame tomAdera ravera pakSa hate upadeza vANI AsAYa ki tomarA vismita haYecha, yAte se tomAderake satarka o huziYAra karate pAre, yena tomarA sAvadhAna hao evaM yena AllAhabhIti avalamvana karate pAra, haYata tomAdera prati anugraha pradarzana karA have?

kintu tArA mithyA pratipanna karala, phale tAke evaM tAra sAthe naukAYa yArA chila tAderake (AyAva hate) rakSA karalAma, Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare amAnya karechila, tAderake DuviYe mAralAma| vastutaH niHsandehe tArA chila eka andha sampradAYa|
‘Ada jAtira nikaTa tAdera bhAi hudake (nAvI rUpe) pAThiYechilAma| se valalaH he AmAra jAti! tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona mA‘vUda nei, tomarA ki sAvadhAna havenA?
tAra jAtira netArA valalaH AmarA tomAke nirvodha dekhachi evaM AmarAto tomAke nizcita rUpe mithyAvAdI mane kari|
se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami nirvodha nai, varaM Ami halAma sArA jAhAnera ravera manonIta rAsUla|
Ami AmAra ravera vArtA tomAdera nikaTa pau~che dicchi, Ara Ami tomAdera ekajana vizvasta hitAkAMkhI |

tomarA ki ete vismita haccha ye, tomAdera jAtirai ekaTi lokera mAdhyame tomAdera ravera pakSa hate tA~ra vidhAna o upadezasaha tomAderake satarka karAra uddeze tomAdera kAche eseche? tomarA sei avasthAra kathA smaraNa kara yakhana nUhera sampradAYera para AllAha tomAderake tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena evaM tomAderake anyadera apekSA zaktite adhikatara vaiziSTyamanDita karechena| tomarA AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara, haYato tomarA saphalakAma have|

tArA valalaH tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa zudhu ei uddeze esecho ye, AmarA yena ekamAtra AllAharai ivAdAta kari evaM AmAdera pUrva-puruSarA yAdera pUjA karata tAderake varjana kari? tumi tomAra kathA o dAvIte satyavAdI hale AmAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAccha tA AnaYana kara|

se valalaH tomAdera ravera zAsti o krodha tomAdera upara avadhArita haYe Ache| tomarA ki AmAra sAthe emana katakaguli nAma samvandhe vitarka karacha yAra nAmakaraNa karecha tomarA evaM tomAdera vApa dAdArA, Ara ye viSaYe AllAha kona dalIla pramANa avatIrNa karenani? sutarAM tomarA (zAstira janya) apekSA karate thAka, Amio tomAdera sAthe apekSA karachi|

ataHpara Ami tAke (hudake) evaM tAra saGgI-sAthIderake AmAra anugrahe rakSA karalAma, Ara yArA AmAra nidarzanake mithyA pratipanna karechila evaM yArA ImAnadAra chilanA tAdera mUlotpATana kare chAr3alAma|

Ara Ami chAmUda jAtira nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihake preraNa karechilAma| se valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, AllAha chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona mA‘vUda nei, tomAdera ravera pakSa hate eka spaSTa nidarzana tomAdera nikaTa eseche, eTi AllAhara uSTrI - tomAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana svarUpa| tomarA eke cher3e dAo - AllAhara yamIne care khAve, oke khArApa uddeze sparza karanA, (keha kona kaSTa dile) eka yantraNAdAYaka zAsti tomAderake grAsa kare phelave|

tomarA smaraNa kara sei viSaYaTi yakhana tini ‘Ada jAtira para tomAderake tAdera sthalAbhiSikta karechena, Ara tini tomAderake pRthivIte emanabhAve pratiSThita karechena ye, tomarA samatala bhUmite prAsAda o pAhAr3a keTe AvAsa gRha nirmANa karecha| sutarAM tomarA AllAhara anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara evaM pRthivIte viparyaYa char3iYe dionA|

tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika pradhAnarA tAdera madhyakAra durvala o utpIr3ita mu’minaderake valalaH tomarA ki vizvAsa kara ye, sAliha tAra rAvva kartRka prerita haYeche? tArA uttare valalaH nizcaYai ye vArtAsaha se prerita haYeche, AmarA tA vizvAsa kari|
dAmbhikarA valalaH tomarA yA vizvAsa kara AmarA tA vizvAsa karinA|

ataHpara tArA sei uSTrITike mere phelalo evaM garva o dAmbhikatAra sAthe tAdera ravera nirdezera viroddhAcaraNa karala evaM valalaH he sAliha! tumi satya rAsUla haYe thAkale AmAderake ye zAstira bhaYa dekhAccha tA AnaYana kara|
sutarAM bhUmikampa tAderake grAsa kare nilo, phale tArA nijedera gRhera madhyei natajAnu haYe par3e raila|

sAliha e kathA vale tAdera janapada hate vera haYe gelaH he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami AmAra ravera vArtA tomAdera kAche pau~che diYechi, Ara Ami tomAderake upadeza diYechilAma, kintu tomarAto hitaiSI vandhuderake pachanda karanA|
Ara Ami lUtake pAThiYechilAma| se tAra kAomake valechilaH tomarA emana azlIla o ku-karma karacho yA tomAdera pUrve vizve Ara kehai kareni|
tomarA strIlokadera vAda diYe puruSadera dvArA nijedera yauna icchA nivAraNa kare niccha| prakRta pakSe, tomarA haccha sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|
tAra jAtira lokadera eTA chAr3A Ara kona javAvai chilanA ye, edera tomAdera janapada theke vera kare dAo, erA nijederake var3a pavitra rAkhate cAYa|
parizeSe, Ami tAke evaM tAra parivArera lokaderake, tAra strI chAr3A, zAsti hate rakSA karechilAma, tAra strI tAdera sAthe pichanei raYe giYechila|
ataHpara Ami tAdera upara muSaladhAre vAripAta ghaTAlAma, ataHpara lakSya kara, aparAdhI lokadera pariNAma ki haYechila|

Ara Ami mAdaiYAnavAsIdera kAche tAderai bhAi zu‘Aivake pAThiYechilAma| se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA ekamAtra AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera Ara kona mA‘vUda nei| tomAdera ravera pakSa hate tomAdera kAche suspaSTa dalIla ese geche| sutarAM tomarA oyana o parimANa pUrNa mAtrAYa dive, mAnuSake tAdera prApya vastu kama diYe kSatigrasta karavenA| Ara duniYAYa zAnti zRMkhalA sthApanera para jhagar3A phAsAda o viparyaYa ghaTAvenA, tomarA vAstavika pakSe ImAnadAra hale ei pathai hala tomAdera janya kalyANakara|

Ara (jIvanera) pratiTi pathe emanibhAve dasyi haYe yeonA ye, ImAnadAra lokaderake bhaYabhIti pradarzana o AllAhara patha hate virata rAkhate thAkave evaM sahaja sarala pathake vakra karAYa vyasta thAkave| ai avasthAnaTira kathA smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA saMkhyAYa svalpa chile, ataHpara tini (AllAha) tomAdera saMkhyA vRddhi kare dilena, Ara ei jagate viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNati ki haYeche tA jJAnacakSu khule lakSya kara|

AmAra nikaTa yA (AllAhara pakSa hate) prerita haYeche tA yadi tomAdera kona dala vizvAsa kare evaM kona dala avizvAsa kare tAhale dhairya dhAraNa kara yatakSaNa nA AllAha AmAdera madhye cur3Anta phAisAlA kare dena| tinii halena uttama phAisAlAkArI|

Ara tAra sampradAYera dAmbhika o ahaMkArI pradhAnarA valechilaH he zu‘Aiva! AmarA avazyai tomAke, tomAra saMgI sAthI mu’minaderake AmAdera janapada hate vahiskAra karava athavA tomarA AmAdera dharmAdarze phire Asave| se valalaH AmarA yadi tAte rAyI nA hai?

tomAdera dharmAdarza hate AllAha AmAderake mukti deYAra para AmarA yadi tAte AvAra phire yAi tAhale nizcitabhAve AllAhara prati mithyA AropakArI hava! AmAdera rAvva AllAha nA cAile ote AvAra phire yAoYA AmAdera pakSe kona kramei sambhava naYa| savakichui AmAdera ravera jJAnAYatta, AmarA AllAhara uparai nirbhara karachi| he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera o AmAdera sampradAYera madhye saThikabhAve phAisAlA kare dina, Apaniito sarvottama phAisAlAkArI|
Ara tAdera sampradAYera kAphira sardArarA valalaH tomarA yadi zu‘Aivake anusaraNa kara tAhale tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta have|
ataHpara bhU-kampana tAderake grAsa karala, phale tArA nijedera gRhei upur3a haYe par3e raila|
avasthA dekhe mane hala, yArA zu‘Aivake mithyA pratipanna karechila tArA yena kakhanao sekhAne vasavAsa kareni, zu‘Aivake mithyA pratipannakArI lokerAi zeSa paryanta dhvaMsa haYe giYechila|

se tAdera nikaTa hate e kathA vale veriYe eloH he AmAra jAti! Ami AmAra ravera vArtA tomAdera nikaTa pau~chiYechi evaM sat upadeza diYechi| sutarAM Ami kAphira sampradAYera janya ki kare AkSepa karate pAri?
Ami kona janapade nAvI rAsUla pAThAle, ora adhivAsIderake duHkha-dAridra o roga vyAdhite AkrAnta kare thAki, uddezya hala, tArA yena namra o vinaYI haYa|

ataHpara Ami tAdera durAvasthAke sukha svAcchandya dvArA parivartana kare diYechi| avazeSe tArA khuva prAcuryera adhikArI haYa, Ara tArA (akRtajJa svare) valeH AmAdera pUrva-puruSarAo ebhAve duHkha bhoga kareche| ataHpara akasmAt Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma, kintu tArA kichui vujhate pAralanA|

janapadera adhivAsIrA yadi ImAna Anata evaM AllAhabhIti avalamvana karata tAhale Ami tAdera janya AkAza o pRthivIra varakatera dvArasamUha khule ditAma, kintu tArA nAvI rAsUladerake mithyA pratipanna kareche, phale tAdera kRtakarmera janya Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma|
rAte yakhana tArA ghumiYe thAke takhana AmAra zAsti ese tAderake grAsa kare phelave - eTA hate ki janapadera adhivAsIrA nirbhaYa haYe par3eche?
athavA janapadera lokerA ki ei bhaYa rAkhenA ye, AmAra zAsti tAdera upara takhana Apatita have yakhana tArA pUrvAhne Amoda pramode rata thAkave?
tArA ki AllAhara pAkar3Ao theke nirApada haYe geche? sarvanAzagrastha sampradAYa chAr3A AllAhara pAkar3Ao theke kehai ni:zaGka hate pArenA|

kona elAkAra adhivAsI dhvaMsa haoYAra para sei elAkAra yArA uttarAdhikArI haYa, tAdera kAche ki eTA pratIYamAna haYani ye, Ami icchA karale tAdera pApera kAraNe tAderake zAsti dite pAri, Ara tAdera antaHkaraNera upara mohara eTe dite pAri yAte tArA kichui zunate pArenA?

ai janapadagulira kichu ghaTanA Ami tomAra nikaTa varNanA karachi, tAdera kAche rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa dalIla pramANasaha esechila, kintu pUrve tArA yA pratyAkhyAna karechila tAra prati tArA ImAna AnAra chilanA, emanibhAvei AllAha avizvAsIdera antaHkaraNera upara mohara mere diYechena|
Ami tAdera adhikAMzake aGgIkAra o pratizruti rakSAkArIrUpe pAini, tave tAdera adhikAMzake pApAcArI rUpe peYechi|

ataHpara Ami mUsAke AmAra AYAta o nidarzanasaha phira‘Auna o tAra pariSadavargera nikaTa pAThAlAma, kintu tArA yulama karala| sutarAM ei viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNAma ki haYechila tA tumi lakSya kara|
mUsA valalaH he phira‘Auna! Ami vizvera ravera ekajana rAsUla|
Ami AllAha samvandhe satya chAr3A Ara kichui valavanA, Ami tomAdera ravera pakSa hate tomAdera kAche suspaSTa pramANa niYe esechi| sutarAM vAnI isarAIlake AmAra sAthe yete dAo|
phira‘Auna valalaH tumi yadi vAstavikai spaSTa dalIla o kona nidarzana ene thAka tAhale upasthita kara, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|
takhana mUsA tAra lAThi nikSepa karala evaM sahasAi oTA eka jIvita ajagare pariNata hala|
Ara se tAra hAta vera karala, tatkSaNAti oTA darzakadera dRSTite zubhra o ujjvala AlokamaYa pratibhAta hala|
phira‘Auna sampradAYera pradhAnarA valalaH niHsandehe e vyakti var3a sudakSa yAdukara|
se tomAderake tomAdera deza theke vahiskAra karate cAYa, ekhana tomAdera parAmarza ki?
tArA valalaH tAke evaM tAra bhAike (hAruna) kichu dinera janya avakAza dina, Ara zahare zahare saMgrAhaka pAThiYe dina,
yena tArA ApanAra (phira‘Auna) nikaTa pratyeka sudakSa yAdukarake upasthita kare|
yAdukarerA phira‘Aunera kAche ese valalaH AmarA yadi vijaYa lAbha karate pAri tAhale AmAdera janya puraskAra thAkave to?
se valalaH hyA~, tomarAi have AmAra daravArera nikaTatama vyakti|
ataHpara yAdukarerA valalaH he mUsA! tumi ki tomAra lAThi nikSepa karave, nAki AmarAi (prathame) nikSepa karava?
valalaH tomarAi nikSepa kara| sutarAM yakhana yAdukarerA nikSepa karala takhana lokera cokhe dhA~dhA~ra sRSTi karala evaM tAderake bhIta o AtaMkita karala, tArA eka var3a rakamera yAdu dekhAla|
Ami mUsAra nikaTa ei pratyAdeza pAThAlAma, tumi tomAra lAThikhAnA nikSepa kara| mUsA tA nikSepa karale oTA (eka virATa ajagara haYe) sahasA odera alIka sRSTigulike grAsa karate lAgala|
parizeSe yA haka chila tA satya pramANita hala, Ara tArA yA kichu karechila tA vAtila pratipanna hala|
Ara phira‘Auna o tAra dalavalera lokerA mukAvilAra mAidAne parAjita hala evaM lAJchita o apamAnita hala|
yAdukarerA takhana sAjadAhavanata hala|
tArA valalaH AmarA vizvera ravera prati ImAna AnalAma,
mUsA o hArUnera ravera prati|

phira‘Auna valalaH Ami anumati deYAra Agei tomarA tAra upara ImAna Anale? nizcaYai tomarA eka cakrAnta pAkiYecha zaharavAsIdera sekhAna theke tAr3iYe deYAra janya| kintu sattvarai tomarA era pariNAma jJAta have|
avazyai Ami tomAdera viparIta hasta-pada kartana karava, tArapara tomAdera savAike Ami zule car3Ava|
tArA (yAdukarerA) valalaH nizcaYai AmarA AmAdera ravera nikaTa phire yAva|

tumi AmAdera madhye echAr3A konai doSa pAcchanA ye, AmAdera kAche yakhana AmAdera ravera nidarzanAvalI ese gela takhana AmarA ImAna enechi| he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake dhairya dAna karuna evaM musalima rUpe AmAdera mRtyu dAna karuna!

phira‘Auna sampradAYera sardArarA tAke valalaH tumi ki mUsA o tAra sampradAYake rAjye azAnti o viparyaYa sRSTira janya mukta cher3e dive evaM tomAke o tomAra devatAderake varjana kare calAra suyoga dive? se valalaH Ami tAdera santAnadera hatyA karava evaM tAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhava, tAdera upara AmAdera zakti o kSamatA pravala o supratiSThita raYeche|

mUsA tAra sampradAYake valalaH tomarA AllAhara nikaTa sAhAyya prArthanA kara evaM dhairya o sahiSNutA avalamvana kara| ei pRthivIra sArvabhauma mAlika AllAha, tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA uhAra uttarAdhikArI karena, zubha pariNAma o zeSa sAphalya lAbha haYa AllAhabhIrudera janya|

tArA valalaH Apani AmAdera nikaTa (nAvI rUpe) Agamanera pUrveo AmarA (phira‘Auna kartRka) niryAtita haYechi evaM ApanAra Agamanera parao niryAtita hacchi| se (mUsA) valalaH sambhavataH zIghrai tomAdera rAvva tomAdera zakrake dhvaMsa karavena evaM tomAderake tAdera rAjye sthalAbhiSikta karavena, ataHpara tomarA kirUpa kAja kara tA tini lakSya karavena|
Ami phira‘Aunera anusArIderake vacharera para vachara durbhikSa, ajanma o phasalahAnira madhye vipanna rekhechilAma, yAte tArA ImAna Ane|

yakhana tAdera sukha, zAnti o kalyANa hata takhana tArA valataH eTA AmAdera prApya, Ara yadi tAdera duHkha dainya o vipada Apada hata takhana tArA oTAke mUsA o tAra saGgI sAthIdera manda bhAgyera kAraNa rUpe nirUpaNa karata| tomarA jene rekha ye, tAdera akalyANa AllAharai niYantraNAdhIna, kintu tAdera adhikAMza se samparke kona jJAna rAkhenA|
tArA valalaH AmAderake yAdu karAra janya ye kona nidarzanai peza karanA kena AmarA tAte ImAna AnavanA|

ataHpara Ami tAdera upara plAvaNa, paGgapAla, ukuna, vyAGa o rakta dhArAra zAsti pAThiYe kliSTa kari, oguli chila AmAra suspaSTa nidarzana, kintu tArA zeSa paryanta dAmbhikatA o ahaMkArei mete raila, tArA chila ekaTi aparAdhI jAti|

tAdera upara kona vAlA musIvata o vipada-Apada Apatita hale tArA valataH he mUsA! AmAdera pakSa theke tomAra ravera nikaTa du‘A kara| tAra sAthe tomAra ye aGgIkAra raYeche tadanuyAYI yadi AmAdera upara theke plega dUra kare dite pAra tAhale AmarA tomAra prati ImAna Anavo evaM tomAra sAthe vAnI isarAIladerake pAThiYe diva|
kintu yakhanai Ami tAdera upara hate plegera zAstira sei samaYaTi apasArita karatAma yA tAdera janya nirdhArita chila, takhanai AvAra tArA pratizruti bhaGga karata|

sutarAM Ami tAdera hate pratizodha nilAma evaM tAderake atala samudre DuviYe mAralAma, kenanA tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche, Ara ei vyApAre tArA chila sampUrNa gAphila vA udAsIna|

ye jAtike durvala o dInahIna bhAvA hata Ami tAderake AmAra kalyANa prApta rAjyera pUrva o pazcimera uttarAdhikArI vAnAi, Ara vAnI isarAIla jAti samparke tomAra ravera zubha o kalyANamaYa vANI (pratizruti) pUrNa hala yehetu tArA dhairya dhAraNa karechila| Ara phira‘Auna o tAra sampradAYera kIrtikalApa o ucca prAsAdasamUhake Ami dhvaMsastupe pariNata karechi|

Ami vAnI isarAIlake samudra pAra kariYe dilAma, ataHpara tArA mUrti pUjArata eka jAtira saMsparze ela| tArA valalaH he mUsA! tAdera yerUpa mA‘vUda raYeche, AmAdera janyao airUpa mA‘vUda vAniYe dAo| se valalaH tomarA ekaTi mUrkha sampradAYa|
e sava loka ye kAje lipta raYeche tAto dhvaMsa karA have, Ara tArA yA karache tA amUlaka o vAtila viSaYa|
se valalaH Ami ki AllAhake cher3e tomAdera janya anya mA‘vUdera sandhAna karava? athaca tinii halena ekamAtra AllAha yini tomAderake vizva jagate zreSThatva dAna karechena!

smaraNa kara sei samaYaTira kathA, yakhana Ami tomAderake phira‘Aunera anusArIdera dAsatva hate mukti diYechi, yArA tomAderake atizaYa marmAntika, kaSTadAYaka o nyAkkArajanaka zAsti dita, tomAdera putraderake hatyA karata evaM nArIderake jIvita rAkhata| eTA chila tomAdera janya tomAdera ravera pakSa theke virATa parIkSA|

Ami mUsAke o‘YAdA diYechilAma triza rAtera janya evaM Aro daza dvArA oTA pUrNa karechilAma| ebhAve tAra ravera nirdhArita samaYaTi calliza rAta dvArA pUrNatA lAbha kare| mUsA tAra bhAi hArunake valechilaH tumi AmAra kAomera madhye AmAra sthalAbhiSiktarUpe kAja karave evaM tAderake saMzodhana karAra kAja karate thAkave, evaM viparyaYa o phAsAda sRSTikArIdera anusaraNa karavenA|

mUsA yakhana nirdhArita sthAne upasthita hala, takhana tAra rAvva tAra sAthe kathA valalena| se takhana nivedana karalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani AmAke darzana dina| AllAha valalenaH tumi AmAke Adau dekhate pAravenA, tave tumi ai pAhAr3era dike tAkAo| yadi ai pAhAr3a svasthAne sthira thAke tAhale tumi AmAke dekhate pArave| ataHpara tAra rAvva yakhana pAhAr3e jyotismAna halena takhana tA pAhAr3ake cUrNa vicUrNa kare dila, Ara mUsA saMjJAhIna haYe par3e gela| yakhana cetanA phire elo takhana se valalaH Apani mahimAmaYa, ApanAra pavitra sattAra kAche Ami tAovAha karachi evaM Amii sarvaprathama ImAna AnalAma|

AllAha valalenaH he mUsA! Ami tomAkei AmAra risAlAta o AmAra sAthe vAkyAlApera janya lokadera madhya hate manonIta karechi| ataeva Ami tomAke yA kichu dii tA tumi grahaNa kara evaM kRtajJatA prakAzakArIdera antarbhukta hao|

ataHpara Ami tAra janya phalakera upara sarva viSaYera upadeza evaM sarva viSaYera suspaSTa vyAkhyA likhe diYechi, (ataHpara tAke valalAma) ei hidAYAtake dRr3ha haste zaktabhAve grahaNa kara evaM tomAra sampradAYake era sundara sundara vidhAnaguli mene calate Adeza kara| Ami phAseka vA satyatyAgIdera AvAsasthAna zIghrai tomAderake pradarzana karAva|

pRthivIte yArA anyAYabhAve ahaMkAra kare ver3AYa Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzanasamUha hate phiriYe rAkhava, pratyekaTi nidarzana dekhAra pareo tArA tAte ImAna Anave nA, tArA yadi sat patha dekhate pAYa tavuo sei patha sat patha vale grahaNa karave nA| kintu tArA bhrAnta o gumarAhIra patha dekhale tAkei tArA grahaNa karave| era kAraNa hala-tArA AmAra nidarzanasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kareche evaM tArA tA theke sampUrNarUpe amanoyogI chila|
yArA AmAra nidarzanasamUha o AkhirAtera sAkSAta mithyA pratipanna kare tAdera samUdaYa ‘Amala vinaSTa haYe yAYa, tArA yA kare tadanuyAYI tAderake pratiphala deYA have|

Ara mUsAra cale yAvAra para alaMkAra dvArA ekaTi vAchurera (mata) putula tairI karala, oTA hate garura mata zavda vera hata| tArA ki dekheni ye, oTA tAdera sAthe kathA valenA evaM tAderake kona pathao dekhiYe deYanA? tavuo tArA oTAke mA‘vUda rUpe grahaNa karala| vastutaH tArA chila var3a atyAcArI|
Ara yakhana tArA lajjita hala evaM dekhala ye, (prakRta pakSe) tArA vibhrAnta haYeche, takhana tArA valalaH AmAdera prabhu yadi AmAdera prati anugraha nA karena tAhale AmarA kSatigrasta haYe yAva|

mUsA rAgAmvita vikSuddha avasthAYa nija jAtira nikaTa phire ese valalaH AmAra cale yAoYAra para tomarA kata nikRSTa pratinidhitva karecha, tomarA tomAdera prabhura nirdezera pUrvei kena tAr3Ahur3A karate gele? ataHpara se phalakaguli phele dila evaM svIYa bhAiYera mastaka (cula) dhare nijera dike TAnate lAgala| se (hArUna) valalaH he AmAra mAtAra putra! ei lokaguli AmAke parAbhUta kare phelechila evaM AmAke mere phelate udyata haYechila| ataeva tumi AmAke zakra samakSe hAsyaspada karanA, Ara ei yAlima lokadera madhye AmAke gaNya karanA|
takhana mUsA valalaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke o AmAra bhAike kSamA karuna! Ara AmAderake ApanAra rAhamAtera madhye dAkhila karuna! Apani sava ceYe daYAvAna|
yArA go-vatsake upAsya rUpe grahaNa kareche, avazyai tArA ei pArthiva jIvane tAdera ravera gayava o lAJchanAYa nipatita have, mithyA racanAkArIderake Ami ebhAvei pratiphala diYe thAki|
yArA khArApa kAja kare, erapara tAovAha karale o ImAna Anale, tomAra AllAhato kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|
mUsAra krodha yakhana prazamita hala takhana se prastara phalakaguli tule nila, tAte lekhA chilaH yArA tAdera rAvvake bhaYa kare tAdera janya raYeche hidAYAta o rAhamAta|

mUsA tAra sampradAYa hate sattara jana netRsthAnIYa loka AmAra nirdhArita sthAne samaveta haoYAra janya nirvAcana karala, yakhana ai lokaguli ekaTi kaThina bhU-kampane AkrAnta hala takhana mUsA valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani icchA karale era pUrveo oderake evaM AmAke dhvaMsa karate pAratena, AmAdera madhyakAra kataka nirvodha lokera anyAYera kAraNe ki Apani AmAderake dhvaMsa karavena? eTAto ApanAra parIkSA, Apani yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM yAke icchA sat pathe paricAlita karena, Apaniito AmAdera abhibhAvaka| sutarAM Apani AmAderake kSamA karuna, evaM AmAdera prati anugraha karuna, kSamAkArIdera madhye Apaniito uttama kSamAkArI|

ataeva AmAdera janya ei duniYAYa o parakAle kalyANa nirdhArita kare dina, AmarA ApanAra nikaTai pratyAvartana karechi| tini (AllAha) valalenaH yAke icchA Ami AmAra zAsti diYe thAki, Ara AmAra karuNA o daYA pratiTi jinisakei parivyapta kare raYeche, sutarAM Ami tAdera janyai kalyANa avadhArita karava yArA pApAcAra hate virata thAke, yAkAta deYa evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUhera prati ImAna Ane|

yArA sei nirakSara rAsUlera anusaraNa kare cale yAra kathA tArA tAdera nikaTa rakSita tAorAta o iJjIla kitAve likhita pAYa, ye mAnuSake sat kAjera nirdeza deYa o anyAYa kAja karate niSedha kare, Ara se tAdera janya pavitra vastusamUha vaidha kare evaM apavitra o khArApa vastuke tAdera prati avaidha kare, Ara tAdera upara cApAno vojhA o vandhana hate tAderake mukta kare| sutarAM tAra prati yArA ImAna rAkhe, tAke sammAna kare evaM sAhAyya kare o sahAnubhUti prakAza kare, Ara sei Alokera anusaraNa kare cale yA tAra sAthe avatIrNa karA haYeche, tArAi (ihakAle o parakAle) sAphalya lAbha karave|

valaH he mAnavamanDalI! Ami tomAdera sakalera janya sei AllAhara rAsUla rUpe prerita haYechi, yini AkAza o bhU-manDalera sArvabhauma ekacchatra mAlika, tini chAr3A Ara kona upAsya nei, tinii jIvita karena o mRtyu ghaTAna| sutarAM AllAhara prati evaM tA~ra sei vArtAvAhaka nirakSara nAvIra prati ImAna Ana| ye AllAha o tA~ra kAlAme vizvAsa sthApana kare, tomarA tArai anusaraNa kara| AzA karA yAYa, tomarA sarala saThika pathera sandhAna pAve|
mUsAra sampradAYera madhye emana ekadala loka raYeche yArA saThika o nirbhula patha pradarzana kare evaM nyAYa vicAra kare|

Ami vAnI isarAIlake dvAdaza gotre vibhakta karechi| mUsAra sampradAYera lokerA yakhana tAra kAche pAnira dAvI jAnAla, takhana Ami mUsAra kAche pratyAdeza pAThAlAma - tomAra lAThi dvArA pAthare AghAta kara, phale oTA hate dvAdaza prasravaNa utsArita hala, pratyeka gotra nija nija pAnasthAna jene nila| Ara Ami tAdera upara megha dvArA chAYA vistAra karalAma evaM tAdera janya AkAza hate ‘mAnnA’ o ‘sAlaoYA’ khAdyarUpI ni‘AmAta avatIrNa karalAma| sutarAM (Ami valalAma) tomAderake yA kichu pavitra jIvikA dAna karA haYeche tA AhAra kara| (kintu orA AmAra zarta upekSA kare yulama karala) tArA AmAra upara kona yulama kareni, varaM tArA nijedera uparai yulama kareche|

yakhana Ami tAderake valechilAmaH ei (vAitula mukAddAsa o tatsaMzliSTa) janapade vasavAsa kara evaM yA icchA AhAra kara, Ara tomarA valaH (he rAvva!) kSamA cAi, Ara dvAradeza diYe nata zire praveza kara; Ami tomAdera aparAdha kSamA karava evaM sat karmazIla lokadera janya AmAra dAna vRddhi karava|

kintu tAdera madhye yArA yAlima o sImA laMghanakArI chila, tArA sei kathA parivartana kare phelalo yA tAderake valate valA haYechila, sutarAM tAdera sImA laMghanera kAraNe Ami AsamAna hate tAdera upara zAsti preraNa karalAma|

Ara tAderake sei janapadera avasthAo jijJesa kara yA samudrera tIre avasthita chila| yakhana tArA zanivArera Adeza laMghana karechila| zanivAra udayApanera dina mAcha pAnite bhese tAdera nikaTa Asata, kintu yedina tArA zanivAra udayApana karatanA, sedina oguli tAdera kAche AsatanA, ebhAve Ami tAdera nApharamAnIra kAraNe tAderake parIkSA karechilAma|

yakhana tAdera ekadala loka apara dalera nikaTa valechilaH ai jAtike tomarA kena upadeza diccha yAderake AllAha dhvaMsa karavena athavA kaThina zAsti divena? tArA uttare valalaH tomAdera ravera nikaTa doSamuktira janya evaM ei AzA karachi ye, haYato tArA tA~ke bhaYa karave|

tAderake ye upadeza deYA haYa tA yakhana tArA vismRta haYa takhana yArA asat kAja theke niSedha karata tAderake Ami uddhAra kari, Ara yAlimaderake tAdera asat karmera kAraNe kaThora zAsti dvArA pAkar3Ao karalAma|
ataHpara yakhana tArA veparoYAbhAve niSiddha kAjaguli karate thAkala takhana Ami valalAmaH tomarA ghRNita o lAJchita vAnara haYe yAo|

tomAra rAvva ghoSaNA karalena ye, tini tAdera (iYAhudIdera) upara kiYAmAta paryanta emana sava lokake zaktizAlI kare preraNa karate thAkavena yArA tAderake kaThinatara zAsti dite thAkave| niHsandehe tomAra rAvva zAsti dAne kSipra hasta, Ara nizcaYai tini kSamAzIla o anugrahazIla|

Ami tAderake vibhinna dale duniYAYa vistRta karechi, tAdera kataka loka sadAcArI, Ara kichu loka bhinnatara| Ara Ami bhAla o mandera madhye nipatita kare tAderake parIkSA kare thAki yAte tArA AmAra pathe phire Ase|

ataHpara tAdera ayogya uttarasurIrA ekera para eka tAdera sthalAbhiSikta haYa evaM tArA kitAverao uttarAdhikArI haYa| kintu tArA ei nikRSTa duniYAra svArthAvalI karAYattva kare Ara valeH AmAderake kSamA karA have| vastutaH ora anurUpa sAmagrI AvAra tAdera nikaTa ele oTAo tArA grahaNa kare| tAdera nikaTa hate ki kitAvera pratizruti neYA haYani ye, AllAhara nAme satya chAr3A kichui valavenA? Ara kitAve yA raYeche tAto tArA adhyaYanao kare| muttAkI o AllAhabhIru lokadera janya parakAlera sAmagrI, tomarA ki etaTuku kathAo anudhAvaNa karate pAranA?
yArA AllAhara kitAvake dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare; Amito sat karmazIladera karmaphala naSTa karinA|

yakhana Ami vAnI isarAIlera upara pAhAr3ake sthApana kari, oTA chila kona ekaTi chAYAra nyAYa, tArA takhana mane karechila ye, oTA tAdera upara par3e yAve| tomAderake yA diYechi tA dRr3habhAve zakta hAte dhAraNa kara evaM ote yA raYeche tA smaraNa rekha| AzA karA yAYa ye, tomarA tAkaoYAra adhikArI have|

yakhana tomAra rAvva vAnI Adamera pRSThadeza hate tAdera vaMzadharaderake vera karalena evaM tAderakei tAdera upara sAkSI vAniYe jijJesa karalenaH Ami ki tomAdera rAvva (prabhu) nai? tArA samasvare uttara dilaH ‘hyA~! AmarA sAkSI thAkalAma|’ (eTA e janya ye) yAte tomarA kiYAmAta divase valate nA pAra, ‘‘AmarA e viSaYe sampUrNa anavahita chilAma|’’

athavA tomarA yena kiYAmAta divase e kathA valate nA pAra - AmAdera pUrva-puruSarAito AmAdera pUrve zir‌ka karechila, AmarA chilAma (zudhumAtra) tAdera paravartI vaMzadhara| sutarAM Apani ki AmAderake sei bhrAnta o vAtiladera kRtakarmera daruNa dhvaMsa karavena?
ebhAvei Ami nidarzanAvalI vizadabhAve vivRta kari yAte tArA phire Ase|
tumi ederake sei vyaktira vRttAnta zuniYe dAo, yAke Ami nidarzana dAna karechilAma, kintu se uhA varjana kare| phale zAitAna tAra pichane lege yAYa, Ara se pathabhraSTadera madhye zAmila haYe yAYa|

Ara Ami icchA karale tAke ei AYAtasamUhera sAhAyye unnata karatAma, kintu se duniYAra prati adhika jhu~ke par3e evaM svIYa kAmanA vAsanAra (pravRttira) anusaraNa karate thAke| tAra udAharaNa ekaTi kukurera nyAYa, oke yadi tumi kaSTa dAo tAhale jihavA vera kare hA~pAYa, AvAra kaSTa nA dileo jihavA vera kare hA~pAte thAke| yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare, ei udAharaNa hala sei sampradAYera janya| tumi kAhinI varNanA kare zonAte thAka, haYato tArA eTA niYe cintA-bhAvanA karave|
katai nA manda udAharaNa sei sampradAYera janya yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare evaM tArA nijerAi nijedera upara atyAcAra karate thAke|
AllAha yAke patha dekhAna se’i patha prApta haYa, Ara yAke tini patha pradarzana hate vaJcita karena se vyartha o kSatigrasta haYa|

Ami vahu jina o mAnuSake jAhAnnAmera janya sRSTi karechi| tAdera hRdaYa raYeche, kintu tArA tadvArA upalavdhi karenA; tAdera cakSu raYeche, kintu tArA tadvArA dekhenA| tAdera karNa raYeche, kintu tadvArA tArA zonenA| tArAi hala pazura nyAYa, varaM tA apekSAo adhika vibhrAnta| tArAi hala gAphila vA udAsIna|

Ara AllAhara janya sundara sundara nAma raYeche, sutarAM tomarA tA~ke sei sava nAmei DAkave, Ara tAderake varjana kara yArA tA~ra nAma vikRta kare, sattvarai tAderake tAdera kRtakarmera pratiphala deYA have|
Ara Ami yAderake sRSTi karechi tAdera madhye emana ekaTi dalao raYeche yArA satya pathera dA‘oYAta deYa evaM nyAYa vicAra kare|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare, Ami tAdera ajJAte tAderake dhIre dhIre dhvaMsera pathe niYe yAva|
Ami tAderake avakAza dicchi, nizcaYai AmAra kauzala ati zakta|
tArA ki eTA cintA karenA ye, tAdera saGgI pAgala naYa? se nichaka ekajana suspaSTa bhaYa pradarzanakArI!

tArA ki AllAhara sRSTi AkAzasamUha o pRthivIra vyavasthApanA samparke kona gabhIra cintA karenA? evaM tAdera jIvane nirdiSTa meYAdaTi pUrNa haoYAra samaYaTi haYato vA nikaTe ese par3eche, tArA ki eTAo cintA karenA? erapara tArA Ara kona kathAYa ImAna Anave?
yAderake AllAha vipathagAmI karena, tAdera kona patha pradarzaka nei, Ara AllAha tAderake tAderai vibhrAntira madhye udabhrAntera nyAYa ghure ver3Ate cher3e dena|

tArA tomAke jijJesa karache, kiYAmAta kakhana saMghaTita have? tumi vale dAoH e viSaYe AmAra rAvvai ekamAtra jJAnera adhikArI, zudhu tinii oTA ora nirdhArita samaYe prakAza karavena, tA have AkAzasamUha o pRthivIte eka bhaYaMkara ghaTanA| tomAdera upara oTA AkasmikabhAvei Asave| tumi yena e viSaYa savizeSa avagata, eTA bheve tArA tomAke e samparke jijJesa karache| tumi vale dAoH e samparkIYa jJAna ekamAtra AmAra raverai raYeche| kintu adhikAMza lokai e kathA vujhenA|

tumi valaH AllAha yA icchA karena tA chAr3A AmAra nijera bhAla-manda viSaYe AmAra kona adhikAra nei| Ami yadi adRzya tattva o khavara jAnatAma tAhale Ami ravera kalyANa lAbha karate pAratAma, Ara kona akalyANai AmAke sparza karate pAratanA, Amito zudhu mu’mina sampradAYera janya ekajana bhaYa pradarzanakArI o susaMvAdavAhI|

tinii AllAha yini tomAderake eka vyakti hate sRSTi karechena evaM sei vyakti hatei tAra saGginI sRSTi karechena, yena se tAra nikaTa theke prazAnti lAbha karate pAre| ataHpara yakhana se tAra sAthe milane pravRtta haYa takhana sei mahilATi eka gopana o laghu garbha dhAraNa kare, Ara oTA niYe calApherA karate thAke| yakhana tAra garbha gurubhAra haYa takhana tArA ubhaYei tAdera ravera kAche prArthanA kareH Apani yadi AmAderake sat santAna dAna karena tAhale AmarA ApanAra kRtajJa vAndA hava|
ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake sat o sustha santAna dAna karena takhana tArA AllAhara deYA ei dAne aMzI sthApana kare, kintu tArA yAke aMzI kare AllAha tAra aneka urdhve|
tArA ki emana vastuke (AllAhara sAthe) aMzI kare yArA kona vastui sRSTi karenA, varaM tArA nijerAi (AllAhara dvArA) sRSTa?
tArA yemana tAdera kona sAhAyya karAra kSamatA rAkhenA, temani nijerAo kona sAhAyya karate pArenA|
tomarA yadi oderake sat pathe DAka tAhale tArA tomAdera anusaraNa karavenA, tAderake DAkA athavA cupa kare thAkA ubhaYai tomAdera pakSe samAna|
AllAha chAr3A tomarA yAderakei DAka, tArAto tomAderai mata vAndA| sutarAM yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao tAhale tAderake upAsya hisAve DAkate thAka, dekha tomAdera DAke sAr3A deYa ki nA!

tAdera ki pA Ache yA dvArA calache? tAdera ki hAta Ache yadvArA kona kichu dhare thAke athavA cakSu Ache yA dvArA dekhate pAYa? tAdera ki karNa Ache yA dvArA zune thAke? tumi valaH AllAhara sAthe tomarA yAderake aMzI karacha tAderake DAka, tArapara (sakale ekatrita haYe) AmAra viruddhe cakrAnta karate thAka, AmAke Adau kona avakAza dionA|
AmAra abhibhAvaka halena sei AllAha yini kitAva avatIrNa karechena, Ara tinii sat karmazIladera abhibhAvakatva kare thAkena|
AllAha chAr3A tomarA yAderake DAka tArA tomAdera sAhAyya karAra kona kSamatA rAkhenA evaM nijederakeo sAhAyya karate pArenA|
yadi tumi tAderake (mUrti) hidAYAtera pathe DAka tAhale se DAka tArA zunavenA| Ara tumi dekhave ye, tArA tomAra dike tAkiYe raYeche, Asale tArA kichui dekhachenA|
tumi vinaYa o kSamA parAYaNatAra nIti grahaNa kara, evaM lokaderake sat kAjera nirdeza dAo, Ara mUrkhaderake er3iYe cala|
zAitAnera ku-mantraNA yadi tomAke prarocita kare tAhale tumi AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA kara, tini sarva zrotA o sarvajJa|
yArA AllAhabhIru, zAitAna yakhana tAderake ku-mantraNA deYa, sAthe sAthe tArA Atmasacetana haYe AllAhake smaraNa kare evaM tAdera jJAna cakSu phire pAYa|
zAitAna yAdera anugata sAthI, tArA Arao vibhrAnti o gumarAhIra madhye praveza kare, e praceSTAYa tArA Adau theme thAkenA|

tumi yakhana kona nidarzana o mu’jiyA tAdera kAche peza karanA, takhana tArA valeH Apani e sava mu’jiyA kena peza karenanA? tumi valaH AmAra ravera nikaTa theke AmAra kAche yA kichu pratyAdeza pAThAno haYa, Ami zudhumAtra tArai anusaraNa kari| ei kuraAna tomAra ravera nikaTa theke vizeSa nidarzana, Ara eTA ImAnadAra sampradAYera janya hidAYAta o rAhamAta|
yakhana kuraAna pATha karA haYa takhana tomarA manoyogera sAthe tA zravaNa karave evaM nIrava nizcupa haYe thAkave, haYato tomAdera prati daYA o anugraha pradarzana karA have|
tomAra rAvvake mane mane savinaYa o sazaMka citte anuccasvare pratyuSe o sandhyAYa smaraNa karave, Ara (he nAvI!) tumi e vyApAre gAphila o udAsIna haYo nA |
yArA (arthAt pherezatA) tomAdera ravera sAnnidhye thAke tArA tA~rai guNagAna o mahimA prakAza kare evaM tA~rai sammukhe sAjadAhavanata haYa| [sAjadAha]

he nAvI! lokerA tomAke yuddhalavdha sampada samparke jijJesa karache| tumi valaH yuddhalavdha sampada AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera janya| ataeva tomarA e vyApAre AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tomAdera nijedera pArasparika samparka saThika rUpe gar3e nAo, Ara yadi tomarA mu’mina haYe thAka tAhale AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara|

nizcaYai mu’minarA erUpai haYa ye, yakhana (tAdera sAmane) AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karA haYa takhana tAdera antarasamUha bhIta haYe par3e, Ara yakhana tAdera sAmane tA~ra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa takhana tAdera ImAna Arao vRddhi pAYa, Ara tArA nijedera ravera upara nirbhara kare|
yArA sAlAta supratiSThita kare evaM Ami yA kichu tAderake diYechi tA theke tArA kharaca kare,
erAi satyikArera ImAnadAra, edera janya raYeche tAdera ravera sannidhAne ucca padasamUha, Arao raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
yerUpa tomAra rAvva tomAke tomAra gRha hate (vadarera dike) vera karalena, Ara musalimadera ekaTi dala tA pachanda kareni |
sei yathArtha viSaYa prakAza haoYAra parao ote tArA tomAra sAthe erUpa vivAda karachila yena keha tAderake mRtyura dike hA~kiYe niYe yAcche, Ara tArA tA pratyakSa karache|

smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha tomAderake du’Ti dalera madhya hate ekaTi samvandhe pratizruti diYechilena ye, oTA tomAdera karatalagata have| tomarA ei AzA karechile yena nirastra dalaTi tomAdera AYatte ese par3e, Ara AllAhara icchA chila ei ye, tini svIYa nirdezAvalI dvArA satyake satyarUpe pratiSThA karena evaM kAphiraderake nirmUla karena|
ihA e janya yAte satya satyarUpe evaM asatya asatyarUpe pratibhAta haYe yAYa, yadio eTA aparAdhIrA aprItikarai mane kare|

smaraNa kara sei saMkaTa muhurtera kathA, yakhana tomarA tomAdera ravera nikaTa kAtara kanThe prArthanA karechile, Ara tini sei prArthanA kavUla kare valechilenaH nizcaYai Ami tomAderake eka hAjAra mAlAikA/pherezatA dvArA sAhAyya karava, yArA ekera para eka Asave|
AllAha eTA karechilena zubha saMvAda hisAve evaM yAte tomAdera citta Azvasta haYa| vastutaH sAhAyyato zudhu AllAhara tarapha thekei haYe thAke| AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

yakhana tini (AllAha) tA~ra pakSa theke prazAntira janya tomAderake tandrAYa Acchanna karena, AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena, (uddezya chila) tomAderake era dvArA pavitra karavena evaM tomAdera hate zAitAnera ku-mantranA dUra karavena, Ara tomAdera hRdaYake sudRr3ha karavena evaM tomAdera pA sthira o pratiSThita rAkhavena|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rAvva mAlAka/pherezatAra nikaTa pratyAdeza karalenaH Ami tomAdera sAthe Achi| sutarAM tomarA ImAnadAradera supratiSThita o avicala rAkha, Ara yArA kAphira, Ami tAdera hRdaYe bhIti sRSTi kare diva| ataeva tomarA tAdera skandhe AghAta hAna, Ara AghAta hAna tAdera aGgulisamUhera pratiTi jor3AYa|
eTA e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare| ye vyakti AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhitA kare tAra jene rAkhA ucita ye, AllAha zAsti dAne khuvai kaThora|
sutarAM tomarA era svAda grahaNa kara, satya asvIkArakArIdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera lelihAna Agunera zAsti|
he ImAnadAragaNa! tomarA yakhana kAphira vAhinIra sammukhIna have takhana tAdera mukAvilA karA hate kakhanoi pRSTha pradarzana karavenA|

Ara sedina yuddha kauzala vA svIYa vAhinIra kendrasthale sthAna neYA vyatIta keha tAdera theke pRSTha pradarzana karale arthAt pAliYe gele se AllAhara gayave pariveSTita have, tAra AzraYasthala have jAhAnnAma, Ara jAhAnnAma katai nA nikRSTa sthAna|

tomarA tAderake hatyA karani, varaM AllAhai tAderake hatyA karechena| Ara (he nAvI!) yakhana tumi (dhUlAvAli) nikSepa karechile takhana tA mUlataH tumi nikSepa karani, varaM AllAhai tA nikSepa karechilena| eTA karA haYechila mu’minaderake uttama puraskAra dAna karAra janya, niHsandehe AllAha sava kichu zonena o jAnena|
Ara emanibhAvei AllAha kAphiradera cakrAnta durvala o nasyAt kare thAkena|

(he kAphirerA!) tomarAto phAisAlA cAccha, phAisAlAto tomAdera sAmanei ese geche| tomarA yadi ekhanao (musalimadera aniSTa karA hate) virata thAka tAhale tA tomAdera pakSei kalyANakara, Ara yadi punarAYa tomarA e kAja kara tAhale Amio tomAderake punarAYa zAsti diva, Ara tomAdera virATa vAhinI tomAdera konai upakAre AsavenA| niHsandehe AllAha mu’minadera sAthe raYechena|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara, tomarA yakhana tAra kathA zunacha takhana tomarA tAra Anugatya hate mukha phiriYe nionA|
tomarA ai sava lokera mata haYonA, yArA vale - AmarA ApanAdera kathA zunalAma, kAryataH tArA kichui zonenA|
AllAhara kAche nikRSTatama jIva hacche ai sava mUka o vadhira loka, yArA kichui vujhenA (arthAt viveka vuddhike kAje lAgAYanA)|

AllAha yadi jAnatena ye, tAdera madhye kalyANakara kichu nihita raYeche tAhale avazyai tini tAderake zonAra tAophIka ditena, tini yadi tAderake zonAtena tAhaleo tArA upekSA kare mukha phiriYe anya dike cale yeta|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera DAke sAr3A dAo yakhana tini tomAderake tomAdera jIvana saJcAraka vastura dike AhavAna karena| Ara jene rekha, AllAha mAnuSa o tAra antarera antarAle thAkena, parizeSe tA~ra kAchei tomAderake samaveta karA have|
tomarA sei phitanAke bhaYa kara yA tomAdera madhyakAra zudhumAtra yAlima o pApiSThaderakei vizeSabhAve kliSTa karavenA| tomarA jene rekha, nizcaYai AllAha zAsti dAne khuvai kaThora|

smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA bhU-pRSThe khuva durvalarUpe parigaNita hate, Ara tomarA ei zaMkAYa nipatita thAkate ye, lokerA akasmAt tomAderake dhare niYe yAve| (ei avasthAYa) AllAhai tomAderake (mAdInAYa) AzraYa dena evaM svIYa sAhAyya dvArA tomAderake zaktizAlI karena, Ara pavitra vastu dvArA tomAdera jIvikA dAna karena yena tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA jene zune AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karanA evaM tomAdera parasparera AmAnata samparkeo vizvAsa bhaGga karanA|
Ara tomarA jene rekha ye, tomAdera dhana sampada o santAna santati prakRta pakSe parIkSAra sAmagrI mAtra, Ara AllAhara nikaTa mahApuraskAra raYeche|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yadi AllAhake bhaYa kara tAhale tini tomAderake nyAYa-anyAYa pArthakya karAra ekaTi mAna nirNaYaka zakti dAna karavena, Ara tomAdera doSakraTi tomAdera hate dUra karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA karavena, AllAha var3ai anugrahazIla o maGgalamaYa|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana kAphirerA tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karechila, tomAke vandI karave athavA hatyA karave kiMvA nirvAsita karave| tArAo Sar3ayantra karate thAkuka evaM AllAhao (svIYa nAvIke vA~cAnora) kauzala karate thAkena, AllAha hacchena zreSTha kauzalI|
tAderake yakhana AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha kare zonAno haYa takhana tArA valeH AmarA zunechi, icchA karale AmarAo era anurUpa valate pAri, niHsandehe eTA purAkAlera upAkhyAna chAr3A kichu naYa|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tArA valechilaH he AllAha! ihA (kuraAna) yadi ApanAra pakSa hate satya haYa tAhale AkAza theke AmAdera upara prastara varSaNa karuna athavA AmAdera upara kaThina pIr3AdAYaka zAsti ene dina|
(he nAvI!) tumi tAdera madhye thAkA avasthAYa tAderake zAsti deYA AllAhara abhiprAYa naYa, Ara AllAha eTAo cAnanA ye, tArA kSamA prArthanA karate thAkave athaca tini tAderake zAsti divena|

kintu tAdera ki valAra Ache ye janya AllAha tAdera zAsti divenanA, yakhana tArA mAsajidula hArAmera patha rodha karache, athaca tArA mAsajidula hArAmera tattvAvadhAYaka naYa? AllAhabhIru lokerAi uhAra tattvAvadhAYaka, kintu tAdera adhikAMza loka eTA avagata naYa|
kA’vA gharera kAche tAdera sAlAta hala zisa deYA o karatAli pradAna chAr3A anya kichui naYa, sutarAM tomarA kupharI karAra kAraNe ekhana zAstira svAda grahaNa kara|

nizcaYai kAphirerA mAnuSake AllAhara patha theke nivRtta karAra uddeze tAdera dhana sampada vyaYa kare, tArA tAdera dhana-sampada vyaYa karatei thAkave, ataHpara oTAi zeSa paryanta tAdera janya duHkha o Aphasosera kAraNa have evaM tArA parAbhUtao have| Ara yArA kupharI kare tAderake jAhAnnAme ekatrita karA have|

eTA e kAraNe ye, AllAha bhAla theke mandake pRthaka karavena, Ara ku-janadera sakalake ekajanera upara apara janake stapIkRta karavena evaM ataHpara jAhAnnAme nikSepa karavena| erAi carama kSatigrasta loka|

tumi kAphiraderake valaH tArA yadi anAcAra theke virata thAke tAhale tAdera pUrvera aparAdha yA haYeche tA AllAha kSamA karavena| kintu tArA yadi anyAYera punarAvRtti kare tAhale pUrvavartIdera dRSTAntato raYechei|

tomarA sadA tAdera viruddhe lar3Ai karate thAkave yatakSaNa nA phitanAra avasAna haYa evaM dIna sampUrNa rUpe AllAhara janya haYe yAYa| Ara tArA yadi phitanA o viparyaYa sRSTi hate virata thAke tAhale tArA ki kareche tA AllAhai dekhavena|
Ara yadi tomAke nA’i mAne evaM dIna theke mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale jene rekha ye, AllAhai tomAdera (musalimadera) abhibhAvaka| tini katainA uttama abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI!

Ara tomarA jene rekha ye, yuddhe tomarA yA kichu gANImAtera mAla lAbha karecha ora eka paJcamAMza AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla, (rAsUlera) nikaTAtmIYa, iYAtIma, misakIna evaM mUsAphirera janya - yadi tomarA ImAna ene thAka AllAhara prati evaM yA Ami avatIrNa karechi AmAra vAndAra upara sei cur3Anta phAisAlAra dina, yedina du‘dala parasparera sammukhIna haYechila| Ara nizcaYai AllAha sakala viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana tomarA prAntarera ei dike chile, Ara tArA prAntarera apara dike zivira racanA karechila, Ara uSTrArohI kAphelA tomAdera apekSA nimnabhUmite chila, yadi pUrva hatei tomAdera o tAdera madhye yuddha samparke kona siddhAnta grahaNa karate cAite tAhale tomAdera madhye matAnaikya sRSTi hata, kintu yA ghaTAnora chila tA AllAha sampanna karAra janya ubhaYa dalake yuddhakSetre samaveta karalena, tAte ye dhvaMsa have se yena satya suspaSTa rUpe pratibhAta havAra para dhvaMsa haYa, Ara ye jIvita thAkave se yena satya suspaSTa rUpe pratibhAta havAra para jIvita thAke| AllAha sarvazrotA o mahAjJAnI|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana AllAha tomAke svapnayoge odera saMkhyA alpa dekhiYechilena, yadi tomAke tAdera saMkhyA adhika dekhAtena tAhale tomarA sAhasa hAriYe phelate evaM yuddha samparke tomAdera madhye matAnaikya sRSTi hata, kintu AllAha tomAderake rakSA karechena| antare yA kichu Ache se samparke tini savizeSa avahita|

Arao smaraNa kara, yA ghaTAnora chila, cUr3AntabhAve sampanna karAra janya yakhana du’dala mukhomukhI danDAYamAna haYechila takhana tomAdera dRSTite odera saMkhyA khuva alpa dekhAcchila, Ara odera cokheo tomAderake khuva svalpa saMkhyaka paridRSTa hacchila, samasta viSaYa o samasyAi AllAhara dike pratyAvartana kare|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhake adhika smaraNa kara evaM avicala thAkave yakhana kona dalera sammukhIna hao, AzA karA yAYa tomarA saphalakAma have|
tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera anugata hao| tomarA sAhasa o kSamatAhArA haYe yAve yadi nijedera madhye vivAda kara| tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara| AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe raYechena|

tomarA tAdera mato AcaraNa karanA yArA nijedera gRha hate sadarpe evaM lokaderake (nijedera zakti) pradarzana kare vera haYa o mAnuSake AllAhara patha hate nivRtta rAkhe, tArA yA kare AllAha tA pariveSTana kare raYechena|

smaraNa kara, yakhana zAitAna tAdera kAryAvalIke tAdera dRSTite khuva cAkacikyamaYa o zobhanIYa kare dekhAcchila, se garvabhare valechilaH kona mAnuSai Aja tomAdera upara vijaYa lAbha karate pAravenA, Ami sAhAyyArthe tomAdera nikaTai thAkava| kintu ubhaYa vAhinIra madhye yakhana pratyakSa yuddha zuru hala takhana se pRSTha pradarzana kare sare par3ala evaM valalaH Ami tomAdera viSaYe dAYitva mukta, Ami yA dekhechi tomarA tA dekhanA, Ami AllAhake bhaYa kari, Ara AllAha zAsti dAne khuvai kaThora|
yArA munAphika, antare yAdera vyAdhi raYeche tArA vale, tAdera dharma tAderake vibhrAnta kareche| ye keha AllAhara upara vizvAsa sthApana kare, nizcaYai AllAha mahA parAkrAnta, prajJAmaYa|

tumi yadi ai avasthA dekhate yakhana mAlAikA/pherezatArA kAphiradera mukhamanDala o pRSThadeze AghAta hene tAdera mRtyu ghaTiYeche, (Ara valache) tomarA jAhAnnAmera yantraNAdAYaka zAstira svAda grahaNa kara|
ei zAsti hala tomAdera sei kAjerai pariNAma phala yA tomAdera du’hAta pUrvAhnei AYojana karechila, AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera upara kakhanao atyAcArI nana|

eTA phira‘Aunera vaMza o tAdera pUrvavartI lokadera avasthAra nyAYa; tArA AllAhara nidarzanake pratyAkhyAna karechila| phale AllAha tAdera pApera kAraNe tAderake pAkar3Ao karalena, niHsandehe AllAha mahAzaktimAna o kaThina zAstidAtA|

ei zAstira kAraNa ei ye, AllAha yadi kona jAtira upara ni‘AmAta dAna karena sei ni‘AmAta tatakSaNa paryanta parivartana karenanA, yatakSaNa paryanta sei jAti nijedera avasthA parivartana nA kare, niHsandehe AllAha mahAzrotA o mahAjJAnI|

phira‘Aunera vaMzadhara o tatpUrvera jAtisamUhera nyAYa tArA tAdera ravera nidarzanasamUha mithyA pratipanna kareche| phale Ami tAdera pApera kAraNe tAderake dhvaMsa karechi evaM phira‘Aunera vaMzadharake (samudre) nimajjita karechi, tArA pratyekei chila yulamakArI|
nizcaYai AllAhara nikaTa nikRSTa jIva tArAi yArA kupharI kare evaM yArA ImAna AnenA|
odera madhye yAdera sAthe tumi cuktivaddha haYecha tArAo nikRSTa, tArA prativArei kRta cukti bhaGga kareche, (cukti bhaGgera vyApAre AllAhake kichumAtra) tArA bhaYa karenA|
ataeva tomarA yadi tAderake yuddhera mAidAne AYatte Anate pAra tAhale tAderake tAdera pichane yArA raYeche tAdera hate vicchinna kare emanabhAve zAYestA kara yAte tArA zikSA pAYa|

(he nAvI!) tumi yadi kona sampradAYera vizvAsa bhaGgera AzaMkA kara tAhale tomAra cuktikeo prakAzyabhAve tAdera sAmane cukti bhaGgera khavara diYe dAo, nizcaYai AllAha vizvAsa bhaGgakArIderake pachanda karenanA|
yArA kAphira tArA (vadara prAntare prANa vA~cAte pere) yena mane nA kare ye, tArA paritrANa peYeche, tArA mu’minagaNake hatavala karate pAravenA|

tomarA kAphiradera mukAvilA karAra janya yathAsAdhya zakti o sadAsajjita azvavAhinI prastuta rAkhave yaddavArA AllAhara zakra o tomAdera zakraderake bhIta santrasta karave, echAr3A anyAnyaderakeo yAderake tomarA jAnanA, kintu AllAha jAnena| Ara tomarA AllAhara pathe yA kichu vyaYa kara, tAra pratidAna tomAderake puropuri pradAna karA have, tomAdera prati (kama diYe) atyAcAra karA havenA|
yadi tArA (kAphirerA) sandhira dike jhu~ke par3e tAhale tumio sandhi karate AgrahI hao, Ara AllAhara upara bharasA kara, niHsandehe tini sarvazrotA o sarvajJAta|

Ara tArA yadi tomAke pratArita karAra icchA kare tAhale tomAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa, tini emana (mahAzaktizAlI) ye, (gAivi) sAhAyya (pherezatA) dvArA evaM mu’minagaNa dvArA tomAke zaktizAlI karechena|

Ara tini mu’minadera antare prIti o aikya sthApana karechena, tumi yadi pRthivIra samudaYa sampadao vyaYa karate tavuo tAdera antare prIti, sadbhAva o aikya sthApana karate pAratenA, kintu AllAhai odera parasparera madhye prIti o sadbhAva sthApana kare diYechena, niHsandehe tini mahAzaktimAna o mahAkauzalI|
he nAvI! tomAra janya o tomAra anusArI mu’minadera janya (sarvakSetre) AllAhai yatheSTa|

he nAvI! mu’minaderake jihAdera janya uddhuddha kara, tomAdera madhye yadi vizajana dhairyazIla mujAhida thAke tAhale tArA du’za jana kAphirera upara jaYayukta have, Ara tomAdera madhye eka‘za jana thAkale tArA eka hAjAra kAphirera upara vijaYI have, kAraNa tArA emana eka sampradAYa yAdera vodhazakti nei, kichui vojhenA|

AllAha ekSaNe tomAdera guru dAYitva lAghava kare dilena, tomAdera madhye ye daihika durvalatA raYeche se samparke tini avagata Achena, etadasattveo tomAdera madhye ekaza’ jana dhairyazIla loka thAkale tArA du’za’ jana kAphirera upara jaYayukta have, Ara eka hAjAra jana thAkale tArA AllAhara hukume du’hAjAra kAphirera upara vijaYa lAbha karave, AllAha dhairyazIladera sAthe raYechena|

kona nAvIra pakSe takhana paryanta vandI (jIvita) rAkhA zobhA pAYanA, yatakSaNa paryanta bhU-pRSTha (deza) hate zakra vAhinI nirmUla nA haYa, tomarA duniYAra kSaNasthAYI sampada kAmanA karacha, athaca AllAha cAna tomAdera parakAlera kalyANa, AllAha mahA parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
AllAhara lipi pUrvei likhita nA hale tomarA yA kichu grahaNa karecha tajjanya tomAdera upara kaThina zAsti Apatita hata|
sutarAM yuddhe tomarA yA kichu gaNImAta rUpe lAbha karecha tA hAlAla o pavitra rUpe bhoga kara, Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara, niHsandehe AllAha kSamAzIla o daYAlu|

he nAvI! tomAdera hAte yArA vandI haYeche tAderake vala, AllAha yadi tomAdera antare kalyANakara kichu raYeche vale avagata hana tAhale tomAdera hate (muktipaNa rUpe) yA kichu neYA haYeche tA apekSA uttama kichu dAna karavena evaM tomAderake kSamA kare divena, AllAha kSamAzIla o daYAlu|

Ara tArA yadi tomAdera sAthe vizvAsaghAtakatA karAra icchA rAkhe tAhale era pUrve AllAhara sAtheo tArA vizvAsaghAtakatA karechila| sutarAM tini tAdera upara tomAke zaktizAlI karechena; AllAha sarvajJa o prajJAmaYa|

yArA ImAna eneche, dInera janya hijarAta kareche, nijedera jAnamAla dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche evaM yArA AzraYa dAna o sAhAyya kareche, tArA parasparera vandhu| Ara yArA ImAna eneche kintu hijarAta kareni, tArA hijarAta nA karA paryanta tAdera abhibhAvakatvera kona dAYitva tomAdera nei, kintu tArA yadi dInera vyApAre tomAdera nikaTa sAhAyya prArthI haYa tAhale tAdera sAhAyya karA tomAdera kartavya, tave tomAdera evaM ye jAtira madhye cukti raYeche tAdera viruddhe naYa, tomarA yA karacha AllAha tA khuva bhAla rUpei lakSya karena|
yArA kupharI karache tArA paraspara parasparera vandhu, tomarA yadi (uparokta) vidhAna kAryakara nA kara tAhale bhU-pRSThe phitanA o mahA viparyaYa dekhA dive|

yArA ImAna eneche, (dInera janya) hijarAta kareche evaM AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche, Ara yArA (mu’minaderake) AzraYa diYeche evaM yAvatIYa sAhAyya sahAnubhUti prakAza kareche, tArAi hala prakRta mu’mina| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|

Ara yArA era pare ImAna eneche o hijarAta kareche evaM tomAdera sAthe ekatre jihAda kareche, tArA tomAderai antarbhukta; AllAhara vidhAne AtmIYagaNa eke anyera apekSA vezi hakadAra, niHsandehe AllAha pratiTi vastu samparke bhAla rUpe avahita|
AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa hate avyAhati (ghoSaNA karA) hacche ai muzarikadera prati yAdera sAthe tomarA sandhi karechile|*
sutarAM (he muzarikarA!) tomarA ei bhU-manDale cAra mAsa vicaraNa kare nAo evaM jene rekha ye, tomarA AllAhake akSama karate pAravenA, Ara nizcaYai AllAha kAphiraderake apadastha karavena|

AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera pakSa theke var3a hAjjera tArikhasamUhe janagaNera sAmane ghoSaNA karA hacche ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla ubhaYai ei muzarikadera (nirApattA pradAna karA) hate niHsamparka hacchena; tave yadi tomarA tAovAha kara tAhale tA tomAdera janya uttama, Ara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale jene rekha ye, tomarA AllAhake akSama karate pAravenA, Ara (he nAvI!) ei kAphiraderake yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda dAo|

kintu hyA~ ai sava muzarika hacche svatantra yAdera nikaTa theke tomarA cuktite Avaddha haYecha, ataHpara tArA tomAdera viruddhe kehakeo sAhAyya kareni| sutarAM tAdera sandhi cuktite tAdera nirdhArita samaYa paryanta pUrNa kara; nizcaYai AllAha satkarmazIladera pachanda karena |

ataHpara yakhana niSiddha mAsaguli atIta haYe yAYa takhana ai muzarikaderake yekhAne pAve tAdera sAthe yuddha kara evaM hatyA kara, tAderake dhare phela, tAderake avarodha kare rAkho evaM tAdera sandhAne ghA~TisamUhe avasthAna kara| ataHpara yadi tArA tAovAha kare, sAlAta AdAYa kare evaM yAkAta pradAna kare tAhale tAdera patha cher3e dAo| nizcaYai AllAha atizaYa kSamAparAYaNa, parama karuNAmaYa|

muzarikadera madhya hate yadi keha tomAra kAche AzraYa prArthanA kare tAhale tumi tAke AzraYa dAna kara, yAte se AllAhara kAlAma zunate pAYa; ataHpara tAke tAra nirApada sthAne pau~che dAo, ei Adeza e janya ye, erA emana loka yArA jJAna rAkhenA|

ei (kurAiza) muzarikadera aGgIkAra AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera nikaTa ki rUpe (valavat) thAkave yadi nA tAdera sAthe tomarA mAsajidula hArAmera sannikaTe aGgIkAra niYe thAka? ataeva ye paryanta tArA tomAdera sAthe saralabhAve thAke, tomarAo tAdera sAthe saralabhAve thAkave, niHsandehe AllAha saMyamazIladera pachanda karena|

ki kare cukti rakSA have, yadi avasthA ei haYa ye, tArA yadi tomAdera upara prAdhAnya lAbha kare tAhale tomAdera AtmIYatAra maryAdAo rakSA karavenA evaM aGgIkArerao nA| tArA tomAderake nijedera mukhera kathAYa santuSTa rAkhe, kintu tAdera antarasamUha asvIkAra kare, Ara tAdera adhikAMza lokai phAsika |
tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake nagaNya mUlye vikri kareche evaM tArA AllAhara patha theke (mu’minaderake) sariYe rekheche| nizcaYai tAdera kAja ati manda|
tArA kona mu’minera sAthe AtmIYatAra maryAdA rakSA karenA evaM nA aGgIkArera; Ara tArAi sImAlaMghanakArI|
ataHpara yadi tArA tAovAha kare evaM sAlAta AdAYa kare o yAkAta deYa tAhale tArA tomAdera dInI bhAi; Ara Ami jJAnI lokadera janya vidhAnAvalI vistAritabhAve varNanA kare thAki|

Ara yadi tArA aGgIkAra karAra para nijedera zapathagulike bhaGga kare evaM tomAdera dharmera prati doSAropa kare tAhale tomarA kupharera agranAYakadera viruddhe yuddha kara, (ei avasthAYa) tAdera zapatha railanA, haYato tArA virata thAkave|

tomarA emana lokadera viruddhe kena yuddha karavenA yArA nijedera zapathagulike bhaGga kareche, Ara rAsUlake dezAntara karAra siddhAnta grahaNa kareche evaM tArA tomAdera viruddhe nijerAi prathame AkramaNa kareche? tomarA ki tAderake bhaYa karacha? vastutaH AllAhakei tomAdera bhaYa karA ucita, yadi tomarA mu’mina haYe thAka|

tomarA tAdera sAthe yuddha kara| AllAha tomAdera hAte tAderake zAsti pradAna karavena evaM tAderake lAJchita karavena, Ara tomAderake tAdera upara vijaYI karavena evaM mu’minera antarasamUhake prazAnta o ThAnDA karavena|
Ara tAdera antarasamUhera kSobha dUra kare divena evaM yAra prati icchA, AllAha karuNA pradarzana karavena, AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

tomarA ki dhAraNA karecha ye, tomAderake ebhAvei cher3e deYA have? athaca AllAhato ekhanao tomAderake parIkSA karenani ye, kArA tomAdera madhya hate jihAda kareche evaM AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minagaNa chAr3A anya kehakeo antaraGga vandhu rUpe grahaNa kareni? Ara AllAha tomAdera samasta karmera pUrNa khavara rAkhena|

muzarikarA yakhana nijerAi nijedera kupharI svIkAra kare takhana tArA AllAhara mAsajidera rakSaNAvekSaNa karave emanato hate pArenA| tArA emana yAdera samasta kAja vyartha; evaM tArA jAhAnnAme sthAYIbhAve avasthAna karave|

AllAhara mAsajidaguli saMrakSaNa karA tAderai kAja, yArA AllAhara prati o kiYAmAta divasera prati ImAna Ane evaM sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta pradAna kare evaM AllAha chAr3A kehakeo bhaYa karenA| AzA karA yAYa ye, erAi saThika patha prApta|
