tomarA ki hAjIdera pAni pAna karAnoke evaM mAsajidula hArAmera rakSaNAvekSaNa karAke tAdera samAna sAvyasta kare rekhecha yArA AllAha o kiYAmAta divasera prati ImAna Ane o AllAhara pathe jihAda kare? tArA AllAhara samIpe samAna naYa; yArA sImA laMghanakArI tAderake AllAha supatha pradarzana karenanA|
yArA ImAna eneche o hijarAta kareche, Ara nijedera dhana o prANa dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda kareche tArA maryAdAYa AllAhara kAche ati var3a, Ara tArAi hacche pUrNa saphalakAma |
tAdera rAvva tAderake nijera pakSa theke susaMvAda dicchena rAhamAtera o ati santuSTira, Ara emana jAnnAtera yAra madhye tAdera janya cirasthAYI ni’AmAta thAkave|
ora madhye tArA anantakAla thAkave, niHsandehe AllAhara nikaTa raYeche zreSTha puraskAra|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA nijedera pitAderake o bhAiderake vandhu rUpe grahaNa karanA yadi tArA ImAnera mukAvilAYa kupharake priYa mane kare; Ara tomAdera madhya hate yArA tAdera sAthe vandhutva rAkhave, vastutaH ai sava lokai hacche var3a atyAcArI|

(he nAvI!) tumi tAderake vale dAoH yadi tomAdera pitA, tomAdera putragaNa, tomAdera bhAigaNa, tomAdera strIgaNa, tomAdera svagotra, Ara ai sava dhana sampada yA tomarA arjana karecha, Ara ai vyavasAYa yAte tomarA mandA par3Ara AzaMkA karacha athavA ai gRhasamUha yekhAne ati Anande vasavAsa karacha, AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera ceYe evaM tA~ra pathe jihAda karAra ceYe yadi (ei sava) tomAdera nikaTa adhika priYa haYa tAhale tomarA pratIkSA karate thAka ye paryanta AllAha nijera nirdeza pAThiYe dena| Ara AllAha Adeza amAnyakArIderake patha pradazarna karena nA|

avazyai AllAha tomAderake (yuddhe) vahu kSetre vijaYI karechena evaM hunAinera dineo| yakhana tomAderake tomAdera saMkhyAdhikya garve ummatta karechila, ataHpara sei saMkhyAdhikya tomAdera konai kAje Aseni, Ara bhU-pRSTha prazasta thAkA sattveo tA tomAdera upara saMkIrNa haYe gela, ataHpara tomarA pRSTha pradarzana pUrvaka palAYana karale|

ataHpara AllAha nija rAsUlera prati evaM anyAnya mu’minadera prati tA~ra sAkinA (prazAnti) nAyila karalena evaM emana sainyadala (arthAt pherezatA) nAyila karalena yAderake tomarA dekhani, Ara kAphiraderake zAsti pradAna karalena; Ara eTA hacche kAphiradera karmaphala|
ataHpara AllAha (ai kAphiradera madhya hate) yAke icchA daYA pradarzana karena, Ara AllAha hacchena ati kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYa|

he mu’minagaNa! muzarikarA hacche ekevArei apavitra, ataeva tArA yena e vacharera para mAsajidula hArAmera nikaTeo Asate nA pAre, Ara yadi tomarA dAridratAra bhaYa kara tAhale AllAha nija anugrahe tomAderake abhAvamukta karavena, yadi tini cAna| nizcaYai AllAha atizaYa jJAnI, var3ai hikamAtaoYAlA|

yArA AllAhara prati ImAna rAkhenA evaM kiYAmAta dinera pratio nA, Ara ai vastugulike hArAma mane karenA yegulike AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla hArAma valechena, Ara satya dharma (arthAt isalAma) grahaNa karenA, tAdera viruddhe yuddha karate thAka ye paryanta nA tArA adhInatA svIkAra kare prajA rUpe jiyiYA dite svIkAra kare|

iYAhudIrA valeH uyAYera AllAhara putra evaM nAsArArA valeH mAsIh AllAhara putra| eTA tAdera mukhera kathA mAtra (vAstave tA kichui naYa), tArAto tAdera matai kathA valache yArA tAdera pUrve kAphira haYeche| AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa karuna! tArA ulTA kona dike yAcche!

tArA AllAhake cher3e nijedera panDita o dharma yAjakaderake rAvva vAniYe niYeche evaM mAraiYAmera putra masIhakeo| athaca tAdera prati zudhu ei Adeza karA haYeche ye, tArA zudhumAtra eka mA‘vUdera ivAdAta karave yini vyatIta ilAha haoYAra yogya kehai naYa| tini tAdera aMzI sthira karA hate pavitra|

tArA erUpa cAcche ye, AllAhara nUrake nijedera mukhera phutkAra dvArA nirvApita kare deYa, athaca AllAha svIYa nUrake (dIna isalAma) pUrNatve pau~chAno vyatIta nirasta havenanA, yadio kAphirerA aprItikarai mane kare|
sei AllAha emana ye, tini nija rAsUlake hidAYAta (kuraAna) evaM satya dharma sahakAre preraNa karechena, yena oke sakala dharmera upara pravala kare dena, yadio muzarikarA aprItikara mane kare|

he mu’minagaNa! adhikAMza AhavAra evaM ruhavAna (iYAhuda o khRSTAnadera Alema o dharma yAjaka) mAnuSera dhana-sampada zArIYAta viruddha upAYe bhakSaNa kare evaM AllAhara patha hate virata rAkhe, Ara yArA svarNa o raupya jamA kare rAkhe evaM tA AllAhara pathe vyaYa karenA, tumi tAderake yantraNAdAYaka eka zAstira susaMvAda zuniYe dAo|

sedina jAhAnnAmera Agune aigulike uttapta karA have, ataHpara aiguli dvArA tAdera lalATasamUhe, pArzvadezasamUhe evaM pRSThadezasamUhe dAga deYA have, Ara valA haveH eTA hacche oTAi yA tomarA nijedera janya saJcaYa kare rekhechile, sutarAM ekhana nijedera saJcaYera svAda grahaNa kara|

nizcaYai AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTira dina theke AllAhara vidhAne mAsa gaNanAYa vAraTi| era madhye vizeSa rUpe cAraTi mAsa hacche sammAnita| eTAi hacche supratiSThita dharma| ataeva tomarA e mAsagulite (dharmera viruddhAcaraNa kare) nijedera kSati sAdhana karanA, Ara muzarikadera viruddhe sakale ekayoge yuddha kara, yemana tArA tomAdera viruddhe sakale ekayoge yuddha kare| Ara jene rekha ye, AllAha muttAkIdera sAthe raYechena|

nizcaYai ei (mAsagulira) sthAnAntara kupharera madhye Arao kupharI vRddhi karA, yadvArA kAphiraderake pathabhraSTa karA haYa| (tA e rUpe ye) tArA sei hArAma mAsake kona vachara hAlAla kare neYa evaM kona vachara hArAma mane kare, AllAha ye mAsagulike hArAma karechena, yena tArA ogulira saMkhyA pUrNa kare nite pAre, ataHpara tArA AllAhara niSiddha mAsagulike hAlAla kare neYa, tAdera duskarmaguli tAdera kAche zobhanIYa mane haYa, Ara AllAha eirUpa kAphiraderake hidAYAta (era tAophIka dAna) karenanA|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera ki hala ye, yakhana tomAderake valA haYa, vera hao AllAhara pathe, takhana tomarA mATite lege thAka (alasabhAve vase thAka)| tAhale ki tomarA parakAlera vinimaYe pArthiva jIvanera upara parituSTa haYe gele? vastutaH pArthiva jIvanera bhoga vilAsato AkhirAtera tulanAYa kichui naYa, ati sAmAnya|

yadi tomarA vera nA hao tAhale AllAha tomAderake kaThora zAsti pradAna karavena evaM tomAdera parivarte anya eka jAtike sthalAbhiSikta karavena, Ara tomarA AllAhara (dInera) konai kSati karate pAravenA| AllAha sarvamaYa kSamatAra adhikArI|

yadi tomarA tAke (rAsUlullAhake) sAhAyya nA kara tAhale AllAhai tAke sAhAyya karavena yemana tini tAke sAhAyya karechilena sei samaYe yakhana kAphirerA tAke dezAntara karechila, yakhana du’janera madhye ekajana chila se, ye samaYa ubhaYe guhAra madhye chila, yakhana se svIYa saGgIke (AvU vAkarake) valechilaH tumi viSaNNa haYonA, nizcaYai AllAha AmAdera saGge raYechena| ataHpara AllAha tAra prati svIYa prazAnti nAyila karalena evaM tAke zaktizAlI karalena emana senAdala dvArA yAderake tomarA dekhate pAoni evaM AllAha kAphiradera vAkya nIcu kare dilena, Ara AllAhara vANI samucca raila, Ara AllAha hacchena pravala prajJAmaYa|

abhiyAne vera hao svalpa saraJjAmera sAthei hoka, athavA pracura saraJjAmera sAthei hoka evaM AllAhara pathe nijedera dhana sampada o prANa dvArA yuddha kara, eTAi tomAdera janya ati uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|

yadi kichu Azu labhya hata evaM sapharao sahaja hata tAhale tArA avazyai tomAra sahagAmI hata; kintu tAderato pathera dUratvai dIrghatara vodha hate lAgala; Ara tArA acirei AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valaveH yadi AmAdera sAdhya thAkata tAhale AmarA nizcaYai tomAdera sAthe vera hatAma; tArA (mithyA vale) nijerAi nijederake dhvaMsa karache; Ara AllAha jAnena ye, tArA mithyAvAdI|
AllAha tomAke kSamA karechena (kintu) tumi tAderake kena anumati dile ye paryanta nA satyavAdI lokerA tomAra kAche prakAza haYe yeta evaM tumi mithyAvAdIderake jene nite?

yArA AllAhara prati o parakAlera prati ImAna rAkhe tArA nijedera dhana-sampada o prANa dvArA jihAda karAra vyApAre tomAra kAche avyAhati prArthanA karavenA, Ara AllAha ei parahejagAra lokadera samvandhe khuvai avagata Achena|

avazyai aisava loka tomAra kAche avyAhati ceYe thAke yArA AllAhara prati o AkhirAtera prati ImAna rAkhenA, tArA tAdera antarasamUha sandehe nipatita raYeche| ataeva tArA nijedera sandehe hatavuddhi haYe raYeche|

Ara yadi tArA (yuddhe) yAtrA karAra icchA karata tAhale sejanya kichu saraJjAmato prastuta karata, kintu AllAha tAdera yAtrAke apachanda karechena, e janya tAderake tAophIka denani evaM vale deYA hala, tomarAo ekhAnei akSama lokadera sAthe vase thAko|

yadi tArA tomAdera sAthe vera hata tAhale dviguNa vibhrATa sRSTi karA vyatIta Ara ki hata? tArA tomAdera madhye phAsAda sRSTi karAra uddeze daur3Adaur3i kare phirata, Ara tomAdera madhyera katipaYa uhA zravaNa karata; AllAha ei yAlimadera samvandhe khuva avagata Achena|
pUrveo tArA phitanA phAsAda sRSTi karechila evaM tomAra kAryakrama vyartha karAra ceSTAYa rata chila| zeSa paryanta haka o AllAhara nirdeza prakAzamAna hala, yadio tA tAdera manaHputa chilanA|

Ara tAdera madhye keha keha emanao Ache ye valeH AmAke (yuddhe gamana nA karAra) anumati dina evaM AmAke vipade phelavenanA| bhAla rUpe vujhe nAo ye, tArAto vipade par3ei Ache| Ara nizcaYai jAhAnnAma ei kAphiradera veSTana karavei|

yadi tomAra prati kona maGgala upasthita haYa tAhale tAdera janya tA cintAra kAraNa haYe dA~r3AYa, Ara yadi tomAra upara kona vipada ese par3e takhana tArA valeH AmarAto prathama thekei nijedera janya sAvadhAnatAra patha avalamvana karechilAma evaM tArA khuzI haYe cale yAYa|

valaH AllAha AmAdera janya yA nirdhAraNa kare diYechena tA chAr3A anya kona vipada AmAdera upara Apatita havenA, tinii AmAdera karma vidhAYaka, Ara sakala mu’minera kartavya hala, tArA yena nijedera yAvatIYa kAje AllAhara uparai nirbhara kare|

valaH tomarAto AmAdera janya du’Ti maGgalera madhye ekaTi maGgalera pratIkSAYa raYecha; Ara AmarA tomAdera janya ei pratIkSA karachi ye, AllAha tomAdera upara kon zAsti saMghaTana karavena - nijera pakSa hate athavA AmAdera dvArA; ataeva tomarA apekSA karate thAka, AmarAo tomAdera sAthe apekSamAna railAma|
tumi valaH tomarA santuSTira sAthe vyaYa kara kiMvA asantuSTira sAthe, tomAdera pakSa theke tA kakSaNai gRhIta havenA; niHsandehe tomarA haccha Adeza laMghanakArI sampradAYa|

Ara tAdera dAna khaYarAta grahaNa nA haoYAra kAraNa ei ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe kupharI kareche, Ara tArA zaithilyera sAthe chAr3A sAlAta AdAYa karenA, Ara tArA dAna karenA| kintu anicchAra sAthe|

ataeva tAdera dhana-sampada evaM santAna-santati yena tomAke vismita nA kare; AllAhara icchA zudhu eTAi ye, esava vastura kAraNe tAderake pArthiva jIvane AyAve Avaddha rAkhena evaM tAdera prANa kupharI avasthAYa vera haYa|
Ara tArA AllAhara kasama kare vale ye, tArA (munAphikarA) tomAderai antarbhukta; athaca tArA tomAdera antarbhukta naYa, varaM tArA hacche kApuruSera dala|
yadi tArA kona AzraYasthala peta, athavA guhA kiMvA lukiYe thAkAra ekaTu sthAna peta tAhale tArA avazyai kSipra gatite sedike dhAvita hata|

Ara tAdera madhye emana kataka loka raYeche yArA sAdAkAhara (vanTana) vyApAre tomAra prati doSAropa kare, ataHpara yadi tArA ai samasta sAdAkAha hate (aMza) prApta haYa tAhale tArA santuSTa haYa, Ara yadi tArA tA theke vaJcita haYa tAhale tArA asantuSTa haYa|

tAdera janya uttama hata yadi tArA ora prati santuSTa thAkato yA kichu tAderake AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla dAna karechilena, Ara valataH AmAdera pakSe AllAhai yatheSTa, bhaviSyate AllAha svIYa anugrahe AmAderake Arao dAna karavena evaM tA~ra rAsUlao, AmarA AllAharai prati AgrahAnvita railAma|

sAdAkAha hacche zudhumAtra garIvadera evaM abhAvagrastadera, Ara ei sAdAkAhara (AdAYera) janya niyukta karmacArIdera evaM (dInera vyApAre) yAdera mana rakSA karate (abhiprAYa) haYa (tAdera), Ara golAmadera AyAda karAra kAje evaM karjadAradera karje (karja parizodhe), Ara jihAde (arthAt yuddha saraJjAma saMgrahera janya) Ara musAphiradera sAhAyyArthe| ei hukuma AllAhara pakSa hate nirdhArita, Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, ati prajJAmaYa|

Ara tAdera madhye emana katipaYa loka Ache, yArA nAvIke yAtanA deYa evaM valeH tini pratyeka kathAYa karNapAta kare thAkena| vale dAoH ei nAvIto karNapAta kare sei kathAYa yA tomAdera janya kalyANakara, se AllAhara prati ImAna Ane, Ara mu’minadera vizvAsa kare, Ara se ai sava lokera prati rAhamAta svarUpa yArA mu’mina| Ara yArA AllAhara rAsUlake yAtanA deYa tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
tArA tomAdera kAche AllAhara nAme zapatha kare yena tArA tomAderake santuSTa karate pAre| AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake santuSTa karA tAdera janya vezi yarurI, yadi tArA satyikArera mu’mina haYe thAke|
tArA ki jAnenA ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera yArA viruddhAcaraNa kare, emana lokera bhAgye raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna? tArA tAte anantakAla thAkave, eTA hacche carama lAJchanA|

munAphikarA AzaMkA kare ye, tAdera (musalimadera) prati nA jAni emana kona sUrA nAyila haYa yA tAdera (munAphikadera) antarera kathA avahita kare deYa| tumi vale dAoH hyA~, tomarA vidrupa karate thAka, nizcaYai AllAha sei viSaYake prakAza karei divena ye samvandhe tomarA AzaMkA karachile|

Ara yadi tAderake jijJesa kara tAhale tArA vale diveH AmarAto zudhu AlApa AlocanA o hAsi tAmAzA karachilAma| tumi valaH tAhale ki tomarA AllAha, tA~ra AYAtasamUha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati hAsi tAmAsA karachile?
tomarA ekhana ajuhAta dekhiYonA, tomarAto ImAna AnAra para kupharI karecha, yadio Ami tomAdera madhya hate katakake kSamA kare dii, tavuo katakake zAsti divai| kAraNa tArA aparAdhI chila|

munAphika puruSa evaM munAphika nArIrA savAi eka rakama, asat karmera zikSA deYa evaM sat kAja hate virata rAkhe, Ara nijedera hAtasamUhake (AllAhara pathe vyaYa karA hate) vandha kare rAkhe, tArA AllAhake bhule geche| sutarAM tinio tAderake bhule gechena, niHsandehe munAphikarA hacche ati avAdhya|

AllAha munAphika puruSa o nArIdera evaM kAphiradera sAthe jAhAnnAmera Agunera aGgIkAra karechena, tAte tArA cirakAla thAkave, oTAi tAdera janya yatheSTa| Ara AllAha tAderake lA’nata karechena evaM tAdera janya raYeche cirasthAYI zAsti|

tomAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche, yArA chila tomAdera ceYe adhikatara zaktizAlI evaM dhana-sampada o santAnAdIra prAcuryyao chila tomAdera ceYe aneka vezI; tArA tAdera (pArthiva) aMza dvArA yatheSTa upakAra lAbha kareche| ataHpara tomarAo tomAdera (pArthiva) aMza dvArA khuva upakAra lAbha karale yemana, tomAdera pUrvavartIrA nijedera aMza dvArA phala bhoga karechila; Ara tomarAo vyAGgAtmaka hAsi tAmAsAYa erUpabhAve nimagna raYecha yemana tArA nimagna haYechila| tAdera kAryasamUha vinaSTa haYe geche duniYAYa o AkhirAte, Ara tArAi kSatigrasta|

tAdera kAche ki ai sava lokera saMvAda pau~cheni yArA tAdera pUrve gata haYeche, nUha sampradAYa evaM Ada o chAmUda sampradAYa, Ara ivarAhImera sampradAYa evaM mAdaiYAnera adhivAsIrA evaM vidhvasta janapadagulira? tAdera kAche tAdera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzanasamUha niYe esechila| vastutaH AllAha tAdera prati atyAcAra karenani, varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati atyAcAra karechila|

Ara mu’mina puruSarA o mu’minA nArIrA hacche paraspara eke anyera vandhu| tArA sat viSaYera zikSA deYa evaM asat viSaYa hate niSedha kare, Ara sAlAtera pAvandI kare o yAkAta pradAna kare, Ara AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Adeza mene cale, esava lokera prati AllAha avazyai karuNA varSaNa karavena, niHsandehe AllAha atizaYa kSamatAvAna, hikamAtaoYAlA|

Ara mu’mina puruSa o mu’minA nArIderake AllAha emana udyAnasamUhera o‘YAdA diYe rekhechena yegulira nimnadeze vaite thAkave naharasamUha, yekhAne tArA ananta kAla thAkave, Arao (o‘YAdA diYechena) uttama vAsasthAnasamUhera, ai sthAYI jAnnAte| Ara AllAhara santuSTi hacche sarvApekSA var3a ni‘AmAta, eTA hacche ati var3a saphalatA|
he nAvI! kAphira o munAphikadera viruddhe jihAda kara evaM tAdera prati kaThoratA avalamvana kara| tAdera vAsasthAna hacche jAhAnnAma; evaM oTA nikRSTa sthAna|

tArA AllAhara nAme zapatha kare valache ye, tArA kichui valeni; athaca nizcaYai tArA kupharI kathA valechila evaM isalAma grahaNera para kAphira haYe gela, Ara tArA emana viSaYera saMkalpa karechila yA tArA kAryakara karate pAreni; tArA zudhu e kAraNe pratizodha niYeche ye, AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUla svIYa anugrahe tAderake sampadazAlI karechena| yadi tArA tAovAha kare tAhale tA tAdera janya uttama have; Ara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale AllAha tAderake ihakAla o parakAle yantraNAdAYaka zAsti pradAna karavena, Ara bhU-pRSThe tAdera nA kona alI thAkave Ara nA kona sAhAyyakArI|

Ara tAdera madhye emana katipaYa loka raYeche yArA AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra kareH AllAha yadi AmAderake nija anugrahe (pracura sampada) dAna karena tAhale AmarA aneka dAna khaYarAta karava evaM khuva bhAla kAja karava|
kAryataH yakhana AllAha tAderake nija anugraha pradAna karalena, takhana tArA tAte kArpaNya karate lAgala evaM (Anugatya karA hate) mukha phiriYe nila, Ara tArAto mukha phiriYe rAkhatei abhyasta|

ataHpara tAdera zAsti svarUpa AllAha tAdera antarasamUhe niphAka (sRSTi) kare dilena, yA AllAhara sAmane hAyira haoYAra dina paryanta sthAYI thAkave e kAraNe ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe nijedera o‘YAdAra khelApha kareche; Ara e kAraNe ye, tArA mithyA valechila|
tAdera ki jAnA nei ye, AllAha tAdera manera gupta kathA evaM gopana parAmarza savai avagata Achena? Ara tAdera ki e khavara jAnA nei ye, AllAha samasta gAivera kathA khuvai jJAta Achena?

svataHpravRddha haYe sAdAkAha pradAnakArI mu’mina evaM yArA nija parizrama theke deYA chAr3A anya kichu dite pArenA tAdera prati yArA doSAropa kare/upahAsa kare, AllAha tAderake ei upahAsera pratiphala divena evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

(he muhAmmAda!) tumi tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara athavA nA kara (ubhaYai samAna), yadi tumi tAdera janya sattara vArao kSamA prArthanA kara tavuo AllAha tAderake kSamA karavenanA| kAraNa tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe kupharI kareche| Ara erUpa satyatyAgI sampradAYake AllAha patha pradarzana karenanA|

rAsUlullAhake (yuddhe gamanera para) pichane pare thAkA lokerA nijedera gRhe vase theke ullAsa prakAza karachila evaM tArA AllAhara pathe nijedera dhana o prANa diYe jihAda karAke apachanda karala| adhikanta valate lAgalaH tomarA ei garamera madhye vera haYonA| tumi vale dAo -jAhAnnAmera Aguna adhikatara garama, kata bhAla hata yadi tArA vujhate pArata!
ataeva tArA alpa kaYekadina (hese-khele) kATiYe dika, Ara pracura tArA kA~dave, ai sava kAjera vinimaYe yA tArA arjana karechila|

AllAha yadi tomAke (mAdInAYa) tAdera kona sampradAYera kAche phiriYe Anena, ataHpara tArA kona jihAde vera hate anumati cAYa, tAhale tumi vale dAoH tomarA kakhanao AmAra sAthI haYe vera havenA evaM AmAra sAthI haYe kona zakrara viruddhe yuddhao karavenA; tomarA pUrveo vase thAkAke pachanda karechile| ataeva ekhano tomarA ai sava lokera sAthe vase thAka yArA pazcAdavartI thAkAra yogya|

Ara bhaviSyate tAdera (munAphikadera) kona loka mArA gele tAra (jAnAyAra) sAlAta tumi kakhanai AdAYa karavenA evaM tAdera kAvarera pAze kakhanao dA~r3AvenA| tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe kupharI kareche evaM tArA kupharI avasthAYai mRtyu varaNa kareche|

Ara tAdera dhana-saspada o santAna-santati tomAke yena vismita nA kare; AllAha zudhu eTAi cAcchena ye, e samasta vastura kAraNe duniYAYa tAderake zAstite Avaddha rAkhena evaM tAdera prANavAYu kupharI avasthAYai vera haYe yAYa|

Ara yakhanai kuraAnera kona aMza e viSaYe avatIrNa karA haYa ye, tomarA AllAhara upara ImAna Ana evaM tA~ra rAsUlera saGgI haYe jihAda kara takhana tAdera madhyakAra sampadazAlI kSamatAvAna vyaktirA tomAra kAche avyAhati cAYa o valeH AmAderake anumati dina, AmarAo ekhAne avasthAnakArIdera sAthe theke yAi|
tArA antaHpuravAsinI nArIdera sAthe thAkate pachanda karala, tAdera antarasamUhera upara mohara lAgiYe deYA hala, kAjei tArA vujhate pArenA|
kintu rAsUla o tAra saGgIdera madhye yArA musalima chila tArA nijedera dhana sampada o prANa dvArA jihAda karala; tAderai janya raYeche yAvatIYa kalyANa evaM tArAi hacche saphalakAma|

AllAha tAdera janya emana udyAnasamUha prastuta kare rekhechena yegulira nimnadeza diYe naharasamUha vaYe calave, Ara tArA ora madhye anantakAla avasthAna karave; eTAi hacche (tAdera) virATa saphalatA|

Ara grAmavAsIdera madhya hate katipaYa vAhAnAkArI loka elo yena tArA anumati pAYa| Ara yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAthe sampUrNa rUpei mithyA valechila tArA ekevArei vase raila; tAdera madhye yesava loka kupharI kareche tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

durvala lokadera upara kona pApa nei, Ara nA rugnadera upara, Ara nA ai sava lokera upara yAdera kharaca karAra sAmarthya nei| yadi ei sava loka AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati niSThA rAkhe (evaM AntarikatAra sAthe Anugatya svIkAra kare) tAhale e sava sat lokera prati kona prakAra abhiyoga nei| Ara AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYa|

Ara ai lokadera uparao naYa, yakhana tArA tomAra nikaTa e uddeze Ase ye, tumi tAderake vAhana dAna karave, Ara tumi vale diYecha - AmAra nikaTato kona vAhana nei yAra upara Ami tomAderake upaviSTa karAi, takhana tArA emana avasthAYa phire yAYa ye, tAdera cakSusamUha hate azru vaite thAke ei anutApe ye, tAdera vyaYa karAra mata kona samvala nei|

abhiyogato zudhumAtra ai lokaderai upara yArA sAmarthyazAlI haoYA sattveo (yuddhe gamana nA karAra) anumati prArthanA karache, tArA antaHpuravAsinI mahilAdera sAthe thAkAke agrAdhikAra dicche| AllAha tAdera antarasamUhera upara mohara mere dilena, kAjei tArA (pApa-puNyake) vujhate pArenA|

tArA tomAdera kAche oyara peza karave yakhana tomarA tAdera kAche phire yAve; (he nAvI) tumi vale dAoH tomarA oyara peza karanA, AmarA kakhanao tomAderake satyavAdI vale mane karavanA, AllAha AmAderake tomAdera (jihAde nA yAoYAra) vRttAnta jAniYe diYechena, Ara bhaviSyateo AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUla tomAdera kAryakalApa paryavekSaNa karavena, ataHpara tomarA pratyAvartita have emana sattAra kAche yini adRzya evaM prakAzya sakala viSaYa avagata Achena, ataHpara tini tomAderake jAniYe divena yA kichu tomarA karechile|

hyA~, tArA takhana tomAdera sAmane zapatha kare valave, yakhana tomarA tAdera kAche phire yAve, yena tomarA tAderake tAdera avasthAra upara cher3e dAo; ataeva tomarA tAderake tAdera avasthAra upara cher3ei dAo; tArA hacche atizaYa apavitra, Ara tAdera ThikAnA hacche jAhAnnAma, ai sava karmera vinimaYe yA tArA karata |
tArA e janya zapatha karave yena tomarA tAdera prati khuzI haYe yAo, ataHpara yadi tomarA tAdera prati khuzI hao tAhale AllAhato emana duskarmakArI lokadera prati khuzI havenanA|

pallIvAsI lokerA kupharI o kapaTatAYa ati kaThora, Ara AllAha tA~ra rAsUlera prati yA avatIrNa karechena tAdera ai sava AhakAmera jJAna nA thAkAYa tAdera eirUpa haoYAi ucita; Ara AllAha hacchena mahAjJAnI, ati prajJAmaYa|

Ara ei grAmavAsIdera madhye emana loka raYeche ye, tArA yA kichu vyaYa kare tA jarimAnA mane kare evaM tomAdera janya durdinera pratIkSAYa thAke; (vastutaH) azubha Avatarna tAdera uparai patita prAYa, Ara AllAha khuva zonena, khuva jAnena |

Ara grAmavAsIdera madhye katipaYa loka emanao Ache yArA AllAhara prati evaM kiYAmAta dinera prati pUrNa ImAna rAkhe, Ara yA kichu vyaYa kare oke AllAhara sAnnidhya lAbhera upakaraNa o rAsUlera du‘A lAbhera upakaraNa rUpe grahaNa kare| smaraNa rekha, tAdera ei vyaYa kArya niHsandehe tAdera janya (AllAhara) naikaTya lAbhera kAraNa; nizcaYai AllAha tAderake nijera rAhmAte dAkhila kare nivena; nizcaYai AllAha hacchena ati kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYa|

Ara ye sava muhAjira o AnasAra (ImAna AnAYa) agravartI evaM prathama, Ara ye sava loka sarala antare tAdera anugAmI, AllAha tAdera prati rAyI-khuzi haYechena yemanabhAve tArA tA~ra prati rAyI haYeche, Ara AllAha tAdera janya emana udyAnasamUha prastuta kare rekhechena yAra taladeze naharasamUha vaite thAkave, yAra madhye tArA cirasthAYIbhAve avasthAna karave, tA hacche virATa kRtakAryatA|

Ara tomAdera maruvAsIdera madhya hate katipaYa loka evaM mAdInAvAsIdera madhya hateo katipaYa loka emana munAphika raYeche yArA niphAkera carame pau~che geche| tumi tAderake jAnanA, Amii tAderake jAni, Ami tAderake dviguNa zAsti pradAna karava, ataHpara (parakAleo) tArA mahA zAstira dike pratyAvartita have|

evaM Arao katakaguli loka Ache yArA nijedera aparAdhasamUha svIkAra kareche, yArA mizrita ‘Amala karechila, kichu bhAla, Ara kichu manda, AzA raYeche ye, AllAha tAdera prati karuNA dRSTi karavena, niHsandehe AllAha atizaYa kSamAzIla, parama karuNAmaYa|

(he nAvI!) tumi tAdera dhana-sampada hate sAdAkAha grahaNa kara, yadvArA tumi tAderake pavitra kare dive, Ara tAdera janya du‘A kara| niHsandehe tomAra du‘A hacche tAdera janya zAntira kAraNa, Ara AllAha khuva zonena, khuva jAnena|

tArA ki eTA avagata naYa ye, AllAhai nija vAndAdera tAovAha kavUla karena, Ara tinii dAna khaYarAta kavUla kare thAkena, Ara eTAo ye, AllAha hacchena tAovAha kavUla karate evaM anugraha karate pUrNa sAmarthyavAna?

he nAvI! tumi vale dAoH tomarA kAja karate thAka, ataHpara tomAdera kAryake acirei dekhe nivena AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o ImAnadAragaNa| Ara nizcaYai tomAderake pratyAvartita hate have emana eka sattAra nikaTa yini hacchena sakala adRzya o prakAzya viSaYera jJAtA, ataHpara tini tomAderake tomAdera sakala kRtakarma jAniYe divena|

evaM Arao kataka loka Ache yAdera vyApAra mulatavI raYeche AllAhara Adeza AsA paryanta, haYa tini tAderake zAsti pradAna karavena, athavA tAdera tAovAha kavUla karavena, Ara AllAha mahAjJAnI, prajJAmaYa|

Ara keha keha emana Ache yArA e uddeze mAsajida nirmANa kareche yena tArA (isalAmera) kSati sAdhana kare evaM kupharI kathAvArtA vale, Ara mu’minadera madhye vibheda sRSTi kare, Ara ai vyaktira avasthAnera vyavasthA kare ye era pUrva hatei AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera virodhI, Ara tArA zapatha kare valave, maGgala bhinna AmAdera Ara kona uddezya nei; Ara AllAha sAkSI Achena ye, tArA sampUrNa mithyAvAdI|

(he muhAmmAda!) tumi kakhanao ote (sAlAtera janya) dA~r3AvenA; avazya ye mAsajidera bhitti prathama dina hatei tAkaoYAra upara sthApita haYeche tA era upayogI ye, tumi tAte (sAlAtera janya) dA~r3Ave; ote emana sava loka raYeche yArA uttama rUpe pavitra haoYAke pachanda kare, Ara AllAha uttama rUpe pavitratA sampAdanakArIderake pachanda karena|

tAhale kon vyakti uttama, ye vyakti svIYa imArAtera bhitti AllAhabhItira upara evaM tA~ra santuSTira upara sthApana kareche athavA sei vyakti ye svIYa imArAtera bhitti sthApana kareche kona gahavarera kinArAYa, yA dhvase par3Ara upakrama, ataHpara tA tAke niYe jAhAnnAmera Agune patita haYa? Ara AllAha emana yAlimaderake (dharmera) jJAna dAna karenanA|
tAdera ei imArAta yA tArA nirmANa kareche, tA sadA tAdera mane khaTkA sRSTi karate thAkave, ye paryanta tAdera antarai chinnabhinna haYe yAYa, Ara AllAha hacchena mahAjJAnI|

niHsandehe AllAha mu’minadera nikaTa theke tAdera prANa o tAdera dhana sampadasamUhake era vinimaYe kraYa kare niYechena ye, tAdera janya jAnnAta raYeche, tArA AllAhara pathe yuddha kare, yAte tArA (kakhanao) hatyA kare evaM (kakhanao) nihata haYa, era kAraNe (jAnnAta pradAnera) satya aGgIkAra karA haYeche tAorAte, iJjIle evaM kuraAne| nijera aGgIkAra pAlanakArI AllAha apekSA adhika Ara ke Ache? ataeva tomarA Ananda karate thAka tomAdera ei kraYa vikraYera upara, yA tomarA sampAdana karecha, Ara eTA hacche virATa saphalatA|

tArA hacche tAovAhakArI, ivAdAtakArI, AllAhara prazaMsAkArI, siYAma pAlanakArI, ruku o sAjadAhakArI, sat viSaYa zikSA pradAnakArI evaM manda viSaYe vAdhA pradAnakArI, AllAhara sImAsamUhera (arthAt AhakAmera) saMrakSaNakArI; Ara tumi emana mu’minaderake susaMvAda zuniYe dAo|
nAvI o anyAnya mu’minadera janya jAYeya naYa ye, tArA muzarikadera janya kSamA prArthanA kare, yadio tArA AtmIYai hoka nA kena, e kathA prakAza havAra para ye, tArA jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

Ara ivarAhImera nija pitAra janya kSamA prArthanA karA zudhu sei o‘YAdAra kAraNe chila, ye o‘YAdA se tAra sAthe karechila| ataHpara yakhana tAra nikaTa e viSaYa prakAza pela ye, se (pitA) AllAhara duzamana, takhana se tA hate sampUrNa rUpe nirlipta haYe gela| vAstavikai ivarAhIma chila atizaYa komala hRdaYa, sahanazIla|

Ara AllAha erUpa nana ye, kona jAtike hidAYAta karAra para pathabhraSTa karena, ye paryanta nA tAderake sei sava viSaYa pariskArabhAve vale dena, ye viSaYe tArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karave; nizcaYai AllAha hacchena sakala viSaYe sarvajJa|
nizcaYai AllAharai rAjatva raYeche AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne| tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna; AllAha chAr3A tomAdera nA kona vandhu Ache, Ara nA kona sAhAyyakArI|

AllAha anugrahera dRSTi karalena nAvIra avasthAra prati evaM muhAjira o AnasAradera avasthAra pratio, yArA nAvIra anugAmI haYechila emana saMkaTa muhurte yakhana tAdera madhyakAra eka dalera antara vicalita haoYAra upakrama haYechila| ataHpara AllAha tAdera prati anugraha dRSTi karalena; niHsandehe AllAha tAdera sakalera upara snehazIla, karuNAmaYa|

Ara ai tina vyaktira avasthAra pratio (anugraha karalena) yAdera vyApAra mulatavI rAkhA haYechila ei paryanta ye, takhana bhU-pRSTha nija prazastatA sattveo tAdera prati saMkIrNa hate lAgala evaM tArA nijerA nijedera jIvanera prati vItazraddha haYe par3ala; Ara tArA vujhate pArala ye, AllAhara pAkar3Ao hate kothAo AzraYa pAoYA yete pArenA tA~rai dike pratyAvartana karA vyatIta; ataHpara tAdera avasthAra pratio anugrahera dRSTi karalena, yAte tArA tAovAha kare| nizcaYai AllAha hacchena atizaYa anugrahakArI, karuNAmaYa|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM satyavAdIdera saGge thAka|

mAdInAra adhivAsI evaM tAdera AzepAze ye sava pallI raYeche tAdera pakSe eTA ucita chilanA ye, tArA AllAhara rAsUlera saGgI nA haYa; Ara eTAo (ucita chila) nA ye, nijedera prANa tAra prANa apekSA priYa mane kare| era kAraNa ei ye, AllAhara pathe tAdera ye pipAsA, klAnti Ara kSudhA pAYa evaM tAdera emana padakSepa grahaNa karAYa kAphiradera ye krodhera kAraNa haYe thAke, Ara duzamanadera hate tArA yA kichu prApta haYa - era pratyekaTi sat kAja vale gaNya have| nizcaYai AllAha sat karmazIla lokadera zramaphala (sAoYAva) vinaSTa karenanA|

Ara choTa-var3a yA kichu tArA vyaYa kareche, Ara yata prAntara tAdera atikrama karate haYeche, tatsamudaYao tAdera nAme likhita haYeche, yena AllAha tAdera kRtakarmasamUhera ati uttama vinimaYa pradAna karena|

Ara mu’minadera eTAo samIcIna naYa ye, (jihAdera janya) savAi ekatre vera haYe par3e; sutarAM emana kena karA haYanA ye, tAdera pratyekaTi var3a dala hate eka ekaTi choTa dala (jihAde) vahirgata haYa, yAte avaziSTa loka dharmajJAna arjana karate thAke, Ara yAte tArA nija kAomake (nApharamAnI hate) bhaYa pradarzana kare yakhana tArA tAdera nikaTa pratyAvartana kare, yena tArA paraheya kare calate pAre|
he mu’minagaNa! ai kAphiradera sAthe yuddha kara yArA tomAdera AzepAze avasthAna karache, yena tArA tomAdera madhye kaThoratA khu~je pAYa; Ara jene rekha ye, AllAha paraheyagAradera sAthe raYechena|

Ara yakhana kona sUrA avatIrNa karA haYa takhana keha keha vale, tomAdera madhye ei sUrA kAra ImAna vRddhi karala? avazyai ye sava loka ImAna eneche, ei sUrA tAdera ImAnake vardhita kareche evaM tArAi Ananda lAbha karache|
kintu yAdera antarasamUhe vyAdhi raYeche, ei sUrA tAdera madhye tAdera kaluSatAra sAthe Arao kaluSatA vardhita kareche, Ara tAdera kupharI avasthAYai mRtyu haYeche|
Ara tArA ki lakSya karenA ye, tArA prati vachara ekavAra athavA du’vAra kona nA kona vipade patita haYa? tavuo tArA tAovAha karenA, Ara nA tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

Ara yakhana kona sUrA nAyila karA haYa takhana tArA eke aparera dike tAkAte thAke (evaM iGgite vale) tomAderake keha dekhachenA to? ataHpara tArA cale yAYa; AllAha tAdera antaragulike (Alo theke) phiriYe diYechena, kAraNa tArA hacche nirvodha samAja!

tomAdera nikaTa Agamana kareche tomAderai madhyakAra emana ekajana rAsUla yAra kAche tomAdera kSatikara viSaYa ati kaSTadAYaka mane haYa, ye hacche tomAdera khuvai hitAkAMkhI, mu’minadera prati var3ai snehazIla, karuNAparAYaNa|

ataHpara yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tumi vale dAoH AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa, tini chAr3A anya keha mA‘vUda nei, Ami tA~rai upara nirbhara karachi, Ara tini hacchena ati var3a Arazera mAlika|
Alipha lAma rA, eTA hacche ati sUkSma tattvapUrNa kitAvera AYAta|

lokadera janya eTA ki vismaYakara mane haYeche ye, Ami tAdera madhya hate ekajanera nikaTa ahI preraNa karechi ei marme ye, tumi sakalake bhaYa pradarzana kara evaM yArA ImAna eneche tAderake ei susaMvAda dAo ye, tArA tAdera ravera nikaTa pUrNa maryAdA lAbha karave| kAphirerA valate lAgala ye, e vyaktito niHsandehe prakAzya yAdukara|

nizcaYai AllAhai hacchena tomAdera rAvva, yini AsamAnasamUhake evaM yamInake sRSTi karechena chaYa dine, ataHpara tini Araze samAsIna halena, tini pratyeka kAja paricAlanA kare thAkena| tA~ra anumati chAr3A supAriza karAra keha nei; emana AllAha hacchena tomAdera rAvva| ataeva tomarA tA~ra ivAdAta kara; tavuo ki tomarA vujhachanA?

tomAdera sakalake tA~rai dike phire yete have, AllAhara o‘YAdA satya; nizcaYai tinii prathamavAra sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tinii punarvAra sRSTi karavena, yAte erUpa lokadera yArA ImAna eneche evaM bhAla kAja kareche tAderake inasApha mata pratiphala pradAna karena; Ara yArA avizvAsI tArA pAna karAra janya pAve uttapta pAni evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantranAdAYaka zAsti tAdera kupharIra kAraNe|

AllAha emana, yini sUryake dIptimAna evaM cA~dake AlokamaYa vAniYechena evaM ora (gatira) janya mAnayilasamUha nirdhArita karechena yAte tomarA vacharasamUhera saMkhyA o hisAva jAnate pAra; AllAha esava vastu ayathA sRSTi karenani, tini ei pramANasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karechena aisava lokera janya yArA jJAnavAna|
niHsandehe rAta o dinera parivartanera madhye evaM AllAha yA kichu AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne sRSTi karechena tatsamudaYera madhye pramANasamUha raYeche ai lokadera janya yArA AllAhara bhaYa poSaNa kare|
yArA AmAra sAthe sAkSAtera AzA poSaNa karenA evaM pArthiva jIvanei paritRpta evaM etei nizcinta thAke evaM yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI samvandhe gAphila |
eirUpa lokadera ThikAnA hacche jAhAnnAma, tAdera kAryakalApera kAraNe|

nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche evaM bhAla kAja kareche, tAdera rAvva tAderake lakSya sthale (jAnnAte) pau~che divena tAdera ImAnera kAraNe, zAntira udyAnasamUhe, tAdera (vAsasthAnera) taladeza diYe naharasamUha vaite thAkave|

sekhAne tAdera vAkya haveH he AllAha! tumi mahAna, pavitra! evaM parasparera abhivAdana have sAlAma (AsasAlAmu ‘AlAikuma), Ara tAdera du‘Ara zeSa vAkya have ‘AlahAmadulillAhi rAvivala ‘AlAmIna’ (samasta prazaMsA sArA jAhAnera rAvva mahAna AllAhara janya)|

Ara AllAha yadi mAnuSera upara tvarita kSati sAdhana karatena, yemana tArA tvarita upakAra lAbha karate Agraha rAkhe, tAhale tAdera aGgIkAra kavei pUrNa haYe yeta! anantara Ami sei lokaderake, yArA AmAra nikaTa upasthita haoYAra cintA karenA, cher3e dii tAdera avasthAra upara, yena tArA tAdera avAdhyatAra madhye ghurapAka khete thAke|

Ara yakhana mAnuSake kona kleza sparza kare takhana AmAke DAkate thAke zuYe, vase evaM dA~r3iYeo; ataHpara yakhana Ami tAra sei kaSTa dUra kare dii takhana se nijera pUrvAvasthAYa phire Ase| ye kaSTa tAke sparza karechila tA mocana karAra janya se yena AmAke kakhanao DAkeini; ei sImA laMghanakArIdera kAryakalApa tAdera kAche eirUpai pachandanIYa mane haYa|

Ami tomAdera pUrve vahu sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechi, yakhana tArA yulama karechila, athaca tAdera nikaTa tAdera rAsUlagaNao pramANAdIsaha Agamana karechila, kintu kichutei tArA ImAna AnalanA| Ara Ami aparAdhIderake ei rUpei zAsti diYe thAki|
ataHpara Ami tAdera sthale tomAderake tAdera para bhUmanDale AvAda karalAma, yena Ami pratyakSa kari ye, tomarA ki rUpa kAja kara|

Ara yakhana tAdera sAmane AmAra AYAtasamUha pATha karA haYa - yA ati spaSTa, takhana ai sava loka, yAdera AmAra nikaTa upasthita haoYAra cintA nei - eirUpa valeH eTA chAr3A anya kona kuraAna AnaYana karuna athavA etei kichu parivartana kare dina| valaH AmAra dvArA ihA parivartana karA sambhava naYa, Amito zudhumAtra uhArai anusaraNa karava yA ahIyoge AmAra kAche pau~cheche| Ami yadi AmAra ravera nApharamAnI kari tAhale Ami eka ati bhISaNa dinera zAstira AzaMkA rAkhi|

tumi vale dAoH yadi AllAhara icchA hata tAhale, nA Ami tomAderake eTA pATha kare zonAtAma Ara nA AllAha tomAderake oTA jAnAtena| kenanA Ami era pUrveoto jIvanera eka dIrgha samaYa tomAdera madhye ativAhita karechi; tAhale ki tomarA etaTuku jJAna rAkhanA?

ataeva sei vyaktira ceYe adhika atyAcArI (yAlima) ke ye vyakti AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare athavA tA~ra AYAtasamUhake mithyA pratipanna kare? niHsandehe emana pApAcArIdera kichutei maGgala havenA|

Ara tArA AllAha chAr3A emana vastusamUhera ivAdAta kare yArA tAdera kona apakAra karate pArenA evaM tAdera kona upakArao karate pArenA| Ara tArA vale, erA hacche AllAhara nikaTa AmAdera supArizakArI| tumi vale dAoH tomarA ki AllAhake emana viSaYera saMvAda diccha yA tini avagata nana, nA AsamAne, Ara nA yamIne? tini pavitra evaM tAdera muzarikI kAryakalApa hate tini aneka urdhve|

Ara samasta mAnuSa (prathama) eka ummAtai chila, ataHpara tArA matabheda sRSTi karala| Ara yadi tomAra ravera pakSa hate eka nirdeza vANI prathame sAvyasta haYe nA thAkata tAhale ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karache tAra cUr3Anta mImAMsA haYe yeta|

Ara tArA valeH tAra prati tAra ravera pakSa hate kona mu’jiyA kena nAyila halanA? tumi vale dAoH gAivera khavara zudhumAtra AllAhai jAnena| ataeva tomarA pratIkSAYa thAka, Amio tomAdera sAthe pratIkSAYa thAkalAma|

Ara yakhana Ami mAnuSake kona ni‘AmAtera svAda upabhoga karAi tAdera upara kona vipada patita haoYAra para, takhanai tArA AmAra AYAtasamUha samvandhe durabhisandhi karate thAke| tumi vale dAoH AllAha ati druta kalAkauzala tairI karate pArena| nizcaYai AmAra mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNa tomAdera sakala durabhisandhi lipivaddha karache|

tini emana, yini tomAderake sthalabhAge o pAni pathe paribhramaNa karAna; yakhana tomarA naukAYa avasthAna kara, Ara sei naukAguli lokaderake niYe anukUla vAYura sAhAyye calate thAke, Ara tArA tAte Anandita haYa, (haThAt) tAdera upara eka pracanDa (pratikUla) vAYu ese par3e evaM pratyeka dika hate tAdera upara taraGgamAlA dheYe Ase, Ara tArA mane kare ye, tArA (vipade) veSTita haYe par3eche, (takhana) sakale khA~Ti vizvAsera sAthe AllAhakei DAkate thAkeH (he AllAha!) Apani yadi AmAderake eTA hate rakSA karena tAhale AmarA avazyai kRtajJa haYe yAva|

ataHpara yakhanai mA‘vUda tAderake uddhAra karena takhanai tArA bhUpRSThe anyAYabhAve vidrohAcaraNa karate thAke| he loka sakala! (zune rekha), tomAdera vidrohAcaraNa tomAderai (prANera) janya vipada have, pArthiva jIvane (eTA dvArA kichu phala) bhoga kare nAo, ataHpara AmArai kAche tomAderake phire Asate have, ataHpara Ami tomAdera yAvatIYa kRtakarma tomAderake jAniYe diva|

vastutaH pArthiva jIvanera avasthAto erUpa, yemana Ami AsamAna hate pAni varSaNa karalAma, ataHpara tA dvArA utpanna haYa yamInera udbhidaguli atizaYa ghana haYe, yA mAnuSa o pazurA AhAra kare; emana ki, yakhana sei yamIna nijera sudRzyatAra pUrNa rUpa dhAraNa karala evaM tA zobhanIYa haYe uThala, Ara ora mAlikarA mane karala ye, tArA ekhana ora pUrNa adhikArI haYeche, takhana dine athavA rAte ora upara AmAra pakSa hate kona Apada ese par3ala| sutarAM Ami oke emana nizcihna kare dilAma, yena gatakAla ora astitvai chilanA| erUpei AYAtagulite Ami vizada rUpe varNanA kari emana lokadera janya yArA cintA bhAvanA kare|
Ara AllAha tomAderake zAntira nivAsera dike AhavAna karena; evaM yAke icchA sarala pathe calAra kSamatA dAna karena|

yArA sat kAja kareche tAdera janya uttama vastu (jAnnAta) raYeche; evaM atirikta kichuo vaTe; Ara nA tAdera mukhamanDalake malinatA Acchanna karave, Ara nA apamAna; tArAi hacche jAnnAtera adhivAsI, tArA ora madhye anantakAla thAkave|

pakSAntare yArA manda kAja kareche tArA tAdera manda kAjera zAsti pAve ora anurUpa, evaM apamAna tAderake AcchAdita kare nive; tAderake AllAha (era zAsti) hate kehai rakSA karate pAravenA, yena tAdera mukhamanDalake AcchAdita kare deYA haYeche rAtera andhakAra starasamUha dvArA| erA hacche jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, tArA ora madhye ananta kAla thAkave|

Ara sei dinaTio ullekhayogya yedina Ami muzarikaderake ekatrita karava, ataHpara valavaH tomarA o tomAdera nirUpita zarIkarA sva sva sthAne avasthAna kara, ataHpara Ami tAdera madhye paraspara vicchinna kare diva evaM tAdera sei zarIkarA valaveH tomarAto AmAdera ivAdAta karatenA|
vastutaH AmAdera o tomAdera madhye AllAhai hacchena yathopayukta sAkSI ye, AmarA tomAdera ivAdAta samvandhe avagata chilAmanA|

sekhAne pratyeka vyaktii svIYa pUrva kRtakarmaguli parIkSA kare nive, evaM tAderake AllAhara dike pratyAvartita karA have, yini tAdera prakRta mAlika| Ara ye sava mithyA mA‘vUda tArA vAniYe niYechila tArA savAi tAdera theke dUre sare yAve|

tumi valaH tini ke, yini tomAderake AsamAna o yamIna hate riyka pau~chiYe thAkena? athavA ke tini, yini karNa o cakSusamUhera upara pUrNa adhikAra rAkhena? Ara tini ke, yini jIvantake prANahIna hate vera karena, Ara prANahInake jIvanta hate vera karena? Ara tini ke yini samasta kAja paricAlanA karena? takhana avazyai tArA valaveH AllAha! ataeva tumi valaH tAhale kena tomarA (zir‌ka hate) nivRtta thAkachanA?
sutarAM tinii hacchena AllAha, yini tomAdera prakRta rAvva, ataeva satyera para bhraSTatA chAr3A Ara ki raila? tAhale tomarA (satyake cher3e) kothAYa phire yAccha?
ebhAve samasta avAdhya lokadera samparke tomAra ravera ei kathA sAvyasta haYe gela ye, tArA ImAna AnavenA|

(he nAvI) tumi valaH tomAdera (nirUpita) zarIkadera madhye emana keha Ache ki ye prathamavArao sRSTi kare evaM punarAvartana karate pAre? tumi vale dAoH AllAhai prathamavArao sRSTi karena, ataHpara tinii punarvArao sRSTi karavena, ataeva tomarA (satya hate) kothAYa phire yAccha?

tumi valaH tomAdera zarIkadera madhye emana keha Ache ki ye satya viSaYera sandhAna deYa? tumi vale dAo, AllAhai satya viSaYera patha pradarzana karena; tAhale ki yini satya viSaYera patha pradarzana karena tini anusaraNa karAra sarvAdhika yogya, nAki ai vyakti ye anyera patha pradarzana karA chAr3A nijei patha prApta haYanA? tAhale tomAdera ki hala? tomarA kirUpa siddhAnta grahaNa karacha?
Ara tAdera adhikAMza loka zudhu alIka kalpanAra pichane calache; nizcaYai alIka kalpanA vAstava vyApAre moTei phalaprasu naYa; nizcaYai AllAha savai jAnena, yA kichu tArA karache |

Ara ei kuraAna kalpanA prasUta naYa ye, AllAha chAr3A anya kArao dvArA prakAzita haYeche, ihAto sei kitAvera satyatA pramANakArI yA era pUrve (nAyila) haYeche, evaM AvazyakIYa vidhAnasamUhera vizada varNanAkArI, (evaM) ete kona sandeha nei (ihA) vizvera ravera pakSa hate (nAyila) haYeche|
tArA ki erUpa vale ye, eTA tAra (nAvIra) svaracita? tumi vale dAoH tAhale tomarA era anurUpa ekaTi sUrA racanA kara evaM gAirullAha hate yAke icchA Deke nAo, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

varaM tArA emana viSaYake mithyA sAvyasta karache, yAke nija jJAnera paridhite AnaYana kareni, Ara ekhano tAdera prati ora pariNAma (AyAva) pau~cheni; erUpabhAve tArAo mithyA sAvyasta karechila, yArA tAdera pUrve gata haYeche| ataeva dekha sei atyAcArIdera pariNAma ki hala?
Ara tAdera madhye emana kataka loka Ache, yArA era prati ImAna Anave evaM emana kataka lokao Ache ye, tArA era prati ImAna AnavenA, Ara tomAra rAvva atyAcArIderake bhAla rUpe jAnena|

Ara (etadasattveo) yadi tArA tomAke mithyA sAvyasta karate thAke tAhale tumi vale dAoH AmAra karmaphala Ami pAva, Ara tomAdera karmaphala tomarA pAve| tomarA AmAra kRtakarmera janya dAYI nao, Ara Amio tomAdera karmera janya dAYI nai|
Ara tAdera kataka emana Ache yArA tomAra (kathAra) prati kAna pete rAkhe| kintu ki tumi vadhiraderake zonAve, yadi tAdera vodhazakti nA thAke?
Ara tAdera kataka emanao Ache yArA tomAke dekhache; tumi ki andhake patha dekhAte pArave, yadi tAdera arntadRSTi nA thAke?
nizcaYai AllAha mAnuSera prati kona yulama karenanA, varaM mAnuSa nijerAi nijederake dhvaMsa karache|

Ara (ai dinaTi tAderake smaraNa kariYe dAo) ye dina tini (AllAha) tAderake eirUpa avasthAYa ekatrita karavena yena tArA pUrNa dinera muhurtakAla mAtra avasthAna karechila, evaM tArA paraspara parasparake cinave; vAstavikai kSatigrasta hala ai sava loka yArA AllAhara sAthe sAkSAta haoYAke mithyA pratipanna kareche evaM tArA hidAYAta prApta chilanA|

Ara Ami tAdera sAthe ye zAstira aGgIkAra karachi, yadi ora sAmAnya aMzao tomAke dekhiYe dii, athavA tomAke mRtyu dAna kari, sarvAvasthAYa tAderake AmArai pAne Asate have, Ara AllAha tAdera sakala kRtakarmerai khavara rAkhena|
pratyeka ummAtera janya rAsUla raYeche, yakhana tAdera sei rAsUla (vicAra divase) ese par3ave, (takhana) tAdera mImAMsA karA have nyAYabhAve, Ara tAdera prati kona avicAra karA havenA|
Ara tArA valeH (AmAdera) ei aGgIkAra kakhana (saMghaTita) have, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao?

tumi vale dAoH AllAhara icchA vyatIta Ami AmAra nijera janyao kona upakAra vA kSatira adhikArI nai, pratyeka ummAtera (AyAvera) janya ekaTi nirdiSTa samaYa Ache; yakhana tAdera sei nirdiSTa samaYa ese pau~che takhana tArA muhurtakAla nA pazcAdapada hate pArave, Ara nA agrasara hate pArave|
tumi vale dAoH vala to, yadi tomAdera upara AllAhara AyAva rAte athavA dine Ase tAhale AyAvera madhye emana kon jinisa raYeche yA aparAdhIrA tAr3AtAr3i cAcche?
tAhale ki oTA yakhana esei par3ave, takhana oTA vizvAsa karave? (valA have) hyA~, ekhana mene nile| athaca tomarA ora janya tAr3Ahur3A karachile|
ataHpara yAlimaderake valA haveH cirasthAYI zAstira svAda grahaNa karate thAka, tomarAto tomAderai kRtakarmera phala pAccha|
tArA tomAke jijJesa karache, oTA (zAsti) ki yathArtha viSaYa? tumi vale dAoH hyA~, AmAra ravera kasama! oTA nizcita satya; Ara tomarA kichutei AllAhake apAraga karate pAravenA|

Ara yadi pratyeka muzarikera kAche ei parimANa (mAla) thAke ye, tA samagra pRthivIra sama parimANa haYa tAhale se tA dAna kareo nijera prANa rakSA karate cAve; evaM yakhana tArA AyAva dekhate pAve takhana (nijedera) anuzocanA prakAza karate sakSama havenA, Ara tAdera phAisAlA karA have nyAYabhAve evaM tAdera prati avicAra karA havenA|
sAvadhAna! AsamAnasamUhe evaM yamIne yA kichu Ache tA savai AllAhara; sAvadhAna! AllAhara aGgIkAra satya, kintu adhikAMza lokai vizvAsa karenA|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM tinii mRtyu ghaTAna, Ara tomarA savAi tA~rai kAche pratyAvartita have|

(he mAnava jAti!) tomAdera kAche tomAdera ravera tarapha hate emana viSaYa samAgata haYeche yA hacche nAsIhAta evaM antarasamUhera sakala rogera ArogyakArI, Ara mu’minadera janya oTA patha pradarzaka o rAhamAta|
tumi vale dAoH AllAhara ei dAna o rAhamAtera prati sakalerai Anandita haoYA ucita; tA oTA (pArthiva sampada) hate vahu guNe uttama yA tArA saJcaYa karache|

tumi valaH AllAha tomAdera janya yA kichu riyka pAThiYechilena, ataHpara tomarA ora kataka aMza hArAma evaM kataka aMza hAlAla sAvyasta kare nile; tumi jijJesa karaH AllAha ki tomAderake anumati diYechena, nA ki tomarA AllAhara upara mithyA Aropa karacha?
Ara yArA AllAhara upara mithyA Aropa kare tAdera kiYAmAtera dina samvandhe ki dhAraNA? vAstavika, mAnuSera upara AllAhara khuvai anugraha raYeche, kintu adhikAMza lokai akRtajJa|

Ara tumi ye avasthAYai thAka nA kena, Ara ye kona aMza hate kuraAna pATha kara evaM tomarA (anyAnya loka) ye kAjai kara, AmAra kAche sava kichurai khavara thAke, yakhana tomarA sei kAja karate zuru kara| kaNA parimANao kona vastu tomAra ravera (jJAnera) agocara naYa - nA yamIne, nA AsamAne| Ara tA hate kSudratara, kiMvA vRhattara, samastai suspaSTa kitAve (kuraAne) lipivaddha raYeche|
mane rekha, AllAhara vandhudera nA kona AzaMkA Ache, Ara nA tArA viSanna have|
tArA hacche sei loka yArA ImAna eneche evaM (pApa hate) paraheya kare thAke|
tAdera janya susaMvAda raYeche pArthiva jIvane evaM parakAleo| AllAhara vAkyasamUhe kona parivartana haYanA; eTA hacche virATa saphalatA|
Ara tomAke yena tAdera uktiguli viSaNNa nA kare| sakala kSamatA evaM iyyAta AllAharai janya; tini zonena, jAnena|

mane rekha, yA kichu AsamAnasamUhe Ache evaM yA kichu yamIne Ache, ei samastai AllAhara| Ara yArA AllAhake cher3e anya zarIkadera ivAdAta kare tArA kon vastura anusaraNa karache? tArA zudhu avAstava kheYAlera tAvedArI kare calache evaM zudhu anumAna prasUta kathA valache|

tini emana yini tomAdera janya rAta vAniYechena, yena tomarA tAte svasti lAbha kara| Ara dinakeo ebhAve sRSTi karechena ye, tA hacche dekhAzonAra upakaraNa| ote (tAohIdera) pramANasamUha raYeche tAdera janya yArA zone|

tArA valeH AllAhara santAna Ache, suvahAnAllAha! tinito kArao mukhApekSI nana| tA~rai adhIne raYeche yA kichu AsamAnasamUhe Ache evaM yA kichu yamIne Ache| tomAdera kAche era (ukta dAvIra) kona pramANao nei; AllAha samvandhe ki tomarA emana kathA Aropa karacho yA tomAdera jAnA nei?
yArA AllAhara upara mithyA racanA kare nizcaYai tArA saphalakAma havenA|
eTA duniYAra sAmAnya ArAma-AYeza mAtra| ataHpara AmArai dike tAdera phire Asate have, takhana Ami tAderake tAdera kupharIra kAraNe kaThina zAstira svAda grahaNa karAva|

Ara tumi tAderake nUhera itivRtta par3e zonAo, yakhana se nijera kAomake valalaH he AmAra kAoma! yadi tomAdera kAche durvaha mane haYa AmAra avasthAna evaM AllAhara AdezAvalIra nAsIhAta karA, tAhale AmArato AllAharai upara bharasA| sutarAM tomarA tomAdera (kalpita) zarIkaderake saGge niYe nijedera Sar3ayantra mAyavUta kare nAo, ataHpara tomAdera sei tadavIra (gopana Sar3ayantra) yena tomAdera duzcintAra kAraNa nA haYa, tArapara AmAra sAthe (yA karate cAo) kare phela, Ara AmAke moTei avakAza dionA|

ataHpara yadi tomarA parommukhai thAka tAhale Amito tomAdera kAche kona pArizramika cAinA, AmAra pArizramikato zudhu AllAharai yimmAYa raYeche| Ara AmAke hukuma karA haYeche, Ami yena musalimadera antarbhukta thAki|

ataHpara tArA tAke mithyA pratipanna karate thAke; ataeva Ami tAke evaM yArA tAra sAthe naukAYa chila tAderake nAjAta dilAma o tAderake AvAda karalAma, Ara yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake mithyA sAvyasta karechila tAderake nimajjita karalAma| sutarAM dekha ki pariNAma haYechila tAdera yAderake sAvadhAna karA haYechila|

AvAra Ami tAra pare apara rAsUladerake tAdera sampradAYera nikaTa preraNa karalAma| tArA tAdera nikaTa mu’jiyA’samUha niYe elo| etadasattveo tArA pUrve yA mithyA sAvyasta karechila pare tA mene neYAra chilanA; ebhAvei AllAha kAphiradera antarasamUhe mohara lAgiYe dena|
ataHpara Ami tAdera para mUsA o hArunake AmAra mu’jiyA sahakAre phira‘Auna o tAra pradhAnadera nikaTa pAThAlAma, ataHpara tArA ahaMkAra karala, Ara sei lokaguli chila pApAcArIparAYaNa|
ataHpara yakhana tAdera prati AmAra sannidhAna hate pramANa pau~chala takhana tArA valate lAgala, nizcaYai eTA suspaSTa yAdu|
mUsA valalaH tomarA ki ei yathArtha pramANa samparke emana kathA valacha, yakhana oTA tomAdera nikaTa pau~chala? eTA ki yAdu? athaca yAdukararAto saphalakAma haYanA!

tArA valate lAgalaH tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa e janya esecha ye, AmAderake sariYe dAo sei tarIkA hate, yAte AmarA AmAdera pUrva-puruSaderake peYechi, Ara pRthivIte tomAdera du’janera Adhipatya sthApita haYe yAYa? AmarA tomAdera du’janake kakhanao mAnavanA|
evaM phira‘Auna valalaH AmAra kAche samasta sudakSa yAdukaradera upasthita kara|
ataHpara yakhana yAdukararA elo, takhana mUsA tAderake valalaH nikSepa kara yA kichu tomarA nikSepa karate cAo|
ataHpara yakhana tArA nikSepa karala takhana mUsA valalaH yAdu eTAi, nizcaYai AllAha ekhanai eTAke vAnacAla kare divena; (kenanA) AllAha azAnti sRSTikArIdera kAja sArthaka karena nA|
Ara AllAha tA~ra vANI anuyAYI satyake pratiSThita karena, yadio pApAcArIrA tA aprItikara mane kare|

kintu mUsAra prati tAra kaomera kSudra ekaTi dala chAr3A keu ImAna Anala nA, e bhaYe ye, phiraAuna o tAdera pAriSadavarga tAderake phitanAYa phelave| Ara nizcaYa phira‘Auna chila yamIne pratApazAlI evaM nizcaYa se sImAlaGghanakArIdera antarbhukta|
Ara mUsA valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! yadi tomarA AllAhara upara ImAna rAkha tAhale tA~rai upara bharasA kara, yadi tomarA musalima hao|
tArA valalaH AmarA AllAharai upara bharasA karalAma| he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake ei yAlimadera lakSyasthala vAnAvenanA |
Ara AmAderake nija anugrahe ei kAphiradera (kavala) hate mukti dina|

Ara Ami mUsA o tAra bhAiYera prati ahI pAThAlAmaH tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ei lokadera janya misare vAsasthAna vahAla rAkha, Ara (sAlAtera samaYa) tomarA savAi nijedera sei gRhagulike sAlAta AdAYa karAra sthAna rUpe gaNya kara evaM sAlAta kAYema kara, Ara mu’minaderake zubha saMvAda jAniYe dAo|

Ara mUsA valalaH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani phira‘Auna o tAra pradhAnavargake dAna karechena jA~kajamakera sAmagrI evaM vibhinna rakamera jIvanopakaraNa| he AmAdera rAvva! era phale tArA ApanAra patha hate (mAnava manDalIke) vibhrAnta karache| he AmAdera rAvva! tAdera sampadagulike nizcihna kare dina evaM tAdera antarasamUhake kaThina karuna yAte tArA ImAna Anate nA pAre ai paryanta yatakSaNa tArA yantraNAdAYaka AyAvake pratyakSa kare|
tini (AllAha) valalenaH tomAdera ubhaYera du‘A kavUla karA hala| ataeva tomarA dRr3ha theka evaM tAdera patha anusaraNa karanA yAdera jJAna nei|

Ara Ami vAnI isarAIlake samudra pAra kare dilAma, ataHpara phira‘Auna tAra sainyadalasaha tAdera pazcAdAnusaraNa karala yulama o niryAtanera uddeze; emanaki yakhana se nimajjita hate lAgala takhana valate lAgalaH Ami ImAna enechi vAnI isarAIla yA~ra upara ImAna eneche, tini chAr3A anya mA‘vUda nei evaM Ami musalimadera antarbhukta hacchi|
ekhana ImAna Anacha? athaca pUrva (muhurta) paryanta tumi nApharamAnI karachile evaM vizRMkhalA sRSTikArIdera antarbhukta chile|
ataeva Ami Aja tomAra lAzake uddhAra karava, yena tumi tomAra paravartI lokadera janya upadeza grahaNera upakaraNa haYe thAka; Ara prakRta pakSe aneka loka AmAra upadezAvalI hate udAsIna raYeche|

Ara Ami vAnI isarAIlake thAkAra janya ati uttama vAsasthAna pradAna karalAma, Ara Ami tAderake AhAra karAra janya utkRSTa vastusamUha dAna karalAma, tArA matabheda kareni ai paryanta yatakSaNa tAdera nikaTa (AhakAmera) jJAna pau~chala| niHsandehe tomAra rAvva kiYAmAta divase tAdera madhye sei sava viSaYera mImAMsA karavena, yAte tArA matabheda karachila|

ataHpara (he nAvI) yadi tumi e (kitAva) samparke sandihAna hao, yA Ami tomAra nikaTa pAThiYechi, tAhale tumi tAderake jijJesa kare dekha, yArA tomAra pUrvekAra kitAvasamUha pATha kare| niHsandehe tomAra nikaTa eseche tomAra ravera pakSa hate satya kitAva, sutarAM tumi kakhanai saMzaYIdera antarbhukta haYonA|
Ara ai sava lokerao antarbhukta haYonA yArA AllAhara AYAtagulike mithyA pratipanna kareche, yena tumi dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta nA hao|
niHsandehe yAdera samvandhe tomAra ravera vAkya sAvyasta haYeche, tArA kakhanao ImAna AnavenA |
yadio tAdera nikaTa samasta pramANa pau~che yAYa, ye paryanta nA tArA yantranAdAYaka zAsti pratyakSa kare|

sutarAM emana kona janapadai ImAna Aneni ye, tAdera ImAna AnA upakArI haYeche, iunusera kAoma chAr3A| yakhana tArA ImAna Anala, takhana Ami tAdera theke pArthiva jIvanera apamAnajanaka zAsti vidUrita karalAma evaM tAderake sukha svAcchande thAkate dilAma eka nirdhArita kAla paryanta|
Ara yadi tomAra rAvva icchA karatena tAhale vizvera sakala lokai ImAna Anata| tAhale tumi ki mAnuSera upara yavaradasti karate pAra, yAte tArA ImAna Anei?
athaca AllAhara hukuma chAr3A kArao ImAna AnA sambhava naYa; Ara AllAha nirvodha lokadera upara (kupharIra) apavitratA sthApana kare dena|
vale dAoH tomarA lakSya kara, yA kichu raYeche AsamAnasamUhe o yamIne; Ara yArA ImAna AnenA, pramANAdI o bhaYa pradarzana tAdera kona upakAra sAdhana karate pArenA|

ataeva tArA zudhu ai lokadera anurUpa ghaTanAvalIra pratIkSA karache yArA tAdera pUrve gata haYeche| tumi vale dAoH AcchA tAhale tomarA ora pratIkSAYa thAka, Amio tomAdera sAthe pratIkSAratadera madhye railAma|
zeSa paryanta Ami svIYa rAsUladerake evaM mu’minaderake nAjAta dilAma, e rUpei Ami mu’minaderake nAjAta diYe thAki|

vale dAoH he lokasakala! yadi tomarA AmAra dIna samvandhe sandihAna hao tAhale Ami sei mA‘vUdadera ivAdAta karinA, AllAhake cher3e tomarA yAdera ivAdAta kara; kintu Ami sei AllAhara ivAdAta kari yini tomAdera tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna, Ara AmAke ei Adeza karA haYeche ye, Ami yena ImAna AnaYanakArIdera dalabhukta thAki|
Ara eTAo ye, nijake nije ei dharmera prati ebhAve niviSTa kare rAkhave ye, anyAnya sakala tarIkA hate pRthaka haYe yAo, Ara kakhanao muzarikadera antarbhukta haYonA|

Ara AllAhake cher3e emana kichura ivAdAta karanA yA nA tomAra kona upakAra karate pAre, Ara nA kona kSati karate pAre| vastutaH yadi erUpa kara tAhale tumi ematAvasthAYa yAlimadera antarbhukta haYe yAve|

AllAha yadi tomAke kona kaSTe nipatita karena tAhale tini chAr3A keha tA mocanakArI nei, Ara yadi tini tomAra prati kona kalyANa o zAnti pau~chAte cAna tAhale tA~ra anugrahera kona apasAraNakArI nei; tini svIYa anugraha nijera vAndAdera madhya hate yAke cAna dAna karena; evaM tini atyanta kSamAzIla, atizaYa daYAlu|

valaH he loka sakala! tomAdera kAche tomAdera ravera pakSa hate satya (dharma) eseche, ataeva ye vyakti saThika pathe Asave, vastutaH se nijera janyai pathe Asave; Ara ye vyakti pathabhraSTa thAkave tAra pathabhraSTatA tArai upare vartAve, Ara AmAke (rAsUlake) tomAdera upara dAYitvazIla karA haYani|
Ara tumi tomAra prati prerita ahIra anusaraNa kara, Ara dhairya dhAraNa kara ei paryanta ye, AllAha mImAMsA kare dena, evaM tinii uttama mImAMsAkArI|
Alipha lAma rA| eTi (kuraAna) emana kitAva yAra AYAtaguli (pramANAdI dvArA) mAyavUta karA haYeche| ataHpara vizadabhAve varNanA karA haYeche; prajJAmaYera (AllAhara) pakSa hate|
e (uddeze) ye, AllAha chAr3A kArao ivAdAta karanA; Ami (nAvI) tA~ra (AllAhara) pakSa hate tomAderake satarkakArI o susaMvAdadAtA|

Ara (e uddeze) ye, tomarA nijedera ravera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tA~ra prati niviSTa thAka| tini tomAderake sukha-sambhoga dAna karavena nirdiSTakAla paryanta evaM pratyeka adhika ‘AmalakArIke adhika sAoYAva divena; Ara yadi tomarA mukha phirAtei thAka tAhale Ami bhISaNa dinera zAstira AzaMkA kari|
AllAharai nikaTa tomAderake phire yete have evaM tini pratyeka vastura upara pUrNa kSamatA rAkhena|

jene rekha, tArA kuJcita kare nijedera vakSake, yena nijedera kathAguli AllAha hate lukAte pAre| sAvadhAna, tArA yakhana kApar3a (nijedera dehe) jar3AYa, tini takhanao sava jAnena tArA yA kichu gopana kare athavA prakAza kare| nizcaYai tini antarera kathAo jAnena|

Ara bhU-pRSThe vicaraNakArI emana kona prANI nei yAdera riyka AllAhara yimmAYa nA raYeche, Ara tini pratyekera dIrgha avasthAnera sthAna evaM alpa avasthAnera sthAnake jAnena, savai kitAve muvIne (lAuhe mAhaphuye) raYeche|

Ara tini emana, yini samasta AsamAna o yamInake sRSTi karechena chaYa dine evaM sei samaYa tA~ra Araza pAnira upara chila, yena tomAderake parIkSA kare nena ye, tomAdera madhye uttama ‘AmalakArI ke? Ara yadi tumi valaH nizcaYai tomAderake mRtyura para jIvita karA have, takhana ye sava loka kAphira tArA valeH eTAto nichaka spaSTa yAdu|

Ara yadi Ami kichu dinera janya tAdera theke zAstike mulatavI kare rAkhi tAhale tArA valate thAkeH sei zAstike kise ATake rekheche? smaraNa rekha, yedina oTA tAdera upara ese par3ave takhana tA kArao nivAraNe kichutei nivArita havenA, Ara yA niYe tArA upahAsa karachila tA ese tAderake ghire nive|
Ami yadi mAnuSake AmAra pakSa hate karuNAra svAda grahaNa karAi, ataHpara tAra rAza Tene dhari tAhale se nirAza o akRtajJa haYe yAYa|

Ara tAke vipada-Apada sparza karAra para Ami yadi tAke ni‘AmAtera svAda grahaNa karAi takhana se valate zuru kareH AmAra sava duHkha kaSTa dUra haYe gela| (Ara) se garva karate thAke, AtmaprazaMsA karate thAke|
kintu yArA dhairya dhAraNa kare o bhAla kAja kare emana lokadera janya raYeche kSamA evaM virATa pratidAna|

tumi ki aMzavizeSa varjana karate cAo ai nirdezAvalI hate yA tomAra prati ahI yoge prerita haYa? Ara tomAra mana saMkucita haYa ei kathAYa ye, tArA valeH tAra prati kona dhana-bhAnDAra kena nAyila halanA, athavA kena tAra sAthe ekajana (mAlAikA/pherezatA) AsenA? tumito ekajana satarkakArI mAtra, AllAhai savakichu pariveSTanakArI|

tAhale ki tArA vale ye, oTA se nijei racanA kareche? tumi vale dAoH tAhale tomarAo ora anurUpa racita dazaTi sUrA AnaYana kara evaM (nija sAhAyyArthe) ye samasta gAirullAhake DAkate pAra Deke Ana, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|

ataHpara yadi tArA tomAdera pharamAYeza pUrNa karate nA pAre tAhale tomarA dRr3ha vizvAsa rekha ye, ei kuraAna avatIrNa haYeche AllAharai jJAna (o kSamatA) dvArA; Ara eTAo ye, AllAha chAr3A Ara kona ilAha nei| tAhale ekhana tomarA musalima have ki?
yArA zudhu pArthiva jIvana evaM ora jAkajamakatA kAmanA kare, Ami tAdera kRtakarmagulira phala duniYAYai diYe dii, tAdera janya kichui kama karA haYanA|
erA emana loka ye, tAdera janya AkhirAte jAhAnnAma chAr3A Ara kichui nei; Ara tArA yA kichu karache tAo viphala have|

tArA ki emana vyaktidera samAna hate pAre yArA kAYema Ache tAdera ravera pakSa hate prerita spaSTa pramANera upara evaM yAra kAche tA~ra prerita eka sAkSI AvRtti kare; evaM tAdera kAche mUsAra kitAva raYeche, yA pathanirdeza o rAhamAta svarUpa? emana lokerAi era prati ImAna rAkhe| Ara anyAnya sampradAYera ye ihA (kuraAna) amAnya karave, jAhAnnAma have tAra pratizruta sthAna| ataeva tumi kuraAna samparke sandehe patita haYonA, niHsandehe eTi satya kitAva tomAra ravera sannidhAna hate| kintu adhikAMza loka ImAna AnenA|

Ara ai vyakti apekSA adhika atyAcArI (yAlima) ke have ye AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare? erUpa lokaderake tAdera ravera sAmane peza karA have evaM sAkSI (mAlAikAgaNa) valaveH erA ai loka yArA nijedera rAvva samvandhe mithyA Aropa karechila| jene rekha, emana yAlimadera janya AllAhara lA’nata,
yArA aparake AllAhara patha hate nivRtta rAkhata evaM ote vakratA vera karAra ceSTAYa lipta thAkata; Ara tArAto AkhirAteo amAnyakArI|

tArA (samagra) bhU-pRSThe AllAhake akSama karate pAreni, Ara nA tAdera janya AllAha chAr3A keha sahAYakao hala| erUpa lokadera janya dviguNa zAsti have; erA (avajJAra kAraNe AhakAmasamUha) nA zunate sakSama hacchila, Ara nA tArA (satya patha) dekhachila|
erA sei loka yArA nijerA nijedera sarvanAza kare pheleche, Ara ye sava upAsya (devatA) tArA gar3e rekhechila, tAdera dika theke orA savAi udhAo haYe geche|
eTA sunizcita ye, AkhirAte erAi have sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
nizcaYai yArA ImAna eneche evaM sat kAryAvalI sampanna kareche, Ara nijedera ravera prati jhu~ke par3eche erUpa lokerAi hacche jAnnAtavAsI, tAte tArA anantakAla thAkave|
ubhaYa sampradAYera dRSTAnta erUpa yemana eka vyakti, ye andha o vadhira, evaM Ara eka vyakti ye dekhateo pAYa evaM zunateo pAYa, ei du’ vyakti ki tulanAYa samAna have? tavuo ki tomarA vujhanA?
Ara Ami nUhake tAra kAomera nikaTa rAsUla rUpe preraNa karechi, (nUha valala) Ami tomAdera janya spaSTa bhaYa pradarzanakArI,
tomarA AllAha chAr3A Ara kArao ivAdAta karanA; Ami tomAdera upara eka bhISaNa yantraNAdAYaka dinera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|

ataHpara tAra sampradAYera madhye ye sava netRsthAnIYa loka kAphira chila tArA valate lAgalaH AmarAto tomAke AmAderai mata mAnuSa dekhate pAcchi; Ara AmarA dekhachi ye, zudhu ai lokerAi tomAra anusaraNa karache yArA AmAdera madhye nitAntai hIna o itara, kona rakama cintA-bhAvanA nA karei; Ara AmAdera upara tomAdera kona zreSThatvao AmarA dekhachinA, varaM AmarA tomAderake mithyAvAdI vale mane karachi|

se valalaH he AmAra kAoma! AcchA valata, Ami yadi svIYa ravera pakSa hate pramANera upara (pratiSThita haYe) thAki evaM tini AmAke nija sannidhAna hate rAhamAta (navuoYAta) dAna karena, ataHpara oTA tomAdera vodhagamya nA haYa, tAhale ki ai viSaYe tomAdera vAdhya karate pAri yakhana tomarA oTA avajJA karate thAka?

Ara he AmAra kAoma! Ami ete tomAdera kAche kona dhana sampada cAcchinA; AmAra vinimaYato zudhu AllAhara yimmAYa raYeche, Ara Ami ei mu’minaderake vera kare dite pArinA; nizcaYai tArA nijedera ravera samIpe gamanakArI, paranta Ami tomAderake nirvodha kAoma rUpe dekhachi|
he AmAra kAoma! Ami yadi tAderake vera karei dii tAhale AllAhara pAkar3Ao hate ke AmAke rakSA karave? tomarA ki etaTuku vujhanA?

Ara Ami tomAderake e kathA valachinA ye, AmAra nikaTa AllAhara sakala bhAnDAra raYeche| evaM Ami adRzyera kathA jAninA, Ara Ami eTAo valinA ye, Ami mAlAka/pherezatA| Ara yArA tomAdera cokhe hIna, Ami tAdera samvandhe eTA valate pArinA ye, AllAha kakhanao tAderake kona ni’AmAta dAna karavenanA; tAdera antare yA kichu Ache tA AllAha uttama rUpe jAnena, Ami erUpa valale anyAYai kare phelava|

tArA valalaH he nUha! tumi AmAdera sAthe virtaka karecha, anantara sei virtaka aneka vezi karecha| sutarAM ye samvandhe tumi AmAderake bhaYa dekhAccha tA AmAdera sAmane AnaYana kara, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|
se valalaH oTAto AllAha tomAdera sAmane AnaYana karavena yadi tini icchA karena evaM tomarA tA~ke akSama karate pAravenA|

Ara AmAra maGgala kAmanA (nAsIhata) karA tomAdera upakAre Asate pArenA, tA Ami tomAdera yatai maGgala kAmanA karate cAinA kena, yadi AllAharai tomAderake pathabhraSTa karAra icchA haYa| tinii tomAdera rAvva, Ara tA~rai kAche tomAderake phire yete have|

tAhale ki tArA (mAkkAra kAphirerA) vale, se (muhAmmAda) eTA (kuraAna) nijei racanA kareche? tumi vale dAoH yadi Ami tA nije racanA kare thAki tAhale AmAra ei aparAdha AmAra upara vartAve, Ara tomarA ye aparAdha karacha tA theke Ami sampUrNa mukta|
Ara nUhera prati ahI prerita halaH yArA ImAna eneche tArA chAr3A tomAra kAoma hate Ara kehai ImAna AnavenA, ataeva yA tArA karache tAte tumi moTei duHkha karanA|
Ara tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne o AmAra nirdezakrame naukA nirmANa kara, Ara AmAra kAche yAlimadera (kAphiradera) samparke kona kathA valanA, tAdera sakalake nimajjita karA have|

se naukA nirmANa karate lAgala, Ara yakhanai tAra kAomera pradhAnadera kona dala uhAra nikaTa diYe gamana karata takhanai tAra sAthe upahAsa karata| se valataH yadi tomarA AmAderake upahAsa kara tAhale AmarAo (ekadina) tomAderake upahAsa karava, yemana tomarA AmAderake upahAsa karacha|
sutarAM sattvarai tomarA jAnate pArave ye, kona vyaktira upara emana AyAva AsAra upakrama haYeche yA tAke lAJchita karave evaM tAra upara cirasthAYI AyAva nAyila have|

avazeSe yakhana AmAra pharamAna ese pau~chala evaM yamIna hate pAni uthale uThate lAgala, Ami valalAmaH pratyeka zreNIra prANI hate ekaTi nara evaM ekaTi mAdI arthAt du’ du’Ti kare tAte (naukAYa) uThiYe nAo evaM nija parivAravargakeo, tAke chAr3A yAra samvandhe pUrve nirdeza haYe geche, evaM anyAnya mu’minaderakeo| Ara alpa kaYekajana chAr3A kehai tA~ra sAthe ImAna Aneni|
Ara se valalaH tomarA ete ArohaNa kara, era gati o era sthiti AllAharai nAme; nizcaYai AmAra rAvva kSamAzIla, daYAvAna|

Ara sei naukATi tAderake niYe pavartatulya taraGgera madhye calate lAgala, Ara nUha svIYa putrake DAkate lAgala evaM se chila bhinna sthAne; he AmAra putra! AmAdera sAthe sAoYAra haYe yAo evaM kAphiradera sAthe thekanA|

se valalaH Ami ekhanai kona pAhAr3e AzraYa grahaNa karava yA AmAke pAni hate rakSA karave| se (nUha) valalaH Aja AllAhara zAsti hate kehai rakSAkArI nei, kintu yAra upara tini daYA karena| itomadhye tAdera ubhaYera mAjhe ekaTi taraGga antarAla haYe par3ala, ataHpara se nimajjitadera antarbhukta hala|

Ara Adeza halaH he yamIna! svIYa pAni zuSe nAo, evaM he AsamAna! theme yAo| takhana pAni kame gela o ghaTanAra parisamApti ghaTala, Ara naukA jUdI (pAhAr3a) era upara ese thAmala| Ara valA hala, anyAYakArIrA AllAhara rAhamAta hate dUre|
Ara nUha nija rAvvake DAkala evaM valalaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAra ei putraTi AmAra parivAravargerai antarbhukta, Ara ApanAra o‘YAdAo sampUrNa satya evaM Apani samasta vicArakera zreSTha vicAraka|

tini (AllAha) valalenaH he nUha! ei vyakti tomAra parivArera antarbhukta naYa, se asat karmaparAYaNa| ataeva tumi AmAra kAche emana viSaYera Avedana karanA ye samvandhe tomAra jJAna nei| Ami tomAke upadeza dicchi ye, tumi ajJa lokadera antarbhukta haYonA|

se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Ami ApanAra nikaTa emana viSaYera Avedana karA hate AzraYa cAcchi ye samvandhe AmAra jJAna nei, Ara Apani yadi AmAke kSamA nA karena tAhale Ami sampUrNa rUpe dhvaMsa haYe yAva|

valA halaH he nUha! avataraNa kara, AmAra pakSa hate sAlAma o vArAkAtasamUha niYe, yA tomAra upara nAyila karA have evaM sei dalasamUhera upara yArA tomAra sAthe raYeche; Ara aneka dala erUpao have yAderake Ami kichukAla (duniYAra) sukha svAcchandya dAna karava, ataHpara tAdera upara patita have AmAra pakSa hate kaThina zAsti|

eTA hacche gAivi saMvAdasamUhera antarbhukta, yA Ami tomAra kAche ahI mAraphata pau~che dicchi| itopUrve eTA nA tumi jAnate, Ara nA tomAra kAoma| ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara; nizcaYai zubha pariNAma muttAkIdera janyai|

Ara ‘Ada (sampradAYa) era prati tAdera bhAi hudake (rAsUla rUpe) preraNa karalAma| se valalaH he AmAra kAoma! tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A keha tomAdera mA‘vUda nei; tomarA zudhu mithyA udbhAvanakArI|
he AmAra kAoma! Ami era janya tomAdera kAche kona vinimaYa cAinA; AmAra vinimaYa zudhu tA~rai jimmAYa raYeche yini AmAke sRSTi karechena| tavuo ki tomarA vujhanA?

Ara he AmAra kAoma! tomarA (tomAdera pApera janya) tomAdera ravera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tA~rai prati niviSTa hao| tini tomAdera upara pracura vRSTi varSaNa karavena evaM tomAderake Arao zakti pradAna kare tomAdera zaktike vardhita kare divena, Ara tomarA pApe lipta haoYAra janya mukha ghuriYe nionA|

tArA valalaH he huda! tumito AmAdera sAmane kona pramANa upasthApana karani evaM AmarA tomAra kathAYa AmAdera upAsya devatAderake varjana karate pArinA, Ara AmarA kichutei tomAra prati vizvAsa sthApanakArI nai|

AmAdera kathA ei ye, AmAdera upAsya devatAdera madhya hate keha tomAke durdazAYa phele diYeche| se valalaH Ami AllAhake sAkSI rAkhachi evaM tomarAo sAkSI theka ye, Ami tA theke mukta, tomarA ye ivAdAte zarIka sAvyasta karacha,
tA~ra (AllAhara) sAthe| sutarAM tomarA savAi mile AmAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karate thAka, ataHpara AmAke sAmAnya avakAza dionA|
Ami AllAhara upara bharasA karechi, yini AmAra rAvva evaM tomAderao rAvva; bhU-pRSThe yata vicaraNakArI raYeche savAi tA~ra muSTite Avaddha; nizcaYai AmAra rAvva sarala pathe raYechena|

ataHpara yadi tomarA phire yAo tAhale AmAke ye vArtA diYe tomAdera prati pAThAno haYeche, Ami oTA tomAdera kAche pau~chiYechi; Ara AmAra rAvva bhU-pRSThe tomAdera parivarte anya lokaderake AvAda karavena evaM tomarA tA~ra konai kSati karate pAravenA| nizcaYai AmAra rAvva pratyeka vastura rakSaNAvekSaNa kare thAkena|
Ara yakhana AmAra (zAstira) hukuma ese pau~chala takhana Ami hudake evaM yArA tAra sAthe ImAnadAra chila tAderake svIYa anugrahe rakSA karalAma, Ara tAderake vA~cAlAma ati kaThina zAsti hate|
Ara tArA chila ‘Ada sampradAYa. yArA nijera ravera nidarzanagulike asvIkAra karala evaM rAsUladerake amAnya karala, pakSAntare tArA pratyeka uddhata svairAcArIra nirdeza anusaraNa karata|

Ara ei duniYAYao abhisampAta tAdera saGge raila evaM kiYAmAta divaseo; bhAla rUpe jene rekha! ‘Ada nija ravera sAthe kupharI karala; Arao jene rekha! dUre par3e raila ‘Ada, rAhamAta hate, yArA hudera kAoma chila|

Ara Ami sAmUda(sampradAYa) era nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihake nAvI rUpe preraNa karalAma| se valalaH he AmAra kAoma! tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A keha tomAdera mA‘vUda nei, tini tomAderake yamIna hate sRSTi karechena evaM tomAderake tAte AvAda karechena| ataeva tomarA tA~ra kAche kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara manoniveza kara tA~rai dike; nizcaYai AmAra rAvva nikaTe raYechena evaM tini Avedana grahaNakArI|

tArA valalaH he sAliha! tumito itopUrve AmAdera madhye AzA-bharasA sthala chile| tumi ki AmAderake ai vastura ivAdAta karate niSedha karacha yAdera ivAdAta AmAdera pitR-puruSerA kare eseche? Ara ye dharmera dike tumi AmAdera DAkacha, vastutaH AmarA tatsamvandhe gabhIra sandehera madhye raYechi, yA AmAderake dvidhA-dvandve phele rekheche|

se valalaH he AmAra kAoma! AcchA valata, Ami yadi nija ravera pakSa hate pramANera upara thAki (evaM) tini AmAra prati nijera rAhamAta (navuoYAta) dAna kare thAkena, Ami yadi AllAhara kathA nA mAni tAhale AmAke AllAha (zAsti) hate ke rakSA karave? tAhaleto tomarA zudhu AmAra kSatii karacha|

Ara he AmAra kAoma! eTA hacche AllAhara uSTrI yA tomAdera janya nidarzana| ataeva oke cher3e dAo yena AllAhara yamIne care khAYa, Ara oke khArApa uddeze sparza karanA, anyathAYa tomAderake Akasmika zAsti ese pAkar3Ao karate pAre|
anantara tArA oke mere phelala| takhana se valalaH tomarA nijedera ghare Arao tina dina vAsa kare nAo; eTA o‘YAdA, yAte vindumAtra mithyA nei|

ataHpara yakhana AmAra hukuma ese pau~chala, Ami sAlihake evaM yArA tAra sAthe ImAnadAra chila tAderake nija anugrahe rakSA karalAma, Ara vA~cAlAma sei dinera var3a lAJchanA hate; nizcaYai tomAra rAvva zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|
Ara sei yAlimaderake eka pracanDa dhvani ese Akramana karala yAte tArA nija nija gRhe upur3a haYe par3e raila|
yena tArA sei gRhagulite kakhanao vasavAsa kareni| bhAla rUpe jene rekha! chAmUda sampradAYa nija ravera sAthe kupharI karala| jene rekha, chAmUda sampradAYa rAhamAta hate dUre chiTake par3ala|
Ara AmAra prerita mAlAikA/pherezatA ivarAhImera nikaTa susaMvAda niYe Agamana karala| (evaM) tArA valalaH sAlAma! ivarAhIma valalaH sAlAma! ataHpara anati vilamve ekaTA bhAjA go-vatsa AnaYana karala|

kintu yakhana se dekhala ye, tAdera hAta sei khAdyera dike agrasara hacchenA takhana tAderake adbhuta bhAvate lAgala evaM mane mane tAdera theke zaMkita hala| (e dekhe) tArA valalaH bhaYa karavenanA, AmarA lUta sampradAYera prati prerita haYechi|
Ara tAra strI danDAYamAna chila, se hese uThalo| takhana Ami tAke (ivarAhImera strIke) susaMvAda dilAma isahAkera evaM isahAkera para iYAkUvera|
se valalaH hAYa kapAla! ekhana Ami santAna prasava karava vRddhA haYe! Ara AmAra ei svAmI ati vRddha| vAstavika eTAto ekaTA vismaYakara vyApAra!

tArA (mAlAka) valalaH Apani ki AllAhara kAje vismaYa vodha karachena? (he) ei parivArera lokerA! ApanAdera prati raYeche AllAhara rAhamAta o vArAkAta; nizcaYai tini samasta prazaMsAra yogya, mahimAnvita|
ataHpara yakhana ivarAhImera sei bhaYa dUra haYe gela evaM se susaMvAda prApta hala takhana AmAra prerita mAlAikAra sAthe lUtera kAoma samvandhe tarka-vitarka (jora supAriza) karate zuru karala|
vAstavika ivarAhIma chila var3a sahiSNu prakRtira, daYAlu svabhAva, komala hRdaYa|
he ivarAhIma! e kathA cher3e dAo, tomAra ravera Adeza ese geche evaM tAdera upara emana eka zAsti Asache yA kichutei pratihata karAra naYa|
Ara yakhana AmAra ai mAlAikAgaNa lUtera nikaTa upasthita hala takhana se tAdera janya cintita haYe par3ala evaM sei kAraNe antara saMkucita hala, Ara valalaH Ajakera dinaTi ati kaThina|

Ara tAra kAoma tAra kAche chuTe elo, evaM tArA pUrva hate ku-kAryasamUha karei Asachila| lUta valalaH he AmAra kAoma! (tomAdera ghare) AmAra ei kanyArA raYeche, erA tomAdera janya ati uttama, ataeva tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAke AmAra mehamAnadera sAmane apamAnita karanA; tomAdera madhye ki suvodha loka keha nei?
tArA valalaH tumito avagata Acha ye, tomAra ei kanyAgulira AmAdera kona praYojana nei, Ara AmAdera abhiprAYa ki tAo tomAra jAnA Ache|
se valalaH ki uttama hata yadi tomAdera upara AmAra kichu kSamatA calata, athavA Ami kona dRr3ha stambhera AzraYa nitAma!

tArA (mAlAikA) valalaH he lUta! AmarAto ApanAra ravera prerita vArtAvAhaka, tArA kakhanao ApanAra nikaTa pau~chate pAravenA, ataeva Apani rAtera kona eka bhAge nijera parivAravargake niYe cale yAna, ApanAdera keha yena pichanera dike phireo nA cAYa; kintu hyA~, ApanAra strI yAvenA, tAra uparao ai Apada Asave yA anyAnyadera prati Asave, tAdera (zAstira) aGgIkAra kRta samaYa hacche prAtaHkAla, prabhAta ki nikaTavartI naYa?
ataHpara yakhana AmAra hukuma ese pau~chala, Ami ai bhU-khanDera upari bhAgake nIce kare dilAma evaM ora upara jhAmA pAthara varSaNa karate lAgalAma, yA ekAdhAre chila (varSita hacchila),
yA vizeSa cihnita karA chila tomAra ravera nikaTa; Ara ai janapadaguli ei yAlimadera hate vezi dUre naYa|

Ara Ami mAdaiYAnera (adhivAsIdera) prati tAdera bhAi zu‘Aivake preraNa karalAma| se valalaH he AmAra kAoma! tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A Ara keha tomAdera ilAha nei; Ara tomarA parimApe o oyane kama karanA| Ami tomAderake svacchala dekhate pAcchi, Ara Ami tomAdera prati emana eka dinera zAstira bhaYa karachi yA nAnAvidha vipadera samaSTi have|
Ara he AmAra kAoma! tomarA parimApa o oyanake purApuribhAve sampanna kara evaM lokaderake tAdera dravyAdite kama karanA, Ara bhU-pRSThe phAsAda sRSTi kare sImA atikrama karanA|
AllAha pradatta yA avaziSTa thAke tA’i tomAdera janya ati uttama yadi tomAdera vizvAsa haYa, Ara Ami tomAdera pAhArAdAra nai|

tArA valalaH he zu‘Aiva! tomAra dharmaniSThA ki tomAke ei zikSA dicche ye, AmarA ai sava upAsya varjana kari yAdera upAsanA AmAdera pitR-puruSarA kare Asache? athavA eTA varjana karate vala ye, AmarA nijedera mAle nijedera icchAnusAre vyavasthA avalamvana kari? vAstavikai tumi haccha var3a sahiSNu, sadAcArI|

se valalaH he AmAra kAoma! AcchA valata, yadi Ami AmAra ravera pakSa hate pramANera upara pratiSThita thAki evaM tini AmAke nija sannidhAna hate ekaTi uttama sampada (navuoYAta) dAna karena, tAhale Ami ki rUpe pracAra nA kare pAri? Ara Ami eTA cAinA ye, Ami tomAdera viparIta sei sava kAja kari yA hate tomAderake niSedha karachi; Amito saMzodhana kare dite cAcchi, ye paryanta AmAra sAdhye haYa, Ara AmAra yA kichu praceSTA tA zudhu AllAharai sAhAyye haYe thAke; Ami tA~rai upara bharasA rAkhi evaM tA~rai dike pratyAvartana kari|

Ara he AmAra kAoma! AmAra prati tomAdera janya haTakAritA yena ei kAraNa nA haYe par3e ye, tomAdera upara sei rUpa vipadasamUha ese par3e yemana nUhera kAoma athavA hudera kAoma athavA sAlihara kAomera upara patita haYechila; Ara lUtera kAomato tomAdera hate dUre (yuge) naYa|
Ara tomarA tomAdera (pApera janya) ravera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara, ataHpara tA~ra dike manoniveza kara; nizcaYai AmAra rAvva parama daYAlu, ati premamaYa|

tArA valalaH he zu‘Aiva! tomAra varNita aneka kathA AmAdera vujhe AsenA evaM AmarA nijedera madhye tomAke durvala dekhachi, Ara yadi tomAra prati tomAra svajanavargera lakSya nA thAkato tAhale AmarA tomAke prastarAghAte cUrNa kare phelatAma, Ara AmAdera nikaTa tomAra konai maryAdA nei|

se valalaH he AmAra kAoma! AmAra parijanavarga ki tomAdera kAche AllAha apekSAo adhika maryAdAvAna? Ara tomarA tA~ke pazcAte phele rekhecha? nizcaYai AmAra rAvva tomAdera samasta kAryakalApake veSTana kare Achena|

Ara he AmAra kAoma! tomarA nijedera avasthAYa kAja karate thAka, Amio (AmAra) kAja karachi| sattvarai tomarA jAnate pArave ye, ke sei vyakti yAra upara emana zAsti Asanna yA tAke apamAnita karave evaM ke sei vyakti ye mithyAvAdI chila; Ara tomarA pratIkSAYa thAka, Amio tomAdera sAthe pratIkSAYa railAma|

(AllAha valena) Ara yakhana AmAra hukuma ese pau~chala takhana Ami mukti dilAma zu‘Aivake, Ara yArA tAra sAthe ImAnadAra chila tAderake nija rAhamAte evaM ai yAlimaderake AkramaNa karala eka vikaTa garjana| ataHpara tArA nija gRhe upur3a haYe par3e raila,
yena tArA ei gRhagulite vAsa kareni| bhAla rUpe jene nAo, rAhamAta hate dUre sare par3ala mAdaiYAna, yemana dUra haYechila chAmUda (sampradAYa) rAhamAta hate|
evaM Ami mUsAke preraNa karalAma AmAra mu’jiyAsamUha o suspaSTa pramANa sahakAre –
phira‘Auna o tAra pradhAnadera nikaTa| ataHpara tArAo phira‘Aunera matAnusAre calate raila evaM phira‘Aunera kona kathA moTei saThika chilanA|
kiYAmAta divase se nija sampradAYera Age Age thAkave, ataHpara tAderake upanIta karavena jAhAnnAme, Ara tA ati nikRSTa sthAna, yAte tArA upanIta have|
ei duniYAYa tAderake karA haYechila abhizApagrasta evaM abhizApagrasta have tArA kiYAmAtera dineo| kata nikRSTa sei puraskAra yA tArA lAbha karave|
eTA chila ei ye, janapadasamUhera katipaYa avasthA yA Ami tomAra nikaTa varNanA karachi, ogulira madhye kona konaTira sampUrNa vilupti ghaTeche|

Ami tAdera prati atyAcAra karini, kintu tArA nijerAi nijedera upara atyAcAra kareche| vastutaH tAdera konai upakAra kareni tAdera sei upAsyaguli yAdera tArA ivAdAta karata AllAhake cher3e, yakhana ese pau~chala tomAra ravera hukuma; tAdera kSati sAdhana chAr3A tArA Ara kono kichui vRddhi karalanA|
‘erUpai tomAra ravera pAkar3Ao| tini kona janapadera adhivAsIdera pAkar3Ao karena yakhana tArA atyAcAra kare| niHsandehe tA~ra pAkar3Ao hacche atyanta yantranAdAYaka, kaThora|

esava ghaTanAYa sei vyaktidera janya var3a upadeza raYeche yArA parakAlera zAstike bhaYa kare; oTA emana ekaTi dina have yedina samasta mAnuSake samaveta karA have evaM oTA hala sakalera upasthitira dina|
Ara Ami oTA zudhu sAmAnya kAlera janya sthagita rekhechi|
yakhana sei dina Asave takhana kona vyakti AmAra anumati chAr3A kathAo valate pAravenA| ataHpara tAdera madhye kataka durbhAgA have evaM kataka have bhAgyavAna|
ataeva yArA durbhAgA have tArAto jAhAnnAme erUpa avasthAYa thAkave ye, tAte tAdera cItkAra o ArtanAda hate thAkave|

tArA anantakAla sekhAne thAkave, ye paryanta AsamAna o yamIna sthAYI thAke| tave yadi AllAhara icchA haYa tAhale bhinna kathA; nizcaYai tomAra rAvva yA kichu cAna tA tini pUrNarUpe samAdhA karate pArena|

pakSAntare yArA haYeche bhAgyavAna, vastutaH tArA thAkave jAnnAte (evaM) tAte tArA ananta kAla thAkave, ye paryanta AsamAna o yamIna sthAYI thAke, kintu yadi AllAhara icchA haYa tAhale bhinna kathA; oTA aphuranta dAna have|

sutarAM erA yAra upAsanA kare ora samvandhe tumi etaTukuo saMzaYa vodha karanA; tArAo Thika sei rUpei ivAdAta karache ye rUpe tAdera pUrva-puruSarA ivAdAta karata| evaM nizcaYai Ami tAderake tAdera (zAstira) aMza pUrNabhAve diYe diva, ekaTuo kama nA kare|

Ara Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataHpara ote matabheda karA hala| Ara yadi ekaTi ukti tomAra ravera pakSa hate pUrvei sthirIkRta haYe nA thAkata tAhale odera cur3Anta mImAMsA haYe yeta| evaM ei lokerA era samvandhe emana sandehe (patita) Ache yA tAderake dvidhA dvandve phele rekheche|
