Ara nizcita ei ye, tomAra rAvva tAderake tAdera karmera pUrNa aMza pradAna karavena; nizcaYai tini tAdera kAryakalApera pUrNa khavara rAkhena|

ataeva tumi yebhAve AdiSTa haYecha, dRr3ha thAka evaM sei lokerAo yArA kupharI hate tAovAha kare tomAra sAthe raYeche, Ara (dharmera) ganDi hate ekaTuo vera haYonA; nizcaYai tini tomAdera kAryakalApa samyakabhAve pratyakSa karena|
Ara yAlimadera prati jhuke par3anA, anyathAYa tomAderake jAhAnnAmera Aguna sparza karave, Ara AllAha chAr3A tomarA kona sAhAyyakArI pAvenA, ataHpara tomAderake kona sAhAyyao karA havenA|
evaM sAlAtera pAvandI hao dinera du’ prAnte o rAtera kichu aMze; niHsandehe sat kAryasamUha asat kAryasamUhake miTiYe deYa; eTA hacche ekaTi (vyApaka) nAsIhAta, nAsIhAta mAnyakArIdera janya|
Ara dhairya dhAraNa kara| kenanA AllAha sat karmazIladera karmaphalake panDa karenanA|

vastutaH ye sava sampradAYa tomAdera pUrve gata haYeche tAdera madhye emana vuddhimAna loka haYani, yArA deze phAsAda vistAre vAdhA pradAna karata, sAmAnya kaYekajana chAr3A, yAderake Ami tAdera madhya hate rakSA karechilAma| Ara yArA avAdhya chila tArA ye ArAma AYeze chila, ora pichanei par3e raila evaM aparAdha pravaNa haYe par3ala|
Ara tomAra rAvva emana nana ye, janapadasamUhake anyAYabhAve dhvaMsa karavena, athaca ora adhivAsIrA sat kAje lipta raYeche|
evaM yadi tomAra ravera icchA hata tAhale tini sakala mAnuSake ekai matAvalamvI kare ditena, kintu tArA matabheda karatei thAkave,
kintu yAra prati tomAra ravera anugraha haYa| Ara e janyai tini tAderake sRSTi karechena; evaM tomAra ravera ei vANIo pUrNa have ye, Ami jina o mAnava sakalera dvArA jAhAnnAmake pUrNa karavai|
rAsUladera ai sava vRttAnta Ami tomAra kAche varNanA karachi, yaddArA Ami tomAra cittake dRr3ha kari| era mAdhyame tomAra kAche eseche satya evaM mu’minadera janya eseche upadeza o sAvadhAnavANI|
yArA vizvAsa karenA tAderake valaH tomarA yemana karacha, karate thAka evaM AmarAo AmAdera kAja karachi|
evaM tomarA pratIkSA kara, AmarAo pratIkSA karachi|

AkAzasamUha o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYera jJAna AllAharai evaM tA~rai kAche savakichu pratyAvartita have| sutarAM tA~ra ivAdAta kara evaM tA~ra upara nirbhara kara, Ara tomarA yA kara se samvandhe tomAra rAvva anavahita nana|
Alipha-lAma-rA eguli suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
Ami avatIrNa karechi ArAvI bhASAYa kuraAna yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
Ami tomAra kAche uttama kAhinI varNanA karachi, ahIra mAdhyame tomAra kAche ei kuraAna preraNa kare, yadio era pUrve tumi chile anavahitadera antarbhukta|
yakhana iusupha tAra pitAke valalaH he pitA! Ami egAraTi nakSatra, sUrya evaM cA~dake dekhechi - dekhechi oderake AmAra prati sAjadAhavanata avasthAYa|
se valalaH he AmAra putra! tomAra svapnera vRttAnta tomAra bhAidera nikaTa varNanA karanA; karale tArA tomAra viruddhe Sar3ayantra karave; zAitAnato mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|

ebhAve tomAra rAvva tomAke manonIta karavena evaM tomAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA divena, Ara tomAra prati o iYAkUvera parivAra parijanera prati anugraha pUrNa karavena yebhAve tini eTA pUrve pUrNa karechilena tomAra pitRpuruSa ivarAhIma o isahAkera prati| nizcaYai tomAra rAvva sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
iusupha o tAra bhAidera ghaTanAYa jijJAsudera janya nidarzana raYeche|
yakhana tArA (bhAiYerA) valechilaH AmAdera pitAra nikaTa iusupha evaM tAra bhAii (vina iYAmIna) adhika priYa, athaca AmarA ekaTi saMhata dala, AmAdera pitAto spaSTa vibhrAntitei raYechena |
iusuphake hatyA kara athavA tAke kona sthAne phele eso| phale tomAdera pitAra dRSTi zudhu tomAdera prati niviSTa have evaM tArapara tomarA bhAla loka haYe yAve|
tAdera madhye ekajana valalaH iusuphake hatyA karanA, varaM yadi tomarA kichu karatei cAo tAhale tAke kona gabhIra kupe nikSepa kara, yAtrI dalera keha tAke tule niYe yAve|
tArA valalaH he AmAdera pitA! iusuphera vyApAre Apani AmAderake avizvAsa karachena kena, yadio AmarA tAra hitAkAMkhI?
Apani AgAmIkAla tAke AmAdera sAthe preraNa karuna, se phalamUla khAve o khelAdhulA karave, AmarA avazyai tAra rakSaNAvekSaNa karava|
se valalaH eTA AmAke kaSTa dive ye, tomarA tAke niYe yAve evaM Ami bhaYa kari, tomarA tAra prati amanoyogI hale tAke nekar3e vAgha kheYe phelave|
tArA valalaH AmarA ekaTi saMhata dala haoYA sattveo yadi tAke nekar3e vAgha kheYe phele tAhaleto AmarA kSatigrastai hava|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAke niYe gela evaM tAke gabhIra kUpe nikSepa karate ekamata hala, ematAvasthAYa Ami tAke jAniYe dilAmaH tumi tAderake tAdera ei karmera kathA avazyai vale dive yakhana tArA tomAke cinavenA|
tArA rAte kA~date kA~date tAdera pitAra nikaTa elo|

tArA valalaH he AmAdera pitA! AmarA daur3era pratiyogitA karechilAma evaM iusuphake AmAdera mAlapatrera nikaTa rekhe giYechilAma, ataHpara tAke nekar3e vAgha kheYe pheleche; kintu Apanito AmAdera vizvAsa karavenanA, yadio AmarA satyavAdI|

Ara tArA tAra jAmAYa mithyA rakta lepana kare enechila| se valalaH nA, tomAdera mana tomAdera janya ekaTi kAhinI sAjiYe diYeche| sutarAM pUrNa dhairyai zreYa, tomarA yA valacha se viSaYe ekamAtra AllAhai AmAra sAhAyyasthala|

eka yAtrI dala elo, tArA tAdera pAni saMgrAhakake preraNa karala| se tAra pAnira vAlati nAmiYe dila, se vale uThalaH ki sukhavara! e ye eka kizora! ataHpara tArA tAke paNya rUpe lukiYe rAkhala, tArA yA karachila sei viSaYe AllAha savizeSa avagata chilena|
Ara tArA tAke vikri karala svalpa mUlye, mAtra kaYeka dirahAmera vinimaYe, tArA ete chila nirlobha|

misarera ye vyakti tAke kraYa karechila, se tAra strIke valalaH sammAnajanakabhAve era thAkAra vyavasthA kara, sambhavataH se AmAdera upakAre Asave athavA AmarA eke putra rUpeo grahaNa karate pAri evaM ebhAve Ami iusuphake sei deze pratiSThita karalAma tAke svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA deYAra janya| AllAha tA~ra kArya sampAdane apratihata; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa|
se yakhana pUrNa yauvane upanIta hala takhana Ami tAke hikamAta o jJAna dAna karalAma, evaM ebhAvei Ami satkarmaparAYaNaderake puraskRta kari|

se ye strI lokera gRhe chila se tAra kAcha theke asat kAja kAmanA karala evaM darajAguli vandha kare dila o valalaH cale eso (AmarA kAma pravRtti caritArtha kari), se valalaH Ami AllAhara AzraYa prArthanA karachi, tini (AyIya) AmAra prabhu! tini AmAke sammAnajanakabhAve thAkate diYechena, sImAlaMghanakArIrA saphalakAma haYanA|

sei ramaNIto tAra prati Asakta haYe chila evaM seo tAra prati Asakta haYe par3ata yadi nA se tAra ravera nidarzana pratyakSa karata| tAke manda kAja o azlIlatA hate virata rAkhAra janya ebhAve nidarzana dekhiYechilAma| se chila AmAra vizuddha citta vAndAdera antarbhukta|

tArA ubhaYe daur3e darayAra dike gela evaM strI lokaTi pichana hate tAra jAmA chir3e phelala, tArA strI lokaTira svAmIke darayAra kAche dekhate pela| strI lokaTi valalaH ye tomAra parivArera sAthe ku-kAja kAmanA kare tAra janya kArAgAre preraNa athavA anya kona vedanAdAYaka zAsti vyatIta Ara ki danDa hate pAre?

se (iusupha) valalaH se’i AmA hate asat kAja kAmanA karechila| strI lokaTira parivArera ekajana sAkSI sAkSya dilaH yadi tAra jAmAra sammukha dika chinna karA haYe thAke tAhale strI lokaTi satya kathA valeche evaM puruSaTi mithyAvAdI |
Ara yadi tAra jAmA pichana dika hate chinna karA haYe thAke tAhale strI lokaTi mithyA kathA valeche evaM puruSaTi satyavAdI|
sutarAM gRhasvAmI yakhana dekhala ye, tAra jAmA pichana dika hate chinna karA haYeche takhana se valalaH bhISaNa tomAdera chalanA|
he iusupha! tumi eTA upekSA kara evaM he nArI! tumi tomAra aparAdhera janya kSamA prArthanA kara, nizcaYai tumii aparAdhI|
nagare katipaYa nArI valalaH AyIyera strI tAra yuvaka dAsa hate asat kAja kAmanA kareche; prema tAke ummatta kareche, AmarAto tAke dekhachi spaSTa vibhrAntite|

strI lokaTi yakhana tAdera Sar3ayantrera kathA zunala, takhana se tAderake Deke pAThAla, tAdera pratyekake ekaTi kare cAku dila evaM yuvakake valalaH tAdera sAmane vera hao| ataHpara tArA yakhana tAke dekhala takhana tArA tAra saundarye abhibhUta hala evaM nijedera hAta keTe phelala| tArA valalaH adbhuta AllAhara mAhAtya! eto mAnuSa naYa, eto eka mahimAnvita mAlAka/pherezatA!

se valalaH ei se yAra samvandhe tomarA AmAra nindA karecha, Ami tAra hate asat kAja kAmanA karechi; kintu se nijake pavitra rekheche; Ami tAke yA Adeza karechi, se yadi tA nA kare tAhale se kArAruddha havei evaM hInadera antarbhukta have|

iusupha valalaH he AmAra rAvva! ei nArIrA AmAke yAra prati AhavAna karache tA apekSA kArAgAra AmAra kAche adhika priYa| Apani yadi AmAke odera chalanA hate rakSA nA karena tAhale odera prati AkRSTa haYe par3ava evaM ajJadera antarbhukta hava|
ataHpara tAra rAvva tAra AhavAne sAr3A dilena evaM tAdera chalanA hate rakSA karalena, tinito sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
nidarzanAvalI dekhAra para tAdera mane hala ye, tAke kichu kAlera janya kArAruddha karatei have|

tAra sAthe du’jana yuvaka kArAgAre praveza karala, tAdera ekajana valalaH Ami svapne dekhalAma, Ami AMgura niMr3iYe rasa vera karachi evaM aparajana valalaH Ami svapne dekhalAma, Ami AmAra mAthAYa ruTi vahana karachi evaM pAkhI tA hate khAcche, AmAderake Apani era tAtparya jAniYe dina, AmarA ApanAke satkarmaparAYaNa dekhachi|

iusupha valalaH tomAderake ye khAdya deYA haYa tA AsAra pUrve Ami tomAderake svapnera vyAkhyA jAniYe diva, Ami yA tomAderake valava tA AmAra rAvva AmAke yA zikSA diYechena tA hate valava, ye sampradAYa AllAhake vizvAsa karenA o paraloke avizvAsI haYa Ami tAdera matavAda varjana karechi|

Ami AmAra pitR puruSa ivarAhIma, isahAka evaM iYAkUvera matavAda anusaraNa kari| AllAhara sAthe kona vastuke zarIka karA AmAdera kAja naYa, eTA AmAdera o samasta mAnuSera prati AllAhara anugraha; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai kRtajJatA prakAza karenA|
he AmAra kArA saGgIdvaYa! bhinna bhinna vahu rAvva zreYa, nAki parAkramazAlI eka AllAha?

tA~ke cher3e tomarA zudhu katakaguli nAmera ivAdAta karacha, ye nAma tomAdera pitRpuruSa o tomarA rekhecha, eigulira kona pramANa AllAha pAThAnani| hukuma (vidhAna) deYAra adhikAra zudhu AllAharai| tini nirdeza diYechena ye, tomarA zudhumAtra tA~rai ivAdAta karave, Ara kArao ivAdAta karavenA; eTAi sarala saThika dIna, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa|

he AmAra kArA saGgIdvaYa! tomAdera ekajanera vyApAra ei ye, se tAra prabhuke mada pAna karAve evaM apara samvandhe kathA ei ye, se zulaviddha have; ataHpara tAra mastaka hate pAkhI AhAra karave, ye viSaYe tomarA jAnate ceYecha tAra siddhAnta haYe geche|

iusupha tAdera madhye ye mukti pAve mane karala, tAke valalaH tomAra prabhura kAche AmAra kathA vala; kintu zAitAna tAke tAra prabhura kAche tAra viSaYe valAra kathA bhuliYe dila| sutarAM iusupha kaYeka vachara kArAgAre raila|

vAdazAha valalaH Ami svapne dekhalAma, sAtaTi sthUlakAYa gAbhI, ogulike sAtaTi zIrNakAYa gAbhI bhakSaNa karache evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa evaM apara sAtaTi zuska| he pradhAnagaNa! yadi tomarA svapnera vyAkhyA karate pAra tAhale AmAra svapna samvandhe abhimata dAo|
tArA valalaH eTA arthahIna svapna evaM AmarA erUpa svapna vyAkhyAYa abhijJa nai|
du’jana kArAruddhera madhye ye mukti peYechila evaM dIrghakAla pare tAra smaraNa hale se valalaH Ami era tAtparya tomAderake jAniYe diva, sutarAM tomarA AmAke pAThiYe dAo|

se valalaH he iusupha! he satyavAdI! sAtaTi sthulakAYa gAbhI, ogulike sAtaTi zIrNakAYa gAbhI bhakSaNa karache evaM sAtaTi savuja zISa o apara sAtaTi zuska zISa samvandhe Apani AmAderake vyAkhyA dina, yAte Ami lokadera kAche phire yete pAri evaM yAte tArA avagata hate pAre|

iusupha valalaH tomarA sAta vachara ekAdikrame cASa karave, ataHpara tomarA zasya saMgraha karave; tAra madhye ye sAmAnya parimANa tomarA AhAra karave, tA vyatIta samasta zasya zISa sameta rekhe dive|
erapara Asave sAtaTi kaThina vachara; ei sAta vachara yA pUrve saJcaYa kare rAkhave - loke tA khAve; zudhu sAmAnya kichu yA tomarA saMrakSaNa karave tA vyatIta|
evaM erapara Asave eka vachara, sei vachara mAnuSera janya pracura vRSTipAta have evaM sei vachara mAnuSa pracura phalera rasa niMr3Ave|

vAdazAha valalaH tomarA iusuphake AmAra kAche niYe eso| yakhana dUta tAra kAche upasthita hala takhana se valalaH tumi tomAra prabhura kAche phire yAo evaM tAke jijJesa karaH ye nArIrA tAdera hAta keTe phelechila tAdera avasthA ki? AmAra rAvva tAdera chalanA samyaka avagata|

vAdazAha nArIderake valalaH yakhana tomarA iusupha hate asat kAja kAmanA karechile takhana tomAdera ki haYechila? tArA valalaH adbhuta AllAhara mAhAtmya! AmarA tAra madhye kona doSa dekhini| AyIyera strI valalaH ekSaNe satya prakAza haYe gela, Amii tAra hate asat kAja kAmanA karechilAma, seto satyavAdI|
se valalaH Ami eTA valechilAma yAte se jAnate pAre ye, tAra anupasthitite Ami tAra prati vizvAsaghAtakatA karini evaM AllAha vizvAsa ghAtakadera Sar3ayantra saphala karenanA|
Ami nijake nirdoSa mane karinA, mAnuSera mana avazyai manda karma-pravaNa| kintu se naYa yAra prati AmAra rAvva anugraha karena| nizcaYai AmAra rAvva ati kSamAzIla o daYAlu|

vAdazAha valalaH iusuphake AmAra kAche niYe eso, Ami tAke ekAnta sahacara niyukta karava| ataHpara vAdazAha yakhana tAra sAthe kathA valala takhana rAjA valalaH Aja tumi AmAdera kAche maryAdAvAna o vizvAsa bhAjana hale|
se valalaH AmAke koSAgArera dAYitve niYojita karuna| nizcaYai Ami uttama saMrakSaNakArI, atizaYa jJAnavAna|
ebhAve Ami iusuphake sei deze pratiSThita karalAma| se sei deze yathA icchA avasthAna karate pArata| Ami yAke icchA tAra prati daYA kari, Ara Ami sat karmaparAYaNadera zramaphala vinaSTa karinA|
yArA mu’mina o muttAkI tAdera parakAlera puraskArai uttama|
iusuphera bhAiYerA elo evaM tAra nikaTa upasthita hala| se tAderake cinala, kintu tArA tAke cinate pAralanA|

Ara se yakhana tAdera sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dila takhana se valalaH tomarA AmAra nikaTa tomAdera vaimAtreYa bhAike niYe eso; tomarA ki dekhachanA ye, Ami mApe pUrNa mAtrAYa dii? evaM Ami uttama meyavAna?
kintu tomarA yadi tAke AmAra nikaTa niYe nA Asa tAhale AmAra nikaTa tomAdera janya kona varAdda thAkavenA evaM tomarA AmAra nikaTavartI havenA|
tArA valalaH ora viSaYe AmarA ora pitAke sammata karAra ceSTA karava evaM AmarA nizcaYai eTA karava|

iusupha tAra bhRtyaderake valalaH tArA ye paNya mUlya diYeche tA tAdera mAlapatrera madhye rekhe dAo, yAte svajanadera kAche pratyAvartanera para tArA vujhate pAre ye, oTA pratyarpana karA haYeche, tA hale tArA punarAYa Asate pAre|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAdera pitAra nikaTa phire elo takhana tArA valalaH he AmAdera pitA! AmAdera janya varAdda niSiddha karA haYeche, sutarAM AmAdera bhAike AmAdera sAthe pAThiYe dina yAte AmarA rasada pete pAri, AmarA avazyai tAra rakSaNAvekSaNa karava|
se valalaH Ami ki tomAderake ora samvandhe seirUpa vizvAsa karava, yerUpa vizvAsa pUrve tomAderake karechilAma ora bhAiYera vyApAre? AllAhai rakSaNAvekSaNe zreSTha evaM tini zreSThatama daYAlu|

yakhana tArA tAdera mAlapatra khulala takhana tArA dekhate pela, tAdera paNyamUlya tAderake pratyarpana karA haYeche| tArA valalaH he AmAdera pitA! AmarA Ara ki pratyAzA karate pAri? eTA AmAdera pradatta paNyamUlya, AmAderake pratyarpana karA haYeche; punarAYa AmarA AmAdera parivAravargake khAdyasAmagrI ene diva evaM AmarA AmAdera bhAiYera rakSaNAvekSaNa karava evaM AmarA atirikta Ara eka uTa vojhAi paNya Anava, yA enechi tA parimANe alpa|

pitA valalaH Ami oke kakhanao tomAdera sAthe pAThAvanA yatakSaNa nA tomarA AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra kara ye, tomarA tAke AmAra nikaTa niYe Asavei, avazya yadi tomarA ekAnta asahAYa haYe nA par3a| ataHpara yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa pratijJA karala takhana se valalaH AmarA ye viSaYe kathA valachi, AllAha tAra vidhAYaka|

se valalaH he AmAra putragaNa! tomarA eka darayA diYe praveza karanA, bhinna bhinna darayA diYe praveza karave, AllAhara vidhAnera viruddhe Ami tomAdera janya kichui karate pArinA| vidhAna AllAharai; Ami tA~rai upara nirbhara kari evaM yArA nirbhara karate cAYa tArA tA~rai (AllAharai) upara nirbhara karuka|

yakhana tArA, tAdera pitA tAderake yebhAve Adeza karechila sebhAvei praveza karala, takhana AllAhara vidhAnera viruddhe oTA tAdera kona kAje elonA; iYAkUva zudhu tAra manera ekaTi abhiprAYa pUrNa karechila evaM se avazyai jJAnI chila| kAraNa Ami tAke zikSA diYechilAma, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa|
tArA yakhana iusuphera sAmane hAyira hala takhana iusupha tAra (sahodara) bhAike nijera kAche rAkhala evaM valalaH Amii tomAra (sahodara) bhAi| sutarAM tArA yA karata sejanya duHkha karanA|

ataHpara se yakhana tAdera sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dila takhana se tAra (sahodara) bhAiYera mAlapatrera madhye pAnapAtra rekhe dila, ataHpara eka ghoSaka uccaiHsvare valalaH he yAtrIdala! tomarA nizcaYai cora|
tArA tAdera dike phire tAkAla evaM valalaH tomarA ki hAriYecha?
tArA valalaH AmarA rAjAra pAnapAtra hAriYechi; ye oTA ene dive se eka uTa vojhAi mAla pAve evaM Ami ora yAmIna|
tArA valalaH AllAhara zapatha! tomarAto jAna ye, AmarA ei deze duskRti karate Asini evaM AmarA corao nai|
tArA valalaH yadi tomarA mithyAvAdI hao tAhale tAra zAsti ki?
tArA valalaH era zAsti ei ye, yAra mAlapatrera madhye pAtraTi pAoYA yAve, se’i tAra vinimaYa, ebhAve AmarA sImAlaMghanakArIdera zAsti diYe thAki|

ataHpara se tAra (sahodara) bhAiYera mAlapatra tallAzira pUrve tAdera mAla-patra tallAzi karate lAgala, pare tAra sahodarera mAla-patrera madhya hate pAtraTi vera karala| ebhAve Ami iusuphera janya kauzala karechilAma, rAjAra Aine tAra sahodarake se ATaka karate pAratanA, AllAha icchA nA karale| Ami yAke icchA maryAdAYa unnIta kari, pratyeka jJAnavAna vyaktira upara Achena sarvajJAnI|

tArA valalaH se yadi curi kare thAke tAra (sahodara) bhAioto itopUrve curi karechila, ete iusupha prakRta vyApAra nijera mane gopana rAkhala evaM tAdera kAche prakAza karalanA| se mane mane valalaH tomAdera avasthAto hInatara evaM tomarA yA valacha se samvandhe AllAha savizeSa avagata|
tArA valalaH he AyIya! era pitA Achena atizaYa vRddha, sutarAM era sthale Apani AmAdera ekajanake rAkhuna! AmarAto ApanAke dekhachi mahAnubhava vyaktidera ekajana|
se valalaH yAra nikaTa AmarA AmAdera mAla peYechi, tAke chAr3A anyake rAkhAra aparAdha hate AmarA AllAhara kAche AzraYa prArthanA karachi| erUpa karale AmarA avazyai sImAlaMghanakArI hava|

yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa hate sampUrNa nirAza hala takhana tArA nirjane giYe parAmarza karate lAgala, odera madhye ye chila vaYojyeSTha se valalaH tomarA ki jAnanA ye, tomAdera pitA tomAdera nikaTa hate AllAhara nAme aGgIkAra niYechena evaM pUrveo tomarA iusuphera vyApAre kraTi karechile; sutarAM Ami kichutei ei deza tyAga karavanA yatakSaNa nA AmAra pitA AmAke anumati dena athavA AllAha AmAra janya kona vyavasthA karena evaM tinii vicArakadera madhye zreSTha|
tomarA tomAdera pitAra nikaTa phire yAo evaM valaH he AmAdera pitA! ApanAra putra curi kareche evaM AmarA yA jAni tArai pratyakSa vivaraNa dilAma, adRzyera vyApAre AmarA avahita chilAmanA|
ye janapade AmarA chilAma ora adhivAsIderake jijJesa karuna evaM ye yAtrIdalera sAthe AmarA esechi tAderakeo, AmarA avazyai satyavAdI|
iYAkUva valalaH nA, tomAdera mana tomAdera janya ekaTi kAhinI sAjiYe diYeche; sutarAM pUrNa dhairyai zreYa; haYato AllAha oderake eka sAthe AmAra kAche ene divena, tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
se odera dika theke mukha phiriYe nila evaM valalaH Aphasosa iusuphera janya| zoke tAra cakSudvaYa sAdA haYe giYechila evaM se chila asahanIYa manastApe kliSTa|
tArA valalaH AllAhara zapatha! Apanito iusuphera kathA bhulavenanA yatakSaNa nA Apani zArIrikabhAve vidhvasta havena, athavA mRtyu varaNa karavena|
se valalaH Ami AmAra asahanIYa vedanA, AmAra duHkha AllAhara nikaTa nivedana karachi evaM Ami AllAhara nikaTa hate yA jAni tomarA tA jAnanA|
he AmAra putragaNa! tomarA yAo, iusupha o tAra sahodarera anusandhAna kara evaM AllAhara karuNA hate tomarA nirAza haYonA, kAraNa kAphira vyatIta kehai AllAhara karuNA hate nirAza haYanA|

yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa upasthita hala takhana valalaH he AyIya! AmarA o AmAdera parivAra parijana vipanna haYe par3echi evaM AmarA tuccha paNya niYe esechi; Apani AmAdera rasada pUrNa mAtrAYa dina evaM AmAderake dAna karuna; AllAha dAtAderake puraskRta karena|
se valalaH tomarA ki jAna, tomarA iusupha o tAra sahodarera prati kirUpa AcaraNa karechile, yakhana tomarA chile ajJa?

tArA valalaH tAhale ki tumii iusupha? se valalaH Amii iusupha evaM ei AmAra sahodara; AllAha AmAdera prati anugraha karechena| ye vyakti muttAkI o dhairyazIla, AllAha seirUpa satkarmaparAYaNadera zramaphala naSTa karenanA|
tArA valalaH AllAhara zapatha! AllAha nizcaYai tomAke AmAdera upara prAdhAnya diYechena evaM AmarA nizcaYai aparAdhI chilAma|
se valalaH Aja tomAdera viruddhe kona abhiyoga nei, AllAha tomAderake kSamA karuna, evaM tini daYAludera madhye zreSTha daYAlu|
tomarA AmAra e jAmATi niYe yAo evaM eTA AmAra pitAra mukhamanDalera upara rekha, tini dRSTizakti phire pAvena, Ara tomarA tomAdera parivArera sakalakei AmAra nikaTa niYe eso|
ataHpara yAtrIdala yakhana vera haYe par3ala takhana tAdera pitA valalaH tomarA yadi AmAke aprakRtistha mane nA kara tAhale valiH Ami iusuphera ghrANa pAcchi|
tArA valalaH AllAhara zapatha! Apanito ApanAra pUrva vibhrAntitei raYechena|

ataHpara yakhana susaMvAda vAhaka upasthita hala evaM tAra mukhamanDalera upara jAmATi rAkhala takhana se dRSTizakti phire pela| se valalaH Ami ki tomAderake valini ye, Ami AllAhara nikaTa hate yA jAni tomarA tA jAnanA|
tArA valalaH he AmAdera pitA! AmAdera pApera janya kSamA prArthanA karuna; AmarAto aparAdhI|
se valalaH Ami AmAra ravera nikaTa tomAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karava, tinito ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ataHpara tArA yakhana iusuphera nikaTa upasthita hala takhana se tAra mAtA-pitAke AliGgana karala evaM valalaH ApanArA AllAhara icchAYa nirApade misare praveza karuna!

Ara iusupha tAra mAtA-pitAke uccAsane vasAla evaM tArA savAi tAra sAmane sAjadAhaYa luTiYe par3ala| se valalaH he AmAra pitA! eTAi AmAra pUrvekAra svapnera vyAkhyA; AmAra rAvva oTA satye pariNata karechena evaM tini AmAke kArAgAra hate mukta karechena evaM zAitAna AmAra o AmAra bhAidera samparka naSTa karAra parao ApanAderake maru aJcala hate ekhAne ene diYe AmAra prati anugraha karechena, AmAra rAvva yA icchA tA nipuNatAra sAthe kare thAkena, tinito sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

he AmAra rAvva! Apani AmAke rAjya dAna karechena evaM svapnera vyAkhyA zikSA diYechena| he AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA! Apanii ihaloka o paraloke AmAra abhibhAvaka, Apani AmAke musalima hisAve mRtyu dAna karuna evaM AmAke satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta karuna!
eTA adRzyalokera saMvAda yA tomAke Ami ahI dvArA avahita karachi, Sar3ayantrakAle yakhana tArA mataikye pau~chechila takhana tumi tAdera sAthe chilenA|
tumi yatai cAo nA kena, adhikAMza lokai ImAna AnAra naYa|
Ara tumito tAdera kAche kona pArizramika dAvI karachonA, eTAto vizvajagatera janya upadeza chAr3A kichu naYa|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte aneka nidarzana raYeche, tArA e samasta pratyakSa kare, kintu tArA e savera prati udAsIna|
tAdera adhikAMza AllAhake vizvAsa kare, kintu tA~ra sAthe zarIka kare|
tAhale ki tArA AllAhara sarvagrAsI zAsti hate athavA tAdera ajJAtasAre kiYAmAtera Akasmika upasthiti hate nirApada?

tumi valaH eTAi AmAra (AllAhara) patha; pratiTi mAnuSake Ami AhavAna kari sajJAne, Ami evaM AmAra anusArIgaNao; AllAha mahimAnvita evaM yArA AllAhara sAthe zarIka sthApana kare Ami tAdera antabhurkta nai|

tomAra pUrveo janapadavAsIdera madhya hate puruSaderakei pAThiYechilAma, yAdera nikaTa ahI pAThAtAma; tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera ki pariNAma haYechila tA ki dekheni? yArA muttAkI tAdera janya parakAlai zreYa; tomarA ki vujhanA?

avazeSe yakhana rAsUlagaNa nirAza hala evaM loke bhAvala ye, rAsUladerake mithyA AzvAsa deYA haYeche takhana tAdera kAche AmAra sAhAyya elo| ebhAve Ami yAke icchA kari se uddhAra pAYa, Ara aparAdhI sampradAYa hate AmAra zAsti rada karA haYanA|

tAdera vRttAnte vodhazakti sampanna vyaktidera janya Ache zikSA, ihA emana vANI yA mithyA pravandha naYa, kintu mu’minadera janya eTA pUrva granthe yA Ache uhAra samarthana evaM samasta kichura vizada vivaraNa, hidAYAta o rAhamAta|
Alipha lAma mIma rA, eguli kuraAnera AYAta; yA tomAra rAvva hate tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tA’i satya; kintu adhikAMza ete vizvAsa karenA|

AllAhai urdhvadeze AkAzamanDalI sthApana karechena stambha vyatIta, tomarA eTA dekhacha| ataHpara tini Araze samAsIna halena evaM sUrya o cA~dake niYamAdhIna karalena; pratyeke nirdiSTakAla paryanta Avartana kare, tini sakala viSaYa niYantraNa karena evaM nidarzanasamUha vizadabhAve varNanA karena yAte tomarA tomAdera ravera sAthe sAkSAt samvandhe nizcita vizvAsa karate pAra|

tinii bhUtalake vistRta karechena evaM ote parvata o nadI sRSTi karechena evaM pratyeka prakArera phala sRSTi karechena jor3AYa jor3AYa; tini dinake rAta dvArA AcchAdita karena; ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche cintAzIla sampradAYera janya|

pRthivIte raYeche paraspara saMlagna bhUkhanDa; ote Ache AGgura-kAnana, zaSyakSeta, ekAdhika zira viziSTa athavA eka zira viziSTa khejura-vRkSa, siJcita ekai pAnite; evaM phala hisAve ogulira katakake katakera upara Ami zreSThatva diYe thAki, avazyai vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYera janya ete raYeche nidarzana|

yadi tumi vismita hao tAhale vismaYera viSaYa tAdera vaktavyaH mATite pariNata haoYAra parao ki AmarA natuna jIvana lAbha karava? orAi odera rAvvake asvIkAra kare evaM oderai galadeze thAkave lauha-zRMkhala, orAi jAhAnnAmI evaM sekhAne orA cirasthAYIbhAve avasthAnakArI|

maGgalera pUrve tArA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale, yadio tAdera pUrve era vahu dRSTAnta gata haYeche| vastutaH mAnuSera sImAlaMghana sattveo tomAra rAvva mAnuSera prati kSamAzIla evaM tomAra rAvva zAsti dAneo kaThora|

yArA kupharI kareche tArA valeH tAra ravera nikaTa hate tAra nikaTa kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYanA kena? he nAvI! kathA ei ye, tumito zudhumAtra bhaYa pradarzanakArI evaM pratyeka sampradAYera janya raYeche patha pradarzaka|
pratyeka nArI yA garbhe dhAraNa kare evaM jarAYute yA kichu kame o vAr3e AllAha tA jAnena| evaM tA~ra vidhAne pratyeka vasturai eka nirdiSTa parimANa Ache|
yA adRzya o yA dRzyamAna tini tA avagata; tini mahAna, sarvocca maryAdAvAna|
tomAdera madhye ye kathA gopana rAkhe evaM ye tA prakAza kare, rAte ye Atmagopana kare evaM dine ye prakAzye vicaraNa kare, tArA samabhAve tA~ra (AllAhara) jJAnagocara|

mAnuSera janya tAra sAmane o pichane ekera para eka praharI thAke; tArA AllAhara Adeze tAra rakSaNAvekSaNa kare; nizcaYai AllAha kona sampradAYera avasthA parivartana karenanA yatakSaNa nA tArA nijedera avasthA nijerA parivartana kare| kona sampradAYa samparke yadi AllAha azubha kichu icchA karena tAhale tA rada karAra keha nei evaM tini chAr3A tAdera kona abhibhAvaka (oYAlI) nei|
tinii tomAderake dekhAna vijalI, yA bhaYa o bharasA saJcAra kare evaM tinii sRSTi karena ghana megha|

vajra dhvani o mAlAikA sabhaYe tA~ra saprazaMsa mahimA o pavitratA ghoSaNA kare| tini vajrapAta ghaTAna evaM yAke icchA oTA dvArA AghAta karena| tathApi orA AllAha samvandhe vitanDA kare; yadio tini mahA zaktizAlI |

satyera AhavAna tA~rai| yArA tA~ke chAr3A AhavAna kare aparake tArA (aparerA) tAderake konai sAr3A deYanA; tAdera dRSTAnta sei vyaktira mata ye tAra mukhe pAni pau~chave ei AzAYa tAra hastadvaYa prasArita kare emana pAnira dike yA tAra mukhe pau~chAra naYa, kAphiradera AhavAna niSphala|
AllAhara prati sAjadAhavanata haYa AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache, icchAYa athavA anicchAYa evaM tAdera chAYAgulio sakAla-sandhyAYa| [sAjadAha]

valaH ke AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra rAvva? valaH tini AllAha! valaH tAhale ki tomarA abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa karecha AllAhara parivarte aparake, yArA nijedera lAbha vA kSati sAdhane sakSama naYa? valaH andha o cakSusmAna ki samAna athavA andhakAra o Alo ki eka? tAhale ki tArA AllAhara emana zarIka sthApana karache yArA (AllAhara sRSTira mata) sRSTi kareche, ye kAraNe sRSTi tAdera madhye vibhrATa ghaTiYeche? valaH AllAha sakala kichura sraSTA, tini eka, parAkramazAlI|

tini AkAza hate vRSTi varSaNa karena, phale nadIsamUha odera parimANa anuyAYI plAvita haYa evaM plAvana tAra uparisthita AvarjanA vahana kare| ebhAve AvarjanA upari bhAge Ase yakhana alaMkAra athavA taijasapatra nirmAnera uddeze kichu agnite uttapta karA haYa tAra| ebhAve AllAha satya o asatyera dRSTAnta diYe thAkena; yA AvarjanA tA phele deYA haYa evaM yA mAnuSera upakAre Ase tA yamIne theke yAYa, ebhAve AllAha upamA diYe thAkena|

maGgala tAdera, yArA tAdera ravera AhavAne sAr3A deYa| evaM yArA tA~ra DAke sAr3A deYanA tAdera yadi pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA samastai thAkata evaM uhAra sAthe sama parimANa Arao thAkata tAhale avazyai tArA muktipaNa svarUpa tA pradAna karata; tAdera hisAva have kaThora evaM jAhAnnAma have tAdera AvAsa; oTA kata nikRSTa AzraYasthala!
tomAra rAvva hate tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA ye vyakti satya vale jAne se, Ara andha ki samAna? upadeza grahaNa kare zudhu vivekavuddhi sampanna vyaktirAi|
yArA AllAhake pradatta aGgIkAra rakSA kare evaM pratijJA bhaGga karenA |
Ara AllAha ye samparka akSuNNa rAkhate Adeza karechena yArA tA akSuNNa rAkhe, bhaYa kare tAdera rAvvake evaM bhaYa kare kaThora hisAvake |

Ara yArA tAdera ravera santuSTi lAbhera janya dhairya dhAraNa kare, sAlAta supratiSThita kare, Ami tAderake ye jIvanopakaraNa diYechi tA hate gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare evaM yArA bhAla dvArA manda dUra kare tAdera janya zubha pariNAma |

sthAYI jAnnAta, tAte tArA praveza karave evaM tAdera mAtA-pitA, pati-patnI o santAna-santatidera madhye yArA sat kAja kareche tArAo evaM mAlAikA/pherezatArA tAdera kAche hAyira have pratyeka darajA diYe|
(tArA valaveH) tomarA dhairya dhAraNa karecha vale tomAdera prati zAnti (sAlAma)! katai nA bhAla ei pariNAma!

yArA AllAhara sAthe dRr3ha aGgIkAre Avaddha haoYAra para tA bhaGga kare, ye samparka akSunna rAkhate AllAha Adeza karechena tA chinna kare evaM pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi kare ver3AYa, tAdera janya Ache abhisampAta evaM Ache manda AvAsa|
AllAha yAra janya icchA karena tAra jIvanopakaraNa vardhita karena kiMvA saMkucita karena; kintu tArA pAthirva jIvana niYei ullasita, athaca ihajIvanato parajIvanera tulanAYa kSaNasthAYI bhoga mAtra|

yArA kupharI kareche tArA valeH tAra ravera nikaTa hate tAra nikaTa kona nidarzana avatIrNa haYanA kena? tumi valaH AllAha yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM tini tAderake tA~ra patha dekhAna yArA tA~ra abhimukhI|
yArA ImAna Ane evaM AllAhara smaraNe yAdera citta prazAnta haYa; jene rekha, AllAhara smaraNei citta prazAnta haYa|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, kalyANa o zubha pariNAma tAderai|

ebhAve Ami tomAke pAThiYechi eka jAtira prati, yAra pUrve vahu jAti gata haYeche, tAdera nikaTa AvRtti karAra janya, yA Ami tomAra prati pratyAdeza karechi; tathApi tArA daYAmaYake asvIkAra kare| tumi valaH tinii AmAra rAvva! tini chAr3A anya kona mA‘vUda nei, tA~rai upara Ami nirbhara kari evaM AmAra pratyAvartana tA~rai kAche|

yadi kona kuraAna emana hata yadvArA parvatake gatizIla karA yeta athavA pRthivIke vidIrNa karA yeta athavA mRtera sAthe kathA valA yeta, tavuo tArA tAte vizvAsa karatanA; kintu samasta viSaYai AllAhara ekhatiYArabhukta; tAhale ki yArA ImAna eneche tAdera pratyaYa haYani ye, AllAha icchA karale nizcaYai sakalake sat pathe paricAlita karate pAratena? yArA kupharI kareche tAdera karmaphalera janya tAdera viparyaYa ghaTatei thAkave, athavA viparyaYa tAdera AzepAze Apatita hatei thAkave, yatakSaNa paryanta nA AllAhara pratizruti ghaTave, nizcaYai AllAha pratizruti pAlane akSama nana|
tomAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlake ThATTA-vidrupa karA haYeche evaM yArA kupharI kareche tAderake kichu avakAza diYechilAma, ataHpara tAderake pAkar3Ao karechilAma; kemana chila AmAra pAkar3Ao!

tAhale ki pratyeka mAnuSa yA kare, tAra yini paryavekSaka tini akSama edera upAsyagulira mata? athaca tArA AllAhara vahu zarIka kareche| tumi valaH tomarA tAdera paricaYa dAo; tomarA ki pRthivIra emana kichura saMvAda tA~ke dite cAo yA tini jAnenanA? nA varaM odera chalanA odera nikaTa zobhana pratIYamAna haYa evaM tArA sat patha hate nivRtta haYa; AllAha yAke vibhrAnta karena tAra kona patha pradarzaka nei|
tAdera janya pArthiva jIvane Ache zAsti evaM parakAlera zAstito Arao kaThora! evaM AllAhara zAsti hate rakSA karAra tAdera keha nei|

muttAkIderake ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deYA haYeche tAra upamA eirUpaH ora pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, ora phalasamUha evaM ora chAYA cirasthAYI; yArA muttAkI eTA tAdera karmaphala, evaM kAphiradera karmaphala Aguna|

Ami yAderake kitAva diYechi tArA yA tomAra prati avatIrNa haYeche tAte Ananda pAYa, kintu kona kona dala ora kataka aMza asvIkAra kare| tumi valaH Amito AllAharai ivAdAta karate o tA~ra kona zarIka nA karate AdiSTa haYechi; Ami tA~rai prati AhavAna kari evaM tA~rai nikaTa AmAra pratyAvartana|

Ara ebhAve Ami ihA (kuraAna) avatIrNa karechi eka vidhAna, ArAvI bhASAYa| jJAna prAptira para tumi yadi tAdera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kara tAhale AllAhara viruddhe tomAra kona abhibhAvaka o rakSaka thAkavenA|

tomAra pUrveo Ami aneka rAsUla preraNa karechilAma evaM tAderake strI o santAna-santati diYechilAma| AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona nidarzana upasthita karA kona rAsUlera kAja naYa; pratyeka viSaYera nirdhArita kAla lipivaddha|
AllAhara yA icchA tA nizcihna karena evaM yA icchA tA pratiSThita rAkhena evaM tA~rai nikaTa Ache kitAvera mUla|
Ami tAderake ye zAstira kathA vali, tAra kichu yadi tomAke dekhiYei dii athavA yadi era pUrve tomAra mRtyu ghaTiYei dii - tomAra kartavyato zudhu pracAra karA; Ara hisAva grahaNera dAYitva AmAra|
tArA ki dekhenA ye, Ami tAdera dezake cAradika hate saMkucita kare Anachi? AllAha Adeza karena, tA~ra Adeza rada karAra keha nei evaM tini hisAva grahaNe tatpara|
tAdera pUrve yArA chila tArAo cakrAnta karechila, kintu samasta cakrAnta AllAhara ekhatiYAre; pratyeka vyakti yA kare tA tini jAnena evaM kAphirerA zIghrai jAnave zubha pariNAma kAdera janya|
yArA kupharI kareche tArA valeH tumi (AllAhara) prerita nao; tumi valaH AllAha evaM yAdera nikaTa kitAvera jJAna Ache tArA AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hisAve yatheSTa|
Alipha lAma rA| ei kitAva Ami tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi yAte tumi mAnava jAtike vera kare Anate pAra andhakAra hate Alora dike; tA~ra pathe, yini parAkramazAlI, prazaMsA |
AllAha, AsamAnasamUha o yamIne yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai; kaThina zAstira durbhoga kAphiradera janya|
yArA pArthiva jIvanake parakAlina jIvanera upara prAdhAnya deYa, mAnuSake nivRtta kare AllAhara patha hate evaM tA (AllAhara patha) vakra karate cAYa; tArAito ghora vibhrAntite raYeche|

Ami pratyeka rAsUlakei tAra svajAtira bhASAbhASI kare pAThiYechi tAdera nikaTa pariskArabhAve vyAkhyA karAra janya, AllAha yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM yAke icchA sat pathe paricAlita karena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

mUsAke Ami AmAra nidarzanasaha preraNa karechilAma evaM valechilAmaH tomAra sampradAYake andhakAra hate Alote AnaYana kara, evaM tAderake AllAhara dinaguli dvArA upadeza dAo, eteto nidarzana raYeche parama dhairyazIla o parama kRtajJa vyaktira janya|

yakhana mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechilaH tomarA AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara yakhana tini tomAderake rakSA karechilena phira‘Auna sampradAYera kavala hate yArA tomAderake nikRSTa zAsti dita, tomAdera putraderake yavAha karata o tomAdera nArIderake jIvita rAkhata; evaM ete chila tomAdera ravera pakSa hate eka mahA parIkSA|
yakhana tomAdera rAvva ghoSaNA karenaH tomarA kRtajJa hale tomAderake avazyai adhika diva, Ara akRtajJa hale avazyai AmAra zAsti have kaThora|
mUsA valechilaH tomarA evaM pRthivIra sakaleo yadi akRtajJa hao tathApi AllAha abhAvamukta evaM prazaMsA |

tomAdera kAche ki saMvAda Aseni tomAdera pUrvavartIdera; nUhera sampradAYera, ‘Ada o chAmUdera evaM tAdera pUrvavartIdera? tAdera viSaYa AllAha chAr3A anya keha jAnenA; tAdera kAche spaSTa nidarzanasaha tAdera rAsUla esechila; tArA tAdera hAta tAdera mukhe sthApana karata evaM valataH yA niYe tomarA prerita haYecha tA AmarA pratyAkhyAna kari evaM AmarA avazyai vibhrAntikara sandeha poSaNa kari sei viSaYe, yAra prati tomarA AmAderake AhavAna karacha|

tAdera rAsUlagaNa valechilaH AllAha samvandhe ki kona sandeha Ache, yini AkAzasamUha o pRthivIra sRSTikartA? tini tomAderake AhavAna karena tomAdera pApa kSamA karAra janya evaM nirdiSTakAla paryanta tomAderake avakAza deYAra janya| tArA valataH tomarAto AmAdera matai mAnuSa; AmAdera pitR puruSagaNa yAdera ivAdAta karata tomarA tAdera ivAdAta hate AmAderake virata rAkhate cAo; ataeva tomarA AmAdera kAche kona akATya pramANa upasthita kara|

tAdera rAsUlagaNa tAderake valataH satya vaTe AmarA tomAdera mata mAnuSa, kintu AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA anugraha karena; AllAhara anumati chAr3A tomAdera nikaTa pramANa upasthita karA AmAdera kAja naYa; mu’minadera AllAhara uparai nirbhara karA ucita|

AmarA AllAhara upara nirbhara karavanA kena? tiniito AmAderake patha pradarzana karechena; tomarA AmAderake ye kleza diccha, AmarA avazyai tA dhairyera sAthe sahya karava evaM nirbharakArIdera AllAharai upara nirbhara karA ucita|

kAphirerA tAdera rAsUladerake valechilaH AmarA tomAderake avazyai AmAdera deza hate vahiskAra karava, athavA tomAderake AmAdera dharmAdarze phire Asatei have| ataHpara rAsUladerake tAdera rAvva ahI preraNa karalena; yAlimaderake Ami avazyai vinAza karava|
tAdera pare Ami tomAderake deze pratiSThita karavai; eTA tAdera janya yArA bhaYa rAkhe AmAra sammukhe upasthita haoYAra evaM bhaYa rAkhe AmAra zAstira|
tArA vicAra kAmanA karala evaM pratyeka uddhata svairAcArI vyartha manoratha hala|
tAdera pratyekera janya pariNAme jAhAnnAma raYeche evaM pratyekake pAna karAno have galita pu~ja |

yA se ati kaSTe galadhaHkaraNa karave evaM tA galadhaHkaraNa karA prAYa asambhava haYe par3ave| sarva dika hate tAra nikaTa Asave mRtyu yantraNA, kintu tAra mRtyu ghaTavenA evaM se kaThora zAsti bhoga karatei thAkave|

yArA tAdera rAvvake asvIkAra kare tAdera upamA - tAdera kAjasamUha chAi sadRza yA jhar3era dine vAtAsa pracanDa vege ur3iYe niYe yAYa; yA tArA upArjana kare tAra kichui tArA tAdera kAje lAgAte pArenA; eTAto ghora vibhrAnti|
tumi ki lakSya karanA ye, AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI yathAvidhi sRSTi karechena? tini icchA karale tomAdera astitva vilopa karate pArena evaM eka natuna sRSTi astitve Anate pArena|
Ara eTA AllAhara janya Adau kaThina naYa|

savAi AllAhara nikaTa upasthita havei| yArA ahaMkAra karata, durvalerA tAderake valaveH AmarAto tomAdera anusArI chilAma; ekhana tomarA AllAhara zAsti hate ki AmAderake kichu mAtra rakSA karate pArave? tArA valaveH AllAha AmAderake sat pathe paricAlita karale AmarAo tomAderake sat pathe paricAlita karatAma; ekhana AmAdera dhairyacyUta haoYA athavA dhairyazIla haoYA ekai kathA; AmAdera kona niskRti nei|

yakhana sava kichura mImAMsA haYe yAve takhana zAitAna valaveH AllAha tomAderake diYechilena satya pratizruti, Amio tomAderake pratizruti diYechilAma, kintu Ami tomAderake pradatta pratizruti rakSA karini; AmArato tomAdera upara kona Adhipatya chilanA, Ami zudhu tomAderake AhavAna karechilAma evaM tomarA AmAra AhavAne sAr3A diYechile; sutarAM tomarA AmAra prati doSAropa karanA, tomarA tomAdera pratii doSAropa kara; Ami tomAdera uddhAre sAhAyya karate sakSama nai evaM tomarAo AmAra uddhAre sAhAyya karate sakSama nao; tomarA ye pUrve AmAke (AllAhara) zarIka karechile tAra sAthe AmAra konai samparka nei; yAlimadera janyato vedanAdAYaka zAsti Achei|

yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tAderake dAkhila karA have jAnnAte yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| sekhAne tArA cirasthAYIbhAve avasthAnakArI have tAdera ravera anumatikrame| sekhAne tAdera abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’|
tumi ki lakSya karanA AllAha kibhAve upamA diYe thAkena? sat vAkyera tulanA utkRSTa vRkSa yAra mUla sudRr3ha evaM yAra prazAkhA urdhve vistRta |
yA pratyeka maosume phala dAna kare tAra ravera anumatikrame, evaM AllAha mAnuSera janya upamA diYe thAkena yAte tArA zikSA grahaNa kare|
ku-vAkyera tulanA eka manda vRkSa yAra mUla bhU-pRSTha hate vicchinna, yAra kona sthAYitva nei|
yArA zAzvata vANIte vizvAsI tAderake ihajIvane o parajIvane AllAha supratiSThita rAkhavena evaM yArA yAlima, AllAha tAderake vibhrAntite rAkhavena; AllAha yA icchA tA karena|
tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karanA yArA AllAhara anugrahera parivarte akRtajJatA prakAza kare evaM tAdera sampradAYake nAmiYe Ane dhvaMsera AlaYe |
jAhAnnAma, yAra madhye tArA praveza karave, kata nikRSTa ai AvAsasthala!
Ara tArA AllAhara samakakSa udbhAvana kare tA~ra patha hate vibhrAnta karAra janya; tumi valaH bhoga kare nAo, pariNAme Agunai tomAdera pratyAvartana sthala|

AmAra vAndAdera madhye yArA mu’mina tAderake vala sAlAta kAYema karate evaM Ami tAderake yA diYechi tA hate gopane o prakAzye vyaYa karate, sei dina AsAra pUrve yedina kraYa-vikraYa o vandhutva thAkavenA|

tinii AllAha yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena, yini AkAza hate pAni varSaNa kare tadvArA tomAdera jIvikAra janya phala-mUla utpAdana karena, yini nauyAnake tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena yAte tA~ra vidhAne oTA samudre vicaraNa kare evaM yini tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena nadIsamUhake|
tini tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena sUrya o cA~dake, yArA avirAma ekai niYamera anuvartI evaM tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena rAta o dinake |
Ara tini tomAderake diYechena tomarA tA~ra nikaTa yA kichu ceYecha; tomarA AllAhara anugraha gaNanA karale ora saMkhyA nirNaYa karate pAravenA; mAnuSa avazyai atimAtrAYa yAlima, akRtajJa|
smaraNa kara, ivarAhIma valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! ei zaharake nirApada karuna evaM AmAke o AmAra putraderake mUrti pUjA hate dUre rAkhuna|
he AmAra rAvva! ei sava mUrti vahu mAnuSake vibhrAnta kareche; sutarAM ye AmAra anusaraNa karave se’i AmAra dalabhukta, kintu keha AmAra avAdhya hale Apanito kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he AmAdera rAvva! Ami AmAra vaMzadharadera katakake vasavAsa karAlAma anurvara upatyakAYa ApanAra pavitra gRhera nikaTa| he AmAdera rAvva! e janya ye, tArA yena sAlAta kAYema kare; sutarAM Apani kichu lokera antara odera prati anurAgI kare dina evaM phalaphalAdi dvArA tAdera riykera vyavasthA karuna yAte tArA kRtajJatA prakAza kare|
he AmAdera rAvva! Apanito jAnena yA AmarA gopana kari evaM yA AmarA prakAza kari; AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra kona kichui AllAhara nikaTa gopana thAkenA|
samasta prazaMsA AllAharai prApya yini AmAke AmAra vArdhakye isamAIla o isahAkake dAna karechena; AmAra rAvva avazyai prArthanA zune thAkena|
he AmAra rAvva! AmAke sAlAta kAYemakArI karuna evaM AmAra vaMzadharadera madhya hateo; he AmAdera rAvva! AmAra prArthanA kavUla karuna|
he AmAra rAvva! yedina hisAva have sedina AmAke, AmAra mAtApitAke evaM mu’minaderake kSamA karuna|
tumi kakhanao mane karanA ye, yAlimarA yA kare se viSaYe AllAha udAsIna| tave tini sedina paryanta tAderake avakAza dena yedina tAdera cakSu have sthira|
bhIti vihavala citte (AkAzera dike ceYe) chuTAchuTi karave| nijedera prati tAdera dRSTi phiravenA evaM tAdera antara have zUnya|

yedina tAdera zAsti Asave sedina samparke tumi mAnuSake satarka kara| takhana yAlimarA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera kichukAlera janya avakAza dina, AmarA ApanAra AhavAne sAr3A diva evaM rAsUladera anusaraNa karavai| tomarA ki pUrve zapatha kare valate nA ye, tomAdera patana nei?

athaca tomarA vAsa karate tAdera vAsabhUmite yArA nijedera prati yulama karechila evaM tAdera prati Ami ki karechilAma tAo tomAdera nikaTa suvidita chila evaM tomAdera nikaTa Ami tAdera dRSTAntao upasthita karechilAma|
tArA bhISaNa cakrAnta karechila, kintu AllAhara nikaTa tAdera cakrAnta rakSita raYeche| tAdera cakrAnta emana chilanA yAte parvata Tale yeta|
tumi kakhanao mane karanA ye, AllAha tA~ra rAsUladera prati pradatta pratizruti bhaGga karena; AllAha parAkramazAlI, danDa vidhAYaka|
yedina ei pRthivI parivartita haYe anya pRthivI have evaM AkAzamanDalIo evaM mAnuSa upasthita have AlalAhara sAmane, yini eka, parAkramazAlI|
sedina tumi aparAdhIderake dekhave zRMkhalita avasthAYa|
tAdera pozAka have AlakAtarAra evaM Aguna Acchanna karave tAdera mukhamanDala|
yAte AllAha pratidAna dena pratyeka nAphasake yA se arjana kareche| nizcaYa AllAha druta hisAva grahaNakArI|
ihA mAnuSera janya eka vArtA yAte era dvArA tArA satarka haYa evaM jAnate pAre ye, tini ekamAtra upAsya evaM yAte vodhazakti sampannarA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Alipha lAma rA| eguli AYAta, mahAgranthera, suspaSTa kuraAnera|
yArA kupharI kareche, tArA ekasamaYa kAmanA karave yadi tArA musalima hata!
tAdera cher3e dAo, tArA khete thAkuka, bhoga karate thAkuka evaM mithyA AzA oderake mohAcchanna kare rAkhuka, pariNAme tArA vujhave|
Ami kona janapadake tAra nirdiSTa kAla pUrNa nA haoYA paryanta dhvaMsa karini|
kona jAti tAra nirdiSTa kAlake tvarAnvita karate pArenA evaM vilamvitao karate pArenA|
tArA valeH ohe, yAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa haYeche! tumito nizcaYai ummAda|
tumi satyavAdI hale AmAdera nikaTa mAlAikA/pherezatAderake hAyira karachanA kena?
Ami mAlAikA/pherezatAderake yathArtha kAraNa vyatIta preraNa karinA; mAlAikA/pherezatArA hAyira hale tArA avakAza pAvenA|
Amii jikara (kuraAna) avatIrNa karechi evaM Amii uhAra saMrakSaka|
tomAra pUrve Ami pUrvera aneka sampradAYera nikaTa rAsUla pAThiYechi|
tAdera nikaTa emana kona rAsUla Aseni yAke tArA ThATTA vidrupa karatanA|
ebhAve Ami aparAdhIdera antare tA saJcAra kari|
tArA kuraAne vizvAsa karavenA evaM atIte pUrvavartIderao ei AcaraNa chila|
yadi tAdera janya Ami AkAzera darayA khule dii evaM tArA sArAdina tAte ArohaNa karate thAke |
tavuo tArA valaveH AmAdera dRSTi sammohita karA haYeche; nA, varaM AmarA eka yAdugrasta sampradAYa|
AkAze Ami graha nakSatra sRSTi karechi evaM oke karechi suzobhita, darzakadera janya|
pratyeka abhizapta zAitAna hate Ami oke rakSA kari|
Ara keha curi kare saMvAda zunate cAile ora pazcAddhAvana kare pradIpta zikhA|
pRthivIke Ami vistRta karechi evaM ote parvatamAlA sthApana karechi; Ami ote pratyeka vastu utpanna karechi suparimitabhAve|
Ara Ami ote jIvikAra vyavasthA karechi tomAdera janya, Ara tomarA yAdera jIvikAdAtA nao tAdera janyao|
AmArai kAche Ache pratyeka vastura bhAnDAra evaM Ami tA susama parimANei saravarAha kare thAki|
Ami vRSTigarbha vAYu preraNa kari, ataHpara AkAza hate vRSTi varSaNa kari evaM tA tomAderake pAna karate dii; ora bhAnDAra tomAdera kAche nei|
Amii jIvana dAna kari o mRtyu ghaTAi evaM Amii cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI|
tomAdera pUrve yArA gata haYeche Ami tAderake jAni evaM pare yArA Asave tAderakeo jAni|
tomAra rAvvai tAderake samaveta karavena; tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
Amito mAnuSake sRSTi karechi chA~ce DhAlA zuSka ThanaThane mATi hate|
era pUrve sRSTi karechi jinake, prakhara zikhAyukta agni hate|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rAvva mAlAikA/pherezatAderake valalenaH Ami chA~ce DhAlA zuSka ThanaThane mATi hate mAnuSa sRSTi karava|
yakhana Ami tAke suThAma karava evaM tAte AmAra rUha saJcAra karava takhana tomarA tAra prati sAjadAhavanata hao|
mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNa savAi ekatre sAjadAha karala|
kintu ivalIsa karalanA, se sAjadAhakArIdera antarbhukta hate asvIkAra karala|
(AllAha) valalenaH he ivalIsa! tora ki hala, tui kena sAjadAhakArIdera antarbhukta halinA?
se uttare valalaH chA~ce DhAlA zuSka ThanaThane mRttikA hate ye mAnuSa Apani sRSTi karechena, Ami tAke sAjadAha karAra nai|
(AllAha) valalenaH tAhale tui ekhAna hate vera haYe yA, kAraNa tui abhizapta|
karmaphala dina paryanta tora prati raila lA’nata|
ivalIsa valalaH he AmAra rAvva! punarutthAna dina paryanta AmAke avakAza dina|
AllAha valalenaH toke avakAza deYA hala |
avadhArita samaYa upasthita haoYAra dina paryanta|
se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani ye AmAke vipathagAmI karalena tajjanya Ami pRthivIte mAnuSera nikaTa pApa kAjake zobhanIYa kare tulava evaM Ami tAdera sakalake vipathagAmI karava|
tave tAdera madhya hate ApanAra nirvAcita vAndAgaNa vyatIta|
tini valalenaH eTAi AmAra nikaTa pau~chAra sarala patha|
vibhrAntadera madhye yArA tora anusaraNa karave tArA chAr3A AmAra vAndAdera upara tora kona kSamatA thAkavenA|
avazyai tora anusArIdera savArai nirdhArita sthAna have jAhAnnAma|
ora sAtaTi darayA Ache, pratyeka darayAra janya pRthaka pRthaka dala Ache|
nizcaYai muttAkIrA thAkave prasravana vahula jAnnAte|
(tAderake valA have) tomarA zAnti o nirApattAra sAthe ekhAne praveza kara|
Ami tAdera antara hate IrSA dUra karava; tArA bhrAtRbhAve paraspara mukhomukhi haYe avasthAna karave|
sekhAne tAderake avasAda sparza karavenA evaM tArA sekhAna hate vahiskRtao havenA|
AmAra vAndAderake vale dAoH nizcaYai Ami kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
Ara AmAra zAsti! tA ati marmantada zAsti|
Ara tumi tAderake ivarAhImera mehamAnadera saMvAda dAo|
yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa upasthita haYe valalaH ‘sAlAma’ takhana se valechilaH AmarA tomAdera Agamane AtaMkita|
tArA valalaH bhaYa karanA, AmarA tomAke eka jJAnI putrera susaMvAda dicchi|
se valalaH tomarA ki AmAke susaMvAda diccha Ami vArdhakyagrasta haoYA sattveo? tomarA ki viSaYe susaMvAda diccha?
tArA valalaH AmarA satya saMvAda dicchi; sutarAM tumi nirAza haYonA|
se valalaH yArA pathabhraSTa tArA vyatIta Ara ke tAra ravera anugraha hate nirAza haYa?
se valalaH he preritagaNa! ataHpara tomarA ki vizeSa kAja niYe esecha?
tArA valalaH AmAderake eka aparAdhI sampradAYera viruddhe preraNa karA haYeche|
tave lUtera parivAravargera viruddhe naYa, AmarA avazyai tAdera sakalake rakSA karava|
kintu tAra strIke naYa; AmarA sthira karechi ye, se avazyai pazcAte avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|
mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNa yakhana lUta parivArera nikaTa elo –
takhana lUta valalaH tomarAto aparicita loka|
tArA valalaH nA, tArA ye viSaYe sandigdha chila AmarA tomAra nikaTa tA niYe esechi|
AmarA tomAra nikaTa satya saMvAda niYe esechi evaM avazyai AmarA satyavAdI|

sutarAM tumi rAtera zeSa prahare tomAra parivAravargasaha vera haYe par3a evaM tumi tAdera pazcAdanusaraNa kara evaM tomAdera madhye keha yena pichana phire nA tAkAYa, tomAderake yekhAne yete valA haYeche sekhAne cale yAo|
Ami tAke e viSaYe pratyAdeza dilAma ye, pratyuSe tAderake samUle vinAza karA have|
nagaravAsIrA AnandommAda haYe upasthita hala|
se valalaH nizcaYai erA AmAra atithi; sutarAM tomarA AmAke veiyyAta karanA|
tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara o AmAke lajjita karanA|
tArA valalaH AmarA ki duniYAvAsI lokake AzraYa dite ApanAke niSedha karini?
lUta valalaH ekAntai yadi tomarA kichu karate cAo tAhale AmAra ei kanyAgaNa raYeche|
tomAra jIvanera zapatha! orAto Apana nezAYa matta chila|
ataHpara sUryodaYera samaYe mahAnAda tAderake AghAta karala|
sutarAM Ami janapadake ulTe dilAma evaM tAdera upara prastara kaMkara nikSepa karalAma|
avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche vodhazakti sampanna vyaktidera janya|
oTA loka calAcalera pathapArzve ekhanao vidyamAna|
avazyai ete mu’minadera janya raYeche nidarzana|
Ara ‘AYakA’vAsIrAoto chila sImA laMghanakArI|
sutarAM Ami tAderake zAsti diYechi, odera ubhaYai prakAzya pathapArzve avasthita|
hijaravAsIrA rAsUladera prati mithyA Aropa karechila|
Ami tAderake AmAra nidarzana dekhiYechilAma, kintu tArA tA upekSA karechila|
tArA pAhAr3a keTe gRha nirmANa karata nirApada vasavAsera janya|
ataHpara prabhAtakAle mahAnAda tAderake AghAta karala|
sutarAM tArA yA arjana karechila tA tAdera kona kAje Aseni|
AkAzasamUha o pRthivI evaM e du’Yera antavartI kona kichui Ami ayathA sRSTi karini; evaM kiYAmAta avazyambhAvI; sutarAM tumi parama saujanyera sAthe tAderake kSamA kara|
nizcaYai tomAra rAvvai mahAna sraSTA, mahAjJAnI|
Amito tomAke diYechi sAta AYAta yA punaH punaH AvRtti karA haYa evaM diYechi mahAna kuraAna|

Ami tAdera vibhinna zreNIke bhoga vilAsera ye upakaraNa diYechi tAra prati tumi kakhanao tomAra cakSudvaYa prasArita karanA; tAderake yA deYA haYeche sei janya tumi kSobha karanA; tumi mu’minadera janya tomAra vAhu avanamita kara|
Ara valaH Amito ekajana bhaYa pradarzanakArI mAtra|
yebhAve Ami avatIrNa karechilAma vibhaktakArIdera upara,
yArA kuraAnake vibhinnabhAve vibhakta kareche|
sutarAM tomAra ravera zapatha! Ami tAdera sakalake prazna karavai,
sei viSaYe, yA tArA kare|
ataeva tumi ye viSaYe AdiSTa haYecha tA prakAzye pracAra kara evaM muzarikadera upekSA kara|
Amii yatheSTa tomAra janya, vidrupakArIdera viruddhe|
yArA AllAhara sAthe apara mA‘vUda pratiSThA kareche| evaM zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave!
Amito jAni ye, tArA yA vale tAte tomAra antara saMkucita haYa|
sutarAM tumi tomAra ravera prazaMsA dvArA tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara evaM sAjadAhakArIdera antarbhukta hao|
Ara tomAra mRtyu upasthita nA haoYA paryanta tumi tomAra ravera ivAdAta kara|
AllAhara Adeza Asavei; sutarAM oTA tvarAnvita karate ceonA; tini mahimAnvita evaM tArA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra urdhve|
tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA nirdeza samvalita ohIsaha mAlAka/pherezatA preraNa karena, ei marme satarka karAra janya, Ami chAr3A kona ilAha nei; sutarAM AmAke bhaYa kara|
tini yathAyathabhAve AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena; tArA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra urdhve|
tini zukra hate mAnuSa sRSTi karechena| athaca dekha, se prakAzya vitanDAkArI|
tini catuspada jantu sRSTi karechena; tomAdera janya ote zIta nivAraka upakaraNa evaM Arao vahu upakAra raYeche; evaM oTA hate tomarA AhArya peYe thAka|
Ara yakhana tomarA godhUli lagne oderake cAraNabhUmi hate gRhe niYe Aso evaM prabhAte yakhana oderake cAraNabhUmite niYe yAo takhana tomarA ora saundarya upabhoga kara evaM gaurava anubhava kara|
Ara orA tomAdera bhAra vahana kare niYe yAYa dUradeze yekhAne prANAnta kleza vyatIta tomarA pau~chate pAratenA; tomAdera rAvva avazyai daYArdra, parama daYAlu|
tomAdera Arohanera janya o zobhAra janya tini sRSTi karechena azva, khaccara, gardabha evaM tini sRSTi karena emana aneka kichu yA tomarA avagata nao|
sarala patha AllAhara kAche pau~chAYa, kintu pathagulira madhye vakra pathao raYeche| tini icchA karale tomAdera sakalakei sat pathe paricAlita karatena|
tinii AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena| ote tomAdera janya raYeche pAnIYa evaM tA hate janmAYa udbhida yAte tomarA pazu cAraNa kare thAka|
tini tomAdera janya ora dvArA utpanna karena zasya, yAitUna, khejura vRkSa, AGgura evaM sarvaprakAra phala; avazyai ete cintAzIla sampradAYera janya raYeche nidarzana|
tinii tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena rAtrI, dina, sUrya evaM cA~dake| Ara nakSatrarAjio adhIna haYeche tA~rai Adeze; avazyai ete vodhazaktisampanna sampradAYera janya raYeche nidarzana|
Ara vividha prakAzya vastuo, yA tomAdera janya pRthivIte sRSTi karechena| ete raYeche nidarzana sei sampradAYera janya yArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

tinii samudrake adhIna karechena yAte tomarA tA hate tAjA gozata AhAra karate pAra evaM yAte tA hate AharaNa karate pAra ratnAvalI yA tomarA bhUSaNa rUpe paridhAna kara; evaM tomarA dekhate pAo, ora vuka cire nauyAna calAcala kare evaM tA e janya ye, tomarA yena tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM tomarA yena kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
Ara tini pRthivIte sudRr3ha parvata sthApana karechena, yAte pRthivI tomAderake niYe Andolita nA haYa evaM sthApana karechena nada-nadI o patha, yAte tomarA tomAdera gantavyasthale pau~chate pAra|
Ara patha nirNAYaka cihnasamUhao; evaM nakSatrera sAhAyyeo mAnuSa pathera nirdeza pAYa|
tave ki yini sRSTi karena tini tArai mata ye sRSTi karenA? tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karavenA?
tomarA AllAhara anugraha gaNanA karale ora saMkhyA nirNaYa karate pAravenA; AllAha avazyai kSamA parAYaNa, parama daYAlu|
tomarA yA gopana rAkha evaM yA prakAza kara, AllAha tA jAnena|
tArA AllAha chAr3A apara yAderake AhavAna kare tArA kichui sRSTi karenA, tAderakei sRSTi karA haYa|
tArA nisprANa nirjIva evaM punarutthAna kave have se viSaYe tAdera kona jJAna nei|
tomAdera mA‘vUda ekai mA‘vUda| sutarAM yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa karenA tAdera antara satyavimukha evaM tArA ahaMkArI|
eTA niHsandeha ye, AllAha jAnena yA tArA gopana kare evaM yA tArA prakAza kare; tini ahaMkArIke pachanda karenanA|
yakhana tAderake valA haYaH tomAdera rAvva ki avatIrNa karechena? uttare tArA valeH pUrvavartIdera kissA-kAhinI|
phale kiYAmAta divase tArA vahana karave tAdera pApabhAra pUrNamAtrAYa evaM pApabhAra tAderao yAderake tArA ajJatA vazataH vibhrAnta kareche; hAYa! tArA yA vahana karave tA katai nA nikRSTa!

tAdera pUrvavartIrAo cakrAnta karechila| AllAha tAdera imArAtera bhittimUle AghAta karechilena; phale imArAtera chAda tAdera upara dhvase par3ala evaM tAdera prati zAsti neme elo emana dika hate yA chila tAdera dhAranAra vAhira|

pare kiYAmAta divase tini tAdera lAJchita karavena evaM valavenaH kothAYa AmAra sei sava zarIka yAdera samvandhe tomarA vitanDA karate? yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYechila tArA valaveH nizcaYai Aja lAJchanA o amaGgala kAphiradera janya|

mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNa tAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa tAdera nijedera prati yulama karate thAkA avasthAYa; ataHpara tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare valaveH AmarA kona manda kAja karatAmanA| hyA~, tomarA yA karate se viSaYe AllAha savizeSa avahita|
sutarAM tomarA dvAraguli diYe jAhAnnAme praveza kara, sekhAne sthAYI haoYAra janya| dekha, ahaMkArIdera AvAsasthala kata nikRSTa!

Ara yArA muttAkI tAderake valA haveH tomAdera rAvva ki avatIrNa karechilena? tArA valaveH mahA kalyANa| yArA satkAja kare tAdera janya raYeche ei duniYAra maGgala evaM AkhirAtera AvAsa Arao utkRSTa; Ara muttAkIdera AvAsasthala kata uttama!
oTA sthAYI jAnnAta, yAte tArA praveza karave; ora pAdadeze srotasvinI nadI pravAhita; tArA yA kichu kAmanA karave tAte tAdera janya tA’i thAkave; ebhAvei AllAha puraskRta karena muttAkIderake|
mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNa yAdera mRtyu ghaTAYa pavitra thAkA avasthAYa, (tAderake) valaveH tomAdera prati zAnti! tomarA yA karate tAra pratidAne jAnnAte praveza kara|
tArA zudhu pratIkSA kare tAdera kAche mAlAka/pherezatA Agamanera athavA tomAra ravera zAsti Agamanera; AllAha tAdera prati kona yulama karenani, kintu tArAi nijedera prati yulama karata|
sutarAM tAdera prati Apatita haYechila tAderai manda karmera zAsti evaM tAderake pariveSTana karechila oTAi yA niYe tArA ThATTA vidrupa karata|

muzarikarA valeH AllAha icchA karale AmAdera pitR-puruSarA o AmarA tini vyatIta apara kona kichura ivAdAta karatAma nA evaM tA~ra anumati vyatIta AmarA kona kichu niSiddha karatAma nA| tAdera pUrvavartIrAo ei rUpai karata; rAsUladera kartavya to zudhu suspaSTa vANI pracAra karA|

AllAhara ivAdAta karAra o tAgutake varjana karAra nirdeza deYAra janya Ami pratyeka jAtira madhyei rAsUla pAThiYechi; ataHpara tAdera katakake AllAha sat pathe paricAlita karena evaM tAdera katakera upara pathabhrAnti sAvyasta haYechila| sutarAM pRthivIte bhramaNa kara evaM dekha, yArA satyake mithyA valeche tAdera parinAma ki haYeche!
tumi tAderake patha pradarzana karate AgrahI haleo AllAha yAke vibhrAnta karechena tAke tini sat pathe paricAlita karavenanA evaM tAdera kona sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tArA dRr3hatAra sAthe AllAhara zapatha kare valeH yAra mRtyu haYa AllAha tAke punarujjIvita karavenanA| kena naYa? tini tA~ra pratizruti pUrNa karavenai; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA avagata naYa|
tini punarutthita karavena, ye viSaYe tAdera matAnaikya chila tA tAderake spaSTabhAve dekhAnora janya evaM yAte kAphirerA jAnate pAre ye, tArAi chila mithyAvAdI|
Ami kona kichu icchA karale sei viSaYe AmAra kathA zudhu ei ye, Ami vali ‘hao,’ phale tA haYe yAYa|
yArA atyAcArita haoYAra para AllAhara pathe hijarAta kareche Ami avazyai tAderake duniYAYa uttama AvAsa pradAna karava evaM AkhirAtera puraSkAraito zreSTha| hAYa! tArA yadi oTA jAnata!
tArA dhairya dhAraNa kare evaM tAdera ravera upara nirbhara kare|
tomAra pUrve Ami ahIsaha (puruSa) mAnuSai preraNa karechilAma, tomarA yadi nA jAna tAhale jJAnIderake jijJesa kara|

tAdera preraNa karechilAma spaSTa nidarzana o granthasaha evaM tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi mAnuSake spaSTabhAve vujhiYe deYAra janya, yA tAdera prati avatIrNa karA haYechila, yAte tArA cintA bhAvanA kare|
yArA duskarmera Sar3ayantra kare tArA ki e viSaYe nizcita ye, AllAha tAderake bhU-garbhe vilIna karavena nA, athavA emana dika hate zAsti Asave nA yA tAdera dhAraNAtIta?
athavA calAphirA karate thAkAkAle tini tAderake dhRta karavenanA? tArAto eTA vyartha karate pAravenA|
athavA tAderake tini bhIta santrasta avasthAYa pAkar3Ao karavenanA? tomAdera rAvvato avazyai kSamAkArI, parama daYAlu|
tArA ki lakSya karenA AllAhara sRSTa vastura prati, yAra chAYA DAne o vAme Dhale par3e AllAhara prati sAjadAhaYa nata haYa?
AllAhakei sAjadAha kare yA kichu sRSTi raYeche AkAzamanDalIte evaM pRthivIte evaM mAlAikAgaNao; tArA ahaMkAra karenA|
tArA bhaYa kare, tAdera upara parAkramazAlI tAdera rAvvake evaM tAderake yA Adeza karA haYa tArA tA pAlana kare| [sAjadAha]
AllAha valenaH tomarA dui ilAha grahaNa karanA; tinii ekamAtra ilAha, sutarAM tomarA AmAkei bhaYa kara|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai; evaM niravacchinna Anugatya tA~rai prApya; tomarA ki AllAha vyatIta anyake bhaYa karave?
tomarA ye sava anugraha bhoga kara tAto AllAharai nikaTa hate| adhikanta yakhana duHkha dainya tomAderake sparza kare takhana tomarA tA~kei vyAkulabhAve AhavAna kara|
AvAra yakhana (AllAha) tomAdera duHkha-dainya dUra karena takhana tomAdera eka dala tAdera ravera sAthe zarIka kare |
Ami tAderake yA dAna karechi tA asvIkAra karAra janya, sutarAM tomarA bhoga kare nAo, acirei jAnate pArave|

Ami tAderake ye riyka dAna kari tArA tAra eka aMza nirdhArita kare tAdera janya yAdera samvandhe tArA kichui jAnenA| zapatha AllAhara! tomarA ye mithyA udbhAvana kara sei samvandhe tomAderake prazna karA havei|
tArA nirdhAraNa kare AllAhara janya kanyA santAna| tini pavitra mahimAnvita, evaM tAdera janya oTAi yA tArA kAmanA kare|
tAdera kehake yakhana kanyA santAnera susaMvAda deYA haYa takhana tAra mukhamanDala kAlo haYe yAYa evaM se asahanIYa manastApe kliSTa haYa|

tAke ye saMvAda deYA haYa, tAra glAni hetu se nija sampradAYa hate Atmagopana kare| se cintA kare ye, hInatA sattveo se tAke rekhe dive, nAki mATite pu~te phelave| sAvadhAna! tArA yA siddhAnta neYa tA katai nA nikRSTa!
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa karenA tArA nikRSTa prakRtira sadRza| Ara AllAhato mahattama prakRtira adhikArI; evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha yadi mAnuSake tAdera sImA laMghanera janya zAsti ditena tAhale bhUpRSThe kona jIva jantukei rehAi ditenanA; kintu tini eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta tAderake avakAza diYe thAkena| ataHpara yakhana tAdera samaYa Ase takhana tArA muhurtakAla vilamva athavA tvarA karate pAravenA|

yA tArA apachanda kare tAi tArA AllAhara prati Aropa kare| tAdera jihavA mithyA varNanA kare ye, maGgala tAderai janya| nizcaYai tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAma evaM tAderakei sarvAgre tAte nikSepa karA have|

zapatha AllAhara! Ami tomAra pUrveo vahu jAtira nikaTa rAsUla preraNa karechi; kintu zAitAna ai sava jAtira kAryakalApa tAdera dRSTite zobhana karechila; sutarAM se’i Aja tAdera abhibhAvaka evaM tAderai janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
Amito tomAra prati ei kitAva avatIrNa karechi yArA e viSaYe matabheda kare tAderake suspaSTabhAve vujhiYe deYAra janya evaM mu’minadera janya patha-nirdeza o daYA svarUpa|
Ara AllAha AsamAna theke vRSTi varSaNa karechena| ataHpara tA diYe yamInake tAra mRtyura para sajIva karechena| nizcaYa ete nidarzana raYeche sei kaomera janyA yArA zune|
avazyai (gRhapAlita) catuspada jantura madhye tomAdera janya zikSA raYeche; ogulira udarasthita govara o raktera madhya hate tomAderake Ami pAna karAi vizuddha dugdha, yA pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu|
Ara khejura gAchera phala o AGgura hate tomarA mAdaka o uttama khAdya grahaNa kare thAka, ete avazyai vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYera janya raYeche nidarzana|
tomAra rAvva maumAchira antare iGgita dvArA nirdeza diYechenaH tumi gRha nirmANa kara pAhAr3a, vRkSa evaM mAnuSa ye gRha nirmANa kare tAte|

era para pratyeka phala hate kichu kichu AhAra kara, ataHpara tomAra ravera sahaja patha anusaraNa kara| ora udara hate nirgata haYa vividha varNera pAnIYa, yAte mAnuSera janya raYeche rogera pratiSedhaka| avazyai ete raYeche nidarzana cintAzIla sampradAYera janya|

AllAhai tomAderake sRSTi karechena| ataHpara tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena evaM tomAdera madhye kehake kehake upanIta karA haYa jarAjIrNa vaYase| phale tArA yA kichu jAnata se samvandhe tArA sajJAna thAkenA; AllAha sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha jIvanopakaraNe tomAdera ekajanake anyajanera upara zreSThatva diYechena| yAderake zreSThatva deYA haYeche tArA tAdera adhInastha dAsa dAsIderake nijedera jIvanopakaraNa hate emana kichu deYanA yAte tArA e viSaYe samAna haYe yAYa; tAhale ki tArA AllAhara anugraha asvIkAra kare?

Ara AllAha tomAdera hatei tomAdera jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM tomAdera yugala hate tomAdera janya putra-pautrAdi sRSTi karechena evaM uttama jIvanopakaraNa dAna karechena| tavuo ki tArA mithyA viSaYe vizvAsa karave evaM AllAhara anugraha asvIkAra karave?
evaM tArA ki ivAdAta karave AllAha chAr3A aparera yAdera AkAzamanDalI athavA pRthivI hate kona jIvanopakaraNa saravarAha karAra zakti nei? evaM tArA kichui karate sakSama naYa |
sutarAM tomarA AllAhara kona sadRza sthira karanA; nizcaYai AllAha jAnena evaM tomarA jAnanA|

AllAha upamA dicchena aparera adhikArabhukta eka dAsera, ye kona kichura upara zakti rAkhenA| evaM apara eka vyakti yAke tini nija hate uttama riyka dAna karechena evaM se tA hate gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare; tArA ki ubhaYe eke aparera samAna? sakala prazaMsA AllAharai prApya; athaca tAdera adhikAMza eTA jAnenA|

AllAha Arao upamA dicchena du’ vyaktira| odera ekajana mUka, kona kichurai zakti rAkhenA evaM se tAra mAlikera janya vojhA svarUpa| tAke yekhAnei pAThAno hoka nA kena se bhAla kichui kare Asate pArenA; se ki ai vyaktira mata samAna have ye nyAYera nirdeza deYa evaM ye Ache sarala pathe?
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYera jJAna AllAharai evaM kiYAmAtera vyApArato cokhera palakera nyAYa, varaM ora ceYeo sattvara; AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

Ara AllAha tomAderake nirgata karechena tomAdera mAtRgarbha hate emana avasthAYa ye, tomarA kichui jAnatenA, evaM tini tomAderake diYechena zravaNazakti, dRSTizakti evaM hRdaYa, yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
tArA ki lakSya karenA AkAzera zUnya garbhe niYantraNAdhIna vihaMgera prati? AllAhai oderake sthira rAkhena; avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janya|

evaM AllAha tomAdera gRhake karena tomAdera AvAsasthala, Ara tini tomAdera janya pazucarmera tAvura vyavasthA karena; oTA vahanakAle (tomAdera bhramaNakAle) evaM ote avasthAnakAle tomarA tA sahaje vahana karate pAra| tini tomAdera janya vyavasthA karena odera pazama, loma o keza hate kichu kAlera janya gRha sAmagrI o vyavahAra upakaraNa|

Ara AllAha yA kichu sRSTi karechena tAte tomAdera janya chAYAra vyavasthA karena evaM tini tomAdera janya pAhAr3e AzraYera vyavasthA karena evaM tomAdera janya vyavasthA karena paridheYa vastrera; oTA tomAderake tApa hate rakSA kare evaM tini vyavasthA karena tomAdera janya varmera, oTA tomAderake yuddhe rakSA kare; ebhAve tini tomAdera prati tA~ra anugraha pUrNa karena yAte tomarA AtmasamarpaNa kara|
ataHpara tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tomAra kartavyato zudhu spaSTabhAve vANI pau~che deYA|
tArA AllAhara anugraha jJAta Ache; kintu seguli tArA asvIkAra kare evaM tAdera adhikAMzai kAphira|
yedina Ami pratyeka sampradAYa hate eka ekajana sAkSI utthita karava sedina kAphiraderake anumati deYA havenA evaM tAderake (AllAhara) santuSTi lAbhera suyoga deYA havenA|
yakhana yAlimarA zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana tAdera zAsti laghu karA havenA evaM tAderake kona virAma deYA havenA|

muzarikarA yAderake (AllAhara) zarIka karechila tAderake dekhe valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! erAi tArA yAderake AmarA ApanAra zarIka karechilAma, yAderake AmarA AhavAna karatAma ApanAra parivarte; ataHpara taduttare tArA valaveH tomarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
sedina tArA AllAhara kAche AtmasamarpaNa karave evaM tArA ye mithyA udbhAvana karata tA tAdera janya niSphala have|
yArA kupharI kareche o AllAhara patha hate vAdhA diYeche, Ami tAdera zAstira upara zAsti vRddhi karava|

sedina Ami utthita karava pratyeka sampradAYa hate tAdera viSaYe eka ekajana sAkSI evaM tomAke Ami Anava sAkSI rUpe edera viSaYe; Ami AtmasamarpaNakArIdera (musalima) janya pratyeka viSaYe spaSTa vyAkhyAsvarUpa, patha nirdeza, daYA o susaMvAda svarUpa tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa karechi|

nizcaYai AllAha nyAYa parAYaNatA, sadAcaraNa o AtmIYa svajanake dAnera nirdeza dena evaM tini niSedha karena azlIlatA, asat kAja o sImA laMghana karate| tini tomAderake upadeza dena yAte tomarA zikSA grahaNa kara|
tomarA AllAhara aGgIkAra pUrNa kara yakhana paraspara aGgIkAra kara evaM tomarA zapatha dRr3ha karAra para tA bhaGga karanA; tomarA yA kara AllAha tA jAnena|

tomarA sei nArIra mata haYonA, ye tAra sUtA mAyavUta kare pAkAnora para ora pAka khule naSTa kare deYa| tomAdera zapatha tomarA parasparake pravaJcanA karAra janya vyavahAra kare thAko, yAte ekadala anyadala apekSA adhika lAbhavAna hao; AllAhato eTA dvArA zudhu tomAderake parIkSA karena; tomAdera ye viSaYe matabheda raYeche, kiYAmAta divase tini tA nizcaYai spaSTabhAve prakAza kare divena|

yadi AllAha icchA karatena tAhale tomAderake eka jAti karate pAratena, kintu tini yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM yAke icchA sat pathe paricAlita karena; tomarA yA kara se viSaYe avazyai tomAderake prazna karA have|

paraspara pravaJcanA karAra janya tomarA tomAdera zapathake vyavahAra karanA; tAhale pA sthira haoYAra para pichale yAve evaM AllAhara pathe vAdhA deYAra kAraNe tomarA zAstira AsvAda grahaNa karave| tomAdera janya raYeche kaThora zAsti|
tomarA AllAhara saGge kRta aMgIkAra tuccha mUlye vikri karanA; AllAhara kAche yA Ache zudhu tA’i tomAdera janya uttama, yadi tomarA jAnate|
tomAdera kAche yA Ache tA niHzeSa have evaM AllAhara kAche yA Ache tA sthAYI; yArA dhairya dhAraNa kare Ami nizcaYai tAderake tArA ye uttama kAja kare tA apekSA zreSTha puraskAra dAna karava|
mu’mina puruSa o nArIra madhye ye keha satkAja karave tAke Ami nizcaYai AnandamaYa jIvana dAna karava evaM tAderake tAdera karmera zreSTha puraskAra pradAna karava|
yakhana tumi kuraAna pATha karave takhana abhizapta zAitAna hate AllAhara AzraYa grahaNa karave|
tAra kona Adhipatya nei tAdera upara yArA ImAna Ane o tAdera ravera uparai nirbhara kare|
tAra Adhipatya zudhu tAderai upara yArA tAke abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa kare evaM yArA (AllAhara) sAthe zarIka kare|

Ami yakhana eka AYAtera parivarte anya eka AYAta upasthita kari, Ara AllAha yA avatIrNa karena tA tinii bhAla jAnena, takhana tArA valeH tumito zudhu mithyA udbhAvanakArI, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAnenA|

tumi valaH tomAra ravera nikaTa hate rUhula kudusa (jivarAIla) satyasaha kuraAna avatIrNa karechena yArA mu’mina tAderake dRr3ha pratiSThita karAra janya evaM hidAYAta o susaMvAda svarUpa AtmasamarpanakArIdera janya|
Amito jAnii tArA valeH tAke zikSA deYa janaika vyakti| tArA yAra prati eTA Aropa kare tAra bhASAto ArAvI naYa; kintu kuraAnera bhASA spaSTa ArAvI bhASA|
yArA AllAhara AYAta vizvAsa karenA tAderake AllAha hidAYAta karenanA evaM tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|
yArA AllAhara nidarzane vizvAsa karenA tArAto zudhu mithyA udbhAvaka evaM tArAi mithyAvAdI|

keha ImAna AnAra para AllAhake asvIkAra karale evaM kupharIra janya hRdaYa unmukta rAkhale tAra upara Apatita have AllAhara gayava evaM tAra janya Ache mahA zAsti; tave tAra janya naYa, yAke kupharIra janya vAdhya karA haYa, kintu tAra citta ImAne avicala|
eTA e janya ye, tArA duniYAra jIvanake AkhirAtera upara prAdhAnya deYa evaM e janya ye, AllAha kAphira sampradAYake hidAYAta karenanA|
orAi tArA, AllAha yAdera antara, karNa o cakSura upara mohara kare diYechena evaM tArAi gAphila|
nizcaYai tArA AkhirAte have kSatigrasta|
(tomAra ravera pathe theke) yArA niryAtita havAra para hijarAta kare evaM pare jihAda kare evaM dhairya dhAraNa kare; tomAra rAvva esava kichura para, tAdera prati avazyai kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
smaraNa kara sei dinake yedina AtmapakSa samarthane yukti upasthita karate Asave pratyeka vyakti evaM pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera pUrNa phala deYA have evaM tAdera prati yulama karA havenA|

AllAha dRSTAnta dicchena eka janapadera yA chila nirApada o nizcinta, yekhAne Asata sava dika hate pracura jIvanopakaraNa; ataHpara orA AllAhara anugraha asvIkAra karala| phale tAdera kRtakarmera kAraNe AllAha tAderake AsvAda grahaNa karAlena kSudhA o bhItira|
tAdera nikaTa esechila eka rAsUla tAderai madhya hate, kintu tArA tAke asvIkAra karechila; phale sImA laMghana karA avasthAYa zAsti tAderake grAsa karala|
AllAha tomAderake yA diYechena tammadhye yA vaidha o pavitra tA tomarA AhAra kara evaM tomarA yadi zudhu AllAharai ivAdAta kara tAhale tA~ra anugrahera janya kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

tini (AllAha) zudhumAtra mRta, rakta, zUkarera mAMsa evaM yA yavAhakAle AllAhara parivarte anyera nAma neYA haYeche tA’i tomAdera janya avaidha karechena, kintu keha ananyopAYa kiMvA sImA laMghanakArI nA haYe ananyopAYI hale AllAhato kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomAdera jihavA theke sAdhAraNataH ye sava mithyA kathA vera haYe Ase serUpa tomarA AllAhara viruddhe mithyA apavAda Aropa kare valanA - eTA hAlAla evaM oTA hArAma| yArA AllAha samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana karave tArA saphalakAma havenA|
tAdera sukha sambhoga sAmAnya evaM tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|
iYAhudIdera janya Ami zudhu tA’i nirdhAraNa karechilAma yA tomAra nikaTa Ami pUrve ullekha karechi evaM Ami tAdera upara kona yulama karini, kintu tArAi yulama karata tAdera nijedera prati|
yArA ajJatA vazataH khArApa kAja kare tArA pare tAovAha karale evaM nijederake saMzodhana karale tAdera janya tomAra rAvva avazyai ati kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai ivarAhIma chila eka ummAta AllAhara anugata, ekaniSTha evaM se chilanA muzarikadera antarbhukta|
se chila AllAhara anugrahera janya kRtajJa; AllAha tAke manonIta karechilena evaM tAke paricAlita karechilena sarala pathe|
Ami tAke duniYAYa diYechilAma maGgala evaM AkhirAteo nizcaYai se satkarmaparAYaNadera anyatama|
ekhana Ami tomAra prati pratyAdeza karalAma, tumi ekaniSTha ivarAhImera dharmAdarza anusaraNa kara; evaM se muzarikadera antarbhukta chilanA|

zanivAra pAlanato zudhu tAdera janya vAdhyatAmUlaka karA haYechila yArA e samvandhe matabheda karata| ye viSaYe tArA matabheda karata tomAra rAvva avazyai kiYAmAta divase sei viSaYe tAdera mImAMsA kare divena|

tumi mAnuSake tomAra ravera pathe AhavAna kara hikamAta o sadupadeza dvArA evaM tAdera sAthe AlocanA kara sundarabhAve| tomAra rAvva bhAla karei jAnena ke tA~ra patha cher3e vipathagAmI evaM ke sat pathe Ache|
yadi tomarA pratizodha grahaNa kara tAhale Thika tatakhAni karave yatakhAni anyAYa tomAdera prati karA haYeche; tave tomarA dhairya dhAraNa karale dhairyazIladera janya oTAi uttama|
tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara; tomAra dhairya have AllAharai sAhAyye; tAdera janya duHkha karanA evaM tAdera Sar3ayantre tumi manaHkSunna haYonA|
nizcaYai AllAha tAderai saGge Achena yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana kare evaM yArA sat karmaparAYaNa|

pavitra o mahimAmaYa tini yini tA~ra vAndAke rAte bhramaNa kariYechilena mAsajidula hArAma hate mAsajidula AkasAYa, yAra pariveza Ami karechilAma vArAkAtamaYa, tAke AmAra nidarzana dekhAnora janya; tinii sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma evaM tAke karechilAma vAnI isarAIlera janya patha nirdezaka| Ami Adeza karechilAma, tomarA Ami vyatIta apara kehakeo karma vidhAYakarUpe grahaNa karanA|
tomarAito tAdera vaMzadhara yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechilAma, se chila parama kRtajJa dAsa|
evaM Ami kitAve (tAorAte) pratyAdeza dvArA vAnI isarAIlake jAniYechilAma, nizcaYai tomarA pRthivIte du’vAra viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM tomarA atizaYa uddhatyakArI have|

ataHpara ei du’era prathamaTira nirdhArita kAla yakhana upasthita hala takhana Ami tomAdera viruddhe preraNa karechilAma AmAra dAsaderake, yuddhe atizaYa zaktizAlI; tArA ghare ghare praveza kare samasta kichu dhvaMsa karechila; zAstira pratijJA kAryakarI haYei thAke|
ataHpara Ami tomAdera punarAYa tAdera upara pratiSThita karalAma, tomAderake dhana-sampada o santAna-santati dvArA sAhAyya karalAma o saMkhyAgariSTha karalAma|

tomarA sat kAja karale tA nijederai janya karave evaM manda kAja karale tAo karave nijedera janya; ataHpara paravartI nirdhArita samaYa upasthita hale Ami AmAra dAsaderake preraNa karalAma tomAdera mukhamanDala kAlimAcchanna karAra janya, prathamavAra tArA yebhAve mAsajide praveza karechila punarAYa sebhAvei tAte praveza karAra janya evaM tArA yA adhikAra karechila tA sampUrNa rUpe dhvaMsa karAra janya|

sambhavataH tomAdera rAvva tomAdera prati daYA karavena| kintu tomarA yadi tomAdera pUrva AcaraNera punarAvRtti kara tAhale tinio tA~ra AcaraNera punarAvRtti karavena; jAhAnnAmake Ami karechi satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera janya kArAgAra|
ei kuraAna sarvazreSTha patha nirdeza kare evaM sat karmaparAYaNa vizvAsIderake susaMvAda deYa ye, tAdera janya raYeche mahA puraskAra|
Ara yArA parakAla vizvAsa karenA tAdera janya Ami prastuta kare rekhechi marmantuda zAsti|
mAnuSa yebhAve kalyANa kAmanA kare sebhAvei akalyANa kAmanA kare| mAnuSato ati tvarApravaNa|

Ami rAta o dinake karechi du’Ti nidarzana; rAtake karechi nirAloka evaM dinake karechi AlokamaYa, yAte tomarA tomAdera ravera anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA varSa saMkhyA o hisAva sthira karate pAra; evaM Ami sava kichu vizadabhAve varNanA karechi|
pratyeka mAnuSera kRtakarma Ami tAra grIvAlagna karechi evaM kiYAmAta divase Ami tAra janya vera karava eka kitAva, yA se pAve unmukta|
(Ami valava) tumi tomAra kitAva pATha kara; Aja tumi nijei tomAra hisAva nikAzera janya yatheSTa|

yArA sat patha avalamvana karave tArAto nijederai maGgalera janya tA avalamvana karave evaM yArA pathabhraSTa have tArAto pathabhraSTa have nijederai dhvaMsera janya evaM keha anya kArao bhAra vahana karavenA; Ami rAsUla nA pAThAno paryanta kehakeo zAsti diinA|

yakhana Ami kona janapada dhvaMsa karAra icchA kari takhana ora samRddhazAlI vyaktiderake sat kAja karate Adeza kari, kintu tArA sekhAne asat kAja kare| ataHpara ora prati danDAjJA nyAYa saGgata haYe yAYa evaM Ami oTAke sampUrNa rUpe vidhvasta kari|
nUhera para Ami kata mAnavagoSThI dhvaMsa karechi| tomAra rAvvai tA~ra dAsadera pApAcAraNera saMvAda rAkhA o paryavekSaNera janya yatheSTa|
keha pArthiva sukha sambhoga kAmanA karale Ami yAke yA icchA sattvara diYe thAki; pare tAra janya jAhAnnAma nirdhArita kari yekhAne se praveza karave nindita o anugraha hate vaJcita avasthAYa|
yArA vizvAsI haYe parakAla kAmanA kare evaM ora janya yathAyatha ceSTA kare tAdera praceSTAsamUha AllAhara kAche gRhIta have|
tomAra rAvva tA~ra dAna dvArA ederake evaM oderake sAhAyya karena evaM tomAra ravera dAna avArita|
lakSya kara, Ami kibhAve tAdera eka dalake aparera upara zreSThatva diYechilAma| parakAlato nizcaYai maryAdAYa zreSTha o zreYatve zreSThatara|
AllAhara sAthe apara kona mA‘vUda sthira karanA; tAhale nindita o niHsahAYa haYe par3ave|

tomAra rAvva nirdeza diYechena ye, tomarA tini chAr3A anya kArao ivAdAta karavenA evaM mAtA-pitAra prati sadvyavahAra karave; tAdera ekajana athavA ubhaYe tomAra jIvaddazAYa vArdhakye upanIta hale tAderake viraktisUcaka kichu valanA evaM tAderake bhatrsanA karanA; tAdera sAthe kathA vala sammAnasUcaka namrabhAve|
anukampAYa tAdera prati vinaYAvanata thAka evaM valaH he AmAra rAvva! tA~dera prati daYA karuna yebhAve zaizave tA~rA AmAke lAlana pAlana karechilena|
tomAdera rAvva tomAdera antare yA Ache tA bhAla jAnena; tomarA yadi sat karmaparAYaNa hao tAhale tini tAdera (AllAha abhimukhIdera) prati kSamAzIla|
AtmIYa svajanake dive tAra prApya evaM abhAvagrasta o paryaTakakeo (musAphirakeo), evaM kichutei apavyaYa karanA|
nizcaYai yArA apavyaYa kare tArA zAitAnera bhAi evaM zAitAna tAra ravera prati atizaYa akRtajJa|
Ara tumi yadi tAdera theke mukha phiriYe nAo evaM tumi tomAra ravera nikaTa hate anukampA lAbhera pratyAzAYa o sandhAne thAka tAhale tAdera sAthe namrabhAve kathA vala|
tumi vaddhamuSTi haYonA evaM ekevAre mukta hastao haYonA; tAhale tumi nindita o niHsva have|
tomAra rAvva yAra janya icchA tAra jIvanopakaraNa vardhita karena evaM yAra janya icchA tA hrAsa karena; tini tA~ra dAsaderake bhAlabhAve jAnena o dekhena|
tomAdera santAnaderake tomarA dAridratAra bhaYe hatyA karanA, tAderake evaM tomAderake Amii jIvanopakaraNa dii; tAderake hatyA karA mahApApa|
tomarA avaidha yauna saMyogera nikaTavartI haYonA, oTA azlIla o nikRSTa AcaraNa|

AllAha yAra hatyA niSedha karechena yathArtha kAraNa chAr3A tAke hatyA karanA; keha anyAYabhAve nihata hale tAra uttarAdhikArIke Ami pratizodha grahaNera adhikAra diYechi| kintu hatyAra vyApAre se yena vAr3AvAr3i nA kare; seto sAhAyya prApta haYechei|
pitRhIna vaYaHprApta nA haoYA paryanta saduddezya chAr3A tAra sampattira nikaTavartI haYonA evaM pratizruti pAlana kara; nizcaYai pratizruti samparke kaiphiYata talava karA have|
mepe deYAra samaYa pUrNa mApe dive evaM oyana karave saThika dA~r3i pAllAYa, eTAi uttama o pariNAme utkRSTa|
ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei sei viSaYe anumAna dvArA paricAlita haYonA| karNa, cakSu, hRdaYa - odera pratyekera nikaTa kaiphiYata talava karA have|
bhUpRSThe dambha bhare vicaraNa karanA, tumito kakhanai padabhare bhU-pRSTha vidIrNa karate pAravenA evaM uccatAYa tumi kakhanai parvata samAna hate pAravenA|
e savera madhye yeguli manda seguli tomAra ravera nikaTa ghRNya|

tomAra rAvva ahIra dvArA tomAke ye hikamAta dAna karechena eguli uhAra antarbhukta; tumi AllAhara sAthe kona ilAha sthira karanA, tAhale tumi nindita o (AllAhara) anugraha hate dUrIkRta avasthAYa jAhAnnAme nikSipta have|
