tomAdera rAvva ki tomAdera janya putra santAna nirdhAraNa karechena evaM tini nije (pherezatAdera) kanyA rUpe grahaNa karechena? tomarAto nizcaYai bhaYAnaka kathA vale thAka|
ei kuraAne vahu nItivAkya Ami vAravAra vivRta karechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare; kintu tAte tAdera vimukhatAi vRddhi pAYa|
valaH tAdera kathA mata yadi tA~ra sAthe Arao mA‘vUda thAkata tAhale tArA Araza adhipatira sAthe pratidvandvitA karAra upAYa anveSana karata|
tini pavitra, mahimAnvita evaM tArA yA vale tA hate tini vahu urdhve|

sapta AkAza, pRthivI evaM odera arntavartI sava kichu tA~rai pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM emana kichu nei yA tA~ra saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karenA| kintu odera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA tomarA anudhAvana karate pAranA; tini sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|
tumi yakhana kuraAna pATha kara takhana tomAra o yArA paraloke vizvAsa karenA tAdera madhye eka pracchanna pardA Tene dii|
Ami tAdera antarera upara AvaraNa diYechi yena tArA upaladdhi karate nA pAre evaM tAderake vadhira karechi| tomAra rAvva eka, eTA yakhana tumi kuraAna hate AvRtti kara takhana tArA sare par3e|

yakhana tArA kAna pete tomAra kathA zune takhana tArA kena tA zune Ami tA bhAla jAni, evaM eTAo jAni ye, gopane AlocanA kAle sImA laMghanakArIrA valeH tomarAto eka yAdugrasta vyaktira anusaraNa karacha|
dekha, tArA tomAra ki upamA deYa! tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM tArA sat patha khu~je pAvenA|
tArA valeH AmarA asthite pariNata o cUrNa-vicUrNa haleo ki natuna sRSTi rUpe punarutthita hava?
valaH tomarA haYe yAo pAthara athavA lauha –

athavA emana kichu yA tomAdera dhAraNAYa khuvai kaThina| tArA valaveH ke AmAderake punarutthita karave? valaH tinii yini tomAderake prathama vAra sRSTi karechena; ataHpara tArA tomAra sAmane mAthA nAr3Ave evaM valaveH oTA kave have? valaH have sambhavataH zIghrai –
yedina tini tomAderake AhavAna karavena evaM tomarA prazaMsAra sAthe tA~ra AhavAne sAr3A dive evaM tomarA mane karave, tomarA alpakAlai avasthAna karechile|
AmAra vAndAderake yA uttama tA valate vala; zAitAna tAdera madhye vibheda sRSTira uskAni deYa; zAitAna mAnuSera prakAzya zatru|
tomAdera rAvva tomAderake bhAlabhAve jAnena; icchA karale tini tomAdera prati daYA karena evaM icchA karale tomAderake zAsti dena; Ami tomAke tAdera abhibhAvaka kare pAThAini|
yArA AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte Ache tAderake tomAra rAvva bhAlabhAve jAnena; Amito nAvIdera katakake katakera upara maryAdA diYechi; dAudake Ami yAvura diYechi|
valaH tomarA AllAha chAr3A yAderake mA‘vUda mane kara tAderake AhavAna kara; karale dekhave tomAdera duHkha dainya dUra karAra athavA parivartana karAra zakti tAdera nei|

tArA yAderake AhavAna kare tAdera madhye yArA nikaTatara tArAito tAdera ravera naikaTya lAbhera upAYa sandhAna kare ye, ke kata nikaTatara hate pAre, tA~ra daYA pratyAzA kare evaM tA~ra zAstike bhaYa kare| nizcaYai tomAra ravera zAsti bhaYAvaha|
emana kona janapada nei yA Ami kiYAmAta dinera pUrve dhvaMsa karavanA athavA kaThora zAsti divanA; eTAto kitAve lipivaddha Ache|

pUrvavartIgaNa kartRka nidarzana asvIkAra karAra kAraNei AmAke nidarzana preraNa karA hate virata rAkhe; Ami spaSTa nidarzana svarUpa sAmUdera nikaTa uSTrI pAThiYechilAma, ataHpara tArA ora prati yulama karechila; Ami bhaYa pradarzanera janyai nidarzana preraNa kari|

smaraNa kara, Ami tomAke valechilAma, tomAra rAvva mAnuSake pariveSTana kare Achena; Ami ye dRzya tomAke dekhiYechi kiMvA kuraAne ullikhita abhizapta vRkSa zudhu mAnuSera parIkSAra janya Ami tAderake bhIti pradarzana kari| kintu eTA tAdera tIvra avAdhyatAi vRddhi kare|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami mAlAikA/pherezatAderake valalAmaH Adamera prati sAjadAhavanata hao; takhana ivalIsa chAr3A savAi sAjadAhavanata hala; se valalaH Ami ki tAke sAjadAha karava yAke Apani mATi hate sRSTi karechena?

se Arao valalaH lakSya karuna, tAke ye Apani AmAra upara maryAdA dAna karalena, kiYAmAtera dina paryanta yadi AmAke avakAza dena tAhale Ami alpa kaYekajana chAr3A tAra vaMzadharaderake samUle vinaSTa karava|
(AllAha) valalenaH yA, jAhAnnAmai tora evaM tAdera samyaka zAsti yArA tora anusaraNa karave|

tora AhavAne tAdera madhya theke yAke pArisa satyacUta kara, tora azvArohI o padAtika vAhinI dvArA tAderake AkramaNa kara evaM tAdera dhana-sampade o santAna-santatite zarIka haYe yA, evaM tAderake pratizruti de| zAitAna tAderake ye pratizruti deYa tA chalanA mAtra|
nizcaYai AmAra dAsadera upara tora kona kSamatA nei; karma vidhAYaka hisAve tora rAvvai yatheSTa|
tomAdera rAvva tinii yini tomAdera janya samudre nauyAna paricAlita karena yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra; tini tomAdera prati parama daYAlu|

samudre yakhana tomAderake vipada sparza kare takhana zudhu tini chAr3A apara yAderake tomarA AhavAna kara tArA tomAdera mana hate udhAo haYe yAYa| ataHpara tini yakhana sthale bhir3iYe tomAderake uddhAra karena takhana tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo; vastutaH mAnuSa var3ai akRtajJa|
tomarA ki nizcita Acha ye, tini tomAderake sthale kothAo bhU-garbhastha karavenanA athavA tomAdera upara kaMkara varSaNa karavenanA? takhana tomarA tomAdera kona karma vidhAYaka pAvenA|

athavA tomarA ki nizcinta Acha ye, tomAderake Ara ekavAra samudre niYe yAvenanA evaM tomAdera viruddhe pracanDa jhaTikA pAThAvenanA evaM tomAdera satya pratyAkhyAna karAra janya tomAderake nimajjita karavenanA? takhana tomarA e viSaYe AmAra viruddhe kona sAhAyyakArI pAvenA|

Amito Adama-santAnake maryAdA dAna karechi, sthale o samudre tAdera calAcalera vAhana diYechi; Ara tAderake uttama jIvanopakaraNa dAna karechi evaM Ami yAderake sRSTi karechi tAdera anekera upara tAderake zreSThatva diYechi|

smaraNa kara sei dinake yakhana Ami pratyeka sampradAYake tAdera netAsaha AhavAna karava; yAderake DAna hAte ‘AmalanAmA deYA have tArA tAdera ‘AmalanAmA pATha karave (Anandera sAthe) evaM tAdera upara sAmAnya parimANao yulama karA have nA|
ye ihaloke andha paralokeo se andha evaM adhikatara pathabhraSTa|

Ami tomAra prati yA pratyAdeza karechi tA hate tomAra padaskhalana ghaTAnora janya tArA cUr3Anta ceSTA kareche yAte tumi AmAra samvandhe kichu mithyA udbhAvana kara| saphalakAma hale tArA avazyai tomAke vandhu rUpe grahaNa karata|
Ami tomAke avicalita nA rAkhale tumi tAdera dike prAYa kichuTA jhu~kei par3ate|
tumi jhu~ke par3ale avazyai tomAke ihajIvane o parajIvane dviguNa zAsti AsvAdana karAtAma; takhana AmAra viruddhe tomAra janya kona sAhAyyakArI petenA|
tArA tomAke deza hate utkhAta karAra cUr3Anta ceSTA karechila tomAke sekhAna hate vahiskAra karAra janya| tAhale tomAra para tArAo sekhAne alpakAlai Tike thAkata|
AmAra rAsUladera madhye tomAra pUrve yAderake Ami pAThiYechilAma tAdera kSetreo chila erUpa niYama evaM tumi AmAra niYamera kona parivartana dekhate pAvenA|
sUrya hele par3Ara para hate rAtera ghana andhakAra paryanta sAlAta kAYema karave evaM kAYema karave phAjarera kuraAna pAThao| kAraNa bhorera kuraAna pATha sAkSI svarUpa|
Ara rAtera kichu aMze tAhAjjuda kAYema karave; eTA tomAra eka atirikta kartavya; AzA karA yAYa tomAra rAvva tomAke pratiSThita karavena prazaMsita sthAne|

valaH he AmAra rAvva! yekhAne gamana zubha o santoSajanaka Apani AmAke sekhAne niYe yAna evaM yekhAna hate nirgamana zubha o santoSajanaka sekhAna hate AmAke vera kare nina evaM ApanAra nikaTa hate AmAke dAna karuna sAhAyyakArI zakti|
Ara valaH satya eseche evaM mithyA vilupta haYeche; mithyAto vilupta haYei thAke|
Ami avatIrNa karechi kuraAna, yA vizvAsIdera janya sucikitsA o daYA, kintu tA sImA laMghanakArIdera kSatii vRddhi kare|
yakhana Ami mAnuSera upara anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa o ahaMkAre dUre sare yAYa evaM tAke aniSTa sparza karale se ekevAre hatAza haYe par3e|
valaH pratyeke tAra nija nija rIti anusAre kAja kare| kintu tomAra rAvva bhAla kare jAnena, ke sarvApekSA nirbhula pathe Ache|
tomAke tArA rUh samparke prazna kare, tumi valaH rUh AmAra ravera Adeza ghaTita; e viSaYe tomAderake sAmAnya jJAnai deYA haYeche|
icchA karale Ami tomAra prati yA pratyAdeza karechi tA avazyai pratyAhAra karate pAratAma; tAhale tumi e viSaYe AmAra viruddhe kona karmavidhAYaka petenA|
eTA pratyAhAra nA karA tomAra ravera daYA; tomAra prati Ache tA~ra mahA anugraha|
valaH yadi ei kuraAnera anurUpa kuraAna racanA karAra janya mAnuSa o jina samaveta haYa evaM tArA parasparake sAhAyya kare tavuo tArA era anurUpa kuraAna racanA karate pAravenA|
Ami ei kuraAne mAnuSera janya vibhinna upamA dvArA AmAra vANI vizadabhAve varNanA karechi| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kupharI karA chAr3A kSAnta haYanA|
Ara tArA valeH kakhanai AmarA tomAte vizvAsa sthApana karavanA, yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera janya bhUmi hate eka prasravaNa utsArita karave|
athavA tomAra kharjurera athavA AGgurera eka vAgAna have yAra phA~ke phA~ke tumi ajasra dhArAYa pravAhita kare dive nadInAlA|
athavA tumi yemana vale thAka, tadanuyAYI AkAzake khanDa vikhanDa kare AmAdera upara phelave, athavA AllAha o mAlAikAderake AmAdera sAmane upasthita karave|

athavA tomAra ekaTi svarNa nirmita gRha have, athavA tumi AkAze ArohaNa karave, kintu tomAra AkAze ArohaNa AmarA takhanao vizvAsa karavanA yatakSaNa nA tumi AmAdera prati eka kitAva avatIrNa karave yA AmarA pATha karava| valaH pavitra AmAra mahAna rAvva! Amito zudhu ekajana mAnuSa, ekajana rAsUla|
‘AllAha ki mAnuSake rAsUla kare pAThiYechena?’ - tAdera ei uktii vizvAsa sthApana hate lokaderake virata rAkhe, yakhana tAdera nikaTa Ase patha nirdeza|
valaH mAlAikA/pherezatArA yadi nizcita haYe pRthivIte vicaraNa karata tAhale Ami AkAza hate mAlAka/pherezatAkei tAdera nikaTa rAsUla kare pAThAtAma|
valaH AmAra o tomAdera madhye svAkSI hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa; tini tA~ra dAsaderake savizeSa jAnena o dekhena|

AllAha yAdera patha pradarzana karena tArAito saThika pathaprApta evaM yAderake pathabhraSTa karena tAdera janya tumi AllAha chAr3A kona sAhAyyakArI pAvenA| kiYAmAtera dina Ami tAderake samaveta karava tAdera mukhe bhara diYe calA avasthAYa, andha avasthAYa, vovA avasthAYa evaM vadhira avasthAYa| tAdera AvAsasthala jAhAnnAma! yakhanai tA stimita have Ami takhana tAdera janya Aguna vRddhi kare diva|
eTAi tAdera pratiphala, kAraNa tArA AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra karechila o valechilaH AmarA asthite pariNata o cUrNa vicUrNa haleo ki natuna sRSTi rUpe punarutthita hava?

tArA ki lakSya karenA ye, AllAha! yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena tini ogulira anurUpa sRSTi karate kSamatAvAna? tini tAdera janya sthira karechena eka nirdiSTa kAla, yAte kona sandeha nei; tathApi sImA laMghanakArIrA pratyAkhyAna karA chAr3A Ara savai asvIkAra kare|
valaH yadi tomarA AmAra ravera daYAra bhAnDArera adhikArI hate tavuo ‘vyaYa haYe yAve’ ei AzaMkAYa tomarA oTA dhare rAkhate, mAnuSato atizaYa kRpaNa|

tumi vAnI isarAIlake jijJesa kare dekha, Ami mUsAke naYaTi suspaSTa nidarzana diYechilAma; yakhana se tAdera nikaTa esechila takhana phira‘Auna tAke valechilaH he mUsA! Amito mane kari tumi yAdugrasta|

mUsA valechilaH tumi avazyai avagata Acha ye, ei samasta spaSTa nidarzana AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra rAvvai avatIrNa karechena pratyakSa pramANa svarUpa| he phira‘Auna! Amito dekhachi, tumi dhvaMsa haYe gecha|
ataHpara phira‘Auna tAderake deza hate uccheda karAra saMkalpa karala; takhana phira‘Auna o tAra saGgIdera sakalake Ami nimajjita karalAma|
erapara Ami vAnI isarAIlake valalAmaH tomarA ei deze vasavAsa kara evaM yakhana kiYAmAtera pratizruti vAstavAYita have takhana tomAdera sakalake Ami ekatrita kare upasthita karava|
Ami satya satyai kuraAna avatIrNa karechi evaM tA satyasahai avatIrNa haYeche; Amito tomAke zudhu susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI rUpe preraNa karechi|
Ami kuraAna avatIrNa karechi khanDa khanDabhAve yAte tumi tA mAnuSera kAche pATha karate pAra krame krame; evaM Ami tA yathAyathabhAve avatIrNa karechi|
valaH tomarA vizvAsa kara athavA nA kara, yAderake era pUrve jJAna dAna karA haYeche tAdera sAmane yakhana AvRtti karA haYa takhana tArA vinaYera sAthe kA~date kA~date bhUmite luTiYe par3e |
evaM valeH AmAdera rAvva pavitra, mahAna! AmAdera ravera pratizruti kAryakara haYei thAke| [sAjadAha]
evaM kA~date kA~date tAdera mukhamanDala mATite luTiYe par3e evaM ete tAdera vinaYai vRddhi pAYa|[sAjadAha]

valaH tomarA ‘AllAha’ nAme AhavAna kara athavA ‘rAhamAna’ nAme AhavAna kara, tomarA ye nAmei AhavAna karanA kena, sava sundara nAmaito tA~ra! tomarA sAlAte tomAdera svara ucu karanA evaM atizaYa kSINao karanA; ei dui era madhya panthA avalamvana kara|

valaH prazaMsA AllAharai yini santAna grahaNa karenani, tA~ra sArvabhaumatve kona aMzI nei evaM tini durdazAgrasta hananA ye kAraNe tA~ra abhibhAvakera praYojana hate pAre; sutarAM svasambhrame tA~ra mAhAtmya ghoSaNA kara|
samasta prazaMsA AllAharai yini tA~ra dAsera prati ei kitAva avatIrNa karechena evaM ete tini asaGgati rAkhenani|
eke karechena supratiSThita tA~ra kaThina zAsti samparke satarka karAra janya evaM vizvAsIgaNa, yArA satkAja kare tAderake ei susaMvAda deYAra janya ye, tAdera janya raYeche uttama puraskAra –
yekhAne tArA have cirasthAYI –
evaM satarka karAra janya tAderake yArA vale ye, AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena|
e viSaYe tAdera konai jJAna nei evaM tAdera pitRpuruSaderao chilanA; tAdera mukha-niHsRta vAkya ki udbhaTa! tArAto zudhu mithyAi vale|
tArA ei vANI vizvAsa nA karale tAdera pichane pichane ghure sambhavataH tumi duHkhe AtmavinAzI haYe par3ave|
pRthivIra upara yA kichu Ache Ami segulike ora zobhanIYa karechi mAnuSake ei parIkSA karAra janya ye, tAdera madhye karme ke zreSTha?
ora upara yA kichu Ache tA avazyai Ami udbhidazUnya mRttikAYa pariNata karava|
tumi ki mane kara ye, guhA o rAkImera adhivAsIrA AmAra nidarzanAvalIra madhye vismaYakara?

yuvakarA yakhana guhAYa AzraYa nila takhana tArA valechilaH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani nija hate AmAderake anugraha dAna karuna evaM AmAdera janya AmAdera kAjakarma saThikabhAve paricAlanAra vyavasthA karuna|
ataHpara Ami tAderake guhAYa kaYeka vachara ghumanta avasthAYa rekhe dilAma|
pare Ami tAderake jAgarita karalAma eTA jAnAra janya ye, dui dalera madhye kona dala tAdera avasthiti kAla saThikabhAve nirNaYa karate pAre|
Ami tomAra kAche tAdera saThika vRttAnta varNanA karachiH tArA chila kaYekajana yuvaka, tArA tAdera ravera prati vizvAsa sthApana karechila evaM Ami tAdera sat pathe calAra zakti vRddhi karechilAma|

Ara Ami tAdera citta dRr3ha karechilAma; tArA yakhana uThe dA~r3Ala takhana valalaH AmAdera rAvva AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra rAvva; AmarA kakhanai tA~ra parivarte anya kona mA‘vUdake AhavAna karavanA; yadi kari tAhale tA atizaYa garhita have|

AmAderai ei svajAtirA tA~ra parivarte aneka mA‘vUda grahaNa kareche, tArA ei sava mA‘vUda samvandhe spaSTa pramANa upasthita kare nA kena? ye AllAha samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kare tAra ceYe adhika sImAlaMghanakArI Ara ke?

tomarA yakhana tAdera hate vicchinna hale evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdAta kare tAdera hate, takhana tomarA guhAYa AzraYa grahaNa kara; tomAdera rAvva tomAdera janya tA~ra daYA vistAra karavena evaM tini tomAdera karmasamUhake phalaprasU karAra vyavasthA karavena|

tumi sUryake dekhave yakhana udita haYa, tAdera guhA theke pAza keTe DAna dike cale yAYa evaM yakhana asta yAYa, tAdera theke pAza keTe vAma dike cale yAYa, athaca tArA guhAra prazasta catvare zAYita| esavai AllAhara nidarzana| AllAha yAke sat pathe paricAlita karena se sat patha prApta evaM tini yAke pathabhraSTa karena, tumi kakhanao tAra kona patha pradarzanakArI abhibhAvaka pAvenA|

tumi mane karate tArA jAgrata, kintu tArA chila nidrita; Ami tAderake pArzva parivartana karAtAma DAne o vAme evaM tAdera kukura chila sammukhera pA du’Ti guhAdvAre prasArita kare; tAkiYe tAderake dekhale tumi pichana phire pAliYe yete evaM tAdera bhaYe AtaMkagrasta haYe par3ate|

evaM ebhAvei Ami tAdera jAgrata karalAma yAte tArA parasparera madhye jijJAsAvAda kare; tAdera ekajana valalaH tomarA katakAla avasthAna karecha? keha keha valalaH eka dina athavA eka dinera kichu aMza; keha keha valalaH tomarA katakAla avasthAna karecha tA tomAdera rAvvai bhAla jAnena; ekhana tomAdera ekajanake tomAdera ei mudrAsaha nagare preraNa kara; se yena dekhe kon khAdya uttama evaM tA hate yena kichu khAdya niYe Ase tomAdera janya; se yena vicakSaNatAra sAthe kAja kare evaM kichutei yena tomAdera samvandhe kehakeo kichu jAnate nA deYa|
tArA yadi tomAdera viSaYa jAnate pAre tAhale tomAderake prastarAghAte hatyA karave athavA tomAderake tAdera dharme phiriYe nive evaM sekSetre tomarA kakhanai sAphalya lAbha karavenA|

evaM ebhAve Ami mAnuSake tAdera viSaYa jAniYe dilAma yAte tArA jJAta haYa ye, AllAhara pratizruti satya evaM kiYAmAte kona sandeha nei; yakhana tArA tAdera kartavya viSaYe nijedera madhye vitarka karachila takhana aneke valalaH tAdera upara saudha nirmANa kara; tAdera rAvva tAdera viSaYa bhAla jAnena; tAdera kartavya viSaYe yAdera mata pravala hala tArA valalaH AmarAto nizcaYai tAdera upara mAsajida nirmANa karava|

ajAnA viSaYe anumAnera upara nirbhara kare keha keha valeH tArA chila tina jana, tAdera caturthaTi chila tAdera kukura; evaM keha keha valeH tArA chila pA~ca jana, SaSThaTi chila tAdera kukura; AvAra keha keha valeH tArA chila sAta jana, aSTamaTi chila tAdera kukura; valaH AmAra rAvvai tAdera saMkhyA bhAla jAnena; tAdera saMkhyA alpa kaYekajanai jAne; sAdhAraNa AlocanA vyatIta tumi tAdera viSaYe vitarka karanA evaM tAdera kehakeo tAdera viSaYe jijJAsAvAda karanA|
kakhanai tumi kona viSaYe valanA - Ami oTA AgAmIkAla karava –
‘AllAha icchA karale’ - ei kathA nA vale; yadi bhule yAo tAhale tomAra rAvvake smaraNa kara o valaH sambhavataH AmAra rAvva AmAke guhAvAsIra vivaraNa apekSA satyera nikaTatara patha nirdeza karavena|
tArA tAdera guhAYa chila tina za’ vachara, Arao naYa vachara|

tumi valaH tArA kata kAla chila tA AllAhai bhAla jAnena, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra ajJAta viSaYera jJAna tA~rai; tini kata sundara draSTA o zrotA! tini chAr3A tAdera anya kona abhibhAvaka nei; tini kehakeo nija kartRtve zarIka karenanA|
tumi tomAra prati pratyAdiSTa tomAra ravera kitAva AvRtti kara; tA~ra vAkya parivartana karAra keha nei; tumi kakhanai tA~ke vyatIta anya kona AzraYa pAvenA|

nijake tumi rAkhave tAderai saMsarge yArA sakAla-sandhyAYa AhavAna kare tAdera rAvvake tA~ra santuSTi lAbhera uddeze evaM tumi pArthiva jIvanera zobhA kAmanA kare tAdera dika hate tomAra dRSTi phiriYe nionA; yAra cittake Ami AmAra smaraNe amanoyogI kare diYechi se tAra kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kare evaM yAra kAryakalApa sImA atikrama kare tumi tAra Anugatya karanA|

valaH satya tomAdera ravera nikaTa hate prerita; sutarAM yAra icchA vizvAsa karuka evaM yAra icchA pratyAkhyAna karuka; Ami sImA laMghanakArIdera janya prastuta rekhechi agni, yAra veSTanI tAderake pariveSTana kare thAkave; tArA pAnIYa cAile tAderake deYA have galita dhAtura nyAYa pAnIYa, yA tAdera mukhamanDala vidagdha karave, kata nikRSTa pAnIYa eTA evaM agni kata nikRSTa AzraYa!
yArA vizvAsa kare evaM sat kAja kare Ami tAderake puraskRta kari, ye sat kAja kare Ami tAra karmaphala naSTa karinA|

tAderai janya Ache sthAYI jAnnAta yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tAderake svarNa-kaMkane alaMkRta karA have, tArA paridhAna karave sUkSma o sthUla rezamera savuja vastra o samAsIna have susajjita Asane; kata sundara puraskAra o uttama AzraYasthala!

tumi tAdera kAche peza kara dui vyaktira ekaTi upamA; tAdera eka janake Ami diYechilAma du’Ti drAkSA udyAna evaM ei du’Tike Ami khejura vRkSa dvArA pariveSTita karechilAma evaM ei du’Yera madhyavartI sthAnake karechilAma zasyakSetra|
ubhaYa udyAnai phala dAna karata evaM ete kona kraTi karatanA evaM ubhaYera phA~ke phA~ke pravAhita karechilAma nahara|
evaM tAra pracura dhana-sampada chila; ataHpara kathA prasaGge se tAra vandhuke valalaH dhana-sampade Ami tomA apekSA zreSTha evaM janavale tomA apekSA zaktizAlI|
ebhAve nijera prati yulama kare se tAra udyAne praveza karala| se valalaH Ami mane karinA ye, eTA kakhanao dhvaMsa have|
Ami mane karinA ye, kiYAmAta have, Ara Ami yadi AmAra ravera nikaTa pratyAvRtta hai-i tAhale Amito nizcaYai eTA apekSA utkRSTa sthAna pAva|
taduttare tAke tAra vandhu valalaH tumi ki tA~ke asvIkAra karacha yini tomAke sRSTi karechena mRttikA o pare zukra hate evaM tArapara pUrNAGga karechena mAnava AkRtira?
kintu Ami valiH AllAhai AmAra rAvva evaM Ami kehakeo AmAra ravera sAthe zarIka karinA|
tumi yakhana dhane o santAne AmAke tomA apekSA kama dekhale takhana tomAra udyAne praveza kare tumi kena valalenAH AllAha yA ceYechena tA’i haYeche, AllAhara sAhAyya vyatIta kona zakti nei|
sambhavataH AmAra rAvva AmAke tomAra udyAna apekSA utkRSTatara kichu divena evaM tomAra udyAne AkAza hate agni varSaNa karavena yAra phale tA udbhidazUNya mAidAne pariNata have|
athavA ora pAni bhU-garbhe antarhita have evaM tumi kakhanao oke phiriYe Anate pAravenA|

tAra dhana-sampada dhvaMsa haYe gela evaM se tAte yA vyaYa karechila tAra janya hAte hAta rekhe AkSepa karate lAgala, yakhana tA dhvaMsa haYe gela| se valate lAgalaH hAYa! Ami yadi kehakeo AmAra ravera sAthe zarIka nA karatAma!
evaM AllAha vyatIta tAke sAhAyya karAra kona lokajana chilanA evaM se nijeo pratikAre sAmarthya halanA|
e kSetre sAhAyya karAra adhikAra AllAharai yini satya; puraskAra dAne o pariNAma nirdhAraNe tinii zreSTha|

tAdera kAche peza kara pArthiva jIvanera upamA - eTA pAnira nyAYa yA Ami varSaNa kari AkAza hate, yadvArA bhUmira udbhida ghana sanniviSTa haYe udgata haYa, ataHpara tA vizuska haYe emana cUrNa vicUrNa haYa ye, vAtAsa oke ur3iYe niYe yAYa; AllAha sarva viSaYe zaktimAna|
dhanaizvarya o santAna-santati pArthiva jIvanera zobhA evaM sat kArya - yAra phala sthAYI, oTA tomAra ravera nikaTa puraskAra prAptira janya zreSTha evaM vAJchA lAbhera vyApAreo utkRSTa|
Ara yedina Ami pAhAr3ake calamAna karava evaM tumi yamInake dekhate pAve dRzyamAna, Ara Ami tAderake ekatra karava| ataHpara tAdera kAukei chAr3ava nA|

Ara tAderake tomAra ravera nikaTa upasthita karA have sArivaddhabhAve evaM valA haveH tomAderake prathamavAra yebhAve sRSTi karechilAma sebhAvei tomarA AmAra nikaTa upasthita haYecha; athaca tomarA mane karate ye, tomAdera janya pratizruta kSaNa Ami upasthita karavanA|

evaM sedina upasthita karA have ‘AmalanAmA evaM tAte yA lipivaddha Ache tAra kAraNe tumi aparAdhIderake dekhave AtaMkagrasta evaM tArA valaveH hAYa! durbhoga AmAdera! eTA kemana grantha! oTAto choTa var3a kichui vAda deYani, varaM oTA samasta hisAva rekheche| tArA tAdera kRtakarma sammukhe upasthita pAve; tomAra rAvva kArao prati yulama karena nA|

evaM smaraNa kara, Ami yakhana mAlAikA/pherezatAderake valechilAmaH tomarA Adamera prati nata hao| takhana savAi nata hala ivalIsa chAr3A; se jinadera ekajana, se tAra ravera Adeza amAnya karala; tAhale ki tomarA AmAra parivarte tAke o tAra vaMzadharake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karacha? tArA to tomAdera zatru; sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya raYeche kata nikRSTa vadalA|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikAle Ami tAderake DAkini evaM tAdera sRjanakAleo naYa, evaM Ami vibhrAntakArIdera sAhAyya grahaNa karAra nai|

evaM sedinera kathA smaraNa kara yedina tini valavenaH tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka mane karate tAderake AhavAna kara; tArA takhana tAderake AhavAna karave, kintu tArA tAdera AhavAne sAr3A divenA evaM Ami tAdera ubhaYera madhyasthale rekhe diva eka dhvaMsa gahavara|
pApIrA Aguna avalokana kare AzaMkA karave yena orA otei patita have, vastutaH oTA hate orA paritrANa pAvenA|
Ami mAnuSera janya ei kuraAne vibhinna upamAra dvArA AmAra vANI vizadabhAve varNanA karechi; mAnuSa adhikAMza vyApArei vitarka priYa|

hidAYAta AsAra para e pratIkSAi zudhu mAnuSake vizvAsa sthApana evaM tAdera ravera kAche kSamA prArthanA karate virata rAkhe ye, kakhana Asave tAdera pUrva-puruSadera anurUpa AyAva athavA kakhanai vA tArA tA pratyakSa karave|

Ami zudhu susaMvAda dAtA o satarkakArI rUpei rAsUladerake pAThiYe thAki, kintu satya pratyAkhyAnakArIrA mithyA avalamvane vitanDA kare satyake vyartha kare deYAra janya evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o yadvArA tAderake satarka karA haYeche sei savake tArA vidrupera viSaYa rUpe grahaNa kare thAke|

kona vyaktike tAra ravera nidarzanAvalI smaraNa kariYe deYAra para se yadi tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa evaM tAra kRtakarmasamUha bhule yAYa tAhale tAra apekSA adhika sImA laMghanakArI Ara ke? Ami tAdera antarera upara AvaraNa diYechi yena tArA kuraAna vujhate nA pAre evaM tAderake vadhira karechi; tumi tAderake sat pathe AhavAna karaleo tArA kakhanao sat pathe AsavenA|

evaM tomAra rAvva kSamAzIla, daYAvAna| tAdera kRtakarmera janya tAderake zAsti dite cAile tini tAdera zAsti tvarAnvita karatena; kintu tAdera janya raYeche eka pratizruta muhurta, yA hate tAdera paritrANa nei|
ai sava janapada - tAdera adhivAsIvRndake Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma yakhana tArA sImA laMghana karechila evaM tAdera dhvaMsera janya Ami sthira karechilAma eka nirdiSTa kSaNa|
smaraNa kara sei samaYera kathA yakhana mUsA tAra saGgIke valechilaH dui samudrera saMyogasthale nA pau~che Ami thAmavanA, Ami yuga yuga dhare calate thAkava|
tArA yakhana ubhaYera saMgamasthale pau~chala, tArA nijedera mAchera kathA bhule gela; oTA suraGgera mata patha kare samudre neme gela|
yakhana tArA Arao agrasara hala, mUsA tAra saMgIke valalaH AmAdera prAtaHrAza niYe eso, AmarAto AmAdera ei saphare klAnta haYe par3echi|

se valalaH Apani ki lakSya karechena, AmarA yakhana zilAkhanDe vizrAma karachilAma takhana Ami mAchera kathA bhule giYechilAma? zAitAnai e kathA valate AmAke bhuliYe diYechila; mAchaTi AzcaryajanakabhAve nijera patha kare neme gela samudre|
mUsA valalaH AmarAto ai sthAnaTirai anusandhAna karachilAma; ataHpara tArA nijedera padacihna dhare phire calala|
ataHpara tArA sAkSAt pela AmAra dAsadera madhye ekajanera yAke Ami AmAra nikaTa hate diYechilAma eka vizeSa jJAna|
mUsA tAke valalaH satya pathera ye jJAna ApanAke dAna karA haYeche tA hate AmAke zikSA divena - ei zarte Ami ApanAra anusaraNa karava ki?
se valalaH tumi kichutei AmAra saGge dhairya dhAraNa kare thAkate pAravenA|
ye viSaYa tomAra jJAnAYatta naYa se viSaYe tumi dhairya dhAraNa karave kemana kare?
mUsA valalaH AllAha cAile Apani AmAke dhairyazIla pAvena evaM ApanAra kona Adeza Ami amAnya karavanA|
se valalaH AcchA, tumi yadi AmAra anusaraNa karai tAhale kono viSaYe AmAke prazna karanA, yatakSaNa nA Ami se samvandhe tomAke kichu vali|

ataHpara tArA yAtrA zuru karala| pare yakhana tArA naukAYa ArohaNa karala takhana se tAte chidra kare dila; mUsA valalaH Apani ki ArohIderake nimajjita kare deYAra janya tAte chidra karalena? Apanito eka gurutara anyAYa kAja karalena|
se valalaH Ami ki valini ye, tumi AmAra saGge kichutei dhairya dhAraNa karate pAravenA?
mUsA valalaH AmAra bhulera janya AmAke aparAdhI karavenanA evaM AmAra vyApAre atyadhika kaThoratA avalamvana karavenanA|

ataHpara tArA calate lAgala, calate calate tAdera sAthe eka vAlakera sAkSAt hale se tAke hatyA karala; takhana mUsA valalaH Apani eka nispApa jIvana nAza karalena hatyAra aparAdha chAr3Ai! Apanito eka gurutara anyAYa kAja karalena|
se valalaH Ami ki valini ye, tumi AmAra sAthe kichutei dhairya dhAraNa karate pAravenA?
(mUsA) valalaH erapara yadi Ami ApanAke kona viSaYe jijJesa kari tAhale Apani AmAke saGge rAkhavenanA; takhana AmAra oyara Apatti cUr3Anta sImAYa pau~che yAve|

ataHpara ubhaYe calate lAgala; calate calate tArA eka janapadera adhivAsIdera nikaTa pau~chala evaM tAdera nikaTa khAdya cAila| kintu tArA tAdera mehamAnadArI karate asvIkAra karala; ataHpara sekhAne tArA eka patanommukha prAcIra dekhate pela evaM se oTAke sudRr3ha kare dila; (mUsA) valalaH Apanito icchA karale era janya pArizramika grahaNa karate pAratena|
se valalaH ekhAnei tomAra o AmAra madhye samparkaccheda hala; ye viSaYe tumi dhairya dhAraNa karate pArani Ami tAra tAtparya vyAkhyA karachi|

naukATira vyApAre - (kathA ei ye), oTA chila katipaYa daridra vyaktira, tArA samudre jIvikA anveSaNa karata; Ami icchA karalAma naukATike kraTiyukta karate; kAraNa tAdera sAmane chila eka rAjA, ye vala praYoge pratyeka (nikhuta) naukA chiniYe nita|
Ara kizoraTi, tAra mAtApitA chila mu’mina - Ami AzaMkA karalAma ye, se vidrohAcaraNa o kupharIra dvArA tAdera vivrata karave|
ataHpara Ami cAilAma ye, tAdera rAvva yena tAderake tAra parivarte eka santAna dAna karena ye have pavitratAYa mahattara o bhakti bhAlavAsAYa ghaniSTatara|

Ara ai prAcIraTi - oTA chila nagaravAsI dui pitRhIna kizorera, era nimnadeze Ache tAdera guptadhana evaM tAdera pitA chila satkarma parAYaNa| sutarAM tomAra rAvva daYAparavaza haYe icchA karalena ye, tArA vaYaHprApta hoka evaM tArA tomAra ravera deYA tAdera dhanabhAnDAra uddhAra karuka; Ami nija hate kichu karini; tumi ye viSaYe dhairya dhAraNe apAraga haYechile eTAi tAra vyAkhyA|
tArA tomAke yulakAranAina samvandhe jijJesa karache; tumi vale dAoH Ami tomAdera nikaTa tAra viSaYa varNanA karava|
Ami tAke pRthivIte kartRtva diYechilAma evaM pratyeka viSaYera upAYa o panthA nirdeza karechilAma|
se eka patha avalamvana karala|

calate calate yakhana se sUryera astagamana sthAne pau~chala takhana se sUryake eka paMkila pAnite asta yete dekhala evaM se sekhAne eka sampradAYake dekhate pela; Ami valalAmaH he yulakAranAina! tumi tAderake zAsti dite pAra athavA tAderake sadaYabhAve grahaNa karate pAra|
se valalaH ye keha sImA laMghana karave Ami tAke zAsti diva| ataHpara se tAra ravera nikaTa pratyAvartita have evaM tini tAke kaThina zAsti divena|
tave ye vizvAsa kare evaM sat kAja kare tAra janya pratidAna svarUpa Ache kalyANa evaM AmAra kAje tAke sahaja nirdeza diva|
AvAra se eka patha dharala|
calate calate yakhana se sUryodaYa sthale pau~chala takhana se dekhalo - oTA emana eka sampradAYera upara udita hacche yAdera janya sUrya tApa hate AtmarakSAra kona antarAla Ami sRSTi karini|
prakRta ghaTanA eTAi ye, tAra vRttAnta Ami samyaka avagata Achi|
AvAra se eka patha dharala|
calate calate se yakhana parvata prAcIrera madhyavartI sthAne pau~chala takhana sekhAne se eka sampradAYake pela yArA tAra kathA moTei vujhate pArachilanA|
tArA valalaH he yulakAranAina! iYAjuja o mA‘juja pRthivIte azAnti sRSTi karache; AmarA ki tomAke rAjasva diva ei zarte ye, tumi AmAdera o tAdera madhye eka prAcIra gar3e dive?
se valalaH AmAra rAvva AmAke ye kSamatA diYechena tA’i utkRSTa; sutarAM tomarA AmAke zrama dvArA sAhAyya kara, Ami tomAdera o tAdera madhyasthale eka mAyavUta prAcIra gar3e diva|

tomarA AmAra nikaTa lauhapinDasamUha AnaYana kara; ataHpara madhyavartI phA~kA sthAna pUrNa haYe yakhana lauhasttapa dui parvatera samAna hala takhana se valalaH tomarA hA~pare dama dite thAka| yakhana oTA agnivat uttapta hala takhana se valalaH tomarA galita tAmA niYe eso, Ami oTA Dhele dii ora upara|
erapara iYAjuja o mA’juja tA atikrama karate pAralanA vA bheda karate pAralanA|
yulakAranAina valalaH eTA AmAra ravera anugraha; yakhana AmAra ravera pratizruti pUrNa have takhana tini oTAke cUrna-vicUrNa kare divena evaM AmAra ravera pratizruti satya|
sedina Ami tAderake cher3e diva ekera para eka taraGgera AkAre evaM ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have; ataHpara Ami tAdera savAike ekatrita karava|
Ara sedina Ami jAhAnnAmake pratyakSabhAve upasthita karava satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera nikaTa –
yAdera cakSu chila andha, AmAra nidarzanera prati evaM yArA zunateo chila apAraga|

yArA satya pratyAkhyAna kareche tArA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra parivarte AmAra vAndAderake abhibhAvakarUpe grahaNa karave? Ami satya pratyAkhyAnakArIdera abhyarthanAra janya prastuta rekhechi jAhAnnAma|
valaH Ami ki tomAderake saMvAda diva karme vizeSa kSatigrastadera vyApAre?
orAi tArA, pArthiva jIvane yAdera praceSTA panDa haYa, yadio tArA mane kare ye, tArA sat kAja karache|

orAi tArA, yArA asvIkAra kare tAdera ravera nidarzanAvalI o tA~ra sAthe tAdera sAkSAtera viSaYa| phale tAdera kAja niSphala haYe yAYa; sutarAM kiYAmAta divase tAdera janya kona ojanera vyavasthA rAkhava nA|
jAhAnnAma-eTAi tAdera pratiphala, yehetu tArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o rAsUlagaNake grahaNa kareche vidrupera viSaYasvarUpa|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tAdera ApyAYanera janya Ache jAnnAtula phiradAusa|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have; tA hate sthAnAntara kAmanA karavenA|
valaH AmAra ravera kathA lipivaddha karAra janya samudra yadi kAli haYa tAhaleo AmAra ravera kathA zeSa havAra pUrvei samudra niHzeSa haYe yAve-sAhAyyArthe era anurUpa Arao samudra niYe eleo|

valaH Amito tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa, AmAra prati pratyAdeza haYa ye, tomAdera ilAha ekamAtra ilAha| sutarAM ye tAra ravera sAthe sAkSAta kAmanA kare se yena sat kAja kare evaM tAra ravera ivAdAte kehakeo zarIka nA kare|
kAph hA iYA ‘AIna sAda|
eTA tomAra ravera anugrahera vivaraNa, tA~ra dAsa yAkAriYAra prati|
yakhana se tAra rAvvake AhavAna karechila nibhRte|
se valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAra asthi durvala haYeche, vArdhakye AmAra mastaka zubhrojjvala haYeche; he AmAra rAvva! ApanAke AhavAna kare Ami kakhanao vyarthakAma haini|
Ami AzaMkA kari AmAra para AmAra svagotrarA dInake dhvaMsa kare dive; AmAra strI vandhyA| sutarAM Apani ApanAra tarapha hate AmAke dAna karuna uttarAdhikArI –
ye AmAra uttarAdhikArI have evaM uttarAdhikArItva pAve iYAkUvera vaMzera evaM he AmAra rAvva! tAke karuna santoSabhAjana|
tini valalenaH he yAkAriYA! Ami tomAke eka putrera susaMvAda dicchi - tAra nAma have iYAhaiYA| ei nAme Ami pUrve kArao nAmakaraNa karini|
se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! kemana kare AmAra putra have yakhana AmAra strI vandhyA evaM Ami vArdhakyera zeSa sImAYa pau~che gechi!
tini valalenaH erUpai have| tomAra rAvva valalenaH eTA AmAra janya sahajasAdhya; Amito pUrve tomAke sRSTi karechi yakhana tumi kichui chilenA|
yAkAriYA valalaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke ekaTi nidarzana dina| tini valalenaH tomAra nidarzana ei ye, tumi susthAvasthAYa kArao sAthe tina dina vAkyAlApa karavenA|
ataHpara se kakSa hate vera haYe tAra sampradAYera nikaTa elo evaM iGgite tAderake sakAla-sandhyAYa (AllAhara) pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karate valala|
Ami valalAmaH he iYAhiYA! ei kitAva dRr3hatAra sAthe grahaNa kara; Ami tAke zaizavei dAna karechilAma jJAna –
evaM AmAra nikaTa hate hRdaYera komalatA o pavitratA; se chila sAvadhAnI –
mAtA-pitAra anugata evaM se chilanA uddhyata, avAdhya chilanA|
tAra prati chila zAnti yedina se janma grahaNa kare evaM zAnti yedina tAra mRtyu haYa evaM yedina se punarujjIvita have|
varNanA kara ei kitAve ullekhita mAraiYAmera kathA, yakhana se tAra parivAravarga hate pRthaka haYe nirAlAYa pUrva dike eka sthAne AzraYa nila|
ataHpara tAdera hate nijeke Ar3Ala karAra janya se pardA karala; ataHpara Ami tAra nikaTa AmAra rUhake (jivarAIlake) pAThAlAma, se tAra nikaTa pUrNa mAnavAkRtite AtmaprakAza karala|
mAraiYAma valalaH tumi yadi (AllAhake) bhaYa kara tAhale Ami tomA hate daYAmaYera kAche AzraYa cAcchi|
se valalaH Amito zudhu tomAra rAvva hate prerita, tomAke eka pavitra putra dAna karAra (susaMvAda jAnAnora) janya|
mAraiYAma valalaH kemana kare AmAra putra have yakhana AmAke kona puruSa sparza kareni evaM Ami vyabhicAriNIo nai|

se valalaH erUpai have; tomAra rAvva valechena - eTA AmAra janya sahaja sAdhya evaM tAke Ami e janya sRSTi karava yena se haYa mAnuSera janya eka nidarzana evaM AmAra nikaTa hate eka anugraha; eTAto eka sthirIkRta vyApAra|
ataHpara se garbhe santAna dhAraNa karala evaM ai avasthAYa eka dUravartI sthAne cale gela|
prasava vedanA tAke eka kharjura vRkSa tale AzraYa nite vAdhya karala; se valalaH hAYa! era pUrve Ami yadi mare yetAma evaM lokera smRti hate sampUrNa vilupta hatAma!
mAlAka/pherezatA tAra nimna pArzva hate AhavAna kare tAke valalaH tumi duHkha karanA, tomAra pAdadeze tomAra rAvva eka nahara sRSTi karechena|
tumi tomAra dike khejura vRkSera kAnDe nAr3A dAo, oTA tomAke supakka tAjA khejura dAna karave|

sutarAM AhAra kara, pAna kara o cakSu jur3iYe nAo; mAnuSera madhye kehake yadi tumi dekha takhana valaH Ami daYAmaYera uddeze maunatA avalamvanera mAnata karechi; sutarAM Aja Ami kichutei kona mAnuSera sAthe vAkyAlApa karavanA|
ataHpara se santAnake niYe tAra sampradAYera nikaTa upasthita hala; tArA valalaH he mAraiYAma! tumito eka adbhuta kAnDa karecha!
he hArUna bhagni! tomAra pitA asat vyakti chilanA evaM tomAra mAtAo chilanA vyabhicAriNI|
ataHpara mAraiYAma iGgite santAnake dekhAla; tArA valalaH ye kolera zizu tAra sAthe AmarA kemana kare kathA valava?
se (IsA) valalaH Amito AllAhara dAsa; tini AmAke kitAva diYechena, AmAke nAvI karechena|
yekhAnei Ami thAki nA kena tini AmAke AziSa bhAjana karechena, tini AmAke nirdeza diYechena yata dina jIvita thAki tatadina sAlAta o yAkAta AdAYa karate –
Ara AmAra mAtAra prati anugata thAkate evaM tini AmAke karenani uddhata o hatabhAgA|
AmAra prati zAnti yedina Ami janma lAbha karechi o zAnti thAkave yedina AmAra mRtyu have evaM yedina Ami jIvita avasthAYa punarutthita hava|
ei mAraiYAma tanaYa IsA! Ami valalAma satya kathA, ye viSaYe tArA vitarka kare|
santAna grahaNa karA AllAhara kAja naYa, tini pavitra, mahimAmaYa; tini yakhana kichu sthira karena takhana valenaH ‘hao’ evaM tA haYe yAYa|
AllAhai AmAra rAvva evaM tomAdera rAvva| sutarAM tA~ra ivAdAta kara, eTAi sarala patha|
ataHpara dalaguli nijedera madhye matAnaikya sRSTi karala; sutarAM ei kAphiradera mahA dinera Agamane bhISaNa durdazA raYeche|
tArA yedina AmAra nikaTa Asave sedina tArA kata spaSTa zunave o dekhave! kintu sImA laMghanakArIrA Aja spaSTa vibhrAntite Ache|
tAderake satarka kare dAo paritApera dina samvandhe, yakhana sakala siddhAnta haYe yAve; ekhana tArA anudhAvana evaM vizvAsa sthApana karavenA|
cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI Ami, pRthivIra evaM ora upara yA Ache tAderao evaM tArA AmArai nikaTa pratyAnIta have|
varNanA kara ei kitAve ullikhita ivarAhImera kathA; se chila satyavAdI o nAvI|
yakhana se tAra pitAke valalaH he AmAra pitA! ye zonenA, dekhenA evaM tomAra kona kAje AsenA tumi tAra ivAdAta kara kena?
he AmAra pitA! AmAra nikaTato eseche jJAna yA tomAra nikaTa Aseni| sutarAM AmAra anusaraNa kara, Ami tomAYa saThika patha dekhAva|
he AmAra pitA! zAitAnera ivAdAta karanA; zAitAna AllAhara avAdhya|
he AmAra pitA! Ami AzaMkA kari, tomAke AllAhara zAsti sparza karave evaM tumi zAitAnera sAthI haYe par3ave|
pitA valalaH he ivarAhIma! tumi ki AmAra deva-devI hate vimukha haccha? yadi nivRtta nA hao tAhale Ami prastarAghAte tomAra prANa nAza karavai; tumi ciradinera janya AmAra nikaTa hate dUra haYe yAo|
ivarAhIma valalaH tomAra nikaTa hate vidAYa; Ami AmAra ravera nikaTa tomAra janya kSamA prArthanA karava, tini AmAra prati atizaYa anugrahazIla|
Ami tomAdera dika hate evaM tomarA AllAha vyatIta yAdera ivAdAta kara tAdera dika hate pRthaka hacchi; Ami AmAra ravera AhavAna kari; AzA kari AmAra ravera AhavAna kare Ami vyarthakAma havanA|
ataHpara se yakhana tAdera theke evaM tArA AllAha vyatIta yAdera ivAdAta karata sei sava hate pRthaka haYe gela takhana Ami tAke dAna karalAma isahAka o iYAkUva evaM pratyekake nAvI karalAma|
evaM tAderake Ami dAna karalAma AmAra anugraha o tAdera dilAma samucca vaMza|
ei kitAve ullekhita mUsAra kathA varNanA kara, se chila vizuddha citta evaM se chila rAsUla, nAvI|
Ami tAke AhavAna karechilAma tUra parvatera dakSiNa dika hate evaM Ami gur3hatattva AlocanArata avasthAYa tAke nikaTavartI karechilAma|
Ami nija anugrahe tAke dilAma tAra bhAi hArUnake, nAvIrUpe|
ei kitAve ullekhita isamAIlera kathA varNanA kara, se chila pratizruti pAlane satyAzraYI evaM se chila rAsUla, nAvI|
se tAra parijanavargake sAlAta o yAkAta AdAYera nirdeza dita evaM se chila tAra ravera santoSabhAjana|
ei kitAve ullekhita idarIsera kathA varNanA kara, se chila satyavAdI nAvI|
evaM Ami tAke dAna karechilAma ucca maryAdA|

nAvIdera madhye yAderake AllAha anugraha karechena erAi tArA, Adamera evaM yAderake Ami nUhera sAthe naukAYa ArohaNa kariYechilAma tAdera vaMzadbhuta, ivarAhIma o isarAIlera vaMzadbhuta o yAderake Ami patha nirdeza karechilAma o manonIta karechilAma tAdera antarbhukta; tAdera nikaTa daYAmaYera AYAta AvRtti karA hale tArA sAjadAhaYa luTiYe par3ata krandana karate karate| [sAjadAha]
tAdera pare elo apadArtha paravartIrA; tArA sAlAta naSTa karala o lAlasA paravaza hala; sutarAM tArA acirei kukarmera zAsti pratyakSa karave|
kintu tArA naYa - yArA tAovAha kareche, ImAna AnaYana kareche o sat kAja kareche; tArAto jAnnAte praveza karave, tAdera prati kona yulama karA havenA –
eTA sthAYI jAnnAta, ye adRzya viSaYera pratizruti daYAmaYa tA~ra vAndAderake diYechena, tA~ra pratizruta viSaYa avazyambhAvI|
sekhAne tArA zAnti chAr3A kona asAra vAkya zunavenA evaM sekhAne sakAla-sandhyA tAdera janya thAkave jIvanopakaraNa|
ei sei jAnnAta, yAra adhikArI karava Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhye muttAkIderake|
AmarA ApanAra ravera Adeza vyatIta avataraNa karinA; yA AmAdera agre o pazcAte Ache evaM yA ei du’era antavartI tA tA~rai evaM tomAra rAvva kono kichu bhulenanA|
tini AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera antarvatI yA kichu Ache savArai rAvva; sutarAM tumi tA~rai ivAdAte dhairyazIla thAka; tumi ki tA~ra samaguNa sampanna kehake jAna?
mAnuSa valeH AmAra mRtyu hale Ami ki jIvita avasthAYa punarutthita hava?
mAnuSa ki smaraNa karenA ye, Ami tAke pUrve sRSTi karechi yakhana se kichui chilanA?
sutarAM zapatha tomAra ravera! Amito tAderake zAitAnaderasaha ekatre samaveta karavai evaM pare Ami tAderake natajAnu avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera caturdike upasthita karavai|
ataHpara pratyeka dalera madhye ye daYAmaYera prati sarvAdhika avAdhya Ami tAke Tene vera karavai|
tArapara Amito tAdera madhye yArA jAhAnnAmera Agune dagdha haoYAra adhikatara yogya tAdera viSaYa bhAla jAni|
evaM tomAdera pratyekei oTA atikrama karave; oTA tomAra ravera anivArya siddhAnta|
pare Ami muttAkIderake uddhAra karava evaM yAlimadera sekhAne natajAnu avasthAYa rekhe diva|
tAdera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa AYAta AvRtti karA hale kAphirerA mu’minaderake valeH du’ dalera madhye konTi maryAdAYa zreYatara o majalisa hisAve konaTi uttama?
tAdera pUrve kata mAnavagoSThIke Ami dhvaMsa karechi yArA tAdera apekSA sampada o vAhya dRSTite zreSTha chila|

valaH yArA vibhrAntite Ache, daYAmaYa tAderake pracura avakAza divena yatakSaNa nA tArA, ye viSaYe tAderake satarka karA hacche tA pratyakSa karave, tA zAsti hoka athavA kiYAmAtai hoka; ataHpara tArA jAnate pArave ke maryAdAYa nikRSTa evaM ke dalavale durvala|
evaM yArA sat pathe cale AllAha tAderake adhika hidAYAta dAna karena evaM sthAYI sat kAja tomAra ravera puraskAra prAptira janya zreSTha evaM pratidAna hisAveo zreSTha|
tumi ki lakSya karecha tAke, ye AmAra AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna kare evaM valeH AmAke dhana sampada o santAna-santati deYA havei|
se ki adRzya samvandhe avahita haYeche athavA daYAmaYera nikaTa hate pratizruti lAbha kareche?
kakhanai naYa, tArA yA vale Ami tA likhe rAkhavo evaM tAdera zAsti vRddhi karate thAkava|
se ye viSaYera kathA vale tA thAkave AmAra adhikAre evaM se AmAra nikaTa Asave ekA|
tArA AllAha chAr3A anya kehake mA‘vUda rUpe grahaNa kare e janya ye, yAte tArA tAdera sahAYa haYa|
kakhanai naYa; tArA tAdera ivAdAta asvIkAra karave evaM tAdera virodhI haYe yAve|
tumi ki lakSya karanA ye, Ami kAphiradera janya zAitAnaderake cher3e rekhechi tAderake manda karme vizeSabhAve praluvdha karAra janya|
sutarAM tAdera viSaYe tAr3A karanA; Amito gaNanA karachi tAdera nirdhArita kAla|
yedina Ami daYAmaYera nikaTa muttAkIdera sammAnita mehamAna rUpe samaveta karava|
evaM aparAdhIderake pipAsArta avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike tAr3iYe niYe yAva|
ye daYAmaYera nikaTa pratizruti grahaNa kareche se vyatIta anya kArao supAriza karAra kSamatA thAkavenA|
tArA valeH daYAmaYa santAna grahaNa karechena|
tomarAto eka bhaYaMkara kathAra avatAraNA karecha|
ete yena AkAzasamUha vidIrNa haYe yAve, pRthivI khanDa vikhanDa have evaM parvatasamUha cUrNa vicUrNa haYe Apatita have –
yehetu tArA daYAmaYera upara santAna Aropa kare|
athaca santAna grahaNa karA daYAmaYera janya zobhana naYa|
AkAzasamUha o pRthivIte emana keha nei ye daYAmaYera nikaTa upasthita havenA vAndA rUpe|
tini tAderake pariveSTana kare rekhechena evaM tini tAderake vizeSabhAve gaNanA karechena|
evaM kiYAmAta divase tAdera sakalei tA~ra nikaTa Asave ekAkI avasthAYa|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare daYAmaYa tAdera janya sRSTi karavena bhAlavAsA|
Amito tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi yAte tumi ora dvArA muttAkIderake susaMvAda dite pAra evaM vitanDA pravaNa sampradAYake satarka karate pAra|
tAdera pUrve Ami kata mAnava goSThIke vinAza karechi! tumi ki tAdera kehakeo dekhate pAo athavA kSINatama zavdao zunate pAo?
tva-hA
tomAke kleza deYAra janya Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karini|
varaM yArA bhaYa kare tAdera upadezArthe –
yini samucca AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena eTA tA~ra nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
daYAmaYa Araze samAsIna|
yA Ache AkAzamanDalIte, pRthivIte, e du’Yera antarvatI sthAne o bhUgarbhe tA tA~rai|
tumi yadi ucca kanThe vala, tini yA gupta o avyakta savai jAnena|
AllAha! tini chAr3A anya kona mA‘vUda nei, samasta uttama nAma tA~rai|
mUsAra vRttAnta tomAra kAche pau~cheche ki?

se yakhana Aguna dekhala takhana tAra parivAravargake valalaH tomarA ekhAne thAka Ami Aguna dekhechi; sambhavataH Ami tomAdera janya tA hate kichu jvalanta aGgAra Anate pAravo athavA ora nikaTe kona patha pradarzaka pAva|
ataHpara yakhana se Agunera nikaTa elo takhana AhavAna kare valA halaH he mUsA!
Amii tomAra rAvva| ataeva tomAra pAdukA khule phelo, kAraNa tumi pavitra tUoYA upatyakAYa raYecha|
evaM Ami tomAke manonIta karechi, ataeva yA ahI preraNa karA hacche tumi tA manoyogera sAthe zravaNa kara|
Ami AllAha! Ami chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei; ataeva AmAra ivAdAta kara evaM AmAra smaraNArthe sAlAta kAYema kara|
kiYAmAta avazyambhAvI, Ami eTA gopana rAkhate cAi yAte pratyekei nija karmAnuyAYI phala lAbha karate pAre|
sutarAM ye vyakti kiYAmAta vizvAsa karenA evaM nija pravRttira anusaraNa kare se yena tomAke tAte vizvAsa sthApane pravRtta nA kare, tAhale tumi dhvaMsa haYe yAve|
he mUsA! tomAra DAna hAte oTA ki?
se valalaH eTA AmAra lAThi; Ami ete bhara dii evaM eTA dvArA AghAta kare Ami AmAra meSapAlera janya vRkSa patra phele thAki evaM eTA AmAra anyAnya kAjeo lAge|
(AllAha) valalenaH he mUsA! tumi oTA nikSepa kara|
ataHpara se tA nikSepa karala, sAthe sAthe tA sApa haYe chuTate lAgala|
tini valalenaH tumi eke dhara| bhaYa karanA, Ami eke era pUrvarUpe phiriYe diva|
evaM tumi hAta vagale rAkha, oTi vera haYe Asave nirmala ujjvala haYe apara eka nidarzana svarUpa|
eTA e janya ye, Ami tomAke dekhAvo AmAra mahA nidarzanagulira kichu|
phira‘Aunera nikaTa yAo, se sImAlaMghana kareche|
mUsA valalaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAra vakSa prazasta kare dina,
AmAra kAjake sahaja kare dina,
AmAra jihavAra jar3atA dUra kare dina,
yAte tArA AmAra kathA vujhate pAre|
AmAra janya kare dina ekajana sAhAyyakArI AmAra svajanavargera madhya hate|
AmAra bhAi hArUNa –
tAra dvArA AmAra zakti sudRr3ha karuna|
evaM tAke AmAra kAje aMzI karuna|
yAte AmarA ApanAra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karate pAri pracura|
evaM ApanAke smaraNa karate pAri adhika|
Apanito AmAdera samyaka draSTA|
tini valalenaH he mUsA, tumi yA ceYecha tA tomAke deYA hala|
evaM Amito tomAra prati Ara ekavAra anugraha karechilAma|
yakhana Ami tomAra mAYera antare iMgita dvArA nirdeza diYechilAma yA ekhAne varNita hacche –

ye, tumi tAke sindukera madhye rAkha, ataHpara tA nadIte bhAsiYe dAo yAte nadI oke tIre Thele deYa, oke AmAra zatru o tAra zatru niYe yAve; Ami AmAra nikaTa hate tomAra upara bhAlavAsA Dhele diYechilAma yAte tumi AmAra dRSTira sAmane pratipAlita hao|

yakhana tomAra vona ese valalaH Ami ki tomAderake vale diva ke ei zizura dAYitva nive? takhana Ami tomAke tomAra mAYera nikaTa phiriYe dilAma yAte tAra cokha jur3AYa evaM se duHkha nA pAYa; evaM tumi eka vyaktike hatyA karechile; ataHpara Ami tomAke manaHpIr3A hate mukti dii, Ami tomAke vahu parIkSA karechi| ataHpara tumi kaYeka vachara mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye chile| he mUsA! erapare tumi nirdhArita samaYe upasthita hale|
evaM Ami tomAke AmAra nijera janya prastuta kare niYechi|
tumi o tomAra bhAi AmAra nidarzanasamUha saha yAtrA zuru kara evaM AmAra smaraNe tomarA ubhaYe zaithilya karanA|
tomarA ubhaYe phira‘Aunera nikaTa yAo, seto sImAlaMghana kareche|
tomarA tAra sAthe namra kathA valave, haYato se upadeza grahaNa karave, athavA bhaYa karave|
tArA valalaH he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA AzaMkA kari ye, se AmAderake tvarAYa zAsti dite udyata have athavA anyAYa AcaraNe sImAlaMghana karave|
tini valalenaH tomarA bhaYa karanA, Amito tomAdera saMge Achi, Ami zuni o dekhi|

sutarAM tomarA tAra nikaTa yAo evaM valaH avazyai AmarA tomAra ravera pakSa theke prerita rAsUla| sutarAM AmAdera sAthe vAnI isarAIlake yete dAo evaM tAderake kaSTa dionA, AmarAto tomAra nikaTa enechi tomAra ravera nikaTa hate nidarzana| evaM zAnti tAdera prati yArA sat pathera anusaraNa kare|
AmAdera prati ahI preraNa karA haYeche ye, zAsti tAra janya ye mithyA Aropa kare o mukha phiriYe neYa|
phira‘Auna valalaH he mUsA! ke tomAdera rAvva?
mUsA valalaH AmAra rAvva tini yini pratyeka vastuke tAra yogya AkRti dAna karechena; ataHpara patha nirdeza karechena|
phira‘Auna valalaH tAhale atIta yugera lokadera avasthA ki?
mUsA valalaH era jJAna AmAra ravera nikaTa lipivaddha raYeche; AmAra rAvva bhula karenanA evaM vismRta hananA|
yini tomAdera janya pRthivIke karechena vichAnA evaM tAte kare diYechena tomAdera calAra patha, tini AkAza hate vAri varSana karena| Ami uhA dvArA vibhinna prakArera udbhida utpanna kari|
tomarA AhAra kara o tomAdera gavAdi pazu carAo; avazyai ete nidarzana raYeche viveka sampannadera janya|
Ami mATi hate tomAderake sRSTi karechi; tAtei tomAderake phiriYe diva evaM tA hate punarvAra vera karava|
Amito tAke AmAra samasta nidarzana dekhiYechilAma; kintu se mithyA Aropa kareche o amAnya kareche|
se valalaH he mUsA! tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa esecha tomAra yAdu dvArA AmAderake AmAdera deza hate vahiskAra kare deYAra janya?

AmarAo avazyai tomAra nikaTa upasthita karava era anurUpa yAdu| sutarAM AmAdera o tomAra mAjhe nirdhAraNa kara eka nirdiSTa samaYa evaM eka madhyavartI sthAna, yAra vyatikrama AmarAo karavanA evaM tumio karavenA|
mUsA valalaH tomAdera nirdhArita samaYa utsavera dina evaM sedina pUrvAhne janagaNake samaveta karA hoka|
ataHpara phira‘Auna uThe gela evaM tAra kauzalasamUha ekatrita karala o ataHpara phire elo|
mUsA tAderake valalaH durbhoga tomAdera! tomarA AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa karanA, tA karale tini tomAderake zAsti dvArA samUle dhvaMsa karavena; ye mithyA udbhAvana kareche se’i vyartha haYeche|
tArA nijedera madhye nijedera kAja samvandhe vitarka karala evaM tArA gopane parAmarza karala|
tArA valalaH ei du’jana avazyai yAdukara, tArA cAYa tAdera yAdu dvArA tomAderake tomAdera deza hate vahiskAra karate evaM tomAdera utkRSTa jIvana vyavasthAra astitva vinAza karate|
ataeva tomarA tomAdera yAdu kriYA saMhata kara, ataHpara sArivaddha haYe upasthita hao evaM ye Aja jaYI have sei saphala have|
tArA valalaH he mUsA! haYa tumi nikSepa kara athavA prathame AmarAi nikSepa kari|
mUsA valalaH varaM tomarAi nikSepa kara| tAdera yAdura prabhAve akasmAt mUsAra mane hala ye, tAdera dar3i o lAThiguli chuTAchuTi karache|
mUsA tAra antare kichu bhIti anubhava karala|
Ami valalAmaH bhaYa karanA, tumii pravala|
tomAra DAna hAte yA Ache tA nikSepa kara, eTA tArA yA kareche tA grAsa kare phelave, tArA yA kareche tAto zudhu yAdukarera kauzala; yAdukarerA yA’i karuka kakhanao saphala havenA|
ataHpara yAdukarerA sAjadAhavanata hala o valalaH AmarA hArUNa o mUsAra ravera prati ImAna AnalAma|

phira‘Auna valalaH ki, Ami tomAdera anumati deYAra pUrvei tomarA mUsAte vizvAsa sthApana karale! seto dekhachi tomAdera pradhAna, se tomAderake yAdu zikSA diYeche; sutarAM Ami tomAderake khejura vRkSera kAnDe zUlaviddha karavai evaM tomarA avazyai jAnate pArave AmAdera madhye kAra zAsti kaThora o adhika sthAYI|

tArA valalaH AmAdera nikaTa ye spaSTa nidarzana eseche tAra upara evaM yini AmAderake sRSTi karechena tA~ra upara tomAke kichutei AmarA prAdhAnya divanA, sutarAM tumi kara yA tumi karate cAo, tumito zudhu ei pArthiva jIvanera upara kartRtva karate pAra|
AmarA AmAdera ravera prati ImAna enechi yAte tini kSamA karena AmAdera aparAdha evaM tumi AmAderake yAdu karate vAdhya karecha tA; Ara AllAha zreSTha o sthAYI|
ye tAra ravera nikaTa aparAdhI haYe upasthita have tAra janya raYeche jAhAnnAma, sekhAne se maraveo nA, vA~caveo nA|
Ara yArA tA~ra nikaTa upasthita have mu’mina avasthAYa, sat kAja kare, tAdera janya raYeche ucca maryAdA –
sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM ei puraskAra tAderai janya yArA pavitra|

Ami avazyai mUsAra prati pratyAdeza karechilAma ei marme, AmAra vAndAderake niYe rajanIyoge vahirgata hao evaM tAdera janya samudrera madhya diYe eka zuska patha nirmANa kara; pichana hate ese tomAke dhare phelA have ei AzaMkA karanA evaM bhaYao karanA|
ataHpara phira‘Auna tAra sainyavAhinIsaha tAdera pazcAddhAvana karala, ataHpara samudra tAderake sampUrNa rUpe nimajjita karala|
Ara phira‘Auna tAra sampradAYake pathabhraSTa karechila evaM sat patha dekhAYani|
he vAnI isarAIla! Amito tomAderake tomAdera zatru hate uddhAra karechilAma, Ami tomAdera pratizruti diYechilAma tUra parvatera dakSiNa pArzve evaM tomAdera nikaTa mAnnA o sAlaoYA preraNa karechilAma|

tomAderake Ami yA dAna karechilAma tA hate bhAla bhAla vastu AhAra kara evaM ei viSaYe sImA laMghana karanA, karale tomAdera upara AvAra krodha avadhArita evaM yAra upara AmAra krodha avadhArita seto dhvaMsa haYe yAYa|
evaM Ami avazyai kSamAzIla tAra prati ye tAovAha’ kare, ImAna Ane, sat kAja kare o sat pathe avicala thAke|
he mUsA! tomAra sampradAYake pazcAte phele tomAke tvarA karate vAdhya karala kise?
se valalaH eito tArA AmAra pazcAte evaM he AmAra rAvva! Ami tvarAYa ApanAra nikaTa elAma, Apani santaSTa havena e janya|
tini valalenaH Ami tomAra sampradAYake parIkSAYa phelechi tomAra cale AsAra para evaM sAmerI tAderake pathabhraSTa kareche|

ataHpara mUsA tAra sampradAYera nikaTa phire gela kruddha haYe; se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomAdera rAvva ki tomAderake eka uttama pratizruti denani? tAhale ki pratizruta kAla tomAdera nikaTa sudIrgha haYeche, nA tomarA ceYecho tomAdera prati Apatita hoka tomAdera ravera krodha, ye kAraNe tomarA AmAra prati pradatta aGgIkAra bhaGga karale?

tArA valalaH AmarA tomAra prati pradatta aGgIkAra svecchAYa bhaGga karini; tave AmAdera upara cApiYe deYA haYechila lokera alaMkArera vojhA evaM AmarA tA agnikunDe nikSepa kari, anurUpabhAve sAmerIo nikSepa kare|
ataHpara se tAdera janya gar3alo eka go-vatsa, eka avaYava, yA hAmvA AoYAja karata; tArA valalaH eTA tomAdera mA‘vUda evaM mUsArao mA‘vUda, kintu mUsA bhule geche|
tAhale ki tArA dekhenA ye, oTA tAdera kathAYa sAr3A deYanA evaM tAdera kona kSati athavA upakAra karAra kSamatAo rAkhenA?
hArUna tAderake pUrvei valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa! eTA dvArA to zudhu tomAderake parIkSAYa phelA haYeche; tomAdera rAvva daYAmaYa, sutarAM tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara evaM AmAra Adeza mene cala|
tArA valechilaH AmAdera nikaTa mUsA phire nA AsA paryanta AmarA era pUjA hate kichutei virata havanA|
mUsA valalaH he hArUNa! tumi yakhana dekhale ye, tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche takhana kise tomAke nivRtta karala –
AmAra anusaraNa hate? tAhale ki tumi AmAra Adeza amAnya karale?

hArUNa valalaH he AmAra sahodara! AmAra zmazru o keza dhare AkarSaNa karanA; Ami AzaMkA karechilAma ye, tumi valaveH tumi vAnI isarAIlera madhye vibheda sRSTi karecha o AmAra vAkya pAlane yatnavAna haoni|
mUsA valalaH ohe sAmerI! tomAra vyApAra ki?
se valalaH Ami yA dekhechilAma tArA tA dekheni; ataHpara Ami sei dUtera padacihna hate eka muSTi niYechilAma evaM Ami tA nikSepa karechilAma, Ara AmAra mana AmAra janya zobhana karechila eirUpa karA|

mUsA valalaH dUra hao, tomAra jIvaddazAYa tomAra janya eTAi raila ye, tumi valaveH Ami aspRzya evaM tomAra janya raila eka nirdiSTa kAla, tomAra velAYa yAra vyatikrama havenA evaM tumi tomAra sei mA‘vUdera prati lakSya kara yAra pUjAYa tumi rata chile; AmarA oke jvAliYe divai, ataHpara oke vikSipta kare sAgare nikSepa karavai|
tomAdera ilAhato zudhumAtra AllAhai yini chAr3A anya kona ilAha nei, tA~ra jJAna sarva viSaYe vyApta|
pUrve yA ghaTeche uhAra saMvAda Ami ebhAve tomAra nikaTa vivRta kari evaM Ami AmAra nikaTa hate tomAke dAna karechi upadeza|
eTA hate ye vimukha have se kiYAmAta divase mahAbhAra vahana karave|
tAte tArA sthAYI have evaM kiYAmAta divase ei vojhA tAdera janya kata manda!
yedina ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have sei dina Ami aparAdhIderake dRSTihIna avasthAYa samaveta karava|
tArA nijedera madhye cupi cupi valAvali karaveH tomarA mAtra daza dina avasthAna karechile|
tArA ki valave tA Ami bhAla jAni| tAdera madhye ye apekSAkRta sat pathe chila se valaveH tomarA eka dinera vezi avasthAna karani|
tArA tomAke parvatasamUha samparke jijJesa karache, tumi valaH AmAra rAvva ogulike samUle utpATana kare vikSipta kare divena|
ataHpara tini oke pariNata karavena masRNa samatala mAidAne|
yAte tumi vakratA o uccatA dekhavenA|
sedina tArA AhavAnakArIra anusaraNa karave, e vyApAre edika odika karate pAravenA; daYAmaYera sAmane sava zavda staddha haYe yAve; sutarAM mRdu padadhvani chAr3A tumi kichui zunate pAvenA|
daYAmaYa yAke anumati divena o yAra kathA tini pachanda karavena se vyatIta kArao supAriza sedina kona kAje AsavenA|
tAdera sammukhe o pazcAte yA kichu raYeche tA tini avagata, kintu tArA jJAna dvArA tA~ke AYatta karate pAre nA|
svAdhIna, svadhiSTha- pAlanakartAra nikaTa sakalei have adhovadana evaM se’i vyartha have ye yulamera bhAra vahana karave|
evaM ye sat kAja kare mu’mina haYa, tAra AzaMkA nei avicArera evaM kSatirao|
e rUpei Ami kuraAnake avatIrNa karechi ArAvI bhASAYa evaM tAte vizadabhAve vivRta karechi satarkavANI yAte tArA bhaYa kare athavA eTA haYa tAdera janya upadeza|
AllAha ati mahAna, prakRta adhipati| tomAra prati kuraAnera AYAta sampUrNa havAra pUrve tumi tvarA karanA evaM valaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAra jJAnake vRddhi karuna|
Amito itopUrve Adamera prati nirdeza dAna karechilAma, kintu se bhule giYechila; Ami tAke saMkalpe dRr3ha pAini|
smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami mAlAikAgaNake valalAmaH Adamera prati sAjadAhavanata hao, takhana ivalIsa chAr3A savAi sAjadAha karala; se amAnya karala|
ataHpara Ami valalAmaH he Adama! e tomAra o tomAra strIra zatru; sutarAM se yena kichutei tomAderake jAnnAta hate vera kare nA deYa, dile tomarA duHkha pAve|
tomAra janya eTAi raila ye, tumi jAnnAte kSudhArta havenA evaM nagnao havenA|
evaM tumi sekhAne pipAsArta havenA evaM raudra kliSTao havenA|
ataHpara zAitAna tAke kumantraNA dila; se valalaH he Adama! Ami ki tomAke vale diva ananta jIvanaprada vRkSera kathA o akSaYa rAjyera kathA?

ataHpara tArA tA hate AhAra karala; takhana tAdera lajjAsthAna tAdera nikaTa prakAza haYe par3ala evaM tArA jAnnAtera vRkSapatra dvArA nijederake AvRta karate lAgala; Adama tAra ravera hukuma amAnya karala, phale se bhrame patita hala|
erapara tAra rAvva tAke manonIta karalena, tAra prati kSamA parAYaNa halena evaM tAke patha nirdeza karalena|

tini valalenaH tomarA ubhaYe ekai saGge jAnnAta hate neme yAo, tomarA paraspara parasparera zatru| pare AmAra pakSa hate tomAdera nikaTa sat pathera nirdeza ele, ye AmAra patha anusaraNa karave se vipathagAmI havenA o duHkha kaSTa pAvenA|
ye AmAra smaraNe vimukha tAra jIvana yApana have saMkucita evaM Ami tAke kiYAmAta divase utthita karava andha avasthAYa|
se valaveH he AmAra rAvva! kena AmAke andha avasthAYa utthita karalena? Amito chilAma cakSusmAna!
tini valavenaH e rUpei AmAra nidarzanAvalI tomAra nikaTa esechila, kintu tumito bhule giYechile evaM sebhAve Aja tumio vismRta hale|
evaM ebhAvei Ami pratiphala dii tAke, ye vAr3AvAr3i kare evaM tAra ravera nidarzane vizvAsa sthApana karenA; parakAlera zAstito avazyai kaThinatara o adhika sthAYI|
eTAo ki tAderake sat patha dekhAlanA ye, Ami tAdera pUrve dhvaMsa karechi kata mAnavagoSThI yAdera vAsabhUmite tArA vicaraNa kare? avazyai ete viveka sampannadera janya raYeche nidarzana|
tomAra ravera pUrva siddhAnta evaM eka nirdhArita samaYa nA thAkale avazyambhAvI hata tvarita zAsti|

sutarAM tArA yA vale se viSaYe tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM sUryodaYera pUrve evaM sUryAstera pUrve tomAra ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara, evaM rAte pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara, Ara dinera prAntasamUhe yAte tumi santaSTa hate pAra|

tumi tomAra cakSudvaYa kakhanao prasArita karanA ora prati yA Ami tAdera vibhinna zreNIke pArthiva jIvanera saundarya svarUpa upabhogera upakaraNa hisAve diYechi tadvArA tAderake parIkSA karAra janya| tomAra rAvva pradatta jIvanopakaraNa utkRSTa o adhika sthAYI|
Ara tomAra parivAravargake sAlAtera Adeza dAo evaM tAte avicala thAka| Ami tomAra nikaTa kona jIvanopakaraNa cAinA, Amii tomAke jIvanopakaraNa dii evaM zubha pariNAmato muttAkIdera janya|
tArA valeH se tAra ravera nikaTa hate AmAdera janya kona nidarzana kena AnaYana karenA? tAdera nikaTa ki Aseni suspaSTa pramANa yA Ache pUrvavartI granthasamUhe?

yadi Ami tAderake itopUrve zAsti dvArA dhvaMsa karatAma tAhale tArA valataH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani AmAdera nikaTa ekajana rAsUla preraNa karalena nA kena? tA hale AmarA lAJchita o apamAnita havAra pUrve ApanAra nidarzana mene calatAma|
valaH pratyekei pratIkSA karache, sutarAM tomarAo pratIkSA kara, ataHpara tomarA jAnate pArave kArA raYeche sarala pathe evaM kArA sat patha prApta haYeche|
mAnuSera hisAva nikAzera samaYa Asanna, kintu tArA udAsInatAYa mukha phiriYe raYeche|
yakhanai tAdera nikaTa tAdera ravera kona natuna upadeza Ase takhana tArA tA zravaNa kare kautukacchale|
tAdera antara thAke amanoyogI, sImA laMghanakArIrA gopane parAmarza kareH eto tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa, tavuo ki tomarA dekhe zune yAdura kavale par3ave?
valaH AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra samasta kathAi AmAra rAvva avagata Achena evaM tinii sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tArA eTAo valeH e sava alIka kalpanA haYa se udbhAvana kareche, nA haYa se ekajana kavi; ataeva se AnaYana karuka AmAdera nikaTa eka nidarzana yerUpa nidarzanasaha prerita haYechila pUrvavartIgaNa|
tAdera pUrve ye sava janapada Ami dhvaMsa karechi ora adhivAsIrA ImAna Aneni; tAhale ki tArA ImAna Anave?
tomAra pUrve Ami ahIsaha mAnuSai pAThiYechilAma; tomarA yadi nA jAna tAhale jJAnIderake jijJesa kara|
Ara Ami tAderake emana deha viziSTa karini ye, tArA AhArya grahaNa karatanA| tArA cirasthAYIo chilanA|
ataHpara Ami tAdera prati AmAra pratizruti pUrNa karalAma, Ami tAderake o yAderake icchA rakSA karechilAma evaM yAlimaderake karechilAma dhvaMsa|
Amito tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechi kitAva yAte Ache tomAdera janya upadeza, tavuo ki tomarA vujhavenA?
Ami dhvaMsa karechi kata janapada yAra adhivAsIrA chila yAlima evaM tAdera pare sRSTi karechi apara jAti|
ataHpara yakhana tArA AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala takhanai tArA janapada hate pAlAte lAgala|
tAderake valA halaH palAYana karanA evaM phire eso tomAdera bhoga sambhArera nikaTa evaM tomAdera AvAsagRhe, haYato e viSaYe tomAderake jijJesa karA hate pAre|
tArA valalaH hAYa durbhoga AmAdera! AmarAto chilAma yAlima|
tAdera ei ArtanAda calate thAke yatakSaNa nA Ami tAderake kartita zasya o nirvApita Aguna sadRza kari|
AkAza o pRthivI evaM yA etadubhaYera madhye raYeche tA Ami krIr3Acchale sRSTi karini|
Ami yadi krIr3Ara upakaraNa cAitAma tAhale Ami AmAra nikaTa yA Ache tA diYei oTA karatAma, Ami tA karini|
kintu Ami satya dvArA AghAta hAni mithyAra upara; phale oTA mithyAke cUrNa-vicUrNa kare deYa evaM tatkSaNAt mithyA nizcihna haYe yAYa| durbhoga tomAdera! tomarA yA valacha tAra janya|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA Ache tA tA~rai, tA~ra sAnnidhye yArA Ache tArA ahaMkAra kare tA~ra ivAdAta karA hate vimukha haYanA evaM klAntio vodha karenA|
tArA dina-rAta tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, zaithilya karenA|
tArA mATi hate tairI ye sava devatA grahaNa kareche seguli ki mRtake jIvita karate sakSama?
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yadi AllAha chAr3A vahu mA‘vUda thAkata tAhale ubhaYai dhvaMsa haYe yeta| ataeva tArA yA vale tA hate Arazera rAvva (adhipati) AllAha pavitra, mahAna|
tini yA karena sei viSaYe tA~ke prazna karA yAvenA; varaM tAderakei prazna karA have|

tArA tA~ke chAr3A vahu mA‘vUda grahaNa kareche? valaH tomarA tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara| eTAi AmAra sAthe yArA Ache tAdera janya upadeza evaM eTAi upadeza chila AmAra pUrvavartIdera janya| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai prakRta satya jAnenA, phale tArA mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ami tomAra pUrve emana kona rAsUla preraNa karini tAra prati ‘lA ilAhA illAllAha’ ei ahI vyatIta| sutarAM tomarA AmArai ivAdAta kara|
tArA valeH daYAmaYa AllAha santAna grahaNa karechena| tini pavitra mahAna! tArAto tA~ra sammAnita vAndA|
tArA tA~ra Age ver3e kathA vale nA; tArA to tA~ra Adeza anusArei kAja kare|
tAdera sammukhe o pazcAte yA kichu Ache tA tini avagata| tArA supAriza kare zudhu tAdera janya yAdera prati tini santaSTa evaM tArA tA~ra bhaYe bhIta santrasta|
tAdera madhye ye valaveH tini vyatIta Amii mA‘vUda, tAke Ami pratiphala diva jAhAnnAma, ebhAvei Ami yAlimaderake pratiphala diYe thAki|

yArA kupharI kare tArA ki bheve dekhenA ye, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI mize chila otaprotabhAve; ataHpara Ami ubhaYake pRthaka kare dilAma evaM prANavAna samasta kichu sRSTi karalAma pAni hate; tavuo ki tArA vizvAsa karavenA?
evaM Ami pRthivIte sRSTi karechi sudRr3ha parvata yAte pRthivI tAderake niYe edika-odika Tale nA yAYa evaM Ami tAte kare diYechi prazasta patha yAte tArA gantavya sthale pau~chate pAre|
evaM AkAzake karechi surakSita chAda| kintu tArA AkAzasthita nidarzanAvalI hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
(AllAhai) sRSTi karechena rAta o dina evaM sUrya o cA~da; pratyekei nija nija kakSapathe vicaraNa kare|
Ami tomAra pUrveo kona mAnuSake cirasthAYI jIvana dAna karini; sutarAM tomAra mRtyu hale tArA ki ciraJjIva haYe thAkave?
jIva mAtrai mRtyura svAda grahaNa karave; Ami tomAderake manda o bhAla dvArA vizeSabhAve parIkSA kari evaM AmArai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|

kAphirerA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tArA tomAke zudhu vidrupera pAtra rUpei grahaNa kare| tArA valeH ei ki se ye tomAdera devatAgulira samAlocanA kare? athaca tArAito ‘rAhamAna’ era ullekhera virodhitA kare|
mAnuSa sRSTigatabhAve tvarA pravaNa, zIghrai Ami tomAderake AmAra nidarzanAvalI dekhAva; sutarAM tomarA AmAke tvarA karate valanA|
Ara tArA valeH tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, ei pratizruti kakhana pUrNa have?
hAYa! yadi kAphirerA sei samaYera kathA jAnato yakhana tArA tAdera sammukha o pazcAta hate Aguna pratirodha karate pAravenA evaM tAderake sAhAyya karAo havenA|
vastutaH oTA tAdera upara Asave atarkite evaM tAderake hatabhamva kare dive; phale tArA oTA rodha karate pAravenA evaM tAderake avakAza deYA havenA|
tomAra pUrveo aneka rAsUlakei ThATTA vidrupa karA haYechila; pariNAme tArA yA niYe ThATTA vidrupa karata tA vidrupakArIderake pariveSTana karechila|
valaH ‘rAhamAna’ era parivarte ke tomAderake rakSA karache rAte o dine? tavuo tArA tAdera ravera smaraNa hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
tAhale ki Ami vyatIta tAdera emana ArAdhya Ache yArA tAderake rakSA karate pAre? tArAto nijederakei sAhAyya karate pArenA evaM AmAra viruddhe tAdera sAhAyyakArIo thAkavenA|

vastutaH Amii tAderake evaM tAdera pitR-puruSaderake bhoga sambhAra diYechilAma; adhikanta tAdera AYuskAlao haYechila dIrgha; tArA ki dekhachenA ye, Ami tAdera dezake caturdika hate saMkucita kare Anachi; tavuo ki tArA vijaYI have?
valaH Amito zudhu ahI dvArAi tomAderake satarka kari, kintu yArA vadhira tAderake yakhana satarka karA haYa takhana tArA satarkavANI zonenA|
tomAra ravera zAstira kichumAtrao tAderake sparza karale tArA nizcaYai vale uThaveH hAYa! durbhoga AmAdera, AmarAto chilAma yAlima!

evaM kiYAmAta divase Ami sthApana karava nyAYavicArera mAnadanDa| sutarAM kArao prati kona avicAra karA havenA evaM kAja yadi sariSAra dAnA parimANa ojanerao haYa tAo Ami upasthita karava| hisAva grahaNakArIrUpe Amii yatheSTa|
Amito mUsA o hArUnake diYechilAma mImAMsAkArI grantha, jyoti evaM muttAkIdera janya upadeza –
yArA nA dekheo tAdera rAvvake bhaYa kare evaM kiYAmAta samparke thAke bhIta-santrasta|
eTi kalyANamaYa upadeza; Amii eTi avatIrNa karechi; tavuo ki tomarA eTAke asvIkAra karave?
Ami era pUrve ivarAhImake sat pathera jJAna diYechilAma evaM Ami tAra samvandhe chilAma samyaka avagata|
yakhana se tAra pitA o tAra sampradAYake valalaH ei mUrtiguli ki, yAdera pUjAYa tomarA rata raYecha?
tArA valalaH AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake edera pUjA karate dekhechi|
se valalaH tomarA nijerA evaM tomAdera pUrva-puruSarAo raYecha spaSTa vibhrAntite|
tArA valalaH tumi ki AmAdera nikaTa satya enecha, nAki tumi kautuka karacha?
se valalaH nA, tomAdera rAvvato AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra rAvva, yini oguli sRSTi karechena evaM ei viSaYe Ami anyatama sAkSI|
zapatha AllAhara! tomarA cale gele Ami tomAdera mUrtiguli samvandhe avazyai vyavasthA avalamvana karava|
ataHpara se cUrNa-vicUrNa kare dila mUrtigulike, tAdera var3a (pradhAna) mUrtiTi vyatIta, yAte tArA tAra dike phire Ase|
tArA valalaH AmAdera upAsyagulira prati erUpa karala ke? se nizcaYai sImAlaMghanakArI|
keha keha valalaH AmarA eka yuvakake odera samAlocanA karate zunechi, tAke valA haYa ivarAhIma|
tArA valalaH tAke upasthita kara loka sammukhe, yAte tArA sAkSya dite pAre|
tArA valalaH ivarAhIma! tumii ki AmAdera upAsyagulira upara erUpa karecha?
se valalaH se’i to eTA kareche, eito edera pradhAna| ederake jijJesa kara yadi erA kathA valate pAre|
takhana tArA mane mane cintA kare dekhala evaM eke aparake valate lAgalaH tomarAito sImAlaMghanakArI|
ataHpara tAdera mAthA nata haYe gela evaM tArA valalaH tumito jAnai ye, erA kathA valenA|
se valalaH tAhale ki tomarA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ivAdAta kara yArA tomAdera kona upakAra karate pArenA, kSatio karate pArenA?
dhika tomAderake evaM AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAdera ivAdAta kara tAderake! tomarA ki vujhavenA?
tArA valalaH tAke pur3iYe dAo evaM sAhAyya kara tomAdera devatAgulike, yadi tomarA kichu karate cAo|
Ami valalAmaH he Aguna! tumi ivarAhImera janya zItala o nirApada haYe yAo|
tArA tAra kSati sAdhanera icchA karechila| kintu Ami tAderake kare dilAma sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
Ara Ami tAke o lUtake uddhAra kare niYe gelAma sei deze yethAYa Ami kalyANa rekhechi vizvavAsIra janya|
evaM Ami ivarAhImake dAna karechilAma isahAka evaM puraskAra svarUpa iYAkUva; evaM pratyekakei karechilAma satkarmaparAYaNa|

Ara Ami tAderake karechilAma netA; tArA AmAra nirdeza anusAre mAnuSake patha pradarzana karata| tAdera kAche Ami ahI preraNa karechilAma sat kAja karate, sAlAta kAYema karate evaM yAkAta pradAna karate; tArA AmArai ivAdAta karata|
evaM lUtake diYechilAma prajJA o jJAna, Ara tAke uddhAra karechilAma emana eka janapada hate yAra adhivAsIrA lipta chila azlIla kAje| tArA chila eka manda sampradAYa; satyatyAgI|
evaM tAke Ami AmAra anugrahabhAjana karechilAma; se chila satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta|
smaraNa kara nUhake; pUrve se yakhana AhavAna karechila takhana Ami sAr3A diYechilAma tAra AhavAne evaM tAke o tAra parijanavargake mahAsaMkaTa hate uddhAra karechilAma|
evaM Ami tAke sAhAyya karechilAma sei sampradAYera viruddhe yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra karechila, tArA chila eka manda sampradAYa; e janya tAdera savAike Ami nimajjita karechilAma|
evaM smaraNa kara dAuda o sulAimAnera kathA, yakhana tArA vicAra karachila zasyakSetra samparke; tAte rAte praveza karechila kona sampradAYera meSa; Ami pratyakSa karachilAma tAdera vicAra|

evaM Ami sulAimAnake e viSaYera mImAMsA vujhiYe diYechilAma evaM tAdera pratyekake Ami diYechilAma prajJA o jJAna| Ami parvata o vihaGgakUlera janya niYama kare diYechilAma yena orA dAudera sAthe AmAra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare; e samasta Amii karechilAma|
Ami tAke tomAdera janya varma nirmANa zikSA diYechilAma yAte oTA tomAdera yuddhe tomAderake rakSA kare; sutarAM tomarA ki kRtajJa havenA?
evaM sulAimAnera vazIbhUta kare diYechilAma uddAma vAYuke; oTA tAra Adezakrame pravAhita hata sei dezera dike yekhAne Ami kalyANa rekhechi| pratyeka viSaYa samparke Amii samyaka avagata|
evaM zAitAnadera madhye kataka tAra janya DuvurIra kAja karata, eTA chAr3A anya kAjao karata; Ami tAdera dike satarka dRSTi rAkhatAma|
Ara smaraNa kara AiYuvera kathA, yakhana se tAra rAvvake AhavAna kare valechilaH Ami duHkha kaSTe patita haYechi, Apanito daYAludera madhye sarvazreSTha daYAlu|

takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A dilAma, tAra duHkha kaSTa dUrIbhUta kare dilAma, tAke tAra parivAra parijana phiriYe diYechilAma, tAdera sAthe tAdera mata Arao diYechilAma AmAra vizeSa rAhamAta rUpe evaM ivAdAtakArIdera janya upadeza svarUpa|
Ara smaraNa kara isamAIla, idarIsa evaM yulakiphala- era kathA, tAdera pratyekei chila dhairyazIla|
evaM tAderake Ami AmAra anugraha bhAjana karechilAma, tArA chila satkarmaparAYaNa|

Ara smaraNa kara yuna-nUna era kathA, yakhana se krodhabhare vera haYe giYechila evaM mane karechila Ami tAra janya zAsti nirdhAraNa karavanA; ataHpara se andhakAra hate AhavAna karechilaH Apani chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei; Apani pavitra, mahAna; Amito sImAlaMghanakArI|
takhana Ami tAra DAke sAr3A diYechilAma evaM tAke uddhAra karechilAma duzcintA hate evaM ebhAvei Ami mu'minaderake uddhAra kare thAki|
evaM smaraNa kara yAkAriYAra kathA, yakhana se tAra rAvvake AhavAna kare valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke ekA cher3e divenanA, Apani cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI

ataHpara Ami tAra AhavAne sAr3A diYechilAma evaM tAke dAna karechilAma iYAhaiYAke, Ara tAra janya tAra strIke yogyatA sampanna karechilAma; tArA satkarme pratiyogitA karata, tArA AmAke DAkata AzA o bhItira sAthe evaM tArA chila AmAra nikaTa vinIta|
Ara smaraNa kara sei nArIke ye nija satItvake rakSA karechila evaM Ami tAra madhye AtmA phu~ke diYechi, evaM tAke o tAra putrake karechilAma vizvavAsIra janya eka nidarzana|
ei ye tomAdera jAti, eTAto ekai jAti evaM Amii tomAdera rAvva, ataeva AmAra ivAdAta kara|
kintu mAnuSa nijedera kAryakalApe parasparera madhye vibheda sRSTi kareche; pratyekei pratyAvartita have AmAra nikaTa|
sutarAM yadi keha mu’mina haYe sat kAja kare tAhale tAra kAja praceSTA agrAhya havenA evaM Amito tA likhe rAkhi|
ye sava janapadake Ami dhvaMsa karechi tAra adhivAsIdera phire nA AsA avadhArita –
ye paryanta nA iYAjuja o mA’jujake vandhanamukta kare deYA have evaM tArA pratyaka u~cu bhUmi theke druta chuTe Asave|
amogha pratizruta kAla Asanna hale akasmAt kAphiradera cakSu sthira haYe yAve| tArA valaveH hAYa durbhoga AmAdera! AmarAto chilAma e viSaYe udAsIna; nA, varaM AmarA chilAma sImAlaMghanakArI|
tomarA evaM AllAhara parivarte tomarA yAdera ivAdAta kara segulito jAhAnnAmera indhana; tomarA savAi tAte praveza karave|
yadi tArA upAsya hata tAhale tArA jAhAnnAme praveza karata nA; tAdera savAi tAte sthAYI have|
sekhAne thAkave tAdera ArtanAda evaM sekhAne tArA kichui zunate pAvenA|
yAdera janya AmAra nikaTa theke pUrva hate kalyANa nirdhArita raYeche tAderake tA hate dUre rAkhA have|
tArA ora kSINatama zavdao zunate pAvenA evaM sekhAne tArA tAdera mana yA cAYa cirakAla tA bhoga karave|
mahAbhIti tAderake viSAda kliSTa karavenA evaM mAlAikArA tAderake abhyarthanA karave ei valeH ei tomAdera sei dina yAra pratizruti tomAderake deYA haYechila|

sedina Ami AkAzake guTiYe phelavo, yebhAve guTAno haYa likhita daphatara| yebhAve Ami sRSTira sUcanA karechilAma sebhAve punarAYa sRSTi karava; pratizruti pAlana AmAra kartavya, Ami eTA pAlana karavai|
Ami upadezera para kitAve likhe diYechi ye, AmAra yogyatAsampanna vAndArA pRthivIra adhikArI have|
ete raYeche vANI, sei sampradAYera janya, yArA ivAdAta kare|
Amito tomAke vizva jagatera prati zudhu rAhamAta rUpei preraNa karechi|
valaH AmAra prati ahI haYa ye, tomAdera mA‘vUda ekai mA‘vUda; sutarAM tomarA haYe yAo AtmasamarpanakArI|
yadi tArA mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tumi valaH Ami tomAderake yathAyathabhAve jAniYe diYechi evaM tomAderake ye viSaYe pratizruti deYA haYeche, Ami jAninA, tA Asanna, nA dUrasthita|
tini jAnena yA kathAYa vyakta kara evaM yA tomarA gopana kara|
Ami jAninA, haYato eTA tomAdera janya eka parIkSA evaM jIvana upabhoga kichu kAlera janya|
rAsUla valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani nyAYera sAthe phAisAlA kare dina, AmAdera rAvvato daYAmaYa, tomarA yA valecha se viSaYe ekamAtra sahAYasthala tinii|
he mAnavamanDalI! tomarA bhaYa kara tomAdera rAvvake; (jene rekha) kiYAmAtera prakampana eka bhaYAnaka vyApAra|

yedina tomarA tA pratyakSa karave sedina pratyeka stanyadAtrI vismRta have tAra dugdha poSya zizuke evaM pratyeka garbhavatI tAra garbhapAta kare phelave; mAnuSake dekhave mAtAla sadRza, yadio tArA nezAgrasta naYa; vastutaH AllAhara zAsti kaThina|
mAnuSera kataka ajJatA vazataH AllAha samvandhe vitanDA kare evaM anusaraNa kare pratyeka vidrohI zAitAnera|
tAra samvandhe ei niYama kare deYA haYeche ye, ye keha tAra sAthe vandhutva karave se tAke pathabhraSTa karave evaM tAke paricAlita karave prajjvalita agnira dike|

he mAnuSa! punarutthAna samvandhe yadi tomarA sandihAna hao tAhale (jene rekha), Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi mATi hate, tArapara zukra hate, erapara jamATa vAdhA rakta theke, tArapara pUrNAkRti athavA apUrNAkRti mAMsapinDa hate; tomAdera nikaTa vyakta karAra janya| Ami yA icchA kari tA eka nirdiSTa kAlera janya mAtRgarbhe sthiti rAkhi, tArapara Ami tomAderake zizu rUpe vera kari, pare yAte tomarA pariNata vaYase upanIta hao; tomAdera madhye kArao mRtyu ghaTAno haYa evaM tomAdera madhye kehake kehake pratyAvRtta karA haYa hInatama vaYase, yAra phale tArA yA kichu jAnata seA samvandhe tArA sajJAna thAkenA| tumi bhUmike dekha zuska, ataHpara tAte Ami vAri varSaNa karale tA zasya zyAmala haYe Andolita o sphIta haYa evaM udagata kare sarvaprakAra naYanAbhirAma udbhida|
eTA e janya ye, AllAha satya evaM tinii mRtyuke jIvana dAna karena evaM tini sarva viSaYe zaktimAna|
Ara kiYAmAta avazyambhAvI, ete kona sandeha nei evaM kAvare yArA Ache tAderake AllAha nizcaYai punarutthita karavena|
mAnuSera madhye keha keha AllAha samvandhe vitanDA kare, tAdera nA Ache jJAna, nA Ache patha nirdezaka, Ara nA Ache kona dIptimAna kitAva|
se vitanDA kare ghAr3a vA~kiYe, lokaderake AllAhara patha hate bhraSTa karAra janya; tAra janya raYeche lAJchanA| ihaloke evaM kiYAmAta divase Ami tAke AsvAdana karAva dahana yantraNA|
(sedina tAke valA have) eTA tomAra kRtakarmera phala| kAraNa AllAha vAndAdera prati atyAcAra karena nA|

mAnuSera madhye keha keha AllAhara ivAdAta kare dvidhAra sAthe; tAra maGgala hale tAte tAra citta prazasta haYa evaM kona viparyaYa ghaTale se tAra pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAYa| se kSatigrasta haYa duniYAYa o AkhirAte; eTAito suspaSTa kSati|
se AllAhara parivarte emana kichuke DAke yA tAra kona apakAra karate pArenA, upakArao karate pArenA, eTAi carama vibhrAnti!
se DAke emana kichuke yAra kSatii tAra upakAra apekSA nikaTatara| kata nikRSTa ei abhibhAvaka evaM nikRSTa ei sahacara!
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita; AllAha yA icchA tA-i karena|
ye mane kare, AllAha kakhanai duniYA o AkhirAte sAhAyya karavenanA, se AkAzera dike rajju pralamvita karuka evaM erapara keTe dika; ataHpara dekhuka tAra praceSTA tA~ra Akrozera hetu dUra kare ki nA!
ebhAvei Ami suspaSTa nidarzana rUpe oTA avatIrNa karechi; Ara AllAha yAke icchA sat patha pradarzana karena|

yArA ImAna eneche evaM yArA iYAhudI haYeche, yArA sAviYI, khRSTAna, agnipUjaka evaM yArA muzarika - kiYAmAta divase AllAha tAdera madhye phAisAlA kare divena| nizcaYai AllAha pratyeka jinisera upara sAkSI|

tumi ki dekhanA ye, AllAhake sAjadAha kare yA kichu Ache AkAzamanDalIte o pRthivIte - sUrya, cA~da, nakSatramanDalI, pavartarAji, vRkSalatA, jIva-jantu evaM sAjadAha kare mAnuSera madhye aneke? AvAra anekera prati avadhArita haYeche zAsti| AllAha yAke heYa karena tAra sammAnadAtA kehai nei; AllAha yA icchA tA karena| (sAjadAha)
erA du’Ti vivAdamAna pakSa, tArA tAdera rAvva samvandhe vitarka kare| yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya prastuta karA haYeche Agunera pozAka; tAdera mAthAra upara Dhele deYA have phuTanta pAni –
yadvArA udare yA Ache tA evaM tAdera carma vigalita karA have|
Ara tAdera janya thAkave lauha-mugura|
yakhanai tArA yantraNAkAtara haYe jAhAnnAma hate vera hate cAve takhanai tAderake phiriYe deYA have| tAderake valA haveH svAda grahaNa kara dahana yantraNAra|

yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tAderake alaMkRta karA have svarNa kaMkana o muktA dvArA evaM sekhAne tAdera pozAka paricchada have rezamera|
tAderake pavitra vAkyera anugAmI karA haYechila evaM tArA paricAlita haYechila parama prazaMsA bhAjana (AllAhara) pathe|

yArA kupharI kare evaM mAnuSake nivRtta kare AllAhara patha hate o mAsajidula hArAma hate, yA Ami karechi sthAnIYa o vahirAgata savArai janya samAna, Ara ye icchA kare ote pApa kAjera sImA laMghana kare tAke Ami AsvAdana karAva marmantada zAsti|

Ara smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami ivarAhImera janya nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma sei gRhera sthAna takhana valechilAmaH AmAra sAthe kona zarIka sthira karanA evaM AmAra gRhake pavitra rekha tAdera janya yArA tAoYApha kare evaM yArA danDAYamAna thAke, ruku kare o sAjadAha kare|
evaM mAnuSera kAche hAjjera ghoSaNA kare dAo, tArA tomAra kAche Asave padavraje o sarva prakAra kSINakAYa uSTrasamUhera piThe, tArA Asave dUra-dUrAntera patha atikrama kare –
