yAte tArA tAdera kalyANamaYa sthAnagulite upasthita hate pAre evaM tini tAderake catuspada jantu hate yA riyka hisAve dAna karechena ora upara nirdiSTa dinagulite AllAhara nAma uccAraNa karate pAre; ataHpara tomarA oTA hate AhAra kara evaM dustha, abhAvagrastake AhAra karAo|
ataHpara tArA yena tAdera aparicchannatA dUra kare evaM tAdera mAnata pUrNa kare o tAoYApha kare prAcIna gRhera|

eTAi vidhAna evaM keha AllAha kartRka nirdhArita vidhAnAvalIra prati sammAna pradarzana karale tAra ravera nikaTa tA uttama| tomAdera janya hAlAla karA haYeche catuspada pazu, aiguli vyatIta yA tomAderake valA haYeche| sutarAM tomarA varjana kara mUrti pUjAra apavitratA evaM dUre thAka mithyA valA hate,

AllAhara prati ekaniSTha haYe evaM tA~ra kona zarIka nA kare| Ara ye AllAhara zarIka kare se yena AkAza hate par3ala, ataHpara pAkhI tAke cho~ mere niYe gela, kiMvA vAYu tAke ur3iYe niYe dUravartI eka sthAne nikSepa karala|
eTAi AllAhara vidhAna evaM keha (AllAhara) nidarzanAvalIke sammAna karale eTAto tAra hRdaYera tAkaoYArai vahiHprakAza|
e savagulite tomAdera janya nAnAvidha upakAra raYeche eka nirdiSTa kAlera janya; ataHpara ogulira kuravAnIra sthAna prAcIna gRhera nikaTa|

Ami pratyeka sampradAYera janya kuravAnIra niYama kare diYechi yAte Ami tAderake jIvanopakaraNa svarUpa ye sava catuspada jantu diYechi segulira upara AllAhara nAma uccAraNa kare| tomAdera mA‘vUda ekai mA‘vUda, sutarAM tA~rai nikaTa Atmasamarpana kara evaM susaMvAda dAo vinItajanaderake,
yAdera hRdaYa bhaYa-kampita haYa AllAhara nAma smaraNa karA hale, yArA tAdera vipada Apade dhairya dhAraNa kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare evaM Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi tA hate vyaYa kare|

evaM utsargIkRta uSTrake karechi AllAhara nidarzanagulira anyatama; tomAdera janya tAte maGgala raYeche; sutarAM sArivaddhabhAve danDAYamAna avasthAYa ogulira upara tomarA AllAhara nAma nAo| yakhana orA kAta haYe par3e yAYa takhana tomarA tA hate AhAra kara evaM AhAra karAo dhairyazIla abhAvagrastake o yAJcAkArI abhAvagrastake| ebhAve Ami oderake tomAdera adhIna kare diYechi yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|

AllAhara kAche pau~chenA ogulira gozata evaM rakta, varaM pau~che tomAdera tAkaoYA| ebhAve tini ogulike tomAdera adhIna kare diYechena yAte tomarA AllAhara zreSThatva ghoSaNA kara e janya ye, tini tomAderake patha pradarzana karechena| sutarAM tumi susaMvAda dAo satkarmazIladerake|
AllAha rakSA karena mu’minaderake| nizcaYai AllAha kona vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJake pachanda karenanA|
yuddhera anumati deYA hala tAderake yArA AkrAnta haYeche| kAraNa tAdera prati atyAcAra karA haYeche| AllAha nizcaYai tAderake sAhAyya karate sakSama|

tAderake tAdera ghara vAr3I hate anyAYabhAve vahiskRta karA haYeche zudhu e kAraNe ye, tArA valeH AmAdera rAvva AllAha! AllAha yadi mAnava jAtira eka dalake anya dala dvArA pratihata nA karatena tAhale vidhvasta haYe yeta khRSTAna, saMsAra virAgIdera upAsanA sthala, gIrjA, iYAhudIdera upAsanAlaYa evaM mAsajidasamUha yAte adhika smaraNa karA haYa AllAhara nAma; nizcaYai AllAha tAke sAhAyya karena ye nijake sAhAyya kare; nizcaYai AllAha zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|
Ami tAderake pRthivIte pratiSThita karale tArA sAlAta kAYema karave, yAkAta dive evaM sat kAjera Adeza karave o asat kArya hate niSedha karave| sakala kAjera pariNAma AllAhara ikhatiYAre|
evaM loke yadi tomAke asvIkAra kare tAhale tAdera pUrveto asvIkAra karechila nUhera kAoma, ‘Ada o chAmUda –
evaM ivarAhIma o lUtera kAoma|

evaM mAdaiYAnavAsI tAdera nAvIderake asvIkAra karechila; evaM asvIkAra karA haYechila mUsAkeo; Ami kAphiradera avakAza diYechilAma evaM pare tAderake zAsti diYechilAma| ataHpara kemana chila AmAra zAsti!

Ami dhvaMsa karechi kata janapada yegulira vAsindA chila yAlima| ei sava janapada tAdera gharera chAdasaha dhvaMsastupe pariNata haYechila evaM kata kUpa parityakta haYechila o kata sudRr3ha prAsAdao|
tArA ki deza bhramaNa kareni? tAhale tArA jJAna vuddhi sampanna hRdaYa o zrutizakti sampanna karNera adhikArI hate pArata| vastutaH cakSuto andha naYa, varaM andha hacche vakSasthita hRdaYa|
tArA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale, athaca AllAha tA~ra pratizruti kakhanao bhaMga karenanA| tomAra ravera ekadina tomAdera gaNanAYa sahasra vacharera samAna|
evaM Ami avakAza diYechi kata janapadake yakhana tArA chila atyAcArI| ataHpara tAderake zAsti diYechi evaM pratyAvartana AmArai nikaTa|
valaH he mAnuSa! Amito tomAdera janya eka spaSTa satarkakArI|
sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane evaM sat kAja kare tAdera janya Ache kSamA o sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
Ara yArA AmAra AYAta vyartha karAra ceSTA kare tArAi have jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

Ami tomAra pUrve ye sava rAsUla kiMvA nAvI preraNa karechi tAdera keha yakhanai kichu AkAMkhA kareche takhanai zAitAna tAra AkAMkhAYa kichu prakSipta kareche| kintu zAitAna yA prakSipta kare AllAha tA vidUrita karena; ataHpara AllAha tA~ra AYAtasamUhake supratiSThita karena evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
eTA e janya ye, zAitAna yA prakSipta kare tini oke parIkSA svarUpa karena tAdera janya yAdera antare vyAdhi raYeche, yAdera hRdaYa pASANa| nizcaYai yAlimarA dustara matabhede raYeche|

evaM e janya ye, yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tArA yena jAnate pAre ye, eTA (kuraAna) tomAra ravera nikaTa hate prerita satya| ataHpara tArA yena tAte vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM tAdera antara yena ora prati anugata haYa| yArA ImAna eneche tAderake AllAha sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
yArA kupharI kareche tArA ote sandeha poSaNa karA hate virata havenA, yatakSaNa nA tAdera nikaTa kiYAmAta ese par3ave AkasmikabhAve, athavA ese par3ave ai dinera zAsti yA theke rakSAra upAYa nei|
sedina AllAharai Adhipatya; tinii tAdera vicAra karavena| sutarAM yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tArA avasthAna karave sukhamaYa jAnnAte|
Ara yArA kupharI kare evaM AmAra AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra kare tAderai janya raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
Ara yArA hijarAta kareche, AllAhara pathe nihata haYeche athavA mRtyu varaNa kareche, tAderake AllAha avazyai utkRSTa jIvikA dAna karavena; evaM AllAha tiniito sarvotkRSTa riykadAtA|
tini tAderake avazyai emana sthAne dAkhila karavena yA tArA pachanda karave evaM AllAhato samyaka prajJAmaYa, parama sahanazIla|
eTAi haYe thAke, kona vyakti nipIr3ita haYe samaparimAna pratizodha grahaNa karale evaM punarAYa se atyAcArita hale AllAha avazyai tAke sAhAyya karavena; AllAha nizcaYai pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|
oTA e janya ye, AllAha rAtake praviSTa karena dinera madhye evaM dinake praviSTa karena rAtera madhye evaM AllAha sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|
e janyao ye, AllAha satya evaM tArA tA~ra parivarte yAke DAke oTAto asatya evaM AllAha to samucca, mahAna|
tumi ki lakSya karani ye, AllAha vAri varSaNa karena AkAza hate yAte savuja zyAmala haYe oThe dharitrI? AllAha samyaka sUkSmadarzI, parijJAta|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai evaM AllAhai to abhAvamukta, prazaMsA|

tumi ki lakSya karani ye, AllAha tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tatsamUdaYake evaM tA~ra nirdeze samudre vicaraNazIla nauyAnasamUhake evaM tinii AkAzake sthira rAkhena yAte oTA patita nA haYa pRthivIra upara tA~ra anumati chAr3A? AllAha nizcaYai mAnuSera prati daYArdra, parama daYAlu|
evaM tinii tomAderake jIvana dAna karechena, ataHpara tinii tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena, punarAYa tomAderake jIvana dAna karavena| mAnuSato ati mAtrAYa akRtajJa|

Ami pratyeka sampradAYera janya nirdhAraNa kare diYechi ivAdAta-paddhati yA tArA anusaraNa karave| sutarAM tArA yena tomAra sAthe e vyApAre vitarka nA kare| tumi tAderake tomAra ravera dike AhavAna kara, tumito sarala pathei pratiSThita|
tArA yadi tomAra sAthe vitanDA kare tAhale valaH tomarA yA kara sei samvandhe AllAha samyaka avahita|
tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda karacha AllAha kiYAmAta divase sei viSaYe tomAdera madhye vicAra mImAMsA kare divena|
tumi ki jAnanA ye, AkAza o pRthivIte yA kichu raYeche AllAha tA avagata Achena? e savai lipivaddha Ache eka kitAve; eTA AllAhara nikaTa sahaja|
evaM tArA ivAdAta kare AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ye samparke tini kona dalIla preraNa karenani evaM yAra samvandhe tAdera kona jJAna nei| vastutaH yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

evaM tAdera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha AvRtti karA hale tumi kAphiradera mukhamanDale asantoSera lakSaNa dekhave| yArA tAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAta AvRtti kare tAderake tArA AkramaNa karate udyata haYa| tumi valaH tAhale ki Ami tomAderake eTA apekSA anya kichura saMvAda diva? oTA Aguna| e viSaYe AllAha pratizruti diYechena kAphiraderake evaM oTA kata nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala!

he lokasakala! ekaTi upamA deYA hacche, manoyoga sahakAre tA zravaNa kara| tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka tArAto kakhanao ekaTi mAchio sRSTi karate pAravenA, e uddeze tArA savAi ekatrita haleo; evaM mAchi yadi tAdera nikaTa hate kichu chiniYe niYe yAYa oTAo tArA ora nikaTa hate uddhAra karate pAravenA| pUjArI o pUjita katai nA durvala!
tArA AllAhara yathocita maryAdA upalavdhi karenA| AllAha nizcaYai kSamatAvAna, parAkramazAlI|
AllAha mAlAikAdera madhya hate manonIta karena vANIvAhaka evaM mAnuSera madhya hateo; AllAha sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|
tAdera sammukhe o pazcAte yA kichu Ache tini tA jAnena evaM samasta viSaYa AllAhara nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA ruku kara, sAjadAha kara evaM tomAdera ravera ivAdAta kara o sat kAja kara yAte saphalakAma hate pAra| [sAjadAha]

evaM jihAda kara AllAhara pathe yebhAve jihAda karA ucita; tini tomAderake manonIta karechena| tini dInera vyApAre tomAdera upara kaThoratA Aropa karenani| eTA tomAdera pitA ivarAhImera millAta; tini pUrve tomAdera nAmakaraNa karechena musalima evaM ei kitAveo, yAte rAsUla tomAdera janya sAkSI svarUpa haYa evaM tomarA svAkSI hao mAnava jAtira janya| sutarAM tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta dAo evaM AllAhake avalamvana kara; tinii tomAdera abhibhAvaka, kata uttama abhibhAvaka evaM kata uttama sAhAyyakArI tini!
avazyai saphalakAma haYeche mu’minagaNa-
yArA nijedera sAlAte vinaYa, namra –
yArA asAra kriYA-kalApa hate virata thAke –
yArA yAkAta pradAne sakriYa –
yArA nijedera yaunAMgake saMyata rAkhe –
nijedera patnI athavA adhikArabhukta dAsIgaNa vyatIta, ete tArA nindanIYa havenA|
sutarAM keha ederake chAr3A anyake kAmanA karale tArA have sImAlaMghanakArI,
evaM yArA AmAnata o pratizruti rakSA kare –
Ara yArA nijedera sAlAte yatnavAna –
tArAi have uttarAdhikArI|
adhikArI have phiradAusera, yAte tArA vasavAsa karave cirakAla|
Amito mAnuSake sRSTi karechi mATira upAdAna hate|
ataHpara Ami oke zukravindu rUpe sthApana kari eka nirApada AdhAre|

pare Ami zukravinduke pariNata kari raktapinDe, ataHpara raktapinDake pariNata kari mAMsapinDe evaM mAMsapinDake pariNata kari asthipaJjare; ataHpara asthipaJjarake Dheke dii mAMsa dvArA; avazeSe oke gar3e tuli anya eka sRSTi rUpe; ataeva nipuNatama sraSTA AllAha kata kalyANamaYa!
erapara avazyai tomarA mRtyu varaNa karave|
ataHpara kiYAmAta divase tomAdera punarutthita karA have|
Amito tomAdera urdhve sRSTi karechi sapta stara evaM Ami sRSTi viSaYe asatarka nai|
evaM Ami AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kari parimitabhAve, ataHpara Ami tA mATite saMrakSita kari; Ami oke apasArita karateo sakSama|
ataHpara Ami oTA dvArA tomAdera janya khejura o AGgurera vAgAna sRSTi kari; ete tomAdera janya Ache pracura phala; Ara tA hate tomarA AhAra kara|
evaM sRSTi kari eka vRkSa yA janme sinAi parvate, ete utpanna haYa bhojanakArIdera janya tela o vyaJjana|

evaM tomAdera janya avazyai zikSaNIYa viSaYa raYeche catuspada jantusamUhera madhye| tomAderake Ami pAna karAi odera yA Ache tA theke; evaM ete tomAdera janya raYeche pracura upakAritA evaM tomarA uhA hate AhAra kara|
evaM tomarA tAte evaM nauyAne ArohaNao kare thAka|
Ami nUhake pAThiYechilAma tAra sampradAYera nikaTa| se valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa! AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera anya kona mA‘vUda nei, tavuo ki tomarA sAvadhAna havenA?

tAra sampradAYera kAphira pradhAnarA valechilaH e lokato tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa, se tomAdera upara zreSThatva lAbha karate cAcche, AllAha icchA karale mAlAka/pherezatA pAThAtena; AmarAto AmAdera pUrva-puruSadera yAmAnAYa erUpa ghaTeche vale zunini|
seto eka ummAda vyakti vai naYa; sutarAM era samparke tomarA kichukAla apekSA kara|
nUha valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke sAhAyya karuna| kAraNa tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valeche|

ataHpara Ami tAra kAche ahI karalAmaH tumi AmAra tattvAvadhAne o AmAra ahI anuyAYI nauyAna nirmANa kara, ataHpara yakhana AmAra Adeza Asave o unUna uthale uThave takhana uThiYe nive pratyeka jIvera eka eka jor3A strI o puruSa evaM tomAra parivAra-parijanake, tAdera madhye yAdera viruddhe pUrve siddhAnta haYeche tAdera samparke tumi AmAke kichu valanA, tArAto nimajjita have|
yakhana tumi o tomAra saGgIrA nauyAne ArohaNa karave takhana valaH samasta prazaMsA ai AllAharai yini AmAdera uddhAra karechena yAlima sampradAYa hate|
Ara valaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke emanabhAve avataraNa kariYe nina yA have kalyANakara; Ara Apanii zreSTha avataraNakArI|
ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche; Amito tAderake parIkSA karechilAma|
ataHpara tAdera para Ami anya eka sampradAYa sRSTi karechilAma|
erapara tAderai ekajanake tAdera nikaTa rAsUla kare pAThiYechilAma; se valechilaH tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tini chAr3A tomAdera anya kona mA‘vUda nei, tavuo ki tomarA sAvadhAna havenA?

tAra sampradAYera pradhAnarA yArA kupharI karechila o AkhirAtera sAkSAtake asvIkAra karechila evaM yAderake Ami diYechilAma pArthiva jIvane pracura bhoga sambhAra, tArA valechilaH eto tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSa; tomarA yA AhAra kara seto tA’i AhAra kare evaM tomarA yA pAna kara seo tA’i pAna kare|
yadi tomarA tomAderai mata ekajana mAnuSera Anugatya kara tAhale tomarA avazyai kSatigrasta have|
se ki tomAderake ei pratizrutii deYa ye, tomAdera mRtyu hale evaM tomarA mATi o asthite pariNata haleo tomAderake punarutthita karA have?
asambhava, tomAderake ye viSaYe pratizruti deYA haYeche tA asambhava!
ekamAtra pArthiva jIvanai AmAdera jIvana, AmarA mari vA~ci ekhAnei evaM AmarA punarutthita havanA|
se to emana vyakti ye AllAha samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kareche evaM AmarA tAke vizvAsa karAra nai|
se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke sAhAyya karuna; kAraNa tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valache|
(AllAha) valalenaH acirei tArA anutapta havei|
ataHpara satya satyai eka vikaTa zavda tAderake AghAta karala evaM Ami tAderake taraGga tAr3ita AvarjanA sadRza kare dilAma; sutarAM dhvaMsa haYe gela yAlima sampradAYa|
ataHpara tAdera pare Ami vahu jAti sRSTi karechi|
kona jAtii tAra nirdhArita kAlake tvarAnvita karate pArenA, Ara nA pAre vilamvita karate|

ataHpara Ami ekera para eka AmAra rAsUla preraNa karechi| yakhanai kona jAtira nikaTa tAdera rAsUla eseche takhanai tArA tAke mithyAvAdI valeche| ataHpara Ami tAdera ekera para ekake dhvaMsa karalAma; Ami tAderake kAhinIra viSaYa karechi; sutarAM dhvaMsa hoka avizvAsIrA!
ataHpara Ami AmAra nidarzana o suspaSTa pramANasaha mUsA o tAra bhAi hArUnake pAThAlAma –
phira‘Auna o tAra pariSadavargera nikaTa; kintu tArA ahaGkAra karala; tArA chila uddhata sampradAYa|
tArA valalaH AmarA ki emana du’ vyaktite vizvAsa sthApana karava yArA AmAderai mata evaM yAdera sampradAYa AmAdera dAsatva kare?
ataHpara tArA tAderake mithyAvAdI valala| phale tArA dhvaMsaprAptadera zAmila hala|
Ami mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma yAte tArA satpatha prApta haYa|
evaM Ami mAraiYAma tanaYa o tAra jananIke karechilAma eka nidarzana, tAderake AzraYa diYechilAma eka nirApada o prasravana viziSTa ucca bhUmite|
he rAsUlagaNa! tomarA pavitra vastu hate AhAra kara o sat kAja kara; tomarA yA kara sei samvandhe Ami savizeSa avagata|
evaM tomAdera ei ye jAti eTAto ekai jAti evaM Amii tomAdera rAvva; ataeva AmAke bhaYa kara|
kintu mAnuSa nijedera madhye tAdera dInake vahudhA vibhakta kareche; pratyeka dalai tAdera nikaTa yA Ache tA niYei santuSTa|
sutarAM kichukAlera janya tAderake svIYa vibhrAntite thAkate dAo|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAderake sAhAyya svarUpa ye dhanaizvarya o santAna-santati dAna kari taddArA –
tAdera janya sarva prakAra maGgala tvarAnvita karachi? nA, tArA vujhenA –
yArA tAdera ravera bhaYe santrasta –
yArA tAdera ravera nidarzanAvalIte ImAna Ane –
yArA tAdera ravera sAthe zarIka karenA|
Ara yArA tAdera ravera nikaTa pratyAvartana karave, ei vizvAse tAdera yA dAna karAra tA dAna kare bhIta-kampita hRdaYe|
tArAi druta sampAdana kare kalyANakara kAja evaM tArA tAte agragAmI haYa|
Ami kehakeo tAra sAdhyAtIta dAYitva arpana karinA evaM AmAra nikaTa Ache eka kitAva yA satya vyakta kare evaM tAdera prati yul‌ma karA havenA|
varaM e viSaYe tAdera antara ajJAnatAYa Acchanna, etadvyatIta Arao kAja Ache yA tArA kare thAke|
Ara Ami yakhana tAdera aizvaryazAlI vyaktiderake zAsti dvArA dhRta kari takhanai tArA ArtanAda kare uThe|
tAderake valA haveH Aja ArtanAda karanA, tomarA AmAra sAhAyya pAvenA|
AmAra AYAta tomAdera kAche pATha karA hata, kintu tomarA pichana phire sare par3ate –
dambha bhare, e viSaYe arthahIna galpa gujava karate|
tAhale ki tArA ei vANI anudhAvana karenA? athaca tAdera nikaTa ki emana kichu eseche yA tAdera pUrva-puruSadera nikaTa Aseni?
athaca tArA ki tAdera rAsUlake cinenA vale tAke asvIkAra kare?
athavA tArA ki vale ye, se unmAda? vastutaH se tAdera nikaTa satya eneche evaM tAdera adhikAMza satyake apachanda kare|

satya yadi tAdera kAmanAra anugAmI hata tAhale vizRMkhala haYe par3ata AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI evaM odera madhyavartI sava kichui| pakSAntare Ami tAderake diYechi upadeza, kintu tArA upadeza hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
athavA tumi ki tAdera kAche kona pratidAna cAo? tomAra ravera pratidAnai zreSTha evaM tinii zreSTha riykadAtA|
tumito tAderake sarala pathe AhavAna karacha|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa karenA tArAto sarala patha hate vicyuta|
Ami tAdera upara daYA karaleo evaM tAdera duHkha-dainya dUra karaleo tArA avAdhyatAYa vibhrAntera nyAYa ghurate thAkave|
Ami tAderake zAsti dvArA dhRta karalAma, kintu tArA tAdera ravera prati vinata halanA evaM kAtara prArthanAo karalanA|
avazeSe yakhana Ami tAdera janya kaThina zAstira dvAra khule dii takhanai tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tinii tomAdera janya karNa, cakSu o antaHkaraNa sRSTi karechena; tomarA alpai kRtajJatA prakAza kare thAka|
tinii tomAderake pRthivIte vistRta karechena evaM tomAderake tA~rai nikaTa ekatrita karA have|
tinii jIvana dAna karena evaM mRtyu ghaTAna, Ara tA~rai adhikAre rAta o dinera parivartana, tavuo ki tomarA vujhavenA?
etadasattveo tArA tA’i vale yemana valechila pUrvavartIrA|
tArA valeH AmAdera mRtyu ghaTale evaM AmarA mATi o asthite pariNata haleo ki AmarA punarutthita hava?
AmAderake to e viSaYei pratizruti pradAna karA haYeche evaM atIte AmAdera pUrva-puruSaderakeo; eTAto prAcIna kAlera kalpakathA vyatIta Ara kichui naYa|
jijJesa karaH ei pRthivI evaM ete yA Ache tA kAra, yadi tomarA jAna to vala?
tArA valaveH AllAhara! valaH tavuo ki tomarA zikSA grahaNa karavenA?
jijJesa karaH ke saptAkAzera rAvva evaM ke’ivA mahAna Arazera rAvva?
tArA valaveH AllAha! valaH tavuo ki tomarA AllAhabhIru havenA?
jijJesa karaH yadi tomarA jAna tAhale vala sava kichura kartRtva kAra hAte, ke AzraYa dAna karena, yA~ra upara AzraYadAtA nei?
tArA valaveH AllAhara! valaH tavuo tomarA kemana kare vibhrAnta haccha?
varaM Amito tAdera nikaTa satya pau~chiYechi; kintu tArA mithyAvAdI|

AllAha kona santAna grahaNa karenani evaM tA~ra sAthe apara kona mA‘vUda nei; yadi thAkata tAhale pratyeka mA‘vUda svIYa sRSTi niYe pRthaka haYe yeta evaM eke aparera upara prAdhAnya vistAra karata| tArA yA vale tA hate AllAha ati pavitra!
tini dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtA, tArA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra urdhve|
valaH he AmAra rAvva! ye viSaYe tAderake pratizruti pradAna karA haYeche, tA yadi Apani AmAke dekhAtena –
tave he AmAra rAvva! Apani AmAke yAlima sampradAYera antarbhukta karavenanA|
Ami tAderake ye viSaYe pratizruti pradAna karechi tA Ami tomAke dekhAte avazyai sakSama|
mandera mukAvilA kara uttama dvArA, tArA yA vale Ami sei samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
Ara valaH he AmAra rAvva! Ami ApanAra AzraYa prArthanA kari zAitAnera prarocanA hate|
he AmAra rAvva! Ami ApanAra AzraYa prArthanA kari AmAra nikaTa odera upasthiti hate|
yakhana tAdera kArao mRtyu upasthita haYa takhana se valeH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke punarAYa preraNa karuna –
yAte Ami sat kAja karate pAri yA Ami pUrve karini| nA eTA havAra naYa; eTAto tAra ekaTA ukti mAtra; tAdera sAmane vArayAkha thAkave punarutthAna dina paryanta|
ataHpara ye dina ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have sedina parasparera madhye AtmIYatAra vandhana thAkavenA, evaM eke aparera kho~ja khavara nivenA|
sutarAM yAdera pAllA bhArI have tArAi have saphalakAma|
Ara yAdera pAllA hAlakA have tArAi nijedera kSati kareche; tArA jAhAnnAme sthAYI have|
Aguna tAdera mukhamanDala dagdha karave evaM tArA sekhAne thAkave vIbhatsa cehArAYa|
tomAdera nikaTa ki AmAra AYAtasamUha AvRtti hatanA? athaca tomarA oguli asvIkAra karate!
tArA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! durbhAgya AmAderake peYe vasechila evaM AmarA chilAma eka vibhrAnta sampradAYa|
he AmAdera rAvva! ei Aguna hate AmAderake uddhAra karuna; ataHpara AmarA yadi punarAYa kupharI kari tAhaleto AmarA avazyai sImAlaMghanakArI hava|
AllAha valavenaH tomarA hIna avasthAYa ekhAnei thAka evaM AmAra sAthe kona kathA valanA|

AmAra vAndAdera madhye ekadala chila yArA valataH he AmAdera rAvva! AmarA ImAna enechi, sutarAM Apani AmAderake kSamA karuna evaM AmAdera upara daYA karuna, Apanito daYAlugaNera madhye zreSTha daYAlu|
kintu tAderake niYe tomarA eto ThATTA vidrupa karate ye, tA tomAderake AmAra smaraNa bhuliYe diYechila; tomarAto tAderake niYe hAsi-ThATTAi karate|
Ami Aja tAderake tAdera dhairyera kAraNe emanabhAve puraskRta karalAma ye, tArAi hala saphalakAma|
tini valavenaH tomarA pRthivIte kata vachara avasthAna karechile?
tArA valaveH AmarA avasthAna karechilAma ekadina athavA ekadinera kichu aMza, Apani nA haYa gaNanAkArIderake jijJesa karuna|
tini valavenaH tomarA alpakAlai avasthAna karechile, yadi tomarA jAnate|
tomarA ki mane karechile ye, Ami tomAderake anarthaka sRSTi karechi evaM tomarA AmAra nikaTa pratyAvartita havenA?
mahimAnvita AllAha yini prakRta mAlika, tini vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei; sammAnita Arazera tinii rAvva|
ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe DAke anya ilAhake yAra nikaTa kona sanada nei, tAra hisAva raYeche tAra ravera nikaTa, nizcaYai kAphirerA saphalakAma havenA|
valaH he AmAra rAvva! kSamA karuna o daYA karuna, daYAludera madhye Apaniito zreSTha daYAlu|
eTi ekaTi sUrA, eTi Ami avatIrNa karechi evaM era vidhAnake avazya pAlanIYa karechi, ete Ami avatIrNa karechi suspaSTa AYAtasamUha yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

vyabhicAriNI o vyabhicArI - nArI o puruSa pratyekake ekaza’ kazAghAta karave, AllAhara vidhAna kAryakarI karate tAdera prati daYA yena tomAderake prabhAvAnvita nA kare, yadi tomarA AllAha evaM parakAle vizvAsI hao; mu’minadera ekaTi dala yena tAdera zAsti pratyakSa kare|
vyabhicArI vyabhicArinI athavA muzarika nArIke vyatIta viYe karenA evaM vyabhicArinIke vyabhicArI athavA muzarika vyatIta keha viYe karenA, mu’minadera janya ederake niSiddha karA haYeche|
yArA satI-sAdhvI ramanIra prati apavAda Aropa kare evaM cArajana sAkSI hAjira karenA, tAderake AziTi kazAghAta karave evaM kakhanao tAdera sAkSya grahaNa karavenA; tArAi satyatyAgI|
tave yadi erapara tArA tAovAha kare o nijederake saMzodhana kare, AllAhato kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

evaM yArA nijedera strIra prati apavAda Aropa kare athaca nijerA vyatIta tAdera kona sAkSI nei, tAdera pratyekera sAkSya ei have ye, se AllAhara nAme cAra vAra zapatha kare valave ye, se avazyai satyavAdI|
Ara paJcama vAre valave ye, se yadi mithyAvAdI haYa tAhale tAra upara neme Asave AllAhara lA’nata|
tave strIra zAsti rahita have yadi se cAra vAra AllAhara nAme zapatha kare sAkSya deYa ye, tAra svAmIi mithyAvAdI|
Ara paJcamavAre valave ye, tAra svAmI satyavAdI hale tAra nijera upara neme Asave AllAhara gayava|
tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkale tomAdera kehai avyAhati petenA; evaM AllAha tAovAha grahaNakArI o prajJAmaYa|

yArA ei apavAda racanA kareche tArAto tomAderai ekaTi dala; eTAke tomarA tomAdera janya aniSTakara mane karanA; varaM eTAto tomAdera janya kalyANakara; tAdera pratyekera janya raYeche tAdera kRta pApa kAjera phala, evaM tAdera madhye ye e vyApAre pradhAna bhUmikA pAlana kareche tAra janya raYeche kaThina zAsti|
e kathA zonAra para mu’mina puruSa evaM nArIgaNa kena nijedera loka samparke uttama dhAranA kareni evaM valeniH eTAto suspaSTa apavAda?
tArA kena e vyApAre cAra jana sAkSI hAyira kareni? yehetu tArA sAkSI hAyira kareni, sei kAraNe tArA AllAhara vidhAne mithyAvAdI|
duniYA o AkhirAte tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkale, tomarA yAte lipta chile tajjanya kaThina zAsti tomAderake sparza karata|

yakhana tomarA lokamukhe eTA char3Acchile evaM emana viSaYa mukhe uccAraNa karachile yAra kona jJAna tomAdera chilanA evaM tomarA eke tuccha ganya karechile, yadio AllAhara nikaTa chila eTA gurutara viSaYa|
evaM tomarA yakhana eTA zravaNa karale takhana kena valalenAH e viSaYe valAvali karA AmAdera ucit naYa; AllAha pavitra, mahAna! eTAto eka gurutara apavAda|
AllAha tomAderake upadeza dicchenaH tomarA yadi mu’mina hao tAhale kakhanao anurUpa AcaraNera punarAvRtti karanA|
AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra AYAtasamUha suspaSTabhAve vivRta karena evaM AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
yArA mu’minadera madhye azlIlatAra prasAra kAmanA kare tAdera janya raYeche duniYA o AkhirAte marmantada zAsti evaM AllAha jAnena, tomarA jAnanA|
tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha o daYA nA thAkale tomAdera kehai avyAhati petenA, evaM AllAha daYArdra o parama daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA zAitAnera padAMka anusaraNa karanA; keha zAitAnera padAMka anusaraNa karale zAitAnato azlIlatA o manda kAjera nirdeza deYa; AllAhara daYA o anugraha nA thAkale tomAdera kehai kakhanao pavitra hate pAratenA, tave AllAha yAke icchA pavitra karena, evaM AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

tomAdera madhye yArA aizvarya o prAcuryera adhikArI tArA yena zapatha grahaNa nA kare ye, tArA AtmIYa-svajana o abhAvagrastaderake evaM AllAhara pathe yArA gRhatyAga kareche tAderake kichui divenA| tArA yena tAdera doSa-kraTi upekSA kare| tomarA ki cAonA ye, AllAha tomAderake kSamA karena? evaM AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA sAdhvI, saralamanA o vizvAsI nArIra prati apavAda Aropa kare tArA duniYA o AkhirAte abhizapta evaM tAdera janya raYeche mahAzAsti|
yedina tAdera viruddhe sAkSya dive tAdera jihavA, tAdera hAta evaM tAdera pA tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe –
sedina AllAha tAdera prApta pratiphala puropuri divena evaM tArA jAnave ye, AllAhai satya, spaSTa prakAzaka|

duzcaritrA nArI duzcaritra puruSera janya; duzcaritra puruSa duzcaritrA nArIra janya; saccaritrA nArI saccaritra puruSera janya evaM saccaritra puruSa saccaritrA nArIra janya| loke yA vale erA tA theke pavitra; edera janya raYeche kSamA evaM sammAnajanaka jIvikA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA nijedera gRha vyatIta anya kArao gRhe gRhavAsIdera anumati nA niYe evaM tAderake sAlAma nA kare praveza karanA; eTAi tomAdera janya zreYa, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|

yadi tomarA gRhe kehake nA pAo tAhale tAte praveza karave nA yatakSaNa nA tomAderake anumati deYA haYa| yadi tomAderake valA haYa phire yAo, tAhale tomarA phire yAve, eTAi tomAdera janya uttama evaM tomarA yA kara sei samvandhe AllAha savizeSa avahita|
ye gRhe keha vAsa karenA tAte tomAdera janya dravya sAmagrI thAkale sekhAne tomAdera praveze kono pApa nei evaM AllAha jAnena yA tomarA prakAza kara evaM yA tomarA gopana kara|
mu’minaderake valaH tArA yena dRSTike saMyata kare evaM tAdera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyAta kare| ete tAdera janya uttama pavitratA raYeche; tArA yA kare sei viSaYe AllAha avahita|

ImAna AnaYanakArinI nArIderake valaH tArA yena tAdera dRSTike evaM tAdera lajjAsthAnera hiphAyAta kare| tArA yena yA sAdhAraNataH prakAzamAna tA vyatIta tAdera saundarya pradarzana nA kare| tAdera grIvA o vakSadeza yena mAthAra kApar3a dvArA AvRta kare| tArA yena tAdera svAmI, pitA, zvazura, putra, svAmIra putra, bhAi, bhrAtusputra, bhagnIputra, Apana nArIgaNa, tAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsI, puruSadera madhye yauna kAmanA rahita puruSa evaM nArIdera gopana aGga samvandhe ajJa vAlaka vyatIta kArao nikaTa tAdera AbharaNa prakAza nA kare| tArA yena tAdera gopana AbharaNa prakAzera uddeze sajore padakSepa nA phele| he mu’minagaNa! tomarA savAi AllAhara dike pratyAvartana kara, yAte tomarA saphalakAma hate pAra|

tomAdera madhye yArA ‘‘AiYima’’ (vipatnIka puruSa vA vidhavA mahilA) tAdera vivAha sampAdana kara evaM tomAdera dAsa-dAsIdera madhye yArA sat tAderao| tArA abhAvagrasta hale AllAha nija anugrahe tAderake abhAvamukta kare divena; AllAhato prAcuryamaYa, sarvajJa|

yAdera viYera sAmarthya nei AllAha tAderake nija anugrahe abhAvamukta nA karA paryanta tArA yena saMyama avalamvana kare evaM tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsadAsIdera madhye keha tAra muktira janya likhita cukti karate cAile tAdera sAthe cuktite Avaddha hao, yadi tomarA tAdera madhye maGgalera sandhAna pAo; AllAha tomAdera ye sampada diYechena tA hate tomarA tAderake dAna karave| tomAdera dAsIrA satatA rakSA karate cAile pArthiva jIvanera dhana sampadera lAlasAYa tAderake vyabhicAriNI hate vAdhya karanA, Ara ye tAderake vAdhya kare, serUpa kSetre tAdera upara yavaradastira para AllAha kSamAzIla, daYAlu|
Ami tomAdera nikaTa avatIrNa karechi suspaSTa AYAta, tomAdera pUrvavartIdera dRSTAnta evaM muttAkIdera janya upadeza|

AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra jyoti, tA~ra jyotira upamA yena ekaTi dIpAdhAra, yAra madhye Ache ekaTi pradIpa; pradIpaTi ekaTi kA~cera AvaraNera madhye sthApita, kA~cera AvaraNaTi ujjvala nakSatra sadRza; eTA prajjvalita karA haYa putaHpavitra yAitUna vRkSera tela dvArA yA prAcyera naYa, praticyerao naYa, Aguna oke sparza nA karaleo yena ora tela ujjvala Alo dicche; jyotira upara jyoti! AllAha yAke icchA patha nirdeza karena tA~ra jyotira dike; AllAha mAnuSera janya upamA diYe thAkena evaM AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|
sei sava gRha, yAke maryAdAYa samunnata karate evaM yAte tA~ra nAma smaraNa karate AllAha nirdeza diYechena, sakAla o sandhyAYa tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare|

sei sava loka, yAderake vyavasA-vANijya evaM kraYa vikraYa AllAhara smaraNa hate evaM sAlAta kAYema o yAkAta pradAna hate virata rAkhenA, tArA bhaYa kare sei dinake yedina tAdera antara o dRSTi viparyasta haYe par3ave –
yAte tArA ye kAja kare tajjanya AllAha tAderake uttama puraskAra dena evaM nija anugrahe tAdera prApyera adhika dena; AllAha yAke icchA aparimita jIvikA dAna kare|

yArA kupharI kare, tAdera AmalasamUha marubhUmira marIcikA sadRza| pipAsArta yAke pAni mane kare thAke, kintu se ora nikaTa upasthita hale dekhave oTA kichu naYa, kintu se pAve sekhAne AllAhake| ataHpara tini tAra karmaphala pUrNa mAtrAYa divena; AllAha hisAva grahaNe tatpara|

athavA (kAphiradera kAja) pramatta samudrera vuke gabhIra andhakArera nyAYa, yAke udvelita kare taraGgera upara taraGga, yAra upare raYeche ghana kAlo megha, ekera upara eka andhakAra| tAra hAtake vera karale se tA Adau dekhate pAYanA| AllAha yAke jyoti dAna karenanA tAra janya kona jyoti nei|

tumi ki dekhanA ye, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yArA Ache tArA evaM uDDIYamAna vihaMgakUla AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare? tArA pratyekei jAne tA~ra yogya prArthanA evaM pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNAra paddhati evaM tArA yA kare sei viSaYe AllAha samyaka avagata|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva AllAharai evaM tA~rai dike pratyAvartana|

tumi ki dekhanA AllAha saJcAlita karena meghamAlAke, ataHpara tAderake ekatrita karena evaM pare puJjIbhUta karena? ataHpara tumi dekhate pAo, ora madhya hate nirgata haYa vAridhArA| AkAzasthita zilAstupa hate tini zilA varSaNa karena evaM era dvArA tini yAke icchA tAra upara hate eTA anya dike phiriYe dena; meghera vidyutjhalaka dRSTizakti prAYa ker3e neYa|
AllAha dina o rAtera parivartana ghaTAna, ete zikSA raYeche antaHdRSTi sampannadera janya|

AllAha samasta jIva sRSTi karechena pAni hate, odera kataka peTe bhara diYe cale evaM kataka du’ pAYe bhara kare cale evaM kataka cale cAra pAYe, AllAha yA icchA sRSTi karena, AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
Amito suspaSTa nidarzana avatIrNa karechi| AllAha yAke icchA sarala saThika patha pradarzana karena|
tArA valeH AmarA AllAha o rAsUlera prati ImAna enechi evaM AmarA Anugatya svIkAra karachi| kintu erapara tAdera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa; vastutaH tArA mu’mina naYa|
Ara yakhana tAderake phAisAlA kare deYAra janya AhavAna karA haYa AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera dike takhana tAdera ekadala mukha phiriYe neYa|
Ara satya tAdera svapakSe hale tArA vinItabhAve rAsUlera nikaTa chuTe Ase|
tAdera antare ki vyAdhi Ache, nA tArA saMzaYa poSaNa kare, nA ki tArA bhaYa kare ye, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla tAdera prati yul‌ma karavena? varaM tArAito yAlima|

mu’minadera uktito ei, yakhana tAdera madhye phAisAlA kare deYAra janya AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera dike AhavAna karA haYa takhana tArA valeH AmarA zravaNa karalAma o mAnya karalAma| Ara tArAito saphalakAma|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare, AllAhake bhaYa kare o tA~ra avAdhyatA hate sAvadhAna thAke tArAi saphalakAma|
tArA dRr3habhAve AllAhara zapatha kare vale, tumi tAderake Adeza karale tArA vera havei; tumi valaH zapatha karanA, yathArtha Anugatyai kAmya| tomarA yA kara AllAha se viSaYe savizeSa avahita|

valaH tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara; ataHpara yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale tAra upara arpita dAYitvera janya se dAYI evaM tomAdera upara arpita dAYitvera janya tomarA dAYI; evaM tomarA tAra Anugatya karale sat patha pAve, rAsUlera dAYitvato zudhu spaSTabhAve pau~che deYA|

tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare AllAha tAderake pratizruti dicchena ye, tini tAderake pRthivIte pratinidhitva dAna karavenai, yemana tini pratinidhitva dAna karechilena tAdera pUrvavartIderake evaM tini avazyai tAdera janya sudRr3ha karavena tAdera dInake yA tini tAdera janya manonIta karechena evaM tAdera bhaYa bhItira parivarte tAderake avazyai nirApattA dAna karavena; tArA AmAra ivAdAta karave, AmAra sAthe kona zarIka karavenA, ataHpara yArA akRtajJa have tArAto satyatyAgI|
tomarA sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yAte tomarA anugraha prApta hate pAra|
tumi kAphiraderake pRthivIte pravala mane karanA; tAdera AzraYasthala Aguna; kata nikRSTa ei pariNAma!

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsa-dAsIrA evaM tomAdera madhye yArA vaYaHprApta haYani tArA yena tomAdera kakSe praveza karate tina samaYe anumati grahaNa kare| phAjarera sAlAtera pUrve, dviprahare yakhana tomarA tomAdera pozAka khule rAkha evaM izAra sAlAtera para| ei tina samaYa tomAdera deha kholA rAkhAra samaYa; ei tina samaYa chAr3A anya samaYe vinA anumatite praveza karale tomAdera janya o tAdera janya kona doSa nei; tomAdera eka janake apara janera nikaTato yAtAYAta karatei haYa| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera nikaTa tA~ra nirdeza suspaSTa rUpe vivRta karena; AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

evaM tomAdera santAna-santati vaYaHprApta hale tArAo yena anumati prArthanA kare tAdera vaYaHjyeSThadera nyAYa| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra nirdeza suspaSTabhAve vivRta karena; AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

Ara vRddhA nArI, yArA viYera AzA rAkhenA, tAdera janya aparAdha nei yadi tArA tAdera saundarya pradarzana nA kare tAdera vahirvAsa khule rAkhe; tave eTA hate virata thAkAi tAdera janya uttama| AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

andhera janya doSa nei, kho~r3Ara janya doSa nei, Ara doSa nei rogIra janya evaM tomAdera nijedera janyao doSa nei AhAra karAYa nijedera gRhe athavA tomAdera pitAdera gRhe athavA tomAdera mAtAdera gRhe athavA tomAdera bhAidera gRhe athavA tomAdera vonadera gRhe athavA tomAdera cAcAdera gRhe athavA tomAdera phuphudera gRhe athavA tomAdera mAmAdera gRhe athavA tomAdera khAlAdera gRhe athavA sei gRhe yAra cAvi raYeche tomAdera kAche athavA tomAdera prakRta vandhudera gRhe| tomarA ekatre AhAra kara athavA pRthakabhAve AhAra kara tAte tomAdera janya kono aparAdha nei| tave yakhana tomarA gRhe praveza karave takhana tomarA tomAdera svajanadera prati sAlAma karave abhivAdana svarUpa, yA AllAhara nikaTa hate kalyANamaYa o pavitra| ebhAve AllAha tomAdera janya tA~ra nirdeza vizadabhAve varNanA karena yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|

tArAi mu’mina yArA AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera upara ImAna Ane evaM rAsUlera saGge samaSTigata vyApAre ekatra hale tAra anumati vyatIta tArA sare par3enA; yArA anumati prArthanA kare tArAi AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUle vizvAsI; ataeva tArA tAdera kona kAje vAire yAvAra janya tomAra anumati cAile tAdera madhye yAderake icchA tumi anumati dive evaM tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karave; AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

rAsUlera AhavAnake tomarA eke aparera prati AhavAnera mata gaNya karanA; tomAdera madhye yArA cupi cupi sare par3e AllAha tAderake jAnena| sutarAM yArA tA~ra Adezera viruddhAcaraNa kare tArA satarka hoka ye, viparyaYa tAdera upara Apatita have athavA Apatita have tAdera upara kaThina zAsti|

jene rekha, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu raYeche tA AllAharai, tomarA yAte vyApRta tini tA jAnena; yedina tArA tA~ra nikaTa pratyAvartita have sedina tini tAderake jAniYe divena tArA yA karata; AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|
kata mahAna tini yini tA~ra vAndAra prati ‘phurakAna’ avatIrNa karechena yAte se vizva jagatera janya satarkakArI hate pAre!

yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatvera adhikArI; tini kona santAna grahaNa karenani; sArvabhaumatve tA~ra kona aMzIdAra nei| tini samasta kichu sRSTi karechena evaM pratyekake parimita karechena yathAyatha anupAte|

Ara tArA tA~ra parivarte mA‘vUda rUpe grahaNa kareche aparake yArA kichui sRSTi karenA, varaM tArA nijerAi sRSTa evaM tArA nijedera apakAra athavA upakAra karAra kSamatA rAkhenA evaM jIvana, mRtyu o punarutthAnera uparao kona kSamatA rAkhenA|
kAphirerA valeH eTA mithyA vyatIta kichu naYa, se eTA udbhAvana kareche evaM bhinna sampradAYera loka tAke e vyApAre sAhAyya kareche; avazyai tArA yul‌ma o mithyAcArera AzraYa niYeche|
evaM tArA valeH egulito sekAlera upakathA yA se likhiYe niYeche; eguli sakAla-sandhyAYa tAra nikaTa pATha karA haYa|
valaH eTA tinii avatIrNa karechena yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra samudaYa rahasya avagata Achena; tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tArA valeH e kemana rAsUla ye AhAra kare evaM hATe vAjAre calAphirA kare? tAra kAche kona mAlAka/pherezatA kena avatIrNa karA halanA ye tAra sAthe thAkata satarkakArI rUpe?
tAke dhana bhAnDAra deYA haYani kena, athavA kena ekaTi vAgAna deYA halanA yA hate se khAdya saMgraha karate pAre? sImAlaMghanakArIrA Arao valeH tomarAto eka yAdugrasta vyaktirai anusaraNa karacha|
dekha, tArA tomAra ki upamA deYa| tArA pathabhraSTa haYeche evaM tArA patha pAvenA|
kata mahAna tini yini icchA karale tomAke dite pArena eTA apekSA utkRSTatara vastu - udyAnasamUha, yAra nimnadeze nada-nadI pravAhita evaM dite pArena prAsAdasamUha|
varaM tArA kiYAmAtake asvIkAra kareche evaM yArA kiYAmAtake asvIkAra kare tAdera janya Ami prastuta rekhechi jvalanta Aguna|
dUra hate Aguna yakhana tAderake dekhave takhana tArA zunate pAve ora kruddha garjana o huGkAra|
evaM yakhana tAderake zRMkhalita avasthAYa ora kona saMkIrNa sthAne nikSepa karA have takhana tArA sekhAne dhvaMsa kAmanA karave|
tAderake valA haveH Aja tomarA ekavArera janya dhvaMsa kAmanA karanA, varaM vahuvAra dhvaMsa haoYAra kAmanA karate thAka|
tAderake jijJesa karaH eTAi zreYa, nAki sthAYI jAnnAta, yAra pratizruti deYA haYeche muttAkIderake! eTAi tAdera puraskAra o pratyAvartana sthala|
sekhAne tArA yA kAmanA karave tA’i pAve evaM tArA sthAYI have| ei pratizruti pUraNa tomAra raverai dAYitva|

evaM yedina tini ekatrita karavena tAderake evaM tArA AllAhara parivarte yAdera ivAdAta karata tAderake, tini sedina jijJesa karavenaH tomarAi ki AmAra ei vAndAderake vibhrAnta karechile, nAki tArA nijerAi pathabhraSTa haYechila?

tArA valaveH Apani pavitra o mahAna! ApanAra parivarte AmarA anyake abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa karate pArinA| Apaniito ederake o edera pitR-puruSaderake bhoga-sambhAra diYechilena| pariNAme tArA upadeza vismRta haYechila evaM pariNata haYechila eka dhvaMsaprApta jAtite|

AllAha (muzarikaderake) valavenaH tomarA yA valate tArA tA mithyA sAvyasta kareche| sutarAM tomarA zAsti pratirodha karate pArave nA, sAhAyyao pAve nA| tomAdera madhye ye sImAlaMghana karave Ami tAke mahAzAsti AsvAda karAva|

tomAra pUrve Ami ye sava rAsUla preraNa karechi tArA savAi AhAra karata o hATe-vAjAre calAphirA karata| he loka sakala! Ami tomAdera madhye ekake aparera janya parIkSA svarUpa karechi| tomarA dhairya dhAraNa karave ki? tomAra rAvva sava kichu dekhena|

yArA AmAra sAkSAt kAmanA karenA tArA valeH AmAdera nikaTa mAlAka/pherezatA avatIrNa karA haYanA kena? athavA AmarA AmAdera rAvvake pratyakSa kari nA kena? tArA tAdera antare ahaMkAra poSaNa kare evaM tArA sImAlaMghana kareche gurutara rUpe|
yedina tArA mAlAikAke/pherezatAderake pratyakSa karave sedina aparAdhIdera janya susaMvAda thAkave nA evaM tArA valaveH yadi kono vAdhA thAkata!
Ami tAdera kRtakarmaguli vivecanA karava, ataHpara segulike vikSipta dhUlikaNAYa pariNata karava|
sedina jAnnAtavAsIdera vAsasthAna have utkRSTa evaM vizrAmasthala have manorama|
yedina AkAza meghapuJjasaha vidIrNa have evaM mAlAikAke (pherezatAderake) nAmiYe deYA have –
sedina prakRta rAjatva have daYAmaYa AllAhara evaM kAphiradera janya sedina have kaThina|
yAlima vyakti sedina nija hastadvaYa daMzana karate karate valaveH hAYa! Ami yadi rAsUlera sAthe sat patha avalamvana karatAma!
hAYa durbhoga AmAra! Ami yadi amukake vandhu rUpe grahaNa nA karatAma!
AmAketo se vibhrAnta karechila AmAra nikaTa upadeza pau~chAra para; zAitAnato mAnuSera janya mahApratAraka|
takhana rAsUla valaveH he AmAra rAvva! AmAra sampradAYato ei kuraAnake parityAjya mane karechila|
ebhAvei pratyeka nAvIra janya Ami aparAdhIdera madhya theke zatru karechi| tomAra janya tomAra rAvva patha pradarzaka o sAhAyyakArI rUpe yatheSTa|
kAphirerA valeH samagra kuraAna tAra nikaTa ekavArei avatIrNa halanA kena? ebhAvei avatIrNa karechi, yAte tomAra hRdaYa ora dvArA mayavUta haYa evaM tA sampUrNa rupe Aste Aste Atmastha karate pAra|
tArA tomAra nikaTa emana kona samasyA upasthita kareni yAra saThika samAdhAna o sundara vyAkhyA Ami tomAke dAna karini|
yAderake mukhe bhara diYe diYe calA avasthAYa jAhAnnAmera dike ekatra karA have, tAderai sthAna have ati nikRSTa evaM tArAi pathabhraSTa|
Amito mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma evaM tAra bhAi hArUnake tAra sAhAyyakArI karechilAma|
evaM valechilAmaH tomarA sei sampradAYera nikaTa yAo yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra kareche; ataHpara Ami tAderake sampUrNarUpe dhvaMsa karechilAma|

Ara nUhera sampradAYa yakhana rAsUladera prati mithyAropa karala takhana Ami tAderake nimajjita karalAma evaM tAderake mAnavajAtira janya nidarzana svarUpa kare rAkhalAma; yAlimadera janya Ami marmantada zAsti prastuta kare rekhechi|
Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma ‘Ada, chAmUda, rA’s evaM tAdera arntavartI kAlera vahu sampradAYakeo|
Ami tAdera pratyekera janya dRSTAnta varNanA karechilAma, Ara tAdera sakalakei Ami sampUrNa rUpe dhvaMsa karechilAma|
tArAto sei janapada diYei yAtAYAta kare yAra upara varSita haYechila akalyANera vRSTi; tAhale ki tArA eTA pratyakSa karenA? vastutaH tArA punarutthAnera AzaMkA karenA|
tArA yakhana tomAke dekhe takhana tArA tomAke zudhu ThATTA-vidrupera pAtra rUpe gaNya kare evaM valeH e-i ki se, yAke AllAha rAsUla kare pAThiYechena!
seto AmAderake AmAdera devatAdera hate dUre sariYe dita yadi nA AmarA tAdera Anugatye dRr3ha pratiSThita thAkatAma| yakhana tArA zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana tArA jAnave ke sarvAdhika pathabhraSTa|
tumi ki dekhanA tAke, ye tAra kAmanA vAsanAke upAsya rUpe grahaNa kare? tavuo ki tumi tAra yimmAdAra have?
tumi ki mane kara ye, tAdera adhikAMza zone o vujhe? tArAto pazurai mata; varaM tArA Arao adhama|
tumi ki tomAra ravera prati lakSya karanA, kibhAve tini chAYA samprasArita karena? tini icchA karale eTAke to sthira rAkhate pAratena| anantara Ami sUryake karechi era nirdezaka|
ataHpara Ami eke AmAra dike dhIre dhIre guTiYe Ani|
evaM tinii tomAdera janya rAtake karechena AvaraNa svarUpa, vizrAmera janya tomAdera diYechena nidrA evaM samutthAnera janya diYechena dina|
tinii svIYa rAhamAtera prAkkAle susaMvAdavAhI rUpe vAYu preraNa karena evaM Ami AkAza hate vizuddha pAni varSaNa kari –
yadvArA Ami mRta bhU-khanDake saJjIvita kari evaM AmAra sRSTira madhyera vahu jIva jantu o mAnuSake tA pAna karAi|
Ara Ami eTA tAdera madhye vitaraNa kari yAte tArA smaraNa kare; kintu adhikAMza loka zudhu akRtajJatAi prakAza kare|
Ami icchA karale pratiTi janapadera janya ekajana satarkakArI preraNa karate pAratAma|
sutarAM tumi kAphiradera Anugatya karanA evaM tumi kuraAnera sAhAyye tAdera sAthe pravala saMgrAma cAliYe yAo|
tinii dui samudrake militabhAve pravAhita karechena; ekaTi miSTi, supeYa evaM aparaTi lavaNAkta, khara; ubhaYera madhye rekhe diYechena eka antarAYa, eka anatikramya vyavadhAna|
evaM tinii mAnuSake sRSTi karechena pAni hate; ataHpara tini tAra vaMzagata o vaivAhika samvandha sthApana karechena| tomAra rAvva sarvazaktimAna|
tArA AllAhara parivarte emana kichura ivAdAta kare yA tAdera upakAra karate pArenA, apakArao karate pArenA; kAphirato svIYa ravera virodhI|
Amito tomAke zudhu susaMvAda dAtA o satarkakArI rUpei preraNa karechi|
valaH Ami tomAdera nikaTa e janya kona pratidAna cAinA, tave ye icchA kare se tAra ravera patha avalamvana karuka|
tumi nirbhara kara tA~ra upara yini ciraJjIva, yA~ra mRtyu nei evaM tA~ra saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara| tini tA~ra vAndAdera pApa samparke yatheSTa avahita|
tini AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI evaM ogulira madhyavartI samasta kichu chaYa dine sRSTi karena; ataHpara tini Araze samAsIna hana; tinii rAhamAna| tA~ra samvandhe ye avagata Ache tAke jijJesa kare dekha|

yakhana tAderake vala haYaH sAjadAhavanata hao ‘rAhamAna’ era prati takhana tArA valeH rAhamAna AvAra ke? tumi kehake sAjadAha karate valalei ki AmarA tAke sAjadAha karava? ete tAdera vimukhatAi vRddhi pAYa| [sAjadAha]
kata mahAna tini, yini nabhomanDale sRSTi karechena tArakArAji evaM tAte sthApana karechena pradIpa o jyotirmaYa cA~da!
evaM yArA upadeza grahaNa karate o kRtajJa hate cAYa tAdera janya tinii sRSTi karechena rAta evaM dinake parasparera anugAmI rUpe|
‘rAhamAna’ era vAndA tArAi yArA namrabhAve calAphirA kare pRthivIte evaM tAderake yakhana ajJa lokerA samvodhana kare takhana tArA valeH sAlAma|
evaM tArA rAta ativAhita kare tAdera ravera uddeze sAjadAhavanata haYe o danDAYamAna theke|
evaM tArA valeH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera hate jAhAnnAmera zAsti vidUrita karuna; ora zAstito nizcita vinAza|
nizcaYai AzraYasthala o vasati hisAve oTA kata nikRSTa!
Ara yakhana tArA vyaYa kare takhana tArA apavyaYa karenA evaM kArpanyao karenA; varaM tArA Ache etadubhaYera mAjhe madhyama panthAYa|
evaM tArA AllAhara sAthe kona upAsyake DAkenA; AllAha yAra hatyA niSiddha karechena, yathArtha kAraNa chAr3A tAke tArA hatyA karenA evaM vyabhicAra karenA; ye eguli kare se zAsti bhoga karave|
kiYAmAta divase tAra zAsti dviguNa karA have evaM sekhAne se sthAYI have hIna avasthAYa|
tArA naYa - yArA tAovAha kare, ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare; AllAha tAdera pApa parivartana kare divena uttama Amalera dvArA; AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
ye vyakti tAovAha kare o sat kAja kare se sampUrNa rUpe AllAhara abhimukhI haYa|
Ara yArA mithyA sAkSya deYanA evaM yakhana tArA asAra kriYA-kalApera sammukhIna haYa takhana svIYa maryAdAra sAthe tA parihAra kare cale –
evaM yArA tAdera ravera AYAta smaraNa kariYe dile ora prati andha evaM vadhira sadRza AcaraNa karenA –
Ara yArA prArthanA kareH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera janya emana strI o santAna-santati dAna karuna yArA AmAdera janya naYana prItikara evaM AmAderake muttAkIdera janya Adarza svarUpa karuna|
tAderake pratidAna svarUpa deYA have jAnnAta, yehetu tArA dhairyazIla| tAderake sekhAne abhyarthanA karA have abhivAdana o sAlAma sahakAre|
sekhAne tArA cirakAla vasavAsa karave, kata uttama sekhAne avasthAna o AvAsasthala!
valaH tomarA AmAra rAvvake nA DAkale tA~ra kichui Ase yAYanA| tomarA asvIkAra karecha, phale acirei neme Asave aparihArya zAsti|
tA’ sIna mIma|
eguli suspaSTa kitAvera AYAta|
tArA mu’mina hacchenA vale tumi haYata manakaSTe AtmavinAzI haYe par3ave|
Ami icchA karale AkAza hate tAdera nikaTa eka nidarzana preraNa karatAma, phale tAdera grIvA vinata haYe par3ata ora prati|
yakhanai tAdera kAche daYAmaYera nikaTa hate kona natuna upadeza Ase takhanai tArA tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa|
tArAto mithyA jeneche, sutarAM tArA yA niYe ThATTA vidrupa karata tAra prakRta vArtA tAdera nikaTa zIghrai ese par3ave|
tArA ki pRthivIra dike dRSTipAta karenA? Ami tAte pratyeka prakArera kata utkRSTa jinisa udagata karechi|
nizcaYai tAte Ache nidarzana, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mu’mina naYa|
tomAra rAvva, tinito parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
smaraNa kara, yakhana tomAra rAvva mUsAke Deke valalenaH tumi yAlima sampradAYera nikaTa cale yAo –
phira‘Aunera sampradAYera nikaTa; tArA ki bhaYa karenA?
takhana se valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! Ami AzaMkA kari ye, tArA AmAke asvIkAra karave|
evaM AmAra hRdaYa saMkucita haYe par3ache, Ara AmAra jihavAto sAvalIla naYa, sutarAM hArunera pratio pratyAdeza pAThAna|

ataeva tomarA ubhaYe phira‘Aunera nikaTa yAo evaM valaH AmarA jagatasamUhera ravera rAsUla|

phira‘Auna valalaH AmarA ki tomAke zaizave AmAdera madhye lAlana pAlana karini? evaM tumito tomAra jIvanera vahu vachara AmAdera madhye kATiYecha|
tumito tomAra kAja yA karAra tA karecha; tumi akRtajJa|
mUsA valalaH Amito eTA karechilAma takhana yakhana Ami ajJa chilAma|
ataHpara Ami yakhana tomAdera bhaYe bhIta halAma takhana Ami tomAdera nikaTa hate pAliYe giYechilAma; ataHpara AmAra rAvva AmAke jJAna dAna karechena evaM AmAke rAsUla karechena|
Ara AmAra prati tomAra ye anugrahera kathA ullekha karecha tAto ei ye, tumi vAnI isarAIlake dAse pariNata karecha|
phira‘Auna valalaH jagatasamUhera rAvva AvAra ki?
mUsA valalaH tini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera madhyavartI sava kichura rAvva, yadi tomarA nizcita vizvAsI hao|
phira‘Auna tAra pariSadavargake lakSya kare valalaH tomarA zunecha to!

phira‘Auna valalaH tumi yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale tA upasthita kara|
ataHpara mUsA tAra lAThi nikSepa karale tatkSaNAt tA eka suspaSTa ajagara hala|
Ara mUsA hAta vera karala, tatkSaNAt tA darzakadera dRSTite zubhra ujjvala pratibhAta hala|

e tomAderake tomAdera deza hate tAra yAduvale vahiskAra karate cAYa! ekhana tomarA ki karate vala?
tArA valalaH tAke o tAra bhAike kiJcit avakAza dAo evaM nagare saMgrAhakaderake pAThAo –
yena tArA tomAra nikaTa pratiTi sudakSa yAdukara upasthita kare|
ataHpara eka nirdhArita dine nirdiSTa samaYe yAdukaraderake ekatrita karA hala|
Ara lokaderake valA halaH tomarAo samaveta haccha ki?
yena AmarA yAdukaradera anusaraNa karate pAri, yadi tArA vijaYI haYa|
ataHpara yAdukararA ese phira‘Aunake valalaH AmarA yadi vijaYI hai tAhale AmAdera janya puraskAra thAkave to?
phira‘Auna valalaH hyA~, takhana tomarA avazyai AmAra nikaTajanadera antarbhukta have|
mUsA tAderake valalaH tomAdera yA nikSepa karAra tA nikSepa kara|
ataHpara tArA tAdera rajju o lAThi nikSepa karala evaM tArA valalaH phira‘Aunera zapatha! AmarAi vijaYI hava|
ataHpara mUsA tAra lAThi nikSepa karala; sahasA oTA tAdera alIka sRSTigulike grAsa karate lAgala|
takhana yAdukarerA sAjadAhavanata haYe par3ala|
tArA valalaH AmarA ImAna AnalAma jagatasamUhera ravera prati –
yini mUsA o hArunerao rAvva|

tArA valalaH kona kSati nei, AmarA AmAdera ravera nikaTa pratyAvartana karava|

Ami mUsAra prati ahI karechilAma ei marmeH AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAte vahirgata hao; tomAderato pazcAddhAvana karA have|
ataHpara phira‘Auna zahare zahare loka saMgrahakArI pAThAla –
ei valeH erAto kSudra ekaTi dala|
evaM tArA AmAdera krodhera sRSTi kareche|
evaM AmarAto sadA satarka ekaTi dala|
pariNAme Ami phira‘Auna goSThike vahiskRta karalAma tAdera udyAnarAji o prasravaNa hate|
evaM dhana bhAnDAra o suramya saudhamAlA hate|
erUpai ghaTechila evaM vAnI isarAIlake Ami karechilAma e samudaYera adhikArI|
tArA sUryodaYa kAle tAdera pazcAte ese par3ala|
ataHpara yakhana du’ dala parasparake dekhala takhana mUsAra saGgIrA valalaH AmarAto dharA par3e yAcchi!

ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai mu’mina naYa|

pUrvavartI kitAvasamUhe avazyai era ullekha raYeche|
vAnI isarAIlera panDitarA eTA avagata Ache, eTA ki tAdera janya nidarzana naYa?
Ami yadi ihA kona AjamIra (bhinna bhASI) prati avatIrNa karatAma –
evaM oTA se tAdera nikaTa pATha karata, tAhale tArA tAte ImAna AnatanA|
ebhAvei Ami pApIdera antare avizvAsa saJcAra karechi|
tArA ete ImAna AnavenA yatakSaNa nA tArA marmantada zAsti pratyakSa kare|
ataHpara eTA tAdera nikaTa ese par3ave AkasmikabhAve, tArA kichui vujhate pAravenA|
takhana tArA valaveH AmAderake ki avakAza deYA have?
tArA ki tAhale AmAra zAsti tvarAnvita karate cAYa?
tumi cintA kare dekha, yadi Ami tAderake dIrghakAla bhoga-vilAsa karate dii,
ataHpara tAderake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYechila tA tAdera nikaTa ese par3e –
takhana tAdera bhoga-vilAsera upakaraNa tAdera kona kAje Asave ki?
Ami emana kona janapada dhvaMsa karini yAra janya satarkakArI chilanA|
eTA upadeza svarUpa, Ara Ami atyAcArI nai|
zAitAnarA ihAsaha avatIrNa haYani|
tArA e kAjera yogya naYa evaM tArA era sAmarthyao rAkhenA|
tAderake zravaNera suyoga hate dUre rAkhA haYeche|
ataeva tumi anya kona mA‘vUdake AllAhara sAthe DekonA, tAhale tumi zAsti prAptadera antarbhukta have|
tomAra nikaTatama AtmIYavargake satarka kare dAo|
evaM yArA tomAra anusaraNa kare, sei sava mu’minera prati vinaYI hao|
tArA yadi tomAra avAdhyatA kare tAhale tumi valaH tomarA yA kara tAra janya Ami dAYI nai|
tumi nirbhara kara parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu AllAhara upara|
yini tomAke dekhena yakhana tumi danDAYamAna hao (sAlAtera janya)|
evaM dekhena sAjadAhakArIdera sAthe tomAra uThA vasA|
tinito sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
tomAderake ki jAnAva, kAra nikaTa zAitAnarA avatIrNa haYa?
tArAto avatIrNa haYa pratyeka carama mithyAvAdI o pApIra nikaTa|
tArA kAna pete thAke evaM tAdera adhikAMzai mithyAvAdI|
evaM kavidera anusaraNa kare tArA, yArA vibhrAnta|
tumi ki dekhanA, tArA vibhrAnta haYe pratyeka upatyakAYa ghure ver3AYa?
evaM yA tArA karenA, tA vale|
kintu tArA vyatIta, yArA ImAna Ane o satkArya kare evaM AllAhake vAra vAra smaraNa kare o atyAcArita havAra para pratizodha grahaNa kare| atyAcArIrA zIghrai jAnave tAdera gantavyasthala kothAYa?
tA sIna; eguli AYAta Ala-kuraAnera evaM suspaSTa kitAvera|
patha nirdeza o susaMvAda mu’minadera janya|
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare o yAkAta pradAna kare evaM yArA AkhirAte nizcita vizvAsI|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa karenA tAdera dRSTite tAdera kAjake Ami zobhana karechi, phale tArA vibhrAntite ghure ver3AYa|
ederai janya raYeche kaThina zAsti evaM erAi AkhirAte sarvAdhika kSatigrasta|
nizcaYai tomAke Ala kuraAna deYA haYeche prajJAmaYa, sarvajJera nikaTa hate|

smaraNa kara sei samaYera kathA, yakhana mUsA tAra parivAravargake valechilaH Ami Aguna dekhechi, sattvara Ami sekhAna hate tomAdera janya kona khavara Anava athavA tomAdera janya Anava jvalanta aGgAra, yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|
ataHpara se yakhana ora nikaTa elo takhana ghoSita halaH dhanya sei vyakti ye Ache ei Agunera madhye evaM yArA Ache ora catuspArzve| jagatasamUhera rAvva AllAha pavitra o mahimAnvita|
he mUsA! Amito AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tumi tomAra lAThi nikSepa kara, ataHpara yakhana se oTAke sarpera nyAYa chuTAchuTi karate dekhala takhana se pichanera dike chuTate lAgala evaM phireo tAkAlanA| valA halaH he mUsA! bhIta haYonA, nizcaYai Ami emana, AmAra sAnnidhye rAsUlagaNa bhaYa pAYanA|
tave yArA yul‌ma karAra para manda kAjera parivarte sat kAja kare tAdera prati Ami kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomAra hAta tomAra vakSapArzve vastrera madhye praveza karAo| eTA vera haYe Asave zubhra nirdoSa haYe; eTA phira‘Auna o tAra sampradAYera nikaTa AnIta naYaTi nidarzanera antargata; tArAto satyatyAgI sampradAYa|
ataHpara yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra spaSTa AYAta elo takhana tArA valalaH eTAto suspaSTa yAdu|
tArA anyAYa o uddhatabhAve nidarzanaguli pratyAkhyAna karala, yadio tAdera antara aigulike satya vale grahaNa karechila| dekha, viparyaYa sRSTikArIdera pariNAma ki haYechila!
Ami avazyai dAudake o sulAimAnake jJAna dAna karechilAma evaM tArA valechilaH prazaMsA AllAhara yini AmAderake tA~ra vahu mu’mina vAndAdera upara zreSThatva dAna karechena|
sulAimAna haYechila dAudera uttarAdhikArI evaM se valechilaH he loka sakala! AmAke pakSIkulera bhASA zikSA deYA haYeche evaM AmAke sava kichu hate pradAna karA haYeche; eTA avazyai suspaSTa anugraha|
sulAimAnera sAmane samaveta karA hala tAra vAhinIke, jina, mAnuSa o pakSIkulake evaM tAderake vinyasta karA hala vibhinna vuhye|

yakhana tArA pipIlikA adhyuSita upatyakAYa pau~chala takhana eka pipIlikA valalaH he pipIlikA vAhinI! tomarA tomAdera gRhe praveza kara, yena sulAimAna evaM tAra vAhinI tAdera ajJAtasAre tomAderake padatale piSe nA phele|

sulAimAna ora uktite mRdu hAsya karala evaM valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani AmAke sAmarthya dina yAte Ami ApanAra prati kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAri, AmAra prati o AmAra mAtA-pitAra prati Apani ye anugraha karechena tajjanya evaM yAte Ami sat kAja karate pAri, yA Apani pachanda karena evaM ApanAra anugrahe AmAke ApanAra satkarmaparAYaNa vAndAdera zreNIbhukta karuna|
sulAimAna pakSIkulera sandhAna nila evaM valalaH vyApAra ki, hudahudake dekhachinA ye! se anupasthita nA ki?
se upayukta kAraNa darzAte nA pArale Ami avazyai tAke kaThina zAsti diva athavA yavAha karava|
anati vilamve hudahuda ese par3ala evaM valalaH Apani yA avagata nana Ami tA avagata haYechi evaM ‘sAvA’ hate sunizcita saMvAda niYe esechi|
Ami eka nArIke dekhalAma ye tAdera upara rAjatva karache; tAke sava kichu deYA haYeche evaM tAra Ache eka virATa siMhAsana|

Ami tAke o tAra sampradAYake dekhalAma, tArA AllAhara parivarte sUryake sAjadAha karache; zAitAna tAdera kAryAvalI tAdera nikaTa zobhana kareche evaM tAderake sat patha hate nivRtta kareche; phale tArA sat patha prApta haYanA –
tArA nivRtta raYeche AllAhake sAjadAha karA hate, yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra lukAYita vastuke prakAza karena, evaM yini jAnena yA tomarA gopana kara evaM yA tomarA prakAza kara|
AllAha, tini chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei| tini mahAArazera adhipati| [sAjadAha]
sulAimAna valalaH Ami dekhava, tumi satya valecha, nA ki tumi mithyAvAdI?
tumi yAo AmAra ei patra niYe evaM eTA tAdera nikaTa arpana kara; ataHpara tAdera nikaTa hate dUre sare theka evaM lakSya kara tAdera pratikriYA ki?
sei nArI valalaH he pariSadavarga! AmAke eka sammAnita patra deYA haYeche|
ihA sulAimAnera nikaTa hate evaM ihA daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu AllAhara nAme|
ahamikA vaze AmAke amAnya karanA, evaM Anugatya svIkAra kare AmAra nikaTa upasthita hao|
sei nArI valalaH he pariSadavarga! AmAra ei samasyAYa tomAdera abhimata dAo; Ami yA siddhAnta nii tAto tomAdera upasthititei nii|
tArA valalaH AmarAto zaktizAlI o kaThora yoddhA; tave siddhAnta grahaNera kSamatA ApanArai| ki Adeza karavena tA Apani bheve dekhuna|
se valalaH rAjA-vAdazAharA yakhana kona janapade praveza kare takhana oke viparyasta kare deYa evaM sekhAnakAra maryAdAvAna vyaktiderake apadastha kare; erAo e rUpai karave|
Ami tAdera nikaTa upaDhaukana pAThAcchi, dekhi dUterA ki vArtA niYe phire Ase!

ataHpara yakhana dUta sulAimAnera nikaTa elo takhana sulAimAna valalaH tomarA AmAke dhana-sampada diYe ki sAhAyya karave? AllAha AmAke yA diYechena tA tomAderake yA diYechena tA hate utkRSTa| athaca tomarA tomAdera upaDhaukana niYe Ananda vodha karacha|

tAdera nikaTa phire yAo, Ami avazyai tAdera viruddhe niYe Asava eka sainyavAhinI yAra mukAvilA karAra zakti tAdera nei| Ami avazyai tAderake sekhAna hate vahiskAra karava lAJchitabhAve evaM tArA have apamAnita|
sulAimAna Arao valalaH he AmAra pariSadavarga! tArA AmAra nikaTa ese Atmasamarpana karAra pUrve tomAdera madhye ke tAra siMhAsana AmAra nikaTa niYe Asave?
eka zaktizAlI jina valalaH Apani ApanAra sthAna hate uThAra pUrve Ami oTA ApanAra nikaTa ene diva evaM e vyApAre Ami avazyai kSamatAvAna, vizvasta|

kitAvera jJAna yAra chila se valalaH Apani cokhera palaka phelAra pUrvei Ami oTA ApanAke ene diva| sulAimAna yakhana oTA sAmane rakSita avasthAYa dekhala takhana se valalaH eTA AmAra ravera anugraha yAte tini AmAke parIkSA karate pArena ye, Ami kRtajJa nA akRtajJa; ye kRtajJatA prakAza kare se tA kare tAra nijera kalyANera janya evaM ye akRtajJa haYa se jene rAkhuka ye, AmAra rAvva abhAvamukta, mahAnubhava|
sulAimAna valalaH tAra siMhAsanera AkRti vadale dAo; dekhi se saThika dizA pAYa, nA ki se vibhrAntera antarbhukta haYa|
ai nArI yakhana elo, takhana tAke jijJesa karA halaH tomAra siMhAsana ki eirUpai? se valalaH eTAto yena oTAi; AmAderake itopUrvei prakRta jJAna dAna karA haYeche evaM AmarA Atmasamarpanao karechi|
AllAhara parivarte se yAra pUjA karata tA’i tAke satya hate nivRta karechila, se chila kAphira sampradAYera antarbhukta|

tAke valA halaH ei prAsAde praveza kara| yakhana se oTA dekhala takhana se oTAke eka gabhIra jalAzaYa mane karala evaM se tAra ubhaYa pAYera gochA anAvRta karala| sulAimAna valalaH svaccha sphaTika manDita prAsAda| sei nArI valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Amito nijera prati yul‌ma karechilAma, Ami sulAimAnera sAthe jagatasamUhera rAvva AllAhara nikaTa Atmasamarpana karachi|
Ami chAmUda sampradAYera nikaTa tAdera bhAi sAlihake pAThiYechilAma ei marme ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara| kintu tArA dvidhA vibhakta haYe vitarke lipta hala|
se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA kena kalyANera pUrve akalyANa tvarAnvita karate cAccha? kena tomarA AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karachanA, yAte tomarA anugraha bhAjana hate pAra?

tArA valalaH tomAke o tomAra saGge yArA Ache tAderake AmarA amaGgalera kAraNa mane kari| sAliha valalaH tomAdera zubhAzubha AllAhara ekhatiYAre, vastutaH tomarA emana eka sampradAYa yAderake parIkSA karA hacche|
Ara sei zahare chila emana naYa vyakti yArA deze viparyaYa sRSTi karata evaM sat kAja karatanA|

tArA valalaH tomarA AllAhara nAme zapatha grahaNa kara; AmarA rAte tAke o tAra parivAra parijanake avazyai AkramaNa karava, ataHpara tAra abhibhAvakake nizcita valavaH tAra parivAra parijanera hatyA AmarA pratyakSa karini; AmarA avazyai satyavAdI|
tArA eka cakrAnta karechila evaM Amio eka kauzala avalamvana karalAma, kintu tArA vujhate pAreni|
ataeva dekha, tAdera cakrAntera pariNAma ki haYeche| Ami avazyai tAderake o tAdera sampradAYera sakalake dhvaMsa karechi|
eito tAdera gharavAr3I sImA laMghana hetu yA janazUnya avasthAYa par3e Ache; ete jJAnI sampradAYera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
evaM yArA mu’mina o muttAkI chila tAderake Ami uddhAra karechi|
smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, se tAra sampradAYake valechilaH tomarA jene zune kena azlIla kAja karacha?
tomarA ki kAma-tRptira janya nArIke cher3e puruSe upagata have? tomarAto eka ajJa sampradAYa|
uttare tAra sampradAYa zudhu valalaH lUta parivArake tomAdera janapada hate vahiskAra kara, erAto emana loka yArA ati pavitra sAjate cAYa|
ataHpara tAke o tAra parijanavargake Ami uddhAra karalAma, tAra strI vyatIta, tAke karechilAma dhvaMsaprAptadera antarbhukta|
tAdera upara bhaYaGkara vRSTi varSaNa karechilAma; yAderake bhIti pradarzana karA haYechila tAdera janya ei varSaNa chila kata mArAtmaka|
valaH prazaMsA AllAhai evaM zAnti tA~ra manonIta vAndAdera prati| zreSTha ki AllAha, nAki tArA yAderake zarIka karA haYa?

varaM tini sRSTi karechena AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM AkAza hate tomAdera janya varSaNa karena vRSTi; ataHpara Ami oTA dvArA manorama udyAna sRSTi kari| ora vRkSAdi udgata karAra kSamatA tomAdera nei| AllAhara sAthe anya kona mA‘vUda Ache ki? tavuo tArA emana eka sampradAYa yArA satya hate vicyuta|

valata, ke pRthivIke karechena vAsopayogI evaM ora mAjhe mAjhe pravAhita karechena nada-nadI evaM tAke sthira rAkhAra janya sthApana karechena sudRr3ha parvata o dui samudrera madhye sRSTi karechena antarAYa; AllAhara sAthe anya kona mA‘vUda Ache ki? tavuo tAdera anekei jAnenA|

ke Artera AhavAne sAr3A dena, yakhana se tA~ke DAke evaM vipada-Apada dUra karena evaM tomAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karena? AllAhara sAthe anya kona mA‘vUda Ache ki? tomarA upadeza ati sAmAnyai grahaNa kare thAko|

ke tomAderake sthalera o pAnira andhakAre patha pradarzana karena evaM ke svIYa anugrahera prAkkAle susaMvAdavAhI vAYu preraNa karena? AllAhara sAthe anya kona mA‘vUda Ache ki? tArA yAke zarIka kare AllAha tA hate vahu urdhve|

valata, ke Adite sRSTi karena, ataHpara ora punarAvRtti karavena, evaM ke tomAderake AkAza o pRthivI hate jIvanopakaraNa dAna karena? AllAhara sAthe anya kona mA‘vUda Ache ki? valaH tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale tomAdera pramANa peza kara|
valaH AllAha vyatIta AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte kehai adRzya viSaYera jJAna rAkhenA evaM tArA jAnenA tArA kakhana punarutthita have|
varaM AkhirAta samparke tAdera jJAna niHzeSa haYeche; tArAto e viSaYe sandehera madhye raYeche, varaM e viSaYe tArA andha|
kAphirerA valeH AmarA o AmAdera pitR-puruSarA mATite pariNata haYe geleo ki AmAdera punarutthita karA have?
e viSaYeto AmAderake evaM pUrva-puruSaderake bhIti pradarzana karA haYechila| eTAto pUrvavartI upakathA vyatIta Ara kichui naYa|
valaH pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM dekha aparAdhIdera pariNAma kirUpa haYeche|
tAdera samparke tumi duHkha karanA evaM tAdera Sar3ayantre manaHkSunna haYonA|
tArA valeH tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, kakhana ei pratizruti pUrNa have?
valaH tomarA ye viSaYe tvarAnvita karate cAccha sambhavataH tAra kichu tomAdera nikaTavartI haYeche|
nizcaYai tomAra rAvva mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai akRtajJa|
tAdera antara yA gopana kare evaM tArA yA prakAza kare tA tomAra rAvva avazyai jAnena|
AkAze o pRthivIte emana kona gopana rahasya nei yA suspaSTa kitAve nei|
vAnI isarAIla ye samasta viSaYe matabheda kare, ei kuraAna tAra adhikAMza tAdera nikaTa vivRta kare|
Ara nizcaYai eTi mu’minadera janya hidAYAta o rAhamAta|
tomAra rAvva nija siddhAnta anuyAYI tAdera madhye phAisAlA kare divena| tini parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa|
ataeva AllAhara upara nirbhara kara; tumito spaSTa satye pratiSThita|
mRtake tumi kathA zonAte pAravenA, vadhirakeo pAravenA AhavAna zonAte, yakhana tArA pichana phire cale yAYa|
tumi andhaderake tAdera pathabhraSTatA hate pathe Anate pArave nA| tumi zonAte pArave zudhu tAderake yArA vizvAsa kare| Ara tArAi AtmasamarpanakArI (musalima)|
yakhana ghoSita zAsti tAdera upara ese yAve takhana Ami mATira gahavara hate vera karava eka jIva, yA tAdera sAthe kathA valave; e janya ye, mAnuSa AmAra nidarzane avizvAsI|
smaraNa kara sei dinera kathA yedina Ami samaveta karava pratyeka sampradAYa hate eka ekaTi dalake, yArA AmAra nirdezAvalI pratyAkhyAna karata evaM tAderake sArivaddha karA have|
yakhana tArA samaveta have takhana (AllAha tAderake) valavenaH tomarA AmAra nidarzana pratyAkhyAna karechile, athaca oTA tomarA jJAnAYatta karate pArani? nA tomarA anya kichu karachile?
sImA laMghana hetu tAdera upara ghoSita zAsti ese par3ave; phale tArA kichui valate pAravenA|
tArA ki anudhAvana karenA ye, Ami rAta sRSTi karechi tAdera vizrAmera janya evaM dinake karechi Alokaprada? ete mu’mina sampradAYera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
Ara yedina ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have sedina AllAha yAderake cAna tArA vyatIta AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra savAi bhIta-vihavala haYe par3ave evaM savAi tA~ra nikaTa Asave vinIta avasthAYa|

tumi parvatamAlA dekhe acala mane karacha, athaca sedina oguli have meghapuJjera nyAYa calamAna, eTA AllAharai sRSTi-naipuNya, yini sava kichuke karechena suSama| tomarA yA kara sei samvandhe tini samyaka avagata|
ye keha sat kAja niYe Asave, se utkRSTatara pratiphala pAve evaM sedina tArA zaMkA hate nirApada thAkave|
Ara ye keha asat kAja niYe Asave, tAke adhomukhe nikSepa karA have Agune (evaM tAderake valA have) tomarA yA karate tArai pratiphala tomAderake deYA hacche|
Amito AdiSTa haYechi ei nagarIra ravera ivAdAta karate, yini eke karechena sammAnita| sava kichu tA~rai| Ami Arao AdiSTa haYechi yena Ami AtmasamarpanakArIdera antarbhukta hai|

Ami Arao AdiSTa haYechi kuraAna AvRtti karate| ataHpara ye vyakti sat patha anusaraNa kare, se tA anusaraNa kare nijerai kalyANera janya evaM keha bhrAnta patha avalamvana karale tumi valaH Amito zudhu sartakakArIdera madhye ekajana|
Ara valaH prazaMsA AllAharai, tini tomAderake sattvara dekhAvena tA~ra nidarzana, takhana tomarA tA vujhate pArave| tomarA yA kara se samvandhe tomAdera rAvva gAphila nana|
tA-sIna-mIma|
ei AYAtaguli suspaSTa kitAvera|
Ami tomAra nikaTa mUsA o phira‘Aunera kichu vRttAnta yathAyathabhAve vivRta karachi, mu’mina sampradAYera uddeze|

nizcaYai phira‘Auna tAra deze parAkramazAlI haYechila evaM sekhAnakAra adhivAsIvRndake vibhinna zreNIte vibhakta kare tAdera ekaTi zreNIke se hInavala karechila, tAdera putraderake se hatyA karata evaM nArIderake se jIvita rAkhata| seto chila viparyaYa sRSTikArI|
Ami icchA karalAma, se deze yAderake hInavala karA haYechila tAdera prati anugraha karate; tAderake netRtva dAna karate o dezera adhikArI karate,
Ara tAderake dezera kSamatAYa pratiSThita karate; evaM phira‘Auna, hAmAna o tAdera vAhinIke tA dekhiYe dite yA tAdera nikaTa theke tArA AzaMkA karata|

Ami mUsAra mAYera antare iMgite nirdeza karalAmaH zizuTike tumi stanya dAna karate thAka; yakhana tumi tAra samparke kona AzaMkA karave takhana tAke dariYAYa nikSepa kara evaM bhaYa karanA, duHkha karanA; Ami tAke tomAra nikaTa phiriYe diva evaM tAke rAsUladera ekajana karava|
ataHpara phira‘Aunera lokajana tAke kur3iYe nila| era pariNAmato ei chila ye, se tAdera zatru o duHkhera kAraNa have| phira‘Auna, hAmAna o tAdera vAhinI chila aparAdhI|

phira‘Aunera strI valalaH ei zizu AmAra o tomAra naYana prItikara| tAke hatyA karanA, se AmAdera upakAre Asate pAre, AmarA tAke santAna hisAveo grahaNa karate pAri| prakRta pakSe tArA era pariNAma vujhate pAreni|
mUsA-jananIra hRdaYa asthira haYe par3echila; yAte se AsthAzIla haYa tajjanya Ami tAra hRdaYake dRr3ha kare nA dile se tAra paricaYato prakAza karei dita|
se mUsAra vonake valalaH era pichane pichane yAo, se tAdera ajJAtasAre dUra hate tAke dekhachila|

pUrva hatei Ami dhAtrIstanya pAne tAke virata rekhechilAma| mUsAra vona valalaH tomAderake ki Ami emana eka parivArera sandhAna diva yArA tomAdera haYe eke lAlana pAlana karave evaM era maGgalakAmI have?
ataHpara Ami tAke phiriYe dilAma tAra jananIra nikaTa yAte tAra cakSu jur3AYa, se duHkha nA kare evaM vujhate pAre ye, AllAhara pratizruti satya; kintu adhikAMza mAnuSai eTA jAnenA|
yakhana mUsA pUrNa yauvane upanIta o pariNata vaYaska hala takhana Ami tAke hikamAta o jJAna dAna karalAma| ebhAve Ami satkarmaparAYaNaderake puraskAra pradAna kare thAki|

se nagarIte praveza karala, yakhana era adhivAsIrA chila asatarka| sekhAne se du’Ti lokake saMgharSe lipta dekhala - ekajana tAra nija dalera evaM apara jana tAra zatru dalera| mUsAra dalera lokaTi tAra zatrura viruddhe tAra sAhAyya prArthanA karala| takhana mUsA tAke ghuSi mArala, etei tAra mRtyu hala| mUsA valalaH eTA zAitAnera kAnDa, seto prakAzya zatru o pathabhraSTakArI|
se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Amito AmAra nijera prati yulama karechi; sutarAM AmAke kSamA karuna! ataHpara tini tAke kSamA karalena| tinito kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
se Arao valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani yehetu AmAra upara anugraha karechena, Ami kakhanao aparAdhIdera sAhAyyakArI havanA|

ataHpara bhIta satarka avasthAYa sei nagarIte tAra prabhAta hala| haThAt se zunate pelo, pUrvadina ye vyakti tAra sAhAyya ceYechila se tAra sAhAyyera janya cItkAra karache| mUsA tAke valalaH tumito suspaSTai ekajana vibhrAnta vyakti|

ataHpara mUsA yakhana ubhaYera zatruke dharate udyata hala takhana sei vyakti vale uThalaH he mUsA! gatakalya tumi yemana eka vyaktike hatyA karecha sebhAve AmAkeo ki hatyA karate cAccha? tumito pRthivIte svecchAcArI hate cAccha, zAnti sthApanakArI hate cAonA?
nagarIra dUra prAnta hate eka vyakti chuTe elo evaM valalaH he mUsA! pariSadavarga tomAke hatyA karAra parAmarza kareche| sutarAM tumi vAire cale yAo, Amito tomAra maGgalakAmI|
bhIta satarka avasthAYa se sekhAna hate vera haYe par3ala evaM valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani yAlima sampradAYa hate AmAke rakSA karuna|
yakhana mUsA mAdaiYAna abhimukhe yAtrA zuru karala takhana valalaH AzA kari, AmAra rAvva AmAke sarala patha pradarzana karavena|

yakhana se mAdaiYAnera kUpera nikaTa pau~chala takhana dekhala ye, ekadala loka tAdera pazugulike pAni pAna karAcche evaM tAdera pazcAte du’jana nArI tAdera pazugulike AgalAcche| mUsA valalaH tomAdera ki vyApAra? tArA valalaH AmarA AmAdera pazugulike pAni pAna karAte pArinA, yatakSaNa rAkhAlarA tAdera pazugulike niYe sare nA yAYa, AmAdera pitA ati vRddha|
mUsA takhana tAdera pazugulike pAni pAna karAlo| ataHpara se chAYAra nIce AzraYa grahaNa karala o valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani AmAra prati ye anugraha karavena Ami tAra kAGgAla|

takhana nArIdvaYera ekajana lajjA jar3ita caraNe tAra nikaTa elo evaM valalaH AmAra pitA ApanAke AmantraNa karechena, AmAdera pazugulike pAni pAna karAnora pArizramika ApanAke deYAra janya| ataHpara mUsA tAra nikaTa ese samasta vRttAnta varNanA karale se valalaH bhaYa karanA, tumi yAlima sampradAYera kavala hate ve~ce gecha|
tAdera ekajana valalaH he pitA! Apani eke majura niyukta karuna; kAraNa ApanAra majura hisAve uttama have sei vyakti ye zaktizAlI, vizvasta|

se mUsAke valalaH Ami AmAra ei kanyAdvaYera ekajanake tomAra sAthe viYe dite cAi ei zarte ye, tumi ATa vachara AmAra kAja karave, yadi tumi daza vachara pUrNa kara seTA tomAra icchA| Ami tomAke kaSTa dite cAinA| AllAha icchA karale tumi AmAke sadAcArI pAve|
mUsA valalaH ApanAra o AmAra madhye ei cuktii raila| e du’Ti meYAdera kona ekaTi Ami pUrNa karale AmAra viruddhe kona abhiyoga thAkavenA| AmarA ye viSaYe kathA valachi AllAha tAra svAkSI|

mUsA yakhana meYAda pUrNa karAra para svaparivAre yAtrA zuru karala takhana se tUra parvatera dike Aguna dekhate pela| se tAra parijanavargake valalaH tomarA apekSA kara, Ami Aguna dekhechi, sambhavataH Ami sethA hate tomAdera janya khavara Anate pAri, athavA eka khanDa jvalanta kASTha Anate pAri yAte tomarA Aguna pohAte pAra|
yakhana mUsA Agunera nikaTa pau~chala takhana upatyakAra dakSiNa pAze pavitra bhUmisthita eka vRkSa hate tAke AhavAna kare valA halaH he mUsA! Amii AllAha, jagatasamUhera rAvva|

Arao valA halaH tumi tomAra lAThi nikSepa kara| ataHpara yakhana se oTAke sarpera nyAYa chuTAchuTi karate dekhala takhana pichanera dike chuTate lAgala evaM phire tAkAlonA| tAke valA halaH he mUsA! sAmane eso, bhaYa karanA, tumito nirApada|

tomAra hAta tomAra vagale rAkha, oTA vera haYe Asave zubhra samujjvala nirdoSa haYe| bhaYa dUra karAra janya tomAra hastadvaYa tomAra upara cepe dhara| e du’Ti tomAra rAvva pradatta pramANa, phira‘Auna o tAra pariSadavargera janya| tArAto satyatyAgI sampradAYa|
mUsA valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Amito tAdera ekajanake hatyA karechi| phale Ami AzaMkA karachi ye, tArA AmAke hatyA karave|
AmAra bhAi hArUna AmA apekSA vAgmI; ataeva tAke AmAra sAhAyyakArI rUpe preraNa karuna, se AmAke samarthana karave| Ami AzaMkA kari ye, tArA AmAke mithyAvAdI valave|

(AllAha) valalenaH Ami tomAra bhAiYera dvArA tomAra vAhu zaktizAlI karava evaM tomAdera ubhaYake prAdhAnya dAna karava| tArA tomAdera kAche pau~chate pAravenA| tomarA evaM tomAdera anusArIrA AmAra nidarzana vale tAdera upara pravala have|
mUsA yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa nidarzanaguli niYe elo takhana tArA valalaH eTAto alIka indrajAla mAtra! AmAdera pUrva-puruSadera kAche AmarA kakhanao erUpa kathA zunini|
mUsA valalaH AmAra rAvva samyaka avagata, ke tA~ra nikaTa hate patha nirdeza niYe eseche, evaM AkhirAte kAra pariNAma zubha have| nizcaYai yAlimarA saphalakAma havenA|

phira‘Auna valalaH he pariSadavarga! Ami chAr3A tomAdera anya upAsya Ache vale Ami jAninA| he hAmAna! tumi AmAra janya iTa por3Ao evaM ekaTi suucca prAsAda tairI kara; haYato Ami tAte uThe mUsAra mA‘vUdake dekhate pAva| tave Ami avazya mane kari ye, se mithyAvAdI|
phira‘Auna o tAra vAhinI anyAYabhAve pRthivIte ahaMkAra karechila ye, tArA AmAra nikaTa pratyAvartita havenA|
ataeva Ami tAke o tAra vAhinIke pAkar3Ao karalAma evaM tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma| dekha, yAlimadera pariNAma ki haYe thAke|
tAderake Ami netA karechilAma| tArA lokaderake jAhAnnAmera dike AhavAna karata| kiYAmAta divase tAderake sAhAyya karA havenA|
ei pRthivIte Ami tAdera pazcAte lAgiYe diYechi abhisampAta evaM kiYAmAta divaseo tArA durdazAgrasta lokadera antarbhukta thAkave|
Amito pUrvavartI vahu mAnava goSThike vinAza karAra para mUsAke diYechilAma kitAva, mAnava jAtira janya jJAna-vartikA, patha nirdeza o daYA svarUpa, yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
mUsAke yakhana Ami vidhAna diYechilAma takhana tumi pazcima prAnte upasthita chilenA evaM tumi pratyakSadarzIo chilenA|

vastutaH Ami aneka mAnava goSThira AvirbhAva ghaTiYechilAma, ataHpara tAdera vahu yuga ativAhita haYeche| tumito mAdaiYAnavAsIdera madhye vidyamAna chilenA, tAdera nikaTa AmAra AYAta AvRtti karAra janya| Amii chilAma rAsUla preraNakArI|

mUsAke yakhana Ami AhavAna karechilAma takhana tumi tUra parvata-pArzve upasthita chilenA| vastutaH eTA tomAra ravera nikaTa hate daYA svarUpa yAte tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karate pAra yAdera nikaTa tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Aseni, yena tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|

rAsUla nA pAThAle tAdera kRtakarmera janya tAdera kona vipada hale tArA valataH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani AmAdera nikaTa kona rAsUla preraNa karalena nA kena? tAhale AmarA ApanAra nidarzana mene calatAma evaM AmarA hatAma mu’mina|

ataHpara yakhana AmAra nikaTa hate tAdera nikaTa satya ese gela, tArA valate lAgalaH mUsAke yerUpa deYA haYechila anurUpa tAke deYA halanA kena? kintu pUrve mUsAke yA deYA haYechila tA ki tArA asvIkAra kareni? tArA valechilaH ubhaYai yAdu, eke aparake samarthana kare; evaM tArA valechilaH AmarA pratyekake pratyAkhyAna kari|
valaH tomarA satyavAdI hale AllAhara nikaTa hate eka kitAva AnaYana kara, ye patha nirdeza etadubhaYa hate utkRSTatara have, Ami sei kitAva anusaraNa karava|

ataHpara tArA yadi tomAra AhavAne sAr3A nA deYa tAhale jAnave ye, tArA zudhu nijedera kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare| AllAhara patha-nirdeza agrAhya kare ye vyakti nija kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare se apekSA adhika vibhrAnta Ara ke? AllAha yAlima sampradAYake patha pradarzana karenanA|
Amito tAdera nikaTa uparyupari vANI pau~che diYechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
era pUrve Ami yAderake kitAva diYechilAma tArA ete vizvAsa kare|
yakhana tAdera nikaTa eTi AvRtti karA haYa takhana tArA valeH AmarA ete ImAna enechi, eTi AmAdera rAvva hate Agata satya| AmarAto pUrveo AtmasamarpanakArI chilAma|
tAderake du’vAra pArizramika pradAna karA have; kAraNa tArA dhairyazIla evaM tArA bhAla dvArA mandera mukAvilA kare evaM Ami tAderake yA diYechi tA hate tArA vyaYa kare|

tArA yakhana asAra vAkya zravaNa kare takhana tA upekSA kare cale evaM valeH AmAdera kAjera phala AmAdera janya evaM tomAdera kAjera phala tomAdera janya; tomAdera prati sAlAma| AmarA ajJadera saGga cAinA|
tumi yAke bhAlavAsa, icchA karalei tAke sat pathe Anate pAravenA| tave AllAha yAke icchA sat pathe Anena evaM tinii bhAla jAnena kArA sat patha anusaraNakArI|

tArA valeH AmarA yadi tomAra sAthe sat patha anusaraNa kari tAhale AmAderake deza hate utkhAta karA have| (AllAha valena) Ami ki tAdera janya eka nirApada ‘‘hArAma’’ pratiSThita karini, yekhAne sarva prakAra phalamUla AmadAnI haYa AmAra deYA riyka svarUpa? kintu tAdera adhikAMzai eTA jAnenA|

kata janapadake Ami dhvaMsa karechi yAra vAsindArA nijedera bhoga sampadera dambha karata| eguliito tAdera gharavAr3I, tAdera pare egulite lokajana sAmAnyai vasavAsa kareche; Ara Amito cUr3Anta mAlikAnAra adhikArI|

tomAra rAvva janapadasamUhake dhvaMsa karena nA, ora kendre tA~ra AYAta AvRtti karAra janya rAsUla preraNa nA karA paryanta evaM Ami janapadasamUhake takhanai dhvaMsa kari yakhana ora vAsindArA yul‌ma kare|
tomAdera yA kichu deYA haYeche tAto pArthiva jIvanera bhoga zobhA evaM yA AllAhara nikaTa raYeche tA uttama evaM sthAYI| tomarA ki anudhAvana karavenA?
yAke Ami uttama puraskArera pratizruti diYechi se yA pAve, se ki ai vyaktira samAna yAke Ami pArthiva jIvanera bhoga sambhAra diYechi, ataHpara yAke kiYAmAta divase aparAdhI rUpe hAyira karA have?
Ara sedina tini tAderake AhavAna kare valavenaH tomarA yAderake AmAra zarIka gaNya karate tArA kothAYa?

yAdera janya zAsti avadhArita haYeche tArA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! ederakeo AmarA vibhrAnta karechilAma, yemana AmarA vibhrAnta haYechilAma; ApanAra samIpe AmarA dAYitva hate avyAhati cAcchi| erA AmAdera ivAdAta karatanA|
tAderake valA haveH tomAdera devatAgulike AhavAna kara| takhana tArA tAderake DAkave| kintu tArA tAdera DAke sAr3A divenA| tArA zAsti pratyakSa karave; hAYa! tArA yadi sat patha anusaraNa karata!
Ara sedina (AllAha) tAderake Deke valavenaH tomarA rAsUladerake ki javAva diYechile?
sedina sakala tathya tAdera nikaTa hate vilupta have evaM tArA eke aparake jijJAsAvAda karate pAravenA|
tave ye vyakti tAovAha karechila evaM ImAna enechila o sat kAja karechila seto sAphalya arjanakArIdera antarbhukta have|
