tomAra rAvva yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM yAke icchA manonIta karena, ete tAdera kona kSamatA nei, AllAha pavitra mahAna evaM tArA yAke zarIka kare tA hate tini urdhve|
Ara tomAra rAvva jAnena tAdera antara yA gopana kare evaM tArA yA vyakta kare|
tinii AllAha, tini vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei; duniYA o AkhirAte prazaMsA tA~rai, vidhAna tA~rai AYatvAdhIna; tomarA tA~rai dike pratyAvartita have|

valaH tomarA ki bheve dekhecha, AllAha yadi rAtake kiYAmAtera dina paryanta sthAYI karena tAhale AllAha vyatIta emana kona ilAha Ache ki ye tomAderake Aloka dAna karate pAre? tomarA ki karNapAta karavenA?

valaH bheve dekha to, AllAha yadi dinake kiYAmAtera dina paryanta sthAYI karena tAhale AllAha vyatIta emana ilAha ke Ache ye tomAderake rAta dAna karate pAre, yAte tomarA vizrAma karave? tomarA ki tavuo bheve dekhavenA?
tinii tA~ra rAhamAtera dvArA tomAdera janya sRSTi karechena dina o rAta, yAte tomarA vizrAma grahaNa kara evaM tA~ra anugraha tAlAza kara, evaM yAte tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza kara|
sedina tini tAderake AhavAna kare valavenaH tomarA yAderake zarIka gaNya karate tArA kothAYa?

pratyeka sampradAYa hate Ami ekajana sAkSI AlAdA karava evaM valavaH tomAdera pramANa upasthita kara| takhana tArA jAnate pArave, mA‘vUda havAra adhikAra AllAharai evaM tArA yA udbhAvana karata tA tAdera nikaTa hate antarhita have|

kArUna chila mUsAra sampradAYabhukta, vastutaH se tAdera prati auddhatya prakAza karechila| Ami tAke dAna karechilAma emana dhanabhAnDAra yAra cAviguli vahana karA ekadala valavAna lokera pakSeo kaSTasAdhya chila| smaraNa kara, tAra sampradAYa tAke valechilaH dambha karanA, nizcaYai AllAha dAmbhikadera pachanda karenanA|

AllAha tomAke yA dAna karechena tadvArA AkhirAtera AvAsa anusandhAna kara| Ara duniYA hate tomAra aMza bhule yeonA; evaM paropakAra kara yemana AllAha tomAra prati anugraha karechena, Ara pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karate ceonA| nizcaYai AllAha viparyaYa sRSTikArIke bhAlavAsena nA |

se valalaH ei sampada Ami AmAra jJAna vale prApta haYechi| se ki jAnatonA ye, AllAha tAra pUrve dhvaMsa karechena vahu mAnava goSThike, yArA tAra ceYe zaktite chila pravala evaM chila adhika prAcuryazAlI? kintu aparAdhIderake tAdera aparAdha samparke tatkSaNAt prazna karA haYanA|

kArUna tAra sampradAYera sAmane upasthita haYechila jAkajamaka sahakAre| yArA pArthiva jIvana kAmanA karata tArA valalaH AhA! kArUnake yerUpa deYA haYeche AmAderake yadi tA deYA hata! prakRtai se mahA bhAgyavAna!
Ara yAderake jJAna deYA haYechila tArA valalaH dhik tomAderake! yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tAdera janya AllAhara puraskAra zreSTha evaM dhairyazIla vyatIta eTA keha pAvenA|
ataHpara Ami kArUnake o tAra prAsAdake bhUgarbhe prothita karalAma| tAra svapakSe emana kona dala chilanA ye AllAhara zAsti hate tAke sAhAyya karate pArata evaM se nijeo AtmarakSAYa sakSama chilanA|

pUrvadina yArA tAra avasthA kAmanA karechila tArA valate lAgalaH dekhaleto AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra janya icchA tAra riyka vardhita karena evaM yAra janya icchA hrAsa karena| yadi AllAha AmAdera prati sadaYa nA hatena tAhale AmAderakeo tini bhUgarbhe prothita karatena| dekhale to! kAphirerA saphalakAma haYanA|
eTA AkhirAtera sei AvAsa yA Ami nirdhArita kari tAdera janya yArA ei pRthivIte auddhatA prakAza karate o viparyaYa sRSTi karate cAYanA| zubha pariNAma muttAkIdera janya|
keha yadi sat kAja kare tAhale se tAra kAja apekSA uttama phala pAve, Ara ye manda kAja kare seto zAsti pAve zudhu tAra kAja anupAte|
yini tomAra janya kuraAnake karechena vidhAna tini tomAke avazyai phiriYe Anavena pratyAvartana sthAne| valaH AmAra rAvva bhAla jAnena ke sat pathera nirdeza eneche evaM ke spaSTa vibhrAntite Ache|
tumi AzA karani ye, tomAra prati kitAva avatIrNa have| eTAto zudhu tomAra ravera anugraha| sutarAM tumi kakhanao kAphiradera sAhAyyakArI haYonA|
tomAra prati AllAhara AYAta avatIrNa haoYAra para keha yena tomAke kichutei seguli hate virata nA rAkhe| tumi tomAra ravera dike AhavAna karate thAka evaM kichutei muzarikadera antarbhukta haYonA|
tumi AllAhara sAthe anya ilAhake DekanA, tini chAr3A anya kona ilAha nei| AllAhara sattA vyatIta sava kichu dhvaMsazIla| vidhAna tA~rai evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|
Alipha lAma mIma,
mAnuSa ki mane kareche ye, ‘AmarA ImAna enechi’ e kathA valalei tAderake avyAhati deYA have evaM tAderake parIkSA karA havenA?
Amito tAdera pUrvavartIderakeo parIkSA karechilAma; AllAha avazyai prakAza kare divena kArA satyavAdI o kArA mithyAvAdI|
yArA manda kAja kare tArA ki mane kare ye, tArA AmAra AYattera vAire cale yAve? tAdera siddhAnta kata manda!
ye AllAhara sAthe sAkSAt kAmanA kare se jene rAkhuka ye, AllAhara nirdhArita kAla Asavei| tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
ye keha (kaThora) sAdhanA kare, se tA kare nijerai janya; AllAhato vizvajagata hate anapekSa|
Ara yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, nizcaYai Ami tAdera manda karmaguli miTiYe diva evaM tAdera kAjera uttama phala dAna karava|

Ami mAnuSake nirdeza diYechi tAra mAtA-pitAra prati sadvyavahAra karate; kintu tArA yadi tomAra upara vala praYoga kare, AmAra sAthe emana kichu zarIka karate ye samparke tomAra kona jJAna nei tAhale tumi tAderake mAnya karanA| AmArai nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara Ami tomAderake jAniYe diva yA tomarA karate|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, Ami avazyai tAderake satkarmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta karava|

mAnuSera madhye kataka loka valeH ‘‘AmarA AllAhate vizvAsa kari|’’ kintu AllAhara pathe yakhana tArA kaSTe patita haYa takhana tArA mAnuSera pIr3anake AllAhara zAstira mata gaNya kare evaM tomAra ravera nikaTa hate kona sAhAyya ele tArA valate thAke, ‘AmarAto tomAdera sAthei chilAma’| vizvavAsIra antare yA Ache AllAha ki tA samyaka avagata nana?
AllAha avazyai prakAza kare divena kArA ImAna eneche evaM avazyai prakAza kare divena kArA munAphika|
kAphirerA mu’minaderake valeH ‘AmAdera patha anusaraNa kara, AmarA tomAdera pApabhAra vahana karava|’ kintu tArAto tAdera pApabhArera kichui vahana karavenA| tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
evaM tArA nijedera vojhA vahana karave evaM nijedera vojhAra sAthe Arao vojhA; evaM tArA ye mithyA udbhAvana kare sei samparke kiYAmAta divase avazyai tAderake prazna karA have|

Amito nUhake tAra sampradAYera nikaTa preraNa karechilAma evaM se tAdera madhye paJcAza kama hAjAra vachara avasthAna karechila| ataHpara plAvana tAderake grAsa kare| kAraNa tArA chila sImAlaMghanakArI|
ataHpara Ami tAke evaM yArA taraNIte ArohaNa karechila tAderake rakSA karalAma evaM vizva jagatera janya eke karalAma ekaTi nidarzana|
smaraNa kara ivarAhImera kathA, se tAra sampradAYake valechilaH tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara evaM tA~ke bhaYa kara, tomAdera janya eTAi zreYa yadi tomarA jAnate|

tomarAto AllAha vyatIta zudhu mUrti pUjA karacha evaM mithyA udbhAvana karacha| tomarA AllAha vyatIta yAdera pUjA kara tArA tomAdera jIvanopakaranera mAlika naYa| sutarAM tomarA jIvanopakaraNa kAmanA kara AllAhara nikaTa evaM tA~rai ivAdAta kara o tA~ra kRtajJatA prakAza kara| tomarA tA~rai nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
tomarA yadi AmAke mithyAvAdI vala tAhale jene rekha ye, tomAdera pUrvavartIrAo nAvIderake mithyAvAdI valechila| suspaSTabhAve pracAra karA chAr3A rAsUlera Ara kona dAYitva nei|
tArA ki lakSya karenA ye, kibhAve AllAha sRSTike astitva dAna karena? ataHpara punarAYa sRSTi karavena| eTAto AllAhara janya sahaja|
valaH pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM anudhAvana kara kibhAve tini sRSTi zuru karechena? ataHpara AllAha punarvAra sRSTi karavena paravartI sRSTi| AllAhato sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tini yAke icchA zAsti dena, yAra prati icchA anugraha karena| tomarA tA~rai nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
Ara tomarA (tA~ke) akSamakArI nao yamIne evaM nA AsamAne| Ara AllAha chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI nei|
yArA AllAhara nidarzana o tA~ra sAkSAtkAra asvIkAra kare tArAi AmAra anugraha hate nirAza haYa| tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

sutarAM ivarAhImera sampradAYera lokerA e chAr3A kona javAva dilanA, tArA valalaH tAke hatyA kara athavA agnidagdha kara| ataHpara AllAha tAke Aguna theke rakSA karalena| nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janya|

ivarAhIma valalaH tomarA AllAhara parivarte mUrtigulike upAsyarUpe grahaNa karecha pArthiva jIvane tomAdera pArasparika vandhutvera khAtire; kintu kiYAmAta divase tomarA eke aparake asvIkAra karave evaM parasparake abhisampAta dive| tomAdera AvAsa have jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkave nA|
lUta tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana karala| (ivarAhIma) valalaH Ami AmAra ravera uddezye deza tyAga karachi| tinito parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

Ami ivarAhImake dAna karalAma isahAka o iYAkUva evaM tAra vaMzadharadera janya sthira karalAma navuoYAta o kitAva evaM Ami tAke puraSkRta karechilAma duniYAYa evaM AkhirAteo| nizcaYai se have satkarmaparAYaNadera anyatama|
smaraNa kara lUtera kathA, se tAra sampradAYake valechilaH tomarA emana azlIla kAja karacho yA tomAdera pUrve vizve keha kareni|

tomarA puruSera upara upagata haccha evaM tomarA rAhAjAni kare thAka evaM tomarA nijedera majalize prakAzya ghRNya kAja kare thAka| uttare tAra sampradAYa zudhu ei valalaH AmAdera upara AllAhara zAsti AnaYana kara, yadi tumi satyavAdI hao|
se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! viparyaYa sRSTikArI sampradAYera viruddhe AmAke sAhAyya karuna|
yakhana AmAra prerita mAlAikA/pherezatArA susaMvAdasaha ivarAhImera nikaTa elo, tArA valechilaH AmarA ei janapadavAsIke dhvaMsa karava, era adhivAsIto sImA laMghanakArI|

ivarAhIma valalaH ei janapade lUta raYeche| tArA valalaH sekhAne kArA Ache tA AmarA bhAla jAni; AmarAto lUtake o tA~ra parijanavargake rakSA karavai, tA~ra strIke vyatIta; se pazcAte avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|

evaM yakhana AmAra prerita mAlAikA/pherezatArA lUtera nikaTa elo takhana tAdera janya se viSaNNa haYe par3ala evaM nijeke tAdera rakSAYa asamartha mane karala| tArA valalaH bhaYa karanA, duHkhao karanA; AmarA tomAke o tomAra parivAravargake rakSA karava, tomAra strI vyatIta; se pazcAte avasthAnakArIdera antarbhukta|
AmarA ei janapadavAsIra upara AkAza hate zAsti nAyila karava, kAraNa tArA chila pApAcArI|
Ami vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYera janya ete ekaTi spaSTa nidarzana rekhechi|
Ami mAdaiYAnavAsIdera prati tAdera bhAi zuA’ivake pAThiYechilAma| se valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, zeSa dinake bhaYa kara evaM pRthivIte viparyaYa ghaTionA|
kintu tArA tAra prati mithyA Aropa karala; ataHpara tArA bhUmikampa dvArA AkrAnta hala; phale tArA nija gRhe natajAnu avasthAYa zeSa haYe gela|

evaM Ami ‘Ada o chAmUdake dhvaMsa karechilAma; tAdera vAr3Igharai tomAdera janya era suspaSTa pramANa| zAitAna tAdera kAjake tAdera dRSTite suzobhita karechila evaM tAderake satpatha avalamvane vAdhA diYechila, yadio tArA chila vicakSaNa|
smaraNa kara kArUna, phira‘Auna o hAmAnake; mUsA tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila; takhana tArA deze dambha karata; kintu tArA AmAra zAsti er3Ate pAreni|

tAdera pratyekakei tAdera aparAdhera janya zAsti diYechilAma; tAdera kArao prati preraNa karechi prastarasaha pracanDa jhaTikA, tAdera kehake AghAta karechila mahAnAda, kehake Ami prothita karechilAma bhU-garbhe evaM kehake karechilAma nimajjita| AllAha tAdera prati kona yul‌ma karenani; tArA nijerAi nijedera prati yul‌ma karechila|
AllAhara parivarte yArA aparake abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa kare tAdera dRSTAnta mAkar3asA, ye nijera janya ghara tairI kare; evaM gharera madhye mAkar3asAra gharaito durvalatama, yadi tArA jAnata|
tArA AllAhara parivarte yA kichuke AhavAna kare AllAha tA jAnena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
mAnuSera janya e sava dRSTAnta varNanA kare thAki, kintu zudhu jJAnI vyaktirAi eTA vujhe|
AllAha yathAyathabhAve AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena, ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janya|
tumi tomAra prati pratyAdiSTa kitAva AvRtti kara evaM sAlAta pratiSThita kara| nizcaYai sAlAta virata rAkhe azlIla o manda kAja hate| AllAhara smaraNai sarvazreSTha| tomarA yA kara, AllAha tA jAnena|

tomarA uttama panthA vyatIta kitAvIdera sAthe vitarka karavenA, tave tAdera sAthe karate pAra yArA tAdera madhye sImAlaMghanakArI evaM valaH AmAdera prati o tomAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte AmarA vizvAsa kari evaM AmAdera mA‘vUda o tomAdera mA‘vUdato ekai evaM AmarA tA~rai prati AtmasamarpaNakArI|

ebhAvei Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi evaM yAderake Ami kitAva diYechilAma tArA ete vizvAsa kare evaM ederao (mAkkAvAsI) keha keha ete vizvAsa kare| zudhu kAphirerAi AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkAra kare|
tumito era pUrve kona kitAva pATha karani evaM svahaste kona dina kitAva likhani ye, mithyAcArIrA sandeha poSaNa karave|
vastutaH yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tAdera antare eTA spaSTa nidarzana| zudhu yAlimarAi AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra kare|
tArA valeH ravera nikaTa hate tAra prati nidarzana prerita haYanA kena? valaH nidarzana AllAhara icchAdhIna, Amito ekajana prakAzya satarkakArI mAtra|
eTA ki tAdera janya yatheSTa naYa ye, Ami tomAra nikaTa kuraAna avatIrNa karechi yA tAdera nikaTa pATha karA haYa? ete avazyai mu’mina sampradAYera janya anugraha o upadeza raYeche|
valaH AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa| AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu raYeche tA tini avagata| yArA vAtilake vizvAsa kare o AllAhake asvIkAra kare tArAito kSatigrasta|
tArA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale; yadi nirdhArita samaYa nA thAkata tAhale zAsti tAdera upara ese yeta| nizcaYai tAdera upara zAsti Asave AkasmikabhAve, tAdera ajJAtasAre|
tArA tomAke zAsti tvarAnvita karate vale; jAhAnnAmato kAphiraderake pariveSTana karavei|
sedina zAsti tAderake Acchanna karave urdhva o adhaHdeza hate evaM tini valavenaH tomarA yA karate tAra svAda AsvAdana kara|
he AmAra mu’mina vAndArA! AmAra pRthivI prazasta; sutarAM tomarA AmArai ivAdAta kara|
jIva mAtrai mRtyura svAda grahaNakArI; ataHpara tomarA AmArai nikaTa pratyAvartita have|

yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare Ami avazyai tAdera vasavAsera janya suucca prAsAda dAna karava jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, kata uttama pratidAna sat karmazIladera –
yArA dhairya avalamvana kare evaM tAdera ravera upara nirbhara kare|
emana kata jIva jantu raYeche yArA nijedera khAdya maojuda rAkhenA; AllAhai riyka dAna karena tAderake o tomAderake evaM tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|
yadi tumi tAderake jijJesa karaH ke AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM cA~da-sUryake niYantraNa karachena? tArA avazyai valaveH AllAha! tAhale tArA kothAYa phire yAcche?
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA tAra riyka vardhita karena evaM yAra janya icchA tA sImita karena| AllAha sarva viSaYe samyaka avahita|

yadi tumi tAderake jijJesa karaH bhUmi mRta haoYAra para AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kare ke oke saJjIvita kare? tArA avazyai valaveH AllAha! valaH prazaMsA AllAharai| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai eTA anubhava karenA|
ei pArthiva jIvanato krIr3A-kautuka vyatIta kichui naYa| pAralaukika jIvanai prakRta jIvana, yadi tArA jAnato|
tArA yakhana nauyAne ArohaNa kare takhana tArA vizuddha citte ekaniSThabhAve AllAhake DAke; ataHpara tini yakhana sthale bhir3iYe tAderake uddhAra karena takhana tArA zirake lipta haYa|
tAdera prati AmAra dAna tArA asvIkAra kare evaM bhoga vilAse matta thAke; acirei tArA jAnate pArave|

tArA ki dekhenA ye, Ami hArAmake nirApada sthAna karechi, athaca era catuspArzve ye sava mAnuSa Ache tAdera upara hAmalA karA haYa; tAhale ki tArA asatyei vizvAsa karave evaM AllAhara anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ye vyakti AllAha samvandhe mithyA racanA kare athavA tA~ra nikaTa hate Agata satyake asvIkAra kare tAra apekSA adhika yAlima Ara ke? jAhAnnAmai ki kAphiradera AvAsasthala naYa?
yArA AmAra uddezye saMgrAma kare, Ami tAderake avazyai AmAra pathe paricAlita karava| AllAha avazyai satkarmaparAYaNadera sAthe Achena|
Alipha lAma mIma|
romakarA parAjita haYeche –
nikaTavartI aJcale; kintu tArA tAdera ei parAjaYera para zIghrai vijaYI have –
kaYeka vacharera madhyei| pUrvera o parera siddhAnta AllAharai| Ara sedina mu’minarA harSotphulla have –
AllAhara sAhAyye, tini yAke icchA sAhAyya karena evaM tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
eTA AllAharai pratizruti; AllAha tA~ra pratizruti bhaGga karenanA, kintu adhikAMza loka jAnenA|
tArA pArthiva jIvanera vAhyika dika samvandhe avagata, Ara AkhirAta samvandhe tArA gAphila|

tArA ki nijedera antare bheve dekhenA ye, AllAha AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI o etadubhaYera antavartI sava kichu sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAvei eka nirdiSTa kAlera janya? kintu mAnuSera madhye anekei tAdera ravera sAkSAte avizvAsI|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa karenA evaM dekhenA ye, tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma kirUpa haYeche? zaktite tArA chila tAdera apekSA pravala; tArA jami cASa karata, tArA (pUrvavartIrA) oTA AvAda karata tAdera apekSA adhika| tAdera nikaTa esechila tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzanasaha; vastutaH tAdera prati yulama karA AllAhara kAja chilanA, varaM tArA nijerAi nijedera prati yulama karechila|
ataHpara yArA manda kAja karechila tAdera pariNAma haYeche manda; kAraNa tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUha pratyAkhyAna karata evaM tA niYe ThATTA-vidrupa karata|
AllAha Adite sRSTi karena, ataHpara tini era punarAvRtti karavena, takhana tomarA tA~rai nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
yedina kiYAmAta have sedina aparAdhIrA hatAza haYe par3ave|
tAdera deva-devIgulo tAdera janya supAriza karavenA evaM tArAi tAdera deva-devIguloke asvIkAra karave|
yedina kiYAmAta saMghaTita have sedina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ataeva yArA ImAna eneche o sat kAja kareche tArA jAnnAte Anande thAkave|
Ara yArA kupharI kareche evaM AmAra nidarzanAvalI o parakAlera sAkSAtkAra asvIkAra kareche tArAi zAsti bhoga karate thAkave|
sutarAM tomarA AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara sandhyAYa o prabhAte –
Ara aparAhne o yuharera samaYa; evaM AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sakala prazaMsA tA~rai|
tinii mRta hate jIvantera evaM jIvanta hate mRtera AvirbhAva ghaTAna evaM bhUmira mRtyura para oke punarujjIvita karena| ebhAvei tomarA utthita have|
tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tini tomAderake mATi hate sRSTi karechena| ekhana tomarA mAnuSa, sarvatra char3iYe par3echa|

evaM tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tini tomAdera janya tomAdera madhya hate sRSTi karechena tomAdera saGginIderake yAte tomarA tAdera sAthe zAntite vAsa karate pAra evaM tini tomAdera madhye pArasparika bhAlavAsA o daYA sRSTi karechena| cintAzIla sampradAYera janya ete avazyai vahu nidarzana raYeche|
evaM tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTi evaM tomAdera bhASA o varNera vaicitrya| ete jJAnIdera janya avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
evaM tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche rAta o dine tomAdera nidrA evaM tA~ra anugraha anveSaNa| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche zravaNakArI sampradAYera janya|

evaM tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tini tomAderake pradarzana karena vidyut, bhaYa o bharasA saJcAraka rUpe evaM tini AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena evaM tadvArA bhUmike ora mRtyura para punarujjIvita karena, ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYera janya|
tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche ye, tA~rai Adeze AkAza o pRthivIra sthiti; ataHpara tini (AllAha) yakhana tomAderake mATi hate uThAra janya ekavAra AhavAna karavena takhana tomarA uThe Asave|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai| savAi tA~ra AjJAvaha|
tinii prathamavAra sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tini eTAke sRSTi karavena punarvAra; eTA tA~ra janya ati sahaja| AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte sarvocca maryAdA tA~rai, evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

(AllAha) tomAdera janya tomAdera nijedera madhye ekaTi dRSTAnta peza karachenaH tomAderake Ami ye riyka diYechi tomAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIdera keha ki tAte tomAdera samAna aMzIdAra? tomarA ki tAderake serUpa bhaYa kara yerUpa tomarA parasparake bhaYa kara? ebhAvei Ami vodhazakti sampanna sampradAYera janya nirdezanAvalI vivRta kari|
vastutaH sImAlaMghanakArIrA ajJatA vazataH tAdera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kare, sutarAM AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena, ke tAke sat pathe paricAlita karave? tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|

tumi ekaniSTha haYe nijeke dInera upara pratiSThita kara| AllAhara prakRtira anusaraNa kara, ye prakRti anuyAYI tini mAnuSa sRSTi karechena; AllAhara sRSTira kona parivartana nei| eTAi sarala dIna| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAnenA|
vizuddha citte tA~ra abhimukhI haYe tA~ke bhaYa kara, sAlAta kAYema kara evaM muzarikadera antarbhukta haYonA|
yArA nijedera dIne matabheda sRSTi kareche evaM vibhinna dale vibhakta haYeche, pratyeka dalai nija nija matavAda niYe utphulla|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha-dainya sparza kare takhana tArA vizuddha citte tAdera rAvavake DAke, ataHpara tini yakhana tAderake svIYa anugraha AsvAdana karAna takhana tAdera eka dala tAdera ravera sAthe zarIka kare –
tAderake Ami yA diYechi tA asvIkAra karAra janya| sutarAM bhoga kare nAo, zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave|
Ami ki tAdera nikaTa emana kona dalIla avatIrNa karechi yA tAderake AmAra zarIka karate vale?
Ami yakhana mAnuSake anugrahera AsvAda dii takhana tArA utphulla haYa evaM tAdera kRtakarmera phale durdazAgrasta halei tArA hatAza haYe par3e|
tArA ki lakSya karenA ye, AllAha yAra janya icchA tAra riyka prazasta karena athavA tA sImita karena? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janya|
ataeva AtmIYake diYe dAo tAra prApya evaM abhAvagrasta o musAphirakeo| yArA AllAhara santuSTi kAmanA kare tAdera janya eTA zreYa evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

mAnuSera dhana sampada vRddhi pAve, e AzAYa sude yA kichu tomarA diYe thAka, AllAhara dRSTite tA vRddhi pAYanA| varaM AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera AzAYa tomarA yA dAna kara tAra parivarte tomarA vahuguNa prApta have|

AllAhai tomAderake sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tomAderake riyka diYechena; tini tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAvena evaM pare tomAderake jIvita karavena| tomAdera deva-devIgulora emana keha Ache ki, ye e savera kona ekaTio karate pAre? tArA yAderake zarIka kare, AllAha tA hate pavitra, mahAna|
mAnuSera kRtakarmera kAraNe samudre o sthale viparyaYa char3iYe par3e, yAra phale tAderake kona kona karmera zAsti tini AsvAdana karAna, yAte tArA phire Ase|
valaH tomarA pRthivIte paribhramaNa kara evaM dekha, tomAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma ki haYeche! tAdera adhikAMzai chila muzarika|
tumi sarala dIne nijeke pratiSThita kara, AllAhara nirdeze anivArya dina AsAra pUrve, sedina mAnuSa vibhakta haYe par3ave|
ye kupharI kare, kupharIra zAsti tArai; yArA sat kAja kare tArA nijederai janya racanA kare zAntira AvAsa|
kAraNa yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, tini (AllAha) tAderake nija anugrahe puraskRta karena| tini kAphiraderake pachanda karenanA|

tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra ekaTi ei ye, tini vAYu preraNa karena susaMvAda deYAra janya o tomAderake tA~ra anugraha AsvAdana karAnora janya, evaM yena tA~ra vidhAne nauyAnaguli vicaraNa kare, yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha sandhAna karate pAra evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao|

Ami tomAra pUrve rAsUladerake preraNa karechilAma tAdera nija nija sampradAYera nikaTa| tArA tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzana niYe esechila; ataHpara Ami aparAdhIderake zAsti diYechilAma| mu’minaderake sAhAyya karA AmAra dAYitva|

AllAha! tini vAYu preraNa karena; phale eTA meghamAlAke saJcArita kare, ataHpara tini eke yemana icchA AkAze char3iYe dena, pare eke khanDa vikhanDa karena evaM tumi dekhate pAo oTA hate nirgata haYa vAridhArA; ataHpara yakhana tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAderake icchA tAdera nikaTa oTA pau~che dena takhana tArA haYa harSotphulla –
yadio tArA tAdera prati vRSTi varSaNera pUrve nirAza chila|
AllAhara anugrahera phala samvandhe cintA kara - kibhAve tini bhUmira mRtyura para oke punarujjIvita karena! ebhAvei AllAha mRtake jIvita karena, kAraNa tini sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
evaM Ami yadi emana vAYu preraNa kari yAra phale tArA dekhe ye, zaSya pIta varNa dhAraNa kareche takhanato tArA akRtajJa haYe par3e|
tumito mRtake zonAte pAravenA, vadhirakeo pAravenA AhavAna zonAte, yakhana tArA pRSTha pradarzana kare sare par3e|
Ara tumi andhakeo phiriYe Anate pArave nA tAdera pathabhraSTatA hate| yArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIte vizvAsa kare zudhu tAderakei tumi zonAte pArave, kAraNa tArA AtmasamarpanakArI|

tinii AllAha! yini tomAderake sRSTi karena durvala avasthAYa; durvalatAra para tini dena zakti, zaktira para AvAra dena durvalatA o vArdhakya| tini yA icchA sRSTi karena evaM tinii sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|
yedina kiYAmAta have sedina aparAdhIrA zapatha kare valave ye, tArA eka ghanTAra vezi (duniYAYa) avasthAna kareni| ebhAvei tArA satyabhraSTa hata|
kintu yAderake jJAna o ImAna deYA haYeche tArA valaveH tomarAto AllAhara vidhAne punarutthAna divasa paryanta avasthAna karecha| eTAito punarutthAna divasa, kintu tomarA jAnatenA|
sedina sImA laMghanakArIra oyara Apatti tAdera kAje AsavenA evaM tAderake (AllAhara) santuSTi lAbhera suyogao deYA havenA|
Amito mAnuSera janya ei kuraAne sarva prakAra dRSTAnta diYechi| tumi yadi tAdera nikaTa kona nidarzana hAjira kara tAhale kAphirerA avazyai valaveH tomarAto mithyAzraYI|
yAdera jJAna nei AllAha tAdera hRdaYa ebhAve mohara kare dena|
ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, nizcaYai AllAhara pratizruti satya| yArA dRr3ha vizvAsI naYa tArA yena tomAke vicalita karate nA pAre|
Alipha lAma mIma
eguli jJAnagarbha kitAvera AYAta|
patha nirdeza o daYA svarUpa, satkarmaparAYaNadera janya|
yArA sAlAta kAYema kare, yAkAta deYa, tArAi AkhirAte nizcita vizvAsI|
tArAi tAdera ravera nirdezita pathe raYeche evaM tArAi saphalakAma|

mAnuSera madhye keha keha ajJatA vazataH AllAhara patha hate vicyuta karAra janya asAra vAkya kraYa kareevaM AllAhara pradarzita patha niYe ThATTA-vidrupa kare, tAderai janya raYeche avamAnanAkara zAsti|

yakhana tAra nikaTa AmAra AYAta AvRtti karA haYa takhana se dambhabhare mukha phiriYe neYa, yena se eTA zunate pAYani, yena tAra karNa du’Ti vadhira; ataeva tAderake yantraNAdAYaka zAstira susaMvAda dAo|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tAdera janya raYeche sukha kAnana,
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have| AllAhara pratizruti satya| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tini AkAzamanDalI nirmANa karechena stambha vyatIta, tomarA eTA dekhacha| tinii pRthivIte sthApana karechena pavartamAlA yAte eTA tomAderake niYe Dhale nA par3e evaM ete char3iYe diYechena sarva prakAra jIva-jantu evaM Amii AkAza hate vAri varSaNa kare ete udbhava kari sarvaprakAra kalyANakara udbhida|
eTA AllAhara sRSTi! tini chAr3A anyarA ki sRSTi kareche AmAke dekhAo| sImAlaMghanakArIrAto spaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche|

Ara Ami to lukamAnake hikamAta diYechilAma (evaM valechilAma) ye, ‘AllAhara zukariYA AdAYa kara| Ara ye zukariYA AdAYa kare se to nijera janyai zukariYA AdAYa kare evaM ye akRtajJa haYa (tAra jene rAkhA ucita) AllAha amukhApekSI, prazaMsita’|
smaraNa kara, yakhana lukamAna upadezAcchale tAra putrake valechilaH he vatsa! AllAhara sAthe kona zarIka karanA| nizcaYai ziraka hacche carama yulama|

Amito mAnuSake tAra mAtApitAra prati sadAcaraNera nirdeza diYechi| mA santAnake kaSTera para kaSTa varaNa kare garbhe dhAraNa kare evaM tAra dudha chAr3Ano haYa dui vachare| sutarAM AmAra prati o tomAra mAtApitAra prati kRtajJa hao| pratyAvartanato AmArai nikaTa|

tomAra mAtA-pitA yadi tomAke pIr3ApIr3i kare AmAra sAthe zarIka karate ye viSaYe tomAra kona jJAna nei tAhale tumi tAdera kathA mAnavenA| tave pRthivIte tAdera sAthe vasavAsa karave sadbhAve evaM ye vizuddha citte AmAra abhimukhi haYeche tAra patha avalamvana kara, ataHpara tomAdera pratyAvartana AmArai nikaTa evaM tomarA yA karate se viSaYe Ami tomAderake avahita karava|
he vatsa! kona kichu yadi sariSAra dAnA parimAnao haYa evaM tA yadi thAke zilAgarbhe athavA AkAze kiMvA mATira nIce, AllAha oTAo hAyira karavena| AllAha sUkSmadarzI, sarvaviSaYe khavara rAkhena|
he vatsa! sAlAta kAYema karave, bhAla kAjera Adeza karave o manda kAja hate niSedha karave evaM Apade-vipade dhairya dhAraNa karave, eTAito dRr3ha saMkalpera kAja|
ahaMkAra vaze tumi mAnuSake avajJA karanA evaM pRthivIte uddhatabhAve vicaraNa karanA| kAraNa AllAha kona uddhata, ahaMkArIke pachanda karenanA|
padacAraNAYa madhya panthA avalamvana karave evaM tomAra kanThasvara karave nIcu; svarera madhye gAdhAra svarai sarvApekSA aprItikara|

tomarA ki dekhanA ye, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache savai AllAha tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena evaM tomAdera prati tA~ra prakAzya o aprakAzya anugraha sampUrNa karechena? mAnuSera madhye keha keha ajJatA vazataH AllAha samvandhe vitanDA kare, tAdera nA Ache patha nirdezaka Ara nA Ache kona dIptimAna kitAva|

tAderake yakhana valA haYa - AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tA anusaraNa kara takhana tArA valeH varaM AmarA AmAdera pitRpuruSaderake yAte peYechi tArai anusaraNa karava| zAitAna yadi tAderake jvalanta agnira zAstira dike AhavAna kare tavuo ki?
yadi keha sat karmaparAYaNa haYe AllAhara nikaTa Atmasamarpana kare tAhale seto dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare eka mAyavUta hAtala, yAvatIYa kAryera pariNAma AllAhara dike|

keha kupharI karale tAra kupharI yena tomAke kliSTa nA kare| AmArai nikaTa tAdera pratyAvartana| ataHpara Ami tAderake avahita karava tArA yA karata| antare yA raYeche se samvandhe AllAha savizeSa avahita|
Ami tAderake jIvanopakaraNa bhoga karate diva svalpakAlera janya| ataHpara tAderake kaThina zAsti bhoga karate vAdhya karava|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa karaH AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI ke sRSTi karechena? tAhale tArA nizcaYai valaveH AllAha! valaH prazaMsA AllAhara| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai jAnenA|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA AllAharai| AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsA|
pRthivIra samasta vRkSa yadi kalama haYa evaM ei ye samudra, era sAthe yadi Arao sAtaTi samudra yukta haYe kAli haYa tavuo AllAhara vANI niHzeSa havenA| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomAdera sakalera sRSTi o punarutthAna ekaTi mAtra prANIra sRSTi o punarutthAnera anurUpa| AllAha sarvazrotA, samyaka draSTA|

tumi ki dekhanA ye, AllAha rAtake dine evaM dinake rAte praveza karAna? tini cA~da-sUryake karechena niYamAdhIna, pratyekaTi vicaraNa kare nirdiSTa kAla paryanta; tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke avahita|
era kAraNa ei ye, AllAha satya evaM tArA tA~ra parivarte yAke DAke tA mithyA| AllAhato samucca, mahAna|

tumi ki lakSya karanA ye, AllAhara anugrahe nauyAnaguli samudre vicaraNa kare, yaddavArA tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra kichu pradarzana karena? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche pratyeka dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janya|

yakhana taraGga tAderake Acchanna kare meghacchAYAra mata takhana tArA AllAhake DAke vizuddha citte| kintu yakhana tini tAderake uddhAra kare sthale pau~chAna takhana tAdera keha keha sarala pathe thAke| zudhu vizvAsaghAtaka, akRtajJa vyaktii tA~ra nirdezAvalI asvIkAra kare|

he lokasakala! tomarA tomAdera rAvavake bhaYa kara evaM bhaYa kara sei dinera yakhana pitA santAnera kona upakAre AsavenA evaM santAnao kona upakAre AsavenA tAra pitAra| nizcaYai AllAhara pratizruti satya, sutarAM pArthiva jIvana yena tomAderake kichutei pratArita nA kare evaM sei pravaJcaka yena tomAderake kichutei AllAha samparke pravaJcita nA kare|

kiYAmAtera jJAna zudhu AllAhara nikaTa raYeche, tinii vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM tinii jAnena yA jarAYute raYeche| keha jAnenA AgAmIkAla se kI arjana karave evaM keha jAnenA kon sthAne tAra mRtyu ghaTave| AllAha sarvajJa, sarva viSaYe avahita|
Alipha lAma mIma|
ei kitAva jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa hate avatIrNa, ete kona sandeha nei|

tAhale ki tArA valeH eTi se nije racanA kareche? nA, eTi tomAra rAvava hate Agata satya, yAte tumi emana eka sampradAYake satarka karate pAra yAdera nikaTa tomAra pUrve kona satarkakArI Aseni| haYato tArA sat pathe calave|

AllAha, tini AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI o etadubhaYera antavartI sava kichu sRSTi karechena chaYa dine| ataHpara tini Araze samAsIna hana| tini chAr3A tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei evaM sAhAyyakArIo nei, tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karavenA?
tini AkAza hate pRthivI paryanta samudaYa viSaYa paricAlanA karena, ataHpara ekadina sava kichui tA~ra samIpe samutthita have, ye dinera parimApa have tomAdera hisAve hAjAra vacharera samAna|
tinii dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtA, parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu –
yini tA~ra pratyeka sRSTike sRSTi karechena uttama rUpe evaM kAdA mATi hate mAnava sRSTira sUcanA karechena|
ataHpara tAra vaMza utpanna karechena tuccha tarala padArthera niryAsa hate|
pare tini oke karechena suSama evaM ote phu~ke diYechena ruh tA~ra nikaTa hate evaM tomAderake diYechena karNa, cakSu o antaHkaraNa; tomarA ati sAmAnyai kRtajJatA prakAza kare thAka|
tArA valeH AmarA mATite paryavasita haleo ki AmAderake AvAra natuna kare sRSTi karA have? vastutaH tArA tAdera ravera sAkSAtkAra asvIkAra kare|
valaH tomAdera janya niyukta mRtyura mAlAka/pherezatA tomAdera prANa haraNa karave| avazeSe tomarA tomAdera ravera nikaTa pratyAvartIta have|

evaM hAYa! tumi yadi dekhate! yakhana aparAdhIrA tAdera ravera sAmane adhovadana haYe valaveH he AmAdera rAvava! AmarA pratyakSa karalAma o zravaNa karalAma; ekhana Apani AmAderake punarAYa preraNa karuna, AmarA sat kAja karava, AmarAto dRr3ha vizvAsI|
Ami icchA karale pratyeka vyaktike sat pathe paricAlita karate pAratAma; kintu AmAra e kathA avazyai satyaH Ami nizcaYai jina o mAnuSa ubhaYa dvArA jAhAnnAma pUrNa karava|
ekhana zAsti AsvAdana kara, kAraNa Ajakera ei sAkSAtkArera kathA tomarA vismRta haYechile| Amio tomAderake vismRta halAma, tomarA yA karate tajjanya tomarA sthAYI zAsti bhoga karate thAka|
zudhu tArAi AmAra nidarzanAvalI vizvAsa kare yArA ora dvArA upadiSTa hale sAjadAhaYa luTiYe par3e evaM tAdera ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM ahaMkAra karenA| [sAjadAha]
tArA zayyA tyAga kare tAdera rAvavake DAke AzAYa o AzaMkAYa, evaM tAderake ye riyka dAna karechi tA hate tArA vyaYa kare|
kehai jAnenA, tAdera janya naYana prItikara ki ki pratidAna lukAYita raYeche tAdera kRtakarmera puraskAra svarUpa|
tAhale ki ye vyakti mu’mina haYeche se pApAcArIra nyAYa? tArA samAna naYa|
yArA ImAna Ane evaM sat kAja kare tAdera kRtakarmera phala svarUpa tAdera ApyAYanera janya jAnnAta have tAdera vAsasthala|

Ara yArA pApAcAra kareche tAdera vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma; yakhanai tArA jAhAnnAma hate vera hate cAve takhanai tAdera phiriYe deYA have tAte evaM tAderake valA haveH ye Agunera zAstike tomarA mithyA valate tA AsvAdana kara|
var3a zAstira pUrve tAderake Ami avazyai laghu zAsti AsvAdana karAva, yAte tArA phire Ase|
ye vyakti tAra ravera nirdezanAvalI dvArA upadiSTa haYe tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa tAra apekSA adhika yAlima Ara ke? Ami avazyai aparAdhIderake zAsti diYe thAki|
Amito mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma; ataeva tumi tAra sAkSAta samvandhe sandeha karanA, Ami tAke vAnI isarAIlera janya patha nirdezaka karechilAma|
Ara Ami tAdera madhya hate netA manonIta karechilAma yArA AmAra nirdeza anusAre patha pradarzana karata| yakhana tArA dhairya dhAraNa karata takhana tArA chila AmAra nidarzanAvalIte dRr3ha vizvAsI|
tArA nijedera madhye ye viSaYe matavirodha karache tomAra rAvavai kiYAmAta divase ora phAisAlA kare divena|
eTAo ki tAderake patha pradarzana karalanA ye, Ami tAdera pUrve dhvaMsa karechi kata mAnava goSThi, yAdera vAsabhUmite erA vicaraNa karache? ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche; tavuo ki tArA zunavenA?

tArA ki lakSya karenA ye, Ami uSara bhUmira pAni pravAhita kare ora sAhAyye udagata kari zasya, yA hate AhArya grahaNa kare tAdera gRhapAlita catuspada jantuguli evaM tArA nijerAo? tAdera ki dRSTizakti nei?
tArA jijJesa kareH tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, kakhana have ei phAisAlA?
valaH phAisAlAra dina kAphiradera ImAna AnA tAdera kona kAje AsavenA evaM tAderake avakAza deYA havenA|
ataeva tumi tAderake upekSA kara evaM apekSA kara; tArAo apekSA karache|
he nAvI! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM kAphiradera o munAphikadera Anugatya karanA| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
tomAra ravera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA ahI haYa uhAra anusaraNa kara; tomarA yA kara AllAha sei viSaYe samyaka avahita|
Ara tumi nirbhara kara AllAhara upara evaM karmavidhAYaka hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa|

AllAha kona mAnuSera abhyantare du’Ti hRdaYa sRSTi karenani; tomAdera strIrA, yAdera sAthe tomarA yihAra kare thAka, tAderake AllAha tomAdera jananI karenani evaM tomAdera poSyaputrake tini (AllAha) tomAdera prakRta putra karenani; aiguli tomAdera mukhera kathA| AllAha satya kathAi valena evaM tinii sarala patha nirdeza karena|

tomarA tAderake DAka tAdera pitR paricaYe; AllAhara dRSTite eTA adhika nyAYa saGgata, yadi tomarA tAdera pitR-paricaYa nA jAna tAhale tArA tomAdera dharmIYa bhAi athavA vandhu; e vyApAre tomarA kona bhula karale tomAdera kona aparAdha nei, kintu tomAdera antare saMkalpa thAkale aparAdha have| Ara AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

nAvI mu’minadera nikaTa tAdera nijedera apekSA ghaniSTatara evaM tAra strIrA tAdera mA| AllAhara vidhAna anusAre mu’mina muhAjira apekSA yArA AtmIYa tArA parasparera nikaTatama| tave tomarA yadi tomAdera vandhu-vAndhavadera prati dAkSiNya pradarzana karate cAo tAhale karate pAra| eTA kitAve lipivaddha|

smaraNa kara, yakhana Ami nAvIdera nikaTa hate aGgIkAra grahaNa karechilAma evaM tomAra nikaTa hateo evaM nUha, ivarAhIma, mUsA, mAraiYAma tanaYa IsAra nikaTa hate, tAdera nikaTa hate grahaNa karechilAma dRr3ha aGgIkAra –
satyavAdIderake tAdera satyavAditA samvandhe jijJesa karAra janya| tini kAphiradera janya prastuta rekhechena marmantada zAsti!

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA tomAdera prati AllAhara anugrahera kathA smaraNa kara, yakhana zatruvAhinI tomAdera viruddhe samAgata haYechila evaM Ami tAdera viruddhe preraNa karechilAma jhaJjhAvAYu evaM eka vAhinI yA tomarA dekhani| tomarA yA kara AllAha tAra samyaka draSTA|

yakhana tArA tomAdera viruddhe samAgata haYechila ucca aJcala o nimna aJcala hate, tomAdera cakSu visphorita haYechila; tomAdera prANa haYe par3echila kanThAgata evaM tomarA AllAha samvandhe nAnAvidha dhAraNA poSaNa karachile|
takhana mu’minarA parIkSita haYechila evaM tArA bhISaNabhAve prakampita haYechila|
evaM munAphikarAo yAdera antare chila vyAdhi, tArA valachilaH AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUla AmAderake ye pratizruti diYechilena tA pratAraNA chAr3A kichui naYa|

Ara tAdera eka dala valechilaH he iYAsarivavAsI! tomAdera kona sthAna nei, tomarA phire cala| evaM tAdera madhye ekadala nAvIra nikaTa avyAhati prArthanA kare valechilaH AmAdera vAr3I ghara arakSita, athaca oguli arakSita chilanA, Asale palAYana karAi chila tAdera uddezya|
yadi zatrurA nagarIra vibhinna dika hate praveza kare tAderake vidrohera janya prarocita karata tAhale avazyai tArA tAi kare vasata; tArA ete kAlavilamva karatanA|
tArA pUrvei AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra karechila ye, tArA pRSTha pradarzana karavenA| AllAhara sAthe kRta aGgIkAra samvandhe avazyai jijJAsAvAda karA have|
valaH tomAdera kona lAbha havenA yadi tomarA mRtyu athavA hatyAra bhaYe palAYana kara evaM sei kSetre tomAderake sAmAnyai bhoga karate deYA have|

valaH ke tomAderake AllAha hate rakSA karave yadi tini tomAdera amaGgala icchA karena evaM tini yadi tomAderake anugraha karate icchA karena tAhale ke tomAdera kSati karave? tArA AllAha chAr3A nijedera kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAvenA|
AllAha avazyai jAnena tomAdera madhye kArA tomAderake yuddhe aMza grahaNe vAdhA deYa evaM tAdera bhrAtRvargake valeH AmAdera saGge eso| tArA kamai yuddhe aMza neYa|

tArA tomAdera vyApAre IrSAvodha kare| yakhana vipada Ase takhana tumi dekhave ye, mRtyubhaYe mUrchAtura vyaktira nyAYa cakSu ulTiYe tArA tomAra dike tAkiYe Ache| kintu yakhana vipada cale yAYa takhana tArA sampadera lobhe tomAdera sAthe vAka cAturItAYa avatIrNa haYa| tArA ImAna Aneni, e janya AllAha tAdera kAryAvalI niSphala kare diYechena evaM AllAhara pakSe eTA sahaja|

tArA mane kare ye, sammilita vAhinI cale yAYani| yadi sammilita vAhinI AvAra ese par3e takhana tArA kAmanA karave ye, bhAla hata yadi tArA yAyAvara maruvAsIdera sAthe theke tomAdera saMvAda nita| tArA tomAdera sAthe avasthAna karaleo tArA yuddha alpai karata|
tomAdera madhye yArA AllAha o AkhirAtera prati vizvAsa rAkhe evaM AllAhake adhika smaraNa kare tAdera janya rAsUlera anusaraNera madhye raYeche uttama Adarza|

mu’minarA yakhana sammilita vAhinIke dekhala takhana tArA vale uThalaH eTAto tA’i, AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla yAra pratizruti AmAderake diYechena evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla satyai valechilena| Ara ete tAdera ImAna o Anugatyai vRddhi pela|
mu’minadera madhye kataka AllAhara sAthe tAdera kRta aGgIkAra pUrNa kareche; tAdera keha keha zAhAdAta varaNa kareche evaM keha keha pratIkSAYa raYeche| tArA tAdera aGgIkAre kona parivartana kareni|
kAraNa AllAha satyavAdIderake puraskRta karena satyavAdItAra janya evaM tA~ra icchA hale munAphikaderake zAsti dena athavA tAderake kSamA karena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

AllAha kAphiraderake kruddhAvasthAYa viphala manoratha haYe phire yete vAdhya karalena| kona kalyANa tArA lAbha kareni| yuddhe mu’minadera janya AllAhai yatheSTa| AllAha sarvazaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

kitAvIdera madhye yArA tAderake sAhAyya karechila tAderake tini tAdera durga hate avataraNe vAdhya karalena evaM tAdera antare bhIti saJcAra karalena; phale tomarA tAdera katakake hatyA karecha evaM katakake karacha vandI|
tini tomAderake adhikArI karalena tAdera bhUmi, gharavAr3I o dhana sampadera evaM emana bhUmi yA tomarA ekhanao padAnata karani| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
he nAvI! tumi tomAra strIderake valaH tomarA yadi pArthiva jIvana evaM ora bhuSaNa kAmanA kara tAhale eso, Ami tomAdera bhoga-sAmagrIra vyavasthA kare dii evaM saujanyera sAthe tomAderake vidAYa dii|
Ara yadi tomarA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o AkhirAta kAmanA kara tAhale tomAdera madhye yArA sat karmazIla AllAha tAdera janya mahA pratidAna prastuta rekhechena|
he nAvI-patnIrA! ye kAja spaSTata azlIla, tomAdera madhye keha tA karale, tAke dviguNa zAsti deYA have evaM eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|
tomAdera ye keha AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati anugata have o sat kArya karave tAke Ami puraskAra diva du’vAra evaM tAra janya rekhechi sammAnajanaka riyka|

he nAvIra patnIrA! tomarA anya nArIdera mata nao, yadi tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara tAhale para-puruSera sAthe komala kanThe emanabhAve kathA valanA yAte antare yAra vyAdhi raYeche se praluvdha haYa evaM tomarA nyAYa saGgata kathA valave|

evaM tomarA svagRhe avasthAna karave; prAcIna jAhelI yugera mata nijederake pradarzana kare ver3AvenA| tomarA sAlAta kAYema karave o yAkAta pradAna karave evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera anugata thAkave; he nAvIra parivAra! AllAha zudhu cAna tomAdera hate apavitratA dUra karate evaM tomAderake sampUrNa rUpe pavitra karate|
AllAhara AYAta o jJAnera kathA, yA tomAdera gRhe paThita haYa, tA tomarA smaraNa rAkhave; AllAha ati sUkSmadarzI, sarva viSaYe avahita|

avazyai Atma-samarpanakArI (musalima) puruSa o Atma-samarpanakArI (musalima) nArI, mu’mina puruSa o mu’minA nArI, anugata puruSa o anugatA nArI, satyavAdI puruSa o satyavAdinI nArI, dhairyazIla puruSa o dhairyazIlA nArI, vinIta puruSa o vinItA nArI, dAnazIla puruSa o dAnazIlA nArI, siYAma pAlanakArI puruSa o siYAma pAlanakArI nArI, yaunAGga hiphAyAtakArI puruSa o yaunAGga hiphAyAtakArI nArI, AllAhake adhika smaraNakArI puruSa o adhika smaraNakArI nArI - edera janya AllAha prastuta rekhechena kSamA o mahA pratidAna|

AllAha o tA~ra rAsUla kona viSaYe nirdeza dile kona mu’mina puruSa kiMvA mu’minA nArIra se viSaYe kona siddhAntera adhikAra thAkavenA| keha AllAha evaM tA~ra rAsUlake amAnya karale seto spaSTai pathabhraSTa|

smaraNa kara, AllAha yAke anugraha karechena evaM tumio yAra prati anugraha karacha, tumi tAke valechileH tumi tomAra strIra sAthe samparka vajAYa rAkha evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara| tumi tomAra antare yA gopana rekhecha AllAha tA prakAza kare dicchena; tumi lokaderake bhaYa karachile, athaca AllAhake bhaYa karAi tomAra pakSe adhikatara saGgata| ataHpara yAYida yakhana tAra (yAinAvera) sAthe viYera sarmpaka chinna karala takhana Ami tAke tomAra sAthe pariNaYa sUtre Avaddha karalAma, yAte mu’minadera poSya putrarA nija strIra sAthe vivAha sUtra chinna karale sei sava ramanIke viYe karAYa mu’minadera janya kona vighna nA haYa| AllAhara Adeza kAryakarI haYei thAke|
AllAha nAvIra janya yA vidhi sammata karechena tA karate tAra janya kona vAdhA nei| pUrve ye sava nAvI atIta haYeche, tAdera kSetreo eTAi chila AllAhara vidhAna| AllAhara vidhAna sunirdhArita|
tArA AllAhara vANI pracAra karata evaM tA~ke bhaYa karata, Ara AllAhake chAr3A anya kehakeo bhaYa karatanA| hisAva grahaNe AllAhai yatheSTa|
muhAmmAda (sAH) tomAdera madhyekAra kona puruSera pitA naYa, kintu (se) AllAhara rasUla evaM zeSa navI| AllAha sarvaviSaYe sarvajJAtA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhake adhika smaraNa kara|
evaM sakAla sandhyAYa AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|

tini tomAdera prati anugraha karena evaM tA~ra mAlAikA/pherezatArAo tomAdera janya anugrahera prArthanA kare andhakAra hate tomAderake AloYa niYe AsAra janya, evaM tini mu’minadera prati parama daYAlu|
yedina tArA AllAhara sAthe sAkSAt karave sedina tAdera prati abhivAdana have ‘sAlAma’| tini tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena uttama pratidAna|
he nAvI! Amito tomAke pAThiYechi sAkSI hisAve evaM susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArI rUpe –
AllAhara anumatikrame tA~ra dike AhavAnakArI rUpe evaM ujjvala pradIpa rUpe|
tumi mu’minaderake susaMvAda dAo ye, tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa raYeche mahA anugraha|
Ara tumi kAphira o munAphikadera kathA zonanA; tAdera niryAtana upekSA kara evaM nirbhara kara AllAhara upara; karmavidhAYaka rUpe AllAhai yatheSTa|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA mu’minA nArIderake viYe karAra para tAderake sparza karAra pUrve tAlAka dile tomAdera janya tAdera pAlanIYa kona iddAta nei yA tomarA gananA karave| tomarA tAderake kichu sAmagrI dive evaM saujanyera sAthe tAderake vidAYa karave|

he nAvI! Ami tomAra janya vaidha karechi tomAra strIderake, yAdera mohara tumi pradAna karecha evaM vaidha karechi ‘phAYa’ hisAve AllAha tomAke yA dAna karechena tanmadhya hate yArA tomAra mAlikAnAdhIna haYeche tAderake evaM viYera janya vaidha karechi tomAra cAcAra kanyA o phuphura kanyAke, mAmAra kanyA o khAlAra kanyAke, yArA tomAra sAthe deza tyAga kareche evaM kona mu’minA nArI nAvIra nikaTa nijeke nivedana karale, evaM nAvI tAke viYe karate cAile seo vaidha| eTA vizeSa kare tomArai janya, anya mu’minadera janya naYa; yAte tomAra kona asuvidhA nA haYa| mu’minadera strI evaM tAdera mAlikAnAdhIna dAsIdera samvandhe yA Ami nirdhArita karechi tA Ami jAni| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tumi tAdera madhye yAke icchA tomAra nikaTa hate dUre rAkhate pAra evaM yAke icchA tomAra nikaTa sthAna dite pAra evaM tumi yAke dUre rekhecha tAke kAmanA karale tomAra kona aparAdha nei| ei vidhAna e janya ye, ete tomAdera tuSTi sahajatara have evaM tArA duHkha pAvenA, Ara tAderake tumi yA dive tAte tAdera pratyekei prIta thAkave| tomAdera antare yA Ache AllAha tA jAnena| AllAha sarvajJa, sahanazIla|

erapara, tomAra janya kona nArI vaidha naYa evaM tomAra strIdera parirvate anya strI grahaNao vaidha naYa yadio tAdera saundarya tomAke mugdha kare, tave tomAra adhikArabhukta dAsIdera vyApAre ei vidhAna prayojya naYa| AllAha sava kichura upara tIkSNa dRSTi rAkhena|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAderake anumati deYA nA hale tomarA khAdya prastuta haoYAra Agei AhArera janya nAvI-gRhe praveza karanA| tave tomAderake AhavAna karale tomarA praveza kara evaM AhAra zeSe tomarA cale yeo; tomarA kathAvArtAYa mazagula haYe par3anA| kAraNa tomAdera ei AcaraNa nAvIke pIr3A deYa, se tomAderake uThiYe dite saMkoca vodha kare| kintu AllAha satya valate saMkoca vodha karenanA| tomarA tAra strIdera nikaTa hate kichu cAile pardAra antarAla hate cAive| ei vidhAna tomAdera o tAdera hRdaYera janya adhikatara pavitra| tomAdera kArao pakSe AllAhara rAsUlake kaSTa deYA athavA tAra mRtyura para tAra strIderake viYe karA saMgata naYa| AllAhara dRSTite eTA ghoratara aparAdha|
tomarA kona viSaYa prakAzai kara athavA gopanai rAkha AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvajJa|

nAvI-patnIdera janya tAdera pitRgaNa, putragaNa, bhrAtRgaNa, bhrAtusputragaNa, bhagnIputragaNa, sevikAgaNa evaM tAdera adhikArabhukta dAsa-dAsIdera sammukhe upasthita haoYAYa kona aparAdha nei| he nAvIra patnigaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara, AllAha savakichu avalokana karena|
AllAha nAvIra prati anugraha karena evaM tA~ra mAlAikArAo nAvIra janya anugraha prArthanA kare| he mu’minagaNa! tomarAo nAvIra janya anugraha prArthanA kara evaM tAke yathAyathabhAve sAlAma jAnAo|
yArA AllAha o rAsUlake pIr3A deYa, AllAha tAderake duniYA o AkhirAte abhizapta karena evaM tini tAdera janya rekhechena lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
mu’mina puruSa o mu’minA nArI kona aparAdha nA karaleo yArA tAderake pIr3A deYa tArA apavAda o spaSTa pApera vojhA vahana kare|

he nAvI! tumi tomAra strIderake, kanyAderake o mu’minA nArIderake valaH tArA yena tAdera cAdarera kiYadaMza nijedera upara Tene deYa| ete tAdera cenA sahajatara have, phale tAderake utyakta karA havenA| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

munAphikarA evaM yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache evaM yArA nagare gujava raTanA kare, tArA virata nA hale Ami nizcaYai tAdera viruddhe tomAke pravala karava; erapara ei nagarIte tomAra prativezI rUpe tArA svalpa samaYai thAkave –
abhizapta haYe, tAderake yekhAnei pAoYA yAve sekhAnei dharA have evaM nirdaYabhAve hatyA karA have|
pUrve yArA atIta haYe geche tAdera vyApAre eTAi chila AllAhara vidhAna| tumi kakhanao AllAhara vidhAne kona parivartana pAvenA|
lokerA tomAke kiYAmAta samparke jijJesa karache| valaH era jJAna zudhu AllAharai Ache| tumi eTA ki kare jAnave ye, sambhavataH kiYAmAta zIghrai haYe yete pAre?
AllAha kAphiraderake abhizapta karechena evaM tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena jvalanta Aguna|
sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM tArA kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI pAvenA|
yedina tAdera mukha-manDala Agune ulaTa pAlaTa karA have sedina tArA valaveH hAYa! AmarA yadi AllAhake mAnatAma o rAsUlake mAnatAma!
tArA Arao valaveH he AmAdera rAvava! AmarA AmAdera netA o var3a lokadera Anugatya karechilAma evaM tArA AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila|
he AmAdera rAvva! tAderake dviguNa zAsti pradAna karuna evaM tAderake dina mahA abhisampAta|
he mu’minagaNa! mUsAke yArA kleza diYeche tomarA tAdera mata haYonA; tArA yA raTanA karechila AllAha tA hate tAke nirdoSa pramANita karena; evaM AllAhara nikaTa se maryAdAvAna|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM saThika kathA vala|
tAhale tini tomAdera kAjake kraTimukta karavena evaM tomAdera pApa kSamA karavena| yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kare tArA avazyai mahAsAphalya arjana karave|

Amito AsamAna, yamIna o pavartamAlAra prati ei AmAnata arpaNa karechilAma, tArA eTA vahana karate asvIkAra karala evaM ote zaMkita hala, kintu mAnuSa oTA vahana karala; seto atizaYa yAlima, atizaYa ajJa|
pariNAme AllAha munAphika puruSa o munAphika nArI evaM muzarika puruSa o muzarika nArIke zAsti divena evaM AllAha mu’mina puruSa o mu’minA nArIke kSamA karavena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
prazaMsA AllAhara yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache sava kichurai mAlika evaM AkhirAteo prazaMsA tA~rai| tini prajJAmaYa, sarva viSaYe avahita|
tini jAnena yA bhUmite praveza kare, tA hate yA nirgata haYa evaM yA AkAza hate varSita haYa o yA kichu AkAze utthita haYa| tinii parama daYAlu, kSamAzIla|

kAphirerA valeH AmAdera upara kiYAmAta AsavenA| valaH Asavei, zapatha AmAra ravera! nizcaYai tomAdera nikaTa oTA Asave| tini adRzya samvandhe samyaka parijJAta; AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte tA~ra agocara naYa aNu parimANa kichu kiMvA tadapekSA kSudra athavA vRhat kichu; varaM ora pratyekaTi lipivaddha Ache suspaSTa kitAve|
eTA e janya ye, yArA mu’mina o sat karmaparAYaNa tini tAderake puraskRta karavena| tAderai janya Ache kSamA o sammAnajanaka riyka|
yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vyartha karAra ceSTA kare tAdera janya raYeche bhaYaMkara marmantuda zAsti|
yAderake jJAna deYA haYeche tArA jAne ye, tomAra ravera nikaTa hate tomAra prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tA satya| ihA mAnuSake parAkramazAlI o prazaMsA AllAhara patha nirdeza kare|
kAphirerA valeH AmarA ki tomAderake emana vyaktira sandhAna diva ye tomAderake vale tomAdera deha sampUrNa chinnabhinna haYe par3aleo tomarA sRSTi rUpe utthita have?
se ki AllAha samvandhe mithyA udbhAvana kare athavA se ki unmAda? vastutaH yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa karenA tArA zAsti o ghora vibhrAntite raYeche|

tArA ki tAdera sammukhe o pazcAte, AsamAna o yamIne yA Ache tAra prati lakSya karenA? Ami icchA karale tAderakesaha bhUmi dhvasiYe diva athavA tAdera upara AkAza manDalera patana ghaTAva; AllAhara abhimukhI pratiTi vAndAra janya ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche|
Ami nizcaYai dAUdera prati anugraha karechilAma evaM Adeza karechilAma, he pavartamAlA! tomarA dAUdera sAthe AmAra pavitratA ghoSaNA kara evaM vihaMgakUlakeo| tAra janya namanIYa karechilAma lauha –
(ei Adeza kare) ‘tumi pUrNa mApera varma tairI kara, kar3AsamUha yathAyathabhAve saMyukta kara evaM tomarA sat kAja kara’, tomarA yA kichu kara Ami ora samyaka draSTA|

sulAimAnera adhIna karechilAma vAYuke yA prabhAte eka mAsera patha atikrama karata evaM sandhyAYa eka mAsera patha atikrama karata| Ami tAra janya galita tAmrera eka prasravana pravAhita karechilAma| evaM chila jina sampradAYa yArA tAdera ravera anumatikrame nijedera kataka tAra sAmane kAja karata| tAdera madhye ye AmAra nirdeza amAnya kare tAke Ami jvalanta agnira zAsti AsvAdana karAva|

tArA sulAimAnera icchAnuyAYI prAsAda, bhAskarya, hAuya sadRza vRhadAkAra pAtra evaM sudRr3ha bhAve cullira upara sthApita vRhadAkAra Dega nirmANa karata| (Ami valechilAma) he dAuda parivAra! kRtajJatAra sAthe tomarA kAja karate thAka| AmAra vAndAdera madhye alpai kRtajJa|

yakhana Ami sulAimAnera mRtyu ghaTAlAma takhana jinaderake tAra mRtyu viSaYa jAnAlo zudhu mATira pokA yA sulAimAnera lAThi khAcchila| yakhana sulAimAna par3e gela takhana jinerA vujhate pArala ye, tArA yadi adRzya viSaYa avagata thAkata tAhale tArA lAJchanAdAYaka zAstite Avaddha thAkatanA|

sAvAvAsIdera janya tAdera vAsabhUmite chila eka nidarzana! du’Ti udyAna, ekaTi DAna dike, aparaTi vAma dike| tAderake valA haYechilaH tomarA tomAdera rAvava pradatta riyka bhoga kara evaM tA~ra prati kRtajJatA prakAza kara| uttama ei sthAna evaM kSamAzIla tomAdera rAvava!

ataHpara tArA Adeza amAnya karala| phale Ami tAdera upara pravAhita karalAma vA~dhabhAGgA vanyA evaM tAdera udyAna du’Ti parivartana kare dilAma emana du’Ti udyAne yAte utpanna haYa visvAda phala-mUla, jhAu gAcha evaM kichu kula gAcha|
Ami tAderake ei zAsti diYechilAma tAdera kupharIra kAraNe| Ami kRtaghna vyatIta Ara kehakeo emana zAsti diinA|

tAdera evaM ye sava janapadera prati Ami anugraha karechilAma seigulira antarvartI sthAne dRzyamAna vahu janapada sthApana karechilAma evaM ai sava janapade bhramaNera yathAyatha vyavasthA karechilAma evaM tAderake valechilAmaH tomarA ei sava janapade nirApade bhramaNa kara dine o rAte|

kintu tArA valalaH he AmAdera rAvava! AmAdera sapharera mAnayilagulira vyavadhAna vardhita karuna! ebhAve tArA nijedera prati yulama karechila| phale Ami tAderake kAhinIra viSaYavastute pariNata karalAma evaM tAderake chinna-bhinna kare dilAma| ete pratyeka dhairyazIla, kRtajJa vyaktira janya nidarzana raYeche|
tAdera samvandhe ivalIsa tAra dhAraNA satya pramANa karala, phale tAdera madhye ekaTi mu’mina dala vyatIta savAi tAra anusaraNa karala|
tAdera upara zAitAnera kona Adhipatya chilanA| kArA AkhirAte vizvAsI evaM kArA ote sandihAna tA prakAza kare deYAi chila AmAra uddezya| tomAra rAvava sarva viSaYera tattvAvadhAYaka|

tumi valaH tomarA AhavAna kara tAderake yAderake tomarA AllAhara parivarte mA‘vUda mane karate| tArA AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte aNu parimAna kono kichura mAlika naYa evaM etadubhaYe tAdera kona aMza nei evaM nA tA~rA sAhAyyakArI|

yAke anumati deYA haYa se chAr3A AllAhara nikaTa kArao supAriza phalaprasu havenA| ataHpara yakhana tAdera antara hate bhaYa vidurita have takhana tArA parasparera madhye jijJAsAvAda karaveH tomAdera rAvava ki valalena? taduttare tArA valaveH yA satya tini tAi valechena| tini samucca, mahAna|
valaH AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI hate ke tomAke riyka pradAna kare? valaH AllAha! evaM nizcaYai AmarA athavA tomarA sat pathe sthita athavA spaSTa vibhrAntite patita|
valaH AmAdera aparAdhera janya tomAderake javAvadihi karate havenA evaM tomarA yA kara se samparke AmAderakeo javAvadihi karate havenA|
valaH AmAdera rAvava AmAderake ekatrita karavena, ataHpara tini AmAdera madhye nyAYera sAthe phAisAlA kare divena, tinii zreSTha phAisAlAkArI, sarvajJa|
valaH tomarA AmAke dekhAo tAderake yAderake zarIka rUpe tA~ra sAthe jur3e diYecha| nA, kakhanao naYa| vastutaH AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Amito tomAke samagra mAnava jAtira prati susaMvAda dAtA o satarkakArI rUpe preraNa karechi| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa jAnenA|
tArA jijJesa kareH tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, ei pratizruti kakhana vAstavAYita have?
valaH tomAdera janya Ache eka nirdhArita dina yA muhurtakAla vilamvita karate pAravenA, tvarAnvitao karate pAravenA|

kAphirerA valeH AmarA ei kuraAne kakhanao vizvAsa sthApana karavanA, era pUrvavartI kitAvasamUheo nA| hAYa! tumi yadi dekhate! yAlimaderake yakhana tAdera ravera sAmane danDAYamAna karA have takhana tArA paraspara vAda prativAda karate thAkave| yAderake durvala mane karA hata tArA kSamatAdarpIderake valaveH tomarA nA thAkale AmarA avazyai mu’mina hatAma|

yArA kSamatAdarpI chila tArA yAderake durvala mane karA hata tAderake valaveH tomAdera nikaTa sat pathera dizA AsAra para AmarA ki tomAderake oTA hate nivRtta karechilAma? vastutaH tomarAito chile aparAdhI|

yAderake durvala mane karA hata tArA kSamatAdarpIderake valaveH prakRta pakSe tomarAito dina-rAta cakrAnte lipta chile, AmAderake nirdeza diYechile yena AmarA AllAhake amAnya kari evaM tA~ra zarIka sthApana kari| yakhana tArA zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana tArA anutApa gopana rAkhave evaM Ami kAphiradera galadeze zRMkhala pariYe diva| tArA yA karata tArai pratiphala tAderake deYA have|
yakhanai Ami kona janapade satarkakArI preraNa karechi takhanai ora vittazAlI adhivAsIrA valecheH tomarA yA saha prerita haYecha AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna kari|
tArA Arao valataH AmarA dhane-jane samRddhazAlI; sutarAM AmAderake kichutei zAsti deYA havenA|
valaH AmAra rAvava yAra prati icchA riyka vardhita karena, athavA eTA sImita karena; kintu adhikAMza lokai eTA jAnenA|

tomAdera dhana sampada o santAna-santati emana kichu naYa yA tomAderake AmAra nikaTavartI kare dive; yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tArAi tAdera karmera janya pAve vahuguNa puraskAra; Ara tArA prAsAde nirApade thAkave|
yArA AmAra AYAtake vyartha karAra ceSTA karave tArA zAsti bhoga karate thAkave|
valaH AmAra rAvava tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA tAra riyka vardhita karena athavA oTA sImita karena| tomarA yA kichu vyaYa karave tini tAra pratidAna divena| tini zreSTha riykadAtA|
yedina tAdera ekatra karavena evaM mAlAikA/pherezatAderake jijJesa karavenaH erA ki tomAderai pUjA karata?
mAlAikA valaveH Apani pavitra, mahAna! AmAdera sAhAyyakArI Apanii, tArA naYa, tArAto pUjA karata jinadera evaM tAdera adhikAMzai chila tAdera prati vizvAsI|
Aja tomAdera eke anyera upakAra kiMvA apakAra karAra kSamatA nei| yArA yul‌ma karechila tAderake valavaH tomarA ye Agunera zAsti asvIkAra karate tA AsvAdana kara|

tAdera nikaTa yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAtasamUha AvRtti karA haYa takhana tArA valeH tomAdera pUrva-puruSa yAra ivAdAta karata ei vyaktiito tAra ivAdAte tomAderake vA~dhA dite cAYa| tArA Arao valeH eTAto mithyA udbhAvana vyatIta kichu naYa| evaM kAphiradera nikaTa yakhana satya Ase takhana tArA valeH eTAto eka suspaSTa yAdu!
Ami tAderake pUrve kona kitAva diini yA tArA adhyaYana karata evaM tomAra pUrve tAdera nikaTa kona satarkakArIo preraNa karini|

tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyA Aropa karechila| tAderake Ami yA diYechilAma erA tAra eka dazamAMzao pAYani, tavuo tArA AmAra rAsUladerake mithyAvAdI valechila| phale kata bhaYaMkara haYechila AmAra zAsti!

valaH Ami tomAderake ekaTi viSaYe upadeza dicchi, tomarA AllAhara uddeze dui jana athavA eka jana kare dA~r3Ao, ataHpara tomarA cintA kare dekha - tomAdera saMgI Adau unmAda naYa| seto Asanna kaThina zAsti samparke tomAdera satarkakArI mAtra|
valaH Ami tomAdera nikaTa kona pArizramika ceYe thAkale tA tomAderai, AmAra puraskArato Ache AllAhara nikaTa evaM tini sarva viSaYe draSTA|
valaH AmAra rAvava satya nikSepa karena; tini adRzyera parijJAtA|
valaH satya eseche evaM asatya nA pAre natuna kichu sRSTi karate evaM nA pAre punarAvRtti karate|
valaH Ami vibhrAnta hale vibhrAntira pariNAma AmArai evaM yadi Ami sat pathe thAki tAhale tA e janya ye, AmAra prati AmAra rAvava ahI preraNa karena| tini sarvazrotA, sannikaTa|
tumi yadi dekhate yakhana tArA bhIta vihavala haYe par3ave! tArA avyAhati pAvenA evaM tArA nikaTastha sthAna hate dhRta have|
Ara tArA valaveH AmarA tA~ke vizvAsa karalAma| kintu eta dUravartI sthAna hate tArA nAgAla pAve kirUpe?
tArAto pUrve tAke pratyAkhyAna karechila; tArA dUravartI sthAna hate adRzya viSaYe vAkya chur3e mArata|
tAdera o tAdera pravRttira mAjhe antarAla karA haYeche, yemana pUrve karA haYechila tAdera samapanthIdera kSetre| tArA chila vibhrAntikara sandehera madhye|

prazaMsA AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA AllAharai yini vANIvAhaka karena mAlAikA/pherezatAderake yArA dui dui, tina tina athavA cAra cAra pAkhA viziSTa| tini tA~ra sRSTite yA icchA sRSTi karena| AllAha sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|
AllAha mAnuSera prati kona anugraha avArita karale keha oTA nivArana karate pArenA evaM tini kichu niruddha karate cAile ataHpara keha ora ummuktakArI nei| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he mAnuSa! tomAdera prati AllAhara anugraha smaraNa kara| AllAha chAr3A ki kona sraSTA Ache ye tomAderake AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI hate riyka dAna kare? tini chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei| sutarAM kothAYa tomarA vipathe cAlita haccha?
tArA yadi tomAra prati mithyA Aropa kare tAhale tomAra pUrveo rAsUladera prati mithyA Aropa karA haYechila| AllAhara nikaTai sava kichu pramANita have|
he mAnuSa! AllAhara pratizruti satya; sutarAM pArthiva jIvana yena tomAderake kichutei pratArita nA kare evaM sei pravaJcaka yena kichutei AllAha samparke pravaJcita nA kare tomAderake|
zAitAna tomAdera zatru; sutarAM tAke zatru hisAve grahaNa kara| seto tAra dalavalake AhavAna kare zudhu e janya ye, tArA yena uttapta jAhAnnAmera sAthI haYa|
yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya Ache kaThina zAsti, kintu yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tAdera janya Ache kSamA o mahA puraskAra|

kehakeo yadi tAra manda kAja zobhana kare dekhAno haYa evaM se oTAke uttama mane kare sei vyakti ki tAra samAna ye sat kAja kare? AllAha yAke icchA vibhrAnta karena evaM yAke icchA sat pathe paricAlita karena| ataeva tumi tAdera janya AkSepa kare tomAra prANake dhvaMsa karanA| tArA yA kare AllAha tA jAnena|

AllAhai vAYu preraNa kare tA dvArA meghamAlA saJcAlita karena| ataHpara Ami tA nirjIva bhU-khanDera dike paricAlita kari, ataHpara Ami oTA dvArA dharitrIke ora mRtyura para saJjIvita kari| punarutthAna e rUpei have|

keha kSamatA cAile se jene rAkhuka ye, samasta kSamatAto AllAharai| tA~rai dike pavitra vANIsamUha ArohaNa kare evaM sat kAja oke unnIta kare, Ara yArA manda karmera phandi ATe tAdera janya Ache kaThina zAsti| tAdera phandi vyartha havei|

AllAha tomAderake sRSTi karechena mATi hate; ataHpara zukra vindu hate, ataHpara tomAderake karechena yugala! AllAhara ajJAtasAre kona nArI garbha dhAraNa karenA evaM prasavao karenA; kona dIrghAYu vyaktira AYu vRddhi karA haYanA athavA tAra AYu hrAsa karA haYanA| kintu tAto raYeche kitAve| eTA AllAhara janya sahaja|

du’Ti dariYA ekarUpa naYa; ekaTira pAni sumiSTa o supeYa, aparaTira pAni lonA, khara| pratyekaTi hate tomarA tAjA gozata AhAra kara evaM alaMkAra yA tomarA paridhAna kara, evaM ratnAvalI AharaNa kara evaM tomarA dekha ye, ora vuka cire nauyAna calAcala kare yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha anusandhAna karate pAra evaM yAte tomarA kRtajJa hao|

tini rAtake dine praveza karAna evaM dinake praveza karAna rAte| tini sUrya o cA~dake karechena niYantrita; pratyeke paribhramaNa kare eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta| tinii AllAha! tomAdera rAvava! sArvabhaumatva tA~rai| Ara tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka tArAto khejura vIcira AvaraNerao adhikArI naYa|

tomarA tAderake AhavAna karale tArA tomAdera AhavAna zunavenA evaM zunaleo tomAdera AhavAne sAr3A divenA| tomarA tAderake ye zarIka karacha tA tArA kiYAmAta divase asvIkAra karave| tA~ra mata kehai tomAke avahita karate pArenA, tini sarvajJa|
he loka sakala! tomarAto AllAhara mukhApekSI, kintu AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsA|
tini icchA karale tomAderake apasAraNa karate pArena evaM eka nUtana sRSTi AnaYana karate pArena|
eTA AllAhara pakSe kaThina naYa|

kona vahanakArI anyera vojhA vahana karavenA, kona bhArAkrAnta vyakti yadi kehakeo eTA vahana karate AhavAna kare tAhale tAra kichui vahana karA havenA, nikaTa AtmIYa haleo| tumi zudhu satarka karate pAra tAderake yArA tAdera rAvavake nA dekhe bhaYa kare evaM sAlAta kAYema kare| ye keha nijeke parizodhana kare seto parizodhana kare nijerai kalyANera janya| pratyAvartanato AllAharai nikaTa|
samAna naYa andha o cakSummAna,
andhakAra o Alo,
chAYA o roda,
Ara samAna naYa jIvita o mRta| AllAha yAke icchA zravaNa karAna| tumi zonAte samartha havenA yArA kAvare raYeche tAderake|
tumi ekajana satarkakArI mAtra|
Ami tomAke satyasaha preraNa karechi susaMvAda dAtA o satarkakArI rUpe; emana kona sampradAYa nei yAra nikaTa satarkakArI prerita haYani|
tArA yadi tomAra prati mithyA Aropa kare tAhale tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyA Aropa karechila; tAdera nikaTa esechila tAdera rAsUlagaNa suspaSTa nidarzana, granthAdi o dIptimAna kitAvasaha|
ataHpara Ami kAphiraderake zAsti diYechilAma| ki bhaYaMkara AmAra zAsti!
tumi ki dekhanA ye, AllAha AkAza hate vRSTi varSana karena evaM uhA dvArA Ami vicitra varNera phalamUla udgata kari? pAhAr3era madhye Ache vicitra varNera phala - zubhra, lAla o nikaSa kAlo|
ebhAve raM veraMYera mAnuSa, jAnoYAra o catuspada jantu raYeche| AllAhara vAndAdera madhye yArA jJAnI tArAi tA~ke bhaYa kare; AllAha parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|
yArA AllAhara kitAva pATha kare, sAlAta kAYema kare, Ami tAderake ye riyka diYechi tA gopane o prakAzye vyaYa kare, tArAi AzA karate pAre tAdera emana vyavasAYera yAra kSaYa nei –
e janya ye, AllAha tAdera karmera pUrNa pratiphala divena evaM nija anugrahe tAderake Aro vezi divena| tinito kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|
Ami tomAra prati ye kitAva avatIrNa karechi tA satya| eTA pUrvavartI kitAvera samarthaka| AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera sava kichu jAnena o dekhena|

ataHpara Ami kitAvera adhikArI karalAma AmAra vAndAdera madhye tAderake yAderake Ami manonIta karechi; tave tAdera keha nijera prati atyAcArI, keha madhya panthI evaM keha AllAhara icchAYa kalyANera kAje agragAmI| eTAi mahA anugraha|
tArA praveza karave sthAYI jAnnAte, sekhAne tAderake svarNa nirmita kaMkana o muktA dvArA alaMkRta karA have evaM sekhAne tAdera pozAka paricchada have rezamera|
evaM tArA valaveH prazaMsA AllAhara yini AmAdera duHkha durdazA dUrIbhUta karechena! AmAdera rAvavato kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|
yini nija anugrahe AmAderake sthAYI AvAsa diYechena, yekhAne kleza AmAderake sparza kare nA| evaM klAntio sparza kare nA|

kintu yArA kupharI kare tAdera janya Ache jAhAnnAmera Aguna| tAdera mRtyura Adeza deYA havenA ye, tArA marave evaM tAdera janya jAhAnnAmera zAstio lAghava karA havenA| ebhAve Ami pratyeka akRtajJake zAsti diYe thAki|

sekhAne tArA ArtanAda kare valaveH he AmAdera rAvava! AmAderake niskRti dina, AmarA sat kAja karava, pUrve yA karatAma tA karavanA| AllAha valavenaH Ami ki tomAderake eta dIrgha jIvana dAna karini ye, takhana keha satarka hate cAile satarka hate pArate? tomAdera nikaTato satarkakArIrAo esechila| sutarAM zAsti AsvAdana kara; yAlimadera kona sAhAyyakArI nei|
AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYa avagata Achena| antare yA raYeche se samvandhe tini savizeSa avahita|

tinii tomAderake pRthivIte pratinidhi karechena| sutarAM keha kupharI karale tAra kupharIra janya se nijei dAYI have| kAphiradera kupharI zudhu tAdera ravera krodhai vRddhi kare evaM kAphiradera kupharI tAdera kSatii vRddhi kare|

valaH tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka sesava devadevIra kathA bheve dekhecha ki? tArA pRthivIte kichu sRSTi kare thAkale AmAke dekhAo; athavA AkAzamanDalI sRSTite tAdera kona aMza Ache ki? nA ki Ami tAderake emana kona kitAva diYechi yAra pramANera upara erA nirbhara kare? vastutaH yAlimarA eke aparake mithyA pratizruti diYe thAke|
AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIke saMrakSaNa karena yAte orA sthAnacyUta nA haYa, orA sthAnacyUta hale tini vyatIta ke oderake saMrakSaNa karave? tini ati sahanazIla, kSamAparAYaNa|

tArA dRr3hatAra sAthe AllAhara zapatha kare valata ye, tAdera nikaTa kona satarkakArI ele tArA anya sava sampradAYa apekSA sat pathera adhikatara anusArI have| kintu tAdera nikaTa yakhana satarkakArI elo takhana tArA zudhu tAdera vimukhatAi vRddhi karala –

pRthivIte auddhatya prakAza evaM kUTa Sar3ayantrera kAraNe| kUTa Sar3ayantra ora udyoktAderakei pariveSTana kare| tAhale ki tArA pratIkSA karache pUrvavartIdera prati prayukta vidhAnera? kintu tumi AllAhara vidhAnera kakhanao kona parivartana pAvenA evaM AllAhara vidhAnera kona vyatikramao dekhavenA|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni? tAhale tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma ki haYechila tA dekhate peta| tArAto edera apekSA adhikatara zaktizAlI chila| AllAha emana nana ye, AkAzamanDalI evaM pRthivIra kona kichui tA~ke akSama karate pAre; tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha mAnuSake tAdera kRtakarmera janya zAsti dile bhUpRSThera kona jIva jantukei rehAi ditenana|, kintu tini eka nirdiSTakAla paryanta tAderake avakAza diYe thAkena| ataHpara tAdera nirdiSTa kAla ese gele AllAha havena tA~ra vAndAdera samyaka draSTA|
iYA sIna|
zapatha jJAnagarbha kuraAnera|
tumi avazyai rAsUladera antarbhukta|
tumi sarala pathe pratiSThita|
kuraAna avatIrNa parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu AllAhara nikaTa hate|
yAte tumi satarka karate pAra emana eka jAtike yAdera pitR-puruSaderake satarka karA haYani, yAra phale tArA gAphila|
tAdera adhikAMzera janya sei vANI avadhArita haYeche; sutarAM tArA ImAna AnavenA|
Ami tAdera galadeze civuka paryanta ver3i pariYechi, phale tArA urdhvamukhI haYe geche|
Ami tAdera sammukhe prAcIra o pazcAte prAcIra sthApana karechi evaM tAderake AvRta karechi, phale tArA dekhate pAYanA|
tumi tAderake satarka kara kiMvA nA kara tAdera janya ubhaYai samAna; tArA ImAna AnavenA|
tumi zudhu tAderakei satarka karate pAra yArA upadeza mene cale evaM nA dekhe daYAmaYa rAhamAnake bhaYa kare| ataeva tumi tAderake kSamA o mahA puraskArera saMvAda dAo|
Amii mRtake kari jIvita evaM likhe rAkhi yA tArA agre preraNa kare evaM yA tArA pazcAte rekhe yAYa, Ami pratyeka viSaYake spaSTa kitAve saMrakSita rekhechi|
tAdera nikaTa upasthita kara eka janapadera adhivAsIdera dRSTAnta; tAdera nikaTa esechila rAsUlagaNa|

yakhana Ami tAdera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma du’jana rAsUla, kintu tArA tAderake mithyAvAdI valala; takhana Ami tAderake zaktizAlI karechilAma tRtIYa ekajana dvArA evaM tArA valechilaH AmarAto tomAdera nikaTa prerita haYechi|
tArA valalaH tomarAto AmAdera mata mAnuSa, daYAmaYa kichui avatIrNa karenani, tomarA zudhu mithyAi valacha|
tArA valalaH AmAdera rAvva jAnena ye, AmarA avazyai tomAdera nikaTa prerita haYechi|
spaSTabhAve pracAra karAi AmAdera dAYitva|

tArA valalaH AmarA tomAderake amaGgalera kAraNa mane kari| yadi tomarA virata nA hao tAhale tomAderake avazyai prastarAghAte hatyA karava evaM AmAdera pakSa hate tomAdera upara yantraNAdAYaka zAsti avazyai Apatita have|
tArA valalaH tomAdera amaGgala tomAderai sAthe, eTA ki e janya ye, AmarA tomAderake upadeza dicchi? vastutaH tomarA eka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|
nagarIra prAnta hate eka vyakti chuTe elo, se valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! rAsUladera anusaraNa kara|
anusaraNa kara tAdera yArA tomAdera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAYanA evaM tArA sat pathaprApta|
AmAra ki yukti Ache ye, yini AmAke sRSTi karechena evaM yA~ra nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have Ami tA~ra ivAdAta karavanA?
Ami ki tA~ra parivarte anya mA‘vUda grahaNa karava? daYAmaYa (AllAha) AmAke kSatigrasta karate cAile tAdera supAriza AmAra kona kAje AsavenA evaM tArA AmAke uddhArao karate pAravenA|
erUpa karale Ami avazyai spaSTa vibhrAntite patita hava|
Amito tomAdera ravera upara ImAna enechi, ataeva tomarA AmAra kathA zona|
tAke valA halaH jAnnAte praveza kara| se vale uThalaH hAYa! AmAra sampradAYa yadi jAnate pArata –
ki kAraNe AmAra rAvva AmAke kSamA karechena evaM sammAnita karechena|
Ami tAra mRtyura para tAra sampradAYera viruddhe AkAza hate kona vAhinI preraNa karini evaM preraNera praYojanao chilanA|
oTA chila zudhumAtra eka mahAnAda| phale tArA nithara nistavdha haYe gela|
paritApa vAndAdera janya! tAdera nikaTa yakhanai kona rAsUla eseche takhanai tArA tAke ThATTA vidrupa kareche|
tArA ki lakSya karenA ye, tAdera pUrve kata mAnavagoSThIke Ami dhvaMsa karechi yArA tAdera madhye phire AsavenA?
evaM avazyai tAdera sakalake ekatre AmAra nikaTa upasthita karA have|
tAdera janya ekaTi nidarzana mRta dharitrI, yAke Ami saJjIvita kari evaM yA hate utpanna kari zasya, yA tArA AhAra kare|
tAte Ami sRSTi kari khejura o AGgurera udyAna evaM utsArita kari prasravaNa –
yAte tArA AhAra karate pAre era phalamUla hate, athaca tAdera hAta oTA sRSTi kareni| tavuo ki tArA kRtajJatA prakAza karavenA?
pavitra mahAna tini, yini udbhida, mAnuSa evaM tArA yAderake jAnenA tAdera pratyekake sRSTi karechena jor3AYa jor3AYa|
tAdera eka nidarzana rAta, oTA hate Ami divAloka apasArita kari, takhana sakalei andhakArAcchanna haYe par3e|
evaM sUrya bhramaNa kare ora nirdiSTa gantavyera dike| eTA parAkramazAlI, sarvajJera niYantraNa|
evaM candrera janya Ami nirdiSTa karechi vibhinna mAnayila, avazeSe oTA zuSka vakra purAtana khejura zAkhAra AkAra dhAraNa kare|
sUryera pakSe sambhava naYa cA~dera nAgAla pAoYA eraM rAtera pakSe sambhava naYa dinake atikrama karA; evaM pratyeke nija nija kakSapathe sAtAra kATe|
tAdera eka nidarzana ei ye, Ami tAdera vaMzadharadera vojhAi nauyAne ArohaNa kariYechilAma|

tAdera nikaTa ki raYeche anugrahera bhAnDAra tomAra ravera, yini parAkramazAlI, mahAna dAtA?
tAdera ki sArvabhaumatva Ache AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera antavartI sava kichura upara? thAkale tArA sir3i veYe ArohaNa karuka|
vahu dalera ei vAhinIo se kSetre avazyai parAjita have|
tAdera pUrveo rAsUladerake mithyAvAdI valechila nUhera sampradAYa, ‘Ada, vahu zivirera adhipati phira‘Auna –
Ara sAmUda, lUta sampradAYa o AikA’ra adhivAsI| tArA chila eka ekaTi vizAla vAhinI|
tAdera pratyekei rAsUladerake mithyAvAdI valeche| phale tAdera kSetre AmAra zAsti haYeche yathArtha|
tArAto apekSA karache ekaTi mAtra pracanDa ninAdera yAte kona virAma thAkavenA|
tArA valeH he AmAdera rAvva! vicAra dinera pUrvei AmAdera prApya AmAderake zIghra diYe dAo|
tArA yA vale tAte tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara| Ara smaraNa kara, AmAra zaktizAlI vAndA dAUdera kathA; se chila atizaYa AllAhara abhimukhI|
Ami niYojita karechilAma parvatamAlAke, orA sakAla sandhyAYa tAra sAthe AmAra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karata|
evaM samaveta vihaMkulakeo, savAi chila tAra abhimukhI|
Ami tAra rAjyake sudRr3ha karechilAma evaM tAke diYechilAma prajJA o phAisAlAkArI vAgmitA|
tomAra nikaTa vivAdakArI lokera vRttAnta pau~cheche ki, yakhana tArA prAcIra DiGgiYe ela ivAdAtakhAnAYa –

evaM dAudera nikaTa pau~chala, takhana tAdera kAraNe se bhIta haYe par3ala| tArA valalaH bhIta havenanA, AmarA dui vivAdamAna pakSa - AmarA eke aparera upara yul‌ma karechi; ataeva AmAdera madhye nyAYa vicAra karuna, avicAra karavenanA evaM AmAderake saThika patha nirdeza karuna|
e AmAra bhAi - era Ache nirAnavvaiTi dumvA evaM AmAra Ache mAtra ekaTi dumvA; tavuo se vale AmAra jimmAYa eTi diYe dAo, evaM kathAYa se AmAra prati kaThoratA pradarzana kareche|

dAuda valalaH tomAra dumvATike tAra dumvAgulira sAthe yukta karAra dAvI kare se tomAra prati yul‌ma kareche| zarIkadera aneke eke anyera upara avicAra kare thAke, karenA zudhu mu’mina o sat karmazIla vyaktirA evaM tArA saMkhyAYa svalpa| dAuda vujhate pArala ye, Ami tAke parIkSA karalAma| ataHpara se tAra ravera nikaTa kSamA prArthanA karala evaM nata haYe luTiYe par3ala o tA~ra abhimukhI hala| [sAjadAha]
ataHpara Ami tAra kraTi kSamA karalAma| AmAra nikaTa tAra janya raYeche ucca maryAdA o zubha pariNAma|

he dAuda! Ami tomAke pRthivIte pratinidhi karechi, ataeva tumi lokadera madhye suvicAra kara evaM kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa karanA, kenanA eTA tomAke AllAhara patha hate vicyuta karave| yArA AllAhara patha parityAga kare tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti, kAraNa tArA vicAra dinake vismRta haYe Ache|
Ami AkAza o pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera madhyasthita kona kichui anarthaka sRSTi karini, yadio kAphiradera dhAraNA tAi| sutarAM kAphiradera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera durbhoga|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare evaM yArA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi kare ver3AYa Ami ki tAderake samaganya karava? Ami ki muttAkIderake aparAdhIdera samAna ganya karava?
eka kalyANamaYa kitAva ihA, Ami tomAra upara avatIrNa karechi, yAte mAnuSa era AYAtasamUha anudhAvana kare evaM vodhazaktisampanna vyaktirA upadeza grahaNa kare|
Ami dAUdake dAna karalAma sulAimAna| se chila uttama vAndA evaM se chila atizaYa AllAha abhimukhI|
yakhana aparAhne tAra sAmane dhAvamAna utkRSTa azvarAjike upasthita karA hala –
takhana se valalaH Amito AmAra ravera smaraNa hate vimukha haYe aizvarya prItite magna haYe par3echi, edike sUrya astamita haYe geche|
oguloke punarAYa AmAra sAmane niYe eso| ataHpara se ogulora pA o galadeza chedana karate lAgala|
Ami sulAimAnake parIkSA karalAma evaM tAra Asanera upara rAkhalAma ekaTi deha; ataHpara sulAimAna AmAra abhimukhI hala|
se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke kSamA karuna evaM emana eka rAjya dAna karuna yAra adhikArI Ami chAr3A Ara keha nA haYa| Apanito parama dAtA|
takhana Ami tAra adhIna kare dilAma vAYuke yA tAra Adeze, se yekhAne icchA karata sekhAne mRdumanda gatite pravAhita hata|
evaM zAitAnaderake, yArA savAi chila prAsAda nirmANakArI o DuvurI|
evaM zRMkhale Avaddha karalAma Arao anekake|
esava AmAra anugraha, eTA tumi anyake dite athavA nije rAkhate pAra| e janya tomAke hisAva dite havenA|
evaM AmAra nikaTa tAra janya raYeche ucca maryAdA o zubha pariNAma|
smaraNa kara AmAra vAndA AiYuvake! yakhana se tAra rAvvake AhavAna kare valechilaH zAitAnato AmAke yantraNA o kaSTe pheleche|
Ami tAke valalAmaH tumi tomAra pA dvArA bhUmite AghAta kara, eito gosalera suzItala pAni o pAna karAra pAnIYa|
Ami tAke dilAma tAra parijanavarga o tAdera mata Arao, AmAra anugrahasvarUpa o vodhazaktisampanna lokadera janya upadezasvarUpa|
Ami tAke Adeza karalAmaH eka muSTi tRNa tule nAo evaM tA dvArA AghAta kara o zapatha bhaGga karanA| Ami tAke pelAma dhairyazIla| kata uttama vAndA se! se chila AmAra abhimukhI|
smaraNa kara, AmAra vAndA ivarAhIma, isahAka o iYAkUvera kathA, tArA chila zaktizAlI o sUkSmadarzI|
Ami tAderake adhikArI karechilAma eka vizeSa guNera, oTA chila parakAlera smaraNa|
avazyai tArA chila AmAra manonIta o uttama vAndAdera antarbhukta|
smaraNa kara isamAIla, Ala iYAsAA’ o yulakiphalera kathA, tArA pratyekei chila sajjana|
eTA eka smaraNIYa varNanA evaM muttAkIdera janya raYeche uttama AvAsa –
cirasthAYI jAnnAta, tAdera janya ummukta raYeche yAra dvAra|
sekhAne tArA AsIna have helAna diYe, sekhAne tArA vahuvidha phalamUla o pAnIYera janya Adeza dive|
Ara tAdera pAze thAkave Anata naYanA samavaYaskA taruNIrA|
eTAi hisAva dine tomAderake deYA pratizruti|
eTAi AmAra deYA riyka yA niHzeSa havenA|
eTA erUpai! Ara sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya raYeche nikRSTatama ThikAnA –
jAhAnnAma, sekhAne tArA praveza karave, kata nikRSTa vizrAmasthala|
eTA sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya| sutarAM tArA AsvAdana karuka phuTanta pAni o pu~ja|
Arao Ache e rUpa vibhinna dharaNera zAsti|
eito eka vAhinI, tomAdera sAthe praveza kareche| tAdera janya nei abhinandana, tArAto jAhAnnAme jvalave|
anusArIrA valaveH varaM tomarAo, tomAdera janyao to abhinandana nei| tomarAito pUrve oTA AmAdera janya vyavasthA karecha, kata nikRSTa ei AvAsasthala!
tArA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! ye eTA AmAdera sammukhIna kareche jAhAnnAme tAra zAsti Apani dviguNa vardhita karuna!
tArA Arao valaveH AmAdera ki hala ye, AmarA ye sava lokake manda vale gaNya karatAma tAderake dekhate pAcchinA?
tAhale ki AmarA tAderake ahetuka ThATTA vidrupera pAtra mane karatAma, nAki tAdera vyApAre AmAdera dRSTi vibhrama ghaTeche?
eTA nizcita satya jAhAnnAmIdera ei vAda prativAda|
valaH Amito ekajana satarkakArI mAtra evaM AllAha chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei yini eka, parAkramazAlI –
yini AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI evaM egulira madhyasthita savakichura rAvva, yini parAkramazAlI, mahA kSamAzIla|
valaH eTA eka mahA saMvAda –
yA hate tomarA mukha phiriYe niccha|
urdhvaloke tAdera vAdAnuvAda samparke AmAra kona jJAna chilanA|
AmAra nikaTato ei ahI eseche ye, Ami ekajana spaSTa satarkakArI|
smaraNa kara, tomAra rAvva mAlAikA/pherezatAderake valechilenaH Ami mAnuSa sRSTi karachi kardama hate|
yakhana Ami oke suSama karava evaM ote AmAra sRSTi rUha saJcAra karava takhana tomarA ora prati sAjadAhavanata hao|
takhana mAlAikA/pherezatArA savAi sAjadAhavanata hala –
zudhu ivalIsa vyatIta; se ahaMkAra karala evaM kAphiradera antarbhukta hala|
tini valalenaH he ivalIsa! Ami yAke nija hAte sRSTi karechi tAra prati sAjadAhavanata hate toke kise vAdhA dila? tui ki auddhatya prakAza karali, nAki tui ucca maryAdAsampanna?
