se valalaH Ami tAra ceYe zreSTha| Apani AmAke Aguna hate sRSTi karechena evaM tAke sRSTi karechena mATi hate|
tini valalenaH tui ekhAna hate vera haYe yA, nizcaYai tui vitAr3ita|
evaM tora upara AmAra lA’nata sthAYI have, karmaphala dina paryanta|
se valalaH he AmAra rAvva! Apani AmAke avakAza dina punarutthAna dina paryanta|
tini valalenaH tui avakAza prAptadera antarbhukta hali –
avadhArita samaYa upasthita haoYAra dina paryanta|
se valalaH ApanAra kSamatAra zapatha! Ami tAdera savAike pathabhraSTa karava|
tave tAdera madhye ApanAra ekaniSTha vAndAderake naYa|
tini valalenaH tave eTAi satya, Ara Ami satyai vali –
tora dvArA o tora anusArIdera dvArA Ami jAhAnnAma pUrNa karavai|
valaH Ami era janya tomAdera nikaTa kona pratidAna cAinA evaM yArA mithyA dAvI kare Ami tAdera antarbhukta nai|
ihAto vizvajagatera janya upadeza mAtra|
era saMvAda tomarA avazyai jAnave, kichukAla pare|
ei kitAva avatIrNa parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa hate|
Ami tomAra nikaTa ei kitAva satyasaha avatIrNa karechi; sutarAM AllAhara ivAdAta kara tA~ra Anugatye vizuddha citta haYe|

jene rekha, avimizra Anugatya AllAharai prApya| yArA AllAhara parivarte anyake abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa kare tArA valeH AmarA to edera pUjA e janyai kari ye, erA AmAderake AllAhara sAnnidhya ene dive| tArA ye viSaYe nijedera madhye matabheda karache AllAha tAra phAisAlA kare divena| ye mithyAvAdI o kAphira, AllAha tAke sat pathe paricAlita karena nA|
AllAha santAna grahaNa karate icchA karale tini tA~ra sRSTira madhye yAke icchA manonIta karate pAratena| pavitra o mahAna tini| tinii AllAha eka, pravala parAkramazAlI|

tini yathAyathabhAve AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena| tini rAta dvArA dinake AcchAdita karena evaM rAtake AcchAdita karena dina dvArA| sUrya o candrake tini karechena niYamAdhIna| pratyekei parikramana kare eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta| jene rekha, tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|

tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena ekai vyakti hate| ataHpara tini tA hate tAra saGginI sRSTi karechena| tini tomAdera diYechena ATa prakAra gRhapAlita pazu| tini tomAdera mAtRgarbhera trividha andhakAre paryAYakrame sRSTi karechena| tinii AllAha! tomAdera rAvva| sArvabhaumatva tA~rai, tini chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei| ataeva tomarA mukha phiriYe kothAYa calecha?

tomarA akRtajJa hale AllAha tomAdera mukhApekSI nana, tini tA~ra vAndAdera akRtajJatA pachanda karenanA| yadi tomarA kRtajJa hao tAhale tini tomAdera janya eTAi pachanda karena| ekera vojhA anye vahana karavenA| ataHpara tomAdera ravera nikaTa tomAdera pratyAvartana evaM tomarA yA karate tini tomAderake tA avagata karAvena| antare yA Ache tA tini samyaka avagata|

mAnuSake yakhana duHkha dainya sparza kare takhana se anutapta haYe ekaniSThabhAve tAra rAvvake DAke| kintu pare yakhana tini tAra prati anugraha karena takhana se vismRta haYe yAYa pUrve yAke se Dekechila tA~ke evaM se AllAhara samakakSa dA~r3a karAYa, aparake tA~ra patha hate vibhrAnta karAra janya| valaH kupharIra jIvana avasthAYa tumi kichu kAla upabhoga kare nAo| vastutaH tumito jAhAnnAmerai adhivAsI|

ye vyakti rAtera vibhinna samaYe sAjadAhavanata haYe o dA~r3iYe Anugatya prakAza kare, AkhirAtake bhaYa kare evaM tAra ravera anugraha pratyAzA kare se ki tAra samAna ye tA karenA? valaH yArA jAne evaM yArA jAnenA tArA ki samAna? vodhazakti sampanna lokerAi zudhu upadeza grahaNa kare|

valaH (AmAra ei kathA) he AmAra mu’mina vAndArA! tomarA tomAdera rAvvake bhaYa kara| yArA ei duniYAYa kalyANakara kAja kare tAdera janya Ache kalyANa| prazasta AllAhara pRthivI, dhairyazIladerake aparimita puraSkAra deYA have|
valaH Ami AdiSTa haYechi AllAhara Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe tA~ra ivAdAta karate|
Ara AdiSTa haYechi, Ami yena AtmasamarpanakArIdera agraNI hai|
valaH Ami yadi AmAra ravera avAdhya hai tAhale Ami bhaYa kari mahA dinera zAstira|
valaH Ami ivAdAta kari AllAharai, tA~ra prati AmAra Anugatyake ekaniSTha rekhe|
ataeva tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAra icchA tAra ivAdAta kara| valaH kiYAmAta divase kSatigrasta tArAi yArA nijedera o nijedera parivAravargera kSatisAdhana kare| jene rekha, eTAi suspaSTa kSati|
tAdera janya thAkave tAdera urdhvadike Agunera AcchAdana evaM nimnadikeo AcchAdana| e dvArA AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake satarka karena| he AmAra vAndArA! tomarA AmAke bhaYa kara|
yArA tAgutera pUjA hate dUre thAke evaM AllAhara abhimukhI haYa tAdera janya Ache susaMvAda| ataeva susaMvAda dAo AmAra vAndAderake|
yArA manoyoga sahakAre kathA zune evaM ora madhye yA uttama tA grahaNa kare tAderake AllAha sat pathe paricAlita karena evaM tArAi vodhazakti sampanna|
yAra upara danDAdeza avadhArita haYeche, tumi ki rakSA karate pArave sei vyaktike ye jAhAnnAme Ache?
tave yArA tAdera rAvvake bhaYa kare tAdera janya Ache vahu prAsAda, yAra upara nirmita Arao prAsAda, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita; AllAha pratizruti diYechena, AllAha pratizruti bhaGga karenanA|

tumi ki dekhanA ye, AllAha AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena; ataHpara bhUmite nirjhara rUpe pravAhita karena evaM tadvArA vividha varNera phasala utpanna karena, ataHpara oTA zukiYe yAYa evaM tomarA oTA pIta varNa dekhate pAo, avazeSe tini oTA khar3akuTAYa pariNata karena? ete avazyai upadeza raYeche vodhazaktisampannadera janya|

AllAha isalAmera janya yAra vakSa unmukta kare diYechena evaM ye tAra ravera Aloke Ache se ki tAra samAna (ye erUpa naYa); durbhoga sei kaThora hRdaYa vyaktidera janya yArA AllAhara smaraNe parAnmukha! tArA spaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche|

AllAha avatIrNa karechena uttama vANI samvalita kitAva yA susAmaJjasa evaM yA punaH punaH AvRtti karA haYa| ete yArA tAdera rAvvake bhaYa kare tAdera gAtra romAJcita haYa, ataHpara tAdera deha-mana prazAnta haYe AllAhara smaraNe jhu~ke par3e; eTAi AllAhara pathanirdeza, tini yAke icchA eTA dvArA patha pradarzana karena| AllAha yAke vibhrAnta karena tAra kona patha pradarzaka nei|
ye vyakti kiYAmAta divase tAra mukhamanDala dvArA kaThina zAsti ThekAte cAve se ki tAra mata ye nirApada? yAlimadera valA have, tomarA yA arjana karate tAra zAsti AsvAdana kara|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo mithyA Aropa karechila, phale zAsti tAderake grAsa karala tAdera ajJAtasAre|
phale AllAha tAderake pArthiva jIvane lAJchanA bhoga karAlena evaM AkhirAtera zAstito kaThinatara, yadi tArA jAnato!
Ami ei kuraAne mAnuSera janya sarva prakAra dRSTAnta upasthita karechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
ArAvI bhASAra ei kuraAna vakratAmukta, yAte mAnuSa sAvadhAnatA avalamvana kare|

AllAha ekaTi dRSTAnta peza karachenaH eka vyaktira mAlika aneka yArA paraspara viruddha bhAvApanna evaM eka vyaktira mAlika zudhu ekajana; ei duiYera avasthA ki samAna? prazaMsA AllAharai prApya; kintu tAdera adhikAMzai eTA jAnenA|
tumito maraNazIla evaM tArAo maraNazIla|
ataHpara kiYAmAta divase tomarA paraspara tomAdera ravera sAmane vAkavitanDA karave|
ye vyakti AllAha samvandhe mithyA vale evaM satya AsAra para tA pratyAkhyAna kare se apekSA yAlima Ara ke? kAphiradera AvAsasthala ki jAhAnnAma naYa?
yArA satya eneche evaM yArA satyake satya vale meneche tArAito muttAkI|
tAdera vAJchita sava kichui Ache tAdera ravera nikaTa| eTAi satkarmazIladera puraskAra|
kAraNa tArA ye sava manda kAja karechila AllAha tA kSamA kare divena evaM tAderake tAdera sat kAjera janya puraskRta karavena|
AllAha ki tA~ra vAndAra janya yatheSTa nana? athaca tArA tomAderake AllAhara parivarte aparera bhaYa dekhAYa| AllAha yAke vibhrAnta karena tAra janya kona patha pradarzaka nei|
evaM yAke AllAha hidAYAta dAna karena tAra janya kona pathabhraSTakArI nei, AllAha ki parAkramazAlI danDavidhAYaka nana?

tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa karaH AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI ke sRSTi karechena? tArA avazyai valaveH AllAha! valaH tomarA ki bheve dekhecha ye, AllAha AmAra aniSTa cAile tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka tArA ki sei aniSTatA dUra karate pArave? athavA tini AmAra prati anugraha karate cAile tArA ki sei anugraha rodha karate pArave? valaH AmAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa| nirbharakArIrA AllAhara upara nirbhara kare|
valaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA sva sva avasthAYa kAja karate thAka, Amio AmAra kAja karachi| zIghrai jAnate pArave –
kAra upara Asave lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti evaM kAra upara Apatita have sthAYI zAsti|

Ami tomAra prati satyasaha kitAva avatIrNa karechi mAnuSera kalyANera janya| ataHpara ye sat patha avalamvana kare se tA kare nijerai kalyANera janya evaM ye vipathagAmI haYa seto vipathagAmI haYa nijerai dhvaMsera janya evaM tumi tAdera tattvAvadhAYaka nao|

AllAhai prANa haraNa karena jIvasamUhera, tAdera mRtyura samaYa evaM yAdera mRtyu Aseni tAdera prANao nidrAra samaYa| ataHpara yAra janya mRtyura siddhAnta karena tAra prANa tini rekhe dena evaM aparaguli phiriYe dena, eka nirdiSTa samaYera janya| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche cintAzIla sampradAYera janya|
tAhale ki tArA AllAha chAr3A aparake supAriza sAvyasta kareche? valaH tAdera kona kSamatA nA thAkaleo evaM tArA nA vujhaleo?
valaH supAriza ikhatiYAre, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva AllAharai| ataHpara tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAnIta have|
ekaka AllAhara kathA valA hale, yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa karenA tAdera antara vitRSNAYa saMkucita haYa evaM AllAhara parivarte tAdera devatAgulira ullekha karA hale tArA Anande ullasita haYa|
valaH he AllAha! AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sraSTA! dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtA! ApanAra vAndArA ye viSaYe matavirodha kare, Apani tAdera madhye ora phAisAlA kare divena|

yArA yul‌ma kareche, yadi tAdera duniYAYa yA Ache tA sampUrNa evaM era sama parimANa sampadao thAke tAhale kiYAmAta divase kaThina zAsti hate muktipaNa svarUpa sakala viSaYa sampatti tArA diYe dive evaM tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa hate emana kichu prakAzita have yA tArA kalpanAo kareni|
tAdera kRtakarmera manda phala tAdera nikaTa prakAza haYe par3ave evaM tArA yA niYe ThATTA vidrupa karata tA tAderake pariveSTana karave|

mAnuSake duHkha dainya sparza karale se AmAke AhavAna kare| ataHpara yakhana Ami tAra prati anugraha kari takhana se valeH Amito eTA lAbha karechi AmAra jJAnera mAdhyame| vastutaH eTA eka parIkSA, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vujhenA|
tAdera pUrvavartIrAo eTAi valata, kintu tAdera kRtakarma tAdera kona kAje Aseni|
tAdera karmera manda phala tAdera upara Apatita haYeche, tAdera madhye yArA yul‌ma kare tAdera uparao tAdera karmera manda phala Apatita have evaM tArA vyarthao karate pAravenA|
tArA ki jAnenA, AllAha yAra janya icchA tAra riyka vRddhi karena athavA hrAsa karena| ete avazyai nidarzana raYeche mu’mina sampradAYera janya|
valaH (AmAra e kathA) he AmAra vAndArA! tomarA yArA nijedera prati avicAra karecha - AllAhara anugraha hate nirAza haYonA; AllAha samudaYa pApa kSamA kare divena| tinito kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomarA tomAdera ravera abhimukhI hao evaM tA~ra nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa kara tomAdera nikaTa zAsti AsAra pUrve, ataHpara tomAderake sAhAyya karA havenA|
anusaraNa kara tomAdera prati tomAdera ravera nikaTa hate uttama yA avatIrNa karA haYeche tAra, tomAdera upara atarkitabhAve tomAdera ajJAte zAsti AsAra pUrve –
yAte kehakeo valate nA haYaH hAYa! AllAhara prati AmAra kartavye Ami ye zaithilya karechi tAra janya Aphasosa! Amito ThATTAkArIdera antarbhukta chilAma|
athavA keha yena nA valeH AllAha AmAke patha pradarzana karale Amito avazyai muttAkIdera antarbhukta hatAma|
athavA zAsti pratyakSa karale yena kehake valate nA haYaH AhA! yadi ekavAra pRthivIte AmAra pratyAvartana ghaTata tAhale Ami satkarmazIla hatAma|
prakRta vyApArato ei ye, AmAra nidarzana tomAra nikaTa esechila, kintu tumi egulike mithyA valechile evaM ahaMkAra karechile; Ara tumito chile kAphiradera ekajana|
yArA AllAhara prati mithyA Aropa kare, tumi kiYAmAta divase tAdera mukhamanDala kAlo dekhave| auddhatyadera AvAsasthala ki jAhAnnAma naYa?
AllAha muttAkIdera uddhAra karavena tAdera sAphalyasaha; tAderake amaGgala sparza karavenA evaM tArA duHkhao pAvenA|
AllAha sava kichura sraSTA evaM tini sava kichura karmavidhAYaka|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra cAvi tA~rai nikaTa| yArA AllAhara AYAtake asvIkAra kare tArAi kSatigrasta|
valaH he ajJa vyaktirA! tomarA ki AmAke AllAha vyatIta anyera ivAdAta karate valacha?
tomAra prati, tomAra pUrvavartIdera prati avazyai ahI haYeche; tumi AllAhara zarIka sthira karale tomAra kAja nisphala have evaM tumi have kSatigrasta|
ataeva tumi AllAharai ivAdAta kara evaM kRtajJa hao|

tArA AllAhara yathocita sammAna karenA| kiYAmAta divase samasta pRthivI thAkave tA~ra hAtera muSTite evaM AkAzamanDalI bhA~ja karA thAkave tA~ra DAna hAte| pavitra o mahAna tini, tArA yAke zarIka kare tini tAra urdhve|

evaM ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have, phale yAderake AllAha icchA karavena tArA vyatIta AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra savAi murchita haYe par3ave| ataHpara AvAra ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have, tatkSaNAt tArA danDAYamAna haYe tAkAte thAkave|
yamIna ora ravera jyotite udbhAsita have, ‘AmalanAmA peza karA have evaM nAvIderake o sAkSIderake hAyira karA have evaM sakalera madhye nyAYa vicAra karA have o tAdera prati yulama karA havenA|
pratyekera kRtakarmera pUrNa pratiphala deYA have| tArA yA kare sei samparke AllAha savizeSa avahita|

kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera dike dale dale hA~kiYe niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA sekhAne upasthita have takhana ora praveza dvAraguli khule deYA have evaM jAhAnnAmera rakSIrA tAderake valaveH tomAdera nikaTa ki tomAdera madhya hate rAsUla Aseni yArA tomAdera nikaTa tomAdera ravera AYAta AvRtti karata evaM ei dinera sAkSAt samvandhe satarka karata? tArA valaveH avazyai esechila| vastutaH kAphiradera prati zAstira kathA vAstavAYita haYeche|
tAderake valA haveH jAhAnnAmera dvArasamUhe praveza kara, tAte sthAYIbhAve avasthitira janya| kata nikRSTa uddhatadera AvAsasthala!

yArA tAdera rAvvake bhaYa karata tAderake dale dale jAnnAtera dike niYe yAoYA have| yakhana tArA sekhAne upasthita have takhana ora dvArasamUha khule deYA have evaM jAnnAtera rakSIrA tAderake valaveH tomAdera prati sAlAma, tomarA sukhI hao evaM jAnnAte praveza kara sthAYIbhAve avasthAnera janya|

tArA praveza kare valaveH prazaMsA AllAhara yini AmAdera prati tA~ra pratizruti pUrNa karechena evaM AmAdera adhikArI karechena ei bhUmira; AmarA jAnnAte yekhAne icchA vasavAsa karava| sadAcArIdera puraskAra kata uttama!

evaM tumi mAlAikA/pherezatAderake dekhate pAve ye, tArA Arazera catuspArzve ghire tAdera ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karache| Ara tAdera vicAra karA have nyAYera sAthe| valA haveH prazaMsA jagatasamUhera rAvva AllAhara prApya|
hA- mIma|
ei kitAva avatIrNa haYeche parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAhara nikaTa hate –
yini pApa kSamA karena evaM tAovAha kavUla karena, yini zAsti dAne kaThora, zaktizAlI| tini vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei| pratyAvartana tA~rai nikaTa|
zudhu kAphirerAi AllAhara nidarzana samvandhe vitarka kare; sutarAM deze deze tAdera avAdha vicaraNa yena tomAdera vibhrAnta nA kare|

tAdera pUrve nUhera sampradAYa evaM tAdera pare anyAnya dalao mithyA Aropa karechila| pratyeka sampradAYa nija nija rAsUlake Avaddha karAra janya abhisandhi karechila evaM tArA asAra tarke lipta haYechila, satyake vyartha kare deYAra janya| phale Ami tAderake pAkar3Ao karalAma evaM kata kaThora chila AmAra zAsti!
ebhAve kAphiradera kSetre satya hala tomAra ravera vANI - erA jAhAnnAmI|

yArA Araza dhAraNa kare Ache evaM yArA era catuspArzva ghire Ache tArA tAdera ravera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare prazaMsAra sAthe evaM tAte vizvAsa sthApana kare evaM mu’minadera janya kSamA prArthanA kare valeH he AmAdera rAvva! ApanAra daYA o jJAna sarvavyApI, ataeva yArA tAovAha kare o ApanAra patha avalamvana kare, Apani tAderake kSamA karuna evaM jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate rakSA karuna|

he AmAdera rAvva! Apani tAderake dAkhila karuna sthAYI jAnnAte, yAra pratizruti Apani tAderake diYechena evaM tAdera mAtA-pitA, pati-patnI o santAna-santatira madhye yArA sat kAja kareche tAderakeo| Apanito parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
evaM Apani tAderake pApa hate rakSA karuna, sei dina Apani yAke zAsti hate rakSA karavena tAketo anugrahai karavena, eTAito mahAsAphalya|

kAphiraderake ucca kanThe valA haveH tomAdera nijedera prati tomAdera kSobha apekSA AllAhara aprasannatA chila adhika, yakhana tomAdera ImAnera prati AhavAna karA haYechila, Ara tomarA tA asvIkAra karechile|

tArA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! Apani AmAderake prANahIna avasthAYa du’vAra rekhechena evaM du’vAra AmAderake prANa diYechena| AmarA AmAdera aparAdha svIkAra karachi; ekhana niskramaNera kona patha milave ki?

tomAdera ei pArthiva zAsti e janya ye, yakhana eka AllAhake DAkA hata takhana tomarA tA~ke asvIkAra karate evaM AllAhara zarIka sthira karA hale tomarA tA vizvAsa karate| vastutaH mahAna AllAharai samasta kartRtva|
tinii tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhAna evaM AkAza hate preraNa karena tomAdera janya riyaka| AllAhara abhimukhI vyaktii upadeza grahaNa kare thAke|
sutarAM AllAhake DAka tA~ra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe, yadio kAphirerA eTA apachanda kare|
tini suucca maryAdAra adhikArI, Arazera adhipati, tini tA~ra vAndAdera madhye yAra prati icchA ahI preraNa karena svIYa Adezasaha yAte se satarka karate pAre kiYAmAtera dina samparke –
yedina mAnuSa vera haYe par3ave| sedina AllAhara nikaTa tAdera kichui gopana thAkavenA| ai dina kartRtva kAra? eka, parAkramazAlI AllAharai|
edina pratyekake tAra kRtakarmera phala deYA have; kArao prati yulama karA have nA| nizcaYai AllAha hisAva grahaNe tatpara|
tAderake satarka kare dAo Asanna dina samparke, yakhana duHkha kaSTe tAdera prANa kanThAgata have| yAlimadera janya kona antaraGga vandhu nei, yAra supAriza grAhya have emana kona supArizakArIo nei|
cakSura apavyavahAra o antare yA gopana Ache sei samvandhe tini avahita|
AllAha vicAra karena saThikabhAve; AllAhara parivarte tArA yAderake DAke tArA vicAra karate akSama| AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa karenA? tAhale dekhate peta tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma ki haYechila? pRthivIte tArA chila edera apekSA zaktite evaM kIrtite pravalatara| ataHpara AllAha tAderake zAsti diYechilena tAdera aparAdhera janya evaM AllAhara zAsti hate tAderake rakSA karAra keha chilanA|
eTA e janya ye, tAdera nikaTa tAdera rAsUlagaNa nidarzanasaha ele tArA tAderake pratyAkhyAna karechila| phale AllAha tAderake zAsti dilena| tinito zaktizAlI, zAsti dAne kaThora|
Ami AmAra nidarzana o spaSTa pramANasaha mUsAke preraNa karechilAma –
phira‘Auna, hAmAna o kArUNera nikaTa; kintu tArA valechilaH eto eka yAdukara, carama mithyAvAdI|

ataHpara yakhana mUsA AmAra nikaTa hate satya niYe tAdera nikaTa upasthita hala takhana tArA valalaH mUsAra upara yArA ImAna eneche tAdera putra santAnaderake hatyA kara evaM nArIderake jIvita rAkha| kintu kAphiradera Sar3ayantra vyartha havei|
phira‘Auna valalaH AmAke cher3e dAo, Ami mUsAke hatyA kari evaM se tAra ravera zaraNApanna hoka| Ami AzaMkA kari ye, se tomAdera dInera parivartana ghaTAve athavA se pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karave|
mUsA valalaH yArA vicAra dine vizvAsa karenA, sei sava uddhata vyakti hate Ami AmAra o tomAdera ravera zaraNApanna hacchi|

phira‘Auna vaMzera eka vyakti ye mu’mina chila evaM nija ImAna gopana rAkhata, valalaH tomarA ki eka vyaktike e janya hatyA karave ye, se valeH AmAra rAvva AllAha, athaca se tomAdera ravera nikaTa hate suspaSTa pramANasaha tomAdera nikaTa eseche? se mithyAvAdI hale tAra mithyAvAditAra janya se dAYI have, Ara yadi se satyavAdI haYa tAhale se tomAderake ye zAstira kathA vale tAra kichuto tomAdera upara Apatita havei| nizcaYai sImA laMghanakArI o mithyAvAdIke AllAha sat pathe paricAlita karenanA|

he AmAra sampradAYa! Aja kartRtva tomAdera, deze tomarAi pravala; kintu AmAdera upara AllAhara zAsti ese par3ale ke AmAderake sAhAyya karave? phira‘Auna valalaH Ami yA vujhi, Ami tomAdera tAi valachi| Ami tomAderake zudhu sat pathai dekhiYe thAki|
mu’mina vyaktiTi valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami tomAdera janya pUrvavartI sampradAYasamUhera zAstira dinera anurUpa durdinera AzaMkA kari –
yemana ghaTechila nUhera kAoma, Ada, sAmUda evaM tAdera paravartIdera kSetre| AllAhato vAndAdera prati kona yulama karate cAna nA|
he AmAra sampradAYa! Ami tomAdera janya AzaMkA kari kiYAmAta divasera –
yedina tomarA pazcAt phire palAYana karate cAve, AllAhara zAsti hate tomAderake rakSA karAra keha thAkavenA| AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya kona patha pradarzaka nei|

pUrveo tomAdera nikaTa iusupha esechila spaSTa nidarzanasaha; kintu se yA niYe esechila tomarA tAte vAra vAra sandeha poSaNa karate| parizeSe yakhana tAra mRtyu hala takhana tomarA valechileH ataHpara AllAha Ara kehakeo rAsUla kare preraNa karavena nA| ebhAve AllAha vibhrAnta karena sImAlaMghanakArI o saMzaYavAdIderake|

yArA nijedera nikaTa kona dalIla pramANa nA thAkaleo AllAhara nidarzana samparke vitanDAYa lipta haYa tAdera e kAja AllAha evaM mu’minadera dRSTite atizaYa ghRNAha| ebhAve AllAha pratyeka uddhata o svairAcArI vyaktira hRdaYake mohara kare dena|
phira‘Auna valalaH he hAmAna! AmAra janya tumi nirmANa kara eka suucca prAsAda yAte Ami pAi avalamvana –

AsamAne Arohanera avalamvana, yena Ami dekhate pAi mUsAra mA‘vUdake; tave Amito tAke mithyAvAdI mane kari| ebhAvei phira‘Aunera nikaTa zobhanIYa karA haYechila tAra manda kAjake evaM tAke nivRtta karA haYechila sarala patha hate evaM phira‘Aunera Sar3ayantra vyartha haYechila sampUrNa rUpe|
mu’mina vyaktiTi valalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAra anusaraNa kara, Ami tomAderake saThika pathe paricAlita karava|
he AmAra sampradAYa! e pArthiva jIvanato asthAYI upabhogera vastu evaM AkhirAtai hacche cirasthAYI AvAsa|

keha manda kAja karale se zudhu tAra kAjera anurUpa zAsti pAve evaM puruSa kiMvA nArIra madhye yArA mu’mina haYe sat kAja kare tArA dAkhila have jAnnAte, sekhAne tAderake deYA have aparimita jIvanopakaraNa|
he AmAra sampradAYa! ki Azcarya, Ami tomAderake AhavAna karachi muktira dike, Ara tomarA AmAke AhavAna karacha jAhAnnAmera dike|
tomarA AmAke valacha AllAhake asvIkAra karate evaM tA~ra samakakSa dA~r3a karAte, yAra samparke AmAra kona jJAna nei; pakSAntare Ami tomAderake AhavAna karachi parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla AllAhara dike|

nizcaYai tomarA AmAke AhavAna karacho emana eka janera dike ye duniYA o AkhirAte kothAo AhavAnayogya naYa| vastutaH AmAdera pratyAvartanato AllAhara nikaTa evaM sImAlaMghanakArIrAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|
Ami tomAderake yA valachi, tomarA tA acirei smaraNa karave evaM Ami AmAra vyApAra AllAhaYa aparNa karachi; AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati savizeSa dRSTi rAkhena|
ataHpara AllAha tAke tAdera Sar3ayantrera aniSTatA hate rakSA karalena evaM kaThina zAsti pariveSTana karala phira‘Auna sampradAYake|
sakAla-sandhyAYa tAderake upasthita karA haYa Agunera sammukhe evaM yedina kiYAmAta saMghaTita have sedina valA haveH phira‘Auna sampradAYake nikSepa kara kaThinatama zAstite|

yakhana tArA jAhAnnAme paraspara vitarke lipta have takhana durvalerA dAmbhikaderake valaveH AmarAto tomAdera anusArI chilAma, ekhana ki tomarA AmAdera theke jAhAnnAmera Agunera kiYadaMza nivAraNa karave?
dAmbhikerA valaveH AmarA savAito jAhAnnAme Achi, nizcaYai AllAha vAndAdera vicAra kare phelechena|
jAhAnnAmIrA ora praharIderake valaveH tomAdera ravera nikaTa prArthanA kara, tini yena AmAdera hate lAghava karena zAsti, eka dinera janya|

tArA valaveH tomAdera nikaTa ki spaSTa nidarzanasaha tomAdera rAsUlagaNa Asenani? jAhAnnAmIrA valaveH avazyai esechila| praharIrA valaveH tAhale tomarAi prArthanA kara, Ara kAphiradera prArthanA vyarthai haYa|
nizcaYai Ami AmAra rAsUladerake o mu’minaderake sAhAyya karava pArthiva jIvane evaM yedina sAkSIgaNa danDAYamAna have,
yedina yAlimadera kono oyara Apatti kona kAje AsavenA, tAdera janya raYeche lA’nata evaM nikRSTa AvAsa|
Ami avazyai mUsAke dAna karechilAma pathanirdeza evaM vAnI isarAIlake uttarAdhikArI karechilAma sei kitAvera –
pathanirdeza o upadeza svarUpa; vodhazakti sampanna lokadera janya|
ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara; nizcaYai AllAhara pratizruti satya, tumi tomAra truTira janya kSamA prArthanA kara evaM sakAla-sandhyAYa tomAra ravera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|

yArA nijedera nikaTa kona dalIla nA thAkaleo AllAhara nidarzana samparke vitarke lipta haYa tAdera antare Ache zudhu ahaMkAra, yA saphala havAra naYa| ataeva AllAhara zaraNApanna hao, tinito sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
mAnava sRSTi apekSA AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTito kaThinatara, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa eTA jAnenA|
samAna naYa andha o cakSummAna evaM yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, Ara yArA duskRtiparAYaNa| tomarA alpai upadeza grahaNa kare thAka|
kiYAmAta avazyambhAvI, ete kona sandeha nei, kintu adhikAMza loka vizvAsa karenA|
tomAdera rAvva valalenaH tomarA AmAke DAka, Ami tomAdera DAke sAr3A diva| kintu yArA ahaMkAre AmAra ivAdAte vimukha tArA avazyai jAhAnnAme praveza karave lAJchita haYe|
AllAhai tomAdera vizrAmera janya sRSTi karechena rAta evaM Alokajjvala karechena dinake| AllAhato mAnuSera prati anugrahazIla, kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa kRtajJatA prakAza karenA|
tinii AllAha tomAdera rAvva, sava kichura sraSTA; tini vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei; sutarAM tomarA kibhAve vipathagAmI haccha?
ebhAvei vipathagAmI haYa tArA yArA AllAhara nidarzanAvalike asvIkAra kare|

AllAhai tomAdera janya pRthivIke karechena vAsopayogI evaM AkAzake karechena chAda evaM tomAdera AkRti karechena utkRSTa evaM tomAderake dAna karechena utkRSTa riyka| eito AllAha, tomAdera rAvva| kata mahAna jagatasamUhera rAvva AllAha!
tini ciraJjIva, tini vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei| sutarAM tomarA tA~kei DAka, tA~ra Anugatye ekaniSTha haYe| prazaMsA jagatasamUhera rAvva AllAhara prApya|

valaH AmAra ravera nikaTa hate AmAra nikaTa suspaSTa nidarzana AsAra pUrve tomarA AllAha vyatIta yAderake AhavAna kara tAdera ivAdAta karate AmAke niSedha karA haYeche evaM Ami AdiSTa haYechi jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa AtmasamarpaNa karate|

tinii tomAdera sRSTi karechena mATi hate, pare zukra vindu hate, tArapara tAderake vera karena zizu rUpe, ataHpara tomarA upanIta hao yauvane, tArapara hao vRddha| tomAdera madhye kArao era pUrvei mRtyu ghaTe evaM eTA e janya ye, tomarA nirdhArita kAla prApta hao evaM yAte tomarA anudhAvana karate pAra –
tinii jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna evaM yakhana tini kichu karA sthira karena takhana tini valenaH hao, evaM tA haYe yAYa|
tumi ki lakSya karanA tAdera prati yArA AllAhara nidarzana samparke vitarka kare? kibhAve tAderake vipathagAmI karA hacche?
yArA asvIkAra kare kitAva o yA saha Ami rAsUladerake preraNa karechilAma tA, zIghrai tArA jAnate pArave –
yakhana tAdera galadeze ver3i o zRMkhala par3iYe Tene niYe yAoYA have –
phuTanta pAnite| ataHpara tAderake dagdha karA have Agune|
erapara tAderake valA haveH kothAYa tArA yAderake tomarA tA~ra zarIka karate –
AllAha vyatIta? tArA valaveH tArAto AmAdera nikaTa hate adRzya haYeche, vastutaH pUrve AmarA emana kichukei AhavAna karini| ebhAve AllAha kAphiradera vibhrAnta karena|
eTA e kAraNe ye, tomarA pRthivIte ayathA ullAsa karate evaM e kAraNe ye, tomarA dambha karate|
tomarA jAhAnnAmera vibhinna darajA diYe praveza kara tAte sthAYIbhAve avasthitira janya, Ara katai nA nikRSTa uddhatadera AvAsasthala!
sutarAM tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara| AllAhara pratizruti satya| Ami tAderake ye pratizruti pradAna kari tAra kichu yadi dekhiYei dii athavA tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi - tAdera pratyAvartanato AmArai nikaTa|

Amito tomAra pUrve aneka rAsUla preraNa karechilAma; tAdera kArao kArao kathA tomAra nikaTa vivRta karechi evaM kArao kArao kathA tomAra nikaTa vivRta karini| AllAhara anumati chAr3A kona nidarzana upasthita karA kona rAsUlera kAja naYa| AllAhara Adeza ele, nyAYa saMgatabhAve phAisAlA haYe yAve| takhana mithyAzraYIrA kSatigrasta have|
AllAhai tomAdera janya catuspada jantu sRSTi karechena, kataka ArohaNa karAra janya evaM kataka tomarA AhAra kare thAka|
ete tomAdera janya raYeche pracura upakAra; tomarA yA praYojana vodha kara eTA dvArA tA pUrNa kare thAka evaM edera upara o nauyAnera upara tomAderake vahana karA haYa|
tini tomAderake tA~ra nidarzanAvalI dekhiYe thAkena| sutarAM tomarA AllAhara kon kon ni‘AmAta asvIkAra karave?

tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni o dekheni tAdera pUrvavartIdera ki pariNAma haYechila? pRthivIte tArA chila edera apekSA saMkhyAYa adhika evaM zaktite o kIrtite adhika pravala| tArA yA karata tA tAdera kona kAje Aseni|
tAdera nikaTa yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha tAdera rAsUla Asata takhana tArA nijedera jJAnera dambha karata| tArA yA niYe ThATTA vidrupa karata tAi tAderake veSTana karala|
ataHpara yakhana tArA AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala takhana valalaH AmarA eka AllAhaYai ImAna AnalAma evaM AmarA tA~ra sAthe yAderake zarIka karatAma tAderake pratyAkhyAna karalAma|
tArA yakhana AmAra zAsti pratyakSa karala takhana tAdera ImAna tAdera kona upakAre elonA| AllAhara ei vidhAna pUrva hatei tAra vAndAdera madhye cale Asache evaM sei kSetre kAphirerA kSatigrasta haYa|
hA mIma|
ihA daYAmaYa, parama daYAlura nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
eTA eka kitAva, vizadabhAve vivRta haYeche era AYAtasamUha ArAvI bhASAYa, kuraAnarUpe jJAnI sampradAYera janya –
susaMvAda dAtA o satarkakArIrUpe, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai vimukha haYeche| sutarAM tArA zunave nA|

tArA valeH tumi yAra prati AmAderake AhavAna karacha sei viSaYe AmAdera antara AvaraNe AcchAdita, karNe Ache vadhiratA evaM tomAra o AmAdera madhye Ache antarAla; sutarAM tumi tomAra kAja kara evaM AmarA AmAdera kAja kari|

valaH Amito tomAdera matai ekajana mAnuSa, AmAra prati ahI haYa ye, tomAdera mA‘vUda ekamAtra mA‘vUda| ataeva tA~rai patha dRr3habhAve avalamvana kara evaM tA~rai nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara| durbhoga aMzIvAdIdera janya –
yArA yAkAta pradAna karenA evaM tArA AkhirAteo avizvAsI|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tAdera janya raYeche niravacchinna puraskAra|
valaH tomarA ki tAke asvIkAra karavei yini pRthivI sRSTi karechena dui dine evaM tomarA tA~ra samakakSa dA~r3a karAte cAo? tinito jagatasamUhera rAvva|
tini sthApana karechena aTala parvatamAlA bhUpRSThe evaM tAte rekhechena kalyANa evaM cAra dine vyavasthA karechena khAdyera - samabhAve, yAJcAkArIdera janya|

ataHpara tini AkAzera dike manoniveza karena yA chila dhUmrapuJja vizeSa| ataHpara tini oTAke evaM pRthivIke valalenaH tomarA ubhaYe eso svecchAYa athavA anicchAYa| tArA valalaH AmarA elAma anugata haYe|

ataHpara tini AkAzamanDalIke dui dine saptAkAze pariNata karalena evaM pratyeka AkAze uhAra vidhAna vyakta karalena evaM Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake suzobhita karalAma pradIpamAlA dvArA evaM karalAma surakSita| eTA parAkramazAlI sarvajJa AllAhara vyavasthApanA|
tavuo tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale valaH Amito tomAderake satarka karachi eka dhvaMsakara zAstira; Ada o sAmUda jAtira anurUpa|

yakhana tAdera nikaTa rAsUlagaNa esechila tAdera sammukha o pazcAt hate evaM valechilaH tomarA AllAha vyatIta kArao ivAdAta karanA takhana tArA valechilaH AmAdera ravera ei rUpa icchA hale tini avazyai mAlAka/pherezatA preraNa karatena| ataeva tomarA yAsaha prerita haYecha AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna karachi|

Ara ‘Ada sampradAYera vyApAra ei ye, tArA pRthivIte ayathA dambha karata evaM valataH AmAdera apekSA zaktizAlI ke Ache? tArA ki tAhale lakSya kareni, ye AllAha tAderake sRSTi karechena tini tAdera apekSA zaktizAlI? athaca tArA AmAra nidarzanAvalIke asvIkAra karata|

ataHpara Ami tAderake pArthiva jIvane lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti AsvAdana karAra janya tAdera virUddhe preraNa karechilAma jhaJjhA-vAYu, amaGgalajanaka dine| AkhirAtera zAstito adhikatara lAJchanAdAYaka evaM tAdera sAhAyya karA havenA|

Ara sAmUda sampradAYera vyApAra ei ye, Ami tAderake patha nirdeza karechilAma, kintu tArA sat pathera parivarte bhrAnta patha avalamvana karechila| ataHpara tAderake lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti AghAta hAnalo tAdera kRtakarmera pariNAma svarUpa|
Ami uddhAra karalAma tAderake yArA ImAna enechila evaM yArA tAkaoYA avalamvana karata|
yedina AllAhara zatruderake jAhAnnAma abhimukhe samaveta karA have sedina tAderake vinyasta karA have vibhinna dale|
parizeSe yakhana tArA jAhAnnAmera sannikaTe pau~chave takhana tAdera kAna, cokha o tvaka tAdera kRtakarma samparke sAkSya dive|

jAhAnnAmIrA tAdera tvakake jijJesa karaveH tomarA AmAdera viruddhe sAkSya diccha kena? uttare tArA valaveH AllAha! yini sava kichuke vAkazakti diYechena tini AmAderakeo vAkazakti diYechena| tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena prathamavAra evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|
tomarA kichu gopana karate nA ei vizvAse ye, tomAdera karNa, cakSu evaM tvaka tomAdera viruddhe sAkSya divenA; uparanta tomarA mane karate ye, tomarA yA karate tAra aneka kichui AllAha jAnenanA|
tomAdera rAvva samvandhe tomAdera ei dhAraNAi tomAdera dhvaMsa eneche| phale tomarA haYecha kSatigrasta|
ekhana tArA dhairya dhAraNa karaleo jAhAnnAmai have tAdera AvAsa sthala evaM tArA anugraha cAileo anugraha prApta havenA|

Ami tAdera janya nirdhAraNa kare diYechilAma sahacara yArA tAdera sammukha o pazcAte yA Ache tA tAdera dRSTite zobhana kare dekhiYechila evaM tAdera vyApAreo tAdera pUrvavartI jina o mAnavadera nyAYa zAstira kathA vAstava haYeche| tArAto chila kSatigrasta|
kAphirerA valeH tomarA ei kuraAna zravaNa karanA evaM tA AvRtti kAle zoragola sRSTi kara yAte tomarA jaYI hate pAra|
Ami avazyai kAphiradera kaThina zAsti AsvAdana karAva evaM nizcaYai Ami tAderake nikRSTa kAryakalApera pratiphala diva –
jAhAnnAma; eTAi AllAhara zatrudera pariNAma; sekhAne tAdera janya raYeche sthAYI AvAsa, AmAra nidarzanAvalI asvIkRtira pratiphala svarUpa|
kAphirerA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! ye sava jina o mAnuSa AmAderake pathabhraSTa karechila tAdera ubhaYake dekhiYe dina, AmarA ubhaYake padadalita karava, yAte tArA lAJchita haYa|

yArA valeH AmAdera rAvva AllAha! ataHpara avicala thAke, tAdera nikaTa avatIrNa haYa mAlAikA (pherezatA) evaM valeH tomarA bhIta haYonA, cintita haYonA evaM tomAderake ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deYA haYechila tAra janya Anandita hao|
AmarAi tomAdera vandhu - duniYAra jIvane o AkhirAte| sekhAne tomAdera janya raYeche yA kichu tomAdera mana cAYa evaM sekhAne tomAdera janya raYeche yA tomarA pharamAYesa kara|
eTA have kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu AllAhara pakSa hate ApyAYana|
ai vyakti apekSA kathAYa ke uttama ye AllAhara prati mAnuSake AhavAna kare, sat kAja kare evaM valeH Amito AtmasamarpanakArIdera antarbhukta|
bhAla kAja evaM manda kAja samAna hate pArenA| manda pratihata kara utkRSTa dvArA; phale tomAra sAthe yAra zatrutA Ache se haYe yAve antaraGga vandhura mata|
ei guNera adhikArI karA haYa zudhu tAderakei yArA dhairyazIla, ei guNera adhikArI karA haYa zudhu tAderakei yArA mahA bhAgyavAna|
yadi zAitAnera ku-mantraNA tomAke prarocita kare tAhale AllAhake smaraNa karave; tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

tA~ra nidarzanAvalIra madhye raYeche rAta o dina, sUrya o cA~da| tomarA sUryake sAjadAha karanA, cA~dakeo naYa; sAjadAha kara AllAhake, yini eguli sRSTi karechena, yadi tomarA prakRtai tA~ra ivAdAta kara|
tArA ahaMkAra karaleo yArA tomAra ravera sAnnidhye raYeche tArAto dina o rAte tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM tArA klAntio vodha karenA| [sAjadAha]

Ara tA~ra ekaTi nidarzana ei ye, tumi bhUmike dekhate pAo zuSka uSara, ataHpara Ami tAte vRSTi varSaNa karale tA Andolita o sphIta haYa; yini jIva dena tinii mRtera jIvana dAnakArI| tinito sarva viSaYe sarva zaktimAna|

yArA AmAra AYAtasamUhake vikRta kare tArA AmAra agocara naYa| zreSTha ke? ye vyakti jAhAnnAme nikSipta have se, nAki ye kiYAmAta divase nirApade thAkave se? tomAdera yA icchA tA kara; tomarA yA kara tini tAra draSTA|
yArA tAdera nikaTa kuraAna AsAra para tA pratyAkhyAna kare tAdera madhye cintA bhAvanAra abhAva raYeche| ihA avazyai eka mahimAmaYa grantha|
kona mithyA ete anupraveza karavenA| sammukha hateo naYa, pazcAt hateo naYa; eTA prajJAmaYa prazaMsA AllAhara nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
tomAra samvandheto tAi valA haYa yA valA hata tomAra pUrvavartI rAsUladera samparke| tomAra rAvva avazyai kSamAzIla evaM kaThina zAstidAtA|

Ami yadi ArAvI bhASAYa kuraAna avatIrNa nA karatAma tAhale tArA avazyai valata, era AYAtaguli vizadabhAve vivRta haYani kena? ki Azcarya ye, era bhASA AjamI, athaca rAsUla ArAvIYa| valaH mu’minadera janya ihA (kuraAna) patha nirdeza o vyAdhira pratikAra| kintu yArA avizvAsI tAdera karNe raYeche vadhiratA evaM kuraAna have tAdera janya andhatva| tArA emana ye, yena tAderake AhavAna karA haYa vahu dUra hate|

Amito mUsAke kitAva diYechilAma, ataHpara ete matabheda ghaTechila| tomAra ravera pakSa hate pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale tAdera mImAMsA haYe yeta| tArA avazyai e samvandhe vibhrAntakara sandehe raYeche|
ye sat kAja kare se nijera kalyANera janyai tA kare evaM keha manda kAja karale ora pratiphala se’i bhoga karave| tomAra rAvva vAndAdera prati kona yulama karena nA|

kiYAmAtera jJAna zudhu AllAhara kAchei nyasta, tA~ra ajJAtasAre kona phala AvaraNa hate vera haYanA, kona nArI garbhadhAraNa karenA evaM santAnao prasava karenA| yedina AllAha tAderake Deke valavenaH AmAra zarIkarA kothAYa? takhana tArA valaveH AmarA ApanAra nikaTa nivedana karachi ye, e vyApAre AmarA kichui jAninA|
pUrve tArA yAderake AhavAna karata tArA adRzya haYe yAve evaM aMzIvAdIrA upaladdhi karave ye, tAdera niskRtira kona upAYa nei|
mAnuSa dhana-sampada prArthanAYa kona klAnti vodha karenA, kintu yakhana tAke duHkha dainya sparza kare takhana se atyanta nirAza o hatAza haYe par3e|

duHkha dainya sparza karAra para yadi tAke Ami anugrahera AsvAda dii takhana se valei thAkeH eTA AmAra prApya evaM Ami mane karinA ye, kiYAmAta saMghaTita have; Ara Ami yadi AmAra ravera nikaTa pratyAvartita haio tAhale tA~ra nikaTato AmAra janya kalyANai thAkave| Ami kAphiraderake tAdera kRtakarma samvandhe avazyai avahita karava evaM tAderake AsvAdana karAva kaThora zAsti|
yakhana Ami mAnuSera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriYe neYa o dUre sare yAYa evaM tAke aniSTatA sparza karale se takhana dIrgha prArthanAYa rata haYa|

valaH tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, yadi ei kuraAna AllAhara nikaTa theke avatIrNa haYe thAke evaM tomarA ihA pratyAkhyAna kara, tAhale ye vyakti ghora viruddhAcaraNe lipta se apekSA adhika vibhrAnta Ara ke?

Ami zIghra tAdera janya AmAra nidarzanAvalI vyakta karava vizvajagate evaM tAdera nijedera madhye| phale tAdera nikaTa suspaSTa haYe uThave ye oTAi satya| eTA ki yatheSTa naYa ye, tomAra rAvva sarva viSaYe avahita?
jene rekha, erA edera ravera sAthe sAkSAtkAre sandhihAna| jene rekha, sava kichuke AllAha pariveSTana kare rekhechena|
hA, mIma|
Aina, sIna, kApha|
parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAha ebhAvei tomAra pUrvavartIdera matai tomAra prati pratyAdeza karena|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA tA~rai| tini samunnata, mahAna|

AkAzamanDalI urdhvadeza hate bheGge par3Ara upakrama haYa evaM mAlAikA/pherezatArA tAdera ravera saprazaMsa pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare evaM martavAsIdera janya kSamA prArthanA kare| jene rekha, AllAhato kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
yArA AllAhara parivarte aparaderake abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa kare, AllAha tAdera prati kaThora dRSTi rAkhena| tumi tAdera karmavidhAYaka nao|

ebhAve Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi ArAvI bhASAYa yAte tumi satarka karate pAra mAkkA evaM ora caturdikera janagaNake evaM satarka karate pAra kiYAmAtera dina samparke, yAte kona sandeha nei| sedina ekadala jAnnAte praveza karave evaM ekadala jAhAnnAme praveza karave|
AllAha icchA karale mAnuSake ekai ummAta karate pAratena| vastutaH tini yAke icchA tAke svIYa anugrahera adhikArI karena| yAlimadera kona abhibhAvaka nei, kona sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tArA ki AllAhara parivarte aparake abhibhAvaka rUpe grahaNa kareche? kintu AllAha! abhibhAvakato tinii evaM tini mRtake jIvita karena| tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tomarA ye viSaYei matabheda kara nA kena, ora mImAMsAto AllAharai nikaTa| valaH tinii AllAha! AmAra rAvva| Ami nirbhara kari tA~ra upara evaM Ami tA~rai abhimukhI!

tini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTikartA, tini tomAdera madhya hate tomAdera jor3A sRSTi karechena evaM Ana‘Amera jor3A; ebhAve tini tomAdera vaMza vistAra karena; kona kichui tA~ra sadRza naYa, tini sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra cAvi tA~rai nikaTa| tini yAra prati icchA tAra riyka vardhita karena athavA saMkucita karena| tini sarva viSaYe savizeSa avahita|

tini tomAdera janya vidhivaddha karechena dIna yAra nirdeza diYechilena tini nUhake| Ara yA Ami ahI karechilAma tomAdera evaM yAra nirdeza diYechilAma ivarAhIma, mUsA o IsAke ei vale ye, tomarA dInake pratiSThita kara evaM ote matabheda karanA| tumi muzarikaderake yAra prati AhavAna karacha tA tAdera nikaTa durvaha mane haYa| AllAha yAke icchA dInera prati AkRSTa karena evaM ye tAra abhimukhI haYa tAke dInera dike paricAlita karena|

tAdera nikaTa jJAna AsAra para zudhumAtra pArasparika vidveSa vazataH tArA nijedera madhye matabheda ghaTAYa| eka nirdhArita kAla paryanta avakAza samparke tomAra ravera pUrva siddhAnta nA thAkale tAdera viSaYe phAisAlA haYe yeta| tAdera para yArA kitAvera uttarAdhikArI haYeche tArA kuraAna samparke vibhrAntikara sandehe raYeche|

sutarAM tumi ora dike AhavAna kara evaM otei dRr3ha pratiSThita thAka yebhAve tumi AdiSTa haYecha evaM tAdera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa karanA| valaH AllAha ye kitAva avatIrNa karechena Ami tAte vizvAsa kari evaM Ami AdiSTa haYechi tomAdera madhye nyAYa vicAra karate| AllAhai AmAdera rAvva evaM tomAderao rAvva| AmAdera kAja AmAdera evaM tomAdera kAja tomAdera| AmAdera evaM tomAdera madhye vivAda nei| AllAhai AmAderake ekatrita karavena evaM pratyAvartana tA~rai nikaTa|
AllAhake svIkAra karAra para yArA AllAha samparke vitarka kare tAdera yukti-tarka tAdera ravera dRSTite asAra evaM tArA tA~ra krodhera pAtra evaM tAdera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti|
AllAhai avatIrNa karechena satyasaha kitAva evaM tulAdanDa| tumi ki jAna, sambhavataH kiYAmAta Asanna?

yArA eTA vizvAsa karenA tArAi eTA tvarAnvita karate cAYa| Ara yArA vizvAsI tArA oke bhaYa kare evaM jAne ye, oTA satya; jene rekha, kiYAmAta samparke yArA vAka-vitanDA kare tArA ghora vibhrAntite raYeche|
AllAha tA~ra vAndAdera prati ati daYAlu| tini yAke icchA riyka dAna karena| tini pravala parAkramazAlI|
ye keha AkhirAtera pratidAna kAmanA kare tAra janya Ami tAra phasala vardhita kare dii evaM ye duniYAra pratidAna kAmanA kare Ami tAke orai kichu dii| kintu AkhirAte tAra janya kichui thAkavenA|

tAdera ki emana katakaguli devatA Ache yArA tAdera janya vidhAna diYeche emana dInera yAra anumati AllAha denani? phAisAlAra ghoSaNA nA thAkale, tAdera viSaYe siddhAnta haYei yeta| nizcaYai yAlimadera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|

tumi yAlimaderake bhIta santrasta dekhave tAdera kRtakarmera janya; Ara eTAi Apatita have tAdera upara| yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare tArA thAkave jAnnAtera manorama sthAne| tArA yA kichu cAve tAdera ravera nikaTa tA’i pAve| eTAito mahA anugraha|

ei susaMvAdai AllAha dena tA~ra vAndAderake yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare| valaH Ami era vinimaYe tomAdera nikaTa hate AtmIYera sauhArdya vyatIta anya kona pratidAna cAinA| ye uttama kAja kare Ami tAra janya ete kalyANa vardhita kari| AllAha kSamAzIla, guNagrAhI|

tArA ki vale ye, se AllAha samparke mithyA udbhAvana kareche? yadi tA’i hata tAhale AllAha icchA karale tomAra hRdaYa mohara kare ditena| AllAha mithyAke muche dena evaM nija vANI dvArA satyake pratiSThita karena| antare yA Ache sei viSaYe tini savizeSa avahita|
tinii tA~ra vAndAdera tAovAha kavUla karena evaM pApa mocana karena evaM tomarA yA kara tini tA jAnena|
tini mu’mina o satkarmazIladera AhavAne sAr3A dena evaM tAdera prati tAra anugraha vardhita karena; kAphiradera janya raYeche kaThina zAsti|

AllAha tA~ra vAndAderake jIvanopakaraNera prAcurya dile tArA pRthivIte avazyai viparyaYa sRSTi karata; kintu tini tA~ra icchA mata saThika parimAnei diYe thAkena| tini tA~ra vAndAderake samyaka jAnena o dekhena|
tArA yakhana hatAzAgrasta haYe par3e takhanai tini vRSTi varSaNa karena evaM tA~ra karuNA vistAra karena| tinii abhibhAvaka, prazaMsA|
tA~ra anyatama nidarzana AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sRSTi evaM etadubhaYera madhye tini ye sava jIvajantu char3iYe diYechena seguli| tini yakhana icchA takhanai oderake samaveta karate sakSama|
tomAdera ye vipada-Apada ghaTe tAto tomAderai kRtakarmera phala evaM tomAdera aneka aparAdha tini kSamA kare dena|
tomarA pRthivIte AllAhara abhiprAYake vyartha karate pAravenA evaM AllAha vyatIta tomAdera kona abhibhAvaka nei, sAhAyyakArIo nei|
tA~ra anyatama nidarzana parvata sadRza samudre calamAna nauyAnasamUha|
tini icchA karale vAYuke staddha kare dite pArena; phale nauyAnasamUha nizcala haYe par3ave samudra pRSThe| nizcaYai ete nidarzana raYeche dhairyazIla o kRtajJa vyaktira janya|
athavA tini tAdera kRtakarmera janya seigulike vidhvasta kare dite pArena evaM anekake tini kSamAo karena|
Ara AmAra nidarzana samparke yArA virtaka kare tArA yena jAnate pAre ye, tAdera kona niskRti nei|
vastutaH tomAderake yA kichu deYA haYeche tA pArthiva jIvanera bhoga| kintu AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache tA uttama o sthAYI - tAdera janya, yArA ImAna Ane o tAdera ravera upara nirbhara kare|
yArA gurutara pApa o azlIla kAja hate ve~ce thAke evaM krodhAviSTa haYeo kSamA kare deYa –
yArA tAdera ravera AhavAne sAr3A deYa, sAlAta kAYema kare, nijedera madhye parAmarzera mAdhyame nijedera kAja sampAdana kare evaM tAderake Ami ye riyka diYechi tA hate vyaYa kare –
evaM yArA atyAcArita hale pratizodha grahaNa kare –
mandera pratiphala anurUpa manda dvArA evaM ye kSamA kare o ApoSa-nispatti kare tAra puraskAra AllAhara nikaTa raYeche| AllAha yAlimadera pachanda karena nA|
tave atyAcArita haoYAra para yArA pratividhAna kare tAdera viruddhe kona vyavasthA grahaNa karA havenA|
zudhu tAdera viruddhe vyavasthA grahaNa karA have yArA mAnuSera upara atyAcAra kare evaM pRthivIte anyAYabhAve vidrohAcaraNa kare ver3AYa, tAdera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|
avazya ye dhairya dhAraNa kare evaM kSamA kare deYa tAto have dRr3ha samparkerai kAja|
AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra janya kona abhibhAvaka nei| yAlimarA yakhana zAsti pratyakSa karave takhana tumi tAderake valate zunaveH pratyAvartanera kona upAYa Ache ki?

tumi tAderake dekhate pAve ye, tAderake (jAhAnnAmera sAmane) upasthita karA hacche, lAJchita o apamAnita avasthAYa| mu’minarA kiYAmAta divase valaveH kSatigrasta tArAi yArA nijedera o nijedera parijanavargera kSati sAdhana kareche| jene rekha, yAlimarA bhoga karave sthAYI zAsti|
AllAha vyatIta tAderake sAhAyya karAra janya tAdera kona abhibhAvaka thAkavenA evaM AllAha yAke pathabhraSTa karena tAra kona gati nei|
tomarA tomAdera ravera AhavAne sAr3A dAo sei dina AsAra pUrve yA AllAhara vidhAne apratiroddha, ‘yedina tomAdera kona AzraYasthala thAkavenA, Ara nA (tomAdera pApa) asvIkAra karAra suyoga thAkave|’

tArA yadi mukha phiriYe neYa tAhale tomAketo Ami tAdera rakSaka kare pAThAini| tomAra kAjato zudhu pracAra kare yAoYA| Ami mAnuSake yakhana anugraha AsvAdana karAi takhana se utphulla haYa evaM yakhana tAdera kRtakarmera janya tAdera vipada Apada ghaTe takhana mAnuSa haYe yAYa akRtajJa|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva AllAharai| tini yA icchA tA’i sRSTi karena| tini yAke icchA kanyA santAna evaM yAke icchA putra santAna dAna karena|
athavA dAna karena putra o kanyA ubhaYai evaM yAke icchA tAke kare dena vandhyA| tini sarvajJa, sarvazaktimAna|

mAnuSera emana maryAdA nei ye, AllAha tAra sAthe kathA valavena ahIra mAdhyama chAr3A, athavA pardAra antarAla vyatita, athavA emana dUta preraNa chAr3A ye dUta tA~ra anumatikrame tini yA cAna tA vyakta kare| tini samunnata, prajJAmaYa|

ebhAve Ami tomAra prati pratyAdeza karechi rUha tathA AmAra nirdeza; tumito jAnatenA kitAva ki o ImAna ki! pakSAntare Ami eke karechi Alo yA dvArA Ami AmAra vAndAdera madhye yAke icchA patha-nirdeza kari; tumito pradarzana kara zudhu sarala patha –
sei AllAhara patha yini AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tAra mAlika| jene rekha, sakala viSaYera pariNAma AllAharai dike pratyAvartana kare|
hA, mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera!
Ami eTA avatIrNa karechi ArAvI bhASAYa kuraAna rUpe, yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
eTA raYeche AmAra nikaTa ummula kitAve; eTA mahAna, jJAnagarbha|
Ami ki tomAdera hate ei upadeza vANI sampUrNarUpe pratyAhAra kare niva ei kAraNe ye, tomarA sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa?
pUrvavartIdera nikaTa Ami vahu nAvI preraNa karechilAma|
evaM yakhanai tAdera nikaTa kona nAvI eseche, tArA tAke ThATTA vidrupa kareche|
tAdera madhye yArA edera apekSA zaktite pravala chila tAderake Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma; Ara ebhAve cale Asache pUrvavartIdera anurUpa dRSTAnta|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa karaH ke AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena? tArA avazyai valaveH egulito sRSTi karechena parAkramazAlI, sarvajJa AllAha –
yini tomAdera janya pRthivIke karechena zayyA evaM ote karechena tomAdera calAra patha, yAte tomarA saThika patha pete pAra;
evaM yini AkAza hate vAri varSaNa karena parimitabhAve| evaM Ami tadvArA saJjIvita kari nirjIva bhUkhanDake| ebhAvei tomAderake punarutthita karA have|
evaM yini yugalasamUhera pratyekake sRSTi karena evaM yini tomAdera janya sRSTi karena emana nauyAna o catuspada jantu yAte tomarA ArohaNa kara –

yAte tomarA odera pRSThe sthira haYe vasate pAra, tArapara tomAdera ravera anugraha smaraNa kara yakhana tomarA ora upara sthira haYe vasa evaM valaH pavitra o mahAna tini yini ederake AmAdera vazIbhUta kare diYechena yadio AmarA samartha chilAmanA ederake vazIbhUta karate|
AmarA AmAdera ravera nikaTa avazyai pratyAvartana karava|
tArA tA~ra vAndAdera madhya hate tA~ra aMza sAvyasta kareche| mAnuSato spaSTai akRtajJa|
tini ki tA~ra sRSTi hate nijera janya kanyA santAna grahaNa karechena evaM tomAderake viziSTa karechena putra santAna dvArA?
daYAmaYa AllAhara prati tArA yA Aropa kare tAdera kehake sei santAnera saMvAda deYA hale tAra mukhamanDala kAlo haYe yAYa evaM se duHsaha marma yAtanAYa kliSTa haYa|
tArA ki AllAhara prati Aropa kare emana santAna, ye alaMkAre AvRta haYe lAlita pAlita haYa evaM tarka-vitarka kAle spaSTa vaktavye asamartha?
tArA daYAmaYa AllAhara vAndA mAlAikAke nArI ganya kareche| edera sRSTi ki tArA pratyakSa karechila? tAdera ukti lipivaddha karA have evaM tAderake jijJesa karA have|
tArA valeH daYAmaYa AllAha icchA karale AmarA edera pUjA karatAmanA| e viSaYe tAdera kona jJAna nei; tArAto zudhu mithyAi valache|
Ami ki tAderake kuraAnera pUrve kona kitAva dAna karechi, yA tArA dRr3habhAve dhAraNa kare Ache?
varaM tArA valeH AmarAto AmAdera pUrva puruSaderake peYechi eka matAdarzera anusArI evaM AmarA tAderai padAGka anusaraNa karachi|

ebhAve tomAra pUrve kona janapade yakhanai kona satarkakArI preraNa karechi takhana ora samRddhazAlI vyaktirA valataH AmarAto AmAdera pUrva-puruSaderake peYechi eka matAdarzera anusArI evaM AmarA tAderai padAGka anusaraNa karachi|

sei satarkakArI valataH tomarA tomAdera pUrva-puruSaderake ye pathe peYecha, Ami yadi tomAdera janya tadapekSA utkRSTa patha-nirdeza AnaYana kari tAhaleo ki tomarA tAdera padAGka anusaraNa karave? tArA valataH tomarA yA saha prerita haYecha AmarA tA pratyAkhyAna kari|
ataHpara Ami tAderake tAdera karmera pratiphala dilAma; dekha, mithyAcArIdera pariNAma ki haYeche!
smaraNa kara, ivarAhIma tAra pitA evaM sampradAYake valechilaH tomarA yAdera pUjA kara tAdera sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei|
samparka Ache zudhu tA~rai sAthe yini AmAke sRSTi karechena evaM tinii AmAke sat pathe paricAlita karavena|
ei ghoSaNAke se sthAYI vANI rUpe rekhe geche tAra paravartIdera janya yAte tArA pratyAvartana kare|
varaM Amii tAderake evaM tAdera pUrva-puruSaderake suyoga diYechilAma bhogera; avazeSe tAdera nikaTa elo satya o spaSTa pracAraka rAsUla|
yakhana tAdera nikaTa satya elo takhana tArA valalaH eTAto yAdu evaM AmarA eTA pratyAkhyAna kari|
evaM tArA valeH ei kuraAna kena avatIrNa karA halanA dui janapadera kona pratipattizAlI vyaktira upara?

tArA ki tomAra ravera karuNA vanTana kare? Amii tAdera madhye jIvikA vanTana kari tAdera pArthiva jIvane evaM ekajanake aparera upara maryAdAYa unnIta kari yAte eke aparera dvArA kAja kariYe nite pAre; evaM tArA yA jamA kare tA hate tomAra ravera anugraha utkRSTatara|

satya pratyAkhyAne mAnuSa eka matAvalamvI haYe par3ave, ei AzaMkA nA thAkale daYAmaYa AllAhake yArA asvIkAra kare tAderake Ami ditAma tAdera gRhera janya raupya nirmita chAda o sir3i yAte tArA ArohaNa kare|
evaM tAdera gRhera janya ditAma raupya nirmita darajA, vizrAmera janya pAlaGka yAte tArA helAna diYe vasata|
evaM svarNera nirmitao| Ara ei savaito zudhu pArthiva jIvanera bhoga sambhAra| muttAkIdera janya tomAra ravera nikaTa raYeche AkhirAtera kalyANa|
ye vyakti daYAmaYa AllAhara smaraNe vimukha haYa Ami tAra janya niYojita kari eka zAitAna, ataHpara se haYa tAra sahacara|
zAitAnarAi mAnuSake sat patha hate virata rAkhe, athaca mAnuSa mane kare ye, tArA sat pathe paricAlita hacche|
avazeSe yakhana se AmAra nikaTa upasthita have takhana se zAitAnake valaveH hAYa! AmAra o tomAra madhye yadi pUrva o pazcimera vyavadhAna thAkata! kata nikRSTa sahacara se!
yehetu tomarA sImAlaMghana karechile, tAi Aja tomAdera ei anutApa tomAdera kona kAje Asave nA, tomarA to savAi zAstite zarIka|
tumi ki zonAte pArave vadhirake? athavA ye andha evaM ye vyakti spaSTa vibhrAntite Ache tAke ki pArave sat pathe paricAlita karate?
Ami yadi tomAra mRtyu ghaTAi, tavuo Ami tAderake zAsti diva|
athavA Ami tAderake ye zAstira bhIti pradarzana karechi yadi Ami tomAke tA pratyakSa karAi tAhale tAdera upara AmAra pUrNa kSamatA raYeche|
sutarAM tomAra prati yA ahI karA haYeche tA dRr3habhAve avalamvana kara| tumi sarala pathei raYecha|
nizcaYai ihA (kuraAna) tomAra evaM tomAra sampradAYera janya upadeza, tomAderake avazyai e viSaYe prazna karA have|
tomAra pUrve Ami ye sava rAsUla preraNa karechilAma tAderake tumi jijJesa kara, Ami ki daYAmaYa AllAha vyatIta kona upAsya sthira karechilAma yAra ivAdAta karA yAYa?
mUsAke Ami AmAra nidarzanasaha phira‘Auna o tAra pariSadavargera nikaTa pAThiYechilAma; se valechilaH Ami jagatasamUhera ravera pakSa hate prerita rAsUla|
se tAdera nikaTa AmAra nidarzanasaha AsA mAtra tArA tA niYe hAsi-ThATTA karate lAgala|
Ami tAderake emana kona nidarzana dekhAini yA ora anurUpa nidarzana apekSA zreSTha naYa| Ami tAderake zAsti dilAma yAte tArA pratyAvartana kare|
tArA valechilaH he yAdukara! tomAra ravera nikaTa tumi AmAdera janya tA prArthanA kara yA tini tomAra sAthe aMgIkAra karechena; tAhale AmarA avazyai sat patha avalamvana karava|
ataHpara yakhana Ami tAdera upara hate zAsti vidUrita karalAma takhanai tArA aMgIkAra bhaMga karate lAgala|
phira‘Auna tAra sampradAYera madhye ei vale ghoSaNA karalaH he AmAra sampradAYa! misara rAjya ki AmAra naYa? ei nadIguli AmAra pAdadeze pravAhita, tomarA ki dekhanA?
Ami ki zreSTha nai ei vyakti hate ye hIna evaM spaSTa kathA valate akSama?
mUsAke kena deYA hala nA svarNa valaYa, athavA tAra sAthe kena elo nA mAlAikA/pherezatA dalavaddhabhAve?
ebhAve se tAra sampradAYake hatavuddhi kare dila| phale tArA tAra kathA mene nila| tArAto chila eka satyatyAgI sampradAYa|
yakhana tArA AmAke krodhAnvita karala takhana Ami tAderake zAsti dilAma evaM nimajjita karalAma tAdera savAike|
ataHpara paravartIdera janya Ami tAderake kare rAkhalAma atIta itihAsa o dRSTAnta|
yakhana mAraiYAma tanaYera dRSTAnta upasthita karA haYa takhana tomAra sampradAYa zoragola zuru kare deYa|
evaM valeH AmAdera devatAguli zreSTha, nA IsA? tArA zudhu vAka-vitanDAra uddezei tomAke e kathA vale| vastutaH tArAto zudhu vAka-vitanDAkArI sampradAYa|
seto chila AmArai eka vAndA, yAke Ami anugraha karechilAma evaM karechilAma vAnI isarAIlera janya dRSTAnta|
Ami icchA karale tomAdera madhya hate mAlAikA/pherezatA sRSTi karate pAratAma, yArA pRthivIte uttarAdhikArI hata|
IsAto kiYAmAtera nidarzana; sutarAM tomarA kiYAmAte sandeha poSaNa karanA evaM AmAke anusaraNa kara| eTAi sarala patha|
zAitAna yena tomAderake kichutei nivRtta nA kare, seto tomAdera prakAzya zatru|

IsA yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha elo takhana se valalaH Amito tomAdera nikaTa esechi prajJAsaha evaM tomarA ye viSaYe matabheda karacha tA spaSTa kare deYAra janya| sutarAM tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM AmAra anusaraNa kara|
AllAhai AmAra rAvva evaM tomAdera rAvva| ataeva tA~ra ivAdAta kara; eTAi sarala patha|
ataHpara tAdera katipaYa dala matAnaikya sRSTi karala; sutarAM yAlimadera janya durbhoga, yantraNAdAYaka dinera zAstira|
tArAto tAdera ajJAtasAre AkasmikabhAve kiYAmAta AsArai apekSA karache|
vandhurA sei dina haYe par3ave eke aparera zatru, tave mu’minarA vyatIta|
he AmAra vAndAgaNa! Aja tomAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM duHkhitao havenA tomarA –
yArA AmAra AYAte vizvAsa karechila evaM AtmasamarpaNa karechila|
tomarA evaM tomAdera sahadharminIgaNa sAnande jAnnAte praveza kara|
svarNera thAlA o pAnapAtra niYe tAderake pradakSiNa karA have; sekhAne raYeche savakichu, antara yA cAYa evaM naYana yAte tRpta haYa| sekhAne tomarA sthAYI have|
eTAi jAnnAta, tomAderake yAra adhikArI karA haYeche, tomAdera karmera phala svarUpa|
sekhAne tomAdera janya raYeche pracura phalamUla, tomarA AhAra karave tA hate|
nizcaYai aparAdhIrA jAhAnnAmera zAstite thAkave sthAYI|
tAdera zAsti lAghava karA havenA evaM tArA hatAza haYe par3ave|
Ami tAdera prati yulama karini, varaM tArA nijerAi chila yAlima|
tArA citkAra kare valaveH he mAlika (jAhAnnAmera adhikartA) tomAra rAvva AmAderake niHzeSa kare dina| se valaveH tomarA ebhAvei thAkave|
AllAha valavenaH Ami tomAdera nikaTa satya pau~chiYe chilAma, kintu tomAdera adhikAMzai chile satya vimukha|
tArA ki kona vyApAre cUr3Anta siddhAnta grahaNa kareche? Amii siddhAnta grahaNakArI|
tArA ki mane kare ye, Ami tAdera gopana viSaYa o mantranAra khavara rAkhinA? avazyai rAkhi| AmAra mAlAikA/pherezatAto tAdera nikaTa theke sava kichu lipivaddha kare|
valaH daYAmaYa ‘rAhamAnera’ kona santAna thAkale Ami hatAma tAra upAsakagaNera agraNI|
tArA yA Aropa kare tA hate pavitra AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra mahAna adhipati evaM Arazera adhikArI|
ataeva tAderake ye dinera kathA valA haYeche tAra sammukhIna havAra pUrva paryanta vAka-vitanDA o krIr3A-kautuka karate dAo|
tinii mA‘vUda nabhomanDalera, tinii mA‘vUda bhUtalera evaM tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
kata mahAna tini, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM eigulira madhyavartI sava kichura sArvabhauma adhipati! kiYAmAtera jJAna zudhu tA~rai Ache evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomarA pratyAvartita have|
AllAhara parivarte tArA yAderake DAke, supArizera kSamatA tAdera nei, tave yArA satya upalavdhi kare ora sAkSya deYa tArA vyatIta|
tumi yadi tAderake jijJesa kara, ke tAderake sRSTi kareche tAhale tArA avazyai valaveH AllAha! tavuo tArA kothAYa phire yAcche?
Ami avagata Achi rAsUlera ei ukti - he AmAra rAvva! ei sampradAYato ImAna AnavenA|
sutarAM tumi tAderake upekSA kara evaM valaH sAlAma! tArA zIghrai jAnate pArave|
hA mIma|
zapatha suspaSTa kitAvera|
Ami ihA avatIrNa karechi eka muvArAka rAte, Amito satarkakArI|
e rAte pratyeka gurutvapUrNa viSaYa sthirIkRta haYa –
AmAra Adezakrame; Ami rAsUla preraNa kare thAki –
tomAra ravera anugraha svarUpa, tini sarvazrotA, sarvajJa –
yini AkAzamanDalI, pRthivI evaM ogulira madhyasthita sava kichura rAvva - yadi tomarA nizcita vizvAsI hao|
tini vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei, tini jIvana dAna karena evaM tinii mRtyu ghaTAna; tinii tomAdera evaM tomAdera pUrva-puruSaderao rAvva|
vastutaH tArA sandehera vazavartI haYe hAsi ThATTA karache|
ataeva tumi apekSA kara sei dinera yedina spaSTa dhumrAcchanna have AkAza|
evaM tA AvRta kare phelave mAnava jAtike| eTA have yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
takhana tArA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake ei zAsti hate mukti dina, AmarA ImAna Anava|
tArA ki kare upadeza grahaNa karave? tAdera nikaTato eseche spaSTa vyAkhyAkArI eka rAsUla;
ataHpara tArA tAke amAnya kare valeH seto zikhAno vuli valache, seto eka pAgala|
Ami tomAdera zAsti kichu kAlera janya rahita karachi, tomarAto tomAdera pUrvAvasthAYa phire yAve|
yedina Ami tomAderake pravalabhAve pAkar3Ao karava sedina Ami tomAderake zAsti divai|
edera pUrve Ami phira‘Auna sampradAYake parIkSA karechilAma evaM tAdera nikaTao esechila eka mahAna rAsUla|
se valalaH AllAhara vAndAderake AmAra nikaTa pratyarpaNa kara| Ami tomAdera janya eka vizvasta rAsUla|
evaM tomarA AllAhara viruddhe uddhata haYonA, Ami tomAdera nikaTa upasthita karachi spaSTa pramANa|
tomarA yAte AmAke prastarAghAte hatyA karate nA pAra tajjanya Ami AmAra rAvva o tomAdera ravera AzraYa prArthanA karachi|
yadi tomarA AmAra kathAYa vizvAsa sthApana nA kara tAhale tomarA AmA hate dUre thAka|
ataHpara mUsA tAra ravera nikaTa nivedana karalaH erAto eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|
Ami valechilAmaH tumi AmAra vAndAderake niYe rAte vera haYe par3a, tomAdera pazcAddhAvana karA have|
samudrake sthira thAkate dAo, tArA emana eka vAhinI yArA nimajjita have|
tArA pazcAte rekhe gela kata udyAna o prasravaNa,
kata zasya kSeta o suramya prAsAda,
kata vilAsa upakaraNa, yA tAderake Ananda dita|
erUpai ghaTechila evaM Ami ei samudaYera uttarAdhikArI karechilAma bhinna sampradAYake|
AkAza evaM pRthivIra kehai tAdera janya azrupAta kareni evaM tAderake avakAzao deYA haYani|
Ami uddhAra karechilAma vAnI isarAIlake lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti hate –
phira‘Aunera; se to parAkrAnta sImAlaMghanakArIdera madhye|
Ami jene zunei tAderake vizve zreSThatva diYechilAma|
evaM tAderake diYechilAma nidarzanAvalI, yAte chila suspaSTa parIkSA|
tArA valei thAke –
AmAdera prathama mRtyu vyatIta Ara kichui nei evaM AmarA Ara punarutthita havanA|
ataeva tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale AmAdera pUrva-puruSaderake upasthita kara|
zreSTha ki tArA nA tuvvA sampradAYa o tAdera pUrvavartIrA? Ami tAderake dhvaMsa karechilAma, avazyai tArA chila aparAdhI|
Ami AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera madhyasthita kona kichui krIr3Acchale sRSTi karini|
Ami e du’Ti ayathA sRSTi karini, kintu tAdera adhikAMzai eTA jAnenA|
nizcaYai sakalera janya nirdhArita raYeche tAdera vicAra divasa –
yedina eka vandhu apara vandhura kona kAje AsavenA evaM tArA sAhAyyao pAvenA|
tave AllAha yAra prati daYA karena tAra kathA svatantra| tini parAkramazAlI, parama daYAlu|
nizcaYai yAkkuma vRkSa have –
pApIra khAdya|
galita tAmrera mata; oTA tAra udare phuTate thAkave –
phuTanta pAnira mata|
(valA have) tAke dhara evaM Tene niYe yAo jAhAnnAmera madhyasthale|
ataHpara tAra mAthAra upara phuTanta pAni Dhele diYe zAsti dAo|
evaM valA haveH AsvAdana kara, tumito chile sammAnita, abhijAta|
eTAto oTAi, ye viSaYe tomarA sandeha karate|
muttAkIrA thAkave nirApada sthAne –
udyAna o jharNAra mAjhe|
tArA paridhAna karave mihi o puru rezamI vastra evaM tArA mukhomukhI haYe vasave|
erUpai ghaTave; tAderake saGginI diva AYatalocanA hura|
sekhAne tArA prazAntacitte vividha phalamUla Anate valave|
prathama mRtyura para tArA sekhAne Ara mRtyu AsvAdana karavenA| tAderake jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate rakSA karavena –
tomAra rAvva nija anugrahe| eTAito mahA sAphalya|
Ami tomAra bhASAYa kuraAnake sahaja kare diYechi yAte tArA upadeza grahaNa kare|
sutarAM tumi pratIkSA kara, tArAoto pratIkSamAna|
hA mIma|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte nidarzana raYeche mu’minadera janya|
tomAdera sRSTite evaM jIvajantura vistAre nidarzana raYeche nizcita vizvAsIdera janya|
nidarzana raYeche cintAzIla sampradAYera janya, rAta o dinera parivartane, AllAha AkAza hate ye vAri varSaNa dvArA dharitrIke ora mRtyura para punarujjIvita karena tAte evaM vAYura parivartane|
eguli AllAhara AYAta yA Ami tomAra nikaTa AvRtti karachi yathAyathabhAve; sutarAM AllAha evaM tA~ra AYAtera parivarte tArA Ara kon vANIte vizvAsa karave?
durbhoga pratyeka mithyAvAdI pApIra|
ye AllAhara AYAtera AvRtti zone, athaca auddhatyera sAthe aTala thAke yena se tA zoneni, tAke saMvAda dAo yantraNAdAYaka zAstira|
yakhana AmAra kona AYAta se avagata haYa takhana se tA niYe parihAsa kare| tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
tAdera pazcAte raYeche jAhAnnAma; tAdera kRtakarma tAdera kona kAje AsavenA, tArA AllAhara parivarte yAderake abhibhAvaka sthira kareche tArAo naYa| tAdera janya raYeche mahAzAsti|
kuraAna sat pathera dizArI; yArA tAdera ravera nidarzanAvalI pratyAkhyAna kare tAdera janya raYeche atizaYa yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|
AllAhai samudrake tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena, yAte tA~ra Adeze tAte nauyAnasamUha calAcala karate pAre evaM yAte tomarA tA~ra anugraha anusandhAna karate pAra o tA~ra prati kRtajJa hao|
tini tomAdera kalyANe niYojita karechena AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sava kichu nija anugrahe| cintAzIla sampradAYera janya ete raYeche nidarzana|
mu’minaderake valaH tArA yena kSamA kare tAderake yArA AllAhara dinagulira pratyAzA karenA, eTA e janya ye AllAha pratyeka sampradAYake tAra kRtakarmera janya pratidAna divena|
ye sat kAja kare se tAra kalyANera janyai tA kare evaM keha manda kAja karale ora pratiphala se’i bhoga karave, ataHpara tomarA tomAdera ravera nikaTa pratyAvartita have|
Amito vAnI isarAIlake kitAva, kartRtva o navuoYAta dAna karechilAma evaM tAderake uttama jIvanopakaraNa diYechilAma evaM diYechilAma zreSThatva vizvajagatera upara|

tAderake suspaSTa pramANa dAna karechilAma dIna samparke| tAdera nikaTa jJAna AsAra para tArA zudhu paraspara vidveSavazataH virodhitA karechila, tArA ye viSaYe matavirodha karata, tomAra rAvva kiYAmAta divase tAdera madhye sei viSaYera phAYasAlA kare divena|
erapara Ami tomAke pratiSThita karechi dInera vizeSa vidhAnera upara| sutarAM tumi ora anusaraNa kara, ajJadera kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa karanA|
AllAhara mukAvilAYa tArA tomAra kona upakAra karate pAravenA; yAlimarA eke aparera vandhu; Ara AllAha muttAkIdera vandhu|
ei kuraAna mAnava jAtira janya suspaSTa dalIla evaM nizcita vizvAsI sampradAYera janya pathanirdeza o rAhamAta|
duskRtikArIrA ki mane kare ye, Ami jIvana o mRtyura dika diYe tAderake tAdera samAna gaNya karava, yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare? tAdera siddhAnta katai manda!
AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena yathAyathabhAve evaM yAte pratyeka vyakti tAra kAja anuyAYI phala pete pAre, Ara tAdera prati yulama karA have nA|

tumi ki lakSya karacha tAke, ye tAra kheYAla khuzIke nijera mA‘vUda vAniYe niYeche? AllAha jene zunei tAke vibhrAnta karechena evaM tAra karNa o hRdaYa mohara kare diYechena evaM tAra cakSura upara rekhechena AvaraNa| ataeva, ke tAke patha nirdeza karave? tavuo ki tomarA upadeza grahaNa karavenA?
tArA valeH ekamAtra pArthiva jIvanai AmAdera jIvana, AmarA mari o vA~ci, Ara samaYai (kAla) AmAderake dhvaMsa kare| vastutaH e vyApAre tAdera kona jJAna nei, tArAto zudhu managar3A kathA vale|
tAdera nikaTa yakhana AmAra suspaSTa AYAta AvRtti karA haYa takhana tAdera kona yukti thAkenA zudhu ei ukti chAr3A ye, tomarA satyavAdI hale AmAdera pUrva-puruSaderake upasthita kara|
valaH AllAhai tomAderake jIvana dAna karena o tomAdera mRtyu ghaTAna| ataHpara tini tomAderake kiYAmAta divase ekatrita karavena yAte kona sandeha nei| kintu adhikAMza mAnuSa tA jAnenA|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva AllAharai; yedina kiYAmAta saMghaTita have sedina mithyAzraYIrA have kSatigrasta|
evaM pratyeka sampradAYake dekhave bhaYe natajAnu; pratyeka sampradAYake tAra AmalanAmAra prati AhavAna karA have, Aja tomAderake tArai pratiphala deYA have yA tomarA karate|
ei AmAra lipi, eTA tomAdera viruddhe satya sAkSya dive| tomarA yA karate tA Ami lipivaddha karechilAma|
yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare, tAdera rAvva tAderake dAkhila karavena svIYa rAhamAte| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
pakSAntare yArA kupharI kare tAderake valA haveH tomAdera nikaTa ki AmAra AYAta pATha karA haYani? kintu tomarA auddhatya prakAza karechile evaM tomarA chile eka aparAdhI sampradAYa|

yakhana valA haYaH AllAhara pratizruti satya evaM kiYAmAta - ete kona sandeha nei, takhana tomarA vale thAkaH AmarA jAninA kiYAmAta ki; AmarA mane kari eTA ekaTi dhAranA mAtra evaM AmarA e viSaYe nizcita nai|
tAdera manda kAjaguli tAdera nikaTa prakAza haYe par3ave evaM yA niYe tArA ThATTA vidrupa karata tA tAderake pariveSTana karave|
Ara valA haveH Aja Ami tomAderake vismRta hava yemana tomarA ei dinera sAkSAtkArake vismRta haYechile| tomAdera AzraYasthala have jAhAnnAma evaM tomAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkavenA|

eTA e janya ye, tomarA AllAhara nidarzanAvalIke vidrupa karechile evaM pArthiva jIvana tomAderake pratArita karechila| sutarAM sedina tAderake jAhAnnAma hate vera karA havenA evaM AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera ceSTAra suyoga deYA havenA|
prazaMsA AllAharai yini AkAzamanDalIra rAvva, pRthivIra rAvva, jagatasamUhera rAvva|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte gaurava garimA tA~rai evaM tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
hA mIma|
ei kitAva parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa AllAhara nikaTa hate avatIrNa|

AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM etadubhaYera madhyasthita sava kichui Ami yathAyathabhAve nirdiSTa kAlera janya sRSTi karechi; kintu kAphiraderake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYeche tA hate mukha phiriYe neYa|

valaH tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAderake DAka tAdera kathA bheve dekhecha ki? tArA pRthivIte ki sRSTi kareche AmAke dekhAo athavA AkAzamanDalIte tAdera kona aMzIdArItva Ache ki? pUrvavartI kona kitAva athavA paramparAgata kona jJAna thAkale tA tomarA AmAra nikaTa upasthita kara - yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
sei vyakti apekSA vibhrAnta ke ye AllAhara parivarte emana kichuke DAke yA kiYAmAtera dina paryantao tAra DAke sAr3A divenA? evaM oguli tAdera prArthanA samvandhe avahita naYa|
yakhana kiYAmAta divase mAnuSake ekatrita karA have takhana aigulo have tAdera zatru, aigulo tAdera ivAdAta asvIkAra karave|
yakhana tAdera nikaTa AmAra suspaSTa AYAta AvRtti karA haYa evaM tAdera nikaTa satya upasthita haYa takhana kAphirerA valeH eTAto suspaSTa yAdu|

tArA ki tAhale vale ye, se eTA udbhAvana kareche? valaH yadi Ami udbhAvana kare thAki tAhale tomarA AllAhara zAsti hate AmAke kichutei rakSA karate pAravenA| tomarA ye viSaYe AlocanAYa lipta Acha sei samvandhe AllAha savizeSa avahita| AmAra o tomAdera madhye sAkSI hisAve tinii yatheSTa evaM tini kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
valaH Ami emana kona prathama o natuna nAvI nai| Ami jAninA, AmAra o tomAdera vyApAre ki karA have; Ami AmAra prati yA ahI karA haYa zudhu tArai anusaraNa kari| Ami eka spaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|

valaH tomarA bheve dekhecha ki ye, ei kuraAna AllAhara nikaTa hate avatIrNa haYe thAke, Ara tomarA ete avizvAsa kara, uparanta vAnI isarAIlera ekajana era anurUpa samparke sAkSya diYe ete vizvAsa sthApana karala athaca tomarA kara auddhatya prakAza, tAhale tomAdera pariNAma ki have? AllAha yAlimaderake sat pathe cAlita karenanA|
mu’minadera samparke kAphirerA valeH eTA bhAla hale tArA era dike AmAdera ceYe agragAmI hatanA| tArA era dvArA paricAlita naYa vale, valeH eTAto eka purAtana mithyA|
era pUrve chila mUsAra kitAva - Adarza o anugraha svarUpa ei kitAva - era samarthaka, ArAvI bhASAYa, yena eTA yAlimaderake satarka kare evaM yArA sat kAja kare tAderake susaMvAda deYa|
yArA valeH AmAdera rAvvato AllAha evaM ei vizvAse avicala thAke, tAdera kona bhaYa nei evaM tArA duHkhitao havenA|
erAi jAnnAtera adhivAsI, sekhAne erA sthAYI have, eTAi tAdera karmaphala|

Ami mAnuSake tAra mAtA-pitAra prati sadaYa vyavahArera nirdeza diYechi| tAra jananI tAke garbhe dhAraNa kare kaSTera sAthe evaM prasava kare kaSTera sAthe, tAra garbhadhAraNa o dudha chAr3Anora samaYakAla triza mAsa, krame se pUrNa zakti prApta haYa evaM calliza vachare upanIta haoYAra para valeH he AmAra rAvva! Apani AmAke sAmarthya dina yAte Ami ApanAra kRtajJatA prakAza karate pAri, AmAra prati o AmAra mAtA-pitAra prati Apani ye anugraha karechena tAra janya evaM yAte Ami sat kAja karate pAri yA Apani pachanda karena; AmAra janya AmAra santAna santatiderake satkarmaparAYaNa karuna, Ami ApanArai abhimukhI halAma evaM AtmasamarpaNa karalAma|
Ami edera satkAjaguli grahaNa kare thAki evaM manda kAjaguli kSamA kari, tArA jAnnAtavAsIdera antarbhukta| ederake ye pratizruti deYA haYeche tA satya pramANita have|

Ara emana loka Ache, ye tAra mAtA-pitAke valeH Aphasosa tomAdera janya| tomarA ki AmAke e bhaYa dekhAte cAo ye, Ami punarutthita hava yadio AmAra pUrve vahu puruSa gata haYeche! takhana tAra mAtA-pitA AllAhara nikaTa phariYAda kare valeH durbhoga tomAra janya! vizvAsa sthApana kara, AllAhara pratizruti avazyai satya| kintu se valeH eTAto atIta kAlera upakathA vyatIta kichui naYa|
edera pUrve ye jina o mAnuSa sampradAYa gata haYeche tAdera mata edera pratio AllAhara ukti satya haYeche| erAi kSatigrasta|
pratyekera maryAdA tAra kAja anuyAYI; eTA e janya ye, AllAha pratyekera karmera pUrNa pratiphala divena evaM tAra prati avicAra karA havenA|

yedina kAphiraderake jAhAnnAmera sannikaTe upasthita karA have sedina tAderake valA haveH tomarAto pArthiva jIvane sukha-sambhoga bhoga kare niHzeSa karecha, sutarAM Aja tomAderake deYA have avamAnanAkara zAsti; kAraNa tomarA pRthivIte anyAYabhAve auddhatya prakAza karechile evaM tomarA chile satyadrohI|

smaraNa kara, ‘Ada sampradAYera bhAiYera kathA, yAra pUrve evaM pareo satarkakArI esechila, se tAra AhakAphavAsI sampradAYake vAlukAmaYa ucca upatyakAYa satarka karechila ei valeH AllAha vyatIta kArao ivAdAta karanA| Ami tomAdera janya mahAdinera zAstira AzaMkA karachi|
tArA valechilaH tumi AmAderake AmAdera deva devIgulira pUjA hate nivRtta karate esecha? tumi satyavAdI hale AmAderake yAra bhaYa dekhAccha tA AnaYaNa kara|
se valalaH era jJAnato zudhu AllAhara nikaTa raYeche; Ami yA saha prerita haYechi zudhu tA’i tomAdera nikaTa pracAra kari, kintu Ami dekhachi, tomarA eka mUr3ha sampradAYa|

ataHpara yakhana tArA tAdera upatyakAra dike megha Asate dekhala takhana tArA valate lAgalaH oTAto megha, AmAderake vRSTi dAna karave| huda valalaH eTAito oTA yA tomarA tvarAnvita karate ceYecha, ete raYeche eka jhar3a-marmantada zAsti vahanakArI|
AllAhara nirdeze eTA sava kichuke dhvaMsa kare dive| ataHpara tAdera pariNAma ei hala ye, tAdera vasatiguli chAr3A Ara kichui railanA| ebhAve Ami aparAdhI sampradAYake pratiphala diYe thAki|

Ami tAderake ye pratiSThA diYechilAma, tomAderake tA deini; Ami tAderake diYechilAma kAna, cokha o hRdaYa; kintu ai kAna, cokha o hRdaYa tAdera kona kAje Aseni; kenanA tArA AllAhara AYAtasamUhake asvIkAra karechila| yA niYe tArA ThATTA vidrupa karata tA’i tAderake pariveSTana karala|
Amito dhvaMsa karechilAma tomAdera catuspArzvavartI janapadasamUha; Ami tAderake vibhinnabhAve AmAra nidarzanAvalI vivRta karechilAma, yAte tArA phire Ase sat pathe|

tArA AllAhara sAnnidhya lAbhera janya AllAhara parivarte yAderake mA‘vUda rUpe grahaNa karechila tArA tAderake sAhAyya karalanA kena? vastutaH tAdera mA‘vUdaguli tAdera nikaTa hate antarhita haYe par3ala| tAdera mithyA o alIka udbhAvanera pariNAma erUpai|

smaraNa kara, Ami tomAra prati AkRSTa karechilAma ekadala jinake, yArA kuraAna pATha zunachila, yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa upasthita hala; tArA eke aparake valate lAgalaH cupa kare zravaNa kara| yakhana kuraAna pATha samApta hala takhana tArA tAdera sampradAYera nikaTa phire gela satarkakArIrUpe|

tArA valechilaH he AmAdera sampradAYa! AmarA eka kitAva pATha zravaNa karechi yA avatIrNa haYeche mUsAra pare, eTA tAra pUrvavartI kitAvake samarthana kare evaM satya o sarala pathera dike paricAlita kare|
he AmAdera sampradAYa! AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra prati sAr3A dAo evaM tAra prati vizvAsa sthApana kara, AllAha tomAdera pApa kSamA karavena evaM yantraNAdAYaka zAsti hate tomAderake rakSA karavena|

yadi keha AllAhara dike AhavAnakArIra DAke sAr3A nA deYa tAhale se pRthivIte AllAhara abhiprAYa vyartha karate pAravenA evaM AllAha chAr3A tAdera kona sAhAyyakArI thAkavenA| tArAto suspaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche|
tArA ki dekhenA ye, AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena evaM e savera sRSTite kona klAnti vodha karenani? tini mRtake jIvana dAna karateo sakSama| nizcaYai tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

yedina kAphiraderake upasthita karA have jAhAnnAmera nikaTa, sedina tAderake valA haveH eTA ki satya naYa? tArA valaveH AmAdera ravera zapatha! eTA satya| takhana tAderake valA haveH zAsti AsvAdAna kara| kAraNa tomarA chile satya pratyAkhyAnakArI|

ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara yemana karechila dRr3ha pratijJa rAsUlagaNa evaM tAdera janya (zAstira) prArthanAYa tar3ighar3i karanA| tAderake ye viSaYe satarka karA haYeche tA yedina tArA pratyakSa karave sedina tAdera mane have, tArA yena dinera eka danDera vezi pRthivIte avasthAna kareni| eTA eka spaSTa ghoSaNA, AllAha hate vimukha sampradAYa vyatIta kehakeo dhvaMsa karA havenA|
yArA kupharI kare evaM aparake AllAhara patha hate nivRtta kare tini tAdera kAja vyartha kare dena|

yArA ImAna Ane, sat kAja kare evaM muhAmmAdera prati yA avatIrNa haYeche tAte vizvAsa kare, Ara uhAi (kuraAna) tAdera rAvva hate satya; tini tAdera manda kAjaguli kSamA karavena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla karavena|

eTA e janya ye, yArA kupharI kare tArA mithyAra anusaraNa kare evaM yArA ImAna Ane tArA tAdera rAvva hate prerita satyerai anusaraNa kare| ebhAve AllAha mAnuSera janya tAdera dRSTAnta sthApana karena|

ataeva yakhana tomarA kAphiradera sAthe yuddhe mukAvilA kara takhana tAdera gardAne AghAta kara, parizeSe yakhana tomarA tAderake sampUrNa rUpe parAbhUta karave takhana tAderake kaSe vA~dhave; ataHpara haYa anukampA, nA haYa muktipaNa| tomarA jihAda cAlAve yatakSaNa nA orA astra nAmiYe phele| eTAi vidhAna| eTA e janya ye, AllAha icchA karale tAderake zAsti dite pAratena, kintu tini cAna tomAderake aparadera dvArA parIkSA karate| yArA AllAhara pathe nihata haYa tini kakhanao tAdera Amala vinaSTa hate denanA|
tini tAderake sat pathe paricAlita karavena evaM tAdera avasthA bhAla kare divena|
tini tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra kathA tini tAderake jAniYechilena|
he mu’minagaNa! yadi tomarA AllAhake sAhAyya kara tAhale AllAha tomAderake sAhAyya karavena evaM tomAdera avasthAna dRr3ha karavena|
yArA kupharI kareche tAdera janya raYeche durbhoga evaM tini tAdera kAja vyartha kare divena|
eTA e janya ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tArA tA apachanda kare| sutarAM AllAha tAdera kAja nisphala kare divena|
tArA ki pRthivIte bhramaNa kareni evaM dekheni tAdera pUrvavartIdera pariNAma ki haYechila? AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa karechena evaM kAphiradera janya raYeche anurUpa pariNAma|
eTA e janya ye, AllAha mu’minadera abhibhAvaka evaM kAphiradera kona abhibhAvaka nei|

yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare AllAha tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita; kintu yArA kupharI kare tArA bhoga vilAse lipta thAke evaM jantu-jAnoYArera mata udara pUrti kare; tAdera vAsasthAna have jAhAnnAma|
tArA ye janapada hate tomAke vitAr3ita kareche tA apekSA ati zaktizAlI kata janapada chila; Ami tAderake dhvaMsa karechi evaM tAderake sAhAyya karAra keha chilanA|
ye vyakti tAra rAvva hate prerita suspaSTa pramANera upara pratiSThita se ki tAra nyAYa yAra nikaTa nijera manda kAjaguli zobhana pratIYamAna haYa evaM yArA nija kheYAla khuzIra anusaraNa kare?

muttAkIderake ye jAnnAtera pratizruti deYA haYeche tAra dRSTAntaH ote Ache nirmala pAnira nahara; Ache dudhera nahara yAra svAda aparivartanIYa, Ache pAnakArIdera janya susvAdu surAra nahara evaM parizodhita madhura nahara| sekhAne tAdera janya thAkave vividha phalasamUha o tAdera ravera kSamA| muttAkIrA ki tAdera nyAYa yArA jAhAnnAme sthAYI have evaM yAderake pAna karate deYA have phuTanta pAni yA tAdera nAr3ibhur3i chinna vicchinna kare dive?

tAdera madhye kataka tomAra kathA zravaNa kare, ataHpara tomAra nikaTa hate vera haYe yArA jJAnavAna tAderake valeH ei mAtra se ki valala? edera antarera upara AllAha mohara mere diYechena evaM tArA nijedera kheYAla khuzIrai anusaraNa kare|
yArA sat patha avalamvana kare AllAha tAdera sat pathe calAra zakti vRddhi karena evaM tAderake muttAkI havAra zakti dAna karena|
tArA ki zudhu e janya apekSA karache ye, kiYAmAta tAdera nikaTa ese par3Uka Akasmika bhAve? kiYAmAtera lakSaNasamUhato esei par3eche! kiYAmAta ese par3ale tArA upadeza grahaNa karave kemana kare?
sutarAM jene rekha, AllAha chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei; kSamA prArthanA kara tomAra evaM mu’mina nara nArIdera truTira janya| AllAha tomAdera gatividhi evaM avasthAna samvandhe samyaka avagata Achena|

mu’minarA valeH ekaTi sUrA avatIrNa haYa nA kena? ataHpara yadi suspaSTa marma viziSTa kona sUrA avatIrNa haYa evaM tAte jihAdera kona nirdeza thAke tAhale tumi dekhave yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA mRtyubhaYe vihavala mAnuSera mata tomAra dike tAkAcche| zocanIYa pariNAma odera|
Anugatya o nyAYa saGgata vAkya odera janya uttama chila; sutarAM jihAdera siddhAnta hale yadi tArA AllAhara prati pradatta aGgIkAra pUraNa karata tAhale tAdera janya eTA maGgalajanaka hata|
kSamatAYa adhiSThita hale sambhavataH tomarA pRthivIte viparyaYa sRSTi karave evaM AtmIYatAra vandhana chinna karave|
AllAha ederakei karena abhizapta, Ara karena vadhira o dRSTizaktihIna|
tAhale ki tArA kuraAna samvandhe abhiniveza sahakAre cintA karenA? tAdera antara tAlAvaddha –
yArA nijedera nikaTa sat patha vyakta haoYAra para tA parityAga kare, zAitAna tAdera kAjake zobhana kare dekhAYa evaM tAdera mithyA AzvAsa deYa|
eTA e janya ye, AllAha yA avatIrNa karechena tA yArA apachanda kare tAderake tArA valeH AmarA kon kon viSaYe tomAdera Anugatya karava? AllAha tAdera gopana abhisandhi avagata Achena|
mAlAikA/pherezatArA yakhana tAdera mukhamanDale o pRSThadeze AghAta karate karate prANa haraNa karave takhana tAdera dazA kemana have!
eTA e janya ye, yAte AllAhara asantoSa janmAYa tArA tAra anusaraNa kare evaM tA~ra santuSTi lAbhera praYAsake apriYa gaNya kare; tini tAdera kAja niSphala kare dena|
yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA ki mane kare ye, AllAha tAdera vidveSa bhAva prakAza kare divenanA?
