Ami icchA karale tomAke tAdera paricaYa ditAma| phale tumi tAdera lakSaNa dekhe tAderake cinate pArate, tumi avazyai kathAra bhaGgite tAderake cinate pArave| AllAha tomAdera kAja samparke avagata|
Ami avazyai tomAderake parIkSA karava, yatakSaNa nA Ami jene nei tomAdera madhye ke jihAdakArI o dhairyazIla evaM Ami tomAdera kAryAvalI parIkSA kari|

yArA kupharI kare evaM mAnuSake AllAhara patha hate nivRtta kare evaM nijedera nikaTa pathera dizA vyakta haoYAra para rAsUlera virodhitA kare, tArA AllAhara kona kSati karate pAravenA| tini tAdera kAja vyartha karavena|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA AllAhara Anugatya kara, rAsUlera Anugatya kara evaM tomAdera karmaphala vinaSTa karanA|
yArA kupharI kare evaM AllAhara patha hate mAnuSake nivRtta kare, ataHpara kAphira avasthAYa mRtyu varaNa kare, AllAha tAderake kichutei kSamA karavena nA|
sutarAM tomarA hInavala haYo nA evaM sandhira prastAva karanA, tomarAi pravala; AllAha tomAdera saGge Achena, tini tomAdera karmaphala kakhanao kSunna karavena nA|
pArthiva jIvanato zudhu krIr3A-kautuka| yadi tomarA ImAna Ana o tAkaoYA avalamvana kara tAhale AllAha tomAdera puraskAra divena evaM tini tomAdera dhana sampada cAnanA|
tomAdera nikaTa hate tini tA cAile evaM tajjanya tomAdera upara cApa dile tomarAto kArpanya karave, evaM tini tomAdera manera saMkIrNatA prakAza kare divena|

dekha, tomarAito tArA yAdera AllAhara pathe vyaYa karate valA hacche, athaca tomAdera aneke kRpaNatA karacha; yArA kArpaNya kare tArAto kArpaNya kare nijederai prati| AllAha abhAvamukta evaM tomarA abhAvagrasta, yadi tomarA pRSTha pradarzana kara tAhale tini anya jAtike tomAdera sthalavartI karavena; tArA tomAdera mata havenA|
nizcaYai Ami tomAke diYechi suspaSTa vijaYa|
yena AllAha tomAra atIta o bhaviSyat truTisamUha mArjanA karena evaM tomAra prati tA~ra anugraha pUrNa karena o tomAke sarala pathe paricAlita karena|
evaM tomAke AllAha valiSTha sAhAyya dAna karena|
tinii mu’minadera antare prazAnti dAna karena yena tArA tAdera ImAnera sAthe ImAna vRddhi kare neYa; AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra vAhinIsamUha AllAharai evaM AllAhai sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

eTA e janya ye, tini mu’mina puruSa o mu’mina mahilAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita; sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM tini tAdera pApa mocana karavena; eTAi AllAhara dRSTite mahA sAphalya|

evaM munAphika puruSa o munAphika mahilA, muzarika puruSa o muzarika mahilA, yArA AllAha samvandhe manda dhAraNA poSaNa kare tAderake zAsti divena| amaGgala cakra tAdera janya, AllAha tAdera prati ruSTa haYechena evaM tAderake abhizapta karechena evaM tAdera janya jAhAnnAma prastuta rekhechena; oTA kata nikRSTa AvAsa!
AllAharai AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra vAhinIsamUha evaM AllAhai parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
Ami tomAke preraNa karechi sAkSIrUpe, susaMvAdadAtA o satarkakArIrUpe|
yAte tomarA AllAha o tAra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana evaM rAsUlake sAhAyya kara o sammAna kara; sakAla sandhyAYa AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|

yArA tomAra vAiAta grahaNa kare tArAto AllAharai vAiAta grahaNa kare| AllAhara hAta tAdera hAtera upara| sutarAM ye oTA bhaGga kare, oTA bhaGga karAra parinAma tArai evaM ye AllAhara sAthe aGgIkAra pUrNa kare tini tAke mahA puraskAra dena|

ye sava ArAva maruvAsI gRhe raYe geche tArA tomAke valaveH AmAdera dhana sampada o parivAra parijana AmAderake vyasta rekheche| ataeva AmAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karuna| tArA mukhe yA vale tA tAdera antare nei| tAderake valaH AllAha tomAdera kArao kona kSati kiMvA maGgala sAdhanera icchA karale ke tAke nivRtta karate pAre? vastutaH tomarA yA kara se viSaYe AllAha samyaka avahita|

nA, tomarA dhAraNA karechile ye, rAsUla o mu’minagaNa tAdera parivAra parijanera nikaTa kakhanai phire Asate pAravenA evaM ei dhAraNA tomAdera antare prItikara mane haYechila; tomarA manda dhAraNA karechile, tomarAto dhvaMsammukha eka sampradAYa|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna AnenA, Ami sei sava kAphirera janya jvalanta agni prastuta kare rekhechi|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva AllAhara; tini yAke icchA kSamA karena evaM yAke icchA zAsti dena| tini kSamAzIla o parama daYAlu|

tomarA yakhana yuddhaladdha sampada saMgrahera janya yAve takhana yArA gRhe raYe giYechila tArA valaveH AmAderake tomAdera sAthe yete dAo| tArA AllAhara pratizruti parivartana karate cAYa| valaH tomarA kichutei AmAdera saGgI hate pAravenA| AllAha pUrvei erUpa ghoSaNA karechena| tArA valaveH tomarAto AmAdera prati vidveSa poSaNa karecha| vastutaH tAdera vodhazakti sAmAnya|

ye sava ArAva maruvAsI gRhe raYe giYechila tAderake valaH tomarA Ahuta have eka pravala parAkrAnta jAtira sAthe yuddha karate; tomarA tAdera sAthe yuddha karave yatakSaNa nA tArA AtmasamarpaNa kare| tomarA ei nirdeza pAlana karale AllAha tomAderake uttama puraskAra dAna karavena| Ara tomarA yadi pUrvAnurUpa pRSTha pradarzana kara tAhale tini tomAderake marmantada zAsti divena|

andhera janya, khaJjera janya, rugnera janya kono aparAdha nei| evaM ye keha AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya karave AllAha tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra nimnadeze nadI pravAhita; kintu ye vyakti pRSTha pradarzana karave tini tAke vedanAdAYaka zAsti divena|

mu’minarA yakhana vRkSatale tomAra nikaTa vAiAta grahaNa karala takhana AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa halena, tAdera antare yA chila tA tini avagata chilena; tAderake tini dAna karalena prazAnti evaM tAderake puraskAra dilena Asanna vijaYa|
evaM vipula parimANa yuddha laddha sampada yA tArA hastagata karave; AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

AllAha tomAderake pratizruti diYechena yuddhe labhya vipula sampadera yAra adhikArI have tomarA| tini ihA tomAdera janya tvarAnvita karechilena evaM tini tomAdera hate mAnuSera hasta nivArita karechena yena tomarA kRtajJa hao evaM eTA mu’minadera janya eka nidarzana evaM AllAha tomAderake paricAlita karena sarala pathe|
Arao vahu sampada raYeche yA ekhano tomAdera adhikAre Aseni, oTAto AllAhara nikaTa rakSita Ache| AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
kAphirerA tomAdera mukAvilA karale pariNAme tArA avazyai pRSTha pradarzana karata, takhana tArA kona abhibhAvaka o sAhAyyakArI petanA|
ihAi AllAhara vidhAna, prAcInakAla hate cale Asache; tumi AllAhara ei vidhAne kona parivartana pAvenA|
tini mAkkA upatyakAYa tAdera hAta tomAdera hate evaM tomAdera hAta tAdera hate nivArita karechena tAdera upara tomAderake vijaYI karAra para| tomarA yA kichu kara AllAha tA dekhena|

tArAito kupharI karechila evaM nivRtta karechila tomAderake mAsajidula hArAma hate evaM vAdhA diYechila kuravAnIra janya Avaddha pazugulike yathAsthAne pau~chate| tomAdera yuddhera Adeza deYA hata, yadi nA thAkata emana katakaguli mu’mina nara o nArI yAderake tomarA jAnanA, tAderake tomarA padadalita karate ajJAtasAre| phale tAdera kAraNe tomarA kSatigrasta hate| yuddhera nirdeza deYA haYani e janya ye, tini yAke icchA nija anugraha dAna karavena, yadi tArA pRthaka hata, Ami tAdera madhyasthita kAphiraderake marmantada zAsti ditAma|

yakhana kAphirerA tAdera antare poSaNa karata gotrIYa ahamikA-ajJatA yugera ahamikA, takhana AllAha tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minaderake svIYa prazAnti dAna karalena; Ara tAderake tAkaoYAra vAkye sudRr3ha karalena evaM tArAi chila era adhikatara yogya o upayukta| AllAha samasta viSaYe samyaka jJAna rAkhena|

nizcaYai AllAha tA~ra rAsUlera svapna vAstavAYita karechena, AllAhara icchAYa tomarA avazyai mAsajidula hArAme praveza karave nirApade - keha keha mAthA munDana karave, keha keha keza kartana karave; tomAdera kona bhaYa thAkavenA| AllAha jAnena, tomarA yA jAnanA| eTA chAr3Ao tini tomAdera diYechena eka sadya vijaYa|
tini tA~ra rAsUlake patha nirdeza o satya dInasaha preraNa karechena, apara samasta dInera upara eke jaYayukta karAra janya| sAkSI hisAve AllAhai yatheSTa|

muhAmmAda AllAhara rAsUla; tAra sahacaragaNa kAphiradera prati kaThora evaM nijedera madhye parasparera prati sahAnubhUtizIla; AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi kAmanAYa tumi tAderake ruku o sAjadAhaYa avanata dekhave| tAdera mukhe sAjadAhara cihna thAkave, tAorAte tAra varNanA eirUpai evaM iJjIleo| tAdera dRSTAnta ekaTi cArAgAcha, yA hate nigarta haYa kizalaYa, ataHpara oTA zakta puSTa haYa evaM pare kAnDera upara dA~r3AYa dRr3habhAve yA kRSakera janya AnandadAYaka| ebhAve AllAha mu’minadera samRddhi dvArA kAphiradera antarajvAlA sRSTi karena| yArA ImAna Ane o sat kAja kare AllAha tAderake pratizruti diYechena kSamA o puraskArera|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAmane tomarA kona viSaYe agranI haYonA evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara, nizcaYai AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvajJa|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA nAvIra kanThasvarera upara nijedera kanThasvara ucu karanA evaM nijedera madhye yebhAve uccaiHsvare kathA vala tAra sAthe sei rUpa uccaiHsvare kathA valanA; kAraNa ete tomAdera kAja nisphala haYe yAve tomAdera ajJAtasAre|
yArA AllAhara rAsUlera sAmane nijedera kanThasvara nIcu kare, AllAha tAdera antarake tAkaoYAra janya parizodhita karechena| tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahA puraskAra|
yArA gharera pichana hate tomAke uccaiHsvare DAke tAdera adhikAMzai nirvodha|
tumi vera haYe tAdera nikaTa AsA paryanta yadi tArA dhairya dhAraNa karata tAhale tA’i tAdera janya uttama hata| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

he mu’minagaNa! yadi kona pApAcArI tomAdera nikaTa kona vArtA AnaYaNa kare, tomarA tA parIkSA kare dekhave yAte ajJatA vazataH tomarA kona sampradAYake kSatigrasta nA kara evaM pare tomAdera kRtakarmera janya anutapta nA hao|

tomarA jene rekha ye, tomAdera madhye AllAhara rAsUla raYechena; tini vahu viSaYe tomAdera kathA mene nile tomarAi kaSTa pAve| kintu AllAha tomAdera nikaTa ImAnake priYa karechena evaM uhA tomAdera hRdaYagrAhI karechena; kupharI, pApAcAra o avAdhyatAke karechena tomAdera nikaTa apriYa| orAi sat patha avalamvanakArI|
eTA AllAhara dAna o anugraha; AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

mu’minadera dui dala dvandve lipta hale tomarA tAdera madhye mImAMsA kare dive; ataHpara tAdera ekadala apara dalake AkramaNa karale AkramaNakArI dalera viruddhe yuddha karave yatakSaNa nA tArA AllAhara nirdezera dike phire Ase| yadi tArA phire Ase tAhale tAdera madhye nyAYera sAthe phAisAlA karave evaM suvicAra karave| nizcaYai AllAha suvicArakArIderake bhAlavAsena|
mu’minarA paraspara bhAi bhAi| sutarAM tomarA dui bhAiYera madhye mImAMsA kare dAo evaM AllAhake bhaYa kara yAte tomarA anugraha prApta hao|

he mu’minagaNa! kona puruSa yena apara kona puruSake upahAsa nA kare; kenanA yAke upahAsa karA haYa se upahAsakArI apekSA uttama hate pAre evaM kona mahilA apara kona mahilAkeo yena upahAsa nA kare; kenanA yAke upahAsa karA haYa se upahAsakArinI apekSA uttama hate pAre| tomarA eke aparera prati doSAropa karanA evaM tomarA eke aparake manda nAme DekanA; ImAna AnAra para manda nAme DAkA garhita kAja| yArA e dharaNera AcaraNa hate nivRtta nA haYa tArAi yAlima|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA vahuvidha anumAna hate dUre thAka; kAraNa anumAna kona kona kSetre pApa evaM tomarA eke aparera gopanIYa viSaYa anusandhAna karanA evaM eke aparera pazcAte nindA karanA| tomAdera madhye ki keha tAra mRta bhAiYera mAMsa bhakSaNa karate cAYa? vastutaH tomarAto eTAke ghRNAi mane kara| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| AllAha tAovAha grahaNakArI, parama daYAlu|

he mAnuSa! Ami tomAderake sRSTi karechi eka puruSa o eka nArI hate, pare tomAderake vibhakta karechi vibhinna jAti o gotre, yAte tomarA eke aparera sAthe paricita hate pAra| tomAdera madhye ai vyaktii AllAhara nikaTa adhika maryAdA sampanna ye adhika muttAkI| AllAha sava kichu jAnena, sava kichura khavara rAkhena|

ArAva maruvAsIrA valeH AmarA ImAna AnalAma| tumi valaH tomarA ImAna Anani, varaM tomarA valaH AmarA Atmasamarpana karechi; kAraNa ImAna ekhano tomAdera antare praveza kareni| yadi tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara tAhale tomAdera karmaphala sAmAnya parimAnao kama karA havenA| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tArAi mu’mina yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna AnAra para sandeha poSaNa karenA evaM jIvana o sampada dvArA AllAhara pathe saMgrAma kare, tArAi satyaniSTha|
valaH tomarA ki tomAdera dIna samparke AllAhake avahita karacha? athaca AllAha jAnena yA kichu Ache AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte| AllAha sarva viSaYe samyaka avahita|

tArA mane kare AtmasamarpaNa kare tomAke dhanya kareche| valaH tomAdera AtmasamarpaNa AmAke dhanya kareche mane karanA| varaM AllAhai ImAnera dike paricAlita kare tomAdera dhanya karechena, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
AllAha AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra adRzya viSaYa samparke avagata Achena| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA dekhena|
kApha, zapatha kuraAnera (tumi avazyai satarkakArI)|
kintu kAphirerA tAdera madhya hate ekajana satarkakArI AvirbhUta hate dekhe vismaYa vodha kare evaM valeH eTAto eka Azcarya vyApAra|
AmAdera mRtyu hale evaM AmarA mRttikAYa pariNata hale AmarA ki punarujjIvita hava? e pratyAvartana sudUra parAhata!
Amito jAni, mRttikA kSaYa kare tAdera kataTuku evaM AmAra nikaTa Ache rakSita phalaka|
vastutaH tAdera nikaTa satya AsAra para tA pratyAkhyAna kareche| phale tArA saMzaYe dodulyamAna|
tArA ki tAdera urdhvasthita AkAzera dike tAkiYe dekhenA ye, Ami kibhAve oTA nirmANa karechi evaM oke suzobhita karechi evaM ote kona phATalao nei?
Ami vistRta karechi bhUmike o tAte sthApana karechi parvatamAlA evaM ote udgata karechi naYana prItikara sarvaprakAra udbhida –
AllAhara anurAgI pratyeka vyaktira janya, jJAna o upadeza svarUpa|
AkAza hate Ami varSaNa kari kalyANakara vRSTi evaM tadvArA Ami sRSTi kari udyAna o udagata kari zasya|
o samunnata khejura vRkSa, yAte Ache guccha khejura –
AmAra vAndAdera jIvikA svarUpa; Ara Ami saJjIvita kari mRta bhUmike; ebhAve punarutthAna ghaTave|
tAdera pUrveo satya pratyAkhyAna karechila nUhera sampradAYa, rA'sa o sAmUda sampradAYa –
Ada, phira‘Auna o lUta sampradAYa|
evaM AikAhara adhivAsI o tuvvA sampradAYa; tArA savAi rAsUladerake mithyAvAdI valechila| phale tAdera upara AmAra zAsti Apatita haYeche|
Ami ki prathamavAra sRSTi karei klAnta haYe par3echi ye, punaHsRSTi viSaYe tArA sandeha poSaNa karache?
Amii mAnuSake sRSTi karechi evaM tAra prakRti tAke ye kumantranA deYa tA Ami jAni| Ami tAra grIvAsthita dhamaNI apekSAo nikaTatara|
smaraNa rekha, dui mAlAka/pherezatA tAra DAne o vAme vase tAra kAja lipivaddha kare|
mAnuSa ye kathAi uccAraNa kare tA grahaNa karAra janya tAra kAche sadA prastuta praharI raYeche|
mRtyuyantraNA avazyai Asave| eTA hatei tomarA avyAhita ceYe Asacha|
Ara ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have, oTAi sei bhaYa pradarzanera dina|
sedina pratyeka vyakti upasthita have| tAra sAthe thAkave cAlaka o tAra karmera sAkSI|
tumi ei dina samvandhe udAsIna chile, ekhana tomAra sammukha hate pardA ummocana karechi| adya tomAra dRSTi prakhara|
tAra saGgI mAlAka/pherezatA valaveH eito AmAra nikaTa ‘AmalanAmA prastuta|
Adeza karA haveH tomarA ubhaYei nikSepa kara jAhAnnAme, pratyeka uddhata kAphirake –
kalyANakara kAje pravala vAdhA dAnakArI, sImAlaMghanakArI o sandeha poSaNakArIke –
ye vyakti AllAhara sAthe anya mA‘vUda grahaNa karata tAke kaThina zAstite nikSepa kara|
tAra sahacara zAitAna valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! Ami tAke avAdhya hate prarocita karini| vastutaH se nijei chila ghora vibhrAnta|
AllAha valavenaH AmAra sAmane vAka-vitanDA karanA; tomAderake Amito pUvei satarka karechi|
AmAra kathAra rada vadala haYanA evaM Ami AmAra vAndAdera prati kona avicAra karinA|
sei dina Ami jAhAnnAmake jijJesa karavaH tumi ki pUrNa haYe gecha? jAhAnnAma valaveH Arao Ache ki?
Ara jAnnAtake muttAkIdera nikaTastha karA have - kona dUratva thAkavenA|
erai pratizruti tomAderake deYA haYechila - pratyeka AllAhara anurAgI, hiphAyAtakArIra janya|
yArA nA dekhei daYAmaYa AllAhake bhaYa kare evaM vinIta citte upasthita haYa –
tAderake valA haveH zAntira sAthe tomarA tAte praveza kara; eTA ananta jIvanera dina|
sekhAne tArA yA kAmanA karave tA’i pAve evaM AmAra nikaTa raYeche tArao adhika|
Ami tAdera pUrve Arao kata mAnava goSThIke dhvaMsa karechi yArA chila tAdera apekSA zaktite pravala, tArA deza-videze bhramaNa kare phirata| pare tAdera anya kona AzraYasthala railanA|
ete upadeza raYeche tAra janya yAra Ache antaHkaraNa, athavA ye zravaNa kare niviSTa citte|
Ami AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI evaM egulira madhyasthita sava kichu sRSTi karechi chaYa dine| AmAke kona klAnti sparza kareni|
ataeva tArA yA vale tAte tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM tomAra ravera prazaMsA, pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara sUryodaYa o sUryAstera pUrve|
tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara rAtera ekAMze evaM sAlAtera pareo|
zona, yedina eka ghoSaNAkArI nikaTavartI sthAna hate AhavAna karave –
yedina mAnuSa avazyai zravaNa karave mahAnAda, sei dinai punarutthAna dina|
Amii jIvana dAna kari, mRtyu ghaTAi evaM sakalera pratyAvartana AmArai dike|
yedina pRthivI vidIrNa have evaM mAnuSa vera haYe Asave vyasta trasta haYe, ei samaveta samAveza karaNa AmAra janya sahaja|
tArA yA vale tA Ami jAni, tumi tAdera upara javaradastikArI nao| sutarAM ye AmAra zAstike bhaYa kare tAke upadeza dAna kara kuraAnera sAhAyye|
zapatha dhUli jhaJjhAra,
zapatha vojhA vahanakArI meghapuJjera,
ataHpara svacchanda gatimaYa nauyAnera,
Ara zapatha karmavanTanakArI mAlAikA/pherezatAra|
tomAderake pradatta pratizruti avazyai satya|
karmaphala dina avazyambhAvI|
zapatha vahu patha viziSTa AkAzera!
tomarAto paraspara virodhI kathAYa lipta|
ye vyakti satyabhraSTa se’i tA parityAga kare|
abhizapta hoka mithyAcArIrA|
yArA ajJa o udAsIna –
tArA jijJesa kareH karmaphala dina kave have?
(valaH) sei dina, yakhana tAderake zAsti deYA have agnite,
evaM (valA have) tomarA tomAdera zAsti AsvAdana kara, tomarA ei zAstii tvarAnvita karate ceYechile|
sedina muttAkIrA thAkave prasravaNa viziSTa jAnnAte|
upabhoga karave tA yA tAdera rAvva tAderake pradAna karavena; kAraNa pArthiva jIvane tArA chila satkarmaparAYaNa|
tArA rAtera sAmAnya aMzai ativAhita karata nidrAYa,
rAtera zeSa prahare tArA kSamA prArthanA karata,
evaM tAdera dhana sampade raYeche abhAvagrasta o vaJcitera haka|
nizcita vizvAsIdera nidarzana raYeche dharitrIte –
evaM tomAdera madhyeo| tomarA ki anudhAvana karavenA?
AkAze raYeche tomAdera riyakera utsa o pratizruta savakichu|
AkAza o pRthivIra ravera zapatha! avazyai tomAdera vAka sphurtira matai e sava satya|
tomAra nikaTa ivarAhImera sammAnita mehamAnadera vRttAnta eseche ki?
yakhana tArA tAra nikaTa upasthita haYe valalaH sAlAma| uttare se valalaH sAlAma| erAto aparicita loka!
ataHpara se gRhAbhyantare gela evaM ekaTi mAMzala bhAjA go-vatsa niYe ela|
tAdera sAmane rAkhala evaM valalaH tomarA khAcchanA kena?
ete tAdera samparke tAra mane bhItira saJcAra hala| tArA valalaH bhIta haYonA| ataHpara tArA tAke eka jJAnI putra santAnera susaMvAda dila|
takhana tAra strI citkAra karate karate sAmane ese gAla cApar3iYe valalaH ei vRddhA vandhyAra santAna have?
tArA valalaH tomAra rAvva erUpai valechena; tini prajJAmaYa, sarvajJa|
se (ivarAhIma) valalaH he prerita mAlAikA/pherezatAgaNa! ApanAdera vizeSa kAja ki?
tArA valalaH AmAderake eka aparAdhI sampradAYera nikaTa preraNa karA haYeche|
tAdera upara nikSepa karAra janya mATira zakta DhelA,
yA sImAlaMghanakArIdera janya cihnita tomAra ravera nikaTa hate |
sekhAne yesava mu’mina chila Ami tAderake uddhAra karechilAma –
evaM sekhAne ekaTi parivAra vyatIta kona AtmasamarpanakArI (musalima) Ami pAini –
yArA yantraNAdAYaka zAstike bhaYa kare Ami tAdera janya ote ekaTi nidarzana rekhechi,
evaM nidarzana rekhechi mUsAra vRttAnte, yakhana Ami tAke pramANasaha phira‘Aunera nikaTa preraNa karechilAma|
takhana se kSamatA dambhe mukha phiriYe nila evaM valalaH ei vyakti haYa eka yAdukara, nA haYa ummAda|
sutarAM Ami tAke o tAra dalavalake zAsti dilAma evaM tAderake samudre nikSepa karalAma; seto chila tiraskArayogya|
evaM nidarzana raYeche A‘dera ghaTanAYa yakhana Ami tAdera viruddhe preraNa karechilAma akalyANakara vAYu|
eTA yA kichura upara diYe vaYe giYechila tAkei cUrna vicUrNa kare diYechila|
Arao nidarzana raYeche sAmUdera vRttAnte, yakhana tAderake valA halaH bhoga kare nAo svalpakAla,
kintu tArA tAdera ravera Adeza amAnya karala; phale tAdera prati vajrAghAta hala evaM tArA tA dekhate chila|
tArA uThe dA~r3Ate pAralanA evaM tA pratirodha karateo pAralanA|
Ami dhvaMsa karechilAma tAdera pUrve nUhera sampradAYake, tArA chila satyatyAgI sampradAYa|
Ami AkAza nirmANa karechi AmAra kSamatA vale evaM Ami avazyai mahAsamprasAraNakArI,
evaM Ami bhUmike vichiYe diYechi; Ami kata sundarabhAve vichiYechi eTA|
Ami pratyeka vastu sRSTi karechi jor3AYa jor3AYa, yAte tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara|
AllAhara dike dhAvita hao; Ami tomAdera prati AllAha kartRka prerita satarkakArI|
tomarA AllAhara sAthe kona mA‘vUda sthira karanA; Ami tomAdera prati AllAha kartRka prerita spaSTa satarkakArI |
ebhAve tAdera pUrvavartIdera nikaTa yakhanai kona rAsUla eseche, tArA valecheH tumito eka yAdukara, nA haYa ummAda!
tArA ki eke aparake ei mantraNAi diYe eseche? vastutaH tArA eka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa|
ataeva tumi tAderake upekSA kara, ete tumi aparAdhI havenA|
tumi upadeza dite thAka, kAraNa upadeza mu’minadera upakAre Asave|
Ami sRSTi karechi jina o mAnuSake e janya ye, tArA AmArai ivAdAta karave|
Ami tAdera nikaTa hate jIvikA cAinA evaM eo cAinA ye, tArA AmAra AhAra yogAve|
AllAhai riyka dAna karena evaM tini pravala, parAkrAnta|
yAlimadera prApya oTAi yA atIte tAdera sama matAvalamvIrA bhoga kareche| sutarAM tArA era janya AmAra nikaTa yena tvarA nA kare|
kAphiradera janya durbhoga tAdera ai dinera ye dinera viSaYe tAderake satarka karA haYeche|
zapatha tura parvatera,
zapatha kitAvera, yA likhita Ache –
unmukta patre|
zapatha vAYatula mA‘murera,
zapatha samunnata AkAzera,
evaM zapatha udvelita samudrera|
tomAra ravera zAsti avazyambhAvI,
era nivAraNa karAra keha nei|
yedina AkAza Andolita have pravalabhAve –
evaM parvata calave druta|
durbhoga seidina mithyAzraYIdera –
yArA krIr3Acchale asAra kAryakalApe lipta thAke|
yedina tAderake hAkiYe niYe yAoYA have jAhAnnAmera Agunera dike,
(valA have) eTAi sei Aguna yAke tomarA mithyA mane karate|
eTA ki yAdu? nA ki tomarA dekhachanA?
tomarA ete praveza kara, ataHpara tomarA dhairya dhAraNa kara athavA nA karA ubhaYai tomAdera janya samAna| tomarA yA karate tomAderake tArai pratiphala deYA hacche|
muttAkIrA thAkave jAnnAte o bhoga karave vilAsa|
tAdera rAvva tAderake yA divena tArA tA upabhoga karave evaM tini tAderake rakSA karavena jAhAnnAmera zAsti hate|
tomarA yA karate tAra pratiphala svarUpa tomarA tRptira sAthe pAnAhAra karate thAka|
tArA vasave zreNIvaddhabhAve sajjita Asane helAna diYe; Ami tAdera milana ghaTAva AYatalocanA hurera saGge|

evaM yArA ImAna Ane Ara tAdera santAna-santati ImAne tAdera anugAmI haYa, tAdera sAthe milita karAva tAdera santAna-santatike evaM tAdera karmaphala Ami kichumAtra hrAsa karavanA, pratyeka vyakti nija kRtakarmera janya dAYI|
Ami tAderake diva phala-mUla evaM gozata yA tArA pachanda kare|
sekhAne tArA eke aparera nikaTa hate grahaNa karave pAna pAtra, yA hate pAna karale keha asAra kathA valavenA evaM asat kAjeo lipta havenA|
surakSita muktA sadRza kizorerA sekhAne tAdera janya niYojita thAkave|
tArA eke aparera dike mukhomukhi jijJasAvAda karave –
evaM valaveH pUrve AmarA parivAra-parijanera madhye zaMkita avasthAYa chilAma –
ataHpara AmAdera prati AllAha anugraha karechena evaM AmAderake agnira zAsti hate rakSA karechena,
AmarA pUrveo AllAhake AhavAna karatAma, tinito kRpAmaYa, parama daYAlu|
ataeva tumi upadeza dAna karate thAka, tomAra ravera anugrahe tumi gaNaka nao, ummAdao nao|
tArA ki valate cAYa ye, se ekajana kavi, AmarA tAra janya kAlera viparyaYera pratIkSA karachi|
valaH tomarA pratIkSA kara, Amio tomAdera sAthe pratIkSA karachi|
tAhale ki tAdera vuddhi tAderake ei viSaYe prarocita kare, nA tArA eka sImAlaMghanakArI sampradAYa?
tArA ki valeH ei kuraAna tAra nijera racanA? varaM tArA avizvAsI|
tArA yadi satyavAdI haYa tAhale ei sadRza kona racanA upasthita karuka|
tArA ki sraSTA vyatIta sRSTi haYeche, nA tArA nijerAi sraSTA?
nA ki tArA AkAza o pRthivI sRSTi kareche? varaM tArAto avizvAsI
tomAra ravera bhAnDAra ki tAdera nikaTa raYeche, nA tArA e samudaYera niYantA?
nA ki tAdera kona sir3i Ache yAte ArohaNa kare tArA zravaNa kare? thAkale tAdera sei zrotA suspaSTa pramANa upasthita karuka|
tAhale ki kanyA santAna tA~ra janya evaM putra santAna tomAdera janya?
tAhale ki tumi tAdera nikaTa pArizramika cAccha ye, tArA eke ekaTi durvaha vojhA mane karave?
nA ki adRzya viSaYe tAdera kona jJAna Ache ye, tArA ei viSaYe kichu likhe?
athavA tArA ki kona Sar3ayantra karate cAYa? pariNAme kAphirerAi have Sar3ayantrera zikAra|
nA ki AllAha vyatIta tAdera anya kona mA‘vUda Ache? tArA yAke zarIka sthira kare AllAha tA hate pavitra|
tArA AkAzera kona khanDa bheGge par3ate dekhaleo valaveH eTAto eka pUJjIbhuta megha|
tAderake upekSA kare cala sei dina paryanta, ye dina tArA vajrAghAtera sammukhIna have|
yedina tAdera Sar3ayantra kona kAje AsavenA evaM tAderake sAhAyyao karA havenA|
e chAr3Ao Arao zAsti raYeche yAlimadera janya| kintu tAdera adhikAMzai tA jAnenA|
dhairya dhAraNa kara tomAra ravera nirdezera apekSAYa; tumi AmAra cokhera sAmanei raYecha| tumi tomAra ravera prazaMsA, pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara yakhana tumi zayyA tyAga kara –
evaM tA~ra pavitratA ghoSaNA kara rAte o tArakAra asta gamanera para|
zapatha nakSatrera, yakhana oTA haYa astamita,
tomAdera saGgI vibhrAnta naYa, vipathagAmIo naYa,
evaM se managar3A kathAo valenA|
eTAto ahI, yA tAra prati pratyAdeza haYa|
tAke zikSA dAna kare zaktizAlI –
prajJA sampanna; se nija AkRtite sthira haYechila,
takhana se Urdhva digante|
ataHpara se tAra nikaTavartI hala, ati nikaTavartI|
phale tAdera madhye dui dhanukera vyavadhAna raila, athavA tArao kama|
takhana AllAha tA~ra vAndAra prati yA ahI karAra tA ahI karalena|
yA se dekheche tAra antakaraNa tA asvIkAra kareni|
se yA dekheche tomarA ki se viSaYe tAra saMge vitarka karave?
nizcaYai se tAke ArekavAra dekhechila|
sidarAtula munatAhAra nikaTa,
yAra nikaTa avasthita vAsodyAna|
yakhana vRkSaTi, yadvArA AcchAdita havAra tadvArA chila AcchAdita,
tAra dRSTi vibhrama haYani, dRSTi lakSyacyUtao haYani|
seto tAra pratipAlakera mahAna nidarzanAvalI dekhechila|
tomarA ki bheve dekhecha lAta o uyayA samvandhe?
evaM tRtIYa ArekaTi ‘mAnAta’ samvandhe?
tAhale ki putra-santAna tomAdera janya evaM kanyA-santAna AllAhara janya?
e dharaNera vanTanato asaGgata|

egulira kataka nAmamAtra yA tomAdera pUrva-puruSarA o tomarA rekhecha, yAra samarthane AllAha kona dalIla preraNa karenani| tArAto anumAna evaM nijedera pravRttirai anusaraNa kare, athaca tAdera nikaTa tAdera ravera pathanirdeza eseche|
mAnuSa yA cAYa tAi ki se pAYa?
vastutaH ihakAla o parakAla AllAharai|
AkAze kata mAlAikA/pherezatA raYeche, tAdera kona supAriza phalaprasu havenA yatakSaNa AllAha yAke icchA evaM yAra prati santaSTa tAke anumati nA dena|
yArA AkhirAte vizvAsa karenA tArAi nArIvAcaka nAma diYe thAke mAlAikAderake|
athaca e viSaYe tAdera kona jJAna nei, tArA zudhu anumAnera anusaraNa kare; satyera mukAvilAYa anumAnera kona mUlya nei|
ataeva ye AmAra smaraNe vimukha tAke upekSA kare cala; seto zudhu pArthiva jIvana kAmanA kare|
tAdera jJAnera daur3a ei paryanta| tomAra rAvvai bhAla jAnena ke tA~ra patha hate vicyuta; tinii bhAla jAnena ke satpatha prApta|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache tA AllAharai| yArA manda kAja kare tAderake tini dena manda phala evaM yArA sat kAja kare tAderake dena uttama puraskAra|

yArA virata thAke gurutara pApa o azlIla kArya hate, choTa- khATa aparAdha karaleo tomAra ravera kSamA aparisIma; tini (AllAha) tomAdera samparke samyaka avagata, yakhana tini tomAderake sRSTi karechilena mATi hate evaM yakhana tomarA mAtRgarbhe bhruNarUpe avasthAna kara| ataeva tomarA AtmaprazaMsA karanA, tinii samyaka jAnena muttAkI ke|
tumi ki dekhecha sei vyaktike ye mukha phiriYe neYa;
evaM dAna kare sAmAnyai, pare vandha kare deYa?
tAra ki adRzyera jJAna Ache ye se jAnave?
tAke ki avagata karA haYani yA Ache mUsAra kitAve,
evaM ivarAhImera kitAve ye pAlana karechila tAra dAYitva?
oTA ei ye, kona vahanakArI aparera vojhA vahana karavenA|
Ara ei ye, mAnuSa tA’i pAYa yA se kare,
Ara ei ye, tAra kAja acirei dekhAno have,
ataHpara tAke deYA have pUrNa pratidAna|
Ara ei ye, sava kichura samAptito tomAra ravera nikaTa|
Ara ei ye, tinii hAsAna, tinii kA~dAna|
evaM ei ye, tinii mArena, tinii vA~cAna,
Ara ei ye, tinii sRSTi karena yugala puruSa o nArI –
zukra vindu hate yakhana tA skhalita haYa;
Ara ei ye, punarutthAna ghaTAnora dAYitva tA~rai|
Ara ei ye, tinii abhAvamukta karena o sampada dAna karena|
Ara ei ye, tini ‘zi’rA’ nakSatrera mAlika|
evaM ei ye, tinii prathama ‘Ada sampradAYake dhvaMsa karechilena|
evaM sAmUda sampradAYakeo, kehakeo tini vAkI rAkhenani|
Ara edera pUrve nUhera sampradAYakeo; tArA chila atizaYa yAlima o avAdhya|
utpATita AvAsa bhUmike ulTiYe nikSepa karechilena|
oke Acchanna karala ki sarvagrAsI zAsti!
tumi tomAra ravera kon anugraha samparke sandeha poSaNa karave?
atItera satarkakArIdera nyAYa ei nAvIo eka satarkakArI;
kiYAmAta Asanna,
AllAha chAr3A kehai eTA vyakta karate sakSama naYa|
tomarA ki ei kathAYa vismaYa vodha karacha!
evaM hAsi- ThATTA karacha! krandana karachanA?
tomarAto udAsIna,
ataeva AllAhake sAjadAha kara evaM tA~ra ivAdAta kara| [sAjadAha]
kiYAmAta Asanna, cA~da vidIrNa haYeche,
tArA kono nidarzana dekhale mukha phiriYe neYa evaM valeH eTAto cirAcarita yAdu|
tArA satya pratyAkhyAna kare evaM nija kheYAla-khuzIra anusaraNa kare, Ara pratyeka vyApArai yathAsamaYe lakSye pau~chave|
tAdera nikaTa eseche susaMvAda, yAte Ache sAvadhAna vANI|
eTA paripUrNa jJAna, tave ei satarka vANI tAdera kona upakAre Aseni|
ataeva tumi tAderake upekSA kara| yedina AhavAnakArI AhavAna karave eka bhaYAvaha pariNAmera dike|
apamAne avanamita netre sei dina tArA kAvara hate vera have vikSipta paGgapAlera nyAYa|
tArA AhavAnakArIra dike chuTe Asave bhIta-vihavala haYe| kAphirerA valaveH kaThina ei dina|
edera pUrve nUhera sampradAYao mithyA Aropa karechila AmAra vAndAra prati evaM valechilaH eto eka pAgala| Ara tAke bhIti pradarzana karA haYechila|
takhana se tAra rAvvake AhavAna kare valechilaH Amito asahAYa; ataeva tumi AmAra pratividhAna kara|
phale Ami unmukta kare dilAma AkAzera dvAra, pravala vAri varSaNe|
evaM mATi hate utsArita karalAma prasravaNa| ataHpara sakala pAni milita hala eka parikalpanA anusAre|
takhana nUhake ArohaNa karAlAma kASTha o kIlaka nirmita eka nauyAne,
yA calata AmAra pratyakSa tattvAvadhAne| eTA puraskAra tAra janya ye pratyAkhyAta haYechila|
Ami eTAke rekhe diYechi eka nidarzanarUpe; ataeva upadeza grahaNakArI keha Ache ki?
ki kaThora chila AmAra zAsti o satarkavANI!
kuraAna Ami sahaja kare diYechi upadeza grahaNera janya, sutarAM upadeza grahaNakArI keha Ache ki?
A‘da sampradAYa satya pratyAkhyAna karechila, phale ki kaThora haYechila AmAra zAsti o satarka vANI!
tAdera upara Ami preraNa karechilAma jhaJjhAvAYu niravicchinna durbhogera dine|
mAnuSake oTA utkhAta karechila unmulita khejura kAnDera nyAYa|
ki kaThora chila AmAra zAsti o satarka vANI!
kuraAna Ami sahaja kare diYechi upadeza grahaNera janya; ataeva upadeza grahaNa karAra keha Ache ki?
sAmUda sampradAYa satarkakArIderake mithyAvAdI valechila|
tArA valechilaH AmarA ki AmAderai sampradAYera eka vyaktira anusaraNa karava? tAhale to AmarA vipathagAmI evaM unmAdarUpe ganya hava|
AmAdera madhye ki tArai prati pratyAdeza haYeche? nA, seto ekajana mithyAvAdI, dAmbhika|
AgAmIkAla tArA jAnave, ke mithyAvAdI, dAmbhika|
Ami tAdera parIkSAra janya pAThiYechi eka uSTrI; ataeva tumi tAdera AcaraNa lakSya kara evaM dhairyazIla hao,
Ara tumi tAderake jAniYe dAo ye, tAdera madhye pAni vanTana nirdhArita evaM pAnira aMzera janya pratyeke hAyira have pAlAkrame|
ataHpara tArA tAdera eka saGgIke AhavAna karala, se oke dhare hatyA karala|
ki kaThora chila AmAra zAsti o satarka vANI!
Ami tAderake AghAta henechilAma eka mahAnAda dvArA; phale tArA haYe gela khoYAr3a prastutakArI vikhanDita zuska zAkhA-prazAkhAra nyAYa|
Ami kuraAna sahaja kare diYechi upadeza grahaNera janya; ataeva upadeza grahaNa karAra keha Ache ki?
lUta sampradAYa pratyAkhyAna karechila satarkakArIderake|
Ami tAdera upara preraNa karechilAma prastara vahanakArI pracanDa jhaTikA, kintu lUta parivArera upara naYa; tAderake Ami uddhAra karechilAma rAtera zeSAMze,
AmAra vizeSa anugraha svarUpa; yArA kRtajJa Ami ebhAvei tAderake puraskRta kare thAki|
lUta tAderake satarka karechila AmAra kaThina zAsti samparke| kintu tArA satarka vANI samvandhe vitanDA zuru karala|
tArA lUtera nikaTa hate tAra mehamAnaderake dAvI karala, takhana Ami tAdera dRSTizakti lopa kare dilAma evaM valalAmaH AsvAdana kara AmAra zAsti evaM satarkavANIra pariNAma|
pratyuSe virAmahIna zAsti tAderake AghAta karala|
(Ami valalAma) AsvAdana kara AmAra zAsti evaM satarkavANIra pariNAma|
Ami kuraAna sahaja kare diYechi upadeza grahaNera janya; ataeva upadeza grahaNakArI keha Ache ki?
phira‘Auna sampradAYera nikaTao esechila satarkakArI|
kintu tArA AmAra sakala nidarzana pratyAkhyAna karala, ataHpara parAkramazAlI o sarvazaktimAna rUpe Ami tAderake sukaThina zAsti dilAma|
tomAdera madhyakAra kAphirerA ki tAdera apekSA zreSTha? nA ki tomAdera avyAhatira kona sanada raYeche pUrvavartI kitAve?
erA ki vale, AmarA eka saMghavaddha aparAjeYa dala?
ei dalato zIghrai parAjita have evaM pRSTha pradarzana karave,
adhikanta kiYAmAta tAdera zAstira nirdhArita kAla evaM kiYAmAta have kaThinatara o tiktatara|
nizcaYai aparAdhIrA vibhrAnta o vikAragrasta|
yedina tAderake upur3a kare Tene niYe yAoYA have jAhAnnAmera dike sei dina valA haveH jAhAnnAmera yantraNA AsvAdana kara|
Ami sava kichu sRSTi karechi nirdhArita parimApe|
AmAra Adezato ekaTi kathAYa nispanna, cokhera palakera mata|
Ami dhvaMsa karechi tomAdera mata dalagulike; ataeva uhA hate upadeza grahaNakArI keha Ache ki?
tAdera samasta kAryakalApa Ache ‘AmalanAmAYa,
Ache kSudra o vRhat sava kichui lipivaddha;
muttAkIrA thAkave srotasvinI vidhauta jAnnAte –
yogya Asane, sArvabhauma kSamatAra adhikArI AllAhara sAnnidhye|
daYAmaYa AllAha!
tinii zikSA diYechena kuraAna|
tinii sRSTi karechena mAnuSa|
tinii tAke zikhiYechena bhAva prakAza karate|
sUrya o cA~da Avartana kare nirdhArita kakSapathe|
‘tArakA o vRkSa ubhaYe (AllAhake) sAjadAha kare|
tini AkAzake karechena samunnata evaM sthApana karechena mAnadanDa –
yAte tomarA bhArasAmya laMghana nA kara|
oyanera nyAyya mAna pratiSThita kara evaM miyAne kama karanA|
tini pRthivIke sthApana karechena sRSTa jIvera janya|
ete raYeche phala-mUla evaM khejura vRkSa, yAra phala AvaraNayukta –
evaM khosAviziSTa dAnA o sugandha gulma|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera pratipAlakera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
mAnuSake tini sRSTi karechena por3A mATira mata zuska mRttikA hate –
Ara jinake sRSTi karechena nirdhUma agnizikhA hate|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera pratipAlakera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tinii dui udaYAcala o dui astAcalera niYantA|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tini pravAhita karena dui dariYA, yArA paraspara milita haYa,
kintu odera madhye raYeche eka antarAla yA orA atikrama karate pArenA|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYa dariYA hate utpanna haYa muktA o pravAla|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
samudre vicaraNazIla parvata sadRza nauyAnasamUha tA~rai niYantraNAdhIna|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
bhUpRSThe yA kichu Ache sava kichu nazvara,
avinazvara zudhu tomAra ravera mukhamanDala yini mahimAmaYa, mahAnubhava|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA Ache savAi tA~ra nikaTa prArthI, pratiniYata tini ati gurutvapUrNa kAje rata|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
he mAnuSa o jina! Ami zIghrai tomAdera prati manoniveza karava|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
he jina o mAnuSa sampradAYa! AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sImA tomarA yadi atikrama karate pAra, atikrama kara; kintu tomarA tA pAravenA AllAhara anumati vyatIta|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tomAdera prati prerita have agnizikhA o dhumrapuJja, takhana tomarA tA pratirodha karate pAravenA|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
yedina AkAza vidIrNa have seidina oTA rakta-raGge raJjita carmera rUpa dhAraNa karave;
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
sedina mAnuSake tAra aparAdha samvandhe jijJesa karA havenA, Ara nA jinake|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
aparAdhIdera paricaYa pAoYA yAve tAdera cehArA hate; tAderake pAkar3Ao karA have pA o mAthAra jhu~Ti dhare|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
eTAi sei jAhAnnAma, yA aparAdhIrA avizvAsa karata|
tArA jAhAnnAmera Aguna o phuTanta pAnira madhye chuTAchuTi karave|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
Ara ye vyakti AllAhara sAmane upasthita haoYAra bhaYa rAkhe, tAra janya raYeche du’Ti udyAna|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYai vahu zAkhA-pallava viziSTa vRkSe pUrNa|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYa udyAne raYeche pravAhamAna dui prasravaNa;
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYa udyAne raYeche pratyaka phala, jor3AYa jor3AYa|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
sekhAne tArA helAna diYe vasave puru rezamera Astara viziSTa pharAze, dui udyAnera phala have tAdera nikaTavartI|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
sei savera mAjhe raYeche vahu AnatanaYanA, yAderake pUrve kona mAnuSa athavA jina sparza kareni|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tArA yena pravAla o padmarAga;
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
uttama kAjera janya uttama puraskAra vyatIta Ara ki hate pAre?
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ei udyAnadvaYa vyatIta Arao du’Ti udyAna raYeche –
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ghana savuja e udyAnaTi du’Ti|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
ubhaYa udyAne raYeche ucchalita dui prasravana|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
sekhAne raYeche phalamUla, khejura o AnAra|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
sei sakalera mAjhe raYeche suzIlA, sundarIgaNa|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tArA tAvute surakSita hura|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tAderake itopUrve kona mAnuSa athavA jina sparza kareni|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
tArA helAna diYe vasave savuja tAkiYAYa o sundara gAlicAra upara|
sutarAM tomarA ubhaYe tomAdera ravera kon anugraha asvIkAra karave?
kata mahAna tomAra ravera nAma yini mahimAmaYa o mahAnubhava!
yakhana kiYAmAta saMghaTita have –
takhana saMghaTana asvIkAra karAra keha thAkavenA|
eTA kehake karave nIca, kehake karave samunnata;
yakhana pravala kampane prakampita have pRthivI –
evaM pavartamAlA cUrNa-vicUrNa haYe par3ave|
phale oTA paryavasita have utkSipta dhUlikaNAYa –
evaM tomarA vibhakta haYe par3ave tina zreNIte|
DAna dikera dala! kata bhAgyavAna DAna dikera dala|
evaM vAma dikera dala! kata hatabhAgA vAma dikera dala!
Ara agravartIgaNaito agravartI|
tArAi naikaTya prApta –
sukha udyAnera|
vahu saMkhyaka have pUrvavartIdera madhya hate;
evaM alpa saMkhyaka have paravartIdera madhya hate,
svarNa khacita Asane –
tArA helAna diYe vasave, paraspara mukhomukhI haYe|
tAdera sevAYa ghorAphirA karave cira kizorerA –
pAna-pAtra, kujA o prasravana niHsRta surApUrNa peYAlA niYe|
sei surA pAne tAdera ziraHpIr3A havenA, tArA jJAnahArAo havenA|
evaM tAdera pachanda mata phalamUla –
Ara tAdera Ispita pAkhIra gozata diYe;
Ara tAdera janya thAkave AYatalocanA hura –
surakSita muktA sadRza –
tAdera karmera puraskAra svarUpa|
sekhAne tArA zunavenA kona asAra athavA pApa vAkya,
‘sAlAma’ Ara ‘sAlAma’ vANI vyatIta|
Ara DAna dikera dala! kata bhAgyavAna DAna dikera dala!
tArA thAkave eka udyAne, sekhAne Ache kanTakahIna kula vRkSa,
kA~di bharA kadalI vRkSa,
samprasArita chAYA,
sadya pravAhamAna pAni,
o pracura phalamUla –
yA zeSa havenA evaM yA niSiddhao havenA,
Ara samucca zayyAsamUha|
tAdera janya Ami karechi vizeSa sRSTi|
tAderake karechi kumArI,
sohAginI o samavaYaskA –
(e savai) DAna dikera lokadera janya|
tAdera aneke have pUrvavartIdera madhya hate|
evaM aneke have paravartIdera madhya hate|
Ara vAma dikera dala, kata hatabhAgA vAma dikera dala!
tArA thAkave atyuSNa vAYu o uttapta pAnite,
kRSNa varNa dhumrera chAYAYa,
yA zItalao naYa, ArAmadAYakao naYa|
itopUrve tArAto magna chila bhoga vilAse|
evaM tArA avirAma lipta chila ghoratara pApa karme|
tArA valataH mare asthi o mRttikAYa pariNata haleo ki punarutthita hava AmarA?
evaM AmAdera pUrvapuruSarAo?
valaH avazyai pUrvavatI o paravartIdera –
sakalake ekatrita karA have eka nirdhArita dinera nirdhArita samaYe|
ataHpara he vibhrAnta mithyA AropakArIrA!
tomarA avazyai AhAra karave yAkkuma vRkSa hate,
evaM oTA dvArA tomarA udara pUrNa karave,
tArapara tomarA pAna karave atyuSNa pAni –
pAna karave tRSNArta uSTrera nyAYa|
kiYAmAta divase oTAi have tAdera ApyAYana|
Amii tomAderake sRSTi karechi, tAhale kena tomarA vizvAsa karachanA?
tomarA ki bheve dekhecha tomAdera vIryapAta samvandhe?
oTA ki tomarA sRSTi kara, nA Ami sRSTi kari?
Ami tomAdera janya mRtyu nirdhArita karechi evaM Ami akSama nai –
tomAdera sthale tomAdera sadRza AnaYana karate evaM tomAderake emana eka AkRti dAna karate yA tomarA jAnanA|
tomarAto avagata haYecha prathama sRSTi samvandhe, tAhale tomarA anudhAvana karanA kena?
tomarA ye vIja vapana kara se samparke cintA karecha ki?
tomarA ki oke aMkurita kara, nA Ami aMkurita kari?
Ami icchA karale eke khar3a-kuTAYa pariNata karate pAri, takhana hatavuddhi haYe par3ave tomarA|
valaveH AmAderato sarvanAza haYeche!
AmarA hRta sarvasva haYe par3echi|
tomarA ye pAni pAna kara sei samparke tomarA bheve dekhecha ki?
tomarAi ki oTA megha hate nAmiYe Ana, nA ki Ami oTA varSaNa kari?
Ami icchA karale oTA lavaNAkta kare dite pAri| tavuo ki tomarA kRtajJatA prakAza karavenA?
tomarA ye agni prajjvalita kara tA lakSya kare dekhecha ki?
tomarAi ki ora vRkSa sRSTi kara, nA Ami sRSTi kari?
Ami eke karechi nidarzana evaM marucArIdera praYojanIYa vastu|
sutarAM tumi tomAra mahAna ravera nAmera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
Ami zapatha karachi nakSatra rAjira astAcalera!
avazyai eTA eka mahA zapatha, yadi tomarA jAnate|
nizcaYai eTA sammAnita kuraAna –
yA Ache surakSita kitAve,
yArA putaH pavitra tArA vyatIta anya keha tA sparza karenA|
ihA jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
tavuo ki tomarA ei vANIke tuccha gaNya karave?
evaM tomarA mithyAropakei tomAdera upajIvya kare niYecha!
parantu kena naYa - prANa yakhana kanThAgata haYa,
evaM takhana tomarA tAkiYe thAka,
Ara Ami tomAdera apekSA tAra nikaTatara, kintu tomarA dekhate pAonA|
tomarA yadi kartRtvAdhIna nA hao –
tAhale tomarA oTA phirAonA kena? yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao!
yadi se naikaTya prAptadera ekajana haYa –
tAra janya raYeche ArAma, uttama jIvanopakaraNa o sukhamaYa udyAna;
Ara yadi se DAna dikera ekajana haYa –
tAke valA haveH he dakSiNa pArzvavartI! tomAra prati zAnti|
kintu se yadi satya asvIkArakArI o vibhrAntadera anyatama haYa –
tAhale raYeche ApyAYana, atyuSNa pAnira dvArA –
evaM dahana, jAhAnnAmera|
eTAto dhruva satya|
ataeva tumi tomAra mahAna ravera nAmera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache savai AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva tA~rai| tini jIvana dAna karena o mRtyu ghaTAna; tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii Adi, tinii anta, tinii vyakta, tinii gupta evaM tini sarva viSaYe samyaka avahita|

tinii chaYa dine AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI sRSTi karechena, ataHpara Araze samAsIna haYechena| tini jAnena yA kichu bhUmite praveza kare evaM yA kichu tA hate vera haYa evaM AkAza hate yA kichu nAme o AkAze yA kichu utthita haYa| tomarA yekhAnei thAka nA kena tini tomAdera saGge Achena, tomarA yA kichu kara AllAha tA dekhena|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra sArvabhaumatva tA~rai, evaM AllAharai dike sava viSaYa pratyAvartita have|
tinii rAtake praveza karAna dine evaM dinake praveza karAna rAte, evaM tini arntayAmI|
AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera prati ImAna Ana evaM AllAha tomAderake yA kichura uttarAdhikArI karechena tA hate vyaYa kara| tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna Ane o vyaYa kare tAdera janya Ache mahA puraskAra|

tomAdera ki hala ye, tomarA AllAhate ImAna AnachanA? athaca rAsUla tomAderake tomAdera ravera prati AhavAna karache evaM AllAha tomAdera nikaTa hate aMgIkAra grahaNa karechena, avazya tomarA yadi tAte vizvAsI hao|
tinii tA~ra vAndAra prati suspaSTa AYAta avatIrNa karena, tomAderake andhakAra hate Alote niYe AsAra janya; AllAhato tomAdera prati karuNAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

tomarA AllAhara pathe kena vyaYa karavenA? AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra mAlikAnAto AllAharai| tomAdera madhye yArA mAkkA vijaYera pUrve vyaYa kareche evaM saMgrAma kareche tArA evaM paravartIrA samAna naYa; tArA maryAdAYa zreSTha tAdera apekSA yArA paravartIkAle vyaYa kareche o saMgrAma kareche| tave AllAha ubhaYera kalyANera pratizruti diYechena| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA savizeSa avahita|
ke Ache ye AllAhake dive uttama RNa? tAhale tini vahu guNe eke vRddhi karavena evaM tAra janya raYeche mahA puraskAra|

sedina tumi dekhave mu’mina nara-nArIderake tAdera sammukha bhAge o DAna pAze tAdera jyoti vicchurita have| (valA have) Aja tomAdera janya susaMvAda jAnnAtera, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita have, sekhAne tomarA sthAYI have, eTAi mahA sAphalya|

sedina munAphika nara o nArI mu’minadera valaveH tomarA AmAdera janya ekaTu thAma, yAte AmarA tomAdera jyotira kichu grahaNa karate pAri| valA haveH tomarA tomAdera pichane phire yAo evaM Alora sandhAna kara| ataHpara ubhaYera mAjhe sthApita have ekaTi prAcIra yAte ekaTi darayA thAkave, ora abhyantare thAkave rAhamAta evaM vahirbhAge thAkave zAsti|

munAphikarA mu’minaderake Deke jijJesa karaveH AmarA ki tomAdera saGge chilAmanA? tArA valaveH hyA~, kintu tomarA nijerAi nijederake vipadagrasta karecha; tomarA pratIkSA karechile, sandeha poSaNa karechile evaM alIka AkAMkhA tomAderake mohAcchanna kare rekhechila AllAhara hukuma AsA paryanta, Ara mahA pratAraka tomAderake pratArita karechila AllAha samparke|

Aja tomAdera nikaTa hate kona muktipaNa grahaNa karA havenA evaM yArA kupharI karechila tAdera nikaTa hateo naYa| jAhAnnAmai tomAdera AvAsasthala, eTAi tomAdera mAolA (yogya sthAna), kata nikRSTa ei pariNAma!

yArA ImAna Ane tAdera hRdaYa bhakti-vigalita haoYAra samaYa ki Aseni AllAhara smaraNe evaM ye satya avatIrNa haYeche tAte? evaM pUrve yAderake kitAva deYA haYechila tAdera mata yena tArA nA haYa, vahukAla atikrAnta haYe gele yAdera antaHkaraNa kaThina haYe par3echila| tAdera adhikAMzai satyatyAgI|
jene rekha, AllAhai dharitrIke ora mRtyura para punarjIvita karena| Ami nidarzanaguli tomAdera janya vizadabhAve vyakta karechi yAte tomarA vujhate pAra|
dAnazIla puruSa o dAnazIlA nArI evaM yArA AllAhake uttama RNa dAna kare tAderake deYA have vahuguNa vezi evaM tAdera janya raYeche mahA puraskAra|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera upara ImAna Ane, tArAi tAdera ravera nikaTa satyaniSTha o zahIda| tAdera janya raYeche tAdera prApya puraskAra o jyoti evaM yArA kupharI kareche o AmAra nidarzana asvIkAra kareche tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI|

tomarA jene rekha ye, pArthiva jIvanato krIr3A kautuka, jA~kajamaka, pArasparika ahaMkAra prakAza, dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite prAcurya lAbhera pratiyogitA vyatIta Ara kichui naYa; ora upamA vRSTi, yadvArA utpanna zasya sambhAra kRSakaderake camatkRta kare, ataHpara oTA zukiYe yAYa, phale tumi oTA pItavarNa dekhate pAo; avazeSe oTA khar3akuTAYa pariNata haYa| parakAle (avizvAsIdera janya) raYeche kaThina zAsti evaM (satpatha anusArIdera janya raYeche) AllAhara kSamA o santuSTi| pArthiva jIvana chalanAmaYa bhoga vyatIta kichui naYa|

tomarA agraNI hao tomAdera ravera kSamA o sei jAnnAta lAbhera praYAse yA prazastatAYa AkAza o pRthivIra mata, yA prastuta karA haYeche AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlagaNe vizvAsIdera janya| eTA AllAhara anugraha yAke icchA tini eTA dAna karena; AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|
pRthivIte athavA vyaktigatabhAve tomAdera upara ye viparyaYa Ase Ami tA saMghaTita karAra pUrvei tA lipivaddha thAke, AllAhara pakSe eTA khuvai sahaja|
eTA e janya ye, tomarA yA hAriYecha tAte yena tomarA vimarSa nA hao, evaM yA tini tomAderake diYechena tAra janya harSotphulla nA hao| AllAha pachanda karenanA auddhata o ahaMkArIderake –
yArA kArpanya kare evaM mAnuSake kArpaNyera nirdeza deYa; ye mukha phiriYe neYa se jene rAkhuka ye, AllAhato abhAvamukta, prazaMsA|

nizcaYai Ami AmAra rAsUladerake preraNa karechi spaSTa pramANasaha evaM tAdera saGge diYechi kitAva o nyAYa nIti, yAte mAnuSa suvicAra pratiSThA kare| Ami lauhao diYechi yAte raYeche pracanDa zakti evaM raYeche mAnuSera janya vahuvidha kalyANa; eTA e janya ye, AllAha prakAza kare divena ke pratyakSa nA kareo tA~ke o tA~ra rAsUladerake sAhAyya kare| AllAha sarvazaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|
Ami nUha evaM ivarAhImake evaM tAdera vaMzadharadera janya sthira karechilAma navuoYAta o kitAva, kintu tAdera alpai sat patha avalamvana karechila evaM adhikAMzai chila satyatyAgI|

ataHpara Ami tAdera anugAmI karechilAma AmAra rAsUlagaNake evaM anugAmI karechilAma mAraiYAma-putra IsAke, Ara tAke diYechilAma IJjIla evaM tAra anusArIdera antare diYechilAma karuNA o daYA; kintu daravezI jIvanato tArA nijerAi AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera janya pravartana karechila; Ami tAderake era vidhAna diini; athaca eTAo tArA yathAyathabhAve pAlana kareni| tAdera madhye yArA ImAna enechila tAderake Ami karechilAma puraskRta evaM tAdera adhikAMzai satyatyAgI|

he mu’minagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara evaM tA~ra rAsUlera prati vizvAsa sthApana kara| tini tA~ra anugrahe tomAderake divena dviguNa puraskAra evaM tini tomAderake divena Alo, yAra sAhAyye tomarA calave evaM tini tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

eTA e janya ye, kitAvIrA yena jAnate pAre ye, AllAhara sAmAnyatama anugrahera uparao tAdera kona adhikAra nei; anugraha AllAharai ekhatiYAre, yAke icchA tAke tini tA dAna karena| AllAha mahA anugrahazIla|

(he rAsUla) AllAha zunechena sei nArIra kathA ye tAra svAmIra viSaYe tomAra sAthe vAdAnuvAda kareche evaM AllAhara nikaTa phariYAda kareche| AllAha tomAdera kathopakathana zonena; AllAha sarvazrotA, sarvadraSTA|

tomAdera madhye yArA nijedera strIdera sAthe yihAra kare tArA jene rAkhuka ye, tAdera strIrA tAdera mA naYa; yArA tAderake janmadAna kare zudhu tArAi tAdera mA; tArAto asaGgata o bhittihIna kathAi vale; nizcaYai AllAha pApa mocanakArI, kSamAzIla|

yArA nijedera strIdera sAthe ‘‘yihAra’’ kare evaM pare tAdera ukti pratyAhAra kare, tAhale eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve ekaTi dAsa mukta karate have - ei nirdeza tomAderake deYA hala| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA samyaka avagata|

kintu yAra e sAmarthya nei, eke aparake sparza karAra pUrve tAke ekAdikrame dui mAsa siYAma pAlana karate have| ye tAteo asamartha have se SATajana abhAvagrastake khAoYAve; eTA e janya ye, tomarA yena AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera upara vizvAsa sthApana kara| eguli AllAhara nirdhArita vidhAna, kAphiradera janya raYeche vedanAdAYaka zAsti|

yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare, tAderake apadastha karA have yemana apadastha karA haYeche tAdera pUrvavartIderake; Ami suspaSTa AYAta avatIrNa karechi; kAphiradera janya raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|

sedina, yedina AllAha tAdera sakalake ekatre punarutthita karavena evaM tAderake jAniYe divena yA tArA karata; AllAha uhAra hisAva rekhechena, yadio tArA tA vismRta haYeche| AllAha sarva viSaYe samyaka draSTA|

tumi ki anudhAvana karanA, AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache AllAha tA jAnena? tina vyaktira madhye emana kona gopana parAmarza haYanA yAte caturtha hisAve tini upasthita thAkenanA; evaM pA~ca vyaktira madhye emana kona gopana parAmarza haYanA yAte SaSTha hisAve tini upasthita thAkenanA; tArA etadapekSA kama hoka vA vezi hoka, tArA yekhAnei thAkukanA kena tini tAdera sAthe Achena| tArA yA kare, tini tAderake kiYAmAta divase tA jAniYe divena| AllAha sarva viSaYe samyaka avagata|

tumi ki tAderake lakSya karanA, yAderake gopana parAmarza karate niSedha karA haYechila; ataHpara tArA yA niSiddha tArai punarAvRtti kare evaM pApAcaraNa, sImA laMghana o rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNera janya kAnAkAni kare| tArA yakhana tomAra nikaTa Ase takhana tArA tomAke emana kathA dvArA abhivAdana kare yadvArA AllAha tomAke abhivAdana karenani| tArA mane mane valeH AmarA yA vali uhAra janya AllAha AmAderake zAsti denanA kena? jAhAnnAmai tAdera upayukta zAsti, sekhAne tArA praveza karave, kata nikRSTa sei AvAsa!

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yakhana gopana parAmarza kara, sei parAmarza yena pApAcaraNa, sImA laMghana o rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa samparke nA haYa| kalyANakara kAja o tAkaoYA avalamvanera parAmarza kara evaM bhaYa kara AllAhake yA~ra nikaTa tomarA samaveta have|

zAitAnera prarocanAYa haYa ei gopana parAmarza, mu’minaderake duHkha deYAra janya; kintu AllAhara icchA vyatIta zAitAna tAdera sAmAnyatama kSati sAdhaneo sakSama naYa| mu’minadera kartavya hala AllAhara upara nirbhara karA|

he mu’minagaNa! yakhana tomAdera valA haYa majalisera sthAna prazasta kare dAo, takhana tomarA sthAna kare dive| AllAha tomAdera janya sthAna prazasta kare divena evaM yakhana valA haYa uThe yAo, takhana uThe yAve| tomAdera madhye yArA ImAna eneche evaM yAderake jJAna dAna karA haYeche AllAha tAderake maryAdAYa unnata karavena; AllAha lipivaddha kare rekhechena, tomarA yA kara sei samparke AllAha savizeSa avahita|

he mu’minagaNa! tomarA rAsUlera sAthe cupi cupi kathA valate cAile uhAra pUrve sAdAkAha pradAna karave, eTAi tomAdera janya zreYa o parizodhaka| yadi tAte akSama hao tAhale e janya tomAderake aparAdhI gaNya karA havenA| kenanA AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|

tomarA ki cupe cupe kathA valAra pUrve sAdAkAha pradAna kaSTakara mane kara? yakhana tomarA sAdAkAha dite pAralenA, Ara AllAha tomAderake kSamA kare dilena, takhana tomarA sAlAta pratiSThita kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara| tomarA yA kara AllAha tA samyaka avagata|

tumi ki tAdera prati lakSya karani, yArA AllAha ye sampradAYera prati ruSTa, tAdera sAthe vandhutva kare? tArA tomAdera (musalimadera) dalabhukta naYa evaM tAderao (iYAhudadera) dalabhukta naYa evaM tArA jene mithyA zapatha kare|
AllAha tAdera janya prastuta rekhechena kaThina zAsti| kata manda tArA yA kare!
tArA tAdera zapathagulike DhAla hisAve vyavahAra kare, ebhAve tArA AllAhara patha hate mAnuSake nivRtta kare; tAdera janya raYeche lAJchanAdAYaka zAsti|
AllAhara zAstira mukAvilAYa tAdera dhana sampada o santAna-santati tAdera kona kAje AsavenA; tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have|

yedina AllAha punarutthita karavena tAdera sakalake, takhana tArA tA~ra (AllAhara) nikaTa serUpa zapatha karave yerUpa zapatha tomAdera nikaTa kare evaM tArA mane kare ye, ete tArA upakRta have| sAvadhAna! tArAito mithyAvAdI|
zAitAna tAdera upara prabhutva vistAra kareche| phale tAderake bhuliYe diYeche AllAhara smaraNa| tArA zAitAnerai dala| sAvadhAna! zAitAnera dala avazyai kSatigrasta|
yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa kare tArA have carama lAJchitadera antarbhukta|
AllAha siddhAnta grahaNa karechena, Ami evaM AmAra rAsUla avazyai vijaYI hava| AllAha zaktimAna, parAkramazAlI|

AllAha o AkhirAte vizvAsI emana kona sampradAYa tumi pAvenA yArA bhAlavAse AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcArIderake, hoka nA ei viruddhAcArIrA tAdera pitA, putra, bhAi athavA tAdera jJAti goSThi| tAdera antare (AllAha) ImAna likhe diYechena evaM tAderake zaktizAlI karechena tA~ra adRzya zakti dvArA; tini tAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have; AllAha tAdera prati santuSTa evaM tArAo tA~ra prati santuSTa, tArAi AllAhara dala| jene rekha, AllAhara dalai saphalakAma have|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache savai tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii kitAvIdera madhye yArA kAphira tAderake prathama samAvezei tAdera AvAsabhUmi hate vitAr3ita karechilena| tomarA kalpanAo karani ye, tArA nirvAsita have evaM tArA mane karechila ye, tAdera durbhedya durgaguli tAderake rakSA karave AllAha hate; kintu AllAhara zAsti emana eka dika hate elo yA chila tAdera dhAranAtIta evaM tAdera antare tA trAsera saJcAra karala| tArA dhvaMsa kare phelala tAdera vAr3Ighara nijedera hAte evaM mu’minadera hAteo| ataeva he cakSummAna vyaktivarga! tomarA upadeza grahaNa kara!
AllAha tAdera nirvAsanera siddhAnta grahaNa nA karale tAderake pRthivIte anya zAsti ditena; parakAle tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti|
uhA e janya ye, tArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera viruddhAcaraNa karechila, evaM keha AllAhara viruddhAcaraNa karaleto AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora|
tomarA ye khejura vRkSaguli kartana karecha evaM yeguli kAnDera upara sthira rekhe diYecha, tAto AllAharai anumatikrame; eTA e janya ye, AllAha pApAcArIderake lAJchita karavena|

AllAha tAdera (iYAhudIdera) nikaTa hate ye ‘phAi’ tA~ra rAsUlake diYechena, uhAra janya tomarA azva kiMvA uSTre ArohaNa kare yuddha karani; AllAhato yAra upara icchA tA~ra rAsUladera kartRtva dAna karena; AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|

AllAha ei janapadavAsIdera nikaTa hate tA~ra rAsUlake yA kichu diYechena tA AllAhara, tA~ra rAsUlera, rAsUlera svajanagaNera evaM iYAtImadera, abhAvagrasta o pathacArIdera yAte tomAdera madhye yArA vittavAna zudhu tAdera madhyei aizvarya Avartana nA kare| ataeva rAsUla tomAderake yA deYa tA tomarA grahaNa kara evaM yA hate tomAderake niSedha kare tA hate virata thAka| tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara, AllAha zAsti dAne kaThora|

ei sampada abhAvagrasta muhAjiradera janya yArA nijedera gharavAr3I o sampatti hate utkhAta haYeche| tArA AllAhara anugraha o santuSTi kAmanA kare evaM AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera sAhAyya kare| tArAito satyAzraYI|

muhAjiradera Agamanera pUrve yArA ei nagarIte vasavAsa kareche o ImAna eneche tArA muhAjiraderake bhAlavAse evaM muhAjiraderake yA deYA haYeche tAra janya tArA antare vidveSa poSaNa karenA, Ara tArA tAderake nijedera upara prAdhAnya deYa nijerA abhAvagrasta haleo; yArA kArpaNya hate nijederake mukta kareche tArAi saphalakAma|

yArA tAdera pare eseche tArA valeH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAderake evaM ImAne agragAmI AmAdera bhAiderake kSamA karuna evaM mu’minadera viruddhe AmAdera antare hiMsA-vidveSa rAkhavenanA| he AmAdera rAvva! Apanito daYArdra, parama daYAlu|

tumi ki munAphikaderake dekhani? tArA kitAvIdera madhye yArA kupharI kareche tAdera ai sava saGgIke valeH tomarA yadi vahiskRta hao tAhale AmarA avazyai tomAdera sAthe dezatyAgI hava evaM AmarA tomAdera vyApAre kakhanao kArao kathA mAnavo nA evaM yadi tomarA AkrAnta hao tAhale AmarA avazyai tomAderake sAhAyya karava| kintu AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, tArA avazyai mithyAvAdI|

vastutaH tArA vahiskRta hale munAphikarA tAdera sAthe deza tyAga karavenA evaM tArA AkrAnta hale tArA tAderake sAhAyya karavenA evaM tArA sAhAyya karate eleo avazyai pRSTha pradarzana karave, ataHpara tArA kona sAhAyyai pAvenA|
prakRta pakSe, tAdera antare AllAha apekSA tomarAi adhikatara bhaYaMkara| eTA e janya ye, tArA eka nirvodha sampradAYa|

tArA savAi samavetabhAveo tomAdera viruddhe yuddha karate samartha havenA, kintu zudhu surakSita janapadera abhyantare athavA durga prAcIrera antarAle theke, parasparera madhye tAdera yuddha pracanDa| tumi mane kara tArA aikyavaddha, kintu tAdera manera mila nei; eTA e janya ye, tArA eka nirvodha sampradAYa|
tAdera tulanA tAdera pUrve yArA nijedera kRtakarmera zAsti AsvAdana kareche, evaM tAdera janyao raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tAdera tulanA hacche zAitAna, yakhana se mAnuSake vale, kupharI kara| ataHpara yakhana se kupharI kare takhana zAitAna valeH tomAra sAthe AmAra kona samparka nei, Ami jagatasamUhera rAvva AllAhake bhaYa kari|
phale ubhaYera pariNAma have jAhAnnAma| sekhAne tArA sthAYI have evaM eTAi yAlimadera karmaphala|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAhake bhaYa kara, pratyekei bheve dekhuka ye, AgAmI kAlera janya se ki agrima pAThiYeche| Ara AllAhake bhaYa kara; tomarA yA kara AllAha se samparke avahita|
Ara tAdera mata haYonA yArA AllAhake vismRta haYeche, phale AllAha tAderake AtmavismRta karechena| tArAito pApAcArI
jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI evaM jAnnAtera adhivAsI samAna naYa| jAnnAtavAsIrAi saphalakAma|
yadi Ami ei kuraAna parvatera upara avatIrNa karatAma tAhale tumi dekhate ye, oTA AllAhara bhaYe vinIta o vidIrNa haYe geche| Ami e sava dRSTAnta varNanA kari mAnuSera janya yAte tArA cintA kare|
tinii AllAha, tini chAr3A kona mA‘vUda nei, tini adRzya evaM dRzyera parijJAtA; tini daYAmaYa, parama daYAlu|

tinii AllAha, tini vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei| tinii adhipati, tinii pavitra, tinii zAnti, tinii nirApattA vidhAYaka, tinii rakSaka, tinii parAkramazAlI, tinii pravala, tinii atIva mahimAnvita; yArA tA~ra zarIka sthira kare AllAha tA hate pavitra o mahAna|
tinii AllAha, sRjanakartA, udbhAvaka, rUpadAtA, sakala uttama nAma tA~rai| AkAza o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he muminagaNa! AmAra zatru o tomAdera zatruke vandhu rUpe grahaNa karanA; tomarA ki tAdera sAthe vandhutva karacha? athaca tArA tomAdera nikaTa ye satya eseche tA pratyAkhyAna kareche; rAsUlake evaM tomAderake vahiskAra kareche e kAraNe ye, tomarA tomAdera rAvva AllAhara upara ImAna enecha| yadi tomarA AmAra santuSTi lAbhera janya AmAra pathe jihAdera uddeze vahirgata haYe thAka tAhale kena tomarA tAdera sAthe gopane vandhutva karacha? tomarA yA gopana kara evaM tomarA yA prakAza kara tA Ami samyaka avagata| tomAdera ye keha eTA kare seto vicyuta haYa sarala patha hate|
tomAderake kAvu karate pArale tArA have tomAdera zatru evaM hAta o jihavA dvArA tomAdera aniSTa sAdhana karave evaM kAmanA karave yena tomarA kupharI kara|
tomAdera atmIYa-svajana o santAna-santati kiYAmAta divase kona kAje AsavenA| AllAha tomAdera madhye phAisAlA kare divena; tomarA yA kara tini tA dekhena|

tomAdera janya ivarAhIma o tAra anusArIdera madhye raYeche uttama Adarza| tArA tAdera sampradAYake valechilaH tomAdera saGge evaM tomarA AllAhara parivarte yAra ivAdAta kara tAra saGge AmAdera kona samparka nei| AmarA tomAderake mAninA| tomAdera o AmAdera madhye zuru hala zatrutA o vidveSa cirakAlera janya, yadi nA tomarA eka AllAhaYa ImAna Ana| tave vyatikrama tAra pitAra prati ivarAhImera uktiH Ami nizcaYai tomAra janya kSamA prArthanA karava, yadio tomAra vyApAre Ami AllAhara nikaTa kona adhikAra rAkhinA| (ivarAhIma o tAra anusArIgaNa valechila) he AmAdera rAvavaH AmarAto ApanArai upara nirbhara karechi, ApanArai abhimukhI haYechi evaM pratyAvartanato ApanArai nikaTa|
he AmAdera rAvva Apani AmAderake kAphiradera pIr3anera pAtra karavenanA, he AmAdera rAvva! Apani AmAderake kSamA karuna! Apanito parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
tomarA yArA AllAha o AkhirAtera pratyAzA kara nizcaYai tAdera janya tAdera madhye raYeche uttama Adarza| keha mukha phiriYe nile se jene rAkhuka ye, AllAhato abhAvamukta, prazaMsA|
yAdera sAthe tomAdera zatrutA raYeche sambhavataH AllAha tAdera o tomAdera madhye vandhutva sRSTi kare divena; AllAha sarvazaktimAna, parama daYAlu|

dInera vyApAre yArA tomAdera viruddhe yuddha kareni evaM tomAdera svadeza hate vahiskRta kareni tAdera prati mahAnubhavatA pradarzana o nyAYavicAra karate AllAha tomAderake niSedha karena nA| AllAhato nyAYaparAYaNaderake bhAlavAsena|

AllAha zudhu tAdera sAthe vandhutva karate niSedha karena yArA dInera vyApAre tomAdera sAthe yuddha kareche, tomAderake svadeza hate vahiskRta kareche evaM tomAdera vahiHskaraNe sAhAyya kareche| tAdera sAthe yArA vandhutva kare tArAto atyAcArI|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera nikaTa mu’minA nArIrA dezatyAgI haYe ele tomarA tAderake parIkSA kara, AllAha tAdera ImAna samvandhe samyaka avagata Achena| yadi tomarA jAnate pAra ye, tArA mu’minA tAhale tAderake kAphiradera nikaTa pherata pAThiYe dionA| mu’minA nArIrA kAphiradera janya vaidha naYa evaM kAphirerA mu’minA nArIdera janya vaidha naYa| kAphirerA yA vyaYa kareche tA tAderake phiriYe dive| ataHpara tomarA tAderake viYe karale kona aparAdha havenA, yadi tomarA tAderake tAdera mohara diYe dAo| tomarA kAphira nArIdera sAthe dAmpatya samparka vajAYa rekhanA| tomarA yA vyaYa karecha tA pherata cAve evaM kAphirerA pherat cAve yA tArA vyaYa kareche| eTAi AllAhara vidhAna; tini tomAdera madhye phAisAlA kare thAkena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

tomAdera strIdera madhye yadi keha hAtachAr3A haYe kAphiradera nikaTa cale yAYa evaM tomAdera yadi suyoga Ase takhana yAdera strIrA hAtachAr3A haYe geche tAdera janya tArA (kAphirerA) yA vyaYa kareche tAra sama parimANa artha pradAna karave| bhaYa kara AllAhake yAke tomarA vizvAsa kara|

he nAvI! mu’minA nArIrA yakhana tomAra nikaTa ese vAiA’ta kare ei marme ye, tArA AllAhara sAthe kona zarIka sthira karavenA, curi karavenA, vyabhicAra karavenA, nijedera santAnaderake hatyA karavenA, tArA sajJAne kona apavAda racanA kare raTAvenA evaM satya kAje tomAke amAnya karavenA takhana tAdera vAiA’ta grahaNa kara evaM tAdera janya AllAhara nikaTa kSamA prArthanA kara| AllAhato kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he mu’minagaNa! AllAha ye sampradAYera prati ruSTa tomarA tAdera sAthe vandhutva karanA, tArAto AkhirAta samparke hatAza haYe par3eche yemana hatAza haYeche kAphirerA samAdhisthadera viSaYe|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache samastai AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare| tini parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
he mu’minagaNa! tomarA yA karanA tA tomarA kena vala?
tomarA yA karanA tomAdera tA valA AllAhara dRSTite atizaYa asantoSajanaka|
yArA AllAhara pathe saMgrAma kare sArivaddhabhAve sudRr3ha prAcIrera mata, AllAha tAderake bhAlavAsena|

smaraNa kara mUsA tAra sampradAYake valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa! tomarA AmAke kena kaSTa diccha yakhana tomarA jAna ye, Ami tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara rAsUla? ataHpara tArA yakhana vakra patha avalamvana karala takhana AllAha tAdera hRdaYake vakra kare dilena| AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake hidAYAta karena nA|

smaraNa kara, mAraiYAma tanaYa IsA valalaH he vAnI isarAIla! Ami tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara rAsUla evaM AmAra pUrva hate tomAdera nikaTa ye tAorAta raYeche Ami uhAra samarthaka evaM AmAra pare AhamAda nAme ye rAsUla Asavena Ami tA~ra susaMvAdadAtA| pare se yakhana spaSTa nidarzanasaha tAdera nikaTa elo takhana tArA valate lAgalaH eTAto eka spaSTa yAdu|
ye vyakti isalAmera dike Ahuta haYeo AllAha samvandhe mithyA racanA kare tAra apekSA adhika yAlima Ara ke hate pAre? AllAha yAlima sampradAYake sat pathe paricAlita karenanA|
tArA AllAhara nUra phutkAre nibhiYe dite cAYa, kintu AllAha tA~ra nUra pUrNarUpe udbhAsita karavena, yadio kAphirerA tA apachanda kare|
tinii tA~ra rAsUlake preraNa karechena hidAYAta evaM satya dInasaha sakala dInera upara oke zreSThatva dAnera janya, yadio muzarikarA tA apachanda kare|
he mu’minagaNa! Ami ki tomAdera emana eka vANijyera sandhAna diva yA tomAdera rakSA karave yantraNAdAYaka zAsti hate?
tA ei ye, tomarA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlera upara vizvAsa sthApana karave evaM tomAdera dhana sampada o jIvana dvArA AllAhara pathe jihAda karave| eTAi tomAdera janya zreYa yadi tomarA jAnate|
AllAha tomAdera pApa kSamA kare divena evaM tomAdera dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita evaM sthAYI jAnnAtera uttama vAsagRhe| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
Ara tini dAna karavena tomAdera vAJchita Arao ekaTi anugraha; AllAhara sAhAyya evaM Asanna vijaYa; mu’minaderake era susaMvAda dAo|

he mu’minagaNa! AllAhara dInera sAhAyyakArI hao, yemana mAraiYAma tanaYa IsA tAra ziSyaderake valechilaH AllAhara pathe ke AmAra sAhAyyakArI have? hAoYArIgaNa valechilaH AmarAito AllAhara pathe sAhAyyakArI| ataHpara vAnI isarAIlera ekadala ImAna Anala evaM ekadala kupharI karala| pare Ami mu’minaderake zaktizAlI karalAma tAdera zatrudera mukAvilAYa; phale tArA vijaYI hala|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache savAi pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare AllAhara, yini adhipati, pavitra, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

tinii ummIdera madhye tAdera ekajanake pAThiYechena rAsUla rUpe ye tAdera nikaTa AvRtti kare tA~ra AYAta, tAderake pavitra kare evaM zikSA deYa kitAva o hikamAta; itopUrveto tArA chila ghora vibhrAntite|
Ara tAdera anyAnyera janyao, yArA ekhanao tAdera sAthe milita haYani| AllAha parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|
eTA AllAharai anugraha, yAke icchA tini eTA dAna karena| AllAhato mahA anugrahazIla|

yAderake tAorAtera dAYitvabhAra arpaNa karA haYechila, ataHpara tA tArA vahana kareni, tAdera dRSTAnta pustaka vahanakArI gardabha| kata nikRSTa sei sampradAYera dRSTAnta yArA AllAhara AYAtake mithyA pratipanna kare| AllAha phAsika/pApAcArI sampradAYake pathapradarzana karena nA|
valaH he iYAhudIrA! yadi tomarA mane kara ye, tomarAi AllAhara vandhu, anya kona mAnavagoSThI naYa; tAhale tomarA mRtyu kAmanA kara, yadi tomarA satyavAdI hao|
kintu tArA tAdera hasta yA agre preraNa kareche tAra kAraNe kakhanao mRtyu kAmanA karavenA| AllAha yAlimadera samparke samyaka avagata|

valaH tomarA ye mRtyu hate palAYana kara sei mRtyura sAthe tomAdera sAkSAt havei| ataHpara tomarA upasthita have adRzya o dRzyera parijJAtA AllAhara nikaTa evaM tomAderake jAniYe deYA have yA tomarA karate|

he mu’minagaNa! jumu’Ara dina yakhana sAlAtera janya AhavAna karA haYa takhana tomarA AllAhara smaraNe dhAvita hao evaM kraYa-vikraYa tyAga kara; eTAi tomAdera janya zreYa, yadi tomarA upaladdhi kara|
sAlAta samApta hale tomarA pRthivIte char3iYe par3ave evaM AllAhara anugraha sandhAna karave o AllAhake adhika smaraNa karave yAte tomarA saphalakAma hao|

yakhana tArA kona vyavasA vA khela-tAmAzA dekhe takhana tArA tomAke dA~r3Ano avasthAYa rekhe ora dike chuTe yAYa| valaH AllAhara nikaTa yA Ache tA krIr3A kautuka o vyavasA apekSA utkRSTa| AllAha sarvazreSTha riyka dAtA|

munAphikarA yakhana tomAra nikaTa Ase takhana tArA valeH AmarA sAkSya dicchi ye, nizcaYai Apani AllAhara rAsUla| Ara AllAha jAnena ye, tumi nizcaYai tA~ra rAsUla evaM AllAha sAkSya dicchena ye, munAphikarA avazyai mithyAvAdI|
tArA tAdera zapathagulike DhAla rUpe vyavahAra kare, Ara tArA AllAhara patha hate mAnuSake nivRtta kare| tArA yA karache tA kata manda!
eTA e janya ye, tArA ImAna AnAra para kupharI kareche; phale tAdera hRdaYa mohara kare deYA haYeche, pariNAme tArA vodhazakti hAriYe pheleche|

tumi yakhana tAdera dike tAkAo takhana tAdera dehAkRti tomAra nikaTa prItikara mane haYa evaM tArA yakhana kathA vale takhana tumi sAgrahe tAdera kathA zravaNa kara, yadio tArA deYAle ThekAno kAThera stambha sadRza| tArA ye kona zoragolake mane kare tAderai viruddhe| tArAi zatru, ataeva tAdera samparke satarka hao, AllAha tAderake dhvaMsa karuna! vibhrAnta haYe tArA kothAYa calache?
yakhana tAderake valA haYaH tomarA eso, AllAhara rAsUla tomAdera janya kSamA prArthanA karavena, takhana tArA mAthA ghuriYe neYa evaM tumi tAderake dekhate pAo ye, tArA dambhabhare phire yAYa|
tumi tAdera janya kSamA prArthanA kara athavA nA kara, ubhaYai tAdera janya samAna| AllAha tAderake kakhanao kSamA karavenanA| AllAha pApAcArI sampradAYake sat pathe paricAlita karenanA|
tArAi valeH AllAhara rAsUlera sahacaradera janya vyaYa karanA yatakSaNa nA tArA sare par3e| AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIra dhana bhAnDArato AllAharai| kintu munAphikarA tA vujhenA|
tArA valeH AmarA mAdInAYa pratyAvartana karale sekhAna hate pravala durvalake vahiskRta karavei| kintu sammAnato AllAharai, Ara tA~ra rAsUla o mu’minadera| kintu munAphikarA eTA jAnenA|
he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera aizvarya o santAna-santati yena tomAderake AllAhara smaraNe udAsIna nA kare| yArA udAsIna have tArAito kSatigrasta|

Ami tomAderake ye riyka diYechi tomarA tA hate vyaYa karave tomAdera kArao mRtyu AsAra pUrve; anyathAYa se valaveH he AmAra rAvva! AmAke Arao kichu kAlera janya avakAza dile Ami sAdAkAha karatAma evaM satkarmazIladera antarbhukta hatAma|
kintu nirdhArita kAla yakhana upasthita have, AllAha takhana kehakeo avakAza divenanA| tomarA yA kara AllAha se samvandhe savizeSa avahita|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache savAi tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kare, sArvabhaumatva tA~rai evaM prazaMsA tA~rai; tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna|
tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena, ataHpara tomAdera madhye keha haYa kAphira evaM keha mu’mina| tomarA yA kara AllAha samyaka draSTA|
tini sRSTi karechena AkAzamanDalI o pRthivI yathAyathabhAve evaM tomAderake AkRti dAna karechena| tomAdera AkRti karechena suzobhana evaM pratyAvartanato tA~rai nikaTa|
AkAzamanDalI o pRthivIte yA kichu Ache savai tini jAnena, tomarA yA gopana kara o tomarA yA prakAza kara evaM tini antaryAmI|
tomAdera nikaTa ki pau~cheni pUrvavartI kAphiradera vRttAnta? tArA tAdera karmera mandaphala AsvAdana karechila evaM tAdera janya raYeche yantraNAdAYaka zAsti|

tA e janya ye, tAdera nikaTa yakhana tAdera rAsUlagaNa spaSTa nidarzanasaha Asato takhana tArA valataH mAnuSai ki AmAdera pathera sandhAna dive? ataHpara tArA kupharI karala o mukha phiriYe nila; kintu ete AllAhara kichu Ase yAYanA| AllAha abhAvamukta, prazaMsA|

kAphirerA dAvI kare ye, tArA kakhanao punarutthita havenA| valaH nizcaYai have, AmAra ravera zapatha! tomarA avazyai punarutthita have| ataHpara tomarA yA karate tomAdera sei samvandhe avazyai avahita karA have| eTA AllAhara pakSe sahaja|
ataeva tomarA AllAha, tA~ra rAsUla o ye jyoti Ami avatIrNa karechi tAte vizvAsa sthApana kara| tomAdera kRtakarma samparke AllAha savizeSa avahita|

smaraNa kara, yedina tini tomAderake samaveta karavena samAveza dine, sedina have lAbha lokasAnera dina| ye vyakti AllAhaYa vizvAsa kare o sat kAja kare tini tAra pApa mocana karavena evaM tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA have cirasthAYI| eTAi mahA sAphalya|
kintu yArA kupharI kare evaM AmAra nidarzanasamUhake asvIkAra kare tArAi jAhAnnAmera adhivAsI, sekhAne tArA sthAYI have, kata manda ai pratyAvartanasthala!
AllAhara anumati vyatireke kona vipadai Apatita haYanA evaM ye AllAhake vizvAsa kare tini tAra antarake supathe paricAlita karena| AllAha sarva viSaYe samyaka avagata|
AllAhara Anugatya kara evaM tA~ra rAsUlera Anugatya kara, yadi tomarA mukha phiriYe nAo tAhale AmAra rAsUlera dAYitva zudhu spaSTabhAve pracAra karA|
AllAha vyatIta kona mA‘vUda nei; sutarAM mu’minarA yena AllAha uparai nirbhara kare|

he mu’minagaNa! tomAdera strI o santAna-santatidera madhye keha keha tomAdera zatru, ataeva tAdera samparke tomarA satarka theka| tomarA yadi tAderake mArjanA kara, tAdera doSa kraTi upekSA kara evaM tAderake kSamA kara tAhale jene rekha ye, AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
tomAdera sampada o santAna santati tomAdera janya parIkSA| AllAharai nikaTa raYeche mahA puraskAra|
tomarA AllAhake yathAyatha bhaYa kara, zona, Anugatya kara o vyaYa kara tomAdera nijederai kalyANe; yArA antarera kArpaNya hate mukta tArAi saphalakAma|
yadi tomarA AllAhake uttama RNa dAna kara tAhale tini tomAdera janya oTA dviguNa vRddhi karavena evaM tini tomAderake kSamA karavena| AllAha guNagrAhI o sahanazIla|
tini dRzya o adRzyera parijJAtA, parAkramazAlI, prajJAmaYa|

he nAvI! tomarA yadi tomAdera strIderake tAlAka dite icchA kara tAhale tAderake tAlAka dio iddAtera prati lakSya rekhe, iddAtera hisAva rekha evaM tomAdera rAvva AllAhake bhaYa kara; tomarA tAderake tAdera vAsagRha hate vahiskAra karanA evaM tArAo yena vera nA haYa, yadi nA tArA lipta haYa spaSTa azlIlatAYa; eguli AllAhara vidhAna| ye AllAhara vidhAna laMghana kare se nijerai upara atyAcAra kare| tumi jAnanA, haYato AllAha erapara kona upAYa kare divena|

tAdera iddAta pUraNera kAla Asanna hale tomarA haYa yathAvidhi tAderake rekhe dive, nA haYa tAderake yathAvidhi parityAga karave evaM tomAdera madhya hate du’jana nyAYa parAYaNa lokake sAkSI rAkhave; tomarA AllAhara janya saThika sAkSya dio| oTA dvArA tomAdera madhye ye AllAha o AkhirAte vizvAsa kare tAke upadeza deYA hacche| ye AllAhake bhaYa kare AllAha tAra niskRtira vyavasthA kare divena –

Ara tAke tAra dhAraNAtIta utsa theke dAna karavena riyka; ye vyakti AllAhara upara nirbhara kare tAra janya AllAhai yatheSTa, AllAha tA~ra icchA pUraNa karavenai, AllAha sava kichura janya sthira karechena nirdiSTa mAtrA|

tomAdera ye sava strIra RtumatI haoYAra AzA nei tAdera iddAta samparke tomarA sandeha karale tAdera iddAtakAla have tina mAsa evaM yAdera ekhanao rajazvAlA haYani tAderao| evaM garbhavatI nArIdera iddAtakAla santAna prasava paryanta| AllAhake ye bhaYa kare AllAha tAra samasyAra samAdhAna sahaja kare divena|
eTA AllAhara vidhAna yA tini tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena; AllAhake ye bhaYa kare tini tAra pApa mocana karavena evaM tAke divena mahA puraskAra|

tomarA tomAdera sAmarthya anuyAYI ye sthAne vAsa kara tAderake sei sthAne vAsa karate dio; tAderake utyakta karanA saMkaTe phelAra janya, tArA garbhavatI haYe thAkale santAna prasava paryanta tAdera janya vyaYa karave, yadi tArA tomAdera santAnaderake stanya dAna kare tAhale tAderake pArizramika dive evaM santAnera kalyANa samparke tomarA saMgatabhAve nijedera madhye parAmarza karave; tomarA yadi nija nija dAvIte anamanIYa hao tAhale anya nArI tAra pakSe stanya dAna karave|

vittavAna nija sAmartha anuyAYI vyaYa karave evaM yAra jIvanopakaraNa sImita se, AllAha yA tAke dAna karechena tA hate vyaYa karave| AllAha yAke ye sAmarthya diYechena tadapekSA gurutara vojhA tini tAra upara cApiYe denanA| AllAha kaSTera para divena svasti|
kata janapada tAdera rAvva o tA~ra rAsUladera nirdezera viruddhAcaraNa karechila dambhabhare| phale Ami tAdera nikaTa hate kaThora hisAva niYechilAma evaM tAderake diYechilAma kaThina zAsti|
ataHpara tArA tAdera kRtakarmera zAsti AsvAdana karala; kSatii chila tAdera karmera pariNAma|

AllAha tAdera janya kaThina zAsti prastuta kare rekhechena| ataeva tomarA AllAhake bhaYa kara| he vodhasampanna vyaktigaNa, yArA ImAna enecha! nizcaYai AllAha tomAdera prati avatIrNa karechena upadeza|

preraNa karechena emana eka rAsUla ye tomAdera nikaTa AllAhara suspaSTa AYAta AvRtti kare, yArA vizvAsI o satkarmaparAYaNa tAderake andhakAra theke Alote AnAra janya| ye keha AllAhake vizvAsa kare o sat kAja kare tini tAke dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita, sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have; AllAha tAke uttama jIvanopakaraNa divena|

AllAhai sRSTi karechena sapta AkAza evaM pRthivIo sei parimANa| ogulira madhye neme Ase tA~ra nirdeza; phale tomarA vujhate pAra ye, AllAha sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna evaM jJAne AllAha sava kichuke pariveSTana kare raYechena|
he nAvI! AllAha tomAra janya yA vaidha karechena tumi tA niSiddha karacha kena? tumi tomAra strIdera santuSTi cAccha? AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
AllAha tomAdera zapatha hate mukti lAbhera vyavasthA karechena, AllAha tomAdera sahAYa; tini sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|

yakhana nAvI tAra strIdera ekajanake gopane kichu valechila, ataHpara yakhana se tA anyake vale diYechila evaM AllAha nAvIke tA jAniYe diYechilena takhana nAvI ei viSaYe kichu vyakta karala evaM kichu avyakta rAkhala| yakhana nAvI tA tAra sei strIke jAnAlo takhana se valalaH ke ApanAke eTA avahita karala? nAvI valalaH AmAke avahita karechena tini yini sarvajJa, samyaka avahita|

yadi tomarA ubhaYe anutapta haYe AllAhara dike pratyAvartana kara yehetu tomAdera hRdaYa jhuke par3eche (tAhale AllAha tomAdera kSamA karavena)| kintu tomarA yadi nAvIra viruddhe eke aparera poSakatA kara tAhale jene rekha ye, AllAhai tAra vandhu evaM jivarAIla o sat AmalakArI mu’minagaNao; uparanta anyAnya mAlAikA/pherezatArAo tAra sAhAyyakArI|

yadi nAvI tomAdera sakalake parityAga kare tAhale tAra rAvva sambhavataH tAke divena tomAdera apekSA utkRSTatara strI yArA have AtmasamarpanakAriNI, vizvAsinI, AnugatyakArinI, tAovAhakArinI, ivAdAtakArinI, siYAma pAlanakAriNI, akumArI evaM kumArI|

he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! tomarA nijederake evaM tomAdera parivAra parijanake rakSA kara aguna hate, yAra indhana have mAnuSa o pAthara, yAte niYojita Ache nirmama hRdaYa kaThora svabhAvera mAlAikA (pherezatA), yArA amAnya karenA AllAha yA tAderake Adeza karena tA evaM tArA yA karate AdiSTa haYa tA’i kare|
he kAphirerA! Aja tomarA doSa skhalanera ceSTA karanA| tomarA yA karate tomAderake tArai pratiphala deYA have|

he vizvAsa sthApanakArIgaNa! tomarA AllAhara nikaTa tAovAha kara, vizuddha tAovAha; sambhavataH tomAdera rAvva tomAdera manda kAjaguli mocana kare divena evaM tomAderake dAkhila karavena jAnnAte, yAra pAdadeze nadI pravAhita| sei dina nAvI evaM tA~ra vizvAsI vAndAderake AllAha apadasta karavenanA| tAdera jyoti tAdera sammukhe evaM dakSiNa pArzve dhAvita have| tArA valaveH he AmAdera rAvva! AmAdera jyotike pUrNatA dAna karuna evaM AmAderake kSamA karuna, Apani sarva viSaYe kSamatAvAna|
he nAvI! kAphira o munAphikera viruddhe jihAda kara evaM tAdera prati kaThora hao| tAdera AzraYasthala jAhAnnAma, oTA kata nikRSTa pratyAvartanasthala|
