AllAha kAphiradera janya nUha o lUtera strIra dRSTAnta upasthita karachena; tArA chila AmAra vAndAdera madhye dui saMkalpa parAYaNa vAndAra adhIna| kintu tArA tAdera prati vizvAsaghAtakatA karechila, phale nUha o lUta tAderake AllAhara zAsti hate rakSA karate pAralanA evaM tAderake valA halaH jAhAnnAme pravezakArIdera sAthe tomarAo tAte praveza kara|

AllAha vizvAsIdera janya upasthita karechena phira‘Auna patnIra dRSTAnta, ye prArthanA karechilaH he AmAra rAvva! ApanAra sannidhAne jAnnAte AmAra janya ekaTi gRha nirmANa karuna evaM AmAke uddhAra karuna phira‘Auna o tAra duskRti hate evaM AmAke uddhAra karuna yAlima sampradAYa hate|

Arao dRSTAnta dicchena imarAna tanaYA mAraiYAmera, ye tAra satItva rakSA karechila, phale Ami tAra madhye rUha phu~ke diYechilAma evaM se tAra ravera vANI o tA~ra kitAvasamUha satya vale grahaNa karechila; se chila anugatadera ekajana|
mahA mahimAnvita tini, sarvamaYa kartRtva yA~ra karAYatva; tini sarva viSaYe sarvazaktimAna –
yini sRSTi karechena mRtyu o jIvana, tomAdera parIkSA karAra janya - ke tomAdera madhye karme uttama? tini parAkramazAlI, kSamAzIla|
tini sRSTi karechena stare stare saptAkAza| daYAmaYa AllAhara sRSTite tumi kona khu~ta dekhate pAvenA; AvAra dekha, kona truTi dekhate pAo ki?
ataHpara tumi vAravAra dRSTi phirAo, sei dRSTi vyartha o klAnta haYe tomAra dike phire Asave|
Ami nikaTavartI AkAzake suzobhita karechi pradIpamAlA dvArA evaM ogulike karechi zAitAnera prati nikSepera upakaraNa evaM tAdera janya prastuta rekhechi jvalanta Agunera zAsti|
yArA tAdera rAvvake asvIkAra kare tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera zAsti, oTA kata manda pratyAvartana sthala!
yakhana tanmadhye nikSipta have takhana tArA uhAra utkSipta garjana zunate pAve, Ara oTA have udvelita|
roSe jAhAnnAma yena pheTe par3ave, yakhanai tAte kona dalake nikSepa karA have, tAderake rakSIrA jijJesa karaveH tomAdera nikaTa ki kona satarkakArI Aseni?
tArA valaveH avazyai AmAdera nikaTa satarkakArI esechila, AmarA tAke mithyAvAdI gaNya karechilAma evaM valechilAmaH AllAha kichui avatIrNa karenani, tomarAto mahA vibhrAntite raYecha|
evaM tArA Arao valaveH yadi AmarA zunatAma athavA viveka-vuddhi praYoga karatAma tAhale AmarA jAhAnnAmavAsI hatAmanA|
tArA tAdera aparAdha svIkAra karave| abhizApa jAhAnnAmIdera janya!
nizcaYai yArA tAdera rAvvake nA dekhei bhaYa kare tAdera janya raYeche kSamA o mahApuraskAra|
tomarA tomAdera kathA gopanei vala athavA prakAzye vala, tinito antaryAmI|
yini sRSTi karechena, tini ki jAnenanA? tini sUkSNadarzI, samyaka avagata|
tiniito tomAdera janya bhUmike sugama kare diYechena; ataeva tomarA dika-digante vicaraNa kara evaM tA~ra pradatta jIvanopakaraNa hate AhArya grahaNa kara; punarutthAnato tA~rai nikaTa|
tomarA ki nizcita Acha ye, AkAze yini raYechena tini tomAderakesaha bhUmike dhvasiYe divenanA, Ara oTA AkasmikabhAve thara thara kare kA~pate thAkave?
athavA tomarA nizcita Acha ye, AkAze yini raYechena tini tomAdera upara kaMkaravarSI jhaJjhA preraNa karavenanA? takhana tomarA jAnate pArave ki rUpa chila AmAra satarka vANI!
evaM edera pUrvavartIrAo mithyA Aropa karechila; phale ki rUpa haYechila AmAra zAsti!
tArA ki lakSya karenA tAdera urdhvadeze vihaGgakUlera prati, yArA pakSa vistAra kare o saMkucita kare? daYAmaYa AllAhai tAderake sthira rAkhena| tini sarva viSaYe samyaka draSTA|
daYAmaYa AllAha vyatIta tomAdera emana kona sainyavAhinI Ache ki yArA tomAdera sAhAyya karave? kAphirerA to vibhrAntite raYeche|
emana ke Ache, ye tomAdera jIvanopakaraNa dAna karave, tini yadi jIvanopakaraNa vandha kare dena? vastutaH tArA avAdhyatA o satya vimukhatAYa avicala raYeche|
ye vyakti mukhe bhara diYe jhuke cale se ki Thika pathe cale, nA ki sei vyakti ye sarala pathe cale?
valaH tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena evaM tomAderake diYechena zravaNazakti, dRSTizakti o antaHkaraNa| tomarA alpai kRtajJatA prakAza kare thAka|
valaH tinii pRthivIte tomAderake char3iYe diYechena evaM tA~rai nikaTa tomAderake samaveta karA have|
tArA valeH tomarA yadi satyavAdI hao tAhale vala, ei pratizruti kakhana vAstavAYita have?
valaH era jJAna zudhu AllAharai nikaTa Ache, Amito spaSTa satarkakArI mAtra|
yakhana oTA Asanna dekhave takhana kAphiradera mukhamanDala mlAna haYe yAve evaM tAderake valA haveH eTAito tomarA cAcchile|

valaH tomarA bheve dekhecha ki - yadi AllAha AmAke o AmAra saGgIderake dhvaMsa karena athavA AmAdera prati daYA pradarzana karena tAte kAphiradera ki? tAderake ke rakSA karave vedanAdAYaka zAsti hate?
valaH tini daYAmaYa, AmarA tA~ke vizvAsa kari o tA~rai upara nirbhara kari, zIghrai tomarA jAnate pArave ke spaSTa vibhrAntite raYeche|
valaH tomarA bheve dekhecha ki, kono eka bhore yadi pAni bhU-garbhe tomAdera nAgAlera vAire cale yAYa tAhale ke tomAderake ene dive pravAhamAna pAni?
nuna, zapatha kalamera evaM orA yA lipivaddha kare tAra|
tomAra ravera anugrahe tumi ummAda nao|
tomAra janya avazyai raYeche niravacchinna puraskAra|
tumi avazyai mahAna caritrera adhikArI|
zIghrai tumi dekhave evaM tArAo dekhave –
tomAdera madhye ke vikAragrasta|
tomAra rAvvato samyaka avagata Achena ye, ke tA~ra patha hate vicyuta haYeche evaM tini jAnena tAderake yArA sat pathaprApta|
sutarAM tumi mithyAcArIdera anusaraNa karanA|
tArA cAYa ye, tumi namanIYa hao, tAhale tArAo namanIYa have|
evaM anusaraNa karanA tAra ye kathAYa kathAYa zapatha kare, ye lAJchita –
pazcAte nindAkArI, ye ekera kathA aparera nikaTa lAgiYe ver3AYa –
ye kalyANera kAje vA~dhA dAna kare, se sImAlaMghanakArI, pApiSTha|
rUr3ha svabhAva evaM tadupari kukhyAta|
se dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite samRddhazAlI|
tAra nikaTa AmAra AYAta AvRtti karA hale se valeH eTAto sekAlera upakathA mAtra|
Ami tAra nAsikA dAgiYe diva|
Ami tAderake parIkSA karechi, yebhAve parIkSA karechilAma udyAna adhipatiderake, yakhana tArA zapatha karechila ye, tArA pratyuSe AharaNa karave vAgAnera phala,
evaM tArA inazAAllAha valeni|
ataHpara tomAra ravera nikaTa hate eka viparyaYa hAnA dila sei udyAne, yakhana tArA chila nidrita|
phale oTA dagdha haYe kRSNavarNa dhAraNa karala|
pratyuSe tArA eke aparake Deke valala –
tomarA yadi phala AharaNa karate cAo tAhale tarit vAgAne cala|
ataHpara tArA calalo nimna svare kathA valate valate|
adya yena tomAdera nikaTa kona abhAvagrasta vyakti praveza karate nA pAre|
ataHpara tArA nivRtta karate sakSama - ei vizvAsa niYe prabhAtakAle vAgAne yAtrA karala|
ataHpara tArA yakhana vAgAnera avasthA pratyakSa karala, tArA valalaH AmarAto dizA hAriYe phelechi!
nA, AmarAto vaJcita!
tAdera zreSTha vyakti valalaH Ami ki tomAderake valini? ekhana tomarA AllAhara pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karachanA kena?
takhana tArA valalaH AmarA AmAdera ravera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA karachi, AmarAto chilAma sImAlaMghanakArI|
ataHpara tArA eke aparera prati doSAropa karate lAgala|
tArA valalaH hAYa! durbhoga AmAdera! AmarAto chilAma sImAlaMghanakArI|
AmarA AzA rAkhi, AmAdera rAvva era parivarte AmAderake divena utkRSTatara udyAna; AmarA AmAdera ravera abhimukhI halAma|
zAsti erUpai haYe thAke evaM AkhirAtera zAsti kaThinatara, yadi tArA jAnata!
muttAkIdera janya avazyai raYeche bhoga vilAsapUrNa jAnnAta, tAdera ravera nikaTa|
Ami ki AtmasamarpanakArIderake aparAdhIdera sadRza ganya karava?
tomAdera ki haYeche? tomAdera e kemana siddhAnta?
tomAdera nikaTa ki kona kitAva Ache yA tomarA adhyaYana kara –
ye, tomAdera janya ote raYeche yA tomarA pachanda kara?
Ami ki tomAdera sAthe kiYAmAta paryanta valavat emana kona pratijJAYa Avaddha Achi ye, tomarA nijedera janya yA sthira karave tA pAve?
tumi tAderake jijJesa kara, tAdera madhye ei dAvIra yimmAdAra ke?
tAdera ki kona zarIka Ache? thAkale tArA tAdera zarIkadera upasthita karuka, yadi tArA satyavAdI haYa|
smaraNa kara, gochA paryanta pA kholAra dinera kathA, sedina tAderake AhavAna karA have sAjadAha karAra janya, kintu tArA tA karate sakSama havenA|
tAdera dRSTi avanata, hInatA tAderake Acchanna karave, athaca yakhana tArA nirApada chila takhanato tAderake AhavAna karA haYechila sAjadAha karate|
yArA AmAke evaM ei vANIke pratyAkhyAna kare tAderake cher3e dAo AmAra hAte, Ami tAderake emanabhAve krame krame dharava ye, tArA jAnate pAravenA|
Ara Ami tAderake samaYa diYe thAki, AmAra kauzala atyanta valiSTha|
tumi ki tAdera nikaTa pArizramika cAccha ye, tArA eke ekaTi durvaha danDa mane kare?
tAdera ki adRzyera jJAna Ache ye, tArA tA likhe rAkhe?
ataeva tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara tomAra ravera nirdezera apekSAYa, tumi matsya sahacarera nyAYa adhairya haYonA, se viSAda Acchanna avasthAYa kAtara prArthanA karachila|
tAra ravera anugraha tAra nikaTa nA pau~chale se lAJchita haYe nikSipta hata unmukta prAntare|
punarAYa tAra rAvva tAke manonIta karalena evaM tAke sat karmaparAYaNadera antarbhukta karalena|
kAphirerA yakhana kuraAna zravaNa kare takhana tArA yena uhAdera tIkSNa dRSTi dvArA tomAke Achar3e phele dive evaM valave ‘‘eto eka pAgala’’|
kuraAnato vizva jagatera janya upadeza|
sei avazyambhAvI ghaTanA|
ki sei avazyambhAvI ghaTanA?
kise tomAke jAnAve sei avazyambhAvI ghaTanA ki?
‘‘Ada o sAmUda’’ sampradAYa asvIkAra karechila mahApralaYa|
Ara sAmUda sampradAYa - tAderake dhvaMsa karA haYechila eka pralaYaMkara viparyaYa dvArA|
Ara ‘Ada’ sampradAYa - tAderake dhvaMsa karA haYechila eka pracanDa jhaJjhAvAYu dvArA|

yA tini tAdera upara pravAhita karechilena sAta rAta o ATa dina virAmahInabhAve; tumi yadi takhana ukta sampradAYake dekhate tAhale dekhate pete ye, tArA sekhAne luTiYe par3e Ache vikSipta asAra khejura kAnDera nyAYa|
tumi tAdera kono astitva dekhate pAo ki?
phira‘Auna, tAra pUrvavartIrA evaM lUta sampradAYa pApAcAre lipta chila|
tArA tAdera ravera rAsUlake amAnya karechila, phale tini tAderake zAsti dena, kaThora sei zAsti!
yakhana plAvana haYechila takhana Ami tomAderake (mAnava jAtike) ArohaNa kariYechilAma nauyAne|
Ami uhA karechilAma tomAdera zikSAra janya evaM e janya ye, zrutidhara karNa ihA saMrakSaNa kare|
yakhana ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have, ekaTi mAtra phutkAra,
parvatamAlA sameta pRthivI utkSipta have evaM ekai dhAkkAYa tArA cUrNa vicUrNa haYe yAve|
sedina saMghaTita have mahA pralaYa|
evaM AkAza vidIrNa haYe vikSipta haYe par3ave|
mAlAikA/pherezatArA AkAzera prAntadeze thAkave evaM sedina ATajana mAlAikA/pherezatA tAdera ravera ‘Arazake dhAraNa karave tAdera urdhve|
sei dina upasthita karA have tomAderake evaM tomAdera kichui gopana thAkavenA|
takhana yAke tAra ‘AmalanAmA DAna hAte deYA have se valaveH nAo, AmAra ‘AmalanAmA pATha kare dekha|
Ami jAnatAma ye, AmAke hisAvera sammukhIna hate have|
sutarAM se yApana karave santoSajanaka jIvana –
sumahAna jAnnAte –
yAra phalarAzi avanamita thAkave nAgAlera madhye|
tAderake valA haveH pAnAhAra kara tRptira sAthe, tomarA atIta dine yA karechile tAra vinimaYe|
kintu yAra ‘AmalanAmA tAra vAma haste deYA have se valaveH ‘hAYa! AmAke yadi deYAi nA hata AmAra ‘AmalanAmA!
evaM Ami yadi nA jAnatAma AmAra hisAva!
hAYa! AmAra mRtyui yadi AmAra zeSa hata!
AmAra dhanasampada AmAra kona kAjei elonA|
AmAra kSamatAo apasRta haYeche|
mAlAikA/pherezatAderake valA haveH dhara oke, galadeze ver3i pariYe dAo|
ataHpara nikSepa kara jAhAnnAme|
punarAYa tAke zRMkhalita kara sattara hAta dIrgha eka zRMkhale|
se mahAna AllAhaYa vizvAsI chilanA|
evaM abhAvagrastake khAdyadAne utsAhita karatanA|
ataeva sedina sekhAne tAra kona suhRda thAkavenA|
evaM kona khAdya thAkavenA, kSataniHsRta srAva vyatIta|
yA aparAdhI vyatIta keha khAvenA|
Ami kasama karachi uhAra yA tomarA dekhate pAo|
evaM yA tomarA dekhate pAonA –
nizcaYai ei kuraAna eka sammAnita rAsUlera vAhita vArtA|
ihA kona kavira racanA naYa; tomarA alpai vizvAsa kara|
ihA kona gaNakera kathAo naYa, tomarA alpai anudhAvana kara|
ihA jagatasamUhera ravera nikaTa hate avatIrNa|
se yadi AmAra nAme kichu racanA kare cAlAte ceSTA karata –
Ami avazyai tAra DAna hAta dhare phelatAma|
evaM keTe ditAma tAra jIvana-dhamanI|
ataHpara tomAdera madhye emana keha nei ye, tAke rakSA karate pArave|
ei kuraAna muttAkIdera janya avazyai eka upadeza|
Ami avazyai jAni ye, tomAdera madhye mithyA AropakArI raYeche|
evaM ei kuraAna nizcaYai kAphiradera anuzocanAra kAraNa have|
avazyai eTA nizcita satya|
ataeva tumi mahAna ravera nAmera pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
eka vyakti cAila saMghaTita hoka zAsti yA avadhArita –
kAphiradera janya, ihA pratirodha karAra keha nei|
ihA Asave AllAhara nikaTa hate yini samucca maryAdAra adhikArI|
mAlAikA/pherezatA evaM rUha AllAhara dike urdhvagAmI haYa emana ekadine, yA pArthiva paJcAza hAjAra vatsarera samAna|
sutarAM tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara, parama dhairya|
tArA ai dinake mane kare sudUra|
kintu Ami dekhachi ihA Asanna|
sedina AkAza have galita dhAtura mata|
evaM parvatasamUha have raGgIna pazamera mata|
evaM suhRda suhRdera kho~ja khavara nivenA|
tAderake karA have eke aparera dRSTigocara| aparAdhI sedinera zAstira vadale dite cAve tAra santAna-santatike,
tAra strI o bhAike,
tAra jJAti goSThike yArA tAke AzraYa dita –
evaM pRthivIra sakalake, yAte ei muktipaNa tAke mukti deYa|
nA, kakhanai naYa, ihAto lelihAna agni –
yA gAtra hate cAmar3A khasiYe dive|
jAhAnnAma sei vyaktike DAkave, ye satyera prati pRSTha pradarzana karechila o mukha phiriYe niYechila –
ye sampada puJjIbhuta evaM saMrakSita kare rAkhachila|
mAnuSato sRSTi haYeche atizaYa asthira citta rUpe|
yakhana vipada tAke sparza kare se haYa hA hutAzakArI|
Ara yakhana kalyANa tAke sparza kare takhana se haYa ati kRpaNa|
tave sAlAta AdAYakArI vyatIta|
yArA tAdera sAlAte sadA niSThAvAna|
Ara yAdera sampadera nirdhArita haka raYeche –
prArthI o vaJcitera|
evaM yArA karmaphala dinake satya vale jAne|
Ara yArA tAdera ravera zAsti samparke bhIta santrasta,
nizcaYai tAdera ravera zAsti hate niHzaGka thAkA yAYanA –
evaM yArA nijedera yaunAGgake saMyata rAkhe|
tAdera strI athavA adhikArabhukta dAsIdera kSetra vyatIta, ete tArA nindanIYa havenA –
tave keha ederake chAr3A anyake kAmanA karale tArA have sImAlaMghanakArI|
evaM yArA AmAnAta o pratizruti rakSA kare|
Ara yArA tAdera sAkSya dAne aTala,
evaM nijedera sAlAte yatnavAna –
tArAi sammAnita have jAnnAte|
kAphiradera hala ki ye, orA tomAra dike chuTe Asache –
DAna o vAma dika hate dale dale?
tAdera pratyeke ki ei pratyAzA kare ye, tAke dAkhila karA have prAcuryamaYa jAnnAte?
nA tA havenA, Ami tAderake yA hate sRSTi karechi tA tArA jAne|
Ami zapatha karachi udaYAcala o astAcalera adhipatira! nizcaYai Ami sakSama –
tAdera apekSA utkRSTatara mAnavagoSThI tAdera sthalavartI karate; evaM Ami akSama nai|
ataeva tAderake vAka-vitanDA o krIr3A kautuke matta thAkate dAo, ye dina samparke tAderake satarka karA haYechila tAra sammukhIna haoYAra pUrva paryanta|
sedina tArA kAvara hate vera have druta vege| mane have tArA kona ekaTi lakSyasthalera dike dhAvita hacche –
avanata netre; hInatA tAderake Acchanna karave; eTAi sedina, ye viSaYe satarka karA haYechila tAderake|
nUhake Ami preraNa karechilAma tAra sampradAYera prati ei nirdezasahaH tumi tomAra sampradAYake satarka kara tAdera prati zAsti AsAra pUrve|
se valechilaH he AmAra sampradAYa! Amito tomAdera janya spaSTa satarkakArI –
e viSaYe ye, tomarA AllAhara ivAdAta kara, tA~ke bhaYa kara evaM AmAra Anugatya kara|
tini tomAdera pApa kSamA karavena evaM tini tomAderake avakAza divena eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta; nizcaYai AllAha kartRka nirdhArita kAla upasthita hale uhA vilamvita haYanA; yadi tomarA eTA jAnate|
se valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! Amito AmAra sampradAYake dina-rAta AhavAna karachi|
kintu AmAra AhavAna tAdera palAYana pravaNatAi vRddhi karache|
Ami yakhana tAdera AhavAna kari yAte tumi tAderake kSamA kara, tArA kAne aMguli deYa, nijederake vastrAvRta kare o jida karate thAke evaM atizaYa auddhatya prakAza kare|
ataHpara Ami tAdera AhavAna karechi prakAzye|
pare Ami soccAra pracAra karechi o upadeza diYechi gopane|
valechiH tomAdera ravera kAche kSamA prArthanA kara, tinito mahA kSamAzIla|
tini tomAdera janya pracura vRSTipAta ghaTAvena|
tini tomAdera samRddha karavena dhana-sampada o santAna-santatite evaM tomAdera janya sthApana karavena udyAna o pravAhita karavena nadI-nAlA|
tomAdera ki haYeche ye, tomarA AllAhara zreSThatva svIkAra karate cAcchanA?
athaca tinii tomAderake sRSTi karechena paryAYakrame|
tomarA ki lakSya karanA AllAha kibhAve sRSTi karechena sapta AkAza stare stare?
evaM sekhAne cA~dake sthApana karechena Aloka rUpe o sUryake sthApana karechena pradIpa rUpe;
tini tomAderake sRSTi karechena mRttikA hate|
ataHpara tAte tini tomAdera pratyAvRtta karavena o pare punarutthita karavena|
evaM AllAha tomAdera janya bhUmike karechena vistRta –
yAte tomarA calAphirA karate pAra prazasta pathe|
nUha valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! AmAra sampradAYato AmAke amAnya karache evaM anusaraNa karache emana lokera yAra dhana sampada o santAna-santati tAra kSati vyatIta Ara kichui vRddhi kareni|
tArA bhaYAnaka Sar3ayantra karechila|
evaM valechilaH tomarA kakhanao parityAga karanA tomAdera deva-devIke; parityAga karanA oYAda, suoYA, Agucha, Auka o nAsarake|
tArA anekake vibhrAnta karache; sutarAM yAlimadera vibhrAnti vyatIta Ara kichui vRddhi karenA|
tAdera aparAdhera janya tAderake nimajjita karA haYechila evaM pare tAderake dAkhila karA haYechila Agune, ataHpara tArA kehakeo AllAhara mukAvilAYa pAYani sAhAyyakArI|
nUha Arao valechilaH he AmAra rAvva! pRthivIte kAphiradera madhya hate kona gRhavAsIke avyAhati dionA|
tumi tAderake avyAhati dile tArA tomAra vAndAderake vibhrAnta karave evaM janma dite thAkave kevala duskRtikArI o kAphira|
he AmAra rAvva! tumi kSamA kara AmAke, AmAra mAtA-pitAke evaM yArA mu’mina haYe AmAra gRhe praveza kare tAderake evaM mu’mina puruSa o mu’minA nArIderake; Ara yAlimadera zudhu dhvaMsai vRddhi kara|
valaH AmAra prati ahI prerita haYeche ye, jinadera ekaTi dala manoyoga sahakAre zravaNa kareche evaM valeche, AmarAto eka vismaYakara kuraAna zravaNa karechi –
yA saThika patha nirdeza kare; phale AmarA ete vizvAsa sthApana karechi| AmarA kakhanao AmAdera ravera sAthe kona zarIka sthira karavanA|
evaM nizcaYai samucca AmAdera ravera maryAdA; tini grahaNa karenani kona patnI evaM nA kona santAna|
evaM AmAdera madhyakAra nirvodharA AllAha samvandhe ati avAstava ukti karata|
athaca AmarA mane karatAma mAnuSa evaM jina, AllAha samvandhe kakhanao mithyA Aropa karavenA|
Ara ye katipaYa mAnuSa kataka jinera smaraNa nita, phale tArA jinadera AtmambharitA vAr3iYe dita|
Ara jinarA valechilaH tomAdera mata mAnuSao mane kare ye, mRtyura para AllAha kehakeo punarutthita karavenanA|
evaM AmarA ceYechilAma AkAzera tathya saMgraha karate| kintu AmarA dekhate pelAma kaThora praharI o ulkApinDa dvArA AkAza paripUrNa|
Ara pUrve AmarA AkAzera vibhinna ghA~Tite saMvAda zonAra janya vasatAma| kintu ekhana keha saMvAda zunate cAile se tAra upara nikSepera janya prastuta jvalanta ulkApinDera sammukhIna haYa|
AmarA jAninA, jagatavAsIra amaMgalai abhipreta, nA ki tAdera rAvva tAdera maMgala karAra icchA rAkhena|
evaM AmAdera kataka sat karmaparAYaNa evaM kataka era vyatikrama, AmarA chilAma vibhinna pathera anusArI;
ekhana AmarA vujhechi ye, AmarA pRthivIte AllAhake parAbhUta karate pAravanA evaM palAYana kareo tA~ke vyartha karate pAravanA|
AmarA yakhana patha nirdezaka vANI zunalAma takhana tAte vizvAsa sthApana karalAma| ye vyakti tAra ravera prati ImAna Ane tAra kona kSati kiMvA jora javaradastira AzaMkA thAkavenA|
AmAdera kataka AtmasamaparNakArI evaM kataka sImA laMghanakArI; yArA AtmasamarpaNa kare tArA sucintitabhAve satya patha veche neYa|
apara pakSe sImA laMghanakArIto jAhAnnAmerai indhana|
tArA yadi satya pathe pratiSThita thAkata, tAderake Ami pracura vAri varSaNera mAdhyame samRddha karatAma –
yadvArA Ami tAderake parIkSA karatAma| ye vyakti tAra ravera smaraNa hate vimukha haYa tini tAke duHsaha zAstite praveza karAvena|
evaM ei ye mAsajidasamUha, AllAharai janya| sutarAM AllAhara sAthe tomarA anya kehakeo DekanA|
Ara ei ye, yakhana AllAhara vAndA tA~ke DAkAra janya danDAYamAna hala takhana tArA tAra nikaTa bhir3a jamAlo|
valaH Ami AmAra rAvvake DAki evaM tA~ra sAthe kehake zarIka karinA|
valaH Ami tomAdera maGgala-amaGgalera mAlika nai|
valaH AllAhara zAsti hate keha AmAke rakSA karate pAravenA evaM AllAha vyatIta Ami kona AzraYa pAvanA|
kevala AllAhara vANI pau~chAno evaM tA pracAra karAi AmAra kAja| yArA AllAha o tA~ra rAsUlake amAnya kare tAdera janya raYeche jAhAnnAmera Aguna, sekhAne tArA cirasthAYI have|
yakhana tArA pratizruti pratyakSa karave takhana tArA vujhate pArave, ke sAhAyyakArIra dika diYe durvala evaM ke saMkhyAYa svalpa|
valaH Ami jAninA tomAderake ye zAstira pratizruti deYA haYeche tA ki Asanna, nA ki AmAra rAvva era janya kona dIrgha meYAda sthira karavena?
tini adRzyera parijJAtA, tini tA~ra adRzyera jJAna kArao nikaTa prakAza karenanA –
tA~ra manonIta rAsUla vyatIta| sekSetre AllAha rAsUlera agre evaM pazcAte praharI niYojita karena,
rAsUlagaNa tAdera ravera vANI pau~che diYechena ki nA jAnAra janya| rAsUlagaNera nikaTa yA Ache tA tA~ra jJAna gocara evaM tini samasta kichura vistArita hisAva rAkhena|
he vastrAvRta!
rAta jAgaraNa kara kichu aMza vyatIta|
ardha rAta kiMvA tadapekSA kichu kama|
athavA tadapekSA vezI| Ara kuraAna AvRtti kara dhIre dhIre spaSTa o sundarabhAve|
Ami tomAra prati avatIrNa karechi gurutvapUrNa vANI|
nizcaYai rAte jAgaraNa ivAdAtera janya gabhIra manoniveza, hRdaYaGgama evaM spaSTa uccAraNe anukUla|
dine tomAra janya raYeche dIrgha karmavyastatA|
sutarAM tumi tomAra ravera nAma smaraNa kara evaM ekaniSThabhAve tAte magna hao|
tini pUrva o pazcimera rAvva, tini vyatIta kona ilAha nei; ataeva tA~kei karma-vidhAYaka rUpe grahaNa kara|
loke yA vale, tAte tumi dhairya dhAraNa kara evaM saujanya sahakAre uhAderake parihAra kare cala|
cher3e dAo AmAke evaM vilAsa sAmagrIra adhikArI satya pratyAkhyAnakArIderake; Ara kichu kAlera janya tAderake avakAza dAo|
AmAra nikaTa Ache zRMkhala prajjvalita Aguna|
Ara Ache emana khAdya yA galAYa ATake yAYa evaM marmantada zAsti|
sei dine pRthivI o parvatamAlA prakampita have evaM parvatasamUha vahamAna vAlukArAzite pariNata have|
Ami tomAdera nikaTa pAThiYechi rAsUla tomAdera janya svAkSI svarUpa, yemana rAsUla pAThiYechilAma phiraAunera nikaTa|
kintu phira‘Auna sei rAsUlake amAnya karechila, phale Ami tAke kaThina zAsti diYechilAma|
ataeva yadi tomarA kupharI kara, ki kare AtmarakSA karave sedina yedina zizuderake pariNata karave vRddhe?
yedina AkAza have vidIrNa; tA~ra pratizruti avazyai vAstavAYita have|
ihA eka upadeza, ataeva yAra abhiruci se tAra ravera patha avalamvana karuka!

tomAra rAvvato jAnena ye, tumi jAgaraNa kara kakhanao rAtera prAYa dui tRtIYAMza, ardhAMza o eka-tRtIYAMza evaM jAge tomAra saMge yArA Ache tAdera ekaTi dalao evaM AllAhai nirdhAraNa karena dina o rAtera parimANa| tini jAnena ye, tomarA era saThika hisAva rAkhate pAranA, ataeva AllAha tomAdera prati kSamA paravaza haYechena| ataeva kuraAnera yataTuku AvRtti karA tomAdera janya sahaja tataTuku AvRtti kara; AllAha jAnena ye, tomAdera madhye keha keha asustha haYe par3ave, keha keha AllAhara anugraha sandhAne deza bhramaNa karave evaM keha keha AllAhara pathe saMgrAme lipta have| ataeva kuraAna hate yataTuku sahajasAdhya AvRtti kara| sAlAta kAYema kara, yAkAta pradAna kara evaM AllAhake dAo uttama RNa| tomarA tomAdera AtmAra maGgalera janya bhAla yA kichu agrima preraNa karave tomarA tA pAve AllAhara nikaTa| uhA utkRSTatara evaM puraskAra hisAve mahattara| Ara tomarA kSamA prArthanA kara AllAhara nikaTa| nizcaYai AllAha kSamAzIla, parama daYAlu|
he vastrAcchAdita!
uTha, satarka vANI pracAra kara|
evaM tomAra ravera zreSThatva ghoSaNA kara|
tomAra paricchada pariskAra rAkha|
apavitratA hate dUre thAka|
adhika pAoYAra pratyAzAYa dAna karanA|
evaM tomAra ravera uddezye dhairya dhara|
yedina ziGgAYa phutkAra deYA have –
sedina have eka saMkaTera dina –
yA kAphiradera janya sahaja naYa|
AmAke cher3e dAo evaM tAke, yAke Ami sRSTi karechi asAdhAraNa kare|
Ami tAke diYechi vipula dhana sampada|
evaM nitya saGgI putragaNa|
evaM tAke diYechi svacchandamaYa jIvanera pracura upakaraNa|
era parao se kAmanA kare ye, Ami tAke Arao adhika dii|
nA, tA havenA, seto AmAra nidarzanasamUhera auddhata viruddhAcArI|
Ami acirei tAke kramavardhamAna zAsti dvArA Acchanna karava|
se cintA karala evaM siddhAnta grahaNa karala|
abhizapta hoka se! kemana kare se e siddhAnta grahaNa karala!
Arao abhizapta hoka se! kemana kare se ei siddhAnte upanIta hala!
se AvAra ceYe dekhala|
ataHpara se bhru kuJcita karala o mukha vikRta karala|
ataHpara se pRSTha pradarzana karala evaM ahaMkAra karala|
evaM ghoSaNA karala, eto loka paramparAYa prApta yAdu bhinna Ara kichu naYa|
eTAto mAnuSerai kathA|
Ami tAke nikSepa karava sAkAra-e|
tumi ki jAna sAkAra ki?
uhA tAdera jIvitAvasthAYa rAkhavenA evaM mRta avasthAYao cher3e divenA|
uhAto gAtracarma dagdha karave|
uhAra tattvAvadhAne raYeche uniza jana praharI|

Ami tAderake karechi jAhAnnAmera praharI| kAphiradera parIkSA svarUpa| Ami tAdera ei saMkhyA ullekha karechi yAte kitAvIdera dRr3ha pratyaYa janme, vizvAsIdera vizvAsa vardhita haYa evaM vizvAsIrA o kitAvIrA sandeha poSaNa nA kare| era phale yAdera antare vyAdhi Ache tArA o kAphirerA valaveH AllAha ei abhinava ukti dvArA ki vujhAte ceYechena? ebhAve AllAha yAke icchA pathabhraSTa karena evaM yAke icchA patha nirdeza karena| tomAra ravera vAhinI samparke ekamAtra tinii jAnena| eTAto mAnuSera janya sAvadhAna vANI|
kakSano nA, candrera zapatha!
zapatha rAtera, yakhana tAra avasAna ghaTe|
zapatha prabhAtakAlera, yakhana uhA haYa Alokojjvala|
nizcaYai jAhAnnAma bhaYAvaha vipadasamUhera anyatama|
mAnuSera janya satarkakArI|
tomAdera madhye ye agrasara hate cAYa kiMvA ye pichiYe par3e, tAra janya|
pratyeka vyakti nija kRtakarmera dAYe Avaddha|
tave DAna pArzvastha vyaktigaNera naYa|
tArA thAkave udyAne evaM tArA paraspare jijJAsAvAda karave –
aparAdhIdera samparke,
tomAderake kise jAhAnnAme nikSepa kareche?
tArA valaveH AmarA sAlAta AdAYa karatAmanA –
AmarA abhAvagrastake AhArya dAna karatAmanA|
evaM AmarA AlocanAkArIdera sAthe AlocanAYa nimagna thAkatAma –
AmarA karmaphala dina asvIkAra karatAma –
AmAdera nikaTa mRtyura Agamana paryanta|
phale supArizakArIdera supAriza tAdera kona kAje AsavenA|
tAdera ki haYeche ye, tArA mukha phiriYe neYa upadeza hate?
tArA yena bhIta- santrastha gardabha –
yA siMhera sammukha hate palAYanapara|
vastutaH tAdera pratyekei kAmanA kare ye, tAke ekaTi ummukta grantha deYA hoka|
nA ihA havAra naYa, varaM tArAto AkhirAtera bhaYa poSaNa karenA|
kakhanao nA, eTAto upadeza mAtra|
ataeva yAra icchA se ihA hate upadeza grahaNa karuka|
AllAhara icchA chAr3A keha upadeza grahaNa karavenA, ekamAtra tinii bhaYera yogya evaM tinii kSamA karAra adhikArI|
Ami zapatha karachi kiYAmAta divasera|
Arao zapatha karachi tiraskArakArI AtmAra|
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, Ami tAra asthisamUha ekatra karate pAravanA?
vastutaH Ami tAra aGgulIra agrabhAga paryanta punaH vinyasta karate sakSama|
tavuo mAnuSa tAra sammukhe yA Ache tA asvIkAra karate cAYa;
se prazna kareH kakhana kiYAmAta divasa Asave?
yakhana cakSu sthira haYe yAve|
evaM cA~da haYe par3ave jyotihIna|
yakhana sUrya o cA~dake ekatra karA have|
sedina mAnuSa valaveH Aja pAlAnora sthAna kothAYa?
nA, kona AzraYasthala nei|
sedina ThA~i have tomAra ravera nikaTa|
sedina mAnuSake avahita karA have se ki agre pAThiYeche evaM ki pazcAte rekhe geche|
vastutaH mAnuSa nijera samvandhe samyaka avagata|
yadio se nAnA ajuhAtera avatAraNA kare|
tAr3AtAr3i ahI AYattva karAra janya tumi tomAra jihavA drutatAra sAthe saJcAlana karanA|
ihA saMrakSaNa o pATha karAnora dAYitva AmArai|
sutarAM yakhana Ami uhA pATha karAi tumi sei pAThera anusaraNa kara|
ataHpara era vizada vyAkhyAra dAYitva AmArai|
nA, tomarA prakRta pakSe pArthiva jIvanake bhAlavAsa|
evaM AkhirAtake upekSA kara|
sedina kona kona mukhamanDala ujjvala have|
tArA tAdera ravera dike tAkiYe thAkave|
kona kona mukhamanDala haYe par3ave vivarNa|
evaM ei AzaMkAYa ye, eka dhvaMsakArI viparyaYa Asanna|
yakhana prANa kanThAgata have|
evaM valA haveH ke tAke rakSA karave?
takhana tAra pratyaYa have ye, uhA vidAYakSaNa|
evaM pAYera saMge pA jar3iYe yAve|
sedina tomAra ravera nikaTa samasta kichu pratyAnIta have|
se vizvAsa kareni evaM sAlAta AdAYa kareni|
varaM se pratyAkhyAna karechila o mukha phiriYe niYechila|
ataHpara se tAra parivAra parijanera nikaTa phire giYechila dambhabhare|
tomAra durbhogera upara durbhoga!
AvAra tomAra durbhogera upara durbhoga!
mAnuSa ki mane kare ye, tAke nirarthaka cher3e deYA have?
se ki skhalita zukravindu chilanA?
ataHpara se raktapinDe pariNata haYa| tArapara AllAha tAke AkRti dAna karena o suThAma karena|
ataHpara tini tA hate sRSTi karena yugala nara o nArI|
tavuo ki sei sraSTA mRtake punarjIvita karate sakSama nana?
kAla-pravAhe mAnuSera upara eka samaYa ativAhita haYeche yakhana se ullekhayogya kichu chilanA|
Ami to mAnuSake sRSTi karechi milita zukravindu hate, tAke parIkSA karAra janya; e janya Ami tAke karechi zravaNa o dRSTizaktisampanna|
Ami tAke pathera nirdeza diYechi; haYa se kRtajJa have, nA haYa se akRtajJa have|
Ami akRtajJadera janya prastuta rekhechi zRMkhala, ver3i o lelihAna agni|
sat karmazIlarA pAna karave mizrita pAnIYa ‘kAphura’ –
emana ekaTi prasravaNera yA hate AllAhara vAndAgaNa pAna karave, tArA ei prasravaNake yekhAne icchA pravAhita karate pArave|
tArA kartavya pAlana kare evaM sedinera bhaYa kare, yedina vipatti have vyApaka|
tAdera cAhidA thAkA sattveo AllAhara santuSTira janya misakIna, iYAtIma o vandIke AhArya dAna kare|
evaM valeH kevala AllAhara santuSTi lAbhera uddezye AmarA tomAderake AhArya dAna kari, AmarA tomAdera nikaTa hate pratidAna cAinA, kRtajJatAo naYa|
AmarA AzaMkA kari AmAdera ravera nikaTa hate eka bhItiprada bhaYaMkara dinera|
pariNAme AllAha tAderake rakSA karavena sei dinera aniSTatA hate evaM tAderake divena utphullatA o Ananda|
Ara tAdera dhairyazIlatAra puraskAra svarUpa tAderake deYA have jAnnAta o rezamI vastra|
sekhAne tArA samAsIna have susajjita Asane, tArA sekhAne atizaYa garama o atizaYa zIta anubhava karavenA|
uhAra vRkSachAYA tAdera upara jhuke thAkave evaM era phalamUla sampUrNa rUpe tAdera nAgAlera madhye thAkave|
tAderake parivezana karA haYe raupya pAtre evaM sphaTikera mata svaccha pAna pAtre|
rUpAlI sphaTika pAtre parivezanakArIrA yathAyatha parimANe uhA pUrNa karave|
sekhAne tAdera pAna karate deYA have yAnayAvIla mizrita pAnIYa –
jAnnAtera emana eka prasavaNera yAra nAma sAlasAvIla|
tAderake parivezana karave cira kizoragaNa, tAderake dekhe mane have tArA yena vikSipta muktA|
tumi yakhana sekhAne dekhave, dekhate pAve bhoga vilAsera upakaraNa evaM vizAla rAjya|
tAdera AvaraNa have sUkSNa savuja rezama o sthula rezama; tArA alaMkRta have raupya nirmita kaMkane, Ara tAdera rAvva tAderake pAna karAvena vizuddha pAnIYa|
avazyai eTAi tomAdera puraskAra evaM tomAdera karmapraceSTA svIkRti prApta|
Ami tomAra prati kuraAna avatIrNa karechi paryAYakrame|
sutarAM dhairyera sAthe tomAra ravera nirdezera pratIkSA kara evaM tAdera madhya kono pApISTha athavA kAphirera Anugatya karanA|
evaM tomAra ravera nAma smaraNa kara sakAla sandhyAYa|
rAtera kiYadaMza tA~ra prati sAjadAYa nata hao evaM rAtera dIrgha samaYa tA~ra pavitratA o mahimA ghoSaNA kara|
tArA bhAlavAse pArthiva jIvanake evaM paravartI kaThina dinake tArA upekSA kare cale|
Ami tAdera sRSTi karechi evaM tAdera gaThana sudRr3ha karechi| Ami yakhana icchA karava takhana tAdera parivarte tAdera anurUpa eka jAtike pratiSThita karava|
ihA eka upadeza, ataeva yAra icchA se tAra ravera patha avalamvana karuka|
tomarA icchA karavenA yadi nA AllAha icchA karena| AllAha sarvajJa, prajJAmaYa|
tini yAke icchA tA~ra anugrahera antarbhukta karena, kintu yAlimadera janyato tini prastuta rekhechena marmantada zAsti|
zapatha kalyANa svarUpa prerita vAYura;
Ara pralaYaGkarI jhaTikAra;
zapatha saJcAlanakArI vAYura;
Ara meghapuJja vicchinnakArI vAYura|
evaM tAra, ye mAnuSera antare pau~che deYa upadeza –
anuzocanA svarUpa athavA satarkatA svarUpa|
nizcaYai tomAderake ye pratizruti deYA haYeche tA avazyambhAvI|
yakhana nakSatrarAjira Alo nirvApita have,
yakhana AkAza vidIrNa have,
evaM yakhana parvatamAlA ummulita o vikSipta have,
evaM rAsUlagaNera nirUpita samaYa upasthita have|
ei samUdaYa sthagita rAkhA haYeche kona dinera janya?
vicAra dinera janya|
vicAra dina samvandhe tumi jAna ki?
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
Ami ki pUrvavartIderake dhvaMsa karini?
ataHpara Ami paravartIderake tAdera anugAmI karava|
aparAdhIdera prati Ami erUpai kare thAki|
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
Ami ki tomAderake tuccha pAni hate sRSTi karini?
ataHpara Ami tA sthApana karechi nirApada AdhAre|
eka nirdiSTa kAla paryanta|
Ami eTAke gaThana karechi parimitabhAve, Ami kata nipuNa sraSTA|
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
Ami ki bhUmike sRSTi karini dhAraNakArI rUpe –
jIvita o mRtera janya?
Ami tAte sthApana karechi sudRr3ha ucca parvatamAlA evaM tomAderake diYechi supeYa pAni|
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
tomarA yAke asvIkAra karate, cala tArai dike|
cala tina kunDala viziSTa chAYAra dike|
ye chAYA zItala naYa evaM yA rakSA karenA agni zikhA hate|
ihA utkSepa karave aTTAlikA tulya vRhat sphuliMga|
uhA pItavarNa uSTrazreNI sadRza|
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
ihA emana ekadina yedina kArao vAkasphurti havenA|
evaM tAderake oyara peza karAra anumati deYA havenA|
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
ihAi phAisAlAra dina, Ami ekatrita karava tomAderake evaM pUrvavartIderake|
tomAdera kona apakauzala thAkale tA praYoga kara AmAra viruddhe|
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
muttAkIrA thAkave chAYAYa o prasravaNa vahula sthAne|
tAdera vAJchita phalamUlera prAcuryera madhye|
tomAdera karmera puraskAra svarUpa tomarA tRptira sAthe pAnAhAra kara|
ebhAve Ami sat karmaparAYaNaderake puraskRta kare thAki|
sedina durbhoga mithyA AropakArIdera janya|
